༄༅/ /mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po rdo grub chen 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi ma dpal bzang po'i gsung 'bum legs bshad nor bu'i bang malngasad bzhugs/ si khron dpe skrun tshogs pa/ si khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang /

pod 5sngon 'gro'i gtam/gna' rtsom ni mi rigs srol rgyun rig gnas kyi grub cha gal chen zhig yin cing / krung hwa mi rigs kyi 'od stong 'bar ba'i rig gnas shul bzhag khrod kyi rin chen nor bu zhig yin/ de 'tshol sdud dang / dag sgrig tho 'god/ par skrun bcas byed rgyu ni rang re'i tang dang rgyal khab kyis mi rigs phul byung rig gnas rgyun 'dzin byed pa'i bya ba rlabs chen zhig yin pas/ rang rgyal mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong bca' khrims sogs bca' khrims dang srid jus su gsal bor gtan la phab yod cing / rim pa khag gi mi dmangs srid gzhung nas 'di phyogs kyi bya ba 'bor chen bsgrubs shing / grub 'bras g.yur du za ba blangs/ nye ba'i lo shas ring / rgyal srid spyi khyab khang nas grangs nyung mi rigs gna' rtsom nang du 'dus pa'i rang rgyal mi rigs gna' rtsom 'tshol sdud dang /dag sgrig tho 'god sogs byed pa'i thad ched du yig cha phud de gtan phab gsar ba mdzad cing / blang bya gsar ba bton/ spyi khyab hru'u ci nas kyang‘‘gna' rtsom dag sgrig par skrun sgos mes rgyal gyi phul byung rig gnas shul bzhag rgyun 'dzin byas te/ krung go'i 1nu

pod 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ khyad chos ldan pa'i spyi tshogs ring lugs 'dzugs skrun la zhabs 'degs zhu dgos’’zhes pa'i bka' slob legs par bstsal/gong gsal dgongs don lag star dngos 'bab byed ched/nga tshos rang skyong khul gyi don dngos dang zung 'brel byas te/ ched gnyer las khungs btsugs shing / ched mkhas mi sna skong 'then dang ci nus sgos mthun rkyen bskrun pa'i rmang gzhi'i steng de'i byed nus 'don skul byas te/ bya ba 'di cung snga ba'i sgo nas las 'go brtsams/nga tsho'i thog ma'i rgyus lon ltar na/ mgo log sa cha'i gna' rtsom la mtshon na thon khungs cung 'bel bo yin par ma zad/brgyud pa ring zhing / rnam grangs mang la/ khyab rgya che ba dang / nang gses rigs kyis dbye na'ang brda sprod dang / rtsom rig lo rgyus/gso rig mtshan nyid rig pa/ rtsis gzhung / nang don rig pa sogs bod kyi srol rgyun rig gnas kyi khyab khongs phal mo che zin cing / dpe rgyun dkon zhing rtsa chen du brtsi rung ba'i gna' gzhung yang mi nyung bar 'dugade phyir thog ma'i 'tshol sdud tsam gyi rmang gzhi'i steng /1993lo nas bzung ste/ mgo log sa cha'i mkhas dbang rim byon gyi gsung rtsom gces bsgrigs dpe tshogs kyi tshal du〈khra dge slong tshal rigang rigang 2

sngon 'gro'i gtam/ pod 5khrims dar rgyas kyi gsung rtsom gces bsgrigs〉sogs snga gzhug tu deb lnga drug tsam par skrun byas te/ rgya che'i klog pa po'i spyan sngar rim par bstar bas/ kun gyi gdeng 'jog legs po byung zhing /bya ba de la 'brel yod sde khag gis mthong gzigs gnang ste/ ched gnyer las khungs dang mi sna sogs la zhing chen rim pa'i gna' rtsom 'tshol sdud myur skyob kyi bya dga' dang gzengs bstod kyi dbugs dbyung thengs du mar gnang / nye lam rgyal khab mi rigs don byed u yon lhan khang gis〈krung go'i grangs nyung mi rigs gna' rtsom spyi byang gnad bsdus〉lag star byed pa'i shar rlung gi 'gros dang bstun zhing / rang skyong khul gyi srid dbang btsugs nas lo 'khor lnga bcu 'khor bar sngon bsu zhu ba'i sta gon rtsom pa dang 'brel/ khul gna' rtsom bya ba'i gzhung las khang gis sngar gyi rmang gzhi'i steng rim pa spaṭa shing gzhi rgya bskyed de/ slar yang〈mgo log dpe rnying dpe tshogs〉'tshol sdud dang / dag sgrig par skrun bcas byed pa'i jus gzhi gsar ba bzos pa ltar nga tshos bya ba 'di da lta dngos su lag star byed 'go brtsams pa yin/de yang nga tshos bya ba 'di nyid sgrub pa'i mdzub ston bsam blo ni tang krung dbyang dang rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi 'brel yod mdzub 3

pod 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ston la brtsi srung sgos/ mi rigs phul byung rig gnas dar spel dang / mi rigs mthun sgril dang rig gnas brje res la shugs snon byed pa dmigs 'dun du byas te/ bden 'tshol lam tshan rig dang mthun pa'i spyod stangs la brten nas sa gnas mi rigs gna' rtsom sngog 'don myur skyob byas thog mi rigs kyi khyad chos ldan pa'i spyi tshogs ring lugs dpal yon 'dzugs skrun la zhabs 'degs zhu rgyu de yin/bya ba'i rtsa don ni chab srid 'du shes shugs dam zhing / srid jus dbye mtshams gsal bor byas te/ lo rgyus dang rtsod sgrub kyi lta ba spyad nas snyigs dor bcud len byed pa'i dus mtshangs sa rig ༄ ra༅gnas kyi ngos nas snga ma'i rnam pa ji bzhin cha tshang du mtshon ci nus byed cing / spyir btang du brtsams chos la dpyad brjod ci yang byed rgyu min/gzhan yang byed sgo'i shes byar slob sbyong dang / ched las shes byar gcigs 'dzin byas te/ nan tan zhib tshags kyi bya ba'i spyod stangs la brten nas gnad sgo stangs 'dzin byas thog rgyun shes sam ched las rang bzhin gyi 'gal 'khrul g.yol ci nus byed rgyu'ang smros ma dgos/ de dang mnyam du spus legs 'du shes chags par byas te/ ma 4

sngon 'gro'i gtam/ pod 5dngul gyi mthun rkyen cung 'byor ba'i gnas tshul 'og〈dpe tshogs〉de jus 'god dang / mdun shog deb tshad/ shog spus/ ye ge'i dag tshad sogs gang rung nas de sngon las spus tshad bzang bar byas te/mig snga'i rgyal nang sa gnas bod yig dpe deb cung legs po'i gras su tshud par byed pa dmigs 'ben du byas yod/'dir cis kyang gleng dgos pa zhig ni de ring nga tshor bya ba 'di spel ba'i go skabs byung tshe/ nga tshor 'di 'dra'i rig gnas shul bzhag rgya che zhing rngams mthug pa zhig myar skyob bya ru yod //spyo 1rngo////re/ /renge raming /gri/rdo—nga / mang ga da dung da brlag tu ma song bar 'a la du yod pa dang de tsho'i rig gnas rin thang gi skor yin te/ de yang de sngon gyi lo rgyus su rang re gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir 'gro ba mi yi sha tshugs su skyes pa ni sus kyang bgrang du med mod/ legs par bsam na mi rigs dang mi'i rigs la 'phral yun du phan pa'i mdzad pa bzang po bskrun pa dang nyams pa med pa'i legs skyes shul du bzhag yod mkhan ni shin tu nyung ngu zhig las med na/ khong tsho ni mi yi khyu mchog dang / phul byung skyes bur bgrang ba don dang ldan te/ ji skad du‘‘mkhas pa rnams ni med na blo gros rnams nyams mi rnams 'tsho ba don yod min’’ces gsungs pa shin tu mad de/ khong tsho yod cing / khong tshos rang byung khams dang spyi 5

pod 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/tshogs la thugs gzhigs yang yang mdzad pa las byung ba'i 'gro ba mi'i blo gros dang shes rab kyi mtshon byed shes rig gi legs skyes rmad du byung ba de dag yod pa dang / legs skyes de dag dus dang go mtshams kyi rgya las brgal te phyi rabs pa dag la pha nor gyi tshul du shul 'jog gnang bar brten/ nga tsho da lta dpal yon ldan pa'i spyi tshogs su 'tsho zhing / nga tshos bskrun pa'i shes rig la rmang gzhi dang khungs lung yod cing / brgyud pa dang ldan par gyur/ mkhas pa de tsho dang rig gzhung de tsho bzhugs pas rang gi rigs rgyud 'di rnams da lta brgyud pa ring la zab cing rgya che ba'i than min ༄rig gnas shig gi bdag por gyur yod la/ shes rig rnam par bkra ba dpal ldan 'dzam bu gling ba'i mi gral gyi star rim 'phang mi dma' bar 'tsho thub pa byung yod/de phyir mkhas pa'i dbang po rim par byon pa dag dang de dag gis mdzad pa'i legs bshad kyi glegs bam dag ni mi rigs shig dang sa gnas shig la mtshon na gzi brjid dang la rgya zhig yin 'dug la/ 'chang bar bya ba'i khyad nor dang 'phyar bar bya ba'i dge mtshan zhig yin par ma zad/ 'tsho bar byed pa'i bla srog dang khrag rgyun zhig tu smras kyang rung snyam/ 'di ltar bsam na khong sngon byon gyi mkhas pa dag rang re la bka' drin bla lhag tu che bas 6

sngon 'gro'i gtam/ pod 5rjes su yi rang zhing snying nas bka' drin zhu 'os la/ sngon 'gro'i rtsom thung 'di yang khong rnam par dad gdung mos gus kyi yid rlabs g.yo bzhin bris pa lags/dus mtshungs su rang re gangs can pa dag la gna' bo'i dus nas bzung mkhas pa la gong bkur dang shes rig la gces thang che ba'i srol rgyun bzang po zhig yod la/ yul mgo log 'dir mtshon na'ang dgon sde dang dge 'dun pa dag gis bshad sgrub kyi ngos nas so so'i mkhas pa dang de'i brtsams chos la gtsigs su 'dzin pa tsam du ma zad/ yul khams spyi nas kyang‘‘mkhas pa yon tan ldan pa dang / skra dkar yang tsha mthong ba ste’’sogs kyis mtshon te mkhas pa dag phu dud bya ba'i yul gsum gyi gtso bo'i go gnas su bgrang ba'i srol 'dug cing / khong tsho ni legs bshad kyi 'byung gnas dang / legs tshogs kyi rtsa ba/ yi rang dang mig ltos kyi mtshon dpe zhig tu brtsi ba dang / khong tshos brtsams pa'i gsang ༄chos dag ni bslab bya'i gnas shig dang / lugs gnyis blang dor gyi tshad gzhi zhig tu brtsi bar byed/ khyim rgyud dang rus rgyud dag la mtshon na rang gi khyim rgyud du 'khrungs pa'i mkhas pa dang de'i gsung chos de tsho so so rang rang gi khyim rgyud kyi khyad nor du byas tebu rabs tsha rgyud du bsrel bar byed pa'i dar srol yod pas/ dus 7

pod 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/'gyur mang po'i khrod du'ang srog dang bsdos nas srung skyob byas 'dug da lta bsam na 'di ni goms srol legs po tsam du ma zad snying stobs rigs shig gi mtshon byed du'ang rung bar snyam/de dag gi dbang gis sa gnas 'dir yang lo rgyus su mkhas pa mi nyung ba tsam byon cing / da lta'i bar 'tshol du yod pa'i legs bshad kyi bstan bcos kyang mang tsam bzhugs la/ de tsho'i thun min rin thang gi cha nas bshad na'ang lo rgyus su mgo log 'di mdo khams 'brel mtshams su chags yod pas/ mdo khams rig gnas ma lag che ba gnyis ka gcig 'dres su song ba'i nyams shig snang la/ bod brgyud nang bstan grub mtha'i dbang du btang na'ang snga 'gyar rnying ma ba dang / ri bo dge lugs pa/ rgyal ba jo rig mo rig rwatsho tsho ma riganang ba/mnyam mad bka' brgyud pa sags grub mtha' cha gras phal mo che zhig yun ring mnyam gnas su chags pas/ dmangs khrod rig gnas tshun gyi rig gnas kun la sa cha gzhan dang mi mtshungs pa'i sger khyad cig lhag ger snang bar bsten/ rig gnas shul bzhag 'di rigs myur skyob thub pa byung na/ bod spyi'i srol rgyun rig gnas kyi dar rgyun nam brgyud pa gyes 'phel 'gro tshul dang /sa gnas thun min rig gnas grub stangs sogs zhib 'jug byed par don snying dang rin thang shin tu che bar gdon mi za la tha na 8 ri

sngon 'gro'i gtam/ pod 5stongashā1 ///nye (11nge ///nye //res /sde dzo bye//shesad 4 srol rgyun rig gnas dngha nang ga sa phyogs rer ma—na na phyogs kyi stong cha gsab nus pa'i tshad du son pa'i rin thang yang yod par zhib 'jug mkhas dbang du ma smra/gang ltar da lta nga tshos〈mgo log dpe rnying dpe tshogs〉'di nyid par du bskrun te mgo log gna' rtsom gyi spyi bab khyad chos dang ngo mtshar kun gyi spyan sngar bstar thub pa ni tang gi mi rigs srid jus don 'bab byung ba'i bye brag gi mtshon dpe zhig yin la/mgo log rig gnas khyab khongs kyi grub 'bras chen po zhig yin cing / krung go'i grangs nyung mi rigs gna' rtsom bya ba'i grub 'bras kyi ya gyal zhig kyang yin pa dang / deng dus la dge ba'i mdzad bzang zhig dang / ma 'o ngas par bslangs pa'i rdo ring zhig ste/ lo rgyus kyi don snying ldan pa'i bya ba rlabs che ba zhig yin pa bsnyon du med la/ sa gnas thun min rig gnas thon khungs sngog 'don sgos khyad thon rig gnas dar spel byed cing / rang skyong khul gyi rig gnas brje res dang phyi phyogs dril sgrog la shugs snon byed par mtshon na don snying chen po tshab byed gzhan du med pa zhig yod par snyam zhing / dus mtshungs su〈dpe tshogs〉'di nyid kyis rgya che'i klog pa po dang 'brel yod zhib 'jug pa dag la'ang rig pa'i longs spyod gsar ba zhig stob nus pa'i yid ches nga tshor 9

pod 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/yod/de sngon gyi srid jus legs po'i go skabs ma shor bar byas te/cha rkyen zhan cing dka' tshegs che ba la ma ltos par mthun rkyen gsar gtod sgos 'tshol sdud dang / dag sgrig myur skyob kyi las la rang rtogs ngang zhugs nas sa gnas rig gnas shul bzhag rtsa chen dag chud zos su mi 'gro ba'i ched du 'bad pa yun ring bsten pa'i ched las don gnyer mi sna dag gis don mthun gyi bya ba mang po bsgrubs song bas/ ngas 'dir khong tshor dka' las myang song zhes zhu zhing / kho bo rang ngos kyis bya ba de la rgyab skyor dang mthun rkyen sbyor ba'ang ldog med kyi 'os 'gan zhig tu brtsis yod/'on kyang rang khul gyi gna' rtsom ma lus par yongs su myar ༄skyob byed rgyu ni da dung dus yun ring zhing dka' khag che ba'i bya ba zhig yin pas/ grub 'bras kyi rmang gzhi'i steng mu 'thud nas rgyun 'khyongs lhod med kyi bya ba 'bor chen zhig bsgrub pa la rag las yod/ mjug mthar mgo log gna' rtsom bya ba legs 'grub yong zhing / grub 'bras gzengs su thon pa'i smon 'dun zhu//zhes pad ma rnam rgyal nas2003 1 1la bris/10

pod 5rtsom pa po ngo sprod mdor bsdus/rdo grub chen kun bzang 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi ma phrin las kun khyab dpal bzang po ni/ bod kyi rus chen bzhi las a lcags 'bri yi rigs las mched pa gnubs lcags mo'i rgyud du/yab rtsod bral dus babs kyi sprul ba'i gter chen khrag 'thung bdud 'joms gling pa rgis li gter ston zhes yongs su grags pa de dang / yum mtshan ldan ḍā ki'i rigs gyur bsod nams mtsho gnyis kyi sras sa bod rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i shing mo gling lor(spyi ༄lo1865)ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas 'bros sgang zhes grags pa'i ri zhol da lta'i mgo log pad ma rdzong gi rdzong grong gi nye 'dabs su sku bltams/ snga ma'i bag chags sad pas sku chung ngu'i dus nas yi ge dang brda sprod sogs gzigs pa tsam gyis thogs med du mkhyen/ rdzogs sprul bzhi ba mi 'gyur nam mkha'i rdo rje'i lung bstan ltar/ grub pa'i khyu mchog chen po rdo grub kun bzang 11

pod 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gzhan phan 'jigs med phrin las 'od zer gyi sku phreng gsum par ngos bzung ste rdo grub chen gyi gdan sar 'khod na'ang / 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse rin po ches brtag pa mdzad tshe gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i yang srid du grub pas/ khri chen gung thang pa'i sku skyer yang grags so//rdza stod du phebs nas 'jam dbyangs ngur smrig 'chang ba'i rnam rol chen po rdza dpal dge sprul sku o rgyan 'jigs med chos kyi dbang po'i zhabs la gtugs nas chos kyi bdud rtsi bzhes pas/lhag pa'i lhas rjes su bzung zhing byin gyis brlabs te dgongs pa ye shes kyi klong rdol/ dgung lo brgyad du son pa chu pho sprel lor dpal sprul rin po ches da lo rdo grub sprul skus spyod 'jug gi bka' khrid gnang dgos zhes phyogs kyi slob bu mang du bsdus tshe /nye gnas 'khor dang bcas pas sprul sku khong sku na chung drags pas re zhig 'khor de lta ba la bka' khrid mi 'ong zhes nan gyis zhus pa ༄bka' bkyon gyis tshar bcad par brten/ bka' nan bzlog ma nus par rdza rgyal dgon du 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i 'khor la spyod 'jug chen mo'i bka' khrid gnang ba na/ 'khor slob kun gyi lus kyi spu long dbang med g.yo zhing / dad pa'i mchi ma sham sham 'bab pa'i tshod du chos kyi 'khor lo rgya cher bskor bas/ dpal sprul rin po 12

yangar the:rdocarngo/ 2pa/ 1(1 re(( rjerdo/ཿba/ can/1rdordoshā du /spro////thag/ jirngo/sprerwa/ spre che'i zhal nas/ rdo grub byis pa lo brgyad pas chos 'khor 'di 'dra bskor nus pa'i tshul la dpag na/ da dung lung gi bstan pa'i gnas tshad rdzogs ran mi 'dug ces thugs dgyes pa chen pos bsngags brjod kyi me tog yang yang 'thor/ snga phyir o rgyan 'jigs med chos kyi dbang po dang / rdzogs sprul mi 'gyur nam mkha'i rdo rje/ rgya rong nam sprul kun bzang theg mchog rdo rje/'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po/ kong sprul blo gros mtha' yas rdo rje 'dzin pa nyag bla gter chen/ 'ju mi pham 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal rgya mtsho sogs dam pa mang du bsten nas/ 'dul ba dbu tshad phar phyin sogs gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i zab chos spyi dang / mdo sgyu sems gsum/ bka' dgongs phur gsum/ snying thig gong 'og sogs snga 'gyar bka' babs kyi cha bo rnam bzhi dang 'brel ba'i ra mi ༄༄pabaka' gter smin grol gyi dbang lung khrid gsum/ mdo smad rdi tsha dgon gyi mgo log sprul sku 'gya ba a lags sogs las kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i yig chas gtso byas ri bo dge ldan pa ltar gyi gzhung bka' pod lnga sogs mdor na mdo sngags gsar rnying grub mtha' ris med kyi lta grub kun la khengs pa dang skyo ngal med par thugs 'dris gsan bsam mdzad pas mkhas pa'i grags pa ches cher rgyas/13

pod 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rab tshes lcags 'brug spyi lo1880lor mgo log pad ma 'bum dpon shog brgyad kyis ched du phul ba'i bzhugs gnas rdo yul khri zhes bya bar dgon gnas gtsang chen dngos grub dpal 'bar gling zhes bya ba gsar du bzhengs pa/ phyis ming zur shugs kyis 'gyur te gsang chen dngos grub dpal 'bar gling du grags/de tsam nas dgon pa de'i g.yon ngos brdzi med bkra leb gong mar thang stong rgyal po'i lha khang du grags pa'i dben khrod cig tu sgrub pa rtse gcig mdzad pas/ tshal khrims kyi dri bsang zhim pos khor rigang rig miyug dus kun 'gengs la/ lhag pa'i lha la mi dang mi lab pa bzhin bgro gleng byed cing / ma gza' dam gsum mir brdzus nas glegs bam skyel 'bul byed pa/ nyin lam du ma'i sar rab gnas kyi 'bru char 'beb pa sogs mngon shes dang brdzu 'phrul la thogs pa med pa'i grub pa'i go 'phang mthon por gshegs kyang / rtag tu sbas pa'i brtul zhugs kho nar dgyes pas don gyi gsang ba sus kyang dpogs par dka'/ gzhan yang gangs ri'i ljongs su bka' bstan 'gyur ro cog dang / bka' gter rnying rgyud/ bod kyi mkhas grub ris med kyi gsung 'bum glegs bam gsar bzhengs sogs bya ba las kyi phrin las kyang rgya cher spel/mthar rab byung bco lnga ba'i zad pa me stag gi lor(1929)14

rtsom pa po ngo sprod mdor bsdus/ pod 5mngaḥ'i 45rig 'ju pha rwazi pa rtepa ri rwab pagazugs sku' bkad pa chas dbyangs su bsdus sa//lung gis zin pa'i thugs sras mgar ba mkhan po 'jigs med 'od zer dang / ser shul mkhan po/ klu shul mkhan po/ mkhan po dam chos bcas mkhan chen bzhis gtso'i rnyiḥphi dug tsha sogs yul gru kun nas slob ma mang du 'dus kyang / 'khor slob rgya cher bsdu ba sogs thun mong gi mnga' thang dang gzi byin gyi spros pa rtag tu bskyungs te bzhugs/gsung rtsom la〈rgyud ma hā yo ga'i tand+ra gsang ba'i snying bo de kho na nyid rnam par nges pa la zur lugs ltar gyi dgongs 'grel spyi don rin chen mdzod kyi lde mig〉dang / 〈mdo las byang chub sems dpa'i gzungs kyi rgyan rnam par bshad pa rgyal yum lus bzang mdzes byed legs bshad phreng ba〉sogs mdo sngags gzhung 'grel gyi skor dang / sgrub thabs skyed rdzogs kyi skor/ lo rgyus gtam tshogs kyi skor/ gsung mgur snyan ngag gi skor/ zhal gdams man ngag gi skor sogs gang la'ang thun mong min pa'i khyad chos rtsal du thon pa'i gsung chos pod chen bcu phrag lhag cig bzhugs pa las/gong smras〈gsang snying spyi don〉dang / 〈gzungs kyi rnam bshad〉〈gter gyi rnam bshad〉sogs la shes nas smra ba'i mkhas pa du mas bstod bsngags kyi me tog mang du 'thor/ gzungs kyi skor la rnam 15

pod 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bshad 'di nyid kho na las gzhung logs su brtsams pa zhig bod na med par grags pas/ 〈gzungs rnam〉'di'i dpe zhig a mdo dge bshes 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros kyi phyag brgyud nas kun gzigs bcu gsum pa chen po'i spyan sngar phul bas dgyes gzigs dang bsngags brjod yang yang gnang bar gsung la/ rdo grub khong rang nas kyang〈gsang snying〉dang〈gzungs rnam〉gnyis ka snying dmar rjen du bstan pa yin ces lan du mar gsung bar grags/ 〈gzungs rnam〉dang〈gter rnam〉gnyis dbyin ji sogs kyi yi ger bsgyur yod pa'ang nye lam thos so/ /gzhan yang khong gi gsung chos gang la'ang rtsom nyams dang rtsom stangs kyi cha nas thun mong la rjes bzlos sa ma song ba'i khyad chos shig yod la/ snyan rtsom ༄la'ang 'gyur bag dang ro nyams gzhan dang gzhan la yong dka' ba'i cha bklags pa tsam gyis lhag ger myong thub pa zhig yod pas/gsung mgur dang / gtam tshogs khrod kyi sgrung thung dag la rtsom rig gi nyams 'gyur dang rin thang ngo mtshar ba zhig yod par sngon dang da lta'i ngag rig smra ba kun zhal gcig tu gleng ngo / /zhes pa'ang lnga rig smra ba bde legs rab rgyas su 'bod pas khul gna' rtsom gzhung las khang gis bskul ngor zla tshes dge bar 'phral mar sbyar ba'o// //16

dkar chagasngon 'gro'i gtam/ (1)rtsom pa po ngo sprod mdor bsdus/ (11)sgrub thabs thor bsdus skor/ (1)thugs sgrub dpal chen 'dus pa'i sgrub khog (120)sgrub chen zin bris/ (140)gnas brtan mchod chog/ (193)phung po gsum chog (210)thugs chen sbyin sreg (261)bka' srung chos skyong bsang gsol sogs kyi skor/ (273)yul lha rngon rgya/ (335)byad gtad phyir bzlog (338)sangs rgyas byang sems mtshan btus/ (341)'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse rin po che'i rtogs brjod/ (362)dpal sprul rin po che'i rtogs brjod/ (451)gtsug lag khang phyag dar gyi gtam/ (482)me tog mchod pa'i gtam/ (508)bsgrigs rjes kyi gtam/ (1)1

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ཿ༅/ /rig 'dzin yum ka'i dbang gi mtshams sbyor ma tig gi chan po zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /riyo cho༅ rig 'dzin yum ka'i dbang gi mtshams sbyor mu tig gi chun po zhes bya/ /dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam pa kun gyis mchog ldan pa'i/ /stong nyid rdo rje btsun mo ni/ /mi 'gyur bde ba'i ye shes kyi/ /'byung gnas chen por nges pas 'dud/ /de'ang gzhung rtsa ba las/ cho ga gcig gis byin rlabs dngaḥ rjes gnang dbang bskur gsum rdzogs paḥ dam tshig 'chal bar mi gtong zhingaḥ nyams su len pa'i gang zag las:gzhan du spel na bka' chad 'byung: zhes shin tu zab cing gnyan par gsungs pa'i yum ka bde chen rgyal mo'i dbang gi cho ga bsgrub pa la/ sbyor ba yo byad kyi shom sogs bdag 'jug dbang don rab gsal las 'byung bas shes shing / dngos gzhi'i bum pa bskyed bzlas skabs/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang byung bde skyong gi gzhal med khang chen por rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma 'khor 'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor ba nyi ma dang 'od zer gyi tshul du rang snang ba'i gnas 2

sgrub thabs thor bsdus skor/ pod/ 5gsum oṃ āḥhūṃ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas ye shes sems ma'i tshogs nam mkha' gang bar spyan drangs/ badzra sa mā dzaḥ gnyis su med par gyar/ dzaḥhūṃḥ༄baṃḥhoḥ badzra dzñā na ḍā kki ni puṣpesogs/ de dag bsngags pa mi zad sogs kyis bstod/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer gzungs thag la 'khril te song bas bum lha'i thugs rgyud bskul/ de rnams kyi sku las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur/zhes dmigs la bzlas brjod gang mang bya/ las bum du dpal rta mchog rol pa thod dbyug dang sdigs mdzub mdzad pa gsal ba'i sku las rdo rje bdud rtsi'i rdul phra rab dpag tu med pa babs pas bum pa gang bar gyurapa'i mos pas las sngags brgya rtsa sogs bzla/ rjes la sngar ltar mchod bstod dang / rgyal ba kun gyi sogs las lha la'ang mchod bstod phul/ oṃ ā hūṃ zhes dung zhal gyi chu mchod yon du phul bas bum lha 'od du zhu nas bum bcud dang ro gcig tu gyur/ zhes 'od zhu'i mthar/ bdag 'jug len pa'am rig me dor ba gang rigs dang / tshogs kyi mchod pa'ang nges par bya'o/ /de nas dbang gi bya ba dngos la 'jug pa ni/ sngon du rig 'dzin yab ka'i dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob pa'i rdo rje'i slob ma bdun nam nyer gcig las mi mang ba 'khod pa la/ phyi rol du khrus bya/ bgegs bskrad/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa rnams grub nas/ mar gyur nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems 3

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/can thams cad kyi don du mtha' gnyis la mi gnas pa'i zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du mchog gi byin rlabs thun mong ma yin pa nod de rim pa gnyis kyi rnal 'byor tshul bzhin du bsgrub par bgyi'o snyam pa'i yid kyis gsan par zhu/ gang gsan par bya ba ni/ rgyal ba thabs mkhas la thugs rje mnga' bas sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i thabs tshul mtha' yas shing bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gsungs pa'i nang nas mchog tu gyur pa ni snyigs dus kyi tshe thung ngu gcig gis gdul bya rin po che lta bu'i gang zag gcig slob pa min pa'i zung 'jug tu mtshams sbyor bar byed pa bla med rnal 'byor chen po'i lam gyi gsang ba 'ba' zhig yin cing gsang sngags kyi chog ga gzhan las sgrub tu mi nus pa'i las dang ye shes kyi dngos grub chen po rnams kyang lam 'dis dka' ba med par 'gug nus pa de rdo rje btsun mo'i chu skyes las byang ba'i thabs dang shes rab zung 'jug gi ting nge spyodami rirang rterngazig ma rig/bye/shā zugacig/)tu/'jan la rag las par gzags nas bad na sgyu 'phrul drwa ba' shes kyi sku gang 'dul der snang gi rnam par 'char ba de nyid mkha' spyod dang sa spyod kyi 'jig rten sogs he ru ka'i grong khyer chos kyi dbyings rgya mtshor 'byams klas pa rnams su ri rab sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi rdul dang mnyam pa'i rnal 'byor ma la sogs pa rdo rje 4

yang〉nya ///spreb rngonatshob/sa/ 121bang thab//rdozlas/ )rdo shā pa/ :sdosasprerwa// spre/mkha' 'gro ma'i dkyil 'khor mtha' yas pa'i gzugs kyis lhan cig skyes pa'i de nyid mtshon pa la brten nas gsang sngags kyi sgo la spyad pa spyod pa'i dpa' bo rgya mtsho'i rdul snyed kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan gyi sa la dbugs 'byin par mdzad pa las re zhig gangs ldan gyi ri bo'i 'gram 'dir rdo rje dbyangs can ma mi mo'i lus su srid pa bzung ste/ rje 'bangs skal ba dang ldan pa rnams la mchog gi ye shes sbyin pa dang / gdul bya tha mal pa rnams kyang grol ba bzhi ldan gyi skus rjes su bzung ba dang / ma 'ongs phyi ma phyi ma'i dus la dgongs te mtsho dang gangs brag thams cad chos nor dam rdzas kyi gter khas phyur bur dgangs pa sogs skad cig dang bskal pa mnyam pa'i rnam par thar pa rgya mtsho'i mthu bstan nas/ slar yang lus ma spang bar 'dod dgur bsgyur ba'i gzugs kyis rig pa 'dzin pa'i zhing nas zhing du rgyu zhing ye shes dang 'jig rten gyi rnal 'byor ma 'bum phrag yangs pa'i tshogs rjer bzhugs pa ni/ rgyal ba'i dbang po kun mkhyen rdo rje thogs med rtsal gyi dag snang jo mo'i byin rlabs zung 'jug rnam rol las/don gyi rnal 'byor ye shes nga nyid yin/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i yul kun rtag tu rgyu/ /'di nas nub phyogs zangs mdog dpal ri na/ /srin po 'dul ba'i cho 'phrul cir yang ston/ /zhes gsungs pa 5

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ltar jo mo mkhar chen bza' bde chen ye shes mtsho rgyal yin la /de lta bu'i don gyi dbang la dgongs nas rnal 'byor ma chen mo 'di'i sgrub thabs cha lag dang bcas pa sprul pa'i sku gu ru chos kyi dbang phyug dang rig 'dzin ratna gling pa sogs mkhas shing dngos grub brnyes pa du mas gtan la phab cing thugs nyams su bstar ba las/ 'dir ni o rgyan dus gsum mkhyen pa'i zhal snga nas/ lho phyogs 'od zer ming can sprul pa'i sku: zab don snying thig chos kyis 'gro ba 'dren: 'brel tshad rig 'dzin zhing du 'phen pa 'byung: zhes pa slu med rdo rje'i gsung gis lung bstan pa rgyal sras mchog grub rgyal po'i rnam 'phrul gter ston gyi skye ba bcu gsum pa kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pa'i zab gter gyi gsang ba rdzogs pa chen po klong chen snying thig gi chos sde ste/ grub pa'i slob dpon nyid kyi gsang las/ sku'i ༄dben gnas sogs nas rgya khrol: zhes bka' stsal pa'i chos bdag gtad rgya'i brgyud pa nas brtsams te da lta'i bar du/dbang gi chu bo ma nub cing / byin rlabs kyi sprin phung ma yal ba'i mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs kyi ngad pa tho ler byung ba dbyings yum bde chen rgyal mo'i rtsa ba'i sgrub pa la brten nas/ mngon par dbang bskur ba skabs su babs pa yin/ de yang slob dpon gyi bya ba 6

sgrub thabs thor bsdus skor/ pod/ 5zhekhularshadakyil 'khor sgrub cing mchod pa dang / bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba sogs sngon du legs par grub nas da slob ma la bya ba yin/ de la'ang maṇḍal dbul zhing gsol ba gdab pa sogs sngon du 'gro dgos pas thog mar bla ma dang khyab bdag rdo rje btsun mo zhal mi gnyis pa'i spyan sngar kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i ri rab gling bzhi/ lha mi'i longs spyod ma tshang ba med pa'i rnam par dmigs te maṇḍal zhig 'bul bar zhu/zhes brda sprad la maṇḍa 'bul/ de nas/ sngon chad dkyil 'khor gyi sgo 'dir ma zhugs pa'am zhugs kyang bskyar nas 'jug pa'i mtshon byed du mig dar dmar po re gdong g.yogs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ tsakṣu banta sogs kyis mig ras dang / dkyil 'khor ba dang mjal ba'i tshe phyag rten gyi slad du/ mchog gi me tog kha dog lnga pa'i chun 'phyang chen po re yang thogs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ a khaṃ wī ras me tog dang /'di gnyis lo rgyus kyi gong du bya ba'ang bdag 'jug gi dgongs par mthun no/ /slar yang khyad par can gyi don zhu ba'i slad du snyim pa me tog dang bcas te gsol ba btab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ kun mkhyen ye shes sogasalan gsum/ tshog sa gsog pa'i slad du/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang dbyings phyug bde chen rgyal mo rnam dbyer ma mchis pa dkon mchog gsum rgya mtsho'i ngo bor bzhugs pa'i spyan 7

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/sngar nye lam rdo rje theg pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i yan lag brgyad kyi thabs mkhas la brten nas bskal pa rgya mtsho'i bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis mig 'phrul lta bur zlum par bgyi'o snyam pa'i yid kyis 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ rdo rje slob dpon sogs lan gsum/ slar yang khyed rang rnams kyi rgyud rig pa 'dzin pa'i sdom ldan du bya ba'i slad du sngar gsal btab pa'i tshogs zhing dang slob dpon gnyis dpang por byas te/ dmigs par bya ba'i yul mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du/ sgrub par byed pa'i thabs rigs lnga'i dam tshig tshul bzhin du bzung nas/ grub pa'i 'bras bu mtha' gnyis la mi gnas pa'i zung 'jug gi go 'phang thob par bgyi'o snyam du dam bca' rnam gsum brtan por bzung ba 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bde bar gshegs pa sogs la na gsam/ de nas/ rig pa bde gshegs snying po'i ngo bo nyid slob ༄ dpon gyi sogs ye shes dbab pa darmes bzhin bya/ de'ang rdo rje gsum gyi phebs rtags ma 'byung na spogs chog gi sgo nas dbab pa dang / sngon du slob dpon gyis bsnyen pa'i skabs su sngags 'bum phrag bzla tshul dgongs 'dus ḍākki'i spyi rgyud nas gsungs pa sogs gzhan du shes dgos/ me tog 'thor ba'i skabs/ sngar gtad pa'i rin po che'i me tog gi cod pan de nyid dkyil 'khor gyi gtso mo'i dbu gtsug tu bcing bar mos la sngags tshig 'di'i rjes zlos 8

sgrub thabs thor bsdus skor/ pod/ 5dang bcas te ltos med du 'dor bar zhu/ pra titstsha badzra hoḥ sngags kyis 'bul du gzhug cing dngos grub kyi mtshan ma brtag/ de ltar phul ba'i me tog gi phreng ba de nyid sngags kyi phreng bar gnas bsgyur te khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor bstsal ba'i mos pa mdzod/ pra titstsha badzra/pra ti skṛ ṇa sogs brjod cing spyi bor bzhag/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas ye shes chen po'i 'od zer gser gyi thur ma lta bu phyung ste khyed rang rnams kyi ma rig pa'i ling tog dang mig dar dus mnyam du bsal ba'i mos pa mdzod/ tsakṣu pra be sha ya phaṭaḥ ces brjod pas rdo rje btsun mo'i dkyil 'khor ye shes kyi snang cha las grub pa'i 'og min gsang ba mchog gi zhing dang gzhal med khang zla gam sgo gcig pa bde ba chen po'i chos 'byung gis mtshan pa'i dbus su/ sku gsum pho nya'i dbang phyug ma bde chen ye shes kyi rgyal mo/ sku'i dbyings la gdan gsum tshang ba'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs shing / rig rtsal dag pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma 'bam sde'i dbas na dgyes no༅ rabyedagur rol ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i rten dang brten par bcas pa phyi nang gsang gsum dbyer med du mthong ba'i mos pa mdzod/ ces mthong pa bstan/des dkyil 'khor chen por 'jug pa'i chos rnams grub nas slar yang dngos gzhi'i slad du gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod / byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas 9

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/sogs/ zhes gsol ba btab pas bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i smin mtshams kyi mdzod spu nas gdan gsum tshang ba'i dkyil 'khor nam mkha' gang bar spros/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis pa'i bden tshig 'bum du brjod/ sems ma rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu gar mig 'phrul ltar bsgyur/ khro bo rnams kyis drag shul gyi rol ba du mas bgegs rnams rgyang du bskrad de/rig pa'i lha mo rnams kyis bde skyong gi bum pa bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis gang ba spyi bor bzhag cing rdo rje gtor blugs kyi cho gas rjes su bzung ba'i mos pa mdzod/ ho/ gsang sngags dam tshig sogs/zhes gsungs shing dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag phung khams skye mched thams cad yongs grub gdan gsum tshang ba'i dkyil 'khor du smin par byas/ chu'i lhag ma spyi bor brtan pa las rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan/ dbang gi lha rnams kyang slob ma la thim par gyur/ des lus kyi sogs/ bzhag pa yin no/dbang gnyis pa'i slad du/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma ye shes kyi dpa' bo dang snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba'i sgra dang 'od zer gyis sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ thugs kar rjes su chags pa'i 10

mang〉 ////spro/ 1—1/spro/lhas/ 121shā pa /ba////lhas/ )rdo/shā se/ 1rngosardorngan/ 14/mes zhu ste/ byang chub sems kyi rgyun mu tig gi mdangs su chags pa rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi padmar son pa nyid lce thog tu bzhag pa la brten nas chan la phabs kyis theb pa bzhin du rtsa rlung thig le'i khams thams cad bde ba chen po'i ting 'dzin mu mtha' med pas khyab ste rgyud byin gyis rlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ho byang chub sems kyi sogs/ bzlas lung ni/ mdun bskyed gtso mo'i thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba dmar po lu gu rgyud du byung / kho rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i sa bon mthar g.yon bskor du 'khor bas bcom ldan 'das ma'i gsung gsang sngags kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa rgyud la zhugs byung snyam pa'i mos pa dang bcas te rtsa ba'i rig pa lan gsum rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ padmo yo gi sogs gsam/ slob dpon la me tog 'thor bzhin pas 'di'i rjes zlos ༄lan gsum mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag gis sogs dkyus bzhin/des ngag gi las dang sogs/ dbang gsum pa'i slad du/ bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i thugs ka nas rdo rje'i rig ma gzugs dang lang tshor ldan zhing 'dod pa'i sgyu rtsal gyi gnas la mkhas pa zhig mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du spros te thar pa brten pa la bskul bar gyur/ ho ye shes rnam pa sogs skabs 'dir slob ma mkha' 'gror gsal ba de nyid mtsho skyes he ru ka'i rnam par bsgyur ba bla ma'i phyag bzhes yin 11

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/cing / a ho ma hā su khāḥ zhes rol pa chen po'i dam tshig gis bskul nas gtad pa'i rig ma dang lhan cig 'du shes gsum ldan gyis mnyam par sbyar bas las rlung gi 'ching ba dbu ma'i dbyings su thim ste/ bde stong dga' ba bzhi'i ye shes rgyud la brtan par byas/ des yid kyi las dang sogs/ dbang bzhi pa'i slad du/ bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i zhal nas sgra brnyan lta ba'i rdo rje'i glu snyan ༄cing 'gyur ba byung ste/ mngon par dbugs dbyung ba'i mos pa mdzod/ ho/ sgra ni grag sogs/zhes ngo sprod pa la brten nas tshig dang dpe yis mi mtshon pa'i rang bzhin lhan cig skyes pa gnyug ma'i de kho na nyid so so rang rig pa'i tshul gyis nyams su myong bar mos la de'i ngang du cung zad re mnyam par 'jog mdzod/ des kun gzhi'i las dang sogs dag par brjod/ mtha' rten shis par bya ba'i slad du/ gdugs dang gser nya sogs/ slar yang khyed rang rnams dbang stegs seng ge'i khri la srid zhi'i dpal gyis 'byor pa chen pos mdun bdar te 'khod pa la nam mkha' gang ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang slob dpon lhan cig pas shis brjod bden tshig gi glu dbyangs snyan par sgrogs shing me tog manda ra ba'i char sil mar snyil bas kyang mnga' gsol ba'i mos pa mdzod/ ye dharmā sogs shis brjod rgyas par bya/ des dbang gi dngos 12

sgrub thabs thor bsdus skor/ pod/ 5gzhi mtha' rten dang bcas pa legs par grub pa lags pas gnas skabs de dag tu thob cing khas blangs pa'i spyi dang bye brag gi dam tshig rnams la gces spras su bya ba'i sgo nas tshul bzhin du srang ngo snyam pa'i yid kyis 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dbang bzhi ༄rdzogs pa'i sogs/ gtso bo'i ji ltar sogs lan gsum/ rjes la dge ba bsngo zhing mjug gi las rim rnams mtha' rgyas su bya la/ bdag 'jug gi skabs su'ang mos pa mdzod ces pa dang khyed rang rnams zhes pa tshig phrad bsgyur bas 'grub cing rjes la tshogs 'khor bya ba dbang don rab gsal gyi dgongs pa yin no/ /sangs rgyas padma'i rang lugs dang / /mthun par sbyar ba'i 'bel gtam 'dis/ /rig pa 'dzin rnams dga' skyed cing / /'gro kun rdo rje btsun mor shog /rig 'dzin yum ka'i dbang gi mtshams sbyor mu tig chun po zhes bya ba kun mkhyen brgyud pa'i rang lugs la dad pa'i snang ba brtan pa rdo shod kyi smyon pa 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi mas rang lo nyer gsum pa la 'chi med dga' ba'i tshal du bris pa dge zhing bkra shis// //13

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/༄/ /rig 'dzin yum ka'i rgyun khyer snying por dril ba rdo rje btsun mo'i zhal lung zhes bya ba bzhugs so//na mo dzñā na sa ka rā ye/ 'dir rdzogs pa chen po klong chen snying gi thig le brda bsgyur nam mkha' mdzod kyi chos sde'i bye brag gi rig 'dzin yum ka rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi'akhor los sgyur ba dbyings phyug bde chen rgyal mo'i rtsa sgrub bde chen dpal phreng gi rgyun khyer snying por dril te nyams su len par 'dod pas/ thog mar/gang gibyudrin gyis bde chen sogs/ ces rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma la gsol gdab sngon du 'gro bas/ skyabs sems bya ba ni/ na mo rgyal yum rdo rje phag mo la:'du 'bral med par skyabs su mchi: phyogs ris bral ba'i sems can rnams: bde chen sa la 'god par bgyi: lan gsum/ de nas dngos gzhi mkha' 'gro'i mngon rtogs sgom pa ni/ ā: snang ba thams cad yum lnga'i klong : srid pa thams cad mkha' 'gro'i dal: rgyu rkyen las 'das gzhal yas khang : thig le nyag gcig chos dbyings sgo: bde chen 'bar ba'i pho brang dbas: cha skyes ge sar bzhad dbye rabyepa'i steng : nyi ma'i gdan la mkha' 'gro'i gtso: chos sku'i klong na kun bzang mo: longs sku'i zhing na wā ra hi: sprul sku ye shes mtsho rgyal ma: zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dmar: gcer mo mnyam pa'i dor stabs can: shin tu chags dang bzhad pa'i 14

rtenaphang〉343〉 ////nges :sku/balhas/ 15shār/ /ba/ji//sa/ 14shār// :lhasasprerwa// spre/zhal: phyag g.yas thod pa'i cang te'u: snyan gyi thad kar gtod cing 'khrol: g.yon pa gri gug yu ba ni: dku la bsnyen nas mchog tu 'gyings: bha ga rgyas shing nu ma 'bur: rin po che dang gzhon nu'i rgyan: puṇḍa ri ka'i do shal 'phyang : rus pa'i rgyan drug sku la gsol: gnag snum dbu skra'i lan tshar can: rin po che yi rtse phran brjid: dbu ma'i spyan ni dbyings la gzigs:longs sku'i spyan gyis 'gro ba 'dul: sprul sku'i spyan gyis khams gsum 'gugs: sku la rgyud sde'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs: 'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gros bskor: rigs bdag padma thod 'phreng rtsal: a tsarya gzhon dkar gsal 'dzum: he ru ka pa cang dril 'khrol0 dam tshig ye shes gnyis sa medaX bsgoms pa /rdo5 risisko༅ /rdo5tsam gyis dngos grub thob: ces dam ye dbyer med kyi nga rgyal brtan po bya zhing dag pa rab 'byams lha'i gsal snang la sems rtse gcig tu bzung / bzlas dmigs ni/ rang nyid mkha' 'gro'i thugs ka ru: phag mo mthing nag/ gri thod can: snying dbus dga' 'khyil baṃ mtshan mthar:sngags phreng 'khor ba'i 'od zer gyis: lha sku'i snang zhen gsal bar byas: rigs bdag bla ma'i thugs rgyud bskul: de las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas: bla ma'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun:zag med bde ba chen por babs: dga' ba bzhi yi byed las 15

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/kyis: dbang bzhi'i ye shes nyams su myong: zhes sems dpa' sum brtsegs su byas te rdo rje'i rtsa sngags yi ge bcu gnyis pa/ oṃ zhes sngags kyi mgo 'dren dang / padmo yo gi ni ste dam tshig sems ma dang / dzñā na wā rā tī zhes ye shes sems ma'i mtshan sngags kyi mthar/ hūṃ zhes rdo rje gsum gyi dngos grub bskul ba'i rig pa sbyar ba ci nus su bzlas/ 'od zer spro bsdu'i dmigs pa bya zhing klong chen dgongs pa'i skyong tshul sogs gzhung las shes/ mthar/ oṃ gu hya dzñā na bo dhi lus dkyil gtso bo'i thugs kar nyi zla'i ga 'ur a yig la sngags phreng gi bskor bar dmigs te spro bsdu bya'o/ tsitta ma hā su kha ru lu ru lu hūṃ bhyo hūṃ: zhes zhi khro 'dus pa'i spyi sngags kyang bzla/ thun las ldang ba na dbyangs gsal rten snying yi ge brgya pas lhag chad skong zhing byin rlabs brtan par byas nas/ lha snang 'od gsal gyi lhar ldang / ho/ cha las cha bar rngol ba ba'im: rang las spal pa'i skur nor ra༄1 / / / ngaX5dkyil 'khor lha: ye shes dbyings su badzra mu: zhes dgongs pa la mnyam par bzhag slar yang / rjes thob sgyu ma'i lha skur ldang : zhes thun mtshams kyi lhar ldang / dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rdo rje btsun mo 'grub gyur nas sogs bsngo smon gyis mtha' brgyan par bya ste/ rnal 'byor 'di tsam gyis skye 'chi bar do gsum sku gsum du sgyur ba'i rdo rje theg pa bla med kyi thabs la mkhas pa'i gnad legs par zin pa yin pas tshes bcu gnyis kyi mchod pa ma gtogs pa dus gzhan rnams su bsdus pa la dga' na 'di la yi dam du bya'o/ /zhes pa'ang kun mkhyen bla ma'i gsung rab kyi bdud rtsis 'tsho ba'i sprang po smyon pa 'jigs med bstan rgyal gyis rdzong sar bkra shis lha rtser sbyar ba dge zhing bkra shis/dge'o////༄7/ /na mo gu ru mañdzu gho ṣa dzñā na kri pe nd+ra ye/ ye she sa kyi ḍā ki 16

sgrub thabs thor bsdus skor/ pod/ 5lge ni bde chen rgyal mo'i dkyil 'khor pa rnams thugs dam bskang ba'i rim pa la/ bshams shing byin gyis rlabs pa spyi ltar grub nas/ rol mo dbyangs dang bcas/ ho/ gzung 'dzin chos kun gnyug ma'i gshis su thim/ /ka dag rig pa dbyings kyi lhums su zhugs/ /dbyings rig dbyer med sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i sprin/ /snang srid thams cad mchod pa'i phyag rgya che/ /lnga ldan padmo drwa ba'i ye shes zhing / /mtha' dbus med par brdal ba'i klong dkyil na/ /rnam dag bdud rtsi mchod yon zhabs bsil dang / /rdo rje me tog bdug pa mar me dri/ /zhal zas rol mo'i nyer spyod phul byung dang / /gzhal med khang brtsegs rin chen spungs pa'i ri/ /dpag bsam nags tshal ma rmos lo tog stug /rin chen nye ba'i rin chen bdun bdun dang / /dge legs char 'bebs bkra shis rdzas rtags brgyad/ /padma'i lag mchog gzugs sdug dbyangs snyan dang / /dri zhim ro bda' lha rdzas reg bya yis/ /legs mtshan lha mo utpal mig yangs tshogs/ /zla ba nyi ma thabs shes zung 'jug pa'i/ /rang bzhin sman mchog dmar chen bha ling ta/ /mchog gi 'dod yon sgyu rtsal drug cu bzhi'i/ /mthar son pad can phyag rgya'i 'du ba sogs/ /rnam pa kun ldan 'byor pa'i cha shas rer/ /bde chen ri mo'i nyams 'gyur 'bum rdzogs pa'i/ /kun bzang mchod sprin 17

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rab 'byams dbyings kyi rgyan/ /dag pa'i mos ngor cig char gsal ba 'dis/ /zung 'jug dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag che/ /dbyings yum rdo rje phag mo'i thugs dam bskangs/ /gnas gsam mkha' 'gro yongs kyi 'khor los sgyur/ /bde rgyal padmo yo ༄gi'i thugs dam bskangs/ /byin rlabs 'byung gnas bka' brgyud bla ma'i gtso/ /rigs bdag padma thod phreng thugs dam bskangs/ /rdo rje btsun mo'i phyi nang gzhan gsum chos/ /rdul bral ye shes dbyings su ro mnyam cha/ /dran pas phung khams skye mched yang dag mthar/ /sbyong mdzad zhi khro rigs brgya'i thugs dam bskangs//khyad par rtsa rlung thig le 'od gsal klong / /rgyas 'debs 'khor lo gsum dkyil thugs dam bskangs/ /mkha' spyod gtum mo la sogs thugs 'khor bdag /ye shes dpa' bor bcas rnams thugs dam bskangs/ /sa spyod sa srung ma sogs gsung 'khor bdag /ye shes dpa' bor bcas rnams thugs dam bskangs/ /sa 'og 'khor lo'i shugs sogs sku 'khor bdag /ye shes dpa' bor bcas rnams thugs dam bskangs/ /de dag rnam 'phrul ri rab rdul phran snyed/ /mkha' 'gro ma dpal lha tshogs thugs dam bskangs/ /rdo rje lus dang phyi rol dkyil 'khor gyi/ /rnal 'byor ma tshogs dgyes pa skong gyur nas/ /thugs dang 'gal ba'i nyams 18

sgrub thabs thor bsdus skor/ pod/ 5sgechags mun pa sangs/ /ye shes snang bas bdag rgyud gsal bar shog /cir snang yul kun tshogs kyi longs spyod du/ /rol pas bde stong rtogs pa'i rtsal 'bar te/ /'du ba gsum dang 'bar ba rnam gsum sogs/ /dngos grub dbyar gyi mtsho ltar 'phel bar sgog /mthar thug phung khams snyigs ma dbyings su dag /mi shigs dwangs ma ye shes bcud kyis smin/ /stong pa'i mkha' la rjes chags mdangs shar te/ /zung 'jug phag mo'i go 'phang myur 'grub shog /gzhan yang ris med rgyal bstan bshad sgrub 'phel/ /de 'dzin zhabs brtan phrin las phyogs mthar khyab/ /'gro kun phan bde'i dge mtshan dar babs shing / /phyam gcig mchog dngos 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /'phros don phran bu smos pa/ bskang ba zhes pa'i 'bru don/ tshogs bskang gnyis kyi zlas phye ba'i tshogs mchod ni zhal zas bza' btung gi bdud rtsis bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams mnyes pa sgrub pa gtso che la/ de'i steng du 'dod yon gyi 'byor pa rgyas pa yid las sprul pa dang / dngos bshams byin gyis brlabs pas sgo nas lha'i thugs rgyud kyi mnyes pa cha shas rdzogs pa'am/kha 'geng bar byed pas na de skad ces bya ste/ tshogs bskang gnyis kyi khyad par yang des shes so/ /der ma zad dam tshig nyams pa'i nyes pas dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams mi mnyes par bgyis pa 'gyod tshangs chen po'i man ngag rgyas par bsgrubs pa la brten nas sbyar ba yang sgra de ltar 'jug ste rang gi dam tshig gso ba dang / lha'i dgongs pa gso ba gnyis gang ltar yang sgra bshad du rung ngo/ /spyir tshogs bskang gnyis la 'gal ba med do/ /grol thig lam rgyas pa'i bskang ba 'chi med sku gsum 'dus pa'i dkyil 19

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/chog tu tshogs phud dang po'i mchod par gsungs pa bzhin no/ /zhes pa'ang btsun pa blo gros gsal ba 'jigs med 'od gsal gyi ngor/ sprang smyon bstan pa'i nyi mas bris pa maṅga lo// //

pha midu sgegazuraḥmi ///thab rngonathabathag )sbostar/ thab///rnga5 /sdo/shā se/ /rngosasprerwasno/ ji gyi/ /dga' ston tshogs 'khor gyi glu rdo rje'i rgyud mangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru dzñā na ḍākki ye/ rab dmar rjes chags g.yo ba'i zhal gyi dkyil 'khor/ /mthong bas bde chen sbyin mdzad pho nya'i dbang phyug /'bum phrag dpa' mo'i dbus nas dal gyis bzhengs la/ /bde stong zla ba'i bdud rtsi snying la stsol mdzod/ /mchog ster padmo yo gi'i gsang sngags rang sgra/ /snyan 'gyur dpa' mo'i rgyang glur lhung lhung 'bab pa/ /thos pas nges don nang gi he ru ka dpal/ /sad mdzad rdo rje'i glu gar tshogs khang 'dir mdzod/ /utpal dri bsung 'thal ba'i mtshar sdug lang tshor yang yang rab ༄dga'i shugs kyis dbang yul skye mched/ /mi shigs nā da'i phyag rgyar ro gcig 'ching ba'i/ /ngo mtshar sgyu ma'i rol pa cir yang rtsen mdzod/ /ro mngar ma mchu'i btung ba sbrang rtsi bzhin du/ /padma lta bu'i zhal gyi sgros nas 'dzags pa/ /'thung bas lhan skyes dga' bas yid dbang myos byed/ /bde sbyin 'dod pa'i sgyu rtsal bdag la ston mdzod/ /sbas don rdo rje'i dbyings phyug sna rtse'i ze'u 'brur/ /dus mes skyil krung 'ching ba'i thabs mkhas gcig 21

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gis/ /rlung sems zla nyi'i rgyu ba dbyings su 'gog pa'i/ /ga ṇa tsakra'i dga' ston bdag dang rol mdzod/ /mtha' bral stong nyid dbyings su ro mnyam zhugs pa'i/ /lhan skyes bde chen sgyu ma'i gar mkhan gcig pu/ /rab 'byams brtan g.yo'i dngos snang cir yang brdzu ba'i/ /yum gcig rdo rje phag mor bdag yid grub mdzod/ /mkha' spyod bde ba che dang nyer bzhi'i grong du/ /'bum phrag lhan cig skyes ma'i tshogs gral nyul ba'i/ /rten 'byung shis pa'i dbyangs snyan glu ru blangs pa/ /rdo rje'i snyan dbang dgyes pa'i mchod sprin gyur cig /dga' ston tshogs 'khor gyi glu rdo rje'i rgyud mangs zhes bya ba 'di ni mkhas pa'i dbang po lung rtogs bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi bzhed skong du 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi mas bris pa maṅga lo// //༄/ /khyab bdag blo ldan mchog sred kyi thugs sgrub gsal bar bsdebs pa dngos grub mchog sbyin zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /'od gsal spros kun nyer zhi gnyug ma'i khams/ /mi shigs thig le chen po'i ngo bo ru/ /snying dbus nges pa don gyi 'og min cher/ /bde chen padma kā rar tha mi dad/ /de'ang rdzogs pa chen po mkha' 'gro yang tig gi rin chen shog ser skor shin tu gsang ba'i chos sde las byung ba'i bla ma 22

sgrub thabs thor bsdus skor/ pod/ 5zhe lo74rig 'dzin byin rlabs thugs sgrub spyi don rnam pa dgur bya ba las/ 'dir khyab bdag blo ldan mchog sred kyi hūṃ sgrub la brten te 'chi ba med pa'i tshe dang phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i shes rab kyi snang ba mngon du sgrub pa ni/ thog mar sgrub pa po dam tshig la gnas shing theg pa mchog la gus pa'i blo can gyis thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gros rgyud legs par sbyangs te/ dngos gzhi'i rnal 'byor ni/ lhun grub kyi dran rig khyab gdal chen po'i ngang nas kun snang dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje'i rtsal dwangs pa'i chu las chu bur ltar sgyu ma lta bu'i gzugs skur lang ba ni/ hūṃ hūṃ/ zhes brjod pas rang nyid skad cig gis ma hā gu ru blo ldan mchog sred rtsal/ sku mdog dmar ser zhal gcig zhi 'dzum chags pa'i nyams dang ldan zhing / phyag gnyis glegs bam dang kā pā la bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa/ sku la za 'og gi ber smug gsol zhing mthong grol 'dab ldan rigs lnga'i zhwa thod mnabs pa/ padma nyi zla'i gdan la skyil mo krung gis brjid cing zhal nas badzra a ra li'i dzab dbyangs sgrogs pa/ phyogs bzhir pad nyi baṃ ro'i gdan la lhan skyes ye shes kyi ḍākki ni/ sku mdog dkar ser dmar ljang la/ gcer mo rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan cing phaṭa dang phem phem gyi sgra sgrogs pa/ phyag na gri gug dang mi thod khrag gis gang ba 'dzin cing / gru mo g.yon na kha ṭwāṃ ḍa ma rus brgyan pa 'chang ba/zhabs gnyis g.yas bskum g.yon brkyangs gar stabs su rol pa/thams cad kyang ye shes bzhi sbyor chen po'i snang ba mtha' dang 23

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dbus med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i spyi gzugs bde stong phyag rgya'i 'khor lor rdzogs pa'o/ /gtso bo'i thags kar ༄padma nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ yig gzhom du med pa'i thig le 'od zer lnga ldan du 'bar ba'i mtha' bskor gtso bo'i sogs 'di tsam las gsung gi sgras zin du med kyang mkha' 'gro ma bzhi'i thugs kar yang yig 'bru bzhi sgom rgyur mngon no//ha ri ni sa'i sngags kyi phreng ba ston ka'i nam mkha' la nyi ma shar ba ltar kun nas snang ba/ de'i 'od kyis rdo rje sku yi dkyil 'khor thams cad khyab ste bde chen bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i nyams bzod med du 'bar bar bltas la lhar snang gi nga rgyal la bslab cing gsal bar 'don /slar yang sku'i cha shas thams cad nas rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i sprin phung tshad med pa nyi zer chen po la rdul 'khrigs pa bzhin du 'od kyi dkyil 'khor las 'thon te/ khams gsum brtan g.yo'i snang ba thams cad rdo rje'i zhabs bro dang hūṃ phaṭa kyi nga ros shig shig yom yom byed cing tha mal gyi snang ba chos nyid du sbyangs nas lhan cig skyes pa mi 'gyur ba'i ye shes kyi rnam rol du ma ro mnyam chen por gyur/ ces bsam la hūṃ bzlas bya/ de'ang lhar snang la a 'thas kyi rgyas 'debs dang / sngags bzlas la drag po'i seng cha mi dgos pas ting 'dzin lhod 'bol le ba'i ngang nas bzlas brjod 'jam na ra ra bya ba kun mkhyen gnyis pa'i man ngag las byung zhing / skabs su bung ba dal gyis 'gro ba lta bu'i dbyangs la bskyon te bzlas pas nyams 'ur/ byin 'thib/ bag dro chil gyis byung na 'od zer spro 24

sgrub thabs thor bsdus skor/ pod/ 5zhe bsdu'i gzer ka zab mo ni/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi thugs ka'i sa bon las spros pa'i 'od kyis phyogs bcu'i zhing khams ma lus pa khyab/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ lha dang drang srong / grub pa dang rig 'dzin nyan rang byang sems/ de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang btsun mor bcas pa rnams kyi tshe dang bsod nams stobs dang gzi brjid/ ye shes yon tan/ shes rab dang ting 'dzin thams cad 'chi med kyi bdud rtsi'i bcud len chen por sad de 'od dang 'od zer gyi rnam pas thugs srog ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' rdo rje yi ge 'bru lnga la thim ste lus kyi nang thams cad ye shes bdud rtsi mtshams sprin zhu lugs su babs pa lta bus mer gyis gang bar bsam la bzla/ 'od zer spro bsdu ni rno la ngar gyis gdags pa ltar las rab 'byams gang la'ang sde kha bsgyur bas chog go/ /spro na 'od zer bsdu ba dang 'brel bar rlung bum can 'jam rlung gi sbyor bas gzung zhing mnyam par bzhag mjug tu/ 'khor gyi mkha' 'gro ma bzhi'i snying po'i o āḥhūṃ gi sgrom nas bton pa/ oṃ ri ni sa ha āḥhūṃ: zhes pa'ang ci nus su bzla/ mdor na snang grags rig gsum bya byed dang bcas pa rdo rje bzhi'i lam khyer dang mi 'bral bar bya ba ni dgongs pa mi 'gyur ba'i gzer shin tu zab pa yin pas de nyid la gnad kyi snying por bya/ zhar byung rang gzhan gyi don du grub pa'i rdzas byin gyis rlob pa'i cho ga ni/rin po che'i bum pa mgul chings can gyi nang du rdzas so lngas sbags pa'i bum bcud dam gi waṃ dang durba la sogs pa tshe dang shes rab 'phel ba'i rdzas kyi ril bus bltams te stegs bu'i khar mchod pas bskor zhing bzhugs su gsol/ kha rgyan dang gzungs thag 25

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/kyang bzhag de nas/ bsnyen skabs 'di nyid du/ bum pa rang byung gi gzhal med khang chen por gyur pa'i dbus su bla ma rig 'dzin dang ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro gtso 'khor lnga po bdag bskyed ji lta ba'i cha lugs su gsal la/ rang gi thugs ka'i 'od zer gzungs thag la 'khril te song bas bum lha'i thugs rgyud bskul/ gtso bo'i phyag mtshan glegs bam las ā li kā li dang / bde skyong las 'chi med kyi bdud rtsi/ gzhan yang gtso 'khor thams cad kyi sku'i cha shas rnams las bde ba chen po'i bdud rtsi ngang hra la la babs te bum nang gi grub rdzas rnams la thim pas 'od gsal de kho na nyid kyi dgongs pas byin gyis brlabs par gyur pa'i dmigs pa bya zhing bzlas pa la 'bad/ rjes su bum lha 'od zhu bya'o/ /gang ltar yang thun mthar 'chi ba 'od gsal gyi lam khyer dang bar do sgyu ma lta bu'i gzugs skur sbyong ba'i man ngag gi gzer ka ni/rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor nam mkha' gang ba rnams dpal 'khor lo'i dbang phyug gi thugs srog dwangs ma'i thig le la thim ste/ gtso 'khor gdan dang bcas pas thams cad ye grol ka nas dag pa'i dbyings su mnyam par bzhag /ces gnas lugs ma bcos pa'i rgyun skyong / slar yang lhun grub nang gsal gyi ye shes chen po'i rtsal snang bde chen sgyu ma mchog gi phyag rgya snang stong chu nang gi zla ba lta bu'i gzugs skur ldang ngo / zhes bsdu ldang gnyis kyis chos sku'i 26

sgrub thabs thor bsdus skor/ pod/ 5tshar rig pa las ye shes kyi gzugs skur snying rje chen po'i 'jug pas ldang ba'i rnam pa lam du byas nas mthar dge ba bsngo/ spyod lam thams cad du'ang lhar snang gi nga rgyal dang ma bral ba'i sgo nas snang grag rig gsum bde stong khyab bdal chen po'i rnam rol du blta zhing nyams bskyangs/ re dogs dang dgag sgrub kyi 'dzin 'khris spangs pa'i brtul zhugs rol pa'i ngar thog kho na las spyod yul la 'jug mtshan mo nyal ba'i tshe dbang shes kun rtog dang bcas pa'i g.yo byed kyi bzhon pa las rlung yin pas/ de nyid bya rtsol las 'das pa'i klong chen gyi rig pa mtha' bral ye yin chen po 'i klong du rang grol ba'i phyir snod bcud thams cad snying ga'i hūṃ las bsdus te gnyug ma'i rang babs su bzhag rmi lam rmis pa na dbyings kyi gsal cha lha'i rnam rol du ldang ba'i rnal 'byor zab mos lam du khyer/ de sogs lhun grub snang ba bzhi'i nyams len rnams 'od gsal mchog sgrub ltar bya/ 'di ltar yang yang 'bad pas dngos su mkha' 'gro 'du ba dang /rtogs pa 'bar zhing rig rtsal rgyas pa la sogs pa dang / rmi lam du'ang gzhung las/shes rab 'phel ba'i rtags rnams 'byung: zhes gsungs pa ltar/ blo gros rgyas pa'i rtags mtshan dang / nyi zla 'char ba dang / padma'i tshal du phyin pa dang / glegs bam rnyed pa dang / rol mo 'khrol ba la sogs pa dang / des mtshon te 'phel ba'i rtags su dar po che 'dzug pa dang / durba'i tshal mthong ba la sogs pa 'byung ngo / /bzlas pa'i grangs tshad ni/ gzhung las/ nyi shu gcig gis skal bar ldan: 'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med: ces pa tsam las gsal kha cher med do/ /bsnyen thems nas tshogs kyi mchod pa dang / dngos grub kyi rdzas myang ba/ bkra shis dga' ston sogs mthar rgyas su bya'o/ /dgongs brgyud ston pa rigs lnga'i thugs tig gter/ /brda brgyud klong byang mkha' 'gro'i man ngag mdzod/ /snyan brgyud grub pa'i zhal lung 'di sbyar bas/ don gnyis 'dod dgu'i dge mtshan rgyas gyur cig khyab bdag blo ldan mchog sred kyi thugs 27

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/sgrub gsal bar bsdebs pa dngos grub mchog sbyin zhes bya ba kun mkhyen 'jam mgon rdo rje 'chang rang byung padma gling pa'i zhal snga nas kyi zhabs rdul spyi bos reg pa'i skal bzang gi gzhon nu kun bzang 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi ma phrin las kun khyab tu 'bod pa'i snyom las pas rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la gsol ba btab ste sbyar bas 'gro kun bde ba chen po blo ldan mchog sred kyi go 'phang la reg pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ //28

sgrub thabs thor bsdus skor/ pod/ 54 zhegyi/ /'jam dpal dbyangs a ra pa tsa na dmar ser dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs 'jam mgon dgyes pa'i zhal lung dang de'i man ngag mtha' rten gyi zin bris 'jam dpal bzhad pa'i rol mo bzhugs so/ /oṃ swa sti siddha/ ye shes snang ba dam pas blo gros kyi/ /padmo rgyas mdzad 'jam dbyangs lhag pa'i lhar/ /btud nas de yi sgrub thabs kun gyi phul/ /'jam mgon bla ma dgyes pa'i zhal lung spel/ /gang zhig mtha' klas pa'i yid can la rjes su brtse ba'i rigs sad cing brtson 'grus dang skal ba ldan pa dag gis 'di ltar nges par bya ste/ rang gzhan thams cad 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen por 'khyams shing 'khyams par 'gyur ba'i rgyu'i gtso bo ni nyes pa mtha' dag gi 'byung gnas bdag tu lta ba cha dang bcas pa nyid yin la/ de spong bar byed pa la de dang 'dzin stangs dngos su 'gal ba'i bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab khyad par can yan lag dang bcas pa bskyed par bya ba'i slad du 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi ting nge 'dzin dang gzungs kyi sgo 29

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/zab mo 'grub par bgyi'o snyam pa'i blos/ 'di nyid kyi rjes sa ༄gnang ba legs par mnos shing / dam tshig la gnas pas/dben zhing yid dang mthun pa'i bsam gtan gyi khang bur 'jam pa'i stan la nye bar 'dug ste/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi rim pas nyams su blang bar bya'o/ /de la dang po sbyor ba la nges 'byung dang / snying rje dang byang chub sems kyi dmigs pa rnams sgo du ma nas yid la byas pa'i mthar mdun gyi nam mkhar skyabs yul rnams mngon sum lta bur gsal btab la/ skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ bdag sogs 'gro kun deng nas byang chub bar/ /dran pas srid zhi'i 'jigs pa sel mdzad pa'i/ /bla ma sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /mi phyed rtse gcig gus pas skyabs su mchi/ /ci nus kyi mthar skyabs yul rnams rang la bstem/ sems bskyed pa ni/mkha' khyab yid can 'khor bar 'ching ba'i rgyu/ /rmongs dang ma rig 'thibs po bsal ba la/ /kun gzigs ye shes snang ba mchog thob phyir/ /smra ba'i nyi ma'i ting 'dzin bsgrub par bgyi/ lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ldan sdug bsngal bral/ /bde dang mi 'bral btang snyoms ngang gnas pa'i/ /tshad med rnam bzhi'i bdud rtsis nyer 'tsho bas/ /phan bde'i padmo rtag tu rgyas gyur cig /ces tshad med bzhi bsgom/30

sgrub thabs thor bsdus skor/ pod/ 5gnyis pa dngos gzhi la thog mar mtshan bcas lha'i ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa ni/chos kun gzod nas spros pa'i mtshan ma las 'das bzhin/ /rten cing 'brel 'byang sgyu ma lta ba'i rnam rol las/ /rang gi snying rabye ra minyid stong gsal 'od kyi gur khang dbus/ /baṃ las padma a las zla steng yi ge dhīḥ gur gum mdog 'dra yid kyi sgrib pa rnam sel ba'i/ //'o da kyis lus kun rab gang dag pa'i shel ltar gyur/ /de ma thag tu rang nyid mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /lang tsho rgyas shing brgyad gnyis lon pa'i tshul 'chang ba/ /gser bsregs mdog 'dra kun nas 'od rab gsal ba'i sku/ /sgeg cing mdzes pa'i sku ni brjid cing 'gying bag can/ /spyan yangs zur gyis gzigs shing cung zad bzhad cing 'dzum/ /zur phud lnga ldan snyan gong utpal dar dpyangs can/ /rin chen cod paṇa 'od gsal bde bar gshegs pas mdzes rigs bdag mi bskyod pa/ /dpa' bo thugs rje ldan pa'i rgyab tu bsil zer can/ /sna tshogs dar dang rin chen rgyan kun 'od 'bar ba/ /phyag g.yas dbang sngon mdog mtshungs shes rab ral gri 'phyar/ /g.yon pas utpal ze'u 'brur brten pa'i glegs bam bsnams/ /chu skyes zla dbus skyil mo krung gis legs bzhugs shing / /sna tshogs 'od kyis mkha' kun 'gengs pa'i ye shes sku/ /snang stong zug 'jug 31

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dbang bo'i gzhu bzhin gsal bar gyur/ /ces brjod cing bsam la lha sku'i gsal snang la rtse gcig tu sems 'dzin/ des skyo na/ gzungs kyi sgo bsgrub pa'i slad du bzlas pa bya ba ni/ rang gi snying gar pad zla'i dbus su dhīḥyig mthar/ /sngon du oṃ sngags a ra pa tsa na dhīḥdang / dhī lce la yang ni mdzes pa'i dhīḥyig gis mtshan te/ /de ltar yi ge'i tshogs kun rin chen sgron me ltar/ /rab tu gsal zhing 'bar ba las byung 'od zer gyis/ /mkha' khyab 'gro ba'i yid kyi mun pa kun bsal zhing / /tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs 'jam dpal gzhon nu'i go 'phang bkod/ /sras bcas rgyal ba'i thugs bskyed smon lam rjes bskul nas/ /mkhyen pa'i ye shes 'od zer rnam pas rang la thim/ /thog med sgrib gnyis bag chags bcas pa sbyangs byas te/ /ji lta ji snyed shes bya'i yul la rab 'jug pa'i/ /gzangs dang blo gros spobs pa'i gter chen grol par gyar ces rimi shi ///〈 //drordo rig phobazlas dmigs dang bcas/ a ra pa tsa na tā ཿ zhes g.yeng ba dang bral ba'i yid kyis rtse gcig tu ci tsam nus pa bzlas/ spro na/ na mo mardzo shri ye ku mā ra bhu dā ya/ bo rnyi sa twa ya/ sta sa twa ya/ lha kā ru ṇi ka ya/tarya tha/ oṃ a ra dze/ bi ra dze/ shuddha bi shuddha/ sho dha ya/ bi sho dha ya/ a ma le/ bi ma le/ nirma le/ dza ya wa te/ ru ru tsa le hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes shes rab blo 'phel gyi gzungs 32

sgrub thabs thor bsdus skor/ pod/ 5'di nyid kyang ci rigs par bzla'o/ /thun 'jog pa'i dus su/ lce'i rtsa ba'i dhīḥ la dmigs te dbugs thog gcig la dhīḥbargya rtsa brgyad dam de ltar ma grub na'ang gtam gzhan gyis bar ma chod par bzlas pa'i mthar mchil ma cung zad med pa'i rkyen gyis dhīḥyig khong bar song bas rang gi lus dhīḥ dmar ser 'od 'bar bar gyur pa la sems rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag pas kyang bzlas pa bya'o/gsum pa rjes ni/ thun las ldang ba'i tshe/ slar yang rang nyid skad cig gis 'jam dpal gzhon nu'i skur gyur par bsams la mchod pa ni so so'i phyag rgya bcas/legs bris bdag po'i btung ba la sbyar ba'i/ /yan lag brgyad ldan bdud rtsi'i mchod yon gyis/ /'phags mchog zhal gyi padmor bsnyen bkur na/ /snying rje'i lang tsho rdzogs pa'i bka' drin stsol/ /oṃ ārya mardzo shri aṅga pra titstsha swā hā/ rnyog pa'i dri ma gzhar yang mi mdza' ba'i/ /dag byed gaṅga'i rgyun gyi reg bya yis/ /zhabs mthil 'khor lo'i re khā bsil ba las/ stong nyid zab mo'i ngal 'tsho thob par mdzod/ /pā rduglo 'chi med bu mo'i khengs pa 'phrog byed pa'i/ /sna tshogs me tog gzhon nu'i gru char gyis/ /nor bu'i zur phud mdzes pa'i skabs ster bas/ /mtha' yas sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin rdzogs shog /puṣpe: lhan cig skyes dang sbyar ba'i phun tshogs las/ /byung ba'i bsung zhim dngar po'i sprin phung gis/ /'jam mgon dri 'dzin dgyes pa'i leg sa byas mthus//'phags rnams rab dga'i tshul khrims dag par shog /dhū peglo33

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/skolimun pa'i 'thibs su bsnyil 'od rno ldan pa/ /nyi zla nor bu sgron me'i snang gsal gyis/ /ye shes gzigs pa'i mdun sar mdzes ster bas/ /mi 'khrugs bzod pa'i go cha brtan par shog /ā lo ke: gdung sel zla ba gzhon nu'i bsil 'od can/ /ga bur tsan dan gur gum dri yi chus/ /bsod nams bye ba'i phung bor byugs pa'i mthus/ /tshogs zung rgya mtsho'i brtson 'grus mthar phyin shog /gandha: skabs gsum dbang po'i btung ba las lhag pa'i/ /bza' bca' btung ba'i khyad par rnam mang po/ /ljags kyi padmar sim pa'i dge mtshan las/ /'gro kun bsam gtan zas kyis 'tsho bar shog /nai wi hye:dbyangs kyi yan lag rgya mtsho'i sgeg 'chang ba/ /snyan 'gyur rol mo'i mchod sprin sbyar ba las/ /sa gsum ma rig gnyid las slong bgyid pa'i/ /shes rab mchog gi sgra dbyangs len par shog /shabha: zhes pa'am/ bsdu na sngags tsam gyis mchod/ rgyas par na mtshan yang dag par brjod pa dang slob dpon rdo rje mtshon cha dang rje btsun sa skya parnyi tas mdzad pa sogs tshig don phun sum tshogs pa'i bstod pa rnams dang / gzhan yang / sras bcas rgyal ba thams cad kyi/ /ye shes phung bo gcig bsdus par/ /'jam dpal dbyangs zhes mtshan gsol bar/ /dad pas cung zad bsngags par bgyi/ 1 /gang khyod rig dang brtse ba yi/ /legs bshad mtha' dag rdzogs 34

ne'i ///thab :pe/spro/lhas/ 15kār/ /pa///rdolhas/ )sgoshār// 151rngapa// spre pa'i mthus/ /srid zhi'i spros pa btul mdzad nas/ /byang chub snying bo'i thig ler mdzes/ 2 /gzhan du 'gro ba drang ba'i slad/ /ji snyed rgyal rnams mdun sa ru/ /byang sems khyu mchog chen po'i tshul/ /smra ba'i nyi ma'ang de snyed snang / 3 / a sku mchog tu dwangs pa'i shel/ /gur gum sar ba'i mdangs mtshungs kyang / /mtshan dpe'i ngo mtshar mtha' yas kyis/ /srid na dpe zlas dben par byas/ 4 /gsung gi nor bu'i rgyud mangs po/ /yan lag drug cu'i nyams 'gyur can/ /shes bya kun dang sbyar ba na/ /sa gsum snyan pa'i khengs pa 'phrog 5 /gzhar yang spros pa las 'das pa'i/ /ji lta'i ye shes thugs chud bzhin/ /ji snyed marṣa pa'i sgeg 'chang bas/ /'phags bzhi'i 'byung gnas gcig tu gyar/ 6 / mdor na bral dang smin pa yi/ /phul byang spu(1 rig re:dzo'i /rdo /sde) skur na tan rgya ma tshul/ / ldan — bas bskal pa brgyar/ /bsngags kyang cha tsam mtshon nus min/ 7 /yid can kun la mngon mtho dang / /nges legs rnam mkhyen lam ston pa'i/ /'phrin las mkha' dang snyoms 'jug pa/ /'khor ba srid du mtha' mi mngon/ 8 /phyogs bcu'i rgyal yang nyin bzhin du/ /o la bstod pa lhur byed na/ /e ma gang gi rnam thar la su zhig gus pa skye mi 'gyur/ 9 /de slad 'dir yang rtse gcig pa'i/ /35

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ dad pas mchod cing gsol 'debs na/ /byang chub snying bor mchis kyi bar/ /thugs rje'i 'bab stegs nyid du mdzod/ 10 /tshul gnas khrims kyi dga' tshal du/ /mang du thos pa'i padmo'i rdzing / /bsam byung mtshar sdug dar babs shing / /sgom pa'i 'bras bu dud gyur cig 11 /phyi nang rig gzhung chu gter che/ /'phel byed 'chad rtsod rtsom pa yi/ /bdud rtsi'i zer brgyas yongs gang ba/ /smra ba'i zla ba nyid gyur cig 12 /lhag par zab mo'i rig sngags grub pas 'jam mgon dgyes pa'i zhal mthong zhing / /gsung gi zil dngar yang yang bstsal bas blo gros lang tsho rdzogs pa'i mthus/ /bdag dang phung bo rnam rig las 'das stong dang rten 'byung mi phyed pa'i/ /kun mkhyen ye shes snang ba gsar bas sa gsum dge legs sbyin gyur cig /ces bstod cing gsol ba gdab pa'am bsdu na/ gzhon nu'i sku lus 'chang ba sogs kyis bstod cing gsol ba gdab/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /'jam dpal gzhon nu 'grub sogs zhes bsngo smon gyis mtshams sbyar te spyod lam la 'jug thun mtshams rnams su'ang 'jam dpal gyi nga rgyal dang ma bral bas tshogs gnyis zung du 'brel ba la bslab par bya'o/ /bsnyen pa byed na/ khrus dang gtsang sbra la gnas pas thun bzhi'i sbyor bas rab mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa nyams dang rmi lam du ral gri dang utpal 'dzin pa/ me 'bar ba/ nyi zla shar ba sogs rtags ma byung gi bar du 'bad/ 'bring dus bsnyen zla ba drug tha ma grangs bsnyen 'bum phrag 36

sgrub thabs thor bsdus skor/ pod/ 5zheralongarabargyad kha skong dang bcas pa bzla'o/ de dag gi skabs su rmi lam du thog ser 'bab pa dang / rlung nag 'khrugs pa dang / gcan gzan gyis zos pa sogs byung na cung zad bar chad kyi rtags yin pas/ thun mtshams rnams su khro rgyal mi g.yo ba'i sgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bya ste/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i gdan la skad cig gis/ /rang nyid khro rgyal mi g.yo sngon po spyan gsum 'bar/ /phyag g.yas ral gri g.yon pas rdo rje'i zhags pa bsnams/ /ye shes me dbus pus g.yon btsugs pa'i stabs kyis rol/ /khro bo'i chas rdzogs thugs kar pad nyi'i dbus su hūṃ/ /mtha' skor sngags phreng dbang sngon mdog mtshungs bskor ba las/ /rab 'bar me 'od tsha zhing rtsub par 'phros pa yis/ /bar chad mi mthun phyogs kun bsregs shing sbyangs bar gyur/ /oṃ tsanta ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūṃ phaṭaḥ zhes brgya stong sogs bzla/ spro na chu srung gi gdams pa'ang nyams su blangs pas 'phral du zhi bar 'gyur la/ gegs sel 'di lhag pa'i lha gang la'ang sbyar du rung ngo / /de ltar rtse gcig tu 'bad pas thog mar 'dzin blo skye zhing / de nas snyan ngag dang rdo rje'i ngag dang / phyin ci ma log pa'i don phun sum tshogs pa rgyud la skyes nas gzungs dang spobs pa'i mthu zla bas reg pa'i chu gter bzhin du 'phel bar 'gyur ba ni nges pa'o/ /rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sgrub thabs phul/ sa skya'i 'jam mgon dgyes pa'i zhal lung rnams/shin tu gsal bar bkod 'dis yid can kun/ /blo gros snang bas mchog tu rgyas gyur cig /ces pa mngon rtogs kyi dngos 37

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gzhi rje btsan gong ma'i gsang rab sor bzhag la tshig gi mtha' rig mi rig mibaskyed tshul dang / sbyor rjes kyi spros pa cung zad dang bcas te mang du thos pa'i bya bral ba 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos sbyar ba'i dge bas 'gro kun chos rab rnam 'byed kyi blo mchog zab mos byang chub snying bo'i go 'phang la myur du reg pa'i rgyur sirji rastu/ sarba dā ka lya ṇi bha ba tu/༄༅/ /ye shes sgyu ma mchog gi sgyu 'phrul sprin/ /ngo mtshar mtshan dpe'i 'khor lor rnam rol ba/ /'jam dpal 'jam pa'i dbyangs ldan zhabs padmo/ /mchod pa'i dga' ston byas nas 'di brjod do/ /'dir 'phags mchog byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal rdo rje sgrub pa'i cho ga 'jam mgon bla ma dgyes pa'i zhal lung gi man ngag mtha' rten gyi zin ris 'jam dpal bzhad pa'i rol mo zhes bya ba 'god pa la/ spyir lhag pa'i lha bsgrub pa la bar chad 'gal rkyen gyi gtso bor gyur ba ni/ sngags la the tshom zhugs pa/ dad pa chung ba/ nyes ltung mang ba/ zhum shing sgyid lug pa sogs yin pas/ de dag ci nas kyang spangs la/ rtog ge shes rab 'chal ba'i ngan rtog gi rnyog pas ma bslad pa'i dad pa dang mos pa'i shugs thun mong ma yin pa rgyud la brtan pa dang /rtag tu kha na ma tho ba'i phyogs rnam par 'joms pa'i mchog nyes 38

ne'i stane'i nga ////spro/ :za/ba/lhas/ 1jo1shā pa /ba///2sa/ )sde/shā pa/ carngosasprepa// shā ltung bshags pa la nan tan du bya ba dang / bdag lta bu'i byis pa skal ba ngan pas ye shes kyi lha 'grub pa ni shin tu thag ring na 'dug mod kyi/ sngags bzlas brjod kyi brtson pa 'di'ang dge ba yin no snyam pa'i blo'i stobs dman pa ma yin par/ lhag pa'i lha ji srid du 'grub par ma gyur pa de srid du nan tan gyi shugs 'di mi ga/tong ste/ lha mngon tu bya ba la de tsam du dka' ba ci yod ces snying stobs gzengs bstod de/ go cha'i stobs ri rab bzhin tu brtan pas sgrub pa la 'jug cing / lha'i mtshan dang sngags dang grub ba'i rtags rnams bla ma ma gtogs pa su la'ang mi smra bar gsang thabs su spyad na sngags 'grub pa shin tu myur ba yin pas gal che ba'i gnad zab pa kho na'o/ /gzhan yang rgya lha gcig gis 'tshengs/ bod lha mang gis phung zer ba ltar blo gros kyi mthu rgyas pa'i thabs su 'jam dpal sgrub pa ches zab na'ang / klu 'dul ba dang / tshe bsring ba dang / pha rol dbang du bya ba la sogs pa la khyung dang gtsug tor rnam rgyal ma dang ku ru ku lle la sogs pa bsgrub na de nyid mchog go snyam pa lta bu'i blo sna rtswa chun gyi rtse mo breg pa lta bus dngos grub 'grub pa shin tu bul pa yin pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams ni mtha thogs pa med pa'i ༄bdag nyid yin pas sangs rgyas gcig gi ye shes las gzugs sku 39

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/tshad med par 'byung ba dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes gzugs sku gcig tu bsdu ba la dbang 'byor ba'i sangs rgyas kyi yul bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i tshul la tshad mas drangs pa'i nges shes brtan por byas te 'phags pa'i sku gcig po nyid rgyal ba kun 'dus su rtogs par bya ba ni gnad che shos zhig yin no/ /de ltar yid la bcang nas sgrub pa dngos kyi tshe sems dang ba 'dren pa'i gnas khang nyams dga' bar bsam gtan gyi spyod lam gyis gnas te/ skyabs su 'gro ba rgyud dang 'dres nges su bya zhing /khyad par du rab byang chub kyi sems la bcos min gyi myong ba dang /'bring yid 'gyur/ tha ma'ang byang chub sems kyi phan yon la mos pas myong thon dang / byang chub kyi sems mtshan nyid pa min kyang snying rje chen po la myong thon tsam dang / byang chub kyi sems skyes rung ma skyes rung srog la babs kyang mi gtong pa'i bsam pa brtan po dang / rdzogs pa'i byang chub don gnyer yid 'gyur ba skyes shing gzhan phan don gnyer de tsam ma byung yang bdag gis byang chab thob na 'gro ba rnams kyang mi 'dor ro snyam pa ste de dag ༄las gang rung gcig kyang med na ni sngags 'grub pa min pas de la ni gnad kyi snying por shes dgos la/ bsgom don dngos gzhi'i tshe/ dang por phyi nang gi chos thams cad rang bzhin med 40

sgrub thabs thor bsdus skor/ pod/ 5 lge pa'i don la blo bzhag cing gang snang gi ma dag pa'i brtan g.yo mtha' dag 'ja' yal ba ltar sbyangs bas dag pa'i snang zhen 'char sla ba yin la/ lha ni bsgom pa na gsal snang dang nga rgyal dag pa dran pa gsum po gnad kyi mdo 'gag yin pas/ nga rgyal brtan pa la lhag par 'bad cing / gsal snang gi tshe rnam pa lam me ba tsam la sems 'dzin pa las dang po nas phyag zhabs kyi spros pa so so ba la dmigs pa 'dzin res byas pas yid rtse gcig gi ting nge 'dzin mi 'grub pa yin pas gsal snang thon mi thon gyi rjes su dga' sdug gi ri mo spel ba sogs rnam par spangs la bsgom zhing / de'ang stobs sogs yongs rdzogs kyi dag pa dran pa med na de bzhin gshegs pa mtshan phun sum tshogs pa kho nas rab tu phye ba ma yin pas sangs rgyas nga rgyal gyi rnal 'byor ji bzhin par 'gro dka' ba'i gnad phyed dgos so/ /lha bskyed nas spyan 'dren mchod bstod mdor bsdus bya bar spro na/ gsal bar gyur zhes pa'i mtshams su rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā ya dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ārya mardzo shri arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ gzhan rnams la'ang 'don pa 41

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bsgyur/ de nas/ dmar ser mdzes pa'i mdangs ldan mtsho yi dbus na padma ge sar gyi/ /sdong por 'khrungs shing ri bong 'dzin pa'i steng na rje btsun 'jam dbyangs ni/ /gzhon nu'i tshul 'dzin rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs mtshams sprin dang mtshungs pas/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis glegs bam ral gri legs bsnams 'jam dbyangs khyod la 'dud/ ces mchod cing bstod la/ dzaḥ hūṃ baṃ ho/ zhes rang la bsnyims nas/ rang gi snying kar sogs bzlas pa la 'jug go/ /bsgyur pa'i skabs dang por snying ka'i yi ge drug po la rtse gcig tu dmigs pa gzhur la drangs shing de la sems zin pa na/ a mi skye ba dang / ra yig rdul dang bral ba sogs kyi don la don rab 'byed pa'i blo gros kyi 'jug pa yangs por bsgrub ste skabs 'gar bzlas pa mi bya bar ting nge 'dzin kho na la bslab/ gzhan du dmigs pa de dag gi mthar 'od zer spro bsdu la blo bzhag cing bzlas brjod bya ba sogs 'don bsgom zung du sbrel/ lar sngags bzla ba'i tshe sngags sgra shin tu dag cing mtshams sbyor gyi gcod 'tshams sogs ji bzhin par ma thon na nyes dmigs 'byung ngo / /zhes sgrub byed nyag nyog dang bcas te snar thang lo tsā ba'i sngags kyi bklag thabs su bshad pa la ni dpyad par bya ba mang yang / don du 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ sgrub pa nyams dang bya ba nyams/ /sgra dang don dang rnam bral ni/ /myur du sngags rnams mi 'grub ste/ /yun ring dus su 'gor ba yin/ /de la grub pa yong med min/ /log par yang ni de mi byed/ /skye ba gzhan du'ang snang ba ste/ /sngags grub mchog kyang ster bar 'gyur/zhes gsungs shing don de la dgongs nas dpung bzang las kyang / gsang sngags dag cing shin tu cho gar bcas zhes gsungs pa yin pas zur ma nyams pa dang gcod mtshams legs pa dang sgra ha cang drag ches pa dang zhan thal ba/ lha bsgom 'phror 42

sgrub thabs thor bsdus skor/ pod/ 5bzhag pa/ bzlas brjod mi tshig gis bcad pa sogs spangs la bzla zhing / der ma zad bzlas pa'i skabs me la phu gdab pa dang / gnyid dang sbrid pa dang glal bas kyang ma chod par bya dgos so/ /bzlas pa'i skabs nam mkha'i khams mtha' dag 'phags pa'i sku'i rnam rol kyis gang bar dmigs shing / de thams cad kyis sngags bzla bar mos na de snyed kyi 'gyur tshabs che bar gsungs so/ /thun mthar gre phug gi dhīḥ yig las bdud rtsi'i rgyun dkar bo bsil chil chil ba ngang hra la la babs pas lus kyi nang thams cad khengs/ nad dang gdon dang grib dang shes rab 'chal ba la sogs pa blo'i skyon mtha' dag rmeg med du sbyangs bar bsam la dhīḥ bzla zhing mjug tu dhīḥyig de snying ka'i dhīḥ yig la bsnyim par bya ste/ 'di ni blo gros kyi rgud pa sel ba'i thabs rab tu zab pa'i zhal shes shig yin no/ /rjes su gzungs dang spobs pa la sogs pa rmad du byung ba'i yon tan gyi tshogs mtha' dag kyang dag pa'i rten 'byung du snang bar zad pas rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i mtshan ma rdul tsam yang med par gzod nas spros pa dang bral ba'i de kho na nyid la dran pa mngon du bzhag pas gzungs spobs rgyud la brtan pa dang chud mi za ba'i dgos ched khyad par can yod la/ thun mtshams rnams su'ang sngags kyi bzlas brjod ni byas kyang ngag gi nus pa 'don pa yin mod/ de bzlas pa'i grangs ni mi gzhug par bshad do/ /de'ang nyi shar dang nyin gung dang nyi nub dang nam phyed dang khams mi bde ba'i skabs rnams su ting nge 'dzin gnad du gcur ba bkag cing / tho rangs rlung rig dwangs pa'i tshe lha'i rnal 'byor gsal bzhin pa'i thugs kar dpal gyi be'u mthing sngon nor bu'i dbyibs zur drug pa'i lte bar dhīḥyig sngar ltar bsgom pa las 'od 'phros/ gre phug gi dhīḥl phog /de las 'od dkar bo dbugs phyir 'byung ba dang lhan gcig sna bug nas brgyud de byung / nam mkha'i khams thams cad khyab/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi sgrib pa'i tshogs ma lus pa sbyangs te 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'i go 'phang la bkod/'phags pa de rnams kyi gzungs spobs blo gros zad mi shes pa'i yon tan thams cad 43

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dang / gzhan srid zhi'i dwangs bcud mtha' dag bsdus te dhīḥyig nyi ma 'char ka'i gzi byin ltar 'od zer tshad med par kun tu 'bar ba'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i char du babs/ dbugs rngub pa'i tshe sna bug nas drangs te khong ba'i nang thams cad dhīḥ yig gis gang / dwangs bcud thugs srog gi yi ge la bsngims mthar rang sems kyi chos nyid la mnyam par bzhag 'di 'dra ba zhag lnga'am bdun tsam du bsgom pas kyang shes rab kyi go yangs por 'gyur zhing gzungs 'grub pa shin tu myur ba yin zhes bla ma'i man ngag yin no/ /ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa'i tshe bying na skyi ser gyi reg bya yid la bya ba'am chu grang gis gdong ba 'khru ba'am/ snang ba'i mtshan ma la sems gzung ba'i sgo nas 'phags pa'i 'od zer gyi rnam rol rjes su dran pa'am/ lha'i gsal snang gi 'dzin stangs la sems sgrim pa rnams ci rigs su bya zhing / rgod pa la thun mgor rlung cham la 'bebs pa zhes dbugs 'byung 'jug gi rgyu ba ma 'khrul bar bgrang ba dang /rlung bum pa can bskyil ba dang shes pa sal le ba'i ngo bo la gtod pa sogs byas pas sel lo/ /sngags bzlas pas lce brtul na ja dkar gyi btung ba sogs bsten/ thun ha cang ring na zhe sun skye zhing mjug na mar ting nge 'dzin nyog nyog por 'gro zhing /ha cang thung na bzlas grangs mi 'byor zhing dmigs pa bya long med pas ran par bya/thun rdzogs nas bsnyen mtshams ngo tir 'jam dpal gyi nga rgyal dang ma bral bar bya/thun khyer skabs lha yang rang sems kyi gnas lugs 'od gsal pa'i klong du sprin nam mkha' la bsdu ba ltar bzhag cing / dmigs med kyi lta bas rgyas btab la/ sgyu ma lta bu'i shes rab kyis spyod lam la 'jug gnas skabs nam du'ang bla ma dang rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs gnyis su med pa la mos gus kyi gdung shugs drag la ngar che ba'i ngang nas gsol ba gdab/ lha mngon du 'grub pa la 'gal rkyen sdig sgrib dag pa dang /mthun rkyen tshogs kyi bsags rgyab la rag las pas nyin mtshams thams cad du yan lag bdun pa la 'bad cing / paṇa chen ma tis/ pha rol byin dang bstod pa mang po dang / /mtshan nas brjod dang mchod pa sna tshogs dang / /malcol dbul zhing gsol 44

raḥmi ////spro/ 115/pa/lhas/ 121shā pa /pa///rdolhas/ )rdo shā pa/ sturngos/ཿna/ 14/ba gdab par bya/ /'di yis myur du 'grub par 'gyur ba yin/ /zhes pa'i don yang nyams su bstar ba shin tu gal che/ de dag las sher phyin gyi mdo la spyir yum sras bcu bdun po gang yin kyang 'dra mod de/ dngos po brgyad don bdun cu rdzogs par ston pa la sdud pa lta bu yum drug po gang rung dgos shing / bstod pa la rdo rje snying po rgyan las bshad pa'i bde gshegs spyi bstod dang gang blo ma sogs byin rlabs can gyi rigs rnams bya ste gzhan ni go sla'o/ /de las gzhan chos spyod rnam bcus mtshon pa'i dge ba'i las la kun tu spyad de spyod lam thams cad don yod par bya'o/ /thun mtshams gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod pas/ rin po che'i snod gtsang mar gtor ma dkar zlum la chab gtsang bran/ ā kā ros lan gsum gyis byin gyis rlabs la/rang gi ming ka nas 'ong zer 'phros pas rje btsan 'jam pa'i 377 / / / riri shi /dbyangs la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ padma ka ma lā ya st+waṃ gyis gdan 'bul/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ārya mabhri shrī ba li ta kha kha kha tī kha tī/ zhes lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul la/ mchod bstod gong ltar byas te nongs pa bshags/ rten yod na brtan bzhugs dang med na gshegs su gsol lo/ /de ltar sgrub pa na dam tshig tu/ khrus dang gtsang sbra la 'bad de/ sha chang / sngo ngad/ sgog tsong / lan tshwa sogs dang / yugs sa mo'i lto dang / dme bo'i zas gos/ khyi dang bud med kyis 'gom reg la sogs pa spangs/gal te kha zas kyi rdol du lan tshwa 'debs pa lta bu'i tshe dbyangs gsal gyi bzlas brjod nyer gcig sogs byas pas brlabs/ gzhan rdzun dang / 'khon dang zhe sdang dang sdig grogs dang / mya ngan drag po byed pa dang smre sngags 'don pa'i sar 'gro ba dang /rang gis kyang sems la gnod pa'i las de lta bu byed pa dang / shes rab kyis rlom 45

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/nas gzhan la smod cing khyad par bla ma dang chos la dmod pa dang / khu ba 'byin pa dang / gzhan la nye bar 'tshe ba rnams spangs te rtag tu lha'i bzlas pa dang bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor re mi chag par bya'o/ /gegs sel gzhung nas bshad pa ltar dang / 'gro ba'i tshe gdan bgrang phreng gis bsrung ba dang / rmi lam du gdon sogs kyis khams 'dzag pa la khro bo'i bsgom bzlas dang / spyod lam gyi sgo nas mtshan ma lag sogs kyis mnan nas nyal bas sel bar bshad do/ /lar sngags kyi mthu 'don pa'i phyir thog mar dbyangs gsal rten snying dang sbrel ba zhag bdun du bsgrubs pas nga rgyal gsal nus pa 'byung ba yin no/ /da ni sbyin sreg gi las 'chad de/ de la bzlas pa'i lhag chad kha skong ba la ni sbyin sreg ma grub na bzlas pa nyid kyi rgyun ring por spel bas kyang 'grub bo zhes 'gro 'dul gter bdag gling pas bshad mod/ 'on kyang dngos grub rno la myur ba'i lcags kyu ches che ba ni sbyin sreg gi mchod ston yin pas shin tu zab pa yin la/ de bya ba la bsnyen pa rdzogs nas yar ngo'i tshes grangs gza' skar phrod sbyor bzang bo la/ bsgrub pa byas pa'i gnas de nyid du maṇḍal rgyar khru gang dang zab tu khru phyed pa'i thab khung can dbus su padma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i steng du ba lu la sogs pa dri bzang bo'i shing blum po'am gru bzhir brtsegs/ de'i nang gi shar lhor ting lo che ba zhig bzhag logs su dpal 'bar dang dge 'dun gyi tshang mal nas blangs pa'i me sta gon du bya/ thab dang sgrub pa po'i bar du me yol dkar po gangs rir bsgom par bya ba'i rten du bkod/rdor dril dgang blugs chab dang ku sha'i 'thor yab dang / yam shing sor brgyad pa/me tog
