/spos mer me dri chab bshos gtsang rnams dang / khyad par rtsi mar gyi mar khu ji ltar 'byor ba dang / rnyed na ba dmar po'i mar gsar gyi zhun mar dang / me tog ser po dri zhim pa gang rnyed/ ku sha bcas rang gi g.yas su bsham/ thab kyi g.yas rol du yang 'byor na chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod bkod/ thab kyi nye skor du dri bzang gis byug cing rdzas rnams la'ang gtor/ 'dir me sbar ba la sogs pa 46

sgrub thabs thor bsdus skor/ pod/ 5gtsang sbra thon dgos pas/ rlung yab dang rtsa skam po sogs 'du bya/ de ltar grub nas snga dro'i dus su dbu brtsam par bya ste/ skyabs 'gro nas mjug mchod stod kyi bar dkyus ltar bya/ dpal 'bar la me sbar te gus pa'i tshul gyis thab g.yas na zlum por bskor la/ yi ge bdun pa'i rtsa sngags lan gsum brjod/ o badzra dzwa la re gyis ting lo sbar/ rtsa skam po gzhan dang bcas me sbar/ khu tshur gnyis bcangs pa'i mthe bong brkyangs pa byang chub mchog gi phyag rgyas dgang blugs bzung la blugs gzar mar dang bcas pas bud shing khyab par blugs te/ yang oṃ badzra dzwa la ram̐ brjod/bsang chu oṃ a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭaḥ nyer gcig la sogs pas brlabs pa thab dang yo byad la 'thor yab kyis bran/ bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ zhu ba las byung pa'i mchod rdzas dang bsregs rdzas rnams lha mnyes pa dang so so'i las sgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ/sogs dang / oṃ āḥ hūṃ gis byin rlabs bya/ thab bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis ye shes kyi me thab yangs shing rgya che ba dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nang ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar bas gang bar gyur/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas shar lho nas me lha 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ thab da me tog cig phul la/ padma ka ma lā ya st+waṃ/ thab kyi dbas su padma /ring riri cadang nyi ma'i gdan la 'khod pa ni/ me lha dkar bo zhal cig phyag gnyis g.yas bgrang phreng dang g.yon ril ba spyi blugs 'dzin pa 47

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor bar gyur/ arghaṃ/ sogs kyis mchod/ku sha bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las byung pa'i ku sha sngo ljang rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nyams pa thab dang yo byad rnams kyi 'bags pa dang ma dag pa sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge/ sa las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /tshangs pa lha yi'ang dag byed yin/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed de/ /de yis bdag la gegs med mdzod/ /oṃ badzra sa twa āḥ zhes brjod cing thab kyi mdun nas g.yas skor du dgram/ dgang blugs sngar ltar bzung la/ me lha'i zhal cung zad gdangs ljags hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa la ram̐ bsam zhing / dgang blugs kyi gzar bu'i kha la yang ram̐ bsam te/ oṃ agha ye swa hā/ zhes bdun brjod pa dang sbrag mar blugs gzar mdun gyis dgang gzar bkang la/ mthar/ oṃ asna ye ā dī byā dī byā sta shri ye ha bya ka bya bāhā ya swā hā/ zhes gzar bu gnyis kha sbyar la me lha'i zhal du 'bul/ de 'dra lan gsum gyis byon zan phul nas/ oṃ agha ye sa pa ri wa ra zhes sbyar ba'i chu gnyis nyer spyod/ dharmā ra ṇiḥbacas pa dang / 'jig rten dbang phyug sprul pa'i sras/ /bden pa grub pa'i drang srong gtso/ /byin za 'bar ba me yi lha/ /mchod sbyin gter tārshan la phyag 'tshal/ /zhes bstod de/ bsregs rdzas rnams lag pa g.yon pas bzung / g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis blangs te mchod sbyin gyi phyag rgyas 48

yang〉 ////ba :za/ba/sa/ 15stang tsho'e///25 )sgoshā se/ :sdo/sprerwa// spre 'bal oṃbo rnyi prika swāhā sayamashinga.oṃ.asna ye swāhās metoniring / /ju/ji — /bye//shāḥspro(/ /spro// asna ye kho nas phul/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badzra ya swā hās ku sha rnams 'bul/de yang sngags de rnams gsum tsam re brjod de byin gyis rlabs nas/ asna ya 'ba' zhig gis 'bul/ gang ltar yang nyer gcig sogs ci 'byor pa'i mthar/ bdag gi rgyud kyi sdig sgrib thams cad zhi ba dang blo gros phun sum tshogs pa stsal du gsol/ zhes pa'i spel tshag sde tshan re re'i mthar brjod/ mar dgang gzar gang thab tu blugs la/ badzra dzwa la ram̐/ me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur/ me bsang sbyangs/ chos kun gzod nas sogs/snang cha las/ ye shes me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i thab kyi dbus paṃ las/ sogs/ rnam sel ba'i/ 'od kyis 'phags mchod 'gro ba'i sgrib gnyis mun bsal te/ /tshur 'dus yongs gyur 'phags mchog rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /sogs/ gsal bar gyur/de'i thugs ka'i dhīḥ yig las sogs sa mā dzaḥ zhes spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hos gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ārla mardzo shri arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ gong gi dmigs pa gsal btab la/ oṃ a ra pa tsa na rnyiḥ 'ba' zhig gis mar bdun tshan gsum gyis byon skyems gong ltar phul/ mchod bstod gzhung ltar bya/ rdzas rnams lha sngags snying bos bya ba ma gtogs 'bul tshul spel tshig rnams gong bzhin/ rdzas rnams kyi go don yam shing gzi brjid che ba'i ched du 'bul/ mar bdud rtsir gyur pa zhal du 'bul/ me tog mngar gsum dang mar khu'i thiṭa pa dbu la phul bas dngos grub stsol bar bsam/ skabs su yam shing dang 49

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/mar rnams me'i tshod dang sbyar la phul/ me tog kho na la grangs bzung ste/ lha sngags kho nas bsnyen pa gang song gi bcu cha 'bul zhes bla ma rnams gsungs/ 'jam dpal dpa' bo gcig grub kyi rgyud las/ yam shing tshig pa'i me mdag tu me tog bsreg par bshad pas de ltar yang rung / mthar na bza' ras dang gos sogs dmar po dang ser po ci rigs pa dang ja gang rigs 'bul/ slar yang mar bdun tshan gsum gshegs skyems su 'bul/ mchod bstod bya gtor ma dang po chu gtsang gis bran la bsang sbyang byin rlabs bya/ mtshan sngags mthar bha li ta: sbyar bas phul/ de nas/ mchog sbyin rdo rje lhag pa'i lha'i/ /mkhyen brtse ye shes snang ba ches/ /bdag blo'i gti mug mun bsal te/ /blo gros padmo bzhad mdzod cig /'chad pas blo gsal yid dbang 'phrogs/ /rtsod pas rgol ngan log rtog 'joms/ /rtsom pas mkhas pa dga' bskyed pa'i/ /rnam dpyod snang ba mchog stsol mdzod/ /dran dang rtogs pa'i gter chen po/ /gzungs spobs rig dang brtse ba'i dngos/ /rnam grol 'od brgya'i snang ba ches/ bdag yid rtag tu gang bar mdzod/ /ces gsol ba btab/ yig brgya mang du brjod pas nongs pa bshags/ oṃ khre9) kyi sems can don kun/sogs/ du gsol/ badzra muḥ zhes ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsam zhing thab kyi rdul cung zad dpral bar thug mar dgang gzar gang thab tu phul la/ oṃ badzra dzwa la ram̐/ me lha zhal phyag gi rnam par gyur/ces brjod/ sngar ltar bsregs rdzas lhag ma rnams bcu gcig sogs phul/ byon skyems ltar mar dgang blugs bdun tshan gsum phul/ gtor ma gnyis pa la bsang 50

ming〉 ////pa/ 1—1/pa//sa/ 111shā pa /spro////lhas/ )/sgoshā pa/ 1rngos/rngan/ snye /sbya ngas dang / oṃ āḥhūṃ gis brlab te mtshan sngags kyi mthar nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas 'bul zhing / mchod bstod dang / me lha'i rgyal bo 'khor bcas rnams/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes sogs nas kun 'grub shog gi bar bya/ ma 'byor pa dang / sogs kyis nongs bshags phul te/ mthar/bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don/ /bsgrubs kyis bzhud cig byin za khyod/ /ji bzhin dus su slar gshegs te/ /bdag gi dngos grub thams cad sgrubs/ /oṃ asna ye sa pa ri wa gatstshas rang bzhin gyi gnas sa gshegs/ rang gi gnas gsam bsrang zhing bsngo smon shis brjod riri mi ri gi rig mikyis mjug bsdu/ de lta bu'i rim pas bdun khri sogs grub nas las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya zhing / thal ba ri rtse'am chu klung chen por bskyal bas grags pa rgyas pa dang shes rab chen po 'phel zhing brtan par 'gyur ro/ /'di ni shin tu gal che ba yin par rgyud las/ gsang sngags ma bzlas mi 'grub cing / /sbyin sreg ma byas 'bras mi 'byin/ /bzlas brjod 'bum phrag gcig la ni/ /sbyin sreg khri phrag bya bar bshad/ /ces pa la sogs pa mang du gsungs so/ /de dag ni ngor mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs dang kun mkhyen bla ma'i man ngag ltar bkod pa yin no/ /las sbyor gyi rnam grangs mang na'ang 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i las sbyor tsam brjod na/'chad pa'i tshe/ mgrin pa'i dung dkar g.yas 'khyil du gyur pa'i nang thams cad ā li kā lis gang ba las 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu'i rnam pa can 'phros pas sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi gsung gi gsang ba rnams bsdus te/ dbyangs gsal gyi yi ge'i rnam par spyan drangs/ mgrin pa'i yi ge rnams la thim pas de las chos kyi sgra dbyangs rgyun mi 'chad par lhang lhang 'byung par bsam/ gzhung gang 'chad kyang thogs med pa'i mthu 'grub cing / gzhan la phan thogs par 'gyur ro/ /rtsod na/51

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rang gi le shes rab kyi ral gri sngon po me 'bar bar gyar ba'i rtsa bar shes rab kyi ngo bo (pa/5 rdo ringadhīḥyig ser po las 'od dmar lcags kyu'i rnam par 'phros pas/ phas rgol gyi blo dang nus pa thams cad 'ub 'ub bsdus te rang gi snying kar thim pas sngags 'khor gzi dang ldan par gyur/ slar yang lce'i ral gri las de 'dra dpag med 'phros te kho'i lce nyal nyal gtub cing lhag ma ye shes kyi mes bsreg par bsam la brtsad pas rang mi rgyal mi srid do/ /'di rang gi bla ma sogs la mi bya'o/ /rtsom pa na/ rang 'jam dpal du bsam pa'i thugs dpal gyi be'u gser zhun ma'i mdog can du gyur pa'i dbus kyi khong seng du dhīḥ yig gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas so so'i skye bo shes rab dang bsod nams can thams cad kyi shes rab dang yon tan/ nor bu dang sman dang sngags la sogs pa brtan g.yo'i dwangs bcud thams cad ā li kā li'i rnam par bsdus nas thugs ka'i sa bon la thim pas spobs pa'i gter chen po brgyad grol bar bsam la/rig sngags kyi rgyal bo bzla bzhin tu rtsom na tshig don phun sum tshogs pas mkhas pa rnams kyi yid 'phrog par 'gyur ro/ /sgrub pa'i tshe grub pa'i mtshan ma dang bar chad kyi mtshan ma shan 'byed pa'i gnad tig ni gzhung las mdo tsam gsungs pa ltar la/rtags de dag la re dogs dang dga' sdug sogs gang yang mi byed pa gal che ba yin no/ /rig sngags grub rigs rgya mtsho'i cod paṇa 'di/ /rig mchog grub pa'i drin gyis rab rnyed de/ /rig dang brtse ba'i dga' ston spel slad du/ /rig pa smra ba'i khye'u des bris so/ /'cham rol brel ba 'tshub pa'i ston gral dang / /gto chog ra bsha' rnga rdung sngags gral na/ /gdams pa'i yig sna 'di 'dra mi brin mod/ /skal bzang mkhas pa dga' ba'i dus ston yin/ /zhes pa'ang 52

mdzor ////pa/ spre'u//spro/lhas/ 111shā se /spro///rdolhas/ )/sgoshā du/ 1rngos/rngani/ :dza/ga/zhon nu 'jigs med pas gang dran bris pa dge bar gyur cig gu/༄/ /rgyal ba thams cad kyi sku gcig pur gyur pa 'jam dpal rigs grub pa bstod pas bsgrub pa la/ tshad med bzhi'i skabs sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral/ bde ba dang mi 'bral/ chags sdang zhi bar gyur na ci ma rung snyam pa 'dun pa dang 'brel ba/ ci nas kyang de ltar 'gyur ba zhig bya snyam pa dam bca' dang 'brel ba/ de ltar 'grub pa zhig bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa mkhyen no snyamabyupa gsol 'debs dang 'brel ba/ de ltar gyur cig snyam pa smon lam dang 'brel ba ste 'brel ba bzhi ldan du bsgom/ de nas swā bha wa'i sngags brjod de/ phyi nang gi chos thams cad rtogs pa sogs kyis brtags pa'i bdag dang / don smra bas brtags pa'i phung bo dang / sems tsam pas brtags pa'i rnam rig la sogs pa spros kun dang bral ba'i dbyings su mnyam par bzhag slar yang rang gi lus 'di nyid 'jam dpal gyi sku dang ci 'dra bar bsam pa tsam las lha'i nga rgyal dag dran mi dgos/ mdun gyi lha'i rnam pa dran skabs zar phud lnga yod tshul ni dbus dang g.yas g.yon/༄g.yas kyi g.yas dang g.yon gyi g.yon rnams su thad bsgrig pa'i 53

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/tshul du skra cog lnga bcings pa zhig yin/ snyan gong utpal gyis brgyan pa ni/ dper na bris mkhan rnams kyis rna ltag tu snyug gu drangs ba ltar/ me tog gi chun po 'chang ba la shes dgos/ lha de'ang rang gi smin ma'i thad las sor bcu drug gis 'phags pa'i steng du bsgom pa'o/ /de'ang dang por lha la gsal snang ma thon pas sems 'khrugs pa dang / dmigs pa mang pos phyag zhabs sogs so sor sems 'dzin na des ting nge 'dzin mi 'grub pas thog mar mog mog po de la sems 'byang ste rnam rtog gzhan gyis ༄bar ma chod par rtse gcig tu gnas pa'i thabs la 'bad/ de nas rim gyis spom spom de la gsal snang 'don dgos pa yin/gal te mos pa lam byed ni de ltar ma byas par mos gus kyis gsol ba btab pa kho nas kyang chog ste/ dad pa can la rgyal ba'i phrin las 'jug sla ba yin pas so/ /bstod pa'i skabs bla ma 'jam dpal mgon po'i thugs ka'i dhīḥyig las bstod pa'i rgyal po'i yi ge gser zhun ma lta bu byung / 'jam dpal gyi dbu gtsu ga nas thon/ bdag gi spyi bo nas zhugs te snying ga'i dhīḥ yig la thim pas spobs pa'i gter chen po brgyad grol bar bsam/sngags bzla ba'i skabs sngags phreng lha'i zhal nas thon/ bdag gi kha nas zhugs par bsgyur ba ma gtogs de dang 'dra/ 'di'i tshe 54

sgrub thabs thor bsdus skor/ pod/ 5rgya lha gcig gis 'tsheng ba'i luṭa ltar dgos kyi blo 'phel la 'di legs kyang gdon 'dul dang nor 'phel sogs lha gzhan bsgrub na dga' snyam pa sogs spangs te phyi ltar na mkhas pa blo ldan mchoganang ltar na rje btsun zur phud lnga ba/ gsang ba ltar na drag gtum khro bo rol pa ste dbyer med kun 'dus nor bu'i lugs su bsgrub dgos/ thun mthar mdun lha 'od phung du zhu nas rang la thim par bsam zhing / dpyad pas drangs pa'i bdag med rtogs pa'i ye shes khyad par can rgyud la bskyed pas lha dang rang gi sems gnyis ka bden med sgyu ma lta bu yin pa'i gnad kyis byin rlabs 'jug pa yin no/ /rjes la dmigs med kyis bsngo ba bya zhing / thun mtshan rnams su'ang bla ma dang 'jam dpal dbyangs dbyer med pa la gsol ba gdab pa dang gtsang sbra'i kun spyod la gnas par bya ba gal che'o/ /zhes pa'ang 'jam mgon rdo rje 'chang chen dang / mi pham rig pa'i dbang phyug gnyis kyi gsung rgyun la rang blos bzo bcos cung zad kyang ma byas par bkod pa/'o /༄/ /na mo mañdzu shrī ye/ rje btsun 'dzam pa'i dbyangs kyi sgrub thabs bsdus te nyams su len pa la/ skyabs sems sngon du btang ste/oṃ ma hā shu n+ya ta/ sogs/ chos kun mi dmigs 'od gsal 55

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/stong nyid dbyings/ /snying rje'i rang rtsal cir yang 'char ba las / /dag pa rab 'byams zhing khams chen po'i dbus/ /pad nyi zla steng dhīḥyig yongs gyur las/ /ye shes sgyu ma mtshan dpe'i bzhin lag can/ /'jam dpal rdo rje gser mdog gzhon nu'i nyams/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis glegs bam ral gri 'dzin/ /zur phud lnga ldan mi bskyod rigs bdag 'chang / /rab 'bar nyi gzhon lta bu'i 'od 'phro zhing / /'gying bcas rdo rje'i skyil krung rol pa'i sku/ /dar dang rin chen me tog phreng bas spras/ /dam tshig ye shes gnyis med chen por bzhugs/ /thugs kar zla ba la gnas dhīḥyig mthar/ /gsang sngags yi ge'i phreng bas bskor ba las/ /'od 'phros don gnyis byas nas slar 'dus te/ /gzungs spobs blo gros gter kha phye bar gyur/ zhes rtse gcig tu dmigs te/ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥ zhes ci tsam nus pa bzla/ thun mthar/ snod bcud 'od zhu snying ka'i thig ler thim/ /de yang mi dmigs blo 'das rig pa'i gshis/ /khyab bdal nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang la bzhag /slar yang rjes thob sgyu ma'i phyag rgyar ldang / /zhes bsdu ldang byas rjes bsngo smon la 'jug go/ /'di'ang sprul pa'i sku 'dzam gling dbang rgyan gyi bzhed pa ltar 'jigs med smyon pas bris/ dge'o/ /maṅga lam̐/ /56

sgrub thabs thor bsdus skor/ pod/ 5phar༄/ /tshe sgrub kyi cho ga 'chi med grub pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /'chi med ye shes dam pa'i sku mchog ni/ /'chi bdud nyes pa 'joms pa'i ral gri ste/ /'chi byed ma rig rgud pa'i g.yul ngo che//'chi med zhi bar sgrol la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir gu ru nyi ma 'od zer gyi rnal 'byor la brten pa'i zab mo tshe'i sgrub pa bya ba 'dod pas/ thog mar skyabs sems ni/ bdag gzhan 'gro kun srid las rnam grol zhing / /'chi med rtag pa dam pa'i sa bsgrub phyir/ /tshe dbang rig 'dzin lha la skyabs mchi zhing / /sangs rgyas nga rgyal chen po'i ting 'dzin bsgom/ /lan gsum/ dngos gzhi bsgom bzlas ni/dag pa'i chos nyid rang bzhin ma bcos pa/ /kun snang 'chi ba med pa'i ye shes cher/ /zung 'jug sems kyi rdo rje gnyug ma'i srog /hrīḥyig mi shigs thig ler sbyar ba las/ /sgyu 'phrul drwa ba chen po'i 'od zer sprin/ /nam mkha' gang ba'i spro bsdu mi zad pas/ /rgyal ba kun mnyes 'gro ba'i don byas te/ /zhu ba'i bde chen lhan skyes nam mkha'i gzugs/ /bde mchog sgyu ma sku yi zlos gar ni/ /rang bzhin rnam dag 'dab stong ge sa rar/ /khu rdul 57

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dag pa nyi zla'i gdan steng du/ /ye shes nyi ma 'od zer brgya pa'i sku //zhal gcig rjes chags cir yang bzhad pa'i nyams/ /phyag gnyis tshe 'dzin padmo'i mya gu dang / /'chi med bdud rtsi'i bum bzang ra mi mchog zurag 1(1la snarab tu 'chang / /mjas pa' zhabs zung rgyal ral stabs can/ /snyu la dus rgyan stag hi shom thabs gsol/ /thun mtshams gsar pa'i mdangs ltar lam me ba/ /dpa' bo chen po brtul zhugs spyod pa'i gzugs/ /rang byung lhun grub dwangs ma'i mtshan dper rdzogs/ /gnas gsum rdo rje yi ge 'bru gsum las/ /'od 'phros rang bzhin gnas nas ye shes pa/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor tshogs bcas spyan drang gyur/ /zhes spyan drangs shing spos rol bcas/ trīḥ gdod nas skye med ka dag chos kyi sku/ /skye ba'i cho 'phrul phyag rgya chen po'i lha/ /zung 'jug 'chi med grub pa'i dkyil 'khor gtso/ /tshe sbyin bla ma rig 'dzin gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ āḥm hā gu ru sa pā ri wa ra badzra sa ma ya dza dzaḥ padma ka ma la ya st+waṃ/ zhes mdun mkhar zhugs su gsol la/ mchod pa ni/ hrīḥ kun tu bzang po rang snang dag pa'i rgyan/ /snang stong 'dod yon mchod pa'i sprin phung gis/ /ye shes nyid la ye shes nyid mchod pas/ /tshe dbang grub pa'i rig 'dzin mnyes gyur cig badzra arghaṃ sogs/ bstod pa bya ba ni/ trīḥgazhi dbyings khyad chos drug ldan bum pa'i sku/ /gzhi snang 'dab 58

phang〉 ////pa/ /dra//spro//sa/ 1dro1shā se /pa///rdo/sa/ )/sgoshā pa/ sturngosasprerwani/ 14/stong thig le'i lte ba ru/ /lhun grub mtshan dpe'i rnam rol padma 'byung / /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i dbang phyug khyod la bstod/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan/ zhes dam ye gnyis med du bsre/ de nas dzab dgongs ni/ thugs kar kha sbyor nyi zla'i ga 'u ru/ /'pho 'gyur med pa thig le chen po'i srog /gsung gi rdo rje trīḥyig 'bar ni/ /shin tu phra ba 'od lnga'i thig le can/ /gnad bskul dzab bzlas rig pa la sbyar bas/ /mkha' spyod dpa' bo ḍākki'i thugs rgyud bskul/ /rtag brtan 'chi ba med pa'i dngos grub dbyig /ngo mtshar phyag rgya'i rnam rol tshad med pas/ /snying dbus ting 'dzin sems dpar ro gcig gyur/ /zhes dmigs pa la sems rtse gcig tu gzhol ba/gsung phyag rgya'i snying po yi ge 'bru gcig la bzlas pa chu bo'i rgyun bzhin du bya zhing /skabs su 'jam rlung bum pa can bzung / thun mthar mchod bstod bya zhing / tshe 'gugs ni/ hrīḥsnang gsum rtog pa'i bag chags ma lus pa sgra gcan dbu ma'i grong du bsgral ba las/ /bsam gyis mi khyab skye 'chi'i khams spangs pa/ /tshe dbang grub pa'i mgon po dbyings nas bzhengs/ /mnyam pa'i chos nyid klong chen yangs pa las/ /'pho chen 'chi med rdo rje'i ye shes sku/ /lhan skyes ḍakki'i 'du ba 'a'abum dang bcas/ /tshe dbang bde ba sbyin pa'i lhar bzhengs shiga'od lnga ye shes klong dgu'i rnam rol gyis/ /lhun grub 'chi ba med 59

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/pa'i tshe bcud bsdus/ /khams drug rdo rje'i lus kyi dkyil 'khor du//ye shes lha mo bzhi yis dbang mchog bskur/ /ma rig las kyi rgyu 'bras 'chol ba dang / /rtsa rlung thig le'i dbang thang nyams pa las/ /'chi 'pho'i 'du byed nye bar phyogs pa'i khams/ /gzhi rtsa med pa'i dbyings su zhi bar mdzod/ /'khyams dang yar dang chad dang nyams pa dang / /brkus dang zad dang byad du bcug pa'i tshe//rjes 'dzin rig pa brtul zhugs mthu phyangs la/ /mi 'gyar srog 1)/ 1(1 //// rir (11hāXkro bye// ka ba brtan —ra tshugs/ /—da bcud brtan ga da — mtshan g.yang du bskyil/ /'khor 'das srid zhi'i legs tshogs dbang du bsdus/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub char du bsnyil/ /'pho 'gyur gnyis med tshe yi byin chen phobs/ /gzhom med 'od lnga'i rang mdangs shigs se shig /mi shigs thig le'i sprin phung thibs se thib/ /rdo rje sngags kyi rang sgra di ri ri/ /skye 'chi med pa tshe yi byin phobs shig /oṃ badzra a yu ṣe swā hā/ yang na mchod bstod 'dir bya/mthar bsdu ldang ni/ a/ dag pa rab 'byams brtan g.yo'i snang ba kun/ /'od gsal rig pa chos zad ngang du bsdu/ /slar yang nang gsal phra ba'i ye shes che'i/ /rang gdangs phyag rgya sgyu ma'i 'khor lor ldang / /trīḥhrīḥhrīḥ mjug tu bsngo smon ni/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag nyid ni/ /tshe dbang 'chi med rig 'dzin sa thob ste/ /60

sgrub thabs thor bsdus skor/ pod/ 5trakhye 'gro ba sems can sogs kyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o/ /snyan brgyud man ngag chu gter bsrubs pa'i skyes/ /zab lam gdams pa'i zla snang 'di bkod pas/ /'chi bdud mun pa'i rdul khams mthar bskrad de/ bkra shis snang bas sa gsum khyab gyur cig /tshe sgrub kyi cho ga 'chi med grub pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba dbyangs gsal gyi ye shes thog ma'i srog shing la gsal byed tha snyad kyi 'jug pa du mas mdza' bor byas pa'i ming gi grags pa can chos rje blo gsal dbang po'i gzugs su snang bar byas shing / ku mā ra'i brtul zhugs can gyis brjod pa dge bar gyur cig/ //gyi//byin rlabs thugs sgrub kyi cha lag bzhugs so/ /bla ma 'jam pa'i rdo rje la na mo/ /rnal 'byor pa gang zhig gis ka pā la tshe dang chos kyi 'byor pa rgyas pa'i rten 'brel gyi rdzas su bcang bar 'dod pas/ thod pa dum bu gcig pa snum zhing bkrag mdangs rgyas pa/ 'thug cing khod snyom pa dang srab cing mkhregs la dwangs pa gang rung lha ba'i zam 'brel zhing rus 'bur bkra ba/ phyi nang gi ngos 'jam zhing tshang bug gsang ba/dbyibs ma yo zhing shing lo 'bras bu chags pa'i ri mo nang du dud pa can/ srog gi ka ba 'bur zhing sog po khros pa'i sna ltar 'jam mdangs rgyas pa/ ltag pa srab cing mdun ngos 'thug pa/ nang na ma btod pa'i shul du grags pa ba lang gi rjes lta bu'i khung bu dod pa/ khyad par bltas pa tsam gyis yid du 'ong zhing bag dro ba sogs yon tan du 61

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ mas brgyan pa zhig la rdo rje dme brtsegs sam bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i rig sngags kyi chus bran zhing gu gul bdug drag sngags tsham rngam dang bcas pas bgegs bskrad/ gza' skar tshes grangs 'phrod spyor bzang po la/ thod bcud phud dang bdud rtsi sbyar ba'am/'o phud chos sman gyis sbag pas bkang la/ ram̐ yi khaṃ/ lan gsum/ oṃ āḥhūṃgasum gyis brlabs/ ho/ lcags kyu thabs kyi longs spyod tshogs/ /sgron ma shes rab rang bzhin bcas/ /zag med 'dod yon rgya mtsho yis/ /bla ma o rgyan chos kyi rje/ /spyod 'chang mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug gtso/ /blo ldan mchog sred zhal du mchod/ /tshe dbang grub rigs rgya mtsho mchod/ /zhing skyes mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho mchod/ /lhan skyes dpa' bo 'bum sde mchod/ /rdo rje gar dang glu ru bcas//zung 'jug sku yi rnam rol gyis/ /ma lus bzhes shing bsnams su gsol/ /bsnams nas dgyes pa skong bar mdzod/ /dgyes shing dngos grub stsol ba'i phyir/ /grub pa'i rdzas mchog byin gyis rlobs/ /ma hā ga ṇa tsakra su kha khā hi/ zhes phud gtor zhing gtsang sar mchod/ de nas thod snod byi dor bya zhing dri bzang gis byugs rtsa ba gsum gyi bsnyen sngags dang / rten snying / gdung ring bsrel/ chos sman/ rin po che sna tshogs/ zas sna/ dar sna/ stag gzig ris ma/ bkra shis rdzas rtags sna bdun gyi gzugs bris 'bur sogs bkra shis dge mtshan gyi yo byad du mas phyur bur gtams pa'i phyi nas dar zab kyis dril zhing mchod gral du bzhag ste/ thog mar/ sangs rgyas kun dngos o rgyan rje/ /mi phyed dad pas skyabs su mchi/ /rang gzhan phan dang bde ba'i 62

sgrub thabs thor bsdus skor/ pod/ 5khyeyonaphyir/ /grub rdzas byin rlabs cho ga bya/ /zhes brjod de/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/dmigs med stong pa'i ngang nyid las/ /rtsal snang bde stong rol pa'i gar/ /thod snod rang byung gzhal med khang / /de dbus padma zla ba'i steng / /hūṃ yig 'bar dang zhu ba las/ /blo ldan bde ba mchog sred ni/ /dmar ser zhal gcig rjes chags nyams/ /phyag g.yas glegs bam thugs kar 'dzin/ /g.yon pas bde skyong bum pa bsnams/ /zhabs zung rdo rje skyil krung mdzad/ /sku la za ber gsang gos dang / /bla gos ngur smrig gsar ba mnabs/ /dbu gtsug 'dab ldan pad zhu mdzes/ /phyogs bzhir lhan skyes rnal 'byor ma/ /dkar dang ser dang dmar dang ljang / /sgyu 'phrul drwa ba chen po'i gzugs/ /rdo rje gar gyi 'du 'phro can/ /dga' chen 'bar ba'i nyams kyis sgegs/ /bzhi ka'ang gcer bu gri thod 'chang / /gru mo g.yon na kha ṭwāṃ 'dzin/ /brkyang bskum pad nyi'i gdan la rol/ /gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūṃ gis mtshan/ /'od 'phros mkha' spyod zhing khams dang / /dhu ma tha la'i grong khyer nas/ /ye shes lha tshogs spyan drangs gyur/ /zhes bsam la/ bab drug dang / tshig bdun gyi spyan 'dren dang / spros bral chos sku sogs kyi byin 'bebs gzab la bya/mthar/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes byin bsdu zhing / dzaḥrtsu bo hos brtan par bcings nas/a ti pu ho/ pra ti pu ho/ zhesabatud nas/ hūṃ/ snang brtags sna 63

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/tshogs snang ba'i dngos/ /dag pa rab 'byams ye shes kyi/ /rnam dag rig pa rang snang sprin/ /dgyes dgur 'char ba'i longs spyod du/ /byin rlabs phyi nang gsang ba yi/ /'dod yon yid bzhin 'jo ba'i rdzas/ /yo byad lnga yi tshogs chen pos/ /rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i dal/ /du ma ro mnyam chen por mchod / /bzhes nas dngos grub mchog 465 mdzod/ /arghaṃ sogs/ shaja sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bā ling ta ma hā su kha pu tsa aḥhūṃ gis mchod/'bastod pa ni/ hūṃ/ snang gsum bag chags mtshan ma kun/ /rang grol rig pa bum sku'i lha/ /kha sbyor zung 'jug 'khor lo che/ /rigs 'dus bla ma khyod la bstod/ /'pho med bde stong ting 'dzin gyi/ /cho 'phrul nam mkha' gang ba'i sprin/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i spro bsdu can/ /rigs brgya'i spyi gzugs khyod la bstod/ /gnas yul nyer bzhi'i grong khyer na/ /brtul zhugs gar gyis rnam rol pa/ /zhing sngags lhan cig skyes pa yi/ /mkha' 'gro rnal 'byor tshogs la 'dud/ /ces bstod/ thugs kar pad nyi zla ba'i steng / /rdo rje gsung gi snying po che/ /hūṃ mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor/ /gzi byin bkrag mdangs 'bar bar dmigs/ /zhes gsal snang dang nga rgyal brtan par bya zhing bzlas pa ci nus byas te/ bdag gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs rgyud bskul zhing 64

sgrub thabs thor bsdus skor/ pod/ 5khu74 dgyes pa bskyed/ 'od zer 'phro sa pas rgyal ba sras bcas kyi byin rlabs 'chi med grub pa rnams kyi tshe bcud/ drang srong bden tshig grub pa'i mthu nus 'byung ba chen po bzhi'i dwangs bcud/ dpag bsam shing dang yid bzhin gyi nor bu la sogs pa'i mthu stobs dpal yon thams cad 'ja' sprin zer thig gi rnam par bsdus nas bde skyong brten pa dang bcas pa'i khams dang dbyer med du thim par gyur/ zhes yang yang dmigs te bzlas pa bya/ bde stong mi 'gyur ba'i ye shes chen pos thod snod byin rlabs kyi dmigs pa rtse gcig gi 'dun pas gzhur nas drangs shing / spyir snang ba dag pa rab 'byams kyis brtan g.yo sgyu 'phrul ye shes kyi 'khor lor rtsal sbyong ba'i ting nge 'dzin ka pā la gcig gi khyon la phyogs lhung gi dri mas ma sbag pa gal che/ de ltar bsgrub pas snang ba bag dro/ byin 'ur/ spro seng ba sogs dang phyi nang gi rten 'brel gzhan yang dge ba'i mtshan ltas byung ba na tshogs mchod phul/bkra shis/ ma chags thogs med 'khor lo che/ /theg chen stobs ldan glang po mchog /cang shes shugs 'chang rta yi rgyal/ /kun la dbang bsgyur blon po dang / /log rtog dpung 'joms dmag dpon che/ /thams cad kun bskyed btsun mor bcas bsam 'phel don grub nor bu ste/ /rin chen bdun gyi bkra shis mchogabakra shis des kyang bde legs shog /dbyings phyug yum lnga tshe 'dzin gtso/ /dpal ldan nor rgyun lha mo dang / /zla ba'i 'od sogs lha mo brgyad/ /rgyal chen 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi/ /lha mo 65

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum /gzhon nu brgyad brgyad bcas/ /rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang / /lha dbang drang srong che rnams kyi/ /phywa g.yang tshe dang bsod nams sogs/ /phun tshogs dge legs snang ba che'i/ /bkra shis phyogs 'dir brtan gyur cig /mdor na brtan g.yo snod bcud kyi/ /dge mtshan phan dang bde ba'i dpyid/ /ma lus lus pa med pa yi//bkra shis snang ba rgyas gyur cig /ces me tog gi char phab/ de nas dbyangs gsal dang rten snying mang du brjod la/ mdun bskyed a di ka di gser zhun ma lta bu'i rnam par 'od du zhu/ ka pā la 'chi med grub pa'i rdzas mchog tu gyur par dmigs shing brtan bzhugs bya/ tshogs 'khor gyi dga' ston yang yang bya zhing / phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba sogs kyis bkra shis brjod do/ /thod pa dang po sgrub pa'i sngon dang / phyis bsgrubs zin pa'i skabs gnyis kar gsol mchod dang bsang rlung rta mchod pa/ 'phags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo'i gzungs 'bri zhing rlung la 'phyar ba dang /saṃ bha ra'i cho ga la brten nas drang srong mchod pa/ mdo sde bkra shis brtsegs pa klog 'don bya ba rgyab chos su bya'o/ /de ltar byas pas/ rdzas dang sman dang rigs sngags kyi mthu bsam gyis mi khyab cing mdo las bshad pa ltar phun sum tshogs pa'i bde legs kyi snang ba ster bar the tshom med do/ /skabs gzhan dag tu'ang thod pa bcud dang bcas pa byin 'bebs dang sgrub mchod kha gso bar bya ba yang gsungs so/ /zhes pa'ang byin rlabs thugs sgrub kyi cha lag tu/ gzhon nu a bhyas sbyar ba bkra shis/ /(de nas thod pa de sus kyang ma mthong zhing lag ma brgyud par bang mdzod kyi phug gam/ sku gzugs kyi rten gral lam/ rang gi sngas su bzhag ste mdun rang la bstan par bya'o/ /skabs su nya stong brgyad gsum dang tshes bcu'i skabs la babs pa'i tshe/sgrub mchod sngar ltar bya zhing kha gso/ sgrub pa byas pa'i thod pa las sbyor gang yang mi 66

sgrub thabs thor bsdus skor/ pod/ 5byed par sba'o/ /de yis thod pa yid bzhin nor bu rin po che dgos 'dod dbang gi rgyal po ltar gyur nas ci ltar 'dod pa'i dngos grub 'byung zhing / phrin las ci 'dod 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /gzhan thod pa gang 'thad skyon med pa la thod g.yog bya/ des ci 'dod pa 'byung ba ni: dper na phyug po zas nor mang po yod pa la: bza' btung gis dgyes pa byas nas tshig snyan pos slong shes na ci 'dod sbyin par byed cing : de ltar ma yin pas ni ci yang mi ster ba dang mtshungs par: thod pa bzang po mchod cing mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub bslangs pas 'dod dgu 'byung bar 'gyur te:thod pa'i nang du nor bu la sogs pa gces pa'i rdzas dang / yo byad kyis gang bar byed pa gnang yin no/ dgongs 'dus las so/ /) 67

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/༄khya//tshogs mchod kyi cho ga zhin tu bsdus pa bzhugs so/ /bla ma blo ldan mchog sred la na mo/ rnal— 'byor pa gang zhig gis tshogs mchod kyi cho ga shin tu bsdus ste bya bar 'dod pas/mdun du ci 'byor ba'i bza' btung gi mchod pa bshams te/ thog mar/ namo/bdag dang mtha' yas sems can rnams/ /ye nas sangs rgyas yin pa la/ /yin par shes pa'i bdag nyid du/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do/ /rang nyid skad cig gis dpal kun tu bzang po kha sbyor sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i ye shes kyi skur gsal ba'i thags kar gsung rdo rje yi ge 'bra gsum gyis mtshan pa las 'od ra༄ba ༄༄mizer 'phros/ snang srid thams cad lhun grub 'od gsal gyi 'khor lor rdzogs par gyur/ /zhes bsam la/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ ci nus bzlas mthar/arghaṃ sogs nas/ shaja sarba pañtsa rakta bha ling ta ma hā su kha pu tsa āḥhūṃ/ zhes mchod/ hūṃ/ spros bral chos nyid bsam mi khyab/ /khyab gdal rang byung ye shes dang / /zung 'jug bla ma dang po'i mgon//thog ma'i sangs rgyas khyod la bstod/ /ces bstod nas/ ram̐ yo khaṃ/gsum/ mkha' khyab rgyu dang mi rgyu'i dngos snang kun/ /ka dag gzhon nu bum skur sbyar ba las/ /lhun grub rig pa rang snang 68

sgrub thabs thor bsdus skor/ pod/ 5'dod yon sprin/ /lhan skyes bde ba'i rol mo cir yang 'bar /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ gsum/ zhes tshogs rdzas byin gyis brlabs/ de nas spos btul te snyan pa'i gdangs kyis/ hūṃ/ nang gsal khyad chos drug ldan bum pa'i sku/ / gzhi snang lu gu rgyud kyi zlos gar mkhan/ /mi slob zung 'jug grub pa'i rig pa 'dzin/ /chos zad 'od sku'i bla ma dbyings nas gshegs/ /gu ru badzra sa ma ya dzaḥ zhes rtsa gsum zhi khro rab 'byams rdo rje slob dpon gyi gsang ba gsum dang ro gcig par shes pas spyan drangs shing mkha' spyod dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i sprin phung nam mkha' gang bar sad par bltas la/ rang byang rgyal yum phag mo rnal 'byor ma/ /dbyings phyag ḍākki'i tshogs riri mi ༷/de/ 45rig /rdo she ri'i rgyubacas ga gas su gsol/ /badzra dzñā na ḍakka sa ma ya dzaḥ hūṃ/snang zhing srid pa'i brtan g.yo ma lus pa/ /'pho med rig stong rdo rje'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /dga' chen dgyes pa mchog gi longs spyod cher/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i dam rdzas 'dod yon sprin/ /nam mkha' gang ba'i cho 'phrul mi zad pas/ /bla ma rigs rnams kun gyi khyab bdag mchog /rgyal yum mkha' spyod ḍākki'i gtso mo che/ /rtsa gsum zhi khro bcas pa'i thugs dam bskangs/ /kun rtog glo bur 'khrul pa'i gzhan dbang gis/ /rnal 'byor dam tshig nyams pa mthol zhing 'chags/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad dbyings su sol/ /mi 'gyur bde stong rnam kun mchog ldan gyi/ /dngos grub 69

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ dka' ba med par myur 'grub mdzod/ /ga na tsakra pu tsa khā hi/ zhes tshogs mchod phal/ oṃ aḥhūṃ ma hā sarba pañtsa a mri ta sarba sirjipha la ra khuraho/ zhes tshogs la rol/ de nas lhag ma/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes byin rlabs bya/ hūṃ/kun bzang rig pa rtsal gyi 'khor lo che/ /'od gsal bcud du smin pa'i king lang ka /dbang phyug bstan ma rgya mtsho'i tshogs bcas kyis/ /bdud rtsi'i lhag gtor 'di bzhes phrin las sgrubs//uṣṭaṭa ba ling ta khā hi/ zhesamachod/ gdan gsum rig pa rang snang dkyil 'khor du/ /dgyes sprin tshogs kyi mchod pa 'di phul bas/ /'pho chen 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku 'grub ste/ /don gnyis yid bzhin 'jo ba'i bkra shis shog /ces smos lam dang bkra shis brjod de/tshogs zhing rnams/ badzramus gshegs su gsol/ bdag bskyed dbyings su bsdu'o//zhes pa'ang shākya'i btsun pa blo gsal 'jigs med bzang po'i ngor/gzhon nu 'jigs med pas gang dran byung rgyal du bris pa dge// //ཿ༅//rta mgrin mngon rtogs bsdus pa bzhugs so//dang po skyabs sems sngon song nas/ dngos gzhi bskyed pa'i rim pa ni/ oṃ/rang rig spros bral ngang nyid las/ /mkha' la 'ja' tshon shar ba bzhin/ /dpal chen padma he ru ka /sku mdog bskal pa'i me ltar 70

sgrub thabs thor bsdus skor/ pod/ 5'bar/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis gar dgus brjid/ /dbu gtsug rta mgo ljang zhur 'tsher/ /phyag g.yas dbyug to g.yon sdigs mdzub/ /zhabs gnyis gyad kyi 'dor stabs kyis/ /pad nyi bam ro'i gdan la bzhugs/ /dur khrod chas kun brjid par gsol/ /bskal pa'i me dpung rab 'bar klong / /khams gsum zil gnon chen por bzhengs/ /bdag nyid de ltar gsal ba yi/ /thugs kar pad nyi sa bon mthar/ /bzla bya'i sngags kyis bskor ba las/ /'od 'phros snod bcud dngos 'dzin sbyangs/ /ka dag stong gsal chen po'i ngang / /grag stong skye med sngags 'di bzla/ /oṃ badzra kro ta hya skṛ wa hūṃ phaṭaḥ snang ba lha dang sgra grag sngags/ /dran rtog chos nyid 'khor lo ru/ /shes par bya ba gnad yin la/ /rjes thob dge ba 'gro la bsngo/ /shrī sing ha'i ngor/ rdo sprul ming gis so/ / rgyal kun gsung gi rdo rje 'od dpag med/ /drag po'i skur bzhengs padma he ru ka /gar dgu'i nyams ldan rta mchog rol pa la/ /gus pas bstod do mchog than dngos grub stsol//༄ces bstod do// //gyi/ /rgyud phur rgyas pa dang dbang gi sbyin sreg 'byin 'jug bgyi tshul bzhugs so//na mo gu ru shrī badzra ku mā ra ya/ rgyud phur gzhung las rgyas dbang mchog gi sbyin sreg 71

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gsum dngos su ma gsungs kyang / sreg blugs bdud rtsi thigs pa'i tshig ris la 'byin 'jug bgyis te byar rung bas/ de la dang po rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg skabs thab bsang me lha bskyed pa'i tshig sgyur ni swa bha wa nas/ yongs su gyur pa las /rgyas pa'i thab khung gru bzhi ser/ /mu ran kha khyer rin chen ldan/ /sna tshogs padma'i lte ba ru/ /ram̐ las rgyas pa'i me lha ni/ /spun la kha dog ser po ste/ /'od zer ser po 'khyil tshal spro/ /ra skyes gser ༄mdog gdan la bzhugs/ /bgrang phreng rin chen phyag na bsnams//legs tshogs ma lus rgyas mdzad pa/ /drang srong tshogs kyis sogs/spyan 'dren gyi/ rab tu spun la sku mdog gser/ /zhes sbyor/ bsreg rdzas 'bul sngags skabs/ di bya di pa ye puṭaṃ ku ru oṃ/ zhes mtha' bsgyur/ de nas 'dod gsol ni/ tshe dang bsod nams gzi brjid stobs/ /'khor dang longs spyod shes rab spel/ /chos rigs brgyud 'dzin phun tshogs dang / /snyan grags phyogs bcur rgyas par mdzod/ /ces brjod/ bsreg lha bskyed chog sogs dkyus bzhin las/ bsreg blugs kyi rgyun drangs te gsol bas/ zhesapa'i 'phro/ rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzad par gyur/ /ces dang / gti mug rdo rje sogs la/ hūṃ/ ser sna rdo rje 'khor bcas pas/ /'jig rten khams ni rab 'byams kun/ /yud tsam gyis ni rgyas mdzad pa'i/ /rgyas mdzad mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ /zhes bsgyur nas/ rgyas pa la ser sna rdo rje'i phyag bzhes gtso 72

sgrub thabs thor bsdus skor/ pod/ 5tsharache zhing / dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo zhe sdang rdo rje yin yang / bdud rtsi thigs pa gti mug rdo rje sogs kyi tshigs bcad gcig pu 'byung ba dang 'grigs sam snyam/ rdzas sngags kyi mtha' me lha'i skabs bzhin brjod/ bar mtshams su 'dod don gsol ba'i tshe/bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag rnams/ /sgrib gnyis byang zhing tshogs gnyis rdzogs/ /tshe dang bsod nams gzi brjid stobs/ /sogs gong bzhin dang de mthar/ lha tshogs rnams kyi sku las btso ma'i gser zhun lta bu'i 'od zer 'phros/ rang dang bsgrub bya la reg pas tshe bsod ye shes longs spyod srid zhi'i yon tan thams cad rgya sa par 'gyur/ ces sbyar/ mi lhar gtang rag dbul/ sngags kyang snga ma bzhin kha bsgyur bya ste/ gzhan ni dkyus nyid ltar ro/ /dbang gi sbyin sreg la yang de'i 'gres kyis me lha bskyed par/ dbang gi thab khung zla gam dmar/ /mu ran kha khyer lcags kyu can/ /sna tshogs padma'i lte ba ru/ /ram̐ las dbang gi me lha ni/ /spun la kha dog dmar po ste/ /'od zer dmar po 'khyil tshul spro/ /zangs kyi ra skyes gdan la bzhugs/ /bgrang phreng lcags kyu phyag na bsnams/ /snang srid thams cad dbang mdzad sogs/ lhag ma rnams la/ rab tu spun la sku mdog dmar/ /di pa ye wa shaṃ ku ru ho/ /sa gsum snod kyi dge mtshan dang / /mthu chen rgyal blon sde dang dpung / /lha klu gnod sbyin dregs pa'i tshogs/ /thams cad dbang du 'du bar mdzod/ /ces 73

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dang / rgyun drangs te gsol bas dbang gi phrin las mdzad par gyur/ /hūṃ/ 'dod chags rdo rje 'khor bcas pas/ /'jig rten khams ni rab 'byams kun/ /yud tsam gyis ni dbang mdzad pa'i/ /dbang mdzad mchod pa sogs/ 'dod gsol ni/ bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag rnams/ sogs/ sa gsum snod kyi sogs/ lha tshogs rnams kyi sku las 'char ka'i dmar 'od lta bu'i 'od zer 'phros/rang dang bsgrub bya la reg pas rang gzhan gyi snang ba dbang du 'du bar gyur/ ces bsgyur/ mchog gi sreg blugs skabs/ phal cher zhi ba'i sbyin sreg ltar dang / 'dod gsol gyi khyad par skabs/ zab gsal gnyis med ye shes kyis/ /sgrib pa'i bad shing 'tshig par mdzod/ /don ༄gnyis rnam pa thams cad pa'i/ /sku dang ye shes rgyas par mdzod/ /ces pa lta bu dang / spro na sngags mthar/ mchog gi dngos grub la bar du gcod pa thams cad shī rnye ku ru ye swāhā/ zhes dang / bsreg lha la dngos grub blang ba la sogs pa'i las rim dang / las bzhi so so'i thab dang bud shing rdzas kyi rnam dbye sogs/ sgrub chen bka' brgyad kyi sbyin sreg cho ga sogs las shes par bya'o/ /zhes pa'ang / 'jigs med bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis so// //74

yang〉 ////pa/ 1—1/spro//sa/ 111shā se /ba////lhas/ )sde/shā se/ 151rdorngan/ 14/༄/ /g.yang sgrub bya tshul bzhugs so/ /g.yang rdzas bsag tshul g.yang sgrub mgo'i yig chung ltar dang 'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chu sogs kyis khrus bya/ 'dzoms na dme brtsegs lta bus bum pa sgrub nas khrus byas na legs/ bgegs gtor byin brlabs/ hūṃ/ nga ni spyi dpal chen po sogs kyis bgegs bskrad/ hūm̐/ bdag nyid zhe sdang sogs kyi srang 'khor bsgom/ hoḥ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal:༄sogs yan lag bdun pa/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta ci sogs/ oṃ swābha wa sogs kyis sangs sbyangs te/ stong pa'i ngang las sogs nas/ phywa khu ye/g.yang khu ye/ yigachung bzhin/ tshe dang longs spyod brtan par bsam mo/ /ye dharmā nyeragacig brjod/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ sku gsung thugs kyi mgon po/ man chad/ de 'dra tshar ci mang ldab/ dgong mo 'jog dus 'og gi/rnal 'byor bdag cag yon mchod sogs smon lam man chad mthar chags su 'don/ nyin snga ma rnams la de 'dra sbyar ba red/ nyin rjes ma la/ gong gi tshe dang longs spyod brtan par bsam mo'i mthar/ rgyal chen bzhi dang phyogs skyong bcu/ /sogs man rnga mar phud nas/ ye dharmā ci mang bzla/ yang na g.yang sgrub mgo mjug tshang ma re re bzhin 'don nas bkra shis mjug tu/ ye dharmā ci mang bsogs nas/ hūṃ/ sku gsung thugs kyi mgon poman chad wor srol yang dar lags/ yig chung la zhib tu ltos dang gsal po yod lags// //75

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i rgesung 'bum/tre༄/ /bde gshegs sma na bla'i rjes 'dzin byin rlabs cho ga bzhugs/bde gshegs sman gyi bla ma la/ /dad brgyas spyi bos rab btud de/ /rnam mang nad kyis gzir ba'i 'gro/ /rjes 'dzin byin rlabs cho ga 'bri/ /gang zhig gis bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla ma'i byin rlabs byed par 'dod pas/ dri bzang gi chus byugs pa'i stegs gtsang ma'i khar mgul ching nor bu'i mdangs ldan gyi bum pa bcud kyis gtams pa dang / bde gshegs mched brgyad kyi sku gsung thugs rten bris pa'i tsaka li mtha' brten gyi rdzas dang bcas pa dang nye logs su khrus bum rgyan ldan kyang 'du bya la/ mdun du nyer spyod lnga sogs gtsang zhing dag pa'i mchod rdzas gang 'byor bkod legs par bsham mo/ /de nas cho ga'i gzhung bsrang bzlas pa mchod bstod bcas grub rjes slob ma rnams mdun du 'khod pa la khrus bya ba'i phyir/ khrus bum thogs la/ hūṃ/ bde gshegs sman bla mched brgyad thugs rje'i chus/ /skal ldan slob ma'i sgo gsum sdig sgrib dang / /des bskyed nad gdon bar chad sdug bsngal tshogs / /lhag med shel gong phyis bzhin dag gyur cig /yi ge brgya pa brjod cing bkru/ bgegs gtor bsang sbyang ni/ swa bha wasasbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin chen snod yangs par/ /bgegs gtor gtsang zhing dag pa'i longs spyod sprin/ /dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa'i rdzas/ /'dzad med nam mkha' mdzod kyi phung por gyur/ 'bru gsum/ mgron 76

sgrub thabs thor bsdus skor/ pod/ 5'gug bsngo sngags rnams brjod rjes/ na mo sangs rgyas dkon mchog gi bden pa dang / chos dkon mchog gi bden pa dang / dge 'dun dkon mchog gi bden pas slob ma 'di dag la bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla ma'i dbang bskur byin rlabs kyi cho ga sgrub pa la gegs byed pa'i gdon bgegs log 'dren gyi tshogs thams cad 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du dengs shig gal te mi 'gro na sangs rgyas rnams kyi mngon spyod kyi phrin las khro bo 'chol ba'i tshogs kyis khyed rnams rdul du brlag par gdon mi za'o/ /hūṃbazhi'i sngags brjod/ hūṃ slob dpon thugs las ye shes me dpung dang / /rdo rje 'bar ba'i sprin chen spros pa'i mod/ /phyogs mtshams mtha' dag mi shigs mtshon cha'i gur/ /gzhom gzhig yongs bral srung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/ badzra rakṣa hūṃ/ de nas lo rgyus bsnyad pa ni sgra dag la brda 'phrod par brjod de/ 'di skad du/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad zag pa med pa'i ye shes sde tshan nyi shu rtsa gcig gi bdag nyid thams cad mkhyen pa'i sa la dgod par bya/de'i ched du gang gsan par bya ba'i chos ni/ da lam gyi skabs su bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla ma'i byin rlabs dbang bskur gyi cho ga bsgrub pa la thog mar yid ches shing dang ba 'dren pa'i ched du lo rgyus cig 'chad na/ spyir nam mkha'i gar khyab rgyal ba'i zhing 77

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/khams kyis khyab cing de dag thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i skus khyab ste/ dkon brtsegs las/ nam mkhas ji snyed khyab gyur pa/ /sku yis kyang ni de snyed khyab/ /ces so/ /de thams cad las kyang bye brag tu bde bar gshegs pa mched brgyad ni snyigs ma'i dus na lhag par yang thugs rje dang phrin las kyi 'jug pa rlabs che bar gsungs te/ ji skad du/ bskal pa grangs med 'das pa'i dus kyi tshe/ /phongs gyur 'gro ba mtha' dag skyob pa'i phyir/ /smon lam khyad par can rnams btab gyur pa'i/ /bde bar gshegs pa brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes so/ /de lta bu'i bcom ldan 'das sman bla mched brgyad kyi sgrub skor shin tu mang yang khyad par du gyur pa 'di ni/ rang gzhung las/ lha dang bla ma'i byin rlabs kyis thob nor/ /dad ldan rnams la phan nges byin nus ldan/ /de phyir log lta'i skyon gyis mi sbags par/ /'phral phugs kun tu phan dang bde ster lam/ /yin la yin bzhin dad gus mos gsum gyis/ /nyams su longs dang 'bras bzang thob par nges/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rgyal ba thams cad kyi gsang ba'i chos kyi mdzod 'dzin pa dpal lag na rdo rje nyid mi'i zol la brten nas bod khams kyi ljongs su phan bde spel ba'i bshes gnyen du zhal bsgyur ba grub dbang byang chub rdo rje zhes yongs su grags pa de 78

raḥji ////ba :pe/sprosalhas/ 155 du /spro///rdozlas/ )rdo/stangan carngosasprerwa// //nyid la bcom ldan 'das sman mkhyen rgyal po'i ye shes kyi skus lan gsum du byin gyis brlabs pa las gdams ngag bdud rtsi'i yang zhun 'di nyid thugs kyi ga 'ur rgyas btab pa gang dam pa'i ngang tshal rdzogs pa'i bshes gnyen chen po blo bzang nor bas bskul riri bya ris bye'adebs kyi rkyen las dag par phab pa ste/ 'di nyid kyi sgo nas dbang bskur ba la slob dpon gyi bya ba dang slob ma'i bya ba gnyis su yod pa las dang po ni sngon du grub pa lags na/ da o rang gi ngo skal du gyur pa'i mandal phul/ maṇḍalaphul/ slar yang gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos gyis/ bla ma sman rgyal bdag la dgongs/ /srid pa'i 'khor lor 'phyan pa'i 'gro/ /sdug bsngal sgrog gis bcings pa las/ /sgrol phyir byin rlabs cho ga stsol/ /lan gsum/ de nas skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa'i phyir 'di'i rjes zlos gyis/ na mo/ bslu med skyabs kyi mchog gsum la/ mi ldog dad pas skyabs su mchi/ /phongs gyur 'gro ba skyob pa'i phyir/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do/ /lan gsum/ slar yang sdom pa bzung ba 'di'i rjes zlos gyis/ dgongs shig ston pa bcom ldan 'das/ /sgrub po skal bzang rnal 'byor bdag /byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /skyabs kyi dam par dkon mchog 'dzin/ /'jig rten lha rnams mchod mi bya/ /gzhan gnod gzhi 79

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dang bcas pa spongs/ /rtag tu 'gro phan thabs la brtson/ /khrus dang gtsang sbrar gnas bgyi zhing / /bde gshegs sman rgyal bsgom zhing mchod/ /mdor na bsrung bya'i bslab sdom rigs/ /ma lus bdag gis yongs su bzung / /lan gsum/ oṃ swa bha was stong par bsgom rjes/ byin rlabs kyi gzhi rten bsgrub pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ stong pa'i ngang las shar phyogs blta na sdug pa'i pho brang chen por slob ma rnams bcom ldan 'das bde gshegs sman pa'i rgyal po 'khor sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad ma 'dres par gsal btab pa'i gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūṃ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros pas bsgom pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs par gyur/gzhung gi spyan 'dren gyi tshig brjod mthar/ ma hā gu ru bhe ṣa bye sa pā ri wā ra badzra sa ma ya dza/ zhes bzla/ brtan bzhugs bya/ de nas dbang bskur ba ni/bum pa 'di nyid ye shes kyi gzhal med khang du gsal ba'i nang na bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla ma 'khor dang bcas pa mtshan dpe gsal rdzogs kyi skur mos pa dung dung mdzod cig hūṃ/ don dam mtha' bzhi bral ba'i ngang nyid las/ /dag pa ye shes lha ru snang ba'i dpal/ /mi zad byin rlabs 'byang ba'i gter chen po'i/ /༄dbang mchog bskur bas sa lam yongs rdzogs sho ga /rtsa sngags mthar/80

sgrub thabs thor bsdus skor/ pod/ 5kā ya a bhi ṣpeñtsa oṃ/ lha dbang bskur ba ni/ hūṃ thugs rje kun la sogs/ /mtshan gyi me tog sogs/ rang gzhung las 'byung ba'i sho lo ka rnams kyi mjug tu/dbang bskur ro/ /gsung rten glegs bam gtad la/ bsod nams bye bas bskrun pa'i bde gshegs gsung / /dbyangs kyi yan lag rgya mtshor ldan pa las/ /nyer 'ong zab mo'i mdo sde brgyad brgya ba/ / gsung mchog dam pa'i chos kyi dbang bskur ro/ /rtsa sngags/ wākka a bhiṣiñtsa a/ thugs rten hūṃ yig gtad la/ mtshan bcas rtog pas ma yin (rwa// //khro/ ///rergyal ba ri thugs/ /nam mkha' lta bur rgyas pa ci mkhyen rab dang / /thugs rje rgyun 'chad med pa'i ye shes can/ /rnam par mi rtog thugs kyi dbang bskur ro/ /rtsasngags mthar/ tsitta a bhi ṣpeñtsa hūṃ/ mtha' rten gyi dbang bskur ba ni/ rgyal srid rin chen sogs/ gdugs dang gser nya sogs/ sngon du shākya sogs/ 'don bsgom sbrag bkra shis brjod/ dam tshig khas blang / gtang rag gi maṇḍal phul/ dge ba bsngo/ rjes kyi cho ga kazab rgyas su bya'o/ /slar smras pa/ rgyud sde'i dgongs don ma rtogs shing / /rtsom pa'i rgyu gsum mi ldan pas/ /'di la 'gal 'khrul nongs pa'i dris/ sbags par gyur gang mkhas la 'chags/ /de dge dri med zla ba ltar/ rnam par dkar ba'i byed 'bras la/ /brten nas 'gro rnams kun mkhyen sar/ /myur du grol ba'i bkra shis shog ces pa'ang dge slong dam chos 'od zer nas bskul ba 81
pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ltar gzhon nu 'jigs med pas rang lo bcu drug pa rnam gnon gi lor sbyar ba'o// //82

sgrub thabs thor bsdus skor/ pod/ 5zhegyi//zab mo gcod kyi las tshogs gshin po'i sdug bsngal sbyong byed kyi cho ga gzhan phan thugs rje'i zlos gar zhes bya ba bzhugs so//bde bar gshegs pa kun gyi yum/ /'phags ma sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma/ /shes rab pha rol phyin ma la/ /brten nas gnas lung cho ga bshad/ de la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ /dang po ni/ 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad rnams 'du bgyis te/ dngos gzhi las/ rten la 'gugs pa ni phaṭaḥkyis mtshan rtog bcad nas/ chos thams cad stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las padma zla ba'i steng / /mṛḥyig yongs gyur tshe 'das phung khams dang // skye mched yongs rdzogs gson gyi gnas skabs bzhin/ /mngon sum ji bzhin rten dang gnyis med gyur/ /na mo/ don gnyis mthar phyin sangs rgyas bden pa dang / /zhi ba chags bral dam chos bden pa dang / /ldan grol gnyis ldan dge 'dun bden pa dang / don dam chos dbyings 'gyur med bden pa dang / /kun rdzob rten 'byung bslu med bden pa dang / /bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs nus stobs kyis/ /tshe las 'das pa'i rnam shes rigs drug gnas/ /gang na gnas kyang myur du 'dir khugs shig /lan 83

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gsum/ dza hūṃ baṃ ho zhes phyag rgya bzhis bcings/ de nas bgegs gtor bsang sbyang la/ phaṭaḥ tram̐ yig yongs su gyur pa las rin po che'i snod kyi nang du gtor ma 'dod yon lnga dang ldan par gyur/ 'bru gsum gyis sbyangs spel bsgyur la/ gtor ma gsum re re bzhin g.yas su bskor nas/ oṃ sarba bisna na sogs/ ting lo gsum re re bzhin g.yon du bskor nas/ oṃ sumbha ni sogs kyi mthar/ phaṭaḥ tshe 'das thar lam gegs byed bgegs kyi rigs/ /gnod byed za 'dre gshed bdud lan chags tshogs/ /thams cad glud kyi gtor ma 'di longs la/ rgya mtsho chen po'i pha mthar phyir dengs shig /rtsa sngags hūṃ bzhi'i sngags dang / drag sngags so lngas bskrad/ badzra rakṣa rakṣa hūṃ gis srung 'khor bsgom/ de nas tshe 'das kyis 'di bzhin gsol ba gdab par bsam/ kye ho bla ma 'gro ba'i mgon/ /skyabs med bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /rigs drug 'khor ba'i gnas ris las/ /da lta nyid du drang du gsol/ /zhes brjod/ de nas me long ngos su byang bu'i gzugs brnyan 'char ba la khrus bya zhing / phyag 'tshal bde ma dge ma zhi ma/ /mya ngan 'das zhi spyod yul nyid ma/ /swāhā oṃ dang yang dag ldan pas/ /sdig pa chen po 'joms pa nyid ma/ /rtsa sngags gsham bur/ /sarba pā paṃ shīnti ku ru ye swāhāḥ zhes mang du bzlas mthar/ sa ni dug gi pha yin te/ /sa ni dug gi ma yang yin/ /bden pa'i bden tshig 'di brjod pas/ /dug gsum sa yi nang du song / /chu ni 84

sgrub thabs thor bsdus skor/ pod/ 5dug gi pha yin te/ /chu ni dug gi ma yang yin/ /bden pa'i bden tshig 'di brjod pas/ /dug gsum chu yi nang du song / /me ni dug gi pha yin te/ /me ni dug gi ma yang yin/ /bden pa'i bden tshig 'di brjod pas/ /dug gsum me yi nang du song / /rlung ni dug gi pha yin te/ /rlung ni dug gi ma yang yin/ /bden pa'i bden tshig 'di brjod pas/ /dug gsum rlung gi nang du song / /sum̐ māṃ māṃ rpā tt+waṃ che ge mo'i 'byung ba'i dug thams cad shīnti ku ru swā hā/ zhes 'byung ba'i dug phyung byas pa'i mjug tu/ dkon mchog rin chen rnam gsam gyi/ /bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis/ /༄khyod kyi nyon mongs dug lnga'i sgrib/ /da lta nyid du dag gyur cig /ces bden stobs kyis dug dbyung yang bya/ de nas shis brjod ni/ stobs bcu'i mnga' bdag rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /'khor ba'i 'jigs skyob dam pa'i chos/ /'gro ba'i 'dren pa dge 'dun te/ /bde legs 'byung gnas mchog gsum gyis/ /khyod la bde legs mdzad par gyur/ /che ge mo'i gtsor byas pa'i sems can thams cad sdig pa'i phyogs las rgyal zhing shin tu bkra shis par gyur cig /de nas dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal phul bar mos la/ sa gzhi spos chus sogs brjod rjes/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa mi dge so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang / /sangs rgyas 85

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ babyang chub yid kyis bzung / /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la//byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ /rang gzhan don gnyis rab bsgrub phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can thams cad bdag gis mgron du gnyer/ /byang chub spyod mchod yid 'ong spyad par bgyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces rjes zlos byed par mos la/ ye shes dbab pa ni/ phaṭaḥ chos thams cad rto/nga par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las tshe 'das lus rten de nyid bcom/ ldan 'das rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur/ phaṭaḥ ma yum chen chos sku'i thugs klong nas/ /rang shar mkha' 'gro lab sgron ma/ /'khor gnas gsum ḍākka'i tshogs dang bcas/ /da lta nyid du 'dir gshegs la/ /mchog thun gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍākki ni dī pa badzra sa ma ya a we sha ya phem phem phem/ zhes gsol ba btab pa'i mod la dbyings nas ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma lab kyi sgron ma 'khor dpa' bo ḍākka'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad nam mkha' nas kha char bab pa bzhin du byon nas tshe 'das rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gsal ba la thim pas dbyings phyug ye shes rje mo lab kyi sgron ma'i gsang ba gsum dang dbyer med du gyur/ ces brjod/ tiṣṭha badzras brtan par byas/ de nas bum pa spyi 86

sgrub thabs thor bsdus skor/ pod/ 5 tyā bor bzhag nas/ oṃ rgyal kun sku yi rdo rje bum pa'i dbang / /deng 'dir tshe 'das lus la bskur ba yis/ /snang stong gzhom bral sku yi dbang thob nas/ /ma cig sku yi gsang ba mngon gyur shog /rtsa sngags mthar/ kā ya a bhi ṣpeñtsa oṃ/ bdud rtsi mgrin par bzhag nas/āḥrgyal kun gsung gi rdo rje bdud rtsi'i dbang / /deng 'dir tshe 'das ngag la bskur ba yis/ /grag stong brjod bral gsung gi dbang thob nas/ /ma cig gsung gi gsang ba mngon gyur shog /rtsa sngags mthar/ wākka a bhi ṣpeñtsa ā/ rdo rje snying gar bzhag la/ hūṃ rgyal kun sbigs kyi ngo bo rdo rje'i dbang / /deng 'dir tshe 'das sems la bskur ba yis/ /rig stong blo bral thugs kyi dbang thob nas/ /ma cig thugs kyi gsang ba mngon gyur shog /rtsa sngags mthar/ tsitta a bhiṣpe ñtsa hūṃ/ gtang rag gi maṇḍal phul/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs/ brjod par bsam/ skabs 'dir 'dod yon bsngo ba ni/ gsur rdzas gya nom par bshams nas/ byin rlabs spyi mthun ltar byas la/ kye ho tshe 'das thar pa'i lam bgrod la sogs nas/ srid pa bar ma dor nyam nga ba'i sogs dang /thams cad nam mkha' mdzod bzhin du sogs/ phaṭaḥ tshe 'das kyi steng gi nam mkhar ma cig lab kyi sgron ma sku gar stabs khyug khyug gsung snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis bu yar shog dag pa mkha' spyod kyi zhing du 'gro'o/ /zhes gsung bar mos la/ phaṭaḥ87

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/kye ma tshe 'das rigs kyi bu/ /rigs drug 'khor ba'i btson ra na//sdug bsngal gsum gyi khri mun 'thibs/ /nyon mongs dug lnga'i sgo srung mang / /thar dka'i gnas 'di ya re nga / /srid pa'i sdug bsngal skyi re bung / /'khor ba'i sems can nyam re thag /'di ru sdod pa khyod re blun/ /de bas gnas 'dir ma chags par/ /thar pa byang chub go 'phang la/ /mos 'dun bskyed cig rigs kyi bu/ /bslu med skyabs gnas mchog gsum la/ /dad gus bskyed cig rigs kyi bu/ /yum chen chos sku'i thugs klong du/ /dbyer med ro gcig e ma ho/ /zhes brjod pa'i mod la tshe 'das kyi rnam shes de nyid 'od kyi gong bu sran ma tsam du gyur nas ma cig lab kyi sgron ma'i thugs kar thim pa'i mod la ma cig kyang chos sku yum chen mo'i dgongs klong dang ro gcig tu gyur/ phaṭaḥ lnga phrugs su brjod pas sku lnga'i dbyings su rgyas btab nas mi dmigs pa'i ngang las dar cig mnyam par bzhag de nas byang bu'i gzugs brnyan mer sbyang ba ni/ phaṭaḥ tshe 'das phung po lnga yi bud shing la/ /bcom ldan rgyal ba rigs lnga'i me sbar ro/ /tshe 'das 'byung ba lnga yi bud shing la/ /rgyal yum gshegs ma lnga yi me 'bar ro/ /tshe 'das rnam shes tshogs brgyad bud shing la/ /sems dpa' chen po brgyad kyi me sbar ro/ /tshe 'das skye mched drug gi bud shing la/ /'gro 'dul thub pa drug gi me sbar ro//88

sgrub thabs thor bsdus skor/ pod/ 5lge tshe 'das lus ngag yid gsum bud shing la/ /rgyal kun gsang ba gsum gyi me sbar bas/ /tshe 'das sgrib gnyis yongs dag tshogs gnyis rdzogs/ /sku gnyis mngon gyur don gnyis 'grub par shogaces brjod mthar rtsa sngags dang mi 'khrugs pa'i gzungs sogs bzlas rjes/ bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam dang / byang chub spyod pa'i smon lam dang / tshe 'das kyi shul mi sogs kyang mtho ris yon tan bdun gyis 'byor ba'i ched du bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o/ /'dir smras pa/ rnam mang duḥkhas gzir ba'i 'gro ba rnams/ rnam dag zhi ba'i yon tan dpag med rnams/ /rnam thob dgrar nges ma rig 'khor bcas rnams/ /rnam par 'joms byed lam bzang 'di ko rmad/ /rmad byung chos 'di zab cing rgya che bas/ /byis blos dpag dka' khyad par rang nyid 'dir/ /legs par sbyangs pa'i shes rab ches dman pas/ /nongs par gyur gang dam pa rnams la 'chags/ /gal te legs pa'i tshig don phra mo 'ga'/ /mchis srid de yang 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /ring por mi thogs rnam grol rgyal ba'i sar/ /dkri slad bsngos bzhin gegs med 'grub gyur cig /ces zab mo gcod kyi las tshogs gshin po'i sdug bsngal sbyong byed kyi cho ga gzhan phan thugs rje'i zlos gar zhes bya ba 'di ni rang slob kun bzang 'jigs med kyi ngor/ grub dbang lakṣi kā ra'i yang srid du ming gi cod pan thob pa/ 'jigs med bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan du 'bod pas shar mar spel ba'i yi ge pa ni nye gnas shākya'i btsun pa ma ti bha dras bris pa dge/ maṅga lo// //89

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/༄//'phrogs byed zhal can ma'i phrin las kyi byang bu'i yan lag tu thugs dam bskang ba sbrel ba/bskang rdzas byin rlabs sngon 'gros/ hūṃ/ rgyal ba'i yum gyur badzra wā ra hi/ /bdud dpung 'dul phyir 'bar ba'i skur bstan nas/ /bdag med seṅge'i nga ro bzhad pa mo/ /dkyil 'khor dbang phyug chen mo'i thags dam bskang / /de yi rdo rje skye mched sgyu ma'i 'phral//ri ri༅ rigi byebade stong 'dod dgur sgyur ba'i zhal brnyan can/ /gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa las byung bdud kyi dgra/ /phra men rdo rje mu drug thugs dam bskang / /gnas yul dur khrod sprul pa'i zhing rnams su/ /gang 'dul der snang sgyu ma'i rol pa yis/ /gsang chen snying po'i chos mdzod legs skyong ba/ /mkha' 'gro ging chen rnams kyi thugs dam bskang / /gzhan yang lhan skyes gnyug ma'i phag mo nyid/ /mi 'dra'i rnam 'gyur bsam yas gzugs bzung ste/ /sgrub pa'i re skong dngos grub stsol mdzad pa'i/ /rtsa gsum srung mar bcas rnams thugs dam bskang / /khams gsum phyi nang snang ba'i 'khor lo kun/ /gzod nas 'od gsal dbyings las ma g.yos phyir/ /kun kyang rdo rje khros ma'i dkyil 'khor du/ /mnyam rdzogs dag pa rab 'byams thugs dam bskang / /phyi ltar lha rdzas nyer spyod 90

sgrub thabs thor bsdus skor/ pod/ 5 tradkudku mchod pa dang / /nang ltar zhing chen las byung me tog sogs/ /thun mong lha dang mi yi 'dod yon sprin/ khyad par bde chen rig ma'i longs spyod dang / /rtsa brgyad yan lag stong sbyar sman mchog dang / /gtor ma'i dam tshig rdo rje'i bza' ba dang / /dmar gyi chu gter rba klong g.yo ba sogs/ /rnal 'byor snang ba bde bar shar ba las/ /snang grag ma lus kun bzang 'byor tshogs su/ /gsal 'bar yid bzhin sprin gyis thugs dam bskang / /rang snang ris med chen por thugs dam bskang / /dus gsum rgyun gyi 'khor lor thugs dam bskang / /thugs dam bskangs gyur nyams chag tshangs par mdzod/ /dbang bskur byin rlobs rdo rje'i ye shes stsol/ /byad phur nad gdon dus min 'chi ba kun/ /thogs med rdo rje gri gug 'bar bas chod/ /bdud bzhi'i khrag chen btung ba'i bcud len gyis/ /tshe bsod ye shes gzi byin rgyas par mdzod//mthar thug rdul bral nam mkha'i sku thob nas/ /rol pa'i seng skad srid zhing 'gengs par shog /ces pa'ang smyug 'dzin pa tsand+ra bha dra'i ngor bstan nyis bris/ bkra shis kha dro/ rang nyid skad cig gis bdud 'dul drag mo gzi byin bskal me ltar 'bar zhing / /seng skad kyi nga ros khams gsum zil gyis gnon pa'i skur gyur/ ces dang /oṃ badzra a mṛ ta sogs/ 'di yang 'jigs med pas bris// //91

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/༄༅/ /na ma shrī he ru ka thugs sgrub dpal chen 'dus pa'i las byang la sbyor rgyu'i bskang ba mdor bsdus ni/ skang rdzas nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas brlab la/ hūṃ chos dbyings kun khyab ye shes chen po'i rtsal/ /'gags med sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rol mo ni/ /snang ba'i dngos kun dag chen rdo rje'i zhing / /lhun grub rig pa snang srid gzhi bzhengs che'i/ /dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs 'og min chen po'i gnas/ /g.yo ba'i dngos snang dag pa rab 'byams kyi/ /ye shes nam mkha'i rdo rjer lhun rdzogs pa'i/ /bde chen mchog gi bdud rtsi'i mchod sprin gter/ /phyi ltar nyer spyod 'dod pa'i yon tan rdzas/ /mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog bdug spos dang / /snang gsal dri chab zhal zas rol mo'i sprin/ /nang ltar yul drug dbyings su thim pa'i rtsal/ /rdo rje sgeg bzhad glu dang gar mkhan ma/ /mchod pa'i lha mos 'dod yon char du 'bebs/ /gsang ba sbyor sgrol sman gtor rakta sogs/ /ye shes sgyu ma longs spyod chen po'i rdzas/ /kun bzang rig pa rang snang rol pa'i sprin/ /chos kyi dbyings ltar 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs pas/ /bla ma he ru ka dpal thugs dam bskang / /che mchog rdo rje srin po'i thugs dam bskang / /dpal chen yang dag lha tshogs thugs dam bskang / /'jam dpal dus dgra'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang / /rta mchog 92

sgrub thabs thor bsdus skor/ pod/ 5tradabang gi lha tshogs thugs dam bskang / /thal 'byin phur pa'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang / /rbod gtong ma mo'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang / /rig 'dzin slob dpon lha tshogs thugs dam bskang // 'jig rten mchod bstod lha tshogs thugs dam bskang / /drag sngags dmod pa'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang / /bdun brgya nyer lnga'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang / /mdor na ye shes klong dgu'i rnam rol las/ /gang 'dul sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i zlos gar gyis/ /don gnyis 'dod pa yongs su rdzogs mdzad pa/ /sgrub sde bka' brgyad lha tshogs thugs dam bskang / /hūṃ/ de ltar thugs dam bskang zhing mchod pa'i mthus/ /bdag gzhan sgo gsum nyes tshogs yongs dag nas/ /rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i spyi gzugs mchog /he ru ka dpal tshe 'dir mngon 'grub shog /ces pa 'ang btsun pa zla ba'i ming can gyi ngor sprang po 'jigs med pas so// //༄//rigs 'dus brgyud 'debs/rigs brgya'i dbang phyug kun bzang rdo rje sems/ /drug pa'i rgyal tshab pra he badzra dang / /dngos grub mchog brnyes 'jam dpal bshes gnyen la/ /gsol ba 'debs so rdo rje ye shes khyo95/ /brtul zhugs mthar phyin mkhas pa shrī seng / /zag med 'ja' 93

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ lus rab grub ye shes mdo/ /theg mchog snying po'i shing rta bi ma'i zhabs/ /gsol ba 'debs so rdo rje ye shes stsol/ /dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag padma 'byung / /'jam dpal sprul pa mnga' bdag khri srong dang / /gangs can mun sel be ro mtsho rgyal la/ /gsol ba 'debs so rdo rje ye shes stsol/ /snying thig brda' 'grol kun mkhyen dri med 'od/ /zab gter bka' babs rig 'dzin 'jigs bral gling / /lha sras zlos gar kun bzang gzhan phan zhabs/ /gsol ba 'debs so rdo rje ye shes stsol/ /gdams pa'i mdzod 'dzin rgyal ba'i myu gu dang / /mkhas dang grub pa'i 'khor sgyur mdo sngags gling / /bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so rdo rje ye shes stsol/ /rgyal thabs spyi blugs dbang chus rgyud smin zhing / /spyi khyad lhag pa'i dam tshig rnam par dag /ting 'dzin lnga dang gab pa bzhi yi gnad/ /yongs rdzogs bskyed rim zab mos gzhi bzung ste/ /snyan brgyud yid bzhin nor bu'i rdzogs rim dang / /ma bsgom sangs rgyas pho nya'i lam brten nas/ /phung khams sgrib bral dbyings su dag pa'i rtsal/ /lnga ldan 'ja' lus rdo rjer smin par shog/ //94

sgrub thabs thor bsdus skor/ pod/ 5zhekhu ༄/ /thun drug gi rnal 'byor/dkon mchog gsum la snying nas skyabs su mchi/ /'gro la phan phyir rdzogs pa'i byang chub sgrub/ /sems can bde ldan sdug bsngal kun dang bral/ /bde dang mi 'bral btang snyoms ngang ka/nas shog /mdun mkhar rin chen padma nyi zla'i steng / /rtsa ba'i bla ma dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang / /mtshan dpe'i gzi 'bar rab 'byams dpa' bo dang / /ḍākki'i sprin phung rnam par spro bzhin bzhugs/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin maṇḍal bcas/ /gus pa chen pos 'bul gyis bzhes su gsol/ /sangs rgyas kun dngos dngos grub rtsa ba ru/ /mthong nas rnam pa kun gyis mnyes byed shog /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho bla ma rang la bstim/ /stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid rdo rje 'chang / /thabs shes rang bzhin rdo rje dril bur bcas//rang snang phyag rgyar 'khyud pa'i bde bas dgyes/ /dge tshogs ci mchis ma gyur 'gro la bsngo/ /skye zhing skye bar sdom gsum mig bzhin srung / /yongs rdzogs rgyal ba'i chos tshul legs bzung nas/ /lga/nga 'dul thabs kyis 'gro ba'i don byed shog/ //95

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/༄/ /bla rnam brgyud 'debs kha skong /mkhas shing grub brnyes kun bzang gzhan phan dpal/ /phyag na padmo rgyal ba'i myu gu dang / / 'jam pa'i dbyangs dngos mkhan chen padma'i mtshan/ /gsol ba 'debs so gnas lugs rang zhal ston/ khyad par zab mo 'od gsal snying thig gi/ /shing rta chen po mdo sngags gling pa'i zhabs/ /bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so don gnyis lhun grub mdzod// //༄/ /mkha' 'gro'i brgyud 'debs kha skong /rlabs chen 'gro 'dul spyod pa'i klong yangs nas/ /rig 'dzin 'jigs med rgyal ba'i myu gu la/ /rnam thar rjes dran ngang nas gsol ba 'debs/ /phyogs med 'gro don nus par byin gyis rlobs/ /rab 'byams chos tshul rgya mtsho'i pho brang nas/ /'jam dpal rdo rje mdo sngags gling pa'i zhabs/ /sgo gsum zol med ngang nas gsol ba 'debs/ /zab lam mtha' ru 'khyol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /mi 'bral bde chen 'khor lo'i zur phud nas/ /bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /khyed shes mos gus ngang 96

sgrub thabs thor bsdus skor/ pod/ 5zhermetranas gsol ba 'debs/ /dgongs brgyud bdud rtsis 'tsho bar byin gyis rlobs// //gyi/ /dpal chen brgyud 'debs kha skong //grub rje'i 'phror de sras thu bo chos kyi blo gros dang / /bai ro'i rnam 'phrul gzhan phan mtha' yas 'od/ /padmas lung bstan bla med rdo rje rtsal/ /gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /mchog grub rgyal po'i yang srid bcu gsum pa/ /ngo mtshar bka' babs bdun ldan mdo sngags gling / /brgyud srol kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol//༄/ /rgyud phur brgyud 'debs kha skong /chos kyi bdag po karma dbang drag dang / /dharma kirti rig pa'i rdo rje'i zhabs/ / brgyud srol kun 'dus bla med rdo rje rtsal/ /bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'deb sa so byin rlabs char chen phobs// //97

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/༄/ /seng gdong brgyud 'debs kha sko nga /bka' gter chos tshul rgya mtsho'i pho brang nas/ /snang mdzad rig pa'i rdo rje la gsol ba 'de bas/ /dgongs brgyud ye shes 'pho bar byin gyis rlobs/ /spros bral 'od gsal snying po'i pho brang nas/ /grub dbang padma badzra la gsol ba 'debs/ /gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa zhig par byin gyis rlobs/ /spangs rtogs rtsal chen rdzogs pa'i pho brang nas/ /'od gsal sprul pa'i rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs/ /zung 'jug lam bzang rnyed par byin gyis rlobs/ /mos gus rin chen brtsegs pa'i pho brang nas/ /drin chen chos rje bla ma la gsol ba 'debs/ /don gnyis phyogs med 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi mas so// //༄/ /bdud 'dul drag mo seng zhal ma'i rgyal dbyangs ba dan dkar po'i che rtags zhes bya ba/hūṃ/ chos nyid byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /bde stong mnyam rdzogs rol pa'i don bsgoms pas/ /gzung 'dzin mtshan mar rtog pa'i g.yul ngo las/ /da ni sngags 'chang rnal 98

sgrub thabs thor bsdus skor/ pod/ 5tratranye'abyor g.yas su rgyal/ /hūṃ/ grags stong bzlas pa sngags kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /bden tshig rig sngags dmod pa'i mtshon cha yis/ /dgra gdon ngan sngags byad ma'i g.yul ngo las/ /da ni sngags 'chang rnal 'byor g.yas su rgyal/ /hūṃ/ dag mnyam snang srid gzhi bzhengs dkyil 'khor du/ /'jigs mdzad rdo rje srin mo'i lhar bsgom pas/ /bar chad dgra 'dre byur gsum g.yul ngo las/ /da ni sngags 'chang rnal 'byor g.yas su rgyal/ /rgyal lo bla med bla ma dkon mchog gsum/ /bdud kyi bdud chen nam par rgyal ba'i dbyangs/ /grags pa srid rtse'i bar du 'bar ba yis/ /sngags 'chang bdag cag phyogs las rnam par rgyal/ rgyal lo/ /lha rgyal lo//zhes pa sprang smyon 'jigs med pas shar mar bris//— ༄/ /rtsa gsum dril sgrub dbang bshad/nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mtha' gnyis la mi gnas pa'i zung 'jug kun tu 'chang ba chen po'i go 'phang la dgod par bya/ de'i ched du rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi rtsa ba dbang bskur zab mo nod de lam rim pa gnyis la bslab par bgyi'o snyam du thugs bskyed de gsan par zhu/ gang gsan par bya ba ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsung rdo rje'i sprul 99

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/pa'i sku bde ba chen po padma saṃ bha ba zhes yongs su grags pa de nyid 'khrul grol gyi mtshan ma'i spros pa mtha' dag shin tu zhi ba'i chos kyi dbyings su thog ma med pa'i dus nas mngon par byang chub pa brnyes su zin kyang gzung 'dzin gyi gdon gyis brlams pas 'khrul pa'i gzhan dbang du gyur pa'i sems can rnams la dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje chen po g.yos nas nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i gdul bya rgya mtsho'i snang ba dang mthun par sku dang zhing khams mtshan dang rnam thar bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sprin rgyas par bkod de rdul phra rab re re'i khongs su'ang sems can gzhal du med pa gdod ma'i dbyings su rnam par grol bar mdzad pa'i phrin las skad cig kyang dus las mi yol ba rgya mtsho'i dus rlabs bzhin du 'jug pa las/ re zhig 'dzam bu'i gling chung ngu'i 'jig rten 'dir padma las brdzus te byung ba dang / o ḍi ya na'i rgyal rigs su mngal nas skye ba sogs sgyu 'phrul gyi rol mo gcig tu tshad bzung las 'das pa'i tshul gyis mtshan dpe'i nyin byed shar te paṇa grub rig 'dzin chen po rnams las chos tshul rgya mtsho'i bdud rtsi rdzogs par bzhes shing / gdod nas grub pa'i dur khrod chen po rnams su brtul zhugs kyi spyod pas dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyi rje bor gyar/ de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang btsan ri bca ri ring100

mdzor ////pa/ 1—1/spro//sa/ 121shā se /pa////lhas/ )sde/shā du/ 1rngosasprepa// 14/rngo/ra bcas pa'i dngos grub mtha' dag gi mdzod la dbang bsgyur/rghaṃ ga la dang o rgyan ma ga dha sogs 'phags yul shar nub lho byang dang yul dbus kyi grong khyer chen po kun tu snang srid 'dod dgur bsgyur ba'i rdzu 'phrul dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i phrin las rlabs po ches skal ldan grangs med pa smin grol du mdzad cing bzhugs pa'i skabs na 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi sprul pa'i sku lha btsan po khri srong lde'u btsan gyi sngon smon skya rengs gsar pas thugs bskyed kyi shing rta'i kha lo drangs te bod kha ba can gyi rgyal khams 'dir zhabs zung bkra shis kyi'akhor lo bkod/ bsam yas sogs mtha' dbas kyi sa'i cha thams cad btul zhing rdo rje'i gnas chen du byin ༄gyis brlabs/ sgrub chen bka' brgyad sogs smin krol gyi chos char bsam las 'das pa phab ste las can rje 'bangs nyi shu rtsa lnga la sogs pa slob brgyud mkhas grub kyi phreng ba gnam gyi skar ma dang sa gzhi'i rtsi shing tsam spel/ dbang rab yi dam lha'i rnal 'byor gyis grol ba dang / rab mchog bla ma'i lam zab 'ba' zhig gis grol ba gnyis las gtso bo phyi ma'i don du dgongs te gu ru rin po che nyid kyi sgrub thabs yan lag dang bcas pa mtha' yas pa zhig gdams shing bkas gtad/ phal cher zhig ma 'ongs pa'i dus kyi gdul bya'i don du snyan brgyud rje 'bangs rig 'dzin 101

21jid/ ji jordo /spyib 'o/:drob//ga byaspurngasno ngas/lngazug rta)stu) ba/ṭa/sprang 'o/dra/zug/ )〈maso so'i 'od gsal dgongs pa'i klong mdzod du rgyas btab cing dpe rgyun gangs brag mtsho gsum sogs te gnas so sor mi 'jig pa'i sgrom bur bstsal nas sbas shing dam can srung ma'i tshogs la gnyer du gtad/ de rnams rang rang so so'i dus rtags dang mthan par gter ston grub thob glo bar ba re byon nas rten 'brel rib pho rig shāgand kyi lde mig gis legs par phyes te ris chad dang ris bral gyi 'gro ba du ma'i longs spyod kyi skal bar bkye ba'i bka' drin mdzad pa las 'dir skabs su babs pa ni thang yig las/ glo bo dge skar sbas pa'i gter kha 'di: mi bzhag 'don pa 'i rtags der bstan nas 'byung : gter ston sangs rgyas bla ma zhes bya 'byung : zhes lung bstan pa ltar bod yul 'dir 'gro 'dul gter ston byon pa rnams kyi thog ma rgyal sras lha rje'i yang srid gter ston sangs rgyas bla mas mnga' ri'i glo bo dge skar gyi gtsug lag khang dang nye ba'i brag rta mgrin mgul nas spyan drangs pa'i zab chos rtsa gsum dril sgrub dngos grub brtan gzigs kyi skor rnams bar skabs su gter dpe dbyings kyi mkha' 'gros phyir bsdus te yang gter du bsdams pa/ slad nas rab byung bcu bzhi par rgyal sras lha rje gter ston rkyang pa'i skye ba bcu gsum pa/dus gsum gter ston rgya tshumatsho'i spyi rje sa'i steng na 'gran zla thams 102

sgrub thabs thor bsdus skor/ pod/ 5trastamacad dang bral ba'i rang byung sprul pa'i skyes mchog padma 'od gsal mdo sngags gling pa zhes mtshan gyi rnga sgra phyogs mthar gsal ba des ngo mchar bka' babs kyi 'khor lo rnam pa bdun gyis rdo rje theg pa'i gsang mdzod rab 'byams la dbang bskur bar mdzad pa'i bka' babs gsum pa yang gter gyi mdzod nas byon pa/ rmad byung byin rlabs kyi gzi brjid mtshungs pa med pa'i chos bka' zab mo la brten nas smin byed kyi dab nga bskur ba sgrub par byed pa la slob dpon gyi bya ba dang sogs sbrel lo// //༄/ /na mo mañdzu shrī ye/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal sgrub par 'dod pas/ gnas dben par stegs bu'i khar 'phags pa'i sku gzugs kyi spyan sngar phyi nang gi mchod pas bskor/ sgrub pa po stan bde ba la gnas te/ dang po skyabs sems ni/ trī/ ka dag rig pa ye grol 'dus ma byas 'jam dpal rdzogs pa chen por skyabs su mchi/ /lhun grub ye shes dbyings su grol ba'i phyir/ /zab mo'i rnal 'byor sgrub par sems bskyed do/ /gnas yo byin rlabs ni/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ phyi dang nang gi gzung 'dzin rtog tshogs khams/ / /kun kyang snang stong mchod pa'i phyag rgya che/ /ye nas rnam grol kun tu bzang po'i sprin/ /nam mkha' mdzod kyi 'khor lor byin gyis rlobs/ /ma hā rasarba pu tsa āḥhūṃ/ dngos gzhi lha bskyed ni/ a/ khyab gdal rig pa stong pa'i 103

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/shengang nyid las/ /kun snang lhun grub snying rje chen po'i rtsal/ /rig dang stong pa mi phyed rdo rje'i sku/ /'jam dpal rnon po ye shes sgyu ma'i gar/ /'pho 'gyur med pa thig le chen po'i zhal/ /chags dang sgeg pa'i nyams 'gyur cir yang snang / /thabs dang shes rab mtshon pa'i phyag gnyis na/ /dbang sngon ral gri utpal glegs bam 'dzin/ /srid zhir mi gnas zhabs gnyis phyed skyil bzhugs//sna tshogs dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis spras/ /'khor du sangs rgyas byang sems paṇa grub tshogs/ til gyi gong bu bzhin du bskor zhing bzhugs/ /de ltar gsal ba'i gnas gsum 'bru gsum las//'od 'phros ye shes dkyil 'khor spyan drangs gyur/ / spos rol bcas/hūṃ/ yul gyi ming ni rgya nag yul/ /ri bo rtse lnga gnas kyi mchog /gnas yul dur khrod brgyad sogs nas/ /'jam dpal rdo rje rnon po'i lha/ /mtha' yas rgyal ba sras dang bcas/ /gnas 'dir thugs rjes gshegs su gsol/ /gshegs nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /mañdzu shrī sa pā ri wa ra badzra sa mā dza/ dza hūṃ baṃ ho/ sa ma ya tiṣṭha ldan/ na mo pu ru sha ya ho/ mchodapa ni/ ho/ tshogs drug snang ba rgyan du rol pa'i dpyid/ /dbang po drug la dgyes dgur 'char ba'i sprin/ /phyi nang gsang ba bla med mchod tshogs kyis/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor mnyes gyur cig /mañdzu shrī badzra 104

raḥmi ////spro/ 151/pa/lhas/ 1jo|shā se /spro/////sa/ )rdo shā pa/ 1rngos/rngan/ snyeX/sa pā ri wa ra arghaṃ sogs/ shabharū pa sogs/ sparsha pra titstsha swāhā/bstod pa ni/ hrī/ ye grol rig pa khyad chos drug ldan dbyings/lhun grub rang gsal bde stong bum pa'i sku/ /blo las 'das pa mtha' grol lta ba'i bab/ /'jam dpal rdzogs pa chen po'i ngang la bstod/ /'dzab dmigs ni/ thugs kar pad nyi zla ba'i steng / /gzhom du med pa khams lnga'i bcud/ /mi shigs thig le'i ngo bo nyid/ /dhīḥ yig gser sbyangs zhun ma'i mdog /de mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor/ /'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang / /byang sems paṇa grub rgya mtsho yi/ /mkhyen brtse nus pa'i dngos grub dbyig /slar 'dus rang la thim par gyur/ /oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥ zhes brgya stong khri 'bum du bzla/ thun mthar mchod bstod phul la/ brjod med don bshags mthar/ tshogs las ni dang po byin rlabs/ hūṃ bdag nyid thugs las 'bru gsum yi ge'i tshogs/ tshogs rdzas rnams la char ltar bab pa yis/ /sbyang spel bsgyur ba'i ye shes bdud rtsi'i sprin/ /rdo rje'i longs spyod nam mkha' gang bar gyur/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ lan gsum/tshogs zhing sbyan 'dren ni/ hūṃ 'og min gnas dang mkha' spyod sprul pa'i grong / /dbugs chen 'byin pa rnam grol zhing lnga sogs/ /sku sasum ston pa'i zhing khams rab 'byams nas/ /'jam dbyangs 'khor bcas tshogs la gshegs su gsol/ /badzra sa mā dza/ tshogs 105

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/phud rnams phul la/ hūṃ dngos 'byor yid sprul dam rdzas sprin gyis mchod/ /thog med nas bsags sdig ltung nyams chags bshags/ /bdud bzhi dbyings bsgral tshogs kyi 'khor los mchod/ /mchog dang than mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /ma hā ga ṇa tsakra sarba pu ༄dza khā tī/ zhes phul/ tshogs la rol/ lhag ma bsngo ba ni/ tshogs lhag kha phrus gdab/oṃ āḥhūṃ gis brlabs/ 'jam dpal rdo rje'i bka' 'khor la gnas pa'i/ /gi lang dbang phyug brtan ma rgya mtsho yis/ /'dod yon longs spyod lhag gtor 'di bzhes la/ /rnam 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod/ /ustsaṭa bha lidha khā tī/ zhes phyi rol du dor/gtang rag mchod bstod mthar yig brgyas nongs pa bshags/ ā/ gdod ma'i gzhi dbyings nang gsal klong chen por/ /gzugs sku'i sgyu 'phrul mkha' la 'ja' tshon bzhin/ /gzhi med rtsa bral ngang du mnyam par bzhag /rjes thob lu gu rgyud kyi don la blta/ /dge bsdo shis brjod sogs spyi ltar bya'o/ /zhes pa'ang 'jam dbyangs 'od zer gyi ngor nyi sgrol zhes pa shing sprel lor sprang po 'jigs med pas so/ /dge zhing bkra shis// //༄༅/ /na mo mañdzu shrī ye/ gang zhig gis 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' sgom zhing sgrub par 'dod pas/ dang po skyabs sems ni/ mkha' khyab 'gro rnams srid las bsgral slad du/ /bcom ldan 'jam dpal mgon la skyabs mchi zhing / /rje btsun 106

sgrub thabs thor bsdus skor/ pod/ 5sgemri ba'i nyi ma'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /bla med byang chub sgrub par sems bskyed do/ /lan gsum/ dngos gzhi'i rnal 'byor ni/ chos rnams ba sam gyis mi khyab dbu ma che/ /rten 'byung sgyu ma lta bur snang ba'i gar/ /mdun gyi nam mkhar rin chen sengabyuge'i khrir/ /rgyal kun yab gcig rje btsun smra ba'i lha/ /dmar ser mtshams sprin snang ba 'bum 'phro zhing / /phyag g.yas ye shes ral gri mkha' la phyar/ /g.yon pas sher phyin glegs bam thugs kar 'dzin/ /dri med dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes/ /zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung pad zlar bzhugs/ /thugs kar zla steng thugs srog yi ge dhīḥmatha' bskor 'bru drug sngags kyis bskor ba las/ /'od zer bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin mngon byung ste/ /bdag gi snying gar zhugs shing thim pa'i mod/ /spobs pa'i gter chen rnam brgyad grol bar 'gyur/ /zhes bsam la/ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥ zhes ci mang bzlas/ a zhes ma skyes tshul la 'jug pa'i sgo/ /ra ti rdul med tshul la 'jug pa'i sgo/ /parba don dam zab mor 'jug pa'i sgo/ /tsa la skye 'chi med par 'jug pa'i sgo/ /na ma ming dang bral bar 'jug pa'i sgo//dhīḥzhes blo gros mchog la 'jug pa'i sgo/ rtogs dka' zab mo sgo drug legs rtogs nas/ /gzungs spobs snang ba rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab/ thun mthar mdun gyi lha rang la bsdu/ dke ba'i 107

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rtsa ba sems can gyi don du bsngo/ zhes pa'ang mdo sngags dang / tshul bzang gnyis kyi ngor 'jigs med med pas so// //༄༅/ /na mo marsā shrī ye/ gang gis 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi ting 'dzin bsgom par 'dod pas khrus gsum sngon du song ste/skyabs sems bya ba ni/ mtha' yas rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes sku/ /bla ma 'jam dpal mgon la skyabs mchi zhing / /mkha' khyab 'gro la phan pa'i don slad du/ lag na ral gri'i rnal 'byor bsgom par bgyi/ /lan gsum/ dngos gzhi'i rnal 'byor ni/ mtha' bzhi'i mtshan ma zhi ba'i de bzhin nyid/ /kun snang ye shes sgyu mar 'phrul ba'i gar/ /mdun gyi nam mkhar rin chen nor bu'i khrir/ /bla ma rje btsun mkhyen pa'i gter chen zhabs/ /mtshams sprin mdangs 'dzin zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /glegs bam ral gri 'dzin cing skyil krung bzhugs/ /byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam las 'ongs pa'i/ /mi zad yid bzhin drwa ba'i phreng ba can/ /mi shigs mtshan dpe'i dkyil 'khor 'bar bar bsgom/ /de yi thugs kar padma zla ba'i steng / /skye ba med dang rdul med don dam dang / /'chi 'pho med dang ming dang bral ba dang / /blo gros zab mo'i sgor gyur yi ge drug /nyi ma 'char ka'i 'od ltar lam me ba/ /snang stong ye shes mchog gi rol mor gsal/ /a ra pa tsa na dhīḥ zhes bzla/ thun mjug 108

sgrub thabs thor bsdus skor/ pod/ 5traporatu/ bla ma 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i thugs ka'i 'od/ /bdag gi snying dbus thig ler zhugs pa'i mod/ /ji lta ji snyed shes bya 'jal ba'i blo/ /mi zad dbyar gyi mtsho ltar rgyas par gyur/ /de mthar bla ma 'od zhu bdag la thim/ /bdag yid sgrib pa'i tshogs kun rab bcom ste/ /mkhyen gnyis ye shes mi zad 'jo ba'i dpyid/ /'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'i dgongs klong bzhag /ces mnyam par bzhag dge ba 'di yis mtha' yas yid can kun/ /stobs dang mi 'jigs yon tan rgya mtsho'i gter/ /'jam dpal dpa' bo'i ye shes mngon byas te/ /rang gzhan don gnyis 'byor pa lhun grub shog /ces bsngo ba bya'o/ /zhes pa'ang bla ma dam pa mkha' spyod kyis gnas kyis bska la ba'i yul nas kyang bskul ba ltar gzhon nu 'jigs med pas bris// //༄/ /thugs rje chen po'i tshe sgrub ni/rang 'phags par gsal ba'i spyi bo'i rigs bdag 'od dpag med de tshe dpag med longs sku'i rnam pa can du bsgyur la/rang gi snying kha'i yig drug gi sngags 'khor las 'od zer 'phros/spyi bo'i tshe dpag med kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ de'i thugs ka'i zla ba la gnas pa'i hrīḥyig dmar po las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu li khri'i kha dog can dpag tu med pa spros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas 109
