pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/kyi zhing thams cad khyab/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i thugs rje byin rlabs dang / 'chi med tshe/ nad med bde ba/ rgas med lang tsho/ mi brdzi ba'i stobs/ mi 'gyur ba'i ye shes la sogs pa'i dngos grub thams cad bsdus/ yang 'phros lha klu gnod sbyin dang /'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po/ tshe bskal pa thub pa'i drang srong la sogs pa rnams kyi tshe dang bsod nams/ stobs dang gzi brjid/sman dang nor bu/ nyi zla dang grub pa'i bcud len la sogs pa'i dwangs bcud nus pa thams cad bsdus/ yang 'phros 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje'i gtsos gza' klu rgyal po sogs sde brgyad ma rungs pa rnams kyis rang gi bla tshe brkus pa dang phrogs pa/gzhan yang sngangs skrag dang zhe sdang drag po dang mya ngan la sogs pa'i rkyen kyis bla yar ba 'thor ba thams cad rdo khab len gyis lcags drang ba ltar rang dbang med par 'ubs kyis bsdus/ de thams cad tshe dpag med kyi phyag gi bum pa'i nang du 'chi med kyi bdud rtsi dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa 'od zer snum bkrag shigs se ba'i rnam par 'khyil/ de nas mgon po tshe dpag med kyis rang nyid la rdo rje'i tshe dbang stsol bar thags dgongs ༄gtad ma thag tu tshe bcud de dag phyag gi bum pa'i kha nas phyur/rim bzhin mar babs/ rang 'phags pa'i thor tshugs nas brgyud/1 10

sgrub thabs thor bsdus skor/ pod/ 5lgeshetralus kyi nang du zhugs/ rang gi tshe srog gi ngo bo snying ga'i hrīḥyig la sib kyis thim pas hrīḥyig dang / der ma zad rang gi sku thams cad nyi ma brgya ltar gzi brjid lhag par 'bar/ nam du yang rga shi'i sdug bsngal gyis mi brdzi ba'i tshe srog rdo rje lta bu/ 'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i sku tshe dang dbyer mi phyed pa thob byung snyam du the tshom med pa'i nges shes bskyed la ma ṇi rtse gcig tu 'don/ sprul nga/'i rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i man ngag gi bdud rtsi red/ 'on kyang rang lhar mi bsgom par mdun mkhar 'phags pa bsgoms nas gsol 'debs kyi tshul du ma ṇi 'don pa la dga' na/mdun gyi 'phags pa'i rigs bdag tu tshe dpag med sngar bzhin bsgo ma/ de nas 'phags pa la mos gus shugs drag pos ma la bu 'bod kyi tshul du yig drug bzla zhing / byang chub kyi sems rin po che dang / spyod pa phar phyin drug gi yon tan mtha' dag rang rgyud la skye ba dang / de nyid gong 'phel du 'gro ba dang / de'i ched du bla ma spyan ras gzigs dang mi 'bral ba'i gsol ba rtse gcig tu sadab pa ni rgyun du bya dgos pa'i gal po che'o/ /de las tshe sgrub tu kha bsgyur tshul ni/ thun mgo la de ltar byas te mtshams shig nas bdag la tshe'i/ dngos grub stsal du gsol snyam du mang tsam bsam pa'i rkyen gyis 'phags pa'i thugs rje shugs g.yos te 111

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ dbu gtsug tshe dpag med kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ gong du bshad pa ltar tshe bcud bsdus/ phyag gyi bum par zhugs/ slar phyur/ shar phyogs nas zla ba shar ba 'od nub phyogs kyi ri rtser 'bab pa bzhin du rang gi spyi bor babs/ lus kyi nang gang bas tshe nyams pa gsos/ gnas pa spel/ 'phel ba brtan cing nus ldan du gyur bar bsgom na'ang i mi chog snyam/ dge zhing bkra shis/sdug bsngal rang grol 'dra bton na ni sgrol dkar tshe sgrub kyang yod pa red de/ ma ṇi'i bzlas grangs la mi gnod ched 'di ltar byas na dga'am snyam/ tshe sgrub kyi rgyal po byang chub kyi sems yin zhing / 'phags pa thugs rje chen po byang chub kyi sems rin po che'i lha yin pas 'chi med tshe yi lha gcig la 'di nyid rang byin rlabs che'o/ /༄7/ /bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dge 'dun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dkon mchog kun 'dus kyi ngo bo/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po/bod kha ba can pa'i lha gcig 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug snying rje'i gter/ mgon med kyi 'gro ba la lhag par brtse ba/ mtshan thos pa tsam gyis mdun du 'byon pa/ gsol ba 112

sgrub thabs thor bsdus skor/ pod/ 5dku'abyor bar byin gyis rlobs/ /rang don sgrib bral zhi ba'i khang bzang du/ /zag med chos kyi 'byor bas mngon dga' zhing / /gzhan don mkha' khyab thugs rje'i phrin las kyis/ /'khor ba dong nas sprugs par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes gsol ba btab/ 'phags mchog dgyes shing 'dzum pa'i mdangs phyungs te/ /ston ka'i zla gzhon shar nas 'ongs pa bzhin/ /tshur byon snying dbus dad dad pa ni padmo'i gdan yin te/ 'phags pa rnams gdul bya'i rgyud la rten cing bzhugs pa'i gnas ni de yin pa'i phyir ro zhes bshad pa'i padmo ru/ /byang chub bar du 'bral med bzhugs par gyur/ /bzang po spyod pa'am/ 'jam dpal dpa' bos sogs bsngo smon bya'o/ /zhes pa'ang sdom brtson gzhung lugs smra ba kun dga' blo gros kyis 'di 'dra bris zhes nan gyis bskul nas/ sprang rgan bstan nyis gang dran mgyogs par bris pa dge legs 'phel// //119

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ ༄/ /thugs sgrub dpal chen 'dus pa'i sgrub khog cung zad yang gsal du byas pa rin po che'i za ma tog rnam par 'byed pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so//na mo gu ru shrī badzra dha rā ya/ /srid zhi'i spyi dpal che ba'i mchog he ru ka dpal bla ma la/ /btud nas sgrub chen bka' brgyad kyi/ /sgrub pa'i khog dbub nyung gsal 'god/ /rig 'dzin thugs sgrub dpal chen 'dus pa'i sgrub pa'i khog dbub za ma tog cung zad yang gsal byas nas brjod pa la/ spyi'i don dang / bya ba'i las rim bshad pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ phyag rgya bzhi'i chings su bcing ste gsungs pa bsdu na/ dam tshig dang sdom pa'i kun spyod dang dkyil 'khor gyi las rim rnams thabs shes kyi tshul du 'brel bar bsgrub pas pha rol phyin drug gis bsdus pa'i tshogs gnyis rlabs po che myur du 'dums nas slob pa'i rig 'dzin gsum dang mi slob lam lhun grub rig 'dzin sku gsum yan lag bdun ldan gyi go 'phang la sbyor ba'o/ /gnyis pa la phun sum tshogs pa lngas gzhi bzung ba/ las kyi rim pas dkyil 'khor bca' ba/ de nyid bsnyen cing sgrub pa'i rim pa ste gsum las/ dang po ni/ ji skad du/ ston pa gnas dang 'khor dang dusaḥ yo byad la sogs gzhir ldan nas: zhes gsungs pa ltar tshul bzhin tshogs par bya'o/ /gnyis pa la/ sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi gnyis las/ dang po la/ sa chog dang mtshams gcod gnyis/ dang po la'ang lnga'i/ dang po sa brtag pa ni/ spyir sgrub gnas kyi skyon yon gzhan du rgyas par bshad pa dang / rang gzhung las kyang / grub thob zhabs kyis bcag pa dang: sogs kyi mtshan nyid shes pa dang / bye brag tu lto 'phye brtags te brkos pa'i ro lnga bsal ba'i 120

thugs sgrub dpal chen 'dus pa'i sgrub khog/ pod/ 5dkushul khengs pa bzang / ma khengs na ngan pas sbyin sreg sogs sel thabs bya'o/ /gnyis pa bslang ba ni/ gzhi de gzugs can gyis bdag ni rin dang tshig gis bslang /mi snang ba la bslang ba ni/ grub na gnyug mar gnas pa la cha gsum dang bsdu na gser skyems dang gtor ma dkar zlum mtheb kyu ril bus mtshan pa bsham/ bye brag tu sa lhar maṇḍal zlum po ba byung dang dris byug pa la me tog gi tshom bu bkod pa'i mdun du nyer spyod dang gtor ma dkar blum mtheb ril can bsham/ bdag bskyed spro na dpal 'dus las gzhung rgyas bsdus ci rigs nyer bsdu lhar ldang gi bar du byas la/ gtso bo'i nga rgyal tsam la gnas pas sa chog la 'jug /de ltar byed na dkyil 'khor gyi stegs bu'i gong du bdag bskyed gtor ma phyi nang gi mchod pa dang bcas pa'ang sngon du bsham dgos/ 'di ka'i sgrub khog sogs las bdag nyid yi dam gyi skur gsal bas zhes pa tsam las mi snang bas nyin zhag de'i khongs su bdag gi rnal 'byor rgyas pa song zin na 'dir thun mtshams lha'i nga rgyal gsal 'debs tsam gyis chog pa 'dra/ gang ltar yang de nas cha gsum gtong na phyi rol du phyin/ ma grub na ci bde bar gnyug mar gnas pa/'i gzhi bdag gtor ma dang gser skyems 'bru gsum gyis brlab/ a ka ros bsngos te/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /sogs kyis phrin las bcol/ de nas gtso bo sa'i lha mo la slong ba'i phyir/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i steng du paṃ las sa'i lha mo gser btso ma'i mdog can bum pa bsnam pa bskyed nas/ oṃ pri bī di dhe wi sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ zhes brjod pas sa'i lha mo la klu gnyan sa bdag gis bskor ba spyan drangs/dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs bstim/ oṃ āḥhūṃ gis mchod pa brlab/ rang sngags la/arghaṃ puṣpesogs btags pas nyer spyod dang / a ka ros gtor ma bsngo/121

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ sogs/ ces brjod pas sogs nas/ badzra sum̐ gyis rang gnas su btang ngo/ /gsum pas dbang du bya ba ni/dbang mchog gi phur bu mdun du bkod la/ bdag nyid yi dam du gsal ba'i thags ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ phar ba la thim/ de dming rari rig minyid dpal rta mgrin gyi skur gyur bar bsams te phur bu blang la/ dkyil 'khor gang du bya ba'i sa la gdab cing / hūṃ padmānta kri ta hūṃ phaṭa/ ces lan bdun bzlas pas/ phur bu las 'phros pa'i 'od zer dmar pos sa gzhi khyab cing bdag gi dbang du gyur par bsam mo/ /bzhi pa sbyong ba ni/slob dpon gyi lag g.yas sor mo lnga phral ba rdo rje rtse lnga par bsams nas rdo rje dang bcas pas dkyil 'khor gyi sa'i steng khor yug tu bskor zhing sa la bzhag /gzhan rnams kyis kyang lag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas sa la reg tshul byas te/ oṃ ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ ces brjod cing lan gsum bsnun pas/ rdo rje las byung ba'i 'od zer gyis snod bcud du 'dzin pa sbyangs/ oṃ bhu khaṃ zhes brjod pas sa phyogs thams cad nam mkha'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsgom/ 'dir/ oṃ me di ni badzra bandha bandha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces brjod pas rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi sa gzhir gyur par bsam pas sa bzung ba'ang snying po'i don gsal las bshad/ lnga pa srung ba ni/ slob dpon stegs bu'i dbus nas zhal mdun du phyogs pas/ rang nyid yi dam du gsal ba'i mig gnyis nyi zla mig 'bras hūṃ las me dpung 'bar bas bgegs 122

thugs sgrub dpal chen 'dus pa'i sgrub khog/ pod/ 5dang log par 'dren pa'i tshogs la gzir bas rnam smin gyi lus bsregs shing sems chos nyid kyi ngang du ra ros par bsam la/ rkang pa rdo rje'i 'gros kyis bskor zhing / oṃ srurya tsand+ra dzwa la dzwa la hūṃ phaṭa/ ces brjod/ spro na rgyud phur ltar khro bcu'i stangs stabs kyang bya bar gsung / phur gdab grol thig dbang rnams las kha bskang ba ni/ hūṃ bdag nyid dpal gyi thugs ka nas/ /khro rgyal ḍākki rā dza 'phros/ /dmar skya zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /g.yas g.yon tho ba lcags kyu thogs/ /'phros pas phyogs bcur rab spros pas/ /phyogs skyong bcu po bkug nas ni/ /phyogs bcu kun tu gdan du bting / /pho mo gan rkyal kha sbub bsnol/ /hūṃ bzhi'i sngags dang / oṃ ind+ra ye/ agha ye/ ya ma ye/ ni ri ti ye/ wā ru ṇa ye/ wa ya wi/ ku be ra/ a shwa na ya/ surya tsand+ra/pra ti bhya/ ti ra baṃ/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho/ zhes brjod nas khro phur skyed pa ni/ hūṃ bdag nyid dpal gyi thugs ka nas/ /phyogs skyong bcu yi gdan steng du/ /'bar ba'i hūṃ bcu 'phros pa las/ /'phro 'dus khro bo bcu ru gyur/ /hūṃ kar rnam rgyal dbyug sngon rgyal/ /gshin rje mi g.yo rta mgrin rgyal/ /'dod rgyal bdud rtsi khams gsum rgyal/ /stobs po che rnams rim bzhin bsgom/ /kun kyang zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ /sku stod khro tshul mtshon cha 'dzin/ /sku smad lcags phur zur gsum pa/ /phyogs skyong bcu yi spyi bor btab/ /me dpung 123

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/'bar ba'i klong dkyil na/ /sprul pa yang sprul bsam las 'das/ /bar chad bgegs dpung ma lus pa/ /rdul phran bzhin du brlag par bya/ /zhes pa'i mthar steng phur shar gyi shar dang / 'og phur nub kyi nub tu gdab pa dang / de bzhin du phyogs bzhi g.yas bskor dang mtshams bzhi g.yon bskor du/ oṃ badzra gro dha hūṃ ka ra hūṃ sogs rang sngags dang bstun nas gdab cing /khro bcu'i phur pas phyogs bcu'i gdon bgegs rnams kyi spyi bo nas rkang mthil gyi bar thal byung du phug pa 'og gzhi dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi la sbrags pas g.yo 'gul med par gyur/ slar yang phur bu las byang ba'i 'od zer rdo rje'i ra gur du gyar pa rigaci /༷/sgo nga rig miphyogs bcu kun tu 'a gas/ o badzra rakṣa rakṣa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes brjod cing rdo rje'i gyad 'gros kyis bskor bas kyang 'grub po/ /skabs 'dir rgyab rim gyi dpung du/ satstsha gdab pa/ srog brlu / nye'u 'don/ bshags skong /zhi ba'i sbyin sreg /mgron bzhi la mchod sbyin ci 'byor/ gzungs mdo sgrogs pa/khyad par gnas kyi shar du sher phyin/ lhor stobs po che/ nub tu lang gshegs/ byang du tog gzungs rnams 'don pa sogs rang ngam gzhan gyis kyang dge ba'i dpung skyed ci 'grub bya'o/ /gnyis pa mtshams gcod la'ang lnga las/ dang po phyi mtshams gcad pa ni/ sgrub khang gi phyi rol gom pa bdun cu rtsa bzhi'i sar tho bzhi la rgyal chen so so'i sku rten nam sngags byang rgyal mtshan dang bcas pa btsugs pa'i mdun du/ stegs kheb ldan gyi khar me tog gi tshom bu'i steng du gtor ma gong ltar dang / de'i mdun du g.yon nas brtsams pa'i chu gnyis nyer spyod dang bcas pa bsham la/ shar gyi mchod gtor ram̐ yi khaṃ dang / oṃ āḥhūṃ gsum gyis brlab la/ rang gi thugs ka nas 124

thugs sgrub dpal chen 'dus pa'i sgrub khog/ pod/ 5'od zer 'phros/ ri rab kyi shar phyogs nas rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung 'khor bcas/ badzra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hos bstim/ oṃ dhri ta raṣṭa hūṃ hūṃ dzaḥ zhes bzla/ rang sngags de la arghaṃ sogs btags pas nyer spyod dang / a ka ros gtor ma phul la/ hūṃ ri rab gling bzhi'i shar phyogs nas/ /dpal ldan rgyal po yul 'khor srung //phyogs bsrung re ba skong ba'i phyir/ /'dir byon mchod sbyin gtor ma bzhes/ /dri za'i gdon rnams mtshams gcod cig /ces phrin las bcol/ tiṣṭha badzras me tog 'thor la brtan par bya/ de bzhin du gzhan gsum so sor yang rigs 'gre bas/ lhor mchod gtor byin brlab kyi 'phror/ ri rab kyi lho phyogs nas sogs/ zhes so sor bsgyur/ gnyis par bar mtshams kyi nang tshan dam sri mnan pa ni/ dug shog la rū pa bya mgo can gyi snying gar tri yig mthar/ ya ma dam sri gi pa ri mā ra ya dza: zhes bris la dug khrag brub khung du bkod nas/gser skyems gtong / e yi ram̐ dzwa la ram̐/ brub khung yangs shing gting zab pa'i tri las dam sri pho mo rid cing nyam thag pa'i lus can du gyur/ zhes dmigs bya bskyed la/ na mo rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang / chos kyi bka' bden pa dang / dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang / khyad par du bcom ldan 'das bde gshegs sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' 125

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bden pa dang / chos nyid rnam par dag pa'i bden pa dang / chos can rten 'brel bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang / bden pa chen po'i byin gyi rlabs kyis ma rungs pa'i sems can ya ma dam sri thams cad mtshan ma rdzas kyi rten 'di la mchis par gyur cigatri yi dzaḥ tri badzra asku sha dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho/ zhes dgug gzhug byas nas de'i snying gar phur pa gdab cing / arya a tsha la dam sri bandha bandha mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa ces bzla/ thun rdzas kyis brab la thod pa mtshan ngan du bcug ste sgrub khang gi them pa'i phyi rol dong nang du bskyur/ rdo g.yam rdo rje rgya gram bris pas kha bcad /gong gi a tsa la'i sngags brjod bzhin pas 'byung ba lnga'i rgyas btab nas mi mngon par byed/ de'i steng du dpon slob rnams hūṃ bzhi pa'i sngags zlo bzhin lag pa lu gu rgyud du sbrel nas/ hūṃ dam sri bya ba'i sdig can khyod: sogs las gzhung ltar bro brdung ngo / /gsum pa sgo byang gdags pa ni/ ro ras sam ra sogs la gshin rje'i sku sngags byang dang bcas pa bris te sgo'i ya them phyi mar btags/ de'i mdun du dmar gtor mtheb ril can dang nyer spyod bcas bsham pa 'bru gsum gyis brlab/badzra sa ma dzaḥs ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hosabasnyim/ arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ kro dha ya ma rā dza i rda ba lidha kha kha khā hi khā his gtor ma bsngo/ hūṃ lha srin sde brgyad 'byung po kun/ /khyod kyi g.yog dang 'khor lags na/ /rnam par smin pa'i chos shod la/ /bdag gis 'bras bu ma thob par/ /sgo 'di tshun chad ma btang cig ces me tog 'thor/ bzhi pa gsang mtshams la ma ṭaṃ bsgral ba ni/ ma ṭaṃ gyi gzugs mgo bo lho nub/126

thugs sgrub dpal chen 'dus pa'i sgrub khog/ pod/ 5dku rkang pa byang shar du bstan pa gan rkyal du bzhag la/ stegs bu'i shar ngos su slob dpon zhal nub tu phyogs te yi dam gyi nga rgyal la gnas pas lcags kyu'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ hūṃ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed cing / sogs nas/bdud dang log 'dren thams cad a karsha ya dzaḥ tri yo dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho zhes dgug cing bsnyim/ snying rje sa khyod bsgral dam tshig ni/ /sogs nas/ rnam par shes pa mya ngan 'da'/ /zhes brjod/ slob dpon gyi zhabs g.yas pas dor stabs kyis ma ṭaṃ gyi gzugs mnan tshul byas la/ hūṃ chos la lta dang gang zag lta/ /sogs/ rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su phaṭa//ces rtse gsum gyi phyag rgya snying gar bsnun pas gzugs phung hril gyis zhig pa'i khog pa bros sbyong ba ni/ hūṃ stong gsum stong gi lo ka na/ /sogs nas/ puṭaṃ swā hā/ wa shaṃ swā hā/ mā ra ya phaṭa bar brjod la ma ṭaṃ gyi gzugs so sor gtub nas stegs bu'i lho nub tu mgo/ shar du snying / lho ru lag g.yas/ nub tu mtshan ma/ byang du rkang g.yon/ shar lhor nang khrol/ nub byang du lag g.yon/ byang shar du rkang g.yas te phyogs mtshams so sor bkod/ 'di ni 'og tu 'byung ba'i byin 'beb kyi tshig ris dang bstun par zad kyi/ 'god tshul gzhan yang yod do/ /de nas/ bdag gi thugs ka nas rghaṃ 'phros khog pa la thim pas khog pa dur khrod rol pa'i gzhal yas khang gi mtha' bskor dur khrod brgyad kyis bskor bar gyur bar bsam zhing khu tshur dpung mgor bsnol dbye dang bcas/hūṃ pra be sha ya phaṭa/ /ces lan bdun gyis sprul ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgo phye/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ ha na ha na phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa ces rdo rje'i gar 'gros kyis lan gsum bskor 127

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/nas dkyil 'khor gyi nang du tshud par bsgom mo/ /lnga pa 'bar ba lta stangs sogs lngas nang mtshams gcod pa ni/ hūṃ bdag nyid zhe sdang rdo rje yiḥ sogs nas/e hūṃ phaṭaḥbar las gzhung ltar bya/ gnyis pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs pa dngos kyi las rim sogs la za ma tog las thig gi 'debs tshul bshad pa'i gong du sta gon gsum smos pa grol tig dbang rnam las bshad pa'i go rim dang mthun yang / 'dir snying po'i don gsal dang bstun pa'i dbang du byas na bzhi ste/ thig las/ sta gon/ re khā 'byed pa/ sgrub rdzas dang rgyan dgod pa'o/ /dang po ni/ thig gang du 'debs pa'i gzhi der bdud rtsi lnga dang ba byung lngas byug cing / oṃ badzra a mṛ ta maṇḍal hūṃ/khrag chen gyis byug cing / oṃ rakta maṇḍal hūṃ/ glad chen gyis byug cing / oṃ ki ka pā la maṇḍa la hūṃ/ zhes brjod cing khyem med par byug thig skud kyi rgyu dpa' bos rin gyis nyos pa'i ras bal la gzhon nu mas bkal ba'i srad bu tshon sna lnga pa srid du dkyil 'khor gyi nyis 'gyur la sbom phra sgo'i nyi shu char phyes pa slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i nga rgyal la gnas pa shar dang thig g.yog yum du gsal ba nub tu gnas pas 'debs par za ma tog las bshad kyang / dbang gi spyi don dang grol thig dbang rnams las slob dpon shar dang / slob ma nub tu phyogs pa ste bltas nas 'debs par bshad pas de ltar dgos sam snyam/ de'ang thig skud oṃ hūṃ tram̐ hrīḥ.āḥzhes brjod pas rigs lnga'i ngo bor gyur pa nub nas shar du drangs pa/ bhri dzñā na ma dā la hūṃ/ zhes lan gsum brjod cing se gol gtogs pa dang bcas nam mkha'i dbyings ye shes kyi thig tshangs thig gnyis sam bzhi dang brgyad la sogs pa g.yas bskor du gdab cing thig gi sgra las 'bri bya'i dkyil 'khor nam mkha' la bkra lam gyis gsal ba la mchod bstod bya/ de nas las thig gdab pa ni/ thig skud logs su yod 128

thugs sgrub dpal chen 'dus pa'i sgrub khog/ pod/ 5tran dang / med na de'i ye shes pa badzra sum̐ gyis gshegs pa bdud rtsi lnga dang dkar chal gyis sbags la gdab tshul ni/ shar nas nub thad tshangs thig gdab/ /lho byang tshad nas gnyis pa gdab/ /phyogs bzhi tshad nas mtshams bzhi gdab/ /dkyil 'khor che chung ci tsam pa'i/ /tog nas dbus kyi lte ba'i bar/ /cha mnyam gsum gsum re re yang //gsum char dbye ba cha chen re/ /kun kyang nang nas rim pa bzhin/ /dang po phyed gdab phyi ma'ang gdab/ /gnyis pa cha bzhir bgo bar bya/ /gsum bzhi mi gdab lnga dbus dor/ /drug pa phyed gdab phyi ma'ang gdab/ /dbus kyi lte ba 'khor lo'i sa/ /cha chen gcig dang cha phran gcig /bskor ba mu khyud nang ma la/ /de'i phyir cha chen gcig dang ni/ /cha phran gcig bskor rtsibs brgyad kyi/ /phyi thig mu khyud cha phran gcig /dbus kyi lte ba chos 'byung ste/ /phyi rol cha chen gsum po ni/ /tshangs pa'i thig gi g.yas g.yon du//nang ma gnyis po cha bzhir dbye/ /phyi ma'i dbus dor mtha' gnyis gdab/ /rta babs dang po ka rgyan mnyam/ /gnyis pa gsum pa gcig phyir bskyed/ /bzhi pa gnyis bskum lnga pa gcig /phyir 'phyar drug pa gnyis su bskum/ /bdun pa brgyad pa re re 'phyar/ /snam bu gsum pa'i phyi thig dang / /tshangs thig rgya gram thebs mtshams nas/ /cha phran rga/nyis bskor glang rgyab dbus/ /snam bu dang po'i phyi thig dang / /sgo tshad g.yas g.yon phrad mtshams nas/ /cha phran gnyis res g.yas g.yon dang / /mu ran cha phran re res bskor/ /snam bu gsum pa'i phyi thig dang / /tshangs nas gnyis phyin 'dzom pa nas/ /bzung ste ka rgyan rtse mo dang / /de nas phreng gnyis gcig phyir phyin/ /sna tshogs rdo rjes phyi mtha' bskor/ /padma chos 'khor gdugs kyi sa/ /cha chen phyi ma rang 'grigs 'gyur/ / sna tshogs pad 'khor cha chen phyed/ /'od lnga'i mu khyud cha phran gcig /dur khrod cha chen rdo ra phyed/ /me ri cha chen gcig rnams so/ /gnyis pa gsum gyi dang po lha sta gon ni/lha gnas rnams su dri'i thig le byas pa la me tog gi tshom bu bkod/ mdun du mchod pa bsham/ marṣa brtse'i dgongs rgyan gyi 'gros sbyar ba/ rdo rje slob dpon 129

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rasangs rgyas dpal: sogs lan gsum/ las gzhung ltar mchod pa byin gyis brlab/hūṃ rang byung rig pa bdag med de bzhin nyid: sogs nas/ ma 'dres yongs rdzogs chen por gsal: zhes pa'i bar gyis lha'i 'khor lo rdzogs par bskyed/ hūṃ rang las shar ba'i dpal chen lha: sogs nas/oṃ hūṃ tram̐ trīḥ.āḥ'i bar gyis byin rlabs dbang bskur bya/ hūṃ ye shes lha tshogs spyan 'dren gshegs/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul/sku gsung thugs yon phrin las bstod/ /bag med 'gal 'khrul nyams chag bshags/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stso(5/ /oṃ badzra arghaṃ nasashasda'i bar dang / sarba pañtsa rakta bā lidha khā hi/ zhes bas mchod bstod sogs phrug gcig tu byas mthar/ sgrub sngags 'bru bcu bzhi pa dang /spyi dril gyi bzlas pa ci rigs bya/ slar yang snga ma mchod bstod bsdus pa gtong / de nas/ rang gi lce hūṃ las skyes pa'i rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsgom la/ rgyal ba sras bcas dgongs su gsol/ /khyed rnams mchod dang sems can don/ /nang par dkyil 'khor 'bri 'tshal bas/ /thugs kyis dgongs te gnang bar mdzod/ /ces lan gsum gsol ba btab pas gnang ba byin te/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor steng gi nam mkhar bteg par bsam zhing sems ma rdo rje ma'i rgya dang bcas/ oṃ badzod tiṣṭha lhan/zhes brjod/ spyi don ltar dam tshig pa rang la bsdus te yig brgya brjod/ re zhig tshom bu mchod pa dang bcas bsdu'o/ /gnyis pa bum pa sta gon ni/ bum pa gnyis chas 'jug sogs sngon 'gros/ mtha' mchod pas bskor/ bdag 'jug dbang don rgya mtsho 130

thugs sgrub dpal chen 'dus pa'i sgrub khog/ pod/ 5ltar bsgrub/ de mthar bum pa mchod pa dang bcas pa re zhig gtsang sar bsdu'o/ /gsum pa slob ma lhag gnas ni spyi don snying po'i don gsal ltar ram/ de las rgyas par spro na grol thig rig 'dzin bka' brgyad dang 'di'i rig 'dzin zhi drag ma bu'i tshul du gsungs pas mkhyen brtse'i dgongs rgyan ltar byas kyang rung / dbang bskur dang ma 'brel ba'i tshe lhag gnas de dag gi 'byin 'jug kyang shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa re khā byed pa ni/ tshon sna lnga po mdog rigs kyis dbye bas phyogs bzhi dbus dang lngar bkod de rigs lnga'i sa bon bris la bzhag las chus 'thor zhing bsang sbyang / stong pa'i ngang las tshon sna lnga oṃ hūṃ swā e hā las rigs lnga yab yum gyi rang bzhin can du gyur/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus rdul tshon la thim pas ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin rin po che'i rdul phra rab tu gyur par bsam la 'bru lnga brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pas brlabs te/ tshon thob mngon rtogs bzhin ma 'dres par bris la/ lha mtshan dgod pa ni yig 'bru phyag mtshan sku mdog dang mtshungs pa'i thig le sogs ci rigs pa bkod/ de ltar grub nas/ yi ge brgya pas nyams chags bshags/ dkyil 'khor la brtag cing chad na gso/ lhag na dbyi/ skyon dang bral bar mthong na sta gon gyi dus kyi nam mkha'i lha dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho'i sngags dang phyag rgya dang bcas pas dkyil 'khor la bstim/ rten 'brel snying po bzlas pas me tog gtor zhing shis pa brjod/ thig tshon gyi lhag ma'i ye shes pa badzra muḥs gshegs la mi mngon par bsdu'o/ bzhi pa rgyan bkod ni/ gnas khang byi dor bya zhing sa rgyan sogs kyis mdzes par brgyan la/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su lcags sam tsandan seng ldeng gang rung gi phur bu'i mgul du dar leb rgan la gser ram mtshal gyis gtso bo'i sngags byang bris pa bkod/ thod sku yod na sgrub phur la rgyab rten cing zhal shar sgor phyogs par bzhag /131

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/thod sku ma 'byor na sgrub phur tsam la'ang brten rung / de dag gang yang gtso bo'i sngags kyi dzab dbyangs spos rol dang bcas pas gzi byin bskyed de bkod/ dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' bskor khro bo bcu'i phur pa 'byor na so so'i sngags bzla zhing phur gdan la bkod/ gzhan yang phyogs bzhir ral gri bzhi/ mtshams bzhir mda' dar me long dang bcas pa bzhi rnams tshon skud sna lnga'i dā bas sbrel/ phyogs bzhir 'phan bzhi dang /mtshams bzhir rgyal mtshan bzhi/ yol ba/ bla re/ dar gyi lda ldi la sogs pas mdzes par brgyan/ sgrub dbang sogs dang 'brel tshe phur gyi mdun du rnam rgyal bum pa dang /g.yas su dbu rgyan/ rgyab tu rdo rje/ g.yon du dril bu sogs dang / las bum kyang dbang gzhung bzhin du 'du bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo nas bzung chu gnyis sngon 'gros nyer spyod lnga sogs thun mong gi mchod pa lnga dang / dbang po'i me tog la sogs pa'i nang mchod/ dpal gyi bshos bu sha khrag gis brgyan pa'i gtor ma/ rtsa brgyad yan lag stong las sbyar ba'i sman/ dpa' bo'i snying khrag padma rakta la sogs pa'i tshad ldan gyi rakta so lnga ste gsang sngags bla med kyi nang gi dam rdzas dang / gsang ba bde stong ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i ga 'u'am zla gam ste/ gzhan yang mkha' 'gro chos skyong gi gtor ma dang phyi nang gi mchod pa bye brag ci 'byor pa gtsang zhing dag pas mtha' bskor zhing bkod legs par bsham mo/ /don gsum pa sgrub cing mchod pa'i rim pa la gsum gyi dang po/sgrub pa po rnams gnas su dgod pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgor rdo rje rgyal po gral gyi dbus su bzhugs pa'i 'khor du/ rdo rje rgyal thebs dang rdo rje las pa/ ging mtshams pa/spyan pa/ dus mtshams pa/ phyag tshang ba sogs sgrub chen la 'du bar 'os pa'i mched lcam rnams gral phyag dang bcas so so'i stan la 'khod de/ thun mong gi sngon 'gros rgyud sbyang / de nas rdo dril byin rlob ni/ hūṃ ye shes 'bar ba'i rdo rje che/ /khro rgyal 'bar ba'i thabs kyi sku/ /bde chen yab rnams skur bzhugs pas/ /dgyes pa mchog gi phrin las mdzad du gsol/ /ma hā badzra 132

thugs sgrub dpal chen 'dus pa'i sgrub khog/ pod/ 5 trahūṃ zhes lan gsum gsor/ hūṃ shes rab chen po'i rang bzhin ni/ /chos nyid stong pa chen po'i sgras/ /'khor ba'i bag chags zil gyis gnon/ /dus gsum rgyal ba kun kyang mnyes/ /ma hā gaṇḍi hoḥzhes dril bu 'khrol ba gsum ste/ de kho na nyid nges pa ni rnam pa thams cad du dran par bya'o/ /gnyis pa sgrub pa'i phrin las gzhung bslang ba ni/ las gzhung gi sngon 'gro nas bzung dpal chen phyag rgya rgyas pa'i mngon rtogs ltar lha bskyed nas bstod pa'i bar mthar chags su gyer la/ dzab kyi tshe/ bhri bi shwa bi shuja phaṭa dzaḥ zhes pas dzab khang phye la bdag mdun gnyis su phyes nas/ dkyus ltar dzab dgongs gsal btab ste/ thun ring zhi ba'i sngags stong / gtso sngags stong / spyi dril sum brgya/ las sbyor lnga bcu lta bus mtshon bzlas pa ci ltar rigs pa bya/ bar mtshams rnams su stong tshigs mchod pa dang / las sbyor gyi sngags mthar/ drang srong dmod bablog gi thal rdeb byed/ thun mthar lha mo bcu drug gi mchod phreng dang / gzhung gi bstod pa btang / yi se brgya pas nongs pa bshags/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor zhing lhag ma dkyil 'khor gyi byang shar du btson du bzung / tshim pa drug ldan gyi smon lam gdab/ slar yang /hūṃ rang byung rig pa bdag med de bzhin nyid: sogs nas bzung thun kanyis pa'i las gzhung bsrang zhing bzlas pa tshogs mchod kyi mthar thug gi bar btang /de lta bu'i rim pas dus gsum mam bzhir las gzhung gyer/ thun phyi ma rnams su cung zad bsdus pa la dga' na rje bla mas mdzad pa'i phrin las snying po ltar bgyis kyang rung /dus gsum mam drug tu nyul le bskrad pa ni/ spro na dgug gzhug sngon du 'gro bas phur thun dang bcas gu gul bdug cing dpal gyi pho nya kun thub rgyal mo'i bskul bya ste/ rnga rol dang bcas/ hūṃ shar phyogs dkar mo dung gi gzhal yas nas/133

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/sogs gyer zhing thun brab la gzir ro/ /de'i rjes 'brel du rig 'dzin byin 'bebs ni/sgrub pa po rnams g.yab dar dang rol mo thogs te dkyil 'khor bskor zhing rol mo dbyangs kyi 'gyur ba dang bcas/ hūṃ/ bskal pa srid pa'i dang po la/sogs nas/ shīrnye garbha'i byin phob cig ces thod phreng rtsal gyi dzab dbyangs dang bcas pa bya'o/ /srod thun gyi mthar chos skyong spyi bye brag gi bskang gso dang thugs dam bskul ba chad tho brtan skyong sogs mjug chog rnams dkyus bzhin rdzogs par byas te nyal ba'i rnal 'byor la 'jug go//gsum pa dngos grub blang ba ni/ sgrub pa thon la nye ba'i tshe/ rma sa/ zla rgyas/ zla khrom sogs dngos grub kyi rdzas gsar ba bsham/ mchod pa rnying pa kha gso zhing gsar pa rgyas par bsham/ nang par las gzhung bsrang ste rtsa ba'i bzlas pa ci rigs pa byas rjes mchod phreng rgyas pa dang / las gzhung ltar sman mchod phul/ bstod pa rdzogs nas/tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgyas par bskor/ sgrub rdzas rnams la dngos grub bsdu ba dang /thugs dam bskul ba'i dmigs 'dun dang bcas/ rtsa sngags mthar/ dharmā kā ya/sardzo kā ya/ nirma kā ya/ tsitta sirji pha la hūṃḥ zhes brgya'am nyer gcig sogs bzlas la/ nyul le bskrad/ rig 'dzin gyi byin 'bebs rgyas par byas mthar/sgrub rdzas rnams bteg ste gzhung gi dngos grub blang ba'i tshig gis gnas gsum du gtugs shing sgrub gtor gyi cha shas myang / slar yang gtang rag gi mchod bstod byas la dngos grub kyi rdzas dang tshogs 'khor la longs spyod/ spro na gong gi dngos grub bsdu ba'i sngags kyi mjug tu bdag 'jug dbang don rgya mtshos bdag dbang blang ba'i mthar/nyul le 'dul ba dang byin 'bebs sngon 'gros sngar bzhin dngos grub blang ngo / /gzhan don du dbang bskur byed na'ang skabs 'dir bya ste/ de la bzlas pa'i skabs su bum pa sgrub pa'ang dgos so/ /de nas sbyin sreg ni sgrub khang gi phyi rol lho phyogs sam dkyil 'khor mdun ngos su rgyas pa'i me thab tu me lha'i mchod bstod 'dod gsol dang bcas 134

thugs sgrub dpal chen 'dus pa'i sgrub khog/ pod/ 5tratrapas rjes thog der/ swā bhā was sbyang/ me lha'i lto ba 'bar zhing sreg pa'i klong : bhri yig gnas 'gyur sprul pa'i gzhal med khang :sogs nas/ a tsand+ra maṇḍa la'i bar gzhung ltar song ba dang / dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams mtshon pa me tog gi tshom bu'am dbu rgyan gyi brdas spyan drangs pa slob dpon la g.yas su bskor mthar/ de'i phyag gis blang ste/ oṃ gu ru shri sogs rtsa sngags brjod cing me tog cung zad thab tu dor la/ che mchog badzra thod phreng rtsal:so rgas nas/ ma 'dres yongs rdzogs chen por gsalaḥ zhes pa'i bar gyis gsal gdab/ hūṃ bla med mchog gi mchod pa dam pa ni/ /sogs sbyin sreg za ma tog ltar la/ thab tu dngos grub blang ba'i rdzas dang gtor ma nas kyang cung zad 'bul bar gsung / slar yang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor la gshegs/ gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa rang nyid la thim par bsams te sngar bzhin me tog gi brdas sgrub dkyil du spyan drang / de nas chos skyong gi gtang rag rgyas par gtong / sngar btson du bzung ba'i lhag ma dang sgrub pa po rnams kyis rol pa'i lhag ma bsdus te lhag chog bya zhing rgyal tho'i phyi rol du dor/ chos skyong gi gtor ma thog steng sogs gtsang sar gshegs/ las gzhung gi bskul nas nyer bsdu lhar ldang bar rdzogs pa dang / tho bzhi dang sgo byang gi lha so so'i mdun du mchod pa bshams la/ bsang sbyang byin rlabs drangs bstim mchod pa gtor ma bsngo ba rnams sngar ltar dang / hūṃ ri rab gling bzhi'i sogasadang / tt+waṃ lha srin sde brgyad sogasakyi mal du/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ sogs kyis phrin las bcol/ tiṣṭha badzra gyisame 135

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/tog 'thor bas brtan bzhugs bya ba'am/ yang na gshegs su gsol la tho byang rnams bkrol/ gzugs brnyan gyi dkyil 'khor la mchod cing bstod de bzod par gsol nas/oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ sogs dang / badzra sum̐ḥgyis rang bzhin ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor chos kyi dbyings su gshegs/ ras bris yin na brtan zhugs bya/ thod sku la sogs pa'i sgrub rdzas dang rgyan rnams bsdus te dben par 'jog slob dpon gyis/ chos thams cad skye ba med pa'i don dran pas dril bu dkrol zhing / a ka ro'i sngags brjod bzhin pas/ lag g.yas pa'i rdo rjes dbang ldan gyi rtsigs pa nas brtsams te lte ba'i bar re khā gsum 'then zhing dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor snying ga'i thig le la 'dus par bsam ste lha mtshan cung zad blang ba mgo bor bkod/ lhag ma rnams kyang rjes mi mngon par phyags shing thig shul dri bzang gi chus dbyi/ khro bcu'i phur bu rnams 'og nas rim par hūṃ mdzad kyi rgya dang / sum̐ bha ni'i sngags kyis dbyung zhing / oṃ ru ru spu ru dzwa la tiṣṭha siddhā lo tsa ni sarba arba sā dha ni swāhā/ zhes bzla bzhin phur rtse 'o mas bkru/ rdul tshon phyags pa'i sngon du phur bu bsdu ba'i phyag bzhes kyang yod mod/ 'dir ni rang gzhung za ma tog ltar byas so/ /'dir zhi khro ngan song sbyong ba ltar mar me'i smon lam gdab/ de nas las gzhung gi bsngo smon shis brjod kyi mthar thug par bya'o/ /rdul tshon rnams las cung zad phrin las kyi don du'ang bzung zhing / byings rnams gter du sba ba'o/ /yang na dbu rgyan dkon la mchod rdzas kyis sna drangs te chu klung chen por 'dor/ 'dir masmo brtse'i dgongs rgyan las/ spro na cho ga sbyor ba'ang yod ces gsungs pa'i shugs kyis cho ga ma byas kyang mi rung ba med par bstan pa 'dra yang / /cho ga byed na rgyun du gnas pa'i chu 'gram du maṇḍal la padma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i dbus dang 'dab ma la tshom bu bkod/ mthar chu gnyis nyer spyod/ klu sman btab pa'i 'o ma gtor ma dang bcas pa dang / de las mtho ba'i stegs steng rdul tshon bkod/ mchod gtor 'bru gsum gyis 136

ra〉 /spyapo/05 /grithab rngasnong/95 byebyezug khur/sdu05 nga/:re /spyongs ltasapo// 21jid/ pa/brlab/ rten bsang sbyang / stong pa'i ngang las waṃ las byung ba'i rgya mtsho rin po che dang me tog gis gang ba'i dbus su padma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa las rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa rang snang gi yum dang bcas pa'o/ /snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas klu chen brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzas spyanadrangs/ 'dab ma brgyad la 'khod pa ni/ stod lha'i lus can thal mo sbyar ba/ sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka dang ldan pa/ smad sbrul mjug tu 'khyil zhing dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa 'khor dang bcas par gyur/ oṃ badzra satwa aṣṭanā ga a dhi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ nas shabhā'i gyi cho gdengasakanorab 'baraba'i'odazeragyis tshobaḥṭa thag zug cad/ dag3 / /sa 'og mun pa'i tshogs rnams rab 'joms shing / /bstan la rab dga' mthu stobs bsam mi khyab/ /klu rgyal 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'a tshal bstod/ /lag g.yon gdengs ka'i tshul dang / g.yas mchog sbyin gyi rgyas/ oṃ klu rgyal mtha' yas nor rgyas bu/ /'jog po dang ni stobs kyis rgyu/ /padma padma chen po dang / dung skyong dang ni rigs ldan no/ /lha mo lha mo chen po dang / /zla ba'i spyi gtsug spyi gtsug che/ /dbyug 'dzin dbyug 'dzin chen po dang / /sog ma me dang hu luṇḍa//dga' bo dang ni nye dga' bo/ /rgya mtsho rgya mtsho chen po dang / /tsha 137

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/zheb tsha ba chen po dang / /dpal gyi 'od dang 'od po che/ /rin chen 'od dang gzugs mdzes dang / /gzugs mdzes chen po sbrul bzang dang / /lto 'phye chen po tshi lu dang / /tshi li chen po rnams dag go/ /oṃ bhakṣa bhakṣa ā gatstsha a gatstsha ma hā nā ga adhi pa ti sarba bhurbha wa st+waṃ st+waṃ swā hā/ zhes pa gsum gyis gtor ma phul nas/ gong bzhin mchod bstod dang / mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /zhes pa nas/yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /cesadang / klu'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i rdul tshon rin po che'i rang bzhin 'di rnams bdag gir mdzad nas mchod pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams spyi dang khyad par sa phyogs 'di dag tu bde legs kyi dpal phun sum tshogs pa 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ zhes phrin las gsol nas shis brjod dang / bzod gsol byas pa'i mthar/ gatstsha gatstsha/ oṃ āḥhūṃ sum̐ zhes rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas klu rnams gshegs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hos rdor sems rang la bsnyim/ rdul tshon mchod gtor tshom bu re khā dang bcas chur gshegs/ rdul tshon gyi snod chus bkang ste nang du log nas spyan ma'i sngags bzla bzhin dkyil 'khor khang pa sogs la bsang gtor bya/ slar yang rdo rje'i glu gar sogs bkra shis dga' ston gyis mtha' rgyas su bya'o/ /bka' gter snying po rig 'dzin thugs sgrub kyi/ /sgrub chen khog dbub bcud bsdus za ma tog /cung zad 138

thugs sgrub dpal chen 'dus pa'i sgrub khog/ pod/ 5tra gsal bar phyes 'dis skal bzang la/ /dngos grub rin chen 'byor pa sbyin gyur cig /ces pa'ang mkhas btsun dam pa 'jigs med 'od gsal gyis 'di 'dra zhig gyis zhes lhag bsam dag pas yang yang bskul ba ltar/ 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi mas smras rim bzhin bskul ba po nyid kyis yi ger bris pa phyogs dus thams cad du dge bar gyur cig/ //139

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/༄/ /sgrub chen zin bris rig pa 'dzin pa dga' ba'i skyed mos tshal zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /sgrub chen gyi sngon du phyi skor bya ba ni/ dkon mchog mchod pa/gtor ma cha gsum/ gzhan yang bgegs gtor rigs/ bka' klog sdig ltung bshags chog skor/ skyabs sems sdom bzung /satstsha/ chu gtor/ byis pa'i ston mo sogs/ phud mchod rgyas pa dang gzhi bdag la bka' bsgo/ zhi rgyas kyi sbyin sreg de rnams gsang rdzogs dang phur pa spu gri las ci rigs su bshad la/bsnyen sgrub kyi sngar cha gsum gtong ba dbang chen yang gsang las kyang bshad/ 'di la bde 'dus las/ bsod nams kyi dpung skyed pa zhes/ sbyin pa gtong ba/ rang rgyud sbyong ba/ mdo sde klog pa/ gtor ma bsngo ba ste bzhi po/ re re la bzhi bzhir phye ba'i bcu drug bshad/ rdo rje gtsug lag las kyang drag sngags kyi nus pa ring du bsgrubs kyang ma grub na skong dang tshogs bsags kyi dpung cher skyed ces bshad de gnad mthun no/ /phyi mtshams rgyal tho 'dzugs zin nas/ rnal 'byor pa rnams 140

sgrub chen zin bris/ pod/ 5tho'i phyi rol du mi rgyu/ phyi mi rnams tshar mi btang / dngos grub ༄zas nor skyel na rung / phyi'i las la 'gro srid na phur pa re bskur/tshur 'dong du mtshams gcod re bya bar gsang rdzogs las so /rgyal tho ni/ gnas kyi phyi rol gom pa bdun cu rtsa bzhi'i sar/ sku gzugs bris pa'i shing byang tho brtsigs la gtsug de mdun maṇḍal zlum po rer gtsang gtor dang / mchod pa lnga lnga bshams la tho chog byed par bde 'dus las so/ /bar mtshams skabs/ spyir dam sri ni/ sngon gsang sngags la zhugs pa slar dam las log pas/dam tshig can la gnod pa'i 'drer gyur pa ste/ de ni sngon dam 'dres zin pa'i phyir mtshams gzhan gyis mi zlog pas sgo them phyi nang mtshams su mnan pa'i mtshams bya bar gsang bdag zhal lung du'o/ /des rgyal po btson du bzung na 'bangs kyis gnod pa byed mi nus pa ltar bgegs kyi rigs gzhan yang srung bar lnga pa chen pos bshad de/ bde 'dus las nang mtshams ma tram̐ bsgral ba la de ltar bshad do/ /gsang rdzogs dam sri mnan chog tu/dam sri bya mchu ma lha dang / mi dang / 'dre'i lhums su zhugs nas bar chad mang po 'dren tshul gsungs pa'ang go dgos/ /ma tram̐ sgrol ba'i mtshams kyi don la/ sgyu 'phrul gyi bco lnga par /bdag med phu thag chod pa dang bde chen sbyar ba'i gab don ma 141

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rtogs par sbyor sgrol sogs sbas gsang la 'chel ba'i sngags pa dur bdag mi bzad par skye bar gsungs pa lta bu'i rigs gtogs kyi dam sri chen po da lta'ang yod la/ de dag gis dur khrod dang khro bo rang rgyud par sgom pa dang drag sngags rang gar zlo ba rnams la kho rang dang bsam sbyor mthun pa'i gnad kyis dbang byed cing / shrī he ru ka'i gnas bdag med rdo rje'i dur khrod du 'jug pa la bgegs byed do/ /de 'dra'i ma tram̐ ni bgegs kyi rgyal po yin la/ sgo drung gnon rgyu'i dam sri ni bgegs chung ngu ste/ snga ma ni non dka' bas phyi ma'i sdebs su ma bstan par 'dul thabs gzhan gsungs so/ /de'ang sngon he ru kas ru tra btul ba na kho'i rig pa ye shes su sbyangs/ rnam smin gyi khog pa de phyi rabs rjes 'jug gi don du bgegs kyi rgyal po rnams kyi dur sar byin gyis brlabs yod pas/ der bkug nas sngon byung ltar tri shu la'i mtshon las dang / bro brdung byas na khug sla zhing pham sla'o/ /'di ni bgegs chen po rnarmas mnan pa'i don du 'gro ste dur du bcug pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /dpyad rten tsam yin gyi gna' bo'i khog pa de nyid du bskyed rgyu yin min bsam dgos te/ sngon byung dang chos mthun sbyar ba tsam las mi gsal lam snyam du yang sems/nges don ni/ sems can dang sems can gyi gnas thams cad 142

sgrub chen zin bris/ pod/ 5zhezhe trabadag dang bdag gi bas stong pa'i bdag med ni dur khrod de/te ru ka'i rang snang dag pa'i dur khrod kyi de nyid do/ /ma tram̐ bdag 'dzin la bshad pas/ de bdag med kyi dur khrod der 'jug tu mi ster te/ de shes rab kyi mtshon chas bsgral ba na/bdag med kyi ro gling mngon du 'gyur zhing de la dbang bsgyur bar 'gyur la/ de'ang sngar bdag 'dzin gson po'i skabs gzhi gang la bdag tu bzung ba'i ro lta bu'i phung khams skye mched nyid kyi steng nas mngon du 'gyur gyi/ ro dang ro gling ngo bo tha dad du med do/ /de'i tshe ni bdag med kyi dur khrod de nyid 'jig rten lha'i phyogs kyi tshogs brgyad bsgral ba'i ro'i tshal du'ang 'gyur ro/ /de 'dra'i rnam dag gi cha las rang shar ba'i dur khrod du ni bgegs katan nas 'jug mi nus te/ spyod yul min pa'i phyir ro/ /des na srung gur khyad par can no/ /de ltar ru tra'i lus kyi cha las dur khrod brgyad grub pa de dag he ru kas zhing skyong dang / phyogs skyong / rig 'dzin dang / grub pa'i rnal 'byor ma mchog gis gang zhing / sngags rang bzhin gyis 'grub pa'i gnas chen khyad par can du byin gyis brlabs yod pas/ 'dir yang de dang sgo bstun nas ma tram̐ gi khog par dur khrod brgyad bskyed de sngags rgyas sgo phye nas nang du 'jug pa dang / dngos gzhi'i tshe yang de'i nang 143

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/lgedu sgrub mchod byas pas ni sgrub pa bkra shis par 'gyur bar bshad do/ /der ma zad 'chad 'gyur ltar dngos gzhi'i dus drug du der ye shes kyi dur khrod brgyad kyi byin 'bebs zur ba yang byed de/'di dag ni dkyil 'khor la byin rlabs chags pa'i thabs rmad du byung bar snang / mtshams gcod kyi sngon/ rdzas bsags pa'i 'phror/ mched lcam gsar pa rnams la/ bgegs gtor dang hūṃ bzhi dang khro bcu'i sngags dang / gu gul gyi bdug pas bgegs gsal zhing / yig brgya'am rnam 'joms kyis bsgrubs pa'i bum chus khrus bya bar spu gri dang gsang rdzogs las so/ /rtags gdab skabs/ he ru ka'i gnas bcu dang / dur khrod brgyad sogs na bzhugs pa'i bcom ldan 'das he ru ka dang / mkha' 'gro ma dang / ging gi tshogs rnams kyi thugs chags shing rang gi nang mi dang jo bor bzung ste dbang bskur ba dang / srung skyob byin gyis rlob pa'i ched du/ de dag gi rtags sam mtshan ma rim bzhin/brang la zhag gi zo ris/ mkhur tshos la rakta'i thig le/ dpral bar thal chen gyi tshom bu rnams/ 'khor ba'i bcud len zhag gi zo ris gsol: chags pas dbang bsdu raktas thig le gsol:skye 'chi rtsad gcod thal chen tshom bu gsol: zhes pa'i de nyid dran bzhin btab/ 'dis ni he ru ka'i nga rgyal gyi dran pa gso 144

mngabastayangazeg /////spros /nyedri(5sdo ༷je (1/ /༷༷/ཿsa// /rdo///ཿཿ// snye /zhing / dbang chen yang gsang skor las bgegs srung ba'i go char 'gyur bar yang bshad/ 'di dag gtso bor spu gri dang gsang rdzogs las btus/ bde 'dus las dpal chas kun gyi rtags ga/dab bam chas 'jug kyang bshad de rgyas bsdus kyi khyad par tsam mo/ /tshom bu dang bcas te sgrub pa'i dus dang 'brel bar bsnyen pa thog mar bya bar gsungs pa ni bsnyen pa sngon nas thems pa la/slar kha gso ba'i bsnyen pa la dgongs te/ sgrub 'bum nyid du gsal lo/ /yang sgrub 'bum chen mor/ las gzhung nam bsrang res gtor ma gsar pa re yang bshams0 sman raka gis gtor cam yang gso: gtso bo'i dzab bam dril dzab la gsung ma chad par bya: zhes gsungs/ /bde 'dus pra khrid du/ gtor ma gtong tshul ni/ gtor ma mi bzung mi btang ba ste/ rgyun gyi dang / gnas skabs kyi mi bzung mi gtang ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rnal 'byor pas gtor ma dgong mo bzung / nang par btang ngo / /de ltar nyin re bzhin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ sgrub pa byed pa'i dus su dpal gyi kator ma ni bzung / rgyun gtor dang 'byung po'i gtor ma ni nang nub med par btang ngo / /zhes bshad cing / lung las gtor ma bzung na bgegs rnams 'du: gtor ma btang na 145

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dngos grub yal: zhes drangs dam can gyi/ so/ /gsang sngags bka'i lde mig gi dpe las/ gtor ma nang par bzung dgong mo gtong ngo : de bzhin du byin gyis brlab cing re re gtong ngo :re re bzung : zhes byung / lde mig las/ gtor ma'i rdzas dang /de nyid sogs gtor ma'i gnad gzhan yang mang du ston to/ /sgrub 'bum du bla mas zhal bkod gdab rgyur/ slob dpon la yi dam gyi lhar zungs/ mched lcam rnams kyang ye shes dag pa'i lha dang lha mor ltos/ 'jig rten gyi gtam dang ngan rtog bzhad gad dang bre mo'i gtam/ chos la gzu lum ris chod/ gcig la gcig zur smod dang 'phya sems brnyas chos 'khon 'dzin khro tshig /sgos mdza'/ nang sdeb/ phyogs ris nye ring ma byed/ ting nge 'dzin gyi sgang la khus(phus) 'debs pa sogs sgra chen po ma 'byin/ slob dpon rnams kyis mi shes pa rnams la brtse bas slobs/ slob bu rnams kyis kyang las kyi slob dpon la sogs pa rnams gtsug gi rgyan bzhin khur/ dzab kyi rgyun ma bcad/ chad dang gnyid dang le lo'i gzhan dbang du ma btang gzhan du na bdud dbang du song nas dngos grub mi 'byung bas sgrims shig ces brtse bas gdams par bshad do/ /de'ang nang re nub re bzhin 'khor la bskul 'debs su byed par bshad pas dang po lan gcig kho nar byed pa 146

sgrub chen zin bris/ pod/ 5khyopo'i stomin phyordo/ /tshogs mchod skabs tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor/ zhes pa /dzos/ju/ kyi 'khor lo'i mchod pa byed pa la dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma gnyis tshogs dgos shing / de la 'dus pa che 'bring chung rgasu/ma yod/ 'du dus tshogs kyi yo byad rnams la dam tshig gi skad kyis mi rjod par tha mal ba'i brdas 'bod na dam tshig nyams par gsungs/ snying po rgyan las/ longs spyo da kasum po nyid med par/ /tshogs kyi bya bar 'gyur ma yin/ /zhes dpa' mo'i 'o ngas spyod chang / dpa' bo'i sha chen/ gnyis ka'i longs spyod snyom 'jug ste gsum ngo tshang dgos par bshad/ shom skabs zhing lpags sam gcan gzan pags par bā la sogs bza' ba rnams g.yas dang / ma da na so/ga/sa btung ba rnams g.yon du bshams/ dam nyams kyis tshogs mchod phul yang lhas mi ba zhes shing / glang chen rab 'bogs las ye shes lha dang 'khon bcug sbyong ba'i bshags pa ye shes sku mchog mar gsungs pas de sngon du gtong srol snang / tshogs bsgral gyi nya bo zur du bcas pa med na bsgral mchod kyi tshogs byin rlabs kyi sngon nas logs su bcad la/ byin rlabs grub pa'i 'og tu phud rim pa gsum spros te/ dang po gnyis mchod bshags/gsum pa gtsang lhag tu bzhag ste/ bar du sngar gyi bsgral mchod rakta bran pa/ 'bul bar gter bdag gling pas bshad/ des 147

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bka' ma'i yig char/ dang po nas bsgral mchod zur du mi dbye bar byin rlabs kyi rjes la phud rim bzhir bsil te/ gsum pa de la hūṃ/ zhes 'dod yon gyi lha mo rang gi snying khar bsdus te/dgug bsgral bstab pa byed par yang bshad/ yang ru zung gi bshags pa gnyis la grangs bzhi rer mdzad pa ni lus ngag yid gsum ye shes dang bzhi'i nyams chag skong ched yin par o rgyan gling pa'i bka' 'dus las gsungs te/ bzhi tshan gnyis ni nyams chag bshags pa dang / dam tshig gso ba'i ched du mdzad dam snyam/ tshogs zhing spyan 'dren skabs/ mdun bskyed yod na de dang bsre/ med na mdun khar bzhag de nas tshogs phud gsum gyi/ bde 'dus gsang sngags lde mig las/ dmar ba la bstab pa/ dkar ba la bshags pa/ mthing ba la mchod pa/ zhes so so'i de nyid dang bcas pa bshad yod de/ mthing dkar dmar gsum ni gtso bo'i zhal gsum po la bya'o/ /dang po ni/ye shes lha la 'dris gdags pa lta bu dang / gnyis pa 'khon gcug sbyong ched yin gsung / phud dang po 'dod yon drug gi sprin du shes pas mchod/ bar pa dam skong gi rdzas bdud rtsi lngar shes pas bshags/ tha ma dgra bgegs kyi gzugs phung du shes pas bstang ces he ru ka gaspo las so/ /rgyud sde sgyu 'phrul sogs ltar na bsgral bstab ni khro bo'i dgos chos su snang mod/ gter 148

sgrub chen zin bris/ pod/ 5traphyogs nas dpyad rgyu yod snang / tshogs bskang gnyis kyi khyad par ni/ tshogs rim gsum ni lha tshogs spyir mchod pa dang / bskang pa la gsang rdzogs las/ lha tshogs mtshan don re re nas thugs dam bskang ba/ zhes gsungs pas so sor bskang ba ste/ sman mchod dus spyir dang / so sor 'bul ba gnyis 'byung ba dang 'dra'o/ /tshogs la rol ba na/ sha lag g.yas rtse gsum rgyas bzung la/ /dpa' bo dang / chang skyes pa'i thod pa dum gcig pa snod du dgos gsungs/dpa' mos ma spyad bar du cig shos la skal pa med par snying po rgyan las te/ gtso bo la ni dang por dpa' mos chang g.yas g.yon steng 'og tu byas nas 'dren/ 'dren cing / de nas de'i rjes bzhin 'brang ba'i dpa' bos bza' ba bstab/ gtso mo la dang por dpa' bos bza' ba 'dren cing / de nas de'i phyi nas 'brang pa'i rnal 'byor mas chang bstab/ de nas g.yas gral la bza' ba dang por dang / g.yon gral la btung ba thog mar stob par smin gter sogs kyis gsungs te pho g.yas gral mo g.yon gral du sde tshan bsdebs pa la dgongs/ der lus dkyil lhag par gsal bas nang gi sreg blugs kyi tshul du rol tshogs la rol dus ratna rakṣi tas/ btung ba dga' ba skyed pa tsam/ /de bas lhag dang chad pa min/ /bde ba skyed phyir btung ba ste/ /myos pa'i phyir ni ma yin no/ /zhes pas ji tsam 'thung ba'ang shes te/ myos pa'i 149

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/tranus pa zil gyis non rim ltar ro/ gsang chog skabs/ mdun bskyed gzhan med na/ bdag bskyed lha tshogs thams cad snyoms 'jus mdzad pa'i bde ba'i sgra dang 'od zer gyis bskul te/ tshogs zhing gi lha yab yum rnams kyang rol pa mdzad pa'i dga' ba'i ros zhu ste rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ snying dbus kyi thig ler bstim/mdun bskyed yod na 'od zhu mi byed/ lhag chog dus/ dme lhag mchod pa'i ras ma dang bcas pa la gong gi gtsang lhag bsna/na gsungs te 'di la bshad rgyu cung zad yod/ lhag ma btson 'dzin byed na lhag chog mi byed ces sngags 'chang mkhas pa la la gsungs te mi 'thad dam snyam/ dus mtshan dang gdong thug srung phyir lhas gtor la nyin mo spos me dang / mtshan mo me sgron 'jug las rdor pas pad skor sngon 'gros mkha' lding gi rgyas blangs la sgrub khang gi sgo drung bar phyi nur du 'gro zhing / phyi rol gom pa bdun bcu'i mtshams de srin mo'i za lam yin pas der spung / snod kyang bshal nas mchod gsungs/ dpal 'bar tshur khyer te yong pa'i phyag len yod/ lhag gtor rigs gtong dus gtor snod ma bsgul bar mi len/ gtor snod kha phyir bstan nas mi 'bul zhes padma'i lam rim gyi rang 'grel du byung / yang sngon du lhag gtor la kha phru 'debs tshul ni/ ya rkan dpa' bo dang / ma rkan dpa' 150

sgrub chen zin bris/ pod/ 5sge khyomor shes pas gaspor/ dpal gyi lce la rta mgrinartsotrīḥ mkha' dbyings phyag rgya rab ldan pas/ /rtog bsreg bdud rtsis sbyor mchod dbul/ /zhes so/ lung 'di nyid ltar sgyu 'phrul khro bo/ yang dag dong sprugs sogs kun no/ /rang gi lce la rta mgrin yum bzhi dang rol pa mdzad pa'i byang sems dza gad kyi kha phru dang ro gcig pas mkha' dbyings kyi phyag rgya las lhag ma dme gtor du dbab ces mthun par 'byung ngo / /de gnyis mnyam par sbyor ba'i byang sems kyi bdud rtsis gtor ma bde chen spor nus su brlab par bltas la/ sor mo rnams phan tshun bcings pa las/ mtheb mdzub the'u chung rnams brkyang ste rtse sprad pa'i nang nas bdud rtsi'i kha zegs bran/ 'di ni dam tshig sre ba'i ched yin no/ /tshogs kyi glu gar ni bde ba chen po'i lam gyi gro gas zhing sngags lhan skyes kyi pho nya mo rnams mnyes pa'i ched du byed pa yin te brtags gnyis las gsungs shing / tshim pa drug thi thad du'ang gsal lo/ /rgyud nyi zla kha sbyor ltar mnyam bzhag gi bde ba brtan par bya ba'i thabs kyang yin no/ /brtags gnyis su/de tshe dga' bas glu blangs te/ /de tshe rdo rje mchog ldan no/ /zhes pa'i rkang pa'i phyi ma'i don ni/ de'i tshe grong pa'i glu phal pa len pa min gyi/ rdo rje'i tshig de kho na nyid mchog dang ldan pa blang zhes pa ste/ theg pa thun mong gi lam ston pa lta bus kyang mi chog go/ /tshim pa drug ni/ tshogs zhing rnams mchod pas tshim pa/ rnal 151

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/'byor pho mo rnams bza' btung snying po rgyan du/ gang du dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma/ /tshim pa ru ni mi nus na/ /de dag snyan gsan dbab mi bya/ /gang du tshim par ma gyur pa//des ni bsod nams rab zad byed/ /de bas kun tu rnal 'byor pa/ /zas sogs kyis ni tshim par bya/ /zhes so/ /gis/ snying ga'i ye shes sems dpa' bdud rtsis/ lus dkyil gyi lha rnams 'bar 'dzag gis/ 'byung po rnams gtor mas/ phyi nang gi mkha' 'gro ma rnams rdo rje'i glus tshim pa ste drug go/ /tshogs mchod du cha gsum gtor ma 'dzud srol snang ba'ang de ltar ro/ /dam tshig lnga pa las/ 'di dag gzhan gyi rgyud gsungs pa'i/ /bya ba rnams ni dal la bya/ /gang phyir myur du byas pa yis/ /rnal 'byor pa yi dga' nyams byed/ /ces las rim rnams dal gyis bag phab nas bya dgos par gsungs/ tshogs 'khor la ni bsngags pa che ste/ ḍosthā he ru ka'i tshogs 'khor gyi cho ga las/ de la sangs rgyas 'thob pa'i rgyu/ / bsod nams ye shes tshogs yin te/ /tshogs las dngos grub mchog tu 'gyur/ /de phyir rtag tu tshogs bsag bya/ /ye shes mngon par rtogs pa ste/ /bsod nams rnam pa mang yod kyang / /rang gi lha yi 'khor lo yis/ /'dod yon lnga sbyor bla na med/ /ces dang / snying po rgyan las/ sdig pa thams cad rnam dag cing //rgya cher 'bras la nyer sbyor ba/ /rnal 'byor spyod pa'i mchog rim 152

sgrub chen zin bris/ pod/ 5dag /nya sogs brgyad la rab tu spyad/ /ces tshogs 'khor gyi skabs su bshad do/ /de la'ang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo gcig tu dbang bskur thob pa min pa 'khor lo der tshogs 'khor skor ba'i 'du bar mi btub gsungs/ the re long tsam las ma bris/nyul le'am nyams drod len pa'i 'byung po ni bar chad kyi ltas mthong ba'am bar chad yod med rtog pa sogs kyi skabs thams cad du bar chad phyogs kyi gtam mchu skor mi 'don pa gal che/ bton na bar chad de dag stobs rgyas nas rang nyid de dag gi dbang du 'gro zhes dgongs 'dus las so/ /dngos grub brtag la'ang gsang rgya gal che ba ni 'dra'o/ /dgong mo nyi ma nub kha zer la bya rog skad bsgyur/ srod la brang rkun nag mo/ nam gung gti mug rgyan byed ma/ nam phyed 'dod chags dmar mo nu can/ phyed yol lam nam smad du na ber rtse/ tho rang lag bsen ma/ / nyi shar gnam the nag po/ nyi dros klu srin sngon mo/ nyin phyed klu chen bzhi/phyed yol sa bdag ma yam/ nyi myur dmu bdud dang the'u rang bsdong ba rnams 'ong ste/ de rnams kyang dam sri'i rigs so/ /bka' brgyad rnam gsum gyi skor du/ de dag so so'i cho 'brang dang / gzags ji lta bas 'ong ba/ 'ong ba'i rtags so so so so ༄shi rabyebacas bshad de/ 'dre'i tshang brtol ba zhes 'dul thabs kyi yan lag tu yang 'gro bas mkho mod/ 'dir ma bris/ dgong kha bya 153

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/mchu nag mo 'ong ba shas che/ gzhan yang dam sri'i bye brag mang po 'ong ste/ de rnams 'ong ba'i rtags thun mong du/ dkyil 'khor mdangs chung ba dang / dam rdzas ham skya ba/ mar me mdangs nyams pa/ rtsed mo glu gzhas la rtsib/ nyams 'thibs shing bying ba/snying rje med par zhe sdang rang ga ma skye ba/ chos dang bla ma la the tshom 'char ba/ 'dod chags sogs nyon mongs gzhan yang 'bar ba/ skyo zhing snying mi dga' phyad de ba dang / nad pa slo bur tsag tsog mang ba/ dge sbyong g.yel zhing byed snying mi 'dod pa/ gnyid dbang du 'gro ba/ sems 'phyo zhing las su mi rung ba sogs 'byung ngo / /de dag 'dul ba'i thabs gsang rdzogs dang rang shar las gsungs tshul ni/ tri yig la nyu le rnams kyi ming gis bskor ba bris pa'i ling ka bcas te dgug gzhug bya/ pho nya btang /sder mo'i sngags dang hūṃ bzhis phur pa gdab/ rdo rje dus mtshams pa ging dkar nag gi chas su zhugs pas bong mje la 'ug mgo bkal ba'i tho bas brdung zhing / mi lag la mi lpags kyi lcag 'bras btags pas mched rnams brab ste bskrad/ nan sngonaltar cho 'phrul che na kun thub rgyal mo skul/ skabs su bros kyang gzir ro/ /bde 'dus bsnyen sgrub kyi pra khrid dang / ti ka las gsungs tshul ni/ bgegs kyang dag pa rab 'byams su 'char ba'i lta dgongs 154

zla bsta /////pa/ /bye/mi/tre// /ji /byed/ //dro/lha/pa// /rdo//2rwaspro// /ji /kyi gdeng brtan na nyul le 'dul thabs gzhan gang yang mi dgos shing / de las gzhan la nyu le so so la gnyen po'i pho nya so sor btang ba dang / rang gtso bor gsal ba'i thugs ka nas spros la btang ste de'ang pho nya de dang de grangs med pa spro bar gsungs/ spyi'i gnyen po kun thub rgyal mo btang ba dang / gdon shin tu drag po pho nyas ma thul ba byung na/las kyi rgyal thebs lta ba'i slob dpon gzhan gyis srang zlog gsad rigang rabang gnan sreg pa ste gzer kha lnga'i las sbyor zur du bsgrubs nas tshar gcad pa'am/ yang na drag sngags kyi spu gris brdeg par bshad do/ /rgyun du 'byung bo'i dngos grub blang ba ni/ tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i gang zag la dam can dngos grub rgyun du skyel ba ni/ nyi ma dmar thag chad pa la lha srin sde brgyad kyis/ mun sros la srin po dam can gyis/ gung la srid pa'i ma mos/ nam phyed na re ma tis/phyed yol na ma mo bdun gyis/ nam lang dkar mo sde bzhis/ tho rengs ging chen bco brgyad kyis/ nyi shar rdo rje srin pos/ nyi dros ha nu ma dhas/ nyin phyed klu dam ldan gyis/ dgong mo klu sman mtsho sman gyis dngos grub skyel lo/ /gzhan yang rgyun du rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro chos skyong dam can rnams kyis/ chos dang / tshe dang / dbang dang / mthu dang / srid dang / nor dang / 'bru dang / zas dang / las sna tshogs kyi dngos grub khyer nas yong ngo / /155

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rtags su sgra snyan pa/ gzugs mdzes pa/ 'od dang du ba/ dri zhim pa/ brtson 'grus rtsom snying 'dod pa/ ting nge 'dzin gsal ba/nyams dga' ba/ byin che ba/ gzengs mtho ba/ dpa' gdeng thob pa/ spobs pa skye ba/ sems las su rung ba byung na dngos grub ste/ dga' brod kyang mi bya/ chos kyi dbyings kyi byin brlabs sam rten 'brel gyi chos nyid tsam du bsam/ nyul le'i bar chad kyi ltas ngan mthong yang mi dga' ba mi byed de bzhin nyid kyi rtsal du lta/ 'di dag ni spu gri dang / gtso bor sgrub 'bum chen mo las bris/ des na nyul le bskrad pa'i rjes la dngos grub kyi byin 'bebs re bya zhing / dngos grub kyi mtshan ma nam byung du thod pa'i bdud rtsi la brten nas glo bur ba'i dngos grub len chog mdor bsdus re byed do/ /dngos grub skyel mkhan de dag ni tshogs sbyor gyi lam la gnas pa zhes sgrub 'bu ma las gsungs te/mdor na dpal ldan he ru kas rang gi 'khor dngos grub ster ba'i pho nyar byin gyis brlabs te btang ba yin la/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dngos la sogs pa ni re zhig dngos grub len yul du khug dka' ba longs sprul gnyis kyi rigs pa lta bu zhig yin pas/ de las ches 'grub sla ba'i pho nya las dngos grub blang ba rgyun du byas pas gong nas gong du dngos grub kyi mthu skyes te/ nam zhig na de'i 156

dzeḥmiphuḥmi ////spro/ cechenacan/ ༷je can/ ༷dro/lhas// 151sprerwani/ 14/song ma rigs bzhis khrag 'thung dang / gtso bo dngos la dngos grub len pa'i nus pa rnyed 'ong ngo / /des na sla ba'i go rim zer ba dang 'dra'o/ /pho nya rkyang grub kyis dngos grub bsgrubs na'ang myur mod kyi tshan chang la/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i bsnyen sgrub dang ༄'brel ba ni tshan shin tu che ste/ 'di 'dra la dgongs nas phur pa'i skabs su'ang rtsa ba spu grir 'brel ba la myur ba dang tshan che ba'i zab gnad gnyis yod par gsungs so/ /de ltar pho nya sa dus mtshams bcur dngos grub nyin bzhin skyel ba dang / de la nyul le rnams bar chad bya ba'i phyir rgyu ba ni/ sngon du bsnyen pa tshad ldan gyis lha'i thugs nye bar byas pa'i 'og tu/ dngos grub mngon du byed pa'i sgrub pa'i skabs su yin gyi/ dang po gzhi bsnyen byed dus nas 'ong ba ni min pa 'dra'o/ /'di dag kyang sgrub chen bka' brgyad kyi gsang gtam zhig yin te/ pha dgongs bus lon pa nyung bar snang ngo / /yang sgrub 'bum chen mor/ de la sgrub pa'i gegs ni: rnam rtog rang ga ma dang : the tshom dang ris chod ya ma bla ste: rdo rje rgyal po'i ting nge 'dzin gal che bas: dgongs pa gsang la snying po bzlas shing : sgrub pa'i gtso bor ting 'dzin gsang: ces pas sgyu ma tsam du gang yang yod pas rtog dpyod du ma dang ldan 157

rjesprorngad/ shā therdo sdispyings khur:drob/thag cesasprad thab/sdizug rta):re ba/sdo/ཿba 'o/dra/zug/ ra〉par bya: don dam par gang yang med pas rnam rtog med par bya'o: bden pa dbyer med dam: snang stong dbyer med pa'i lta ba dang : spyod pa ma nor bas 'bras bu lam du 'khyer ba'i theg chen mchog la 'bad do0 zhes bden zhen sogs tha mal pa'i cornam rtog mi rgyu bar bya bar bstan/ de'i de ma thag par/ dam tshig nyams na dngos grub rdul tsam yang mi 'byung : dam tshig ni ma tshor bar yang nyams srid pas bshags rgyun btsugs te 'bad do: dam can sprin ltar gtibs: dngos grub char ltar 'byung /'phro la dam tshig phra mo gcig nyams kyang : rlung sprin la phogs pa ltar dam can gyed nas dngos grub 'chad pas bar chod kyis tshugs srid pas bskangs bshags gces te nan tan bya: nyams pa la gzab cing 'dzem mo: de la bskang ba yang phyi rdzas skong ngam mdos sman rag gtor ma: nang rtog tshogs lhar gsal gdab ste: lha dang gnyis med du rtogs pa ni zab bo: gsang ba lta bas bskang bya skong byed bskang rgyu thams cad chos nyid la chos nyid thim par gnyis med du bskang ba ni gnad che'o: bla ma dang mched thugs rab tu mnyes par bya ste dbang zhu: dus mchod ma chag pa ni bskang bshags dam pa'o: 'thib pa sangs phyir gar yang bya: skyo ba bsang phyir rdo rje'i glu blang : bar chad 'dul 158

ringashādzi /////spros /bye/shā(1// dzoX /byed/ //dro/lhas// 11rngo/45ཿ// 14/phyir bro yang bya: skabs su ya mtshan gtam yang brjod: bar mtshams kun tu tshe yang dgug: zas rnams 'tsham par 'aza' zhing: lhag tshad lhag phud snod du bsags la phan chad du mi 'khyer: mi la mi sbyin no: dzab la nan tan bskyed pa sgrub pa'i srog yin pas ya ma brla ye bya mi rung: the tshom spangs te dad brtson bskyed do: zhes so/ yang de las sgrub pa la/ rab lo sgrub rtags dang sbyar ba/ 'bring zla sgrub grangs dang sbyar ba/ tha na zhag bdun nam lngar sgrub pa ste gsum las/ dang po ni bdag don dngos grub sgrub pa'i dbang du byas pa dang / gnyis pa ni/ de ltar mi nus pas las rung tsam gyi phyir ram/ gzhan yang slob ma la dbang bskur sngon 'gro'i ched du dang / gsum pa ni/ gzhan don so so'i skye bo g.yengs shing mi khom pa'i don nam/'on te rang gi dam bca' mi gcod pa dang / bskangs gso'i ched yin par gsungs te/ 'di la dus mtshams bkol byang du bshad tshul yang yod/ de ltar na tshom bu'i sgrub pa la yang lam mos slob dang nges rdzogs kyi rim pa du ma zhig yod do/ /bde 'dus bsnyen sgrub ti ka las/ rgya gar pa'i lugs ltar dngos grub chen po ma thob kyi bar du tshogs sgrub rtsom pa'i lo sgrub 'grol ba na ni 'og tu 'chad pa'i gnas srang sogs mi dgos par gsungs so/ /༄159

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/yang sgrub 'bum las/ dngos grub kyi rnam grangs kyang / me chu nad mtshon mu ge dmag dgra dpal 'dus bsnyen yig tu rgyal po'i chad pa zhes 'byung / dus min 'chi ba ste 'jigs pa brgyad zhi ba/ tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang gzi brjid 'khor dang longs spyod de 'byor ba drug rgyas pa/ rgyal po'i tshul dang rje dpon dang slob dpon dang pha ma'i tshul du gzhan gyis mthong nas mos lugs bzhis dbang du 'du ba/ dgra bgegs skad cig la tshar gcod pa ste las bzhi dang / gzhan yang sa 'og sa steng gi rin po che dang /chos kyi gter la dbang ba dang / rig pa la rtsal dbang thob nas snang ba la dbang bsgyur ba dang / gser 'gyur rtsi dang ri lu mig sman rkang mgyogs mkha' spyod sogs te/ de dag yongs su rdzogs pa'am ma mtha' sna re yan chad la gsungs pas der bshad pa'i lo sgrub kyi dngos grub la yang che chung sna tshogs shig yod par mngon te /sngon du rim pa dang po'i lam ci tsam btang ba'i khyad du sems so//ma grub na spogs chog ni/ dam tshig nyams chag drag tu bshags/bskang ba rgya chen po bya/ bsod nams kyi dpung bskyed/ sngar gyi rten rdzas lag cha thams cad khrus nas dbyung zhing / bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pas rab gnas bya/ brtson 'grus drag pos sgrub pa lan gsum mam bdun du spogs pas 'grub ces phur pa spu gri las 160

phaḥmi〉neshāsta ////pa/ /nyebyeca)sno khrojo (5sdo ༷༷/2sa// /rdo//rdo pa// 14/gsungs la/ sgrub 'bum las lan gsum spogs pa dang / des ma grub na gnad 'bebs bya tshul zhig gsungs so/ /dngos grub len pa'i sngon du glags tshol ba'i bgegs srung phyir dkyil 'khor gyi mthar rta bro rdung zhing skor ba ni sgrub 'bum las lan gnyis su bshad/ zhal gdams rmi lam mar yang bar skabs kun tu las byang ltar rta bro rdung zhing gdul zhes gsungs/sgrub 'bum gyi dngos grub len chog gong 'og kun tu dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i sbyor mtshams nas spros pa'i bde ba chen po'i bdud rtsi dbang skur ba'i bsam rgyud 'ba' zhig gsungs te/ dngos grub kyi snying po bde stong lhan skyes ye shes la bzhed pa yin no/ /dngos grub kyi zhal zas sogs mnyam por bgos te/ cha gcig bla ma la 'dren/ cha gcig rig 'dzin la phud du bzhag gzhan mnyam por bgos te/ yogs tshad du rol pa las mi la mi sbyin pa gal che zhes sgrub 'bum las so/ /lo sgrub zla zhag gi sgrub pa gang byed kyang /sum gnyis bsnyen sgrub dang / gsum cha gcig las sbyor la skyel bar de nyid las so/ /las sbyor skabs spyir ting nge 'dzin gyi rdzong bca' ba dang / drag po'i las kyi g.yul 'gyed pa'i zab gnad mtha' yas kyang /sgrub 'bum gyi tshig gis zin pa rnams las/ dgongs pa gsum ni/161

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/mi ldog pa'i phyir du bdag he ru kar gsal ba/ mi rdugs pa'i phyir du phur pa yakṣa gī la yar gsal ba/ mi 'byams pa'i phyir du ling ga gzas po dngos su gsal ba'o/ /phur pa'i rnam dbye ni/rdzong 'phrang srog gsum gyi dgongs pa tha mi dad pa ni rig pa ye shes kyi phur pa/ bsgral bya las ngan gdul dka' ba'i sems can ngan 'gror ltung ba la mi bzod pa'i brtse ba ni tshad med thugs rje'i phur pa/ rang rang gi phyag g.yas pa'i sor mo lnga la khrag 'thung rigs lnga dang g.yon sor mo lnga la kro dhi rigs lnga bskyed de/de rnams mnyam par sbyor ba'i byang sems las phur pa sras su bskyed la mthu dbang bskur ba ni sbyor mtshams byang sems kyi phur pa/ dgongs pa de lta bus rgyu lcags sam seng ldeng ngam skyer ba las grub pa'i rdzas phur sor mo bcu gnyis pa 'di gtso phur du gsungs pas sor nyer bzhi pa'o/ /lar bcu gnyis pa sogs kyang 'gal ba med pa 'dra/thal sbyar gyis bzung ba ni mtshan ma rdzas kyi phur ba ste bzhi'o/ /byug bdug sogs ni/ gu gul gyi bdug pas gzi byin bskyed/raktas dbang skur/ yungs dkar gyis bskul/ zhes sgrub 'bum du bshad la/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi bka' brgyad gzhung las/gu gul gyi dud pas dbyings nas bzhengs/ nyung dkar gyis bskul/raktas gzi byin skyed/ ces go rim dang byed las mi 'dra tsam 162

sgrub chen zin bris/ pod/ 5bshad/ byed las de dag kun gyi mgor/ mngon spyod kyi phrin las mdzad par/ zhes pa re sbyor rgyu yin pa 'dra/ gru gu yang dbang rta mgrin las/ phur bu padma tī la yar gsal ba la/ yungs dkar gyis brab pas ba spu'i bu ga thams cad khro chung gi go chas gtams pas gzi byin bskyed par dang / gu gul gyis bdugs pas khros 'khrugs rngams pa dang / phur rtser raktas byugs pas gdul bya la thugs rjes chags pas mdangs dang ldan par bsam/ zhes bshad do/ phur skor bya tshul sgrub 'bum gyi don bla ma'i phyag bzhes kyis brgyan pa ni/ oṃ badzra ma hā krodha/ zhes srung phyir klad la lan gsum g.yas su bskor/ padma kro dhi shwa ri/ rang la mi ldog par bya phyir sked la lan gsum phyir la bskor/ badzra tī li tī la ya zhes gzir phyir lan gsum mdun du bsgril/ ma hā yakṣa/ pho rgyud dgug phyir g.yas su tsham rngam lan gsum bya/ kā la rū pa/ lan gsum dril/ karma ram̐ ram̐/ mo rgyud dgug phyir g.yon du tsham rngam lan gsum bya/ dzwa la ram̐/ lan gsum dril/ mā ra ya hūṃḥ gar pad kyis phur dar 'phyar zhing nya bo la gdab ces rig 'dzin pad 'phrin gyis bshad/ thugs sgrub bar chad kun sel las kyang /klad la bskor bas bdag 'khor srung: sked la bskor bas phyir mi ldog: ces sogs 'di dang phyogs 'drar bshad/ de nas tshe 163

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/khrus gnas gsum gyi dgongs pa ni/ gsang rdzogs kyi rgyud dang sgrub 'bum gyi dgongs pa rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling bas gab dkrugs bsal nas bshad pa ltar brjod na/ gzas po'i snying nang na srog gi dngos po khrag gi dwangs ma bye'u len pa'i mgo tsam gyi dbus na che'i rang bzhin 'od kyi a dkar po/ de'i dkyil na rnam shes kyi ngo bo ni ljang gu gcig gsal gdab/ phur pa'i zur gsum gyi rtse la hūṃ gsum dang rtse sgab bam rtse mo dang nye ba'i phyogs zur gsum la phaṭa gsum bkod/ de nyid snying gar bsnun pas a dkar de phur rtse'i hūṃ gsum gyis tsen blangs te rang la phyogs pas khab len la lcags 'du ba ltar rang gi thugs srog la 'ub kyis 'dres nas bdag bkrag mdangs gzi brjid 'bar bar blta ba ni tshe lung / yang kho'i snying ga'i ni yig gi steng du phur ba bsgril bas de nag thum gyis song ste dran pa nyams/ byung tshor gyi sgo 'gags/ nyon mongs pa'i bag chags rtsad nas chod de sku gsum gyi rang bzhin du go 'phos nas phur rtse'i hūṃ yig gsum dang dbyer med du 'dres par blta ba ni khrus lung / de nas phur rtse nam mkha' la deng byas la phaṭa sgra drag po gsum gyis bskul bas hūṃ gsam po de zar gyi phaṭa yig gsam pos me stag yar ba ltar 'og dming rir me rig mimin gyi zhing du spros pas de na bzhugs pa'i bcom ldan 'das kyi 164

sgrub chen zin bris/ pod/ 5thugs ka'i hūṃ la zhugs/ hūṃ de yang bde ba chen po'i rjes chags kyis zhu ste mgrin par 'phags āḥl thim/ a yang zhu ste spyi bo'i oṃ la thim/ oṃ de yang zhu/ dhu ti brgyud/ dga' ba bzhi'i 'gros kyis babs nas yum mkhar rgyal ba'i sras su bskrun par bsam pa ni gnas lung ngo / kha cig de ltar gnas spar zin nas phur gdab byed pa g.yag ro la tshab byed pa 'dra bas mi 'thad zer ba ni/sgrub 'bum sogs las tshe khrus gnas gsum rdzogs rjes su phur gdab rgyas par byed tshul gsungs pa dang dngos 'gal te/gnas spar ba'i rnam shes phung po la phyir ldog tu mi rung bar bya ba'i ched du/ phur pa'i rgyas gdab kyis skye ba'i sgo bcad pa yin pas gnad ma go bar zad de spu gri dang sgrub 'bum las de ltar gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /'di la bag chags kyi rten gzhi bsgral ba zhes kyang 'chad do/ /slob dpon gyis phur gdab dang thun char phab pa'i 'og tu phur pa mched rnams la rim pas bskor te so sor nas 'debs par yang de gnyis las gsungs te/ drag po'i las la dpung tshan bskyed pa yin no/ /de nas liṅga cha gsum du gtubs te/ kha cig tu pho rkang pa g.yas nas dang / mo g.yon nas thog ma byas te bcad gsungs/ stod tshogs tha mar bcug la bstabs/ smad kyis sbyin sreg bya/ de'i thal ba dang mgo bo mnan pa bya zhes kyang de 165

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ nyid las so/ /tshogs thams cad las sbyor gyi bsad pa gnyis las rim gcig tu byed mi byed la 'bri byang gi bzhed pa mi mthun yang / byang pa'i lugs ltar gcig gis 'thus par byed pa nyid gter gzhung de dag la 'grigs shing sgyu 'phrul le'u nyi shu pa las gsungs pa'i drag po'i las sgrub rgyas spros tshe yang / tshogs tha ma zar du mi byed pa nyid dpal ldan zar pa sogs kyi phyag bzhes rig mi ༄༄༄migatsang ma yin no/ /yang sgrub 'bum chen mor/ bdag chos dbyings kyi rig rtsal dpal du shar ba dang gcig: phur pa chos sku'i rab rtsal dgra bgegs kyi gnyen por snang ba dang gnyis:dgra bgegs chos nyid ma rig pa'i ngan rtsal bla med gnas su tshe lung khrus lung gi dgongs pas bsgral: phung po la phyir mi ldog pa'i ched du: gdab: gcod: bstab: bsreg: mnan pa bya ste byang chub pa: de gsum grub mtha' gcig ste: bdag chos sku:phur pa longs sku: gzas pa po rgyal sras sprul sku gsum chos dbyings skye med du gcig pa'o: bdag phur 'ben gsum grub mtha' gcig: ces pa'i don no: zhes gsungs te: bdag phur 'ben gsum sku gsum du gsungs pa ni/ 'dra ba las btags pa ste/ de gsum gyi nang nas sangs rgyas kyi gzugs su phyis grub pa ni gzas po yin pas de sprul sku dang / de sangs rgyas 166

sgrub chen zin bris/ pod/ 5khyo4zhesu sprul byed kyi rtsa ba'i sku ni phur pa yin pas de longs sku/ phur ji/ yang rnal 'byor pas sprul tshul sngar bshad pa ltar yin pas sazhan gnyis ka'i sprul gzhi sngags pa yin pa la dgongs nas de chos skur gsungs pa ste 'gro lugs 'di ni gter phyogs na kun tu rgyu zhis/ yin no/ /zhar byung gtor zlog dus/ zlog pa'i sngon du bas/da pa 'byung ba'i don la dpyad na de gnyis yul tha dad yin byas na ni mi 'grigs par snang bas/ 'di ltar zlog pa'i slar dpyad duru/// sngar yod kyi gnod byed bsad pa dang gsar du 'jug pa dang phyir bzlog pa zhes ba༅/da rgyur mngon/ skabs su spyir me dang sa g.yo sogs sems med kyi sa/nod pa'ang zlog pa 'byung mod/ zlog rgyu gtso bo ni ma rungs nga/'i sems can yin te/ mngon spyod kyi yul gcig dgos pa'i phyir te/ las 'di mngon spyod kyi rtsa ba'i gzer kha yin pas so/ /srung bas ma nges pa min te sla/ de ltar na bsad pa'i las kyis kho'i mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul gyi khro phur bcag nas gzod phyir zlog gi bskrad pa byas na shin tu sla ba yin no/ /gdab kha byas pas kho'i srog ma 'gag kyang mthu dpal gzi brjid kyi brling cha bcom nas rang dbang dang 'bral du 'jug pa yang 'thad de/ tshe 'das la gnas lung byas pas yul de ngan song du skyes zin 'pho ma nus kyang / sdug bsngal rtse zhil ba sogs la phan par bshad pa bzhin 167

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/no/ /dkyus la 'jug ste/ sbyin sreg skabs/ las gzhung bsrang ste tshogs mchod kyi rjes la/ slob dpon bzhis dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs bzhir bya ba'am/ yang na rang kho nas res mos byas te las bzhi'i sreg blugs 'bul ba'ang rung zhes sgrub 'bum las so//thab kyi dbus su me lha dang sreg lha gnyis po dbyer med du dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i rnam par bsgom nas sreg blugs kyi rim pa gcig gis mnyes par byed pa yin par paṇa chen chos kyi rgyal po mang 'a ris pas bshad de/ sgrub 'bum chen mo la/ me lha dang yongs rdzogs lha rnams gnyis su med par gsal ba'i thugs kar: me nyid ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i bskyed la0 zhes gsangs pa'i (5 ra༄ dgongs pa'o/ /rgyun gyi me mchod la ni za byed rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sbyin sreg dang / rnal 'byor ma'i mar me'i sbyin sreg gi rigs pa sbyar ro/ /de'ang me lha dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i rnam par byas pa la mchod pa ni gsar ma'i dkyil chog mang por phyogs skyong gi gtor chog skabs phyogs skyong bco lnga rdo rje 'chang gi gzugs su sgom par gsungs pa'i rigs pas kyang bsam du yod la/ de dkyil 'khor ba dang dbyer med du bltas nas mchod pas ni sgrub dkyil lha rnams me lha la zhugs nas sreka blugs bzhes par 'gyur te/ dbang gi dus su sangs rgyas thams 168

sgrub chen zin bris/ pod/ 5lgezhe cad slob dpon gyi lus la zhugs nas mchod pa len par gsungs pa bzhin no/ /sgyu 'phrul las/ zhal du gyur pa'i me bos la/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sbyin sreg gis dngos grub sgrub pa'i zab gnad ni me lha lha'i zhal du ste lha tshim pa'i sgor byed pa'i cho ga la thug par rig pa mchog las bshad cing / sgrub sde'i skor na me lha zur du mi skyed pa'i phyogs mang po yod pas de la man ngag 'di sal che'o/ /de ltar sbyin sreg grub ma thag bro'i las rim bya/ de nas sreg rdzas kyi lhag ma rnams gtor mar stsal te lhag chog bya zhes sgrub 'bum du gsungs pa sgyu 'phrul pa dang yang mthun/ yang de nyid las/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi thal ba chu la gshegs te/ chu de 'thung ba'i sems can gyi sgrib pa sbyong ngo / /rgyas pa'i mdzod phugs su gdab ste/ longs spyod rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /dbang gi rdzing ngam khron par blug ste/ lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du 'du'o/ /drag po'i ni mnan nam rlung la skur te/ gnod byed brlag par byed do zhes bshad/ rjes mtha' rgyas skabs/ sa sbyin la rin chen lnga bdar ba las grub pa'i bum pa so btang ba'i nang du/ dar sna dang / 'bru sman rin chen/ snying po lnga/ sgrub gtor cha gsum du byas pa'i phud cha gcig rnams bstsal te/ 'bras bu can gyi shing bi kha rgyan dang mgul chings gsol/ lha'i rigs kyi kha dog tu 169

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bsgyur te/ rdo rje las pas gser gyi 'jor dang / dngul gyi phro pa thogs la/ dkyil 'khor 'og tu khung bu brus te sa'i lha mo'i mkha' dbyings kha phye bar bsams la/ sgrub pa po rnams gos rgyan gsar pa bgo/ lag g.yon du bum pa thogs/ g.yas pas me tog 'thor bzhin dkyil 'khor bskor la smon lam btab ste sba/rigs kyi phyag mtshan gter gyi steng du bris pas rgyas gdab/ des ni dngos grub brtan par 'gyur bas tshe 'dir tshe ring zhing /longs spyod 'phel/ sa bdag gzhi bdag gi ko long sogs zhi nas/ gnas dang yul phyogs kyang bkra shis par 'gyur/ dngos grub gter du sbas pa'i rten 'brel gyis tshe phyi ma la mi zad pa'i gter gyi bdag por 'gyur zhing / gzhan yang dngos grub mang po'i gter kha dang ma 'bad bzhin du phrad par 'gyur te/ 'di ni sgrub 'bum la bltas nas zhib mor bris yod do/ /phan yon de ltar 'ong ba ni sa'i lha mo'i bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnam thar gyi mthu yin te/ me lhas sngags kyi 'bras bu myar du 'byin pa bzhin ༄no/ /sgrub pa rdzogs nas gnas srung ba ni/ sgrub 'bum las 'di ltar bshad de/ zhag gsum du las gzhung lan re bsrang ste gtor ma gtor thag ring por mi 'gro/ gnas su dme yuṭa mdze sprang mi 170

82)rtse ////pa/ /bye/shā'u/sdo dzodre 'u)// ༷༷sde/2sa// cardo//spre pa// 14/btang / de nas sgrub pa'i yo byad lhag ma rnams cha gsum du bgos te/ gcig bla ma la dbul/ gcig rgyal thebs sogs la dbal/ gcig tshar ston byas te dge slong bzhi sde bya/ bon rtsis ༄ sman bzo bzhi sde bya/ rgyal rje blon 'bangs sprang po bzhi sde bya/byis pa'i ston mo sog sa kyang bya'o/ /gzhan yang rig 'dzin gong mas gnas der gsung rab nyan bshad klog gsum sogs rnam dkar dang 'brel ba'i dga' ston ci tsam byas pa de tsam du dge legs kyi 'byor pa rlabs che ba 'byung zhes bshad do/ /sgrub 'bum chen mo'i dngos gzhi'i sa bcad nyer gsum par gsang rdzogs rang gi rgyud la dgongs nas/ le'u dgu pa nas/ gdul bya blo rigs tha dad pa: sku gsum thugs yon phrin las kyi: bye brag sgrub la mos na yang : 'di yi bsnyen sgrub skabs dang sbyor : bde bar gshegs pa rang rgyud med: gang ltar mos pa de ltar 'grub:ces pas/ spyir gsang sngags bsnyen sgrub 'di zhi khro bka' brgyad thams cad kyi khog skyed byed ma lta bu yin phyir: sngon rjes chog khrigs 'di bzhin la: 'dod lha'i mtshan dang rdzas bcas gar dgos su bcug ste: bar 'dir rang rang gi sgrub gzhung : zhi khro: yang dag: phur pa: bdud rtsi: ma mo: padma: thugs rje chen po: phyag rdor: gang byed 'di'i sgo nas bton pas khyad 171

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/trapar mchog tu 'gyur ro: zhes gsungs shing / sngags rnying ma'i sgrub chen gyi phyag bzhes thams cad kyi rtsa ba'i khungs su mthong nas de rtsa bar bzung / bde 'dus bsnyen sgrub kyi phra khrid sogs gzhan la'ang bltas nas bris pa o rgyan mkhan po'i sngags brgyud byed na mkho nges pa can du yod do/ /las kyi phreng ba las/ dus kyi nyul ma dang / tshogs kyi skos nyul ba dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi drod nyul ba dang / ti ra'i gnas 'phrogs pa dang / dur khrod gnas nyul ba dang / mchod pa'i phud nyul ba ste nyul le drug dang / dus kyi dkyil 'khor dang /tshogs kyi dang / gsal bkra'i sogs dkyil 'khor drug bshad do//sgyu 'phrul lam rim las/ sngar bshad dang mi 'dra ba'i nyul le dang / bar chad kyi rtags kyi rnam grangs du ma zhig bshad cing /dngos grub kyi rtags su/ sku rtags su dam can sprin ltar 'thibs shing 'ong ba/ gsung rtags su bdud rtsi rang khol ba/ thugs rtags su mar me 'bar yun ring zhing 'od gsal ba nang du thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs pa'i rtags sam ltas phyi rol du dal gyi mar me la shar ba zhes pa ste des 'gres/ zhes bshad cing / dam can 'khor ba'i rtags su/ yid dga'/ ting 'dzin gsal ba 'byung bar bshad/ gsung rtags bdud rtsi la 'bab pa ni/ bdud rtsi de smra lces myang bya yin pa'i 172

sgrub chen zin bris/ pod/ 5traphyir ro zhes kyang gsungs/ bris sku bzhad pa/ sgrub rdzas zhag tu 'khyil ba/ mar me rang 'bar ba zhes gzhan du gsungs pa'ang sku gsung thugs kyi rtags so sor sbyor rgyu yin pa 'dra/ tshogs sgrub kyi lam gyi snying po ni 'dod yon lam khyer gyi thabs rgyas pa rnams te/ 'di ni dpal gsang ba'i snying po dang / de'i lam rim rtsa 'grel du/ gos rgyan bza' btung glu dang tshig /bro gar tshogs kyi sprin phung la/ /sogs las rgya cher shes dgos te/ gzhan sgrub pa'i tshogs sgrub kyi las rim yang sgrub sde'i lugs dang mthun tshabs che ba zhig snang ngo / /de nyid snang chen las/ ji ltar padma dmar po chu las skyes kyang chu'i nyes pa'i skyon gyis gos par mi 'gyur ba'i rang bzhin yin pa de bzhin du mi dmigs pa'i thugs rje chen po'i chags pas byang chub sems dpa' rnams 'khor bar skyes kyang 'khor ba'i gzung ba dang 'dzin pa'i rnam par rtog pas go/sa par mi 'gyur ba'i phyir/ 'dod pas mi chags zhes gsungs so/ /zhes dang / chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i gzugs brnyan dang mtshungs pa'o zhes nges par bzung nas/ mi dmigs pa'i thugs rje chen pos de bzhin gshegs pa dang /sems can gyi khams thams cad la chags pa'i padma chen po las padma'i rigs kyi gzugs su sprul nas byed pa'o/ /zhes bshad de/— 173

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la chags pa'i don ni/ sangs rgyas thams cad padma'i rigs kyi rnam par shin tu mnyam par bzhag pa'i sbyor bas mngon du byas pa'o/ /dpal mchog 'grel chen las kyang ji ltar padma 'dam gyi nang na dmar du zin kyang chu'i nyes pas mi gos so/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' bag chags dang bcas pa'i nyon mongs pa dang bral ba rnams ni/'khor ba'i 'dam gyi nang du skyes shing thugs rje chen po'i chags pas chags su zin kyang / 'khor ba'i nyes pas gos par mi 'gyur ro/ /de ltar chos rnams bsgom na ni/ zhes bya ba ni ji ltar yongs su dag pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni thugs rje chen po'i chags pas chags kyang 'dod chags la sogs pa'i 'khor ba'i chu'i nyes pa las nges par grol ba yin no/ /de bzhin du las dang po pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis chos thams cad ngo bo nyid kyis dag pa'o zhes bsgom zhing / yang dang yang du mngon sum du byed la/ snying rje chen po'i chags pas chags na blo ldan zhes bya ba shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa shes pa dang ldan pa'o / /nyon mongs pa can du gyur kyang zhes bya ba ni 'khor ba'i nyon mongs can dang nye ba'i nyon mongs pa la sogs pa dang ldan du zin kyang ngo / /nyon mongs kun las rnam grol nas/ /myur du byang 174
