sgrub chen zin bris/ pod/ 5trashitratrakhuchub ma/chog thob 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba ni nyon mongs pa thams cad las rnam par grol ba'i sgom pa'i rang bzhin gyi shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rtogs pas myur ba nyid du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas shing / sangs rgyas nyid mthong bar 'gyur ba'o/ /ting 'dzin 'di la gzigs pas zhes bya ba ni mngon sum du byed pas so//nge bzhin gshegs pa thams cad ni rnam par snang mdzad la sogs ji/ ste1/ de bsgom pa dang ldan pa'i sems dang sems las byung ba ni dbang phyug nyid du 'thob par 'gyur zhing rtogs par 'gyur ba ste/ bzung ba dang 'dzin pa'i rnam par rtog pa dang bral bas rang dbang du spyod par mdzad pa'i phyir/ de nas bcom ldan 'das spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug ces mtshan btags so zhes bya ba ni rang dbang du gyur pa thugs su chud pa des de'i rjes su 'gro ba'i don las bcom ldan 'das spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug ces mtshan btags pa'o/ /de nas brtsams te zhes bya ba ni bsgom pa'i dus nas nye bar bzung nas so/ /bdag nyid kyi dngos po thams cad shin tu yongs su dag pa zhes bya ba ni sku dang kasung dang thugs rdo rje rnam par dag pa de thugs su chud pa dang / rjes su mthun pa'i lus dang ngag dang yid yongs su thob pas so/ /dus ji srid gcig gis bdag nyid kyi dngos po thams cad yongs 175

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/su dag par 'gyur zhe na/ byang chub kyi snying po'i bar du zhes bya ba gsungs te/ ji srid bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon sum du ma byas pa de'i bar du/ de de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs thob pa la gegs su gyar pa'i sgrib pa dang ldan par mi 'gyar ba'o/ /myar du 'tshang rgya ra spyor 47 de'i char ra:ra 4sgo ra zi —5ba nyad ba par 'gyur ta zhas bya ba na ga bar zad da/ /zhas gsungs/ padma dmar po'i de nyid 'di dag trīḥyig dmar po'i de nyid du yang 'gro ste/ de nyid bsdus pa dang dpal mchog las de de'i sngags don dang de nyid du gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /padma'i snying po ni padma'i sa bon gyi tshogs kyis gang bas sa bon gyi mdzod do/ /'dir padma ni lha thugs rje chen po/ snying po ni sher phyin dang de'i yi ge trīḥ de las padma'i rigs mtha' yas pa spro ba ni/ snying po de sa bon gyi mdzod du 'gyur lugs so snyam de dpyad dgos/yang de nyid snang ba'i 'gro 'dul gyi dum bu'i 'grel par/ mdo sde zab mo rgya che ba'i/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa smos te/ de la zab pa ni chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa zhes bstan pa'i phyir ro/ /rgya che ba ni nam mkha'i khams khyab pa'i gzugs du ma ston pa'i phyir ro/ /mdor bstan pas na mdo sde ste/ de'i don mdor bstan pa brjod pa'i stobs kyis sems la nges pa bskyed 176

phuḥmi /////pa// /bye/shā(tre// /sdijo (1// //dro/lhaspros// /rdo//2ཿཿ// 14/pa'o/ /zab pa yang yin la rgya che ba yang de yin pas na mdo sde ste/mdo sde zab cing rgya che ba'o/ /de dag gi rgyud 'bum pa la sogs pa rgya cher bstan pa de las mdor bsdus nas brjod cing rab tu ston pa/ zhes gsungs te/ padma'i rigs kyi chos kyi yi ge rnams zab rgyas kyi mdo sder bsngags tshal yin no/ /de'i steng nas de ༄nyid bsdus pa'i trīḥbashad la nges pa drangs shing / mi tra dzo ki'i yig drug gi bshad pa dang bsgrigs nas yig drug gsung rab thams cad bsdus pa'i mdo sde yin lugs kyang shes par bya'o/ /yang de nyid las/ byang chub kyi sems kyi yi ge hūṃ dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i yi ge hrīḥrnam par bsams te/ zhes so/ /dhīḥyig ni ha dang ra dang i gsum 'dus pa'i bdag nyid kyi yi ge thig les brgyan pa ste/ ye shes thig le'i dka' 'grel du/ 'dab ma gnyis pa'i bzhi pa'o/ /zhes bya ba ni yi ge ha'o/ /de'i 'og tu me'o zhes pa ni ra dang ldan pa'o/ /dbyangs yig ces pa ni ā'i bdag nyid sbyar ba'o/ /rigs pa'i rgyal mo mchog ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po yi ge trīḥ'o/ /thig le steng du ldan pa ni trīḥyi don no/ /de rang dang nye ba ni trīḥste gnyis pa'o/ /zhes rig sngags kyi rgyal mo yi ge gcig ma'i sngags btu tshul gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de'ang g.yung drung 'khyil ba gsum gyi zhal 177

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gdams las/ trīḥni thig le gsum du bzhugs/ /i ni rlung gi thig le ste/ /ha ni byang chub thig le'o/ /rakta'i yi ge ra yig ste/ /zhes pa ltar/ srog 'dzin shin tu phra ba'i rlung dang / khams dkar dmar ro/ /tsheg drag gnyis kyis dhu tir byang sems dkar dmar gyi 'du 'phrod mtshon gsungs so/ /mdor na khu rdul rlung gsum bde stong du ro gcig 'dres pa'o/ /tsheg drag thig le yin pas bde ba la bshad kyang rung ngam dpyad/ gzhan yang trīḥyig gis po/zhi la khams dkar dmar gyi dbus su rlung sems zhugs pa dang / sgrub pa po'i lus ngag yid gosum/ rtsa thig rlung gsum sogs sbyang gzhi dang / rdo rje gsum gyi rnal 'byor sogs sbyong byed kyi lam dang / sbyang 'bras sku gsung thugs rdo rje gsum sogs mtshon tshul mang du spros kyang chog ces tho'u bkwan pas so/ /dper na myu gu'i cha shas thams cad rdzogs par skyed pa'i nus pa dang ldan pa'i chos zhig la myu gu'i sa bon zhes 'dogs pa ltar/rta mchog rol pa'i go 'phang skyed pa'i nus pa thams cad trīḥyig la tshang bas sa bon gyi yi ger bzhag par 'chad do/ /'di las sngags skabs/ byer gtub sogs bod skad 'dres pas sngags su mi 'thad do zhes na/ dpal ldan lha mo'i sngags bhyo bdun mar yang / kha la ra ka chen mo zhes yod pa sogs bshad nas/ mdor 178

〉〈'e tsharaḥji ////spro// /bye/shāthebasdo dzoXni()sdo //sde/lhas// :rdo//2ཿཿ// :dza/na sngags gsung ba po dang byin gyis rlob pa pos skad gang dang gang du byin gyis brlabs pa de kho na dbang btsan par bya dgos kyi/thams cad saṃ skri ta'i skad kho na dang mthun dgos pa'i nges pa med pas 'di 'dra la sgra pas spyod mi nus shing dpyad pas skyon du song ba'ang mang ngo zhes kyang tho'u bkwan pas so/ /sgra bzang po smra ba rnams kyi zhen pa dgag pa dang / sgra ngan pa smra ba rnams la thugs brtse nas de dag gi skad byin gyis brlabs pa'ang yod dam snya ma/ bod kyi 'byung po rnams kyi skad phar la rang gshed du bskor ched de dag gi skad du gnyan po'i drag sngags byin gyis rlabs par bshad lugs kyang yod dam ste/ lha btsun byang chub 'od kyi gter kha bu pra ming sring gi sngags zhang zhung gi skad du mdzad pa la rin bzang dgyes pa'i lo rgyus bzhin no/ /oṃ dang hūṃ phaṭa rnams kyi don rnal 'byor rgyud las gsungs pa ni/ rdo rje rtse mo las/ oṃ ni ci zhig yin par bshad/ /mchog dang nor ster dpal dang g.yang / /skal bzang rnam pa dang ldan zhing //dam bca' ba dang bkra shis don/ /nor bu 'dzin pa'i snying po yin/ /zhes pa ltar oṃ yig ni mchog ster ba sogs kyi ched yin no/ /hūṃ ni nges tshig gi tshul gyis u phyis nas han ti 'joms par byed pa ste/ thugs rje chen po'i thabs kyis sdug bsngal ba dang ma 179

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/trarungs pa thams cad 'joms par byed pa'i don te/ rtse mor/ yi ge hūṃ ni ci yin brjod/ /sdug bsngal 'chos shing 'joms par byed//srid pa'i zhags pa gcod byed cing / /gdugs pa dngangs shing gsod byed pa'i/ /hūṃ ni mchog tu dran par bya/ /zhes so/ /phaṭa ni gdug pa can dang sdug bsngal 'joms shing bde ba 'gugs par byed pa ste/ rtse mor/ yi ge phaṭa ni ci yin brjod/ /gdug/ dang sdug bsngal 'joms byed cing / /bde ba dag ni 'gugs par byed/ /phaṭa ni 'joms byed sgra yin te/ /grogs dang bcas pas 'joms par byed/ /ces te 'di la lo chen rin bzang gi 'gyur du/ nyon mongs gdug pa ltung byed cing / /zhi ba 'gugs pa yin par bshad/ /phaṭa ces bya ba ltung ba'i dgra/ /ngan 'gro'i 'gro ba ltung ba'o/ /zhes gdug pa can 'joms shing zhi ba 'gugs la ngan 'gro'i 'gro ba pa gnas nas 'pho bar byed pa ste/ khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi dkyil chog tu phaṭa ces bya ba ngan 'gro'i 'gro ba 'pho bar byed pa'o/ /zhes so/ /yang tshe sngags sogs las 'byung ba'i swā hā ni/ rtse mo las/ swā hā zhes pa ci yin brjod/ /sdig pa thams cad zhi byed cing / /dge ba tshogs ni 'phel bar byed/ /nyes par byed pa 'phrog byed cing / /sdug bsngal thams cad 'joms pa'i mchog /ces gsung ste/ de lta bu'i sgo nas 180

(2〉phang〉mdzojis par ///tshong/ /nyebyecan/ /je can/ ༷dro//sa// carngosardorngan/ 14/dbugs 'byin pa'o/ /kun rig ṭika chen bzhin bris so/ /gu ru zhi ba'i rgyu'i sa bon dang thugs srog la hūṃ du byed pa sogs kyang yod mod/ hrīḥyig la mdzad pa 'di ni khyad par 'phags te/ trīḥsher phyin padma'i rigs kyi sa bon du bsngags pa thugs rje chen po'i zin tho ltar dang / sha 'ug gter byon gar dbang tshe sgrub kyi lo rgyus las/ rgya gar mkhas pa padma 'byung nas nga: gdul bya'i mos ngor ji snyed sprul pa'i gar: chu zla'i rol par bsam mi khyab ston te: ngo bo mi 'gyur kun bzang snang mtha' yas: rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag spyi mes yin: de phyir nga bsgrub sangs rgyas kun bsgrub 'gyur: lha gzhan bsgrub kyang nga nyid bsgrub pa ste: bzang ngan phyogs ris 'di zhes dbye ba med:'on kyang sngon gyi smon lam khya da par gyis: padma'i rigs su bsgrub na dngos grub myur: phrin las mtha' rgyas gzhan snang dbang du sdud: 'gal rkyen mi 'byung byang chub go 'phang nye:zhes gsungs pas gu ru'i rgyu ma nor ba rtsa ba'i sngags su padma'i rigs kyi rtsa ba'i yi ge nyid ches 'thad pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang 'di'i gtso bo 'od gsal rdo rjer gsangs pa ni/ rigs re re'ang ༄rigs drug ka'i bdag nyid dang / ye shes re re'ang ye shes drug ka'i ngo bo nyid yin pa/ phreng ba las rigs re re'ang lnga lnga'i rang 181

21rngad/ spre/ therdo sdispyings 'o/:drob/thag byaspurngasno rngakubastazug rta):re tha/sdosakhung khurasdo/zug/ tsham〈mi4bzhin du bshad pa lta bu ste/ de las 'dir padma'i rigs la rigs drug tu phye ba'i rigs thams cad bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbang du mdzad pa'o/ /hrīḥyig gi bshad pa gzhan yang tshe sgrub ye shes 'od mchog las/ bzhi pa bsnyen pa srog gi bzlas pa ni:thugs kar hrīḥgasal hrī:yig mang du bzlas: de bzhin gsheg/sa/ pa kun gyi srog yin no: ha ni rlung yin longs sku kun gyi sngag/sa :de nyid bzlas na rlung sems gnyis med grol: ra ni sprul sku smin byed de yin te: de bzlas drod kyi ye shes skye bar 'gyur: a ni skye med chos kyi sku yin te: i ni don dam ngo bo nyid dang ldan:rtogs shing bzlas pas bde stong mchog tu 'gyur: des na bange gshegs yongs 'dus sngags 'di bsnyen: hrīḥzhes rlung sems thams cad gtum mo'i dbyings su zhugs pa las bde stong lha na skyes kyi ye shes 'char zhing / de las rdo rje gsum mam sku gsum dbyer med go 'phang la sbyor ba'i rdo rje'i lam gnad ches rmad du byung ba bstan no/ /thags rje chen po'i brda yi don ni/ bshad 'grel chen mor/ ༄ zhal gcig ni sems can la thugs rje mi 'gyur ba/ zhes snying rje ngo gnyis pa dang / ngo mi rtag pa spangs pa/ sgrub thabs gcig skor du ni/ zhal gcig ni lhan skyes ye shes rang dang gnyis su 182

raḥ〉snangaḥ〉 ////spro/ /nyebye(5sdo /ji (5sdo /sdigalhas// 1rngo//rdo pa// 14/med pa'i brda/ zhes so/ /'dzum mdangs ldan pa ni sems can la byams par mdzad pa/ spyan mi zum pa ni sems can la thugs rjes gzigs pa/ phyag bzhi ni/ tshad med rnam pa bzhi ldan pas/ /'gro don phyogs med mdzad pa'i rtags/ /zhes so/ /yang gnyis med chos sku'i phyag gnyis thal mo sbyar/ /longs sku shes rab padma g.yon na 'dzin/ /sprul sku thabs kyi bgrang phreng g.yas na 'dzin/ /zhes dang / zhal bcu gcig pa'i thad du/ rtsa ba chos sku'i phyag gnyis thal mo sbyar/ /yan lag longs sku'i phyag gi dang po ni/ /skyon gyi ma gos padma dkar po 'dzin/ /nying lag sprul sku'i phyag gi dang po na/ /'khor ba'i sems can 'dren pa'i bgrang phreng 'dzin/ /zhes te/ phyi ma gnyis ni/ ma tig gi phreng ba snying rje rgyun chad med ༄pas sems can 'khor ba nas byang chub tu 'dren pa'o/ /padma ni/'khor bar sems can gyi don mdzad kyang 'khor ba'i nyon mongs pa dang rnam rtog gi skyon gyis ma gos pa'o/ /zhes so/ /phyag bzhi sku gsum dang sbyar bar ma zad/ phyag mtshan de ltar sbyar ba'ang snang ste/ thugs sgrub bar chad kun sel las/ dang po'i phyag gnyis stong nyid phyag rgya mdzad: g.yas 'og shel phreng grags stong sngags sgra sgrogs: g.yon 'og pad dkar sgyu 'phrul sprul pa 'gyed: ces rdo rje gsum gyi bshad pa mdzad de/ snga ma dang bsre 183

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/khyorgyu min pa 'dra/ tshul khrims bzang po'i lugs las/ zhal chos sku thig le gcig tu 'khyil/ /spyan thabs shes snying rjes zim bur gzigs/ /phyag tshad med bzhi ldan 'jam zhing mnyen/ /zhes so/ /sku mdog dkar po ni/ chos sku dri ma med pa'i brda/ /zhes dang /dkar 'tsher zhes pa/ chos kyi dbyings rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa la 'khor ba'i rtog 'dzin gyis ma gos pa/ /zhes so/ / zhabs mnyam skyil ni/ dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med pa'i don la thugs mnyam pa nyid las mi g.yo bar bzhugs pa/ zhes dang / zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i skyil krung bzhugs/ /mnyam gzhag don la ma g.yos rtags/ /zhes te/ zhabs gnyis chos dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med pa'i brda/ zhes dang / 'gro ba'i don la thabs shes zung 'jug gis mnyam par bzhugs pa/ zhes kyang ngo / /rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa ni/'dod pa'i yon tan thams cad la spyod kyang / zhen med du sems can gyi don dang tshul bstun pa'i brda/ zhes dang / 'dod yon ma spangs par chos nyid rol pa'i rgyan du shar ba/ zhes te/dgos 'dod phun tshogs 'byung ba'i rtags su'ang bshad do / /nam mkha'i rgyal po'i sgrub thabs su/ ri dwags kyi pags pa ni snying rje chen po dang ma bral ba/ dar gyi sham thabs ni chos kyi ngo 184

sgrub chen zin bris/ pod/ 5khyotsha dang ldan pa/ zhes so/ /bar chad kun sel du/ sdug bsngal gdung sel dar gyi stod g.yogs dang : nyon mongs dri mas ma gos sham thabs gsol: dgos 'dod re skong rin chen rgyan gyis spras: snying rje'i ri dwags lpags pa phrag na 'chang: zhes so/ /nyi zla padma'i gdan la bzhugs pa ni/ thugs rje sems can la nyi zla ltar snyom sa pa dang / 'khor ba'i skyon gyis mi gos pa'i brda 'o/ /yum gsang ye ni/ gzung 'dzin gyi dri ma bral bas dkar gsal/'gro ba la rjes su chags pas dmar mdangs 'tsher ba/ phyag mtshan la/ thugs rgyud bde stong gi ros myos shing gang bas thod chang / ye shes des srid zhi thams cad skul zhing dbang du sdud pas ḍā ru ste bde stong sher byin gyi rang sgras sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad g.yo/sangs rgyas thams cad skul/ 'gro ba'i gnas thams cad skyod/ sems can rnams gti mug gi gnyid las slong / ye shes dang phrin las kyi khyad dam/ yang na/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul nas bde chen gyi ye shes 'bebs pas ḍā ru/ ye shes kyi btung ba'i rgyun de zad mi shes par 'chang bas na thod chang ste/ pad snod na gnas pa dang /myos par byed pa gnyis char bde ba chen po dang mthun no/ /dzab dbyangs nyer gcig ni mkha' 'gro gsang skor du bstan par zad kyi// 'gro 'dul yid bzhin nor bu'i gzhung dkyus su bstan pa ni/185

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/trabazla tshul drug ste/ phyi mdo sde ltar gzhan don du bzlas pa/ nang gsang sngags ltar bsnyen sgrub tu bzlas pa/ gsang ba mkha' 'gro mas byin rlabs brda'i tshul du bzlas pa/ bla ma dang lha la gsol ba gdab pa ma la bus 'bod kyi tshul du bzlas pa/ sgrib sbyong chos spyod kyi tshul du bzlas pa/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa mnyam gzhag bsam gtan gyi tshul du bzlas pa'o/ /de rnams la dzab dgongs drugasngags don 'chad tshul drug dbyangs kyi 'dren stangs drug sogs yod de bshad 'grel chen mo las shes par bya'o/ /dpung bzang gis zhus pa'i le'u bcu pa las/ spyan ras gzigs kyis gsang sngags bye ba phrag /gsum dang de bzhin 'bum phrag lnga rnams bshad/ /de yi rig sngags bdag po rta mgrin dang / /de yi ming can dkyil 'khor dam pa gsungs/ /bcu gnyis phyag dang phyag drug pa dang ni/ /thor tshugs cod pan 'dod pa 'byor byed dang / /zhal bzhi don yod zhags par bdun bstan 'di/ /sa steng gsang sngags nyi ma bdun ltar 'bar/ /de rnams rta mgrin dkyil 'khor gsang sngags te/ /mi la mchod sbyin 'jig rten gsum gyis 'dud/ /sgrol ma dkar mo gos dkar spyan ma dang / /rnam gzigs ral pa gcig ma dkar sham dang / /grags ldan khro gnyer can dang 'di dag rnams/ /padma'i rigs kyi 186

sgrub chen zin bris/ pod/ 5khunyenarigs sngags rgyal mo mchog /de dag dkyil 'khor sna tshogs gzugs can dang / /phyag rgya rnam pa sna tshogs rnams dang ldan/ /zhes bshad do/ /rgyud de'i brjed byang las/ de'i rigs sngags bdag po rta mgrin dang / /zhes bya ba ni padma'i rigs kyi gsang sngags thams cad kyi rgyal po yin pa'i don to/ /de yi ming can dkyil 'khor/ zhes bya ba ni dpal rta mgrin padma'i rigs kyi rig pa'i rgyal po yin pas/ dpal sdom gyi rgyud la sogs pa las rab tu gnas pa'i dkyil 'khor 'byung ngo cog la de'i ming can zhes gdags te/ 'phags pa rta mgrin nyid kyi khyad par gyi dkyil 'khor 'ba' zhig la gdags pa ni ma yin no/ /don yod zhags pa bdun bstan pa/ /zhes bya ba ni bshad ma thag pa'i don yod pa'i zhags pa drug dang dpal rta mgrin dang bdun no/ /nyi ma bdun ltar 'bar/ zhes bya ba'i dpes ni sgrub pa po'i las dang nyon mongs pa thams cad bsreg cing mngon par mtho ba'i dpal yang 'bar bar byed pa'i don to/ /de rnams rta mgrin dkyil 'khor gsang sngags te zhes bya ba ni rig pa'i rgyal po yin pas/de dag gi dkyil 'khor la yang dbang bsgyur bar bstan to/ /mi la mchog sbyin zhes bya ba ni dam pa brgyad la sogs pa ster ba'i don to/ /'jig rten gsum gyis 'dud ces bya ba ni lha'i rigs 187

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dang mi'i rigs dang / klu'i rigs rnams kyi mchod gnas su gyur ces bya ba'i tha tshig go/ /sgrol ma zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni padma'i rigs kyi yum brgyad yod par ston pa'o/ /de dag dkyil 'khor zhes bya ba ni yum de rnams kyi dkyil 'khor zhes bya ba'i tha tshig go/ /sna tshogs gzugs can zhes bya ba ni dkyil 'khor gyi tshul tha dad pa dang / 'khor sna mang bar bstan to/ /phyag rgya rnam pa sna tshogs rnams dang ldan/ /zhes bya ba ni las kyi bye brag gis lha re re la yang phyag rgya du ma dang bcas pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes so/ /de la dam pa brgyad ni dpung bzang nyid las/ bcud kyi len dang gter dang phug 'gro dang / /nor bsgyur 'byung khungs sngags dang gser 'gyur rtsi/ /rin thang med pa'i rin chen nor sbyin te/ /brgyad po bstan pa yongs su bsgrags pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'o/ /de bzhin du/ spyod rgyud rnam snang mngon byang / yo ga de nyid bsdus pa/ bla med gsang ba 'dus pa sogs rgyud sde bzhi ka las khro bo'i dbang po 'di ches mang du bshad de ma bkod do/ /'od dang 'od zer zhes pa/ lus las byung ba 'od/ sems las byung ba 'od zer zhes pa'am/ bem po las byung ba 'od/ ye shes las byung ba 'od zer zhes ka ma dhe nus bshad de/ 'od dang 'od zer spangs nas ni/ /nyi ma lta bar mi nus bzhin/ /zhes 188

blongabasta /////spro/ /bye/mi/tre// /jiX /tre/sdu //dro/lhaspros// /rdo//2ཿཿ// /ji /sogs kyis dpyad rgyu yod/ /gser sbyangs pa'i kha dog lta bu ni gsal ba/ de la nyi ma phog pa'i kha dog lta ba ni 'tsher ba ste/ de ༄ bzhin du rang nyid gsal zhing gzhan du mi 'phro ba 'od/ gzhan snang bar byed pa 'od zer zhes byas na'ang rung ngam/ 'od dang 'od zer gyis zlas phye ba'i 'od dang / spyir 'od ces 'byung ba'ang mi gcig gam snyam/ yang ka ma dhe nus/ gsang ba'i snying po zhes bya ba ni/ gsang bar bya ba'i snying po yin pas na gsang ba'i snying po ste/ ji srid du kha cig gis gsang sngags rnams 'grub pa'i rgyu ni gsang ba yin zhes bshad pa lta bu'o/ /zhes so/ /yang / skrag na de ma thag tu gsod/ /ces bya ba ni 'jigs par mi bya ste/ 'phags pa de kho na nyid bsdus pa las kyang / 'jigs pa/'i lhag pa'i bgegs gzhan med/ /ces gsungs la/ rdo rje 'jigs byed las kyang / de la 'jigs pa chen por 'byung bar 'gyur te/ sngags pas de la 'jigs par mi bya'o/ /ji ltar 'a jigs pa de ltar bgegs kyi bar chad du 'gyur ro/ /ba ra chad du gyur na dngos grub med de/ de'i phyir sngags pas 'jigs par mi bya'o zhes gsungs so/ /gal te 'jigs pa na hūṃ hūṃ zhes 'brug ltar sgrogs shing / rang gi lha'i rnal 'byor dran pas zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes kyang dpal rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs/ zhes so/ 189

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gzhan gyis byas pa la gzhan spyod pa'i rnam grangs yod tshul thad/padma kha phye ba dang / lcags g.yo ba dang / shing thal bar 'gro ba sogs rang stobs min gyi/ nyi ma dang khab len dang / me'i gzhan stobs yin pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos dang zang zing gi longs spyod sangs rgyas kyi zhing la rang cag gis spyod pa'ang rang gi las kho na'i mthu min gyi/ sangs rgyas kyi bsngo smon dang bsdu dngos bzhi'i gzhan stobs gtso ba sogs te/ 'di 'dra la dgongs nas/ chos kun tha dad rjes su 'jug /chos kun phan tshun rjes su 'jug /chos kun rjes su zhugs pa ste/ /mtha' bral rjes su 'gro ba'o/ /zhes bshad par ka ma dhe nus so/ /'dis sngon las rkyang par ma zad 'phral rkyen yang mthu che bar shes te las mi zad pa yang 'phral rkyen stobs bzhi dang phrad na 'joms 'gro ba dang / las kyi rnam smin las thob pa'i lus kyang 'phral rkyen pha mas ma gsos na mi 'tsho ba lta bu'o/ /de'ang rang rang gi chos nyid ji lta ba bzhin du gzhan gyis byas pa gzhan la 'byor ba yin gyi/gzhan du ma yin te/ khab len gyi mthu'i khyad par lcags kyis thob kyi/ zangs la sogs pas mi thob pa bzhin no/ /gsang sngags kyi bdag nyid che ba dang / rdo rje slob dpon gyis thabs mkhas pa'i che bas tshe 'das sdig can go 'phang bzang po la mig 190

sgrub chen zin bris/ pod/ 5trasgomathara'aphrul bzhin myur bar bgrod nas/ gtsug tor dri med du/ kye ma sangs rgyas/ kye ma chos/ kye ma dge 'dun/ kye ma rigs sngags/'bras bu 'phral du ston pa/ zhes sogs dang / sbyong rgyud du/kasang sngags lta bu'i 'dren pa med/ /ces sogs gsungs pa'ang de kho na bzhin yin par ka ma dhe nus so/ /dpal bde mchog tu/mtshan dang 'gro ba dang gzugs sogs gzhan du sgyur bar bshad pa'ang / sems can de dag gi sngon gyi las kyis thob pa'i rnam smin gyi phung po yang / 'phral rkyen rnal 'byor pa'i rig sngags kyis bsgyur ba'o// //oṃ swā sti/ padma'i chos gter rin chen sgrom phye ste/ /dus mthar chos kyis phongs pa'i 'gro ba la/ /zab lam gdams pa'i dga' sto na 'gyed mdzad pa/ /dpal ldan bla ma bskal brgyar zhabs brtan shog /tshar gcod rjes 'dzin phrin las rab 'byams kyis/ /snyigs ma'i 'gro 'dul bka' gter bstan pa skyong / /rnga yab gling pa'i dgongs pa skong mdzad pa/ /bdud 'joms sprul pa'i gter ston zhabs brtan shog /dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i dbang phyug he ru ka /padma 'byung gnas mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas kyi/ /rdo rje gsung mchog grub pa'i bdud rtsi yis/ /rig 'dzin sku tshe'i ljon bzang rgyas smin shog/ //chung don ngor bstan pa'i nyi mas gsol ba 191
sa med bstan nyi'i ba

pod/ 5zhespre/ /thub dbang gnas brtan 'khor bcas mchod pa'i cho ga 'phags pa dgyes pa'i rol mo zhes bya ba bzhugs so//thub dbang gnas brtan 'khor bcas mchod pa'i cho ga 'phags pa dgyes pa'i rol mo zhes bya ba/ dpal shākya seṅge la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thub dbang gnas brtan 'khor bcas la phyag mchod 'bul bar 'dod pas/ thog mar gong du rten gsum ci 'byor ba bshams pa'i mdun du stegs bu'i khar mchod pa sna tshogs gtsang zhing gya nom par bkod/ spos kyi dri zhim pos bdug gso sbyong la gnas par byas te/ bde ba'i stan la 'dug nas/ skyabs sems sngon du gtong / de nas/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin gyi rlabs dang tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' thang chen po dang / chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i stobs kyis/deng 'dir khor yug gi sa gzhi 'di dag bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag med kyi zhing gi bkod pa'i yon tan ltar phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa mdzes shing yid du 'ong bar gyur pa'i gzhi/ gzhal med khang rin po che sna bdun mchog tu 'bar ba bkod pa legs pas mdzes shing lhun stug pa/ yangs 193

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/shing rgya che ba/ steng gi shar lhor khrus kyi chol zang dang bcas pa/de'i lte bar rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i khri seng ge chen po brgyad kyis btegs pa'i steng du pad zla'i gdan/ mthar bskor kun tu seng khri pad zla'i gdan grangs med pa dang / phyi nang kun tu yang cha rigs dang 'tsham par lha dang mi'i yo byad dam pa zhal zas dang / na bza' dang / rol mo la sogs pa phul du phyin pa sna tshogs pa/ phung po gsum pa'i mdo dang / bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin rgya mtsho thams cad kyis rgyas par gang zhing rgyan klubs pa dang ldan pa 'byung bar gyur cigamachod pa'i sprin gzungs lan bdun sogs bzla zhing byin gyis brlab/ de nas spos btul te/ thal mo sbyar la/ ston pa bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang rkang par ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skye bu 'dul bas kha lo sgyur ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po 'phags pa nyan thos kyi dge 'dun chen po bcu drug sogs slob ma dul ba mtha' yas pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa deng 'dir bdag cag la sogs pa 'gro ba mang po'i bsod nams kyi zhing du spyan 'dren cing mchis na/ston pas bdag cag la thugs brtse ba nye bar bzhag ste yon tan 194

ra〉50nazhe tha/cadalhas/ thabachenacad zugaḥdzatshod ཿdzathan/ ྅rngosasprerwa// sgo tshad med pa bkod pa'i pho brang gi gnas 'dir gdan 'dzom pa chen po mdzad de byin gyis brlab par ci gnang / ji ltar sngon de bzhin gshegs pa nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas te 'jig rten rnams la thugs brtse ba dang / lha dang mi rnams kyi don dang /grub pa dang bde ba bla na med par bya ba'i phyir grong khyer rgyu bar mdzad de/ ston pa dul ba 'khor dul ba dang ldan pa/ zla ba skar ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/ brgya byin lha'i 'khor gyis bskor ba lta bu/ tshangs pa tshangs ris kyi 'khor gyis bskor ba lta bu/ khya /rdo/khro ༷/ sgo 1)/sne // gle riring ma ga cang sa ltar dbang rnams na tu dul ba/ spyod lam dang spyod pa ma 'khrugs pa/ chu gter ltar ting nge ba/ sprin chu dang bcas pa lta bu/ glang po'i rgyal po ltar dregs pa dang bral ba/dzam bu chu bo'i gser gyi mchod sdong ltar dpal gyis lhang nge lhan ne lham mer 'phags pa/ nyi ma stong bas lhag pa'i 'od dang ldan pa/ rin po che'i ri bo 'gro ba ltar kun tu bzang ba/ kun shes ko'u di n+ya la sogs pa nyan thos chen po dang / gzhan yang dge slong gi dge 'dun mang pos bskor te sangs rgyas kyi spyod lam mthong na mi mthun pa med pas skye rgu rnams la bsod nams kyi zhing nye bar bsgrubs pa de bzhin du deng 'dir bdag cag la sogs pa skye bo mang po la phan pa dang bde ba'i phyir skyabs mdzad 195

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/pa dang / bsod nams nye bar bsgrub pa'i slad du de bzhin gshegs pa dang 'phags pa'i gnas brtan rnams bstan pa la mngon par dga' ba'i lha'i 'khor bsod nams chen po rnams dang thabs gcig pho brang gi gnas 'dir gshegs shing gdan 'dzom pa chen po mdzad de byin gyis rlob par ci gnang / sposarol cher bya/ bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs/ /bdag cag bsod nams skal bar ldan/ /bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nas kyang / /'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ /padma ka ma la ye stu ma/ de nas khrus bum sogs khrus kyi yo byad sta gon du byas te 'dul ba nas gsungs pa'i khrus stegs gsal btab la/ khrus kyi 'bab stegs shin tu dri zhim pa/ /glang po'i rmig mthil lta bar zlum pa'i zhabs/ /ka dam me tog 'dra ba'i ༄snying po can/ /lha mi dga' ba skyed byed 'dun sa der/ /sangs rgyas mi mchog slob ma'i tshogs su bcas/ /dge mtshan shis pa'i zhabs pad nyer bkod de/ /'dag chal rdul khams 'dren pa'i zhabs bsil chus/ /nye reg khrus kyi cho ga rnam par bstar/ /ji ltar bde gshegs bltams pa tsam nyid nas/ /lha dbang klu rgyal rnams kyis khrus gsol ltar/ /deng 'dir lha yi chu ni dag pa yis//ston mchog slob mar bcas la sku khrus gsol/ /dri zhim spos chus gang ba'i bum pa dang / /glu gar rol mo'i bye brag rnam mang sogs//196

gnas brtan mchod chog/ pod/ 5tra zhephul byung mchod pa'i yo byad sna tshogs pas/ /thub dbang gnas brtan rnams la sku khrus gsol/ /rgyal ba'i sku la sgrib pa mi mnga' yang / /bdag gzhan sgo/ gsum nyes tshogs sbyang ba'i phyir/ / gtsang ma chab kyi khrus gsol 'di bgyis pas/ /skyon med rnam dag sku mchog thob pa shog /me long la ras kyis dbyi zhing / reg 'jam lha rdzas dar gyi phreng ba dang / /gtsang zhing ngad ldan ka shi'i ras bzang gis/ /dril phyis mchod pa'i ri mo 'di byas pas/ /'phags pa dgyes pa'i tshul khrims rnam dag shog /na bza' phul la/dri med mtshan la sgrib gsal mi mnga' yang / /dad pas ngur smrig rgyal mtshan phul ba yis/ /nam mkha'i mtha' klas gyur pa'i sems can rnams/ /sangs rgyas brtul zhugs mchog la spyod par shog /de nas/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir/ /nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni/ /ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyid na/ /de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol/ /phyag mchod dang po la spyi bye brag gnyis las/ dang po ni/ thabs mkhas thugs rjes shākya'i rigs su 'khrungs/ /gzhan gyi mi thub bdud kyi dpung 'joms pa/ /gser gyi lhun po lta bur brjid pa'i sku/ /shākya'i rgyal po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thub pas bka' bsgos bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ /yan lag 'byung dang ma pham nags na gnas/ /dus ldan rdo rje mo'i bu bzang po 197

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dang / /gser be'u ba ra dhwa dza gser can mchog /'phags pa ba ku la dang sgra gcan 'dzin/ /lam phran bha ra dhwa dza bsod snyoms len/ /lam bstan klu'i sde sped byed mi phyed pa/ /dge bsnyen dar hamā ta dang rgyal chen bzhi/ /'khor dang bcas pa'i zhabs kyi padmo la/ /phyag 'tshal skyabs mchi snying nas gsol ba 'debs/ /gnyisapa la gtso bo dang 'khor gyi phyag mchod gnyis las/ dang po ni/ langs te phyag 'tshal ba'am thal mo sbyar ba btud de/ ston pa bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa/ rig pa gsum shin tu brnyes pa/ bslab pa gsum la legs par bslabs pa/ dul ba'i gnas gsum gyi gzhi la mkhas pa/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhis spyod pa'i gzhi la gnas pa/ bsdu ba'i dngos po la yun ring po nas sbyang sa pa mdzad pa/ mi 'jigs pa bzhis bsnyengs pa mi mnga' ba/ yan lag lnga spangs pa/ 'gro ba lnga las yang dag par 'das pa/ yan lag drug dang ldan pa/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs pa/ rtag tu gnas pa drug gis gnas pa/ byang chub kyi yan lag bdun gyi me tog gis phyug pa/lam gyi yan lag brgyad ston pa/ mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu la mkhas pa/ phyogs bcur snyan pa yang dag par rgyas pa/ mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po/ shākya'i khyu mchog shākya 198

dzaḥji43〉 ཿsa/can//sa/ /spro/2rta/'u she :spro//tsābyeḥbasdu the:khro:sgo// 1rngosasprerwa// 25/seng ge/ shākya thub pa/ 'jig rten gyi bla ma/ stobs bcu mnga' ba'i zhabs kyi padmo la rnam par btud de phyag 'tshal lo mchod do skyabs su mchi'o/ /cinusakyi mthar/ ston pa bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i spyan sngar mchod pa'i rdzas sna tshogs kyi sprin rab 'byam/sa/ mandha ra ba dang puṇḍa ri ka la sogs pa'i me tog lhan cig skyes pa dang sbyar ba las byung ba'i bdug spos/ mun pa'i khams mtha' dag rnam par sel ba'i mar me/ sman dang dri'i byugs pa sna tshogs/ lha'i zhal zas bza' bca' btung ba'i khyad par ro mchog brgya ldan/ rol mo sil snya na gyi sgra dbyangs snyan nga/ra 'byung ba la sogs pa/ bden pa dang mos pa'i stobs kyis chos kyi dbyings kyi mtha' klas pa kun nas khyab pa'i mchod sprin tshad med par sprul te mchod do/ /gsol lo/ /rim gror bgyi'o/ /gang yang bdag cag rnams thog ma med pa'i srid pa nas 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang / gti mug la sogs pas sems zil gyis non te/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas sdig pa mi dge ba'i las ji snyed cig byas shing bsags pa de dag thams cad mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa rnams kyi spyan sngar gnong zhing 'gyod pas mthol lo bshags so/ /phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi 'phags pa dang so so'i skye bo'i rgyud du gtogs pa/ mtho ris kyi lam dang 199

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/zheldan pa rnams dang / nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi lam dang ldan pa rnams dang / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu 'gro ba'i lam dang ldan pa yang rung ste/ dge ba'i rtsa ba gang dag ji snyed pa de dag thams cad kyi rjes su phrag dog med pa'i sems kyis yi rang bar bgyi'o/ /sangs rgyas 'jig rten gyi sgron ma gang dag 'tsho zhing gzhes pa de dag gi spyan sngar gdul bar bya ba'i sems can gyi khams thams cad smin pa dang grol bar byed pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bla na med pa bskor ba dang / mya ngan las mi 'da' bar yun ring du bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs so/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis mtshon te rang gzhan rnams kyis dus ga sum du bsags shing gsog par 'gyur ba'i bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po mtha' dag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngo bar bgyi'o/ /zhes yan lag bdun pa phul mthar gsol ba gdab pa ni/ deng 'dir thub dbang gan sa brtan 'khor bcas gdan 'dzoms pa'i spyan sngar/ ston pa bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i mtshan nas brjod cing yid la byas pa dang phyag mchod phul ba la brten nas/ bdag cag la sogs pa'i sems can sgrib pa dang sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin sna tshogs pas gzir zhing gdungs pa thams cad bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi bar du 200

gnas brtan mchod chog/ pod/ 5tratra bde ba dam pa'i mchog la reg par gnas par gyur cig phyi dang nang gi mi mthun pa'i tshogs gang zhig gdon dang rims dang dug gi 'jigs pa dang / mya ngan dang yid mi bde ba la sogs pa lus kyi gnod pa dang / sems kyi gdung ba sna tshogs pa thams cad zhi bar gyur cig tshe rabs thams cad du ngan 'gro log par ltung ba'i skye gnas kyi khams thams cad du mi 'pho zhing bde ba nas bde ba bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten du skye bar gyur cigaskye zhing skye ba'i phreng ba kun tu yon tan rin po che'i 'byung gnas bshe sa ga nyen dam pa tshul bzhin du bsten te sangs rgyas 'byung ba mnyes par byed nus par gyur cig 'khor ba'i phun tshogs kyi 'byor pa mtha' dag snying po med pa chu shing gi so nam ltar shes te srid pa thams cad la mi lta ba'i thar 'dod rgyun chad med par gyur cig chos 'dul ba tshangs par spyod pa'i yon tan rin po che ba zhi yi bdag nyid can yongs su thos nas dus gsum gyi 'phags pa dgra bcom pa rnams kyi rjes su slob par shog cig mtha' yas pa'i sems can gyi khams rgya mtsho srid pa'i gcong rong zab mo las bsgral ba dang / byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams yongs su rdzogs par bgyi ba'i slad du bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi sems yid la bya ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig rgyal ba'i sras kyi spyod 201

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/tharapa'i sgo rgya mtsho yongs su bsdus pa pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi brtul zhugs las nam yang mi nyams par gyur cig phan bde'i 'byung gnas rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cigaston pa'i bstan pa la bya ba rgya chen po mdzad pa'i smon lam gyi mthu grub pa sde snod 'dzin pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa rnams kyang zhabs pad bskal pa rgya mtshor brtan cing bstan pa 'dzin pa'i phrin las kyi go skabs yangs par gyur cig bstan 'dzin dge 'dun gyi sde rnams kyang tshul khrims dang lta ba mchog la gnas shing / klog pa thos bsam dang 'phags pa'i mi smra ba la gnas pa rnam par dag pas thub bstan lung rtogs kyi bdag nyid 'jig rten na yun ring du skyong ba ra gyu ra cig lha dang mir bcas pa'i skye rgu'i 'jig rten thams cad legs lam dge ba bcu'i brtul zhugs mchog la gnas shing / gnas skabs phan pa dang mthar thug bla na ma mchis pa'i ye shes kyi go 'phang rin po che myur du thob par gyur cig gnyis pa 'khor rnams la phyag mchod 'bul ba ni/'phags pa rnam par grol ba'i ye shes kyi sa mthor gshegs te/khams gsum pa'i yul las shin tu 'das pa/ len pa med par sems zag pa rnams dang bral ba tsandan sbang ba lta bur bsil ba 202

gnas brtan mchod chog/ pod/ 5trakhyethob pa/ zad pa dang mi skye ba shes pa'i ye shes snang ba mngon du gyur cing / ston pa bcom ldan 'das shākya'i rgyal po'i spyan sngar slad ma'i dus su bde bar gshegs pa'i chos kyi mdzod dam pa 'jig rten na yongs su skyong bar 'phags pa'i tshig nges pa'i zhal gyis bzhes pa/ gnas brtan yan lag 'byung slob ma dul ba'i tshogs 'phags pa nyan thos kyi dge 'dun chen po chig stong sum brgya dang bcas pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ci rigs kyi mthar/'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po yan lag 'byung gi spyan sngar so kya/sa/ yan lag bdun pa dang / deng 'dir thub dbang gnas brtan 'khor bcas gdan 'dzom pa'i spyan sngar/ 'phags pa yan lag 'byung ba'i mtshan nas brjod cing sogs gsol ba 'debs pa sngar bzhin bya/sa/zhan rnams la'ang de'i 'gres kyi kha bsgyur/ dmigs bsal du yan lag 'byung zhes pa'i mal der/ ma pham pa nags na gnas dus ldan rdo rje mo'i bu bzang po gser be'u gser can mchog ba ku la sgra gcan 'dzin lam phran bstan bsod snyoms len lam chen pa klu'i sde sbed byed mi phyed pa zhes bsgyur/ chig stong sum brgya 'is pa'i tshab tu/ / chig brgya stong bzhi brgya chig stong chig brgya stong drug brgya chig stong stong nyis brgya 203

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ lnga brgya bdun brgya dgu brgya stong chig brgya chig stong dgu brgya stong nyis brgya stong bzhi brgya chig stong zhes bsgyur ba ma gtogs thams cad 'dra/ de nas/ gnas brtan chen po rnams kha na ma tho ba med pa'i sri zhus mchod de dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa dge bsnyen dharmā ta mngon par shes pa dang rdzu 'phrul gyi rnam par rol pas kun tu rtsen pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod do skyabs su mchi'o/ /ci 'grub mthar/ dngos bshams gzungs rig sogs kyi yan lag bdun pa 'bul/dge bsnyen dharmā ta'i mtshan nas brjod cing phyag mchod phul ba la brten nas bdag cag la sogs pa'i sems can thams cad tshe rabs kun tu dge ba'i chos rnams kyis rnam par 'phel ba dang /bdud dang mu stegs lta ba ngan pa'i phyogs thams cad kyis mi phyed pa thob par gyur cig phan bde'i rtsa lag thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas pa dang bstan 'dzin chen po rnams zhabs pad bskal pa rgya mtshor brtan par gyur cig phyogs dus kun tu bde skyid rdzogs ldan gyi bskal pa chen pos mtha' yas pa'i skye rgu rnams la phan pa dang bde ba'i dga' ston rgyun mi chad par gyur cig de nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa dang gnas brtan chen po rnams kha na ma tho ba med pa'i sri zhus mchod de dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa/ dkar phyogs skyong ba'i 204

raḥmi ཿsa/(5sdolhas/ /pa/shetocan/ ྅rngo/the:droḥbashe the:khroḥ/// :sdosasprepa// spre/rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung dang / 'phags skyes po dang /mig mi bzang dang / rnam thos sras la sogs pa lha'i dge bsnyen chen po rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod do skyabs su mchi'o/ /sogs ci rigs mthar/ dngos bshams gzungs rig sogs yan lag bdun pa dang / dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha chen po rnams kyi mtshan nas brjod cing sogs/ gsol 'debs bya tshul dharma ta'i skabs bzhin no/ /de nas mjug maṇḍal tshom bu so bdun ma phul te/ kha bsgyur/ ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid thub dbang gnas brtan 'khor bcas gdan 'dzom pa chen por gyur pa'i spyan sngar rtse gcig gus pa'i yid kyis 'bul bar bgyi'o/ /zhes pa tsam min pa spyi nas 'byung ba ltar bya zhing / sngar bshad pa'i/ thabs mkhas thugs rje sogs kyi phyag mchod dang / dngos bshams gzungs rig mos stobs kyis sprul pa'i/ /mchod tshogs kun 'bul sdig ltung thams cad bshags/dge la yi rang bskul zhing gsol ba 'debs/ /'dis mtshon dge ba byang chub chen po bsngo/ /zhes yan lag bdun pa phul/ mthar/ bcom ldan gdan 'dzom chen po dgongs su gsol/ /thub dbang gnas brtan 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams kyi/ /mtshan mchog thos dang dran brjod phyag mchod mthus/ /bdag cag la sogs sems can gang dang gang / / gnas skabs mthar thag mi mthan phyogs kun zhi/ /bde skyid chos ༄ ༄ldan dpal 'byor rab tu 'phel/ /theg mchog dge ba'i bshes 205

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/kyis rjes bzung nas/ /gsung gi bdud rtsis 'tsho bar byin gyis rlobs/ /tshul khrims dag cing thos bsam sgom par ldan/ /nges/ par 'byung dang byang chub sems gnyis 'byongs/ /rtag tu gzhan phan spyod las mi g.yel bas/ /rnam mkhyen go 'phang thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /rgyal bstan dri med phyogs bcur dar zhing rgyas//bstan 'dzin mchog rnams zhabs pad bskal brgyar brtan/ /'jig rten bde legs chen pos khyab pa dang / /don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i bkra shis 465/ /zhes gsol 'debs bya/ de nas/ ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dge slong gi dge 'dun dang bcas pa rnams gdan 'dzom pa chen por gyur pa'i spyan sngar/bdag cag la sogs pa 'gro ba mang po'i don du skyabs mdzad par bskul zhing gsol ba btab pa'i skabs 'dir/ bdag cag dus ngan pa'i sems can bag med pa dang nyon mongs pa mang ba'i dbang gis cho ga'i sbyor ba ma tshang ba dang / gtsang sbra ma thon pa dang nyes spyod kyi dri mas sbags par gyur pa gang lags pa de dag thams cad mgon po thugs rje dang ldan pa rnams kyi spyan sngar mthol zhing bshags par mchi na/ snyigs ma'i dus kyi sems can rang bzhin ngan pa/ cho ga nyams pa dang / rnam par ma dul ba'i ngang tshul can lags pas/ ci nas thugs brtse bar dgongs te 206

gnas brtan mchod chog/ pod/ 5zhetshangs pa mchog stsol zhing bzod par mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod nas/ gshegs su gsol ba ni/ ston pa thugs rje chen po dang ldan pas bdag cag la sogs pa 'gro ba mang po'i don mdzad pa lags kyis slar yang sangs rgyas kyi zhing gzhan dang gzhan pa rnams su gdul bya'i 'gro ba gzhan dang gzhan gdul ba'i dbang gi phyir gzugs sku'i rnam par rol pa tshad med pas gshegs shing / da dung yang bdag cag thugs rje chen po'i spyan ras kyis rtag tu btsa' bar ci sanang / 'phags pa nyan thos kyi gnas brtan chen po rnams kyang 'jig rten la thugs brtse bas snyigs dus kyi mthar yang 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir dam pa'i chos skyong ba'i phyir ljongs nas ljongs rgyu 'ing / shas cher gang du bzhugs pa'i ri'i rgyal po gangs can dang / bya rgod phung po dang kha che'i rgyud la sogs pa rnams su slan chad kyang phyogs 'dir yang dang yang du gdan 'dzom mdzad par dgongs shing 'byon par ci gnang / oṃ khyed kyis sems can sogs rol mo bya zhing / mjug tu bsngo smon dang / bkra shis rgya cher bya'o/ /de'ang cho ga rgyas par spro na dngos bstan ltar dang / de las bsdu na ston pa la phyag mchod yan lag lhag ma rnams gsol 'debs dang bcas pa'i mthar gnas brtan rnams kyi phyag mchod brjod de/ mthar/ 'phags pa'i tshogs de dag gi zhes kha bsgyur te yan 'a ga lhag ma rnams dang gsol 'debs bcu drug po tshar gcig gis 'grub par bya zhing /207

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/zhegasol 'debs kyi tshe/ 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po rnams kyi mtshan brjod cing zhes bsgyur/ shin tu bsdu na ston pa dang gnas brtan rnams kyi phyag mchod so sor phul nas yan lag lhag ma rnams dang gsol 'debs lan cig gis 'thus shing dharmā ta dang rgyal chen rnams la phyag mchod kyi mthar/ dngos bshams gzungs rig dang/ dge bsnyen dharmā ta dang dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha chen po rnams kyi zhes bsgyur nas gsol 'debs stabs gcig tu byas pas 'grub bo/ /zhar byung gzungs bum bsgrub na mjug gi gtang rag mchod bstod mgor/ thub dbang gnas brtan rnams kyi sku las 'od zer bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du babs pas bum pa yongs su gang bar gyur/ ces brjod nas/ mu ne'i gzungs ci rigs bzla'o/ /cho ga 'di'i spyan 'dren skabs dharmā ta dang rgyal chen rnams kyi spyan 'dren dngos su mi 'byung ba ni/ gtso bo thub dbang dang / gnas brtan bcas spyan drangs na gzhan ni de dang lhan cig tu 'byon zhing byin gyis rlob par sngon dam bcas pa'i phyir mi dgos pa yin no/ /'o na ston pa spyan drangs pas chog gis/ gzhan mi dgos par rig pa mtshungs so zhe na/ mi mtshungs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor byang sems kho nas bskor ba la phyag mchod 'bul ba'i skabs gzhan yang yod pas/ 'dir 'khor gyi gtso bo gang dang lhan cig tu 'dren pa'i dmigs byed dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /blun po dag na re/ gnas brtan bcu drug theg chen pa yin nam min/ yin na khyod kyis da lta byang sems kho nas bskor ba zhes pa'i tshig las gnas brtan 'di rnams byang sems min par shugs kyis bstan pa dang 'gal zhing / min na de dag la gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshe rgyal sras kyi spyod pa mi nyams par gsol ba 'debs tshul de mi 'thad de/ 'debs yul nyid rgyal sras min pa'i phyir ro zhe na/ 'di rnams byang 'phags yin par sngon gyi dam pa dag gsungs mod/208

gnas brtan mchod chog/ pod/ 5dku sal te min du zin kyang skyon phyi ma dag gtan med de/ yod na byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis sangs rgyas nyan thos dang bcas pa la mchod pa 'bul pa'i tshe yang nyan thos kyi dge 'dun mchod pa'i bsod nams rdzogs byang gi rgyur bsngo mi rung bar 'gyur te/'dir yang phyag mchod phul ba la brten nas zhes sogs rigs pa shin tu mtshungs pa'i phyir dang / gzhan brjod bya mang du yod la/ gnas brtan 'di rnams byang 'phags yin du chug kyang / skyon snga ma med de/ de ni yongs su grags pa dang / snang tshul ji ltar bstan tshul nas yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar na de dag gis cho ga yongs su rdzogs te/tshul 'di ltar 'bad pas ni sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rgyas shing / dge 'dun gyi sde 'phel ba dang / rgyal khams thams cad bde zhing skyid pa dang / tshe ring ba dang /tshul khrims rnam par dag pa sogs phan yon zad mi shes pa yod do/ zhes pa'ang mdo smad rdo rong gi sprang 'khyams/ 'jigs med bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan du 'bod pas rang lo nyi shu pa shing sprel hor zla dgu pa'i yar ngos kyi gral tshes brgyad la babs pa zla ba gro bzhin gyi dga' ma dang lhan cig rtse ba'i 'grub sbyor bzang po'i nyin bris pa 'dis kyang rgyal bstan yon tan rin po che'i rtsa lag 'jig rten na yun du gnas pa'i rgyur gyur cig sarba dā maṅga lam// //209

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/khu〉༄/ /'phags pa phung po gsum pa'i mdo sbre bklag chog tu bkod pa bsod nams yid bzhin rin po che'i sprin zhes bya ba bzhugs so//sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyaka 'tshal lo/ /gang gis rmad byung rgyal sras spyod pa'i gtam/ /bskal pa bye ba brgyar yang rnyed dka' ba/ /'gro la thugs rje'i dbang gis ston mdzad pa/ /mnyam med bla ma mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di na thub pa'i sde snod rin po che/ /mtshan tsam thos kyang chos spyod rnam pa bcu'i/ /bgyi ba phra mo tsam yang mi nus pa'i//ngur smig rgyal mtshan can de shin tu smad/ /de slad de dang de 'dra'i don phyir dang / /bdag nyid theg chen chos la dad pa'i blo//mi nyams slad nas slad mar 'phel bya'i phyir/ /bsod nams bdud rtsi'i sgo mo 'di dbye'o/ /'dir phung po gsum pa'i mdo sde rnam par bsdu ba byas te/ klog bde bar 'god pa la/ ji skad du/byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sa las bshad pa/ byang chub sems dpa' myur du bla na med pa'i byang chub tu 'tshang rgya ba'i 210

phung po gsum chog/ pod/ 5ra〉thabs la mkhas pa'i sgo gsum ste/ gsum gang zhe na/ sdig pa ba shags pa dang / bsod nams la yi rang ba dang / de bzhin sashegs pa bskul ba'o/ /zhes bstan cing / 'phags pa zhi ba lha sa bslab btus su'ang de ltar gsungs pas na/ mkhas pa legs pa 'dod pa rnams ni ci nas kyang tshul 'di la nan tan snying por mdzad par rigs so zhes byis pa bdag kyang thal mo sbyar te gsol lags so/ /de la cho ga 'di sgrub pa'i thog mar gnas khang phyag dar bya zhing / spos dang bzang po drug gi chus chag chag gdab/ bdug spos sbyar/ gtsang zhing bkod pa legs pa'i stegs bu dar gyi steng khebs can gyi khar mchod yon dang / me tog la sogs pa mchod pa'i tshogs shin tu gya nom pa bstar zhing / gdugs dang /rgya' ma/tshan la sogs pa khang bzang gi rgyan bkod pa mdzes par byas nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa la dad pa dang / sems can thams cad la snying brtse ba nye bar bzhag ste/stan ran pa zhig blangs la pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la phab ste/ gos tshag legs par bcos la/ dul zhing dbang po'i sgo bsdams pas mi cor ba dang / mi rgod pa dang /mi g.yeng ba dang / des pa dang / brtan pa dang / mthong na dga' ba'i spyod lam rnam par dag pas gnas nas/ dran pa mngon du bzhag la cho ga'i tshul phun sum tshogs pa 'di brtsam par bya'o/ /de la 'dir sngon du gnas yo byin gyis rlob pa dang / tshogs zhing spyan drangs pa ni mi dgos te/ chos kyi dbyings kyi mtha' klas pa'i rnam 'dren sras dang bcas pa la dmigs pa nyid dang / kun tu bzang po'i smon lam gyi khyad par gyis mchod pa yang dag par sgrub pa nyid du 'du zhing rnam par dag pa'i phyir ro/ /de'i phyir thog mar/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub 211

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/sems dpa' gzigs pa rab rib med cing ye shes chags pa mi mnga' ba de dag deng 'dir bdag gi mchod pa'i tshogs sbyar ba 'di dag bzhes shing byin gyis rlob pa dang / bdag byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa'i dkyil 'khor la rab tu gzhag pa dang / thams cad mkho pa nyid kyi tshogs yongs su bsdu ba'i slad du gzigs shing maphyo pas dgongs su gsol/bdag 'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ye shes chen pos legs par thags su chud ///ri sa bca pa blo mnga' ba/ sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam pa nyid brnyes pa/ chos kyi sku gnyis su med pa la rten cing gnas pa/nam mkha'i dkyil yul du gyur cing thug pa med pa'i ye shes mnga' ba/ chos kyi dbyings thams cad du rab tu zhugs pa'i sku dang ldan pa/ chos kyi cod pan chags pa med pa mchog dam pa dri ma med pas bcings pa/ so so yang dag par rig pa chen po rjes su bsgrags pas shin tu rnam par phye ba'i dbyangs dang ldan pa/bsod nams mi zad pa'i mdzod kyis ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor yangs shing 'od gsal ba/ nyon mongs pa med pa'i chos thugs su/ chud pas mi rten par gnas pa/ chos kyi dbyings thams cad du shin tu rnam par grol ba'i ye shes kyi sku dang ldan pa/ bskal pa bye 212

phung po gsum chog/ pod/ 5tra ba dpag tu med par yon tan gyi chos yongs su brjod kyang mi zad cing thug pa med pa'i yon tan gyi bsngags pa bstan pa'i khyad par brnyes pa de dag la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sems can thams cad snyed kyis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams las de bzhin gshegs pa re re'i tshul khrims kyi yon tan bsngags pa phun sum tshogs pa las brtsams te/ bskal pa mtha' yas par bsngags pa brjod kyang de bzhin gshegs pa de'i tshul khrims kyi yon tan bsngags pa yang mi 'dzad cing de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gi spobs pa so so yang dag par rig pa la yang thug pa ma mchis te/ de ltar gzhan yang ting nge 'dzin dang /shes rab dang / rnam par grol ba dang / rnam par grol ba'i ye shes mthong ba dang / stobs dang / mi 'jigs pa la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi chos dpag tu ma mchis pa de dag la mos pa'i mchog gis mos so/ /gtso bo dang / dam pa dang / khyad par du 'phags pa dang / rab dang / phul dang / gya nom pa dang / bla ma dang / bla na ma mchis pa dang / mnyam pa ma mchis pa dang /mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa dang / mtshungs pa ma mchis pa dang /snang ba ma mchis pa dang / bdag nyid chen po dang / zil gyis mi non pa dang / yon tan gyi chos thams cad sdud pa dang / yang 213

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ tradag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis bka' stsal ba'i mos pas/ lhag par mos so/ /mos nas kyang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag la phu dud bya ba dang / phyag bya ba dang / sems can thams cad g.yas phyogs kyi lam la gnas par bya ba'i slad du du/sa/ mo g.yas pa sa la phab ste phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can gang das lam yon po la gnas pa de dag 'phags pa'i lam la gnas par bya ba'i slad du pus mo g.yon pa sa la phab ste phyag 'tshal lo/ sems can thams cad bdud dang phyir rgol ba mtha' dag laru rnam par rgyal zhing byang chub kyi snying po la 'dug nas thams cad mkhyen pa yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i slad du lag pa g.yas pa sa la phab ste phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can gang dag byis pa'i chos 'a gnas te/ yon po'i lam la 'dzin cing gdul bar dka' ba de dag bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhis shin tu sdud pa'i slad du lag pa g.yon pa sa la phab ste phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can thams cad nga rgyal ma mchis pas bla ma rnams la rim gro bgyi ba rnyed cing spyi gtsug bltar mi mthong ba dang / dge ba'i chos thams cad 'phags par bya ba'i slad du gdong dang dpral ba sa la phab ste phyag 'tshal lo/ /de ltar bdag yan lag lngas phyag 'tshal ba 'dis sems can thams cad kyi sgrib pa rnam pa lnga sel bar gyur 214

phung po gsum chog/ pod/ 5tra cig dbang po lnga yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yongs su shes par gyur cig mngon par shes pa nyams pa med pa lnga thob par gyur cig mig lnga yongs su dag par gyur cig sems can 'gro ba lngar skyes pa rnams srid pa'i rgyun las ldog par gyur cig rnam par grol ba'i phung po lnga khyad par du 'phags pa thob par gyur cig gzhan yang bdag gis byams pa'i lus kyi las dang / byams pa'i ngag gi las dang /byams pa'i yid kyi las ye shes sngon du 'gro ba dang / kun tu bzang ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi rgyan gyi lus kyi las dang / ngag gi las dang / yid kyi las kyis bcom ldan 'das de dag la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bstod do/ /bkur ro/ /bsngags so/ /rab tu bsngags so/ /'dud do/ /rab tu 'dud do/ /phyag bgyi'o/ /gzhol lo/ /blta'o/ /brtag go/ /zhes brjod cing spro na phyag 'tshal ba dang sbrags te ci nus su bskyar/ de nas/ dmigs pa dpag tu ma mchis pa dang ldan pa'i me tog dang / spos dang / phreng ba dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / chos gos dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / mar me dang / bkod pa dang / lhab lhub dang / mchod rten rtsig pa dang / sku gzugs bgyi ba dang / rin po che dang / rgyan dang / bzhon pa dang / 'chag dang / gtsug 215

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dku lag khang dang / yo byad thams cad bkod pa rnam par dag pa rgya chen po 'di dag gis kyang de bzhin gshegs pa de dag la bsti bstang du bgyi'o/ /btsun par bgyi'o/ /ri mor bgyi'o/ /mchod do/ /gsol lo/ /rim gror bgyi'o/ /zhes brjod nas 'khar ba'i sil khrol dang /rnga dang / dung dang / mkhar rnga dang / gling bu la sogs pa rol mo'i bye brag du ma'i sgra sbyar bas mtshams sbyar te/ mchod pa mos pa'i stobs las nges par byung ba/ khams gsum pa las shin tu 'das pa/ nyon mongs pa ma mchis pa'i chos las byung ba/ mngon par 'du bgyid pa ma mchis pa'i phyag rgyas btab pa/ ye shes sgyu ma las yongs su grub pa/ las sgyu ma las shin tu rnam par phye ba/ gnas thams cad las shin tu spags pa/ 'jig rten sgyu ma las byung ba/ ngo bo nyid kyi chos dang 'brel ba/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis bka' stsal ba'i mchod pas de bzhin gshegs pa de dag la bsnyi bstang nasarim gror bgyi'i bar gong bzhin/ rol mo'i sgra sbyar zhing / spos kyi dud pa'i sprin phung cher spros te/ gong du yang byang chub sems dpa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i rgyud bsam par 'tshal ba/ sems can gyi rgyud yongs su smin par bgyid par 'tshal ba/ zhing gi rgyud rnam par sbyong bar 'tshal ba/ las kyi rgyu dang mi 'gal bar 'tshal ba /chos kyi rgyud rab tu rnam par 'byed par 'tshal ba/ dus gsum 216

phung po gsum chog/ pod/ 5tragyi rgyud yongs su rtogs par 'tshal ba/ phyogs kyi rgyud la rab tu 'jug par 'tshal ba/ 'dod chags ma mchis pa'i rgyud la rab tu 'god par 'tshal ba/ mos pa'i rgyud rnam par sbyong bar 'tshal ba/dbang po'i rgyud la lta bar 'tshal ba/ chos kyi dbyings kyi 'khor 'o/ la rnam par 'phrul par 'tshal ba/ 'gro ba'i 'khor lo thams cad bsdu bar 'tshal ba'i byang chub sems dpa'i rnams kyis ji ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dag gis sangs rgyas kyi mkhyen pa chags pa mi mnga' zhing sgrib pa mi mnga' bas mkhyen cing rab tu mkhyen pa de lta bus de bzhin gshegs pa de dag la mchod par bgyi ba de bzhin du bdag gis kyang yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis bka' stsal ba'i mchod pa/ byang chub sems dpa' dkyil 'khor thams cad rab tu dga' bar bgyid pa/byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa rab 'byams las nges par byung ba/ byang chub sems dpa' ye shes bla ma gnas pa'i yul gyi rjes su zhugs pas de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod par bgyi'o/ /yang 'dir rol mo'i tshogs mang po sgra 'byin pas brgyan te/ de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pa'i las kyi slad du de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pa dang / rim gro bgyi ba gtsug gi bla ma zhes/ bgyi bas 'jig rten gyi khams khams thams cad du 'dug ste/ de 217

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/labazhin gshegs pa la mchod pa 'di lta ste/ pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba/ ma skyes pa'i chos las byung ba/ byang chub sems dpa' rigs btsun par skyes pa'i ye shes kyi mig gis rig pa/ sangs rgyas kyi yul thams cad rgyas par 'gengs pas 'jig rten gyi khams chos kyi dbyings su gtogs pa ming gis khyab pa mang po dag na chos kyi dbyings rgyas par 'gengs pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rnams dang / nam mkha'i khams kyi mthas gtugs pa chos kyi dbyings su gtogs pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams rnams su 'jug go/ /de bas gong du yang mchod pa yon tan dpag tu ma mchis pa dang ldan pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba chen po'i shugs kyis bskyed pa/ rdo rje'i dbang po snang bar bgyid pa/ sangs rgyas kyi yul thams cad du snang ba'i me tog gi rgyal po'i ye shes las byung ba'i mchod pas de bzhin gshegs pa de dag la bsngi bstang du bgyi'i nasarim gror bgyi'ibar/ ji ltar bdag gi don du mchod pa de bzhin du 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byams ma lus pa thams cad na sems can ci tsam sems can gyi ris na mchis pa/ sems can gyi khams de dag thams cad kyi ched du yang de bzhin gshegs pa de dag la mchod par bgyi'o/ /zhes pa'i mthar sil snyan la sogs pa rol mo'i tshogs dkrol zhing sgra phyungs pas legs par spras te skabs kyi mjug bsdu'o/ /de dag ni phung 218

phung po gsum chog/ pod/ 5tra po gsum gyi mdun bsu ba'i sbyor ba yin par shes par bya la/ phung po gsum gyi thog ma 'di yin te/ gang yang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis bka' ma bstsal ba dang / gang sems can dam pa rnams kyis rnam par spangs pa dang / gang de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis smad pa dang / gang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis yongs su spangs pa dang / gang 'phags pa rnams kyis bshung ba dang /gang mkhas pa rnams dang zhe 'gras pa dang / gang rig rngapre rnams kyis bor ba 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang / gti mug gis rab tu gzir ba'i dbang gis byung ba'am/ nga rgyal dang / 'chab pa dang / khon du 'dzin pa dang / phrag dog dang / ser sna dang /mya ngan gi dbang gis byung ba'am/ sgyu dang g.yo'i dbang gis byung ba'am/ mngon par zhen pa'i stobs kyis byung ba 'di lta ste/ las kyi sgrib pa'am/ chos kyi sgrib pa'am/ nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa'am/lta ba'i sgrib pa'am/ mi shes pa'i sgrib pa'am/ rnam par smin pa'i sgrib pa'am/ chos kyis phongs par 'gyur ba'i sgrib pa'am/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa ldan pa'i sgrib pa'am/ theg pa chen po'i bar chad du 'gyur ba'i sgrib pa'am/ dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad pa gsog pa la gnod pa'i sgrib pa'am/ sdig pa'i grogs po dang 'dre ba'i sgrib pa'am/ byang chub sems dpa' kun 219

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/tu bzang po'i spyod pa'i smon lam yongs su rdzogs par bgyi ba la sgrib pa dang chod pa yang rung ste/ sgrib pa'i las bgyis shing bsags pa sgrib pa'i kun nas ldang ba gang gis sems can dmyal bar mchi bar 'gyur ba dang / dud 'gro'i skye gnas su mchi bar 'gyur ba dang / yi dwags kyi yul du mchi bar 'gyur ba dang / lha dbul por skye bar 'gyur ba dang / sangs rgyas la lta ba yongs su mi 'dzin pa dang / chos mnyan pa yongs su mi len pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa dang / chos dang / dge 'dun dkon mchog mngon par mi rig par 'gyur ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang 'grogs pa mi thob par 'gyur ba dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen yang dag pas yongs su bzung ba mi rnyed par 'gyur ba dang /dge ba'i rtsa ba chab 'tshal ba yongs su 'dzin par 'gyur ba dang /byang chub kyi sems brjed par 'gyur ba dang / pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam mi nyan par 'a gyur ba dang / bdud sdig can rnams kyis 'joms par 'gyur ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos thag ring du bgyed par 'gyur ba dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad brtsam pa'i sbyor ba las rnam par ldog par 'gyur ba dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen la 'khu bar 'gyur ba dang / bsam pa yongs su dag pa mi 'thob pa dang / dran pa brjed pa ma mchis pa mi 220

raḥji ///ཿpa/ 1(1 rngo/////can/ /15ཿ/// /rngosasprerwa// 14/'thob pa dang / chos la lta ba mi 'thob pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi rnam par sprul ba la mi mos pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams la yid gnyis 'tshal bar 'gyur ba dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo 'ong du mi chud pa dang sha spo nas sar gnon pa mi 'thob rpā dang /pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par bgyi ba'i las byas pa dang ldan pa khong du mi chud pa dang / smon lam chen po las nur bar 'gyur ba dang / spyod pa yongs su dag pa mi 'thob pa dang / spar mar/ byang chub sems dpa' dang 'grogs pa mi 'thob pa dang / zhes snang /kazungs kyi rgyan gyi snang ba mi 'thob pa dang / spobs pa'i rgyan gyi snang ba khong du mi chud pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa'i smon lam la yongs su 'dris par bgyi ba khong du mi chud pa dang / chos mnyam pa nyid mi rtogs pa dang / bsod nams mnyam pa nyid mi skyed pa dang / ye shes mnyam pa nyid khong du mi chud pa dang / 'khor ba'i chos rnams kyis kun tu gzhom par 'gyar ba'i sgrib pa de lta bu la sogs pa dang / byang chub ༄sems dpa'i spyod pa dang / yon tan gyi chos thams cad kun sgrub pa la mi phyogs par 'gyur ba'i sgrib pa'i 'gebs pa grangs ma mchis pa 'bum phrag bcu po de dag dus gsum du gtogs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad chos kyi dbyings su 'dus pa/ ye 221

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/shes gzigs pa sgrib pa mi mnga' ba/ chags pa ma mchis pa'i mig gi yul brnyes pa/ mnyam pa nyid kyi rjes su zhugs pa'i sku dang ldan pa/ chos kyi dbyings mun pa ma mchis par zhugs pa'i ye shes kyi spyan brnyes pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad kyi spyan sngar bdag mngon sum du gyur par mos nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yul tshad med par brtags te/ skra'i rtse mo'i cha shas bzhag pa'i khyon tsam re re la de bzhin gshegs pa sems can thams cad de snyed du lhag par mos so/ /skra'i rtse mo'i cha shas gcig bzhag pa'i khyon la ji lta ba de bzhin du chos kyi dbyings thams cad du yang de bzhin gshegs pa sems can thams cad snyed du lhag par mos so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa re re la'ang lus thob pa 'gro ba thams cad kyi sems kyi skad cig snyed kyis zhabs padma gnyis la spyi bos gtugs te phyag 'tshal lo/ /lus thob pa re re la yang mgo ngag gi lam gyi nges pa'i tshig ji snyed pa de snyed du lhag par mos so/ /mgo re re la yang kha'i sgo zhing khams thams cad kyi rdul phra rab tu dbye ba snyed du lhag par mos so/ kha'i sgo re re la yang lce'i rtse mo zhing khams thams cad kyi rdul phra rab tu dbye ba snyed du lhag par mos so/ /lce'i rtse mo'i dkyil 'khor re re la yang nges pa'i tshig gi sgrar btags pa'i tha snyad yang dag par 222

phung po gsum chog/ pod/ 5rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis bka' ba495 ba/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi tshig gi spyod pa dang mnyam pas sgrib pa ma mchis pa'i dkyil 'khor dang 'thun par gyur nas lhag pa'i bsam pa nyon mongs pa'i ri chen po rnam par 'thor ba las byung ba'i sgrib par 'gyur ba'i las de dag 'chags so/ /mi 'chab ba'o/ /'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du 'tshal bar 'gyur ba'i bshags pas 'chags so/ /bsal lo/ /rnam par gzhig go/ /rab tu gzhom mo/ /spang ngo / /gdon to/ /las la dbang bas dbang bgyi'o/ /stobs bskyed pa brnyes pa rnam sa kyi bde ba nye bar bstan pa'i slad du yongs su bsngo'o/ /gal te rgyas par spro ba dang / de kho na nyid la blta nyes pa'i dbang gis chad pa'i lta bar ltung ste/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'chad par 'gyur ba'i dogs pa med pa zhig yin na ni 'di dag kyang rnam par 'jog go/ /yang bdag gis 'khor ba thog ma'i mtha'i mu nas bzung ste/ yang dag pa'i mtha' dang /bdag gi mtha' ma 'tshal bas/ chos ma lags pa la chos su 'du shes bskyed pa dang / 'dul ba ma lags pa la 'dul bar 'du shes bskyed pa dang / sbyin gnas ma lags pa la sbyin gnas su 'du shes bskyed pa dang / mi dge ba la dge ba ra 'du shes bskyed pa dang / phyin ci log pa'i sems kyis bdag gi lus su lta bas yongs su dkris pa dang / dge ba'i chos gang yang sangs rgyas 223

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/kyis bka' ma bstsal ba mngon par 'dus bgyis pa dang / bgyid pa dang / bgyid du bstsal ba dang / bgyid pa la rjes su yi rang bar gyur pa gang ci mchis pa de dag 'chags so/ /dmigs pa gnas te/ bdag gis sems can ma mchis pa la sems can du 'du shes pa dang / sems sgyu ma lta bur ma 'tshal nas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pa gang lags pa de thams cad 'chags so/ /bdag gis mngon par 'du bgyid pa ma mchis par ma 'tshal nas lus dang / ngag dang /yid kyis chos dge ba dang / mi dge ba mngon par 'du bgyid pa dang / mngon par 'dus bgyis pa gang lags pa de 'chags so/ /bdag gis sbyin pa dang / tshul khrims dang / bzod pa dang /brtson 'grus dang / bsam gtan dang / shes rab mnyam pa nyid du ma 'tshal nas dmigs par lhung bas sbyin pa byin pa dang /tshul khrims mchog tu 'dzin pas tshul khrims bsrangs pa dang /༄bdag dang gzhan du 'du shes pas bzod pa bsgoms pa dang /lus dang sems la gnas te brtson 'grus brtsams pa dang / 'du shes dang dmigs pa gnas te bsam gtan bskyed pa dang / kun tu rtog pa dang / rnam par rtog pa rab tu 'jug pa la mngon par dga' bas shes rab rnam par dpyad pa gang lags pa de 'chags 224

phung po gsum chog/ pod/ 5traso/ /bdag gis don dam pa'i mchod pa ma 'tshal nas gzugs dang / rgyan dang mtshan la mngon par zhen pas sangs rgyas la mchod pa bgyis pa gang lags pa de 'chags so/ /bdag chos kyi dbyings tha mi dad pa'i ye shes la ma zhugs kyi/ chos tha dad pa la gnas te/ chos mnyan pa'am/ bshad pa'am/ rab tu bsam par gyur pa gang lags pa de dag 'chags so/ /bdag gis chos 'dus ma byas su ma 'tshal te/ dge 'dun la mngon par 'du shes nas/ dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur bgyis pa gang lags pa de dag 'chags so/ /bdag gis dgon pa ma 'tshal nas dgon pa'i gnas bsten te/ 'dod pa nyung zhing chog shes pa la mngon par zhen pa gang lags pa de dag 'chags so/ /bdag gis chos nyid gnas par ma 'tshal nas 'byung ba dang 'jig pa la gnas te/sangs rgyas kyi yon tan blang bar zhugs pa gang lags pa de dag 'chags so/ /bdag gis chos kyi dbyings yongs su bzung ba ma mchis par ma 'tshal ma zhugs kyi/ sems can bsdu bar 'tshal ba'i bsdu bas sems can dag bsdus pa gang lags pa de dag 'chags so/ /bdag gis byang chub kyi mtshan nyid kyi rang bzhin ma 'tshal nas lta ba la yongs su zhen pas byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun bsgoms pa gang lags pa de dag 'chags so//225

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bdag gis dge sbyong gi lam zhi ba ma 'tshal nas rab tu byung ba bsnyen par rdzogs te/ dge sbyong gi dngos po bskyed pa gang lags pa de dag 'chags so/ /kun rdzob la 'jug pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba gzhan gang dag bsags pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba gang dag gis 'dus byas kyi bde bar gyur te/ 'dus ma byas las shin tu ring bar gyur pa gang lags pa de dag 'chags so/ /'di dag ni byis pa'i skye bo su zhig bden pa gnyis phyin ci log tu zhen pa rnams kyis dpyad par bya ba ma yin gyis/ chos spong bar 'gyur ta re/ de lta bus na de dag gis kyang dad pa tsam nye bar bzhag ste/ de kho na nyid la skyi g.ya' ba dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba khyad du gsod pa'i 'du shes spang bar bya'o/ /rgyas pa'am bsdu bar mos kyang rung ste/ 'di dag brjod par bya'o//gong du yang byang chub sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mnyes par bgyid par 'tshal ba/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa thams cad yongs su sbyong bar 'tshal ba/ byang chub sems dpa' rnam par bzhag pa thams cad las 'da' bar 'tshal ba /byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bgyid par 'tshal ba/ byang chub sems dpa'i gter thams cad thob par 'tshal ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bstan pa yang dag par 'dzin par 'tshal ba/ pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bgyid par 'tshal ba/ sems can 226

phung po gsum chog/ pod/ 5thams cad yongs su smin par bgyid par 'tshal ba/ 'jig rten gyi khams yong sa su dag pa thams cad rtogs par 'tshal ba/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa'i smon lam yongs su rdzogs par bgyi ba rtogs par 'tshal ba rnams kyis ji ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dag gis sangs rgyas kyi mkhren pa chags pa mi mnga' zhing sgrib pa mi mnga' bas mkhren cing rab tu ryakhren sgyu de lta bus sgrib par 'gyur ba'i las bshags par bgyi ba de bzhin du ci nas kyang bdag gis bshags pas legs par bshags par 'gyur ba dang / yang dag par 'gyur ba dang / 'od gsal bar 'gyur ba dang / kha na ma tho ba ma mchis par 'gyur ba dang /gsal bar 'gyur ba dang / dug ma mchis par 'gyur ba dang /sgrib pa ma mchis par 'gyur ba dang / bar du gcod pa ma mchis par 'gyur ba dang / yon tan gyi chos thams cad sgrub par 'gyur ba de lta bur sgrib par 'gyur ba'i las kyi nyes pa thams cad 'chags so/ /ji ltar bdag gi don du bshags pa de bzhin du 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byams ma lus pa thams cad na sems can ci tsam sems can gyi ris na mchis pa sems can gyi khams de dag thams cad kyi ched du yang sgrib par 'gyur ba'i las kyi nyes pa thams cad 'chags so/ /de nas phung po rnam pa gnyis pa ni 'di 227

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/yin te/ de ltar bdag gi las kyi nyes pa sgrib par 'gyur ba thams cad so sor bshags nas sgrib pa ma mchis pa rnam par dag pa'i dkyil 'khor la gnas te/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba la rjes su yi rang ngo / /dge ba'i rtsa ba'i tshogs kyi khyad par gang gis ngan song dbul po yi dwags kyi mi khom par mchi ba dang /dud 'gro'i skye gnas kyi mi khom par mchi ba dang / sems can dmyal ba'i mi khom par mchi ba thams cad rnam par bzlog pa de la rjes su yi rang bar bgyi'o/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba'i tshogs kyi khyad par gang gis lha dang mir skye ba yongs su 'dzin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi dga' ba dang bde ba nyams su myong ba de dag la yang rjes su yi rang ngo / /dge ba'i rtsa ba'i tshogs kyi khyad par gang gis 'khor ba la yid 'byung ba'i sems thob pa dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen yang dag pas yongs su bzung ba dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams la gus pa'i sems rnyed pa dang / sangs rgyas 'byung ba mnyes par bgyid cing mnyes nas mi mnyes par mi 'gyur ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa las chos bstan pa mngon sum du nyan cing thos nas som nyi dang yid gnyis bzlog pa dang /'jig rten gsum po thams cad nas 'byung ba rtogs pa dang /sems can thams cad kyi ston pa'i sems bskyed pa rnyed pa dang /228

phung po gsum chog/ pod/ 5'gro ba thams cad thogs pa ma mchis pa'i mig thob pa dang /ngos mnyam pa'i rjes su mchi ba smon lam chen po yongs su dag par bgyid pa de dag la yang rjes su yi rang ngo / dge ba'i rtsa ba'i tshogs kyi khyad par gang gis lus mtshan dang / dpe byad bzang pos legs par brgyan pa thob pa dang / yon tan thams cad rnam par dag pa'i rgyan yongs su dag pa thob pa dang / stobs bcus brgyan pa'i sems rin po che thob pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi shugs las phyir mi ldog pa thob pa dang /gzungs kyi rigs khong du chud pa dang / chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag pa khong du chud pa dang / rnam par smin pa mi zad pa la gnas te mngon par shes pa thob pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rgyan bsgrub pa khong du chud pa dang / bdud kyi rtsod pa'i dmag tshogs thams cad rab tu bcom nas khya mchog tu gyar pa khong du 25 ngar zung miXḍi —rig /drodichud pa da dag la yang rjas su ya rang nga / /dag ba' rtsa ba nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos mnyam pa nyid las skyes pa'i rig pa dang / rnam par grol ba dang / 'dod chags dang bral ba dang / zag pa ma mchis pa dang ldan pa gang lags pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba gang dag byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa thams cad ldan pa nas/ bla 229

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/zhen med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub khong du chud pa dang ldan pa'i bar gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag la yang rjes su yi rang ngo /byang chub sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pa'i las kyi slad du/ de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pa dang / rim gror bgyi ba byang chub sems dpa' dbang bskur ba rnams kyi khyad par du 'gro ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' dga' ldan gyi gnas mchog na gnas pa rnams kyi khyad par du 'gro ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' mngal na gnas pa rnams kyi bsod nams kyi me tog rgyas pa'i snying po snang ba dang / byang chub kyi snying po mchog dam pa na gnas pa byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i gtsug gi bla ma zhes bgyi ba rnams kyis 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byams thams cad du 'jug pa gang lags pa de dag rnams la'ang rjes su yi rang ngo / yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dus gsum du gshegs pa rnams kyis dge ba'i rtsa ba thabs mkhas pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas rnam par 'phrul ba dang ldan pa gang lags pa de la yang rjes su yi rang ngo / / gal te rgya cher spro na ni/ tshig gi sbyor ba gzhan dang tshul gyi rnam grangs gzhan las brtsams te 'di dag kyang bklag cing rjes su dran par bya'o/ /gang yang 'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis dang po thugs 230

phung po gsum chog/ pod/ 5tra bskyed pa nas bzung ste/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i bar dang ldan pa rnams kyi bar de'i dge ba'i rtsa ba gang ci yang rung / sangs rgyas kyis bka' ba455 pa/ rtsa ba ma mchis shing rten ma mchis pa/gtong ba ma mchis pas gtong ba rnam par dag pa dang / rang bzhin gyi tshul khrims mi zad mi skye ba dang / sems can ma mchis pa'i bzod pa dang / dmigs pa las dben pa'i brtson 'grus dang / sems kyi ngo bo nyid la nges par sems pa'i bsam gtan dang / tshu rol dang pha rol gyi mthar lta ba rnam par spangs pa'i the/sa rab rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba zab mo la 'jug pa dang /sto nga pa nyid kyi rnam pa'i byams pa dang / rnam pa'i rnam pa ma mchis pa'i snying rje dang / chos la kun tu mi 'byung ba'i dga' ba dang / yal bar 'dor ba ma lags pa'i btang snyoms gang lags pa de dag la rjes su yi rang ngo / /khyim gyi dngos po thams cad bzung ba ma mchis shing gang yongs su ma bzung ba/ rtsa ba ma mchis shing rten pa ma mchis pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba ma dran pa dran par gyur pa'i dran pa nye bar bzhag pa rnams dang / ma 'gags pa dang ma skyes pa'i yang dag par spong ba rnams dang / lus dang /sems dang / brtson 'grus dang / 'dun pa dang ldan pa'i brdzu 231

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/zhe'aphrul gyi rkang pa rnams dang / dbang po lnga mtshan nyid ma mchis pa'i dbang po rnams dang / nam mkha' ltar mi thul ba'i stobs rnams dang / don dam pa yang dag par rtogs pa'i byang chub kyi yan lag rnams dang / mi gnyis pa'i lam dang ldan pa'i lam dang / zhi ba'i zhi gnas thob pa dang / reg pa dang rnam par gro' ba dang 'thun pa'i lhag mthong dang / mngon par shes pa'i ye shes sngon du 'gro ba de dag thams cad la rjes su yi rang ngo thos/ ma'i mtha' nas lus kyi ngo bo nyid yongs su dag pa dang / brjod du ma mchis pa'i ngag rnam par dag pa dang / sangs rgyas la rirna gro bgyi ba bsnyen bkur bgyis pa ma mchis pa dang / chos la rim gro bgyi ba chos thams cad yongs su gzung ba ma mchis pa dang /dge 'dun la rim gro bgyi ba tshogs pa ma mchis shing yon tan ma mchis pa dang / spyod lam thams cad rnam par ma brtags pa'i sdom pa spyod pa dang / 'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpar gyur pa de dag gi chos spyod pa/ yang dag pa'i sdom pa/ bdud thams cad kyis mi shigs pa/ 'jig rten thams cad dang ma 'dres pa/ nyan thos dang /rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sar ma nges pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i lam dang mthun pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bzang po/ las dkar 232

phung po gsum chog/ pod/ 5trapo ma lags pa 'gag par 'gyur ba gzhan gang ci mchis pa dang /dge ba'i rtsa ba bzang po/ 'od gsal ba'i las gang gis byang chub sems dpa' de dag gis sangs rgyas kyi ye shes thob pa dang /'thob pa dang / 'thob par 'gyur ba de dag la bdag rjes su yi rang ngo / /'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das byang chub brnyes pa de dag gi tshul khrims dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / shes rab dang / rnam par grol ba dang / rnam par grol ba'i ye shes mthong ba zag pa ma mchis pa dang / stobs mi thul ba rnams dang / mi 'jigs pa phyir mi ldog pa rnams dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos chags pa ma mchis pa rnams dang / kun tu mi 'byung ba'i byams pa chen po dang / snying rje chen po gzhan gyi dring la mi 'jog pa dang / spyi ga/tsug bltar mi mthong ba nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa gang lags pa dang / gnyis su ma mchis pa'i bsod nams rnam par smin pa'i mtshan nyid dang / lus dang ngag dang sems kyi rgyud bcos ma ma lags pa nam mkha' ltar yongs su dag pa dang / brgya byin dang tshangs pa thams cad kyis bskul ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo dang /brjod pa ma mchis pa dang ldan pa'i chos bstan pa dang / sems can thams cad la shes pa snang ba rnam par shes pa las gzhan ma 233

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/lags pa de dag thams cad la rjes su yi rang ngo / /sems can thams cad la phan gdags pa'i slad du thabs mkhas pa'i gnas la gnas pa dag 'das pa dang ma byon pa dang da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bzhugs pa'am/ yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa yang rung ste/ dam pa'i chos nub kyi bar du de dag la mchod pa bgyis pa dang / bgyid pa dang / bgyid par 'gyur ba gang lags pa de dag thams cad la yang rjes su yi rang ngo / /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa de dag gi nyan thos 'dus pa sems can thams cad las yang dag par 'das pa rnams dang / dad pas rjes su 'brang ba rnams dang / chos kyi dbyings la zhugs pa rnams dang / chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba rnams dang / log pa brgyad las yang dag par 'das pa'i brgyad pa rnams dang / chags pa med pa'i rigs la gnas pa'i rigs kyi sa pa rnams dang / rgyun du zhugs pa rgyun las bzlog ste zhugs pa rnams dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba gang du yang mi 'gro ba rnams dang / phyir mi 'ong ba 'di nas shi 'phos nas der gnas par 'gyur ba rnams dang / dgra bcom pa grangs ma mchis shing skye ba ma mchis pas/ rab tu phye ba rnams dang /rang sangs rgyas rten cing 'brel bar 'byang ba zab mo khong du chud ༄234

phung po gsum chog/ pod/ 5ra〉 pa rnams dang / byang chub sems dpa' ye shes mngon sum du rtogs pa rnams dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' dang mtshungs pa'i sems dang po bskyed pa rnams dang / byang chub sems dpa' spyod pa thams cad las yang dag par 'das pa'i spyod pa la zhugs pa rnams dang / byang chub sems dpa' 'khor ba'i chos las 'das shing sangs rgyas kyi chos thob pa phyir mi ldog pa rnams dang / byang chub sems dpa' skye ba thams cad las shin tu 'das pa rnams dang / byang chub sems dpa' skye ba gcig gis thogs pa rnams kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba rten pa ma mchis pa gang lags pa de dag dang / 'dus byas las yongs su rgal ba de dag thams cad la rjes su yi rang ngo/ /'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i dus kyi sems can rnams la smin pa'i bsod nams bgyi ba'i dngos po dang / tshul khrims kyi bsod nams bgyi ba'i dngos po dang / /bsgom pa dngos po ma mchis pa'i dngos por gyur ba'i bsod nams bgyi ba'i dngos po sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis mkhyen pa gang lags pa de dag thams cad la rjes su yi rang ngo / /zhes bsams shing rdzogs par bklag go/ /spros te rgya cher byed 'dod kyang rung mi 'dod kyang rung ste/ mjug tu/ gong du yang byang chub sem sa dpa' bdud kyi rtsod pa'i dmag tshogs thams cad rab tu 235

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gdul bar 'tshal ba/ phas kyi rgol ba'i tshogs thams cad zil gyis gnon par 'tshal ba/ ma rig pa'i mun pa mun gnag dang /rab rib kyi ling tog mang po sel bar 'tshal ba/ ngan song dang mi khom pa dang ngan 'gro'i lam thams cad gcod par 'tshal ba/ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad nam par sbyong bar 'tshal ba/chos thams cad snang ba thob par 'tshal ba/ kun tu bzang po'i lus khyu mchog tu gyur pa thob par 'tshal ba/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du tshim par bgyid pa'i dbyangs kyi yan lag rnam par dag pa thob par 'tshal ba chos thams cad kyi lta ba bzhin du rtogs par bgyi ba'i slad du ye shes kyi mig rnam par sbyong bar 'tshal ba/ 'khor ba'i 'khor lo bzlog par 'tshal ba/ chos kyi 'khor lo chen po rab tu bskor bar 'tshal ba/stobs bcu'i ye shes kyis non par 'tshal ba rnams kyis ji ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dag gis sangs rgyas kyi mkhyen pa chags pa mi mnga' zhing sgrib pa mi mnga' bas mkhyen cing rab tu mkhyen pa de lta bas dge ba'i rtsa ba'i tshogs thams cad la rjes sa ri bca rib phuyi rang bar bgyi ba de bzhin du bdag kyang rjes su yi rang ba'i mchog dang / ma chad pa dang / ma lhag pa dang / nam mkha' ltar rnam par dag pa dang / shes rab dang ye shes kyis rtogs pa dang /236

phung po gsum chog/ pod/ 5haṃ sa/zhan yang nges pa'i don gyi chos dang ldan pa dang / bla na ma mchis pa dang / nam mkha' dang mnyam pa dang / mya ngan las 'das pa dang mnyam pa dang / mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa nyid kyi rjes su yi rang bas rjes su yi rang ngo / /gtso bo dang / dam pa dang / khyad par 'phags pa dang / rang dang sogs phyag 'tshal skabs ltar/ bka' stsal ba'i rjes su yi rang bas rjes su yi rang ngo ji ltar bdag gi don du rjes su yi rang ba de bzhin du 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byams ma lus pa thams cad na sems can ji tsam sogs gong bzhin/ ched du yang dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag thams cad la rjes su yi rang ngo / /de nas bsod nams kyi phung po gsum pa'i dbang du byas nas bskul ba dang gsol ba gdab pa gnyis su mchis pa'i dang po ni/ sil snyan gyi sgra sbyar bas mdun bsus te/ 'di skad du/ de ltar bdag dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad la rjes su yi rang nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad la bskul lo/ /de ltar na phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams phyogs bcu'i mu thug yongs su rje bar 'jug pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad gzhi phyal ba'i rjes su 'gro zhing 'jug pa/ steng g.yogs med pa'i rgyud kyi phyogs yongs su rje bar bshad pa/'chol ba'i rgyud kyi 'jig rten gyi khams mngon du sgrub pa/ rnam par dbye ba'i mig 'phrul lta bu chos kyi dbyings su gtogs pa'i 237

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byams thams cad na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang dag bdud kyi rtsod pa'i dmag tshogs thams cad mngon par btul nas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas te/ chos thams cad la sgrib pa med pa nyid brnyes pa/ byang chub kyi snying po mchog dam par gshegs pa/ chos kyi tshul g.yo ba ma mchis pa'i rang bzhin du gyur pa/ chos kyi sku rab tu zhi bar ldan pa dag 'di lta ste/ chos gzung bar mdzad pa'i slad du 'jig rten thams cad/ na bskul ba'i sa la gzhes te/ thags las chung ngur gzhol ba////kye riring //sne)// sgocang gsung ba la dgyes pa/ byang chub — nga la gzigs pa / lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang dri za dang lha ma yin dang / narna/ mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang lto 'phye chen po thams cad kyis mngon par bstod de/ dgyes shing bzhug sa pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag la bdag gis bla ma la ri mo gus par bgyi ba chen pos lus btud de chos kyi 'khor lo chen po rab tu bskor bar bskul gyis/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad yongs su 'grub par bgyi ba dang / 'gro ba thams cad bskyab pa dang /nyon mongs pa thams cad rnam par byang bar bgyi ba dang / som nyi thams cad yang dag par gzhom pa dang / the tshom thams cad 238
