phung po gsum chog/ pod/ 5trakun tu gcad pa dang / sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun thams cad rab tu bsgrag pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du sangs rgyas 'byung ba rgyun mi 'chad par bgyi ba'i slad du sa/ngas rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis pha rol tu phyin pa'i yan 'a/ga thams cad shin tu yongs su sbyangs pa/ phyir mi ldog pa/sto bas bcu zil gyis mi non pa/ 'khor ba'i 'khor lo rab tu 'joms pa/ lta bar gyur pa dang / nyon mongs pa thams cad rab tu 'jig pa so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi rjes su bsgrags pa// shin tu rnam par phye ba'i sgra dang ldan pa/ 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi'i tshul nges par brtags pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo chen po bskor bar gsol lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos kyi tshul 'jig rten thams cad dang mi mthun pa'i 'khor lo la 'di lta ste/chos kyi 'khor lo mi 'jug pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo dang mngon par mi 'grub pa'i 'khor lo dang / tshu rol dang pha rol yongs su kacod pa'i 'khor lo dang / rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba zab rno/'i 'khor lo dang / bdud dang phyir rgol ba choms pa'i 'khor lo skor du gsol/ brjod du ma mchis pa'i rnga rdung du gsol/ sgra rna/ mchis pa'i dung 'bud du gsol/ chos shes pa'i rgyal mtshan dang tog bsgreng du gsol/ shes rab dang ye shes dang rnam par 239

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/lgegrol ba'i sgron ma 'bar bar mdzad du gsol/ thugs rje chen po'i sprin bsdu bar gsol/ chos chen po'i char pa'i chu rgyun gyis sems can rnams kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba'i lo tog rnam par spel du gsol /'phags pa'i shes rab dang ye shes kyi nor gyis sems can thams/ cad tshim par mdzad du gsol lo/ /snying rje chen po'i stobs la lhag par dmigs par bgyi ba dang / rang gi byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rgyun mi gcad par bgyi ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i lam thams cad yongs su sbyang ba'i slad du byang chub sems/ dpa' thams cad la yang bdag skul lo/ /snying rje chen po'i stobs la lhag par dmigs par bgyi ba'i slad du nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad la yang bdag skul lo/ /mi dge ba'i chos thams cad nam par bzlog pa dang / dge ba'i chos thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bgyi ba'i slad du sems can thams cad la yang bdag skul lo/ /slar yang rol mo sna tshogs rnam par sbur ba dang spos btul ba'i sprin gyis rgya cher dkrigs te/ gong du yang byang chub sems dpa' bskul ba'i phung po dang ldan pa rnams kyis ji ltar sangs/ rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis sangs rgyas kyi mkhyen pa chags pa mi mnga' zhing sgrib pa mi mnga' bas mkhyen cing rab tu mkhyen pa de lta bus sangs rgyas thams cad dang / byang chub sems 240

phung po gsum chog/ pod/ 5dpa' thams cad dang / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad dang / sems can thams cad la bskul bar bgyi ba de bzhin du bdag kyang bskul ba'i mchog dang sogs gong bzhin la/bka' bstsal ba'i bskul bas yang dag par bskul bar bgyi'o/ /ji ltar bdag gi don du bskul ba de bzhin du 'jig rten sogs gong bzhin te/ de dag thams cad kyi ched du yang bskul bar bgyi'o/ /zhes rol mo'i sgra dbyangs snyan par 'byung ba'i glu'i 'gyur ba dang sbrags te/ yang 'dir gnyis pa bya ste/ gang yang phyogs bcu rnam par dbye ba'i tshul rgya mtsho mtha' dbas med pa'i khongs sa chad pa 'jig rten gyi ra༄1 dgame ༄༄mekhams rgya mtsho dag na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang dag 'khor lo dag shin tu bskor ba/ gdul ba dag shin tu btul ba/zam pa dag shin tu btags pa/ bstan pa dag shin tu byin gyis brlabs pa/ byang chub sems dpa' dag shin tu lung bstan pa/sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa dag shin tu mdzad pa/ phas kyi rgol ba'i phyogs thams cad shin tu tshar bcad pa/ rjes su bstan pa rnams shin tu 'phags pa/ zhing thams cad du bsgrags pa/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du rnam par dag pa'i gnas chen por gyur pa de dag zhing de dang de dag dang / 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byams de dang de dag dang / sems can gyi 241

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/khuris de dang de dag na sems can rab 'byams ma gus par gyur pa/dbang po yongs su skyo ba/ snod du ma gyur pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa la lta ba'i rgyun bcad pa/ rtag tu chags pa/ yul la mngon par dga' ba/ 'dus byas kyi sgrib pas zin pa/ 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga la sred pa'i dbang du mchis pa de dang de dag la yul thams cad la bdag med par yang dag par ston cing sems can 'khor ba la mngon par dga' ba rnams yid 'byung ba bskyed pa'i ched dang / 'du byed thams cad mi rtag par rab tu bstan pa'i ched du 'byor pa thams cad mthar rgud pa'i sgor yang dag par ston la/ sangs rgyas yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa chen po zhi bar yang dag par bstan pa'i ched du srog gi dbang po thams cad mthar 'chi bar yang dag par ston cing de bzhin gshegs pa 'phos te/ shin tu bral nas 'jig rten du mi dga' ba chen po ston la/ lha dang / mi dang lha ma yin du bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi mdun du yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa chen po ston te/ lha'i dbang po thams cad ngu ba dang / klu'i dbang po thams cad mya ngan bgyid pa dang / gnod sbyin gyi dbang po thams cad smre sngags 'don pa dang / 'gro ba'i dbang po thams cad rab tu mi dga' ba'i yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa chen po ston par mdzad 242

phung po gsum chog/ pod/ 5lgeṅkapa na bdag gis bla ma la rim gro gus pa chen pos lus btud pa bgyis nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag la sku tshe bsring ba dang / ring du bzhugs par gsol gyis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams 'gro ba thams cad sdug bsngal gyi phung po las bzlog pa dang / sems can thams cad rab tu bde ba la 'god pa dang /sems can thams cad kyi dbul po'i lam rnam par gcad pa dang /sems can thams cad 'khor ba'i 'brog dgon pa chen po las bsgral ba dang / 'gro ba thams cad sangs rgyas kyi yul sgrib pa ma mchis pa la gnas pa la dgod pa dang / 'gro ba thams cad chos dkon mchog gis tshim par bgyi ba dang / 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad yongs su sbyang ba dang / 'gro ba thams cad gdul ba mthar thug pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad yongs su gzung ba'i slad du bskal pa chos kyi dbyings kyi mtha' klas pa/nam mkha'i khams kyi mthas gtugs par bzhugs su gsol/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag la bdag mngon par gsol ba'i mchog gis mngon par gsol lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi chos kyi dbyings gnas pa'i tshul gyis ji ltar de dag mi skye zhing / ma skyes pa de bzhin du/ ma 'gag mi 'gag 'gag par mi 'gyur ba de ltar bzhugs su gsol lo/ /gtso bo dang sogs 243

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gong bzhin byas te/ bka' 455 ba'i mngon par gsol bas gsol lo//gong du yang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dag gis ji ltar sangs rgyas kyi mkhyen pa chags pa mi mnga' zhing sgrib pa mi mnga' bas masnyen cing rab tu mkhyen pa de lta bus byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi gus pa de lta bu dang / lus btud pa de lta bu dang /ngag gi las 'byung ba de lta bu dang / yid kyi las sgrub pa de lta bus sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mya ngan las 'da' bar phyogs par dgongs pa la phyi ma'i mtha'i mur thug pa'i bskal bar sku tshe yongs su bskyang bar mngon par gsol bar bgyi ba de bzhin du bdag kyang gsol lo/ /ji ltar bdag gi don du gsol ba de bzhin du 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byams ma lus pa sogs gong bzhin/ ched du yang mngon par gsol lo/ /zhes yun ring zhig tu dran pa nye bar bzhag la gnas par bya'o/ /de dag gis ni bsod nams bya ba'i phung po rnam pa gsum mthar phyin te/ da ni phung po gsum pa'i bsngo ba brjod par bya'o/ /de la dge ba'i rtsa ba mngon du bya ba dang / de nyid 'dun pa las rab tu bsgyur ba'i cho ga bstan pa ste gnyis shig yod pa las/ phyogs snga ma'i dbang du byas nas/ de ltar bdag de bzhin gshegs pa la mngon par gsol ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba'i stobs bskyed pa thob par gyur/ bsam pa dang lhag pa'i bsam pa'i stobs kyis brtan par gyur/ dad pa dang mos pa'i stobs la 244

phung po gsum chog/ pod/ 5tra shin tu gnas par gyur nas lhag pa'i bsam pa'i snod yangs pa yang dag par bskyed de/ dge ba'i rtsa ba rab 'byams thams cad yang dag par gzung ngo / /byang chub sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad na 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mkhyen pa nyid sgrib pa ma mchis pa la brtson pa/ chos kyi dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor rnam par dag pa rjes su dran pa/ 'gro ba thams cad yongs su skyob pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba'i tshogs chen blang bar rab tu brtson pa/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i rtsol bas rtsol ba/ go cha chen po bgos pa/ smon lam chen po mngon par sgrub pa/ dge ba'i rtsom pa rgya chen po la rab tu brtson pa/ pha rol tu phyin pa chen po'i dkyil 'khor du rab tu sbyor ba/ yon tan gyis thams cad rnam par sbyong bar 'tshal ba/ mtha' dang dbus med pa'i sa la gnas par 'tshal ba/ 'gro ba thams cad kyis yongs su rdzogs par 'tshal ba/ sems kyi 'khri shing rnam par sbyong bar 'tshal ba/ chos kyi sgo nye bar stob par 'tshal ba/ dge ba'i rtsa ba chen po'i shugs rnam par spel bar 'tshal ba'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis 'di lta ste/ sems can thams cad stobs bcu rnam par dag pa'i mthar gtugs pa dang / sangs 245

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/tyārgyas thams cad la mchod pa dang rim gror bgyi ba'i slad du thams/ cad mkhyen pa nyid la dge ba'i rtsa ba ji snyed cig bskyed pa dang / skyed par 'gyur ba dang / skyed pa de dag dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba gcig pu la btang ba rnams/ dang / yang dge ba'i rtsa ba gang dag byang chub sems dpa'i sa nas sar 'phar ba'i mod las skyes pa rnams dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa'i smon lam/ yongs su rdzogs pa las byung ba rnams dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sa 'phrul ba dang ldan pa la zhugs pa rnams dang / chos thams cad kyi don mthong ba rjes su thob pa/ chags pa med pa'i ye shes kyi sa'i snying po rdo rje ltar sra ba/ mi shigs pa'i sems bskyed pa rnams kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba'i tshogs kun nas sgo/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mngon sum du gyur pa/ las kyi shugs kun nas ngos ye shes 'phags pa zhes bgyi bas bskyed pa /sems kyi skad cig sems kyi skad cig la yang de bzhin gshegs pa/ la mchod pa dang rim gro bgyi bar 'jug ste/ de dag 'jug pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba'i rgyu mthun pas thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi tshad med pa'i rkyen rnams kyis sems kyi skad cig sems kyi skad cig la sems can gyi khams thams cad la mngon par 'gebs 246

phung po gsum chog/ pod/ 5shing ji tsam du thabs kyi tshul brjod pa la 'jug pa dpag tu ma mchis pa dag gis byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang mnyam pa nyid kyang yang dag par 'grub ste/ byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad dge ba'i rtsa ba'i shugs de dag thams cad rgyun mi 'chad par gtong ba de tsam du bdag gis lhag pa'i bsam pa'i snod la mos pa'i lam shin tu rnam par dag pa yang dag par bskyed nas dge ba'i rtsa ba'i shugs de dag thams cad yang dag par mnod do/ /yang dag par gzung ngo / /bdag gir bgyi'o/ /blang ngo / /lhag par mos so/ /kun gyi rjes su zhugs par bgyi'o/ /bdag gir bgyi ba mchog dang / gtso bo dang sogs bya/ gong bzhin/bka' bstsal ba'i bdag gir bgyi bas bdag gir bgyi'o/ /gong du yang byang chub sems dpa' bsod nams kyi tshogs yang dag par 'tshal ba/ yon tan gyi tshogs sgrub par 'tshal ba/ sgrib pa ma mchis pa'i yul la 'jug par 'tshal ba/ chags pa ma mchis pa'i mtha' la gnas par 'tshal ba/ dus gsum thams cad du 'jug par 'tshal ba rnams kyis ji ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dag gis mkhyen cing rab tu mkhyen pa de lta bus dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad bdag hir bgyi ba de bzhin du bdag gis kyang bdag gir bgyi'o/ /ji ltar bdag gi don du bdag gir bgyi ba247

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/zhede bzhin du 'jig rten gyi khams sogs gong bzhin la/ ched du yang bdag gir bgyi'o/ /bdag gi mos pa dang ldan pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba gang lags pa dang / sangs rgyas thams cad la phyag 'tshal ba dang ldan pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba gang lags pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la lhag par mchod pa dang ldan pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba gang lags pa dang / mos pa'i stobs las nges par byung ba'i mchod pa dang ldan pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba gang lags pa dang / sgrib par 'gyur ba thams cad sel ba dang ldan pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba gang lags pa dang / rjes su yi rang ba dang ldan pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba gang lags pa dang / sangs rgyas thams cad la bskul ba dang ldan pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba gang lags pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la mngon par gsol ba dang ldan pa'i dge ba'i rtsal ba gang lags pa dang / bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba rab 'byams thams cad sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la shin tu phul nas bdag gir bgyi ba dang ldan pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba gang lags pa dang / bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba thog ma dang po ma mchis pa'i tshe rabs nas bgyis pa thams cad mkhyen par yongs su ma bsngos pa gang lags pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dus byas kyis yo byad 'tshal bas mngon par bsgrubs pa 248

phuḥmisnang〉 /༷/ཿbdu 1(1 ཿsa////65/ the15ཿ/// :dros/rngan/ 14/sang lags pa dang / nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyis mngon par bsgrubs pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba gang lags pa dang / bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba las kyis mngon par bsgrubs pa/ dus thams cad du bsags pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyis mkhyen pa gang lags pa de dag thams cad yongs su bsdu'o/ /bzlum mo/ /bsdu bar bgyi'o/ /gong du yang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la mchod par 'tshal ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bstan pa yang dag par 'dzin par 'tshal ba rnams kyis ji ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dag gis mkhyen cing rab tu mkhyen pa de lta bus dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad yongs su bsdu bar bgyi ba de bzhin du bdag gis kyang yongs su bsdu'o/ /bsdus nas kyang 'di lta ste/ 'das pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la mchod pa'i las dang / mtshan rgyas par bgyi ba dang / ma byon pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i smon lam yongs su rdzogs par bgyi ba dang / stobs bcu dang byang chub kyi phyogs myur du khong du chud par bgyi ba'i slad du sems can thams cad la stsal to/ /gtong ngo / /yongs sa gtong ngo / /rnam par gtong ngo / /nges par gtong ༄ngo / /nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad la dbul lo/ /249

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rshagatang ngo sogs nas nges par gtang ngo / /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la yang dbul lo/ /gtong ngo sogasasangs rgyas thams cad la yang dbul lo sogs/ de bzhin gshegs pa re re la yang mchod pa'i las kyi slad du da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad mkhyen pa byang chub kyi yan lag tu thugs nges pa rnams kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor chos kyi dbyings kyi tshad tsam rnams su mchod pa bkod pa'i rgyan thams cad kyis kun tu gnas par gyur cig rin po che thams cad kyis khebs pa'i rgyan gyis chos kyi dbyings kun tu gnas par gyur cig chos kyi dbyings kun tu gnas par gyur cig ces gzhan la'ang sbyar te/ me tog thams cad kyi bla re bres pa'i rgyan gyis chos kyi dbyings kun tu gnas par gyur cikarin po che thams cad kyi rgyal mtshan bsgreng ba'i rgyan gyis chos kyi dbyings kun tu gnas par gyur cig rin po che thams cad kyi drwa ba bres pa'i rgyan gyis chos kyi dbyings kun tu gnas par gyur cig rin po che thams cad kyi na bzas g.yogs pa'i rgyan gyis chos kyi dbyings kun tu gnas par gyur cig gzhal du mi spyod pa'i gos kyi sprin gyi char dang rin po che thams cad kyis sangs rgyas la mchod pa bkod pa'i rgyan gyis chos kyi dbyings kun tu gnas par gyur cig snying po'i spos thamyo/sa cad kyi bdugs pa'i 250

phung po gsum chog/ pod/ 54storshargyan gyis chos kyi dbyings kun tu gnas par gyur cig rgyan gyi dmigs pa thams cad la chags pa las grol ba'i sil snyan 'khrol ba dang ldan pa'i dbyangs kyi rgyan gyis chos kyi dbyings kun tu sanas/ par gyur cig rin po che thams cad kyi pa dma bkram pa'i rgyan gyis chos kyi dbyings kun tu gnas par gyur cig chos rgya ma/tsho thams cad kyi rjes su sgrogs pa'i sprin gyi rgyan gyis chos kyi dbyings kun tu gnas par gyu ra cig rol mo'i sgra sna tshogs nye bar sbyar bas mtshams brgyan te/ rin po che thams cad kyi sprin snang ba rab tu 'byed pa'i rgyan gyis chos kyi dbyings kun tu gnas par gyur cigalha 'i yo byad thams cad las shin tu 'das pa rin po che'i cod pan sna tshogs pa'i sprin gyi rgyan gyis chos kyi dbyings kun tu gnas par gyur cig /de ltar dge ba'i rtsa ba'i sgo nye bar sgrub pa 'dis ji ltar byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor du mchod pa thams cad dang lda na pas 'jug pa de bzhin du bdag kyang dge ba'i rtsa ba'i sgo nye bar sgrub pa 'dis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor du de ltar dpag tu ma mchis pa'i mchod pa phyi ma'i ma tha'i mur thug par byin gyis rlob pa la 'jug par gyur cig de ltar bdag dge ba'i tshogs chen po'i bsod nams kyi phung po tshad 251

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/med pas brtan par gyur nas bdag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed par bgyi'o/ /ji ltar de bzhin gshegs pa mar me mdzad dang / shākya'i khyu mchog dang /tshe dpag med pa dang / mi 'khrugs pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' byams pa dang / blo gros rgya mtsho dang / nam mkha' mdzod dang / 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa dang / kun tu bzang ngo/ la sogs pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis sngon gyi rgyal ba la lhag par byas shing / dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed de/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu thugs bskyed par mdzad pa de bzhin du bdag kyang bla na med pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed par bgyi'o/ /mchog dam pa nga rgyal zhi ba sems la lags pa'i sems dang / 'gro ba thams cad yongs su bskyab pa'i sems dang /byang chab kyi sems des khyab par ma gyar pa'i chos kyi dbyings de ra gi rig migang yang ma mchis so/ /byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba'i tshogs des dus gsum du ma khyab pa cung zad kyang ma mchis so/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes par bgyid pa'i sems dang / byang chub sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad rab tu dga' bar bgyid pa'i sems dang / nyan thos dang rang sangs 252

phuḥmi ///ཿpa/ spre(1 ཿsa////(5/ /15ཿsa// ྅rngo///rngan/ 1)/rgyas thams cad rjes su yi rang ba'i sems dang sems bskyed pa des yongs su zin par ma gyur pa'i sems can de gang yang ma mchis so/ /mchod par ma gyur pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa de gang yang mi bzhugs so/ /gang yang sems can thams cad 'khor los sgyur ba dang / 'jig rten skyong ba dang / brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas su gyur pa rnams kyi bsod nams yongs su grub pa ni ches nyung gi/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pa thog mar gyur pa yang de lta ma yin no/ /de ltar bdag gis bsod nams kyi phung po mngon par bsgrubs pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba ma tha' yas pa yongs su sbyang ba ji snyed cig de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyis ma.o pa gang lags pa de dag thams cad yongs su bsdu'o/ /dani phyogs phyi mas brten pa nyid kyi dbang du byas nas/bsdus nas kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngo'o/ /bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di dag gis sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes par bgyid cing dgyes par bgyid par gyur cig sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad yongs su spyong bar gyur cig sems can thams cad yongs sa smin par bgyid par gyar cig dge ba'i rigang rigang bshes gnyen thams cad dang / chos smra ba thams cad mgu bar 253

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bgyid cing dga' bar bgyid par gyur cig de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bstan pa yang dag par 'dzin cing bsrung ba dang yongs su skyong bar gyur cig sgrib pa'i ling tog thams cad rnam par sbyong bar gyur cig bdud kyi rtsod pa'i dmag tshogs thams cad rab tu 'dul bar gyur cig sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad mngon par rdzogs par byang chub par gyur cig ting nge 'dzin thams cad dang / dbang thams cad thob pa dang / mngon par she sa pa thams cad kyis rnam par rtsen pa dang / rnam par thar pa thams cad kyis rnam par 'phrul par gyur cig ci nas kyang 'khor ba na mi 'bral zhing tshe rabs gzha na du brjes pa na chab 'tshal bar mi 'gyur ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa pha rol tu phyin pa bskyud par mi 'gyur ba dang / byis pa so so'i skye bo dang 'dre bas sgrib pa'i cha dang 'thun par mi 'gyur ba de lta bu bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag yongs su bsngo'o/ /ci nas kyang byang chub sems dpa' de dag sangs rgyas de dag sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di nas sangs rgyas mngon sum du bzhugs pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan du sangs rgyas de dag la mchod pa bkod pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan par bgyid du mchi ba dang / sangs rgyas la mchod pa bkod pa'i rgyan de'i tha ma'i sems bskyed pa thob pa yongs su 254

phung po gsum chog/ pod/ 5 ṅge rdzogs par dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag yongs su bsngo'o/ /'chi ba'i dus kyi tshe na yang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis phyag g.yas pa gser gyi kha dog can brkyang ste/ bdag gi spyi bor 'jog par gyur cig ci nas bdag dngos po thams cad la mi lta ba bkod pa rgyun thogs pa ma mchis pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pas yongs su bsgos pa'i sems dang / tshor ba thams cad rgyun chad pa'i sems kyis 'chi ba'i dus bgyid par gyur cig dad pa grangs ma mchis pa dang / ri mo gus par bgyi ba grangs ma mchis pa dang / dga' ba dang dad pa grangs ma mchis pas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag la lta zhing rtog la kun tu smra zhing yang dag par smra bzhin du 'chi sogasamachod pa yid du 'ong bas de bzhin gshegs pa de dag la mchod cing me tog dang / spos dang /phreng ba dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / na bza' dang /gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dpag tu ma mchis pa dag gis de bzhin gshegs pa de dag la mchod cing blta la rtog bzhin du 'chi ba'i dus bgyid par gyur cig bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad na sems can dmyal ba thams cad rgyun chad par gyur cig dud 'gro'i skye gnas dang /gshin rje'i 'jig rten thams cad rgyun chad par gyur cig lha 255

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dbul po thams cad dang / mi dbul po thams cad dang / ser sna thams cad dang / 'chal ba'i tshul khrims thams cad dang /gnod sems thams cad dang / le lo thams cad dang / rnam par g.yeng ba thams cad dang / 'chal ba'i shes rab thams cad rgyun chad par gyur cig byang chub tu sems bskyed pa dang /sangs rgyal la blta ba dang / dam pa'i chos mnyan pa dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang 'grogs pa dang mi 'bral bar gyur cigadage ba'i rtsa ba 'dis bdag sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad dang lus mnyam par gyur cig ngag mnyam pa dang / sems mnyam pa dang / ye shes mnyam par gyur cig ji ltar gong du yang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dag gis ji ltar sangs rgyas kyi mkhyen pa chags pa mi mnga' zhing sgrib pa mi mnga' bas mkhyen cing rab tu mkhyen pa de lta bus byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngo bar bgyi ba de bzhin du bdag gis kyang dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chab tu yongs sa bsngo ba'i mchog gis yongs sa bsngo'o/ /de rig mi rig mi rigazi gal te rgyas par spro na 'di yang bklag par bya ste/ de ltar bdag gis dge ba'i rtsa ba'i shugs rgyas par byas pa dang / bsod nams kyi 256

phung po gsum chog/ pod/ 5zhetshogs yongs su bzlum par bgyis pa gang lags pa de dag thams cad gzod ma nyid nas rang bzhin gyis ma skyes pa/ ma byung ba/len pa ma mchis pa/ 'dus ma bgyis pa/ de bzhin du byang chub kyang len pa ma mchis shing / 'dus ma bgyis pa ste/ chos nyid de dang ma chad pa dang / mi lhag pa dang / ma smad pa dang / mnyam pa ma mchis pa dang / mi mtho ba dang / ma dma' ba'i yongs su bsngo bas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la chos phra rab tsam yang mi dmigs par yongs su bsngo'o/ /'di ltar mig ni gzugs rnams la mi 'jug ste/ gzugs kyang mig la ma yin mod kyi 'on kyang dmigs pa'i rgyu rkyen gyis rnam par shes pa 'byung ste/ rnam par shes pa de yang mig las ma byung / gzugs las kyang ma yin te/ byung nas kyang zhig cing med de mi gnas so//de bzhin du rna ba dang / sgra dang / sna dang / dri dang / lce dang /ro dang / lus dang / reg bya dang / yid dang / chos rnams la mi 'jug mod kyi/ 'on kyang dmigs pa'i rgyu rkyen gyis rnam par shes pa 'byung ste/ de yang gzung ba las kyang ma byung / 'dzin pa'i bdag po'i rkyen las kyang ma byung ste/ byung nas kyang zhig cing med de mi gnas so/ /de bzhin du dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub lam la mi 'jug byang chub kyang dge ba'i rtsa ba la mi 'jug mod 257

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/lgekyi/ 'on kyang byang chub kyi rgyu rkyen gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba la dmigs pa'i sems bskyed pa rnams kyis skye'o/ /de yang mi gnas pa ste/skyes nas zhig cing med do/ /de la sems gang gis dge ba'i rtsa ba mngon par 'dus byas pa dang / sems gang gis byang chub tu yongs su bsngos pa'i sems bskyed pa de dag phan tshun du 'brel ba mi byed do/ /'di lta ste dper na/ me ni gang nas ma 'ongs te/de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi shes rab kyi me yang gang nas kyang ma 'ongs mod kyi/ 'on kyang dge ba'i rtsa ba la brten nas 'bar te byung nas zhig cing med do/ /ye shes snang ba rab tu thob pa chos rnam par 'byed pa de lta bu dag la blo rnam par mi spyod pa gang yin pa de ni byang chub sems dpa'i yongs su bsngo ba'o/ /ji ltar mkhas pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i rgyu mthun pa'i thabs la mkhas pa dang ldan pa gang dag byang chub sems dpa'i skyon med pa la 'jug pa dang / lung bstan pa dang /bzod pa snang ba'i ye shes thob pa rnams kyi yongs su bsngo ba de bzhin gshegs pa la mngon sum du gyur cing / stobs bcu mnga' ba rnams dbang du gyur pa de bzhin du bdag kyang 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa'i bsngo ba la rjes su slob bo/ /rjes su sgrub bo/ /rjes su bgyid do/ /rgyas par bgyi ba'am bsdu yang rung ste/ mjug bsdu ba'i slad 258

phung po gsum chog/ pod/ 5khyedu/ gtso bo dang / dam pa dang sogs gong bzhin la/ bka' stsal ba'i yongs su bsngo bas yongs su bsngo'o/ /ji ltar bdag gi don du yongs su bsngos pa de bzhin du 'jig rten gyi khams sogs gong bzhin las/ thams cad kyi ched du yang bsngo'o/ /ji ltar bdag gis dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su bsdus te rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu smon lam btab pa de bzhin du yongs su 'grub par phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po smon lam rgya mchosare pha rol tu phyin pa rnams kyis bden tshig lha'i rnga sgra dbyangs su sgrog cing / shis brjod me tog gi char chen 'bum du snyil bas dge legs kyi dus ston kun nas rgyas pa'i byin rlabs snang ba dkar pos phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad du khyab par gyur cigade ltar brjod cing dus gsum du rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi sems rin po che yid la bya zhing thabs la mkhas pa'i 'jug pa zad mi shes pa 'di nyid nan tan chen pos bslab par bya ba'i rigs so/ /smras pa/ gang zhig de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos nyid dang / /mthun par smra ba'i ngag gi sbyor ba gcig /gleng bar mi 'jigs spobs pa gang thob pa/ /de kun sangs rgyas rnams kyi phrin las yin/ /de slad 'di la rgyu mtshan shes pa dang / /mos pa tsam gyis 'jug/ par 'dod pa'ang rung / /de dag rmad byung spyod pa'i gtam gyi skyes/ /bsod nams nor bu'i gter chen 'di 259

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/longs shig /gang dag grags pa tsam gyis rjes 'brangs nas/ /bdag gi legs par bshad pa mi bzhed kyang / /thub pa'i legs gsungs mdo sde ltos shig dang / /'di la phul byang nges pa skye yang ༄srid/ /gal te de dag tshul 'dir mi dgyes kyang / /phyogs re'i mig can rnams kyi spyan sngar 'chags/ /blo mig yangs por phyes pa'i mkhas pa dang / /'phags pa'i skye bo dgyes pa'i mchod sprin yin/ /de dge dri med padma'i rtsa ba ltar/ /rnam dkar snang ba gang zhig nyer thob pa/ /de yis 'jig rten kun la phan byed cing / /'gro kun byang chub zhi ba'i mchog brnyes shog /'phags pa phung po gsum pa'i mdo sde bklag chog tu bkod pa bsod nams yid bzhin rin po che'i sprin zhes bya ba yul rdo rong gi sprang 'khyams gzhon nu 'jigs med bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan nam/ ming gzhan kun bzang 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi ma phrin las kun khyab dpal bzang po zhes grags skam gyi ska rags bcings pa'i ban de snyom las pas sug bris su bgyis pa 'dis kyang ston pa phan bzhed mtshungs pa ma mchis pa'i bstan pa rin po che chos mdzod nor bu'i khang bzang tshe rabs thams cad du rdzogs par 'dzin pa'i smon lam gyi mthu yongs su grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig swasnyi bi dza yantu// //260

pod/ 5༄/ /thugs rje chen po sdug bsngal rang grol las sreg sbyong gi chog sgrig thar pa'i 'od ces bya ba bzhugs/ngo bo mi 'gyur rang byung stong pa'i gshis/ /rnam pa ma 'gags brdal ba rdo rje'i khams/ /cir yang snang ba kun mkhyen rjes brtse'i lha/ /'jigs med 'dzam gling rgyan des shis pa stsol/ /gang thugs mkha' la snying rje chen po nyid/ /ches rgyas phan bde'i 'od kyis mkha' khyab 'gro'i/ /sdug bsngal mun pa rang sar grol byed pa'i/ /lhag pa'i lha mchog bde chen 'khor lor rol/ /gang la brten na thags bskyed ye shes mes/ /kun dkris 'khor ba'i ༄bud shing nyer bsregs te/ /sgrib tshogs ma rig mun pa rab bcom nas/ /thar mchog bde chen lam snang mngon du byed/ /de phyir klong chen snying gi thig le yi/ /gsang sgrub thugs chen sdug bsngal rang grol gyi/ /zhi ba'i phrin las sreg sbyong cho ga ni/ /gzhung la brten nas dam pa'i bka' bzhin bkod/ /de la dang po sbyor ba ni/las gzhung bsrang ste sgrub mchod bum bzlas/ gnas lung lam sbyong yan chad grub nas/gang du bya ba'i gnas su bdag gi rnal 'byor la bsnyen bzhin pas/ gzhi bdag la 261

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dkar gtor dang gser skyems/ a kā ros brlabs te/ gang dag 'dir gnas lha dang klu/ /gnod sbyin srin po'am gzhan dag la/ /sa 'di bdag gis bslang bar bgyi/ /dkyil 'khor don du stsal du gsol/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang / /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing / /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs/ /dngos grub kun gyi sdong grogs mdzod/ /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang / /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang / /'bra rnams 'phel zhing ༄chos 'phel ba/ /dge legs thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod/ /kyis bsngo/ rdo rje dang bcas pa'i lag pa g.yas pa sa la bzhag ste/ hya skṛ ba'i sngags kyis kun rdzob tsam du sbyangs shing /don dam chos thams cad gdod ma nas stong zhing bdag med par rtogs pa'i nges shes kyis rgyas btab/ thabs stegs grub bzhi ba byung gis byugs pa'i khar/ tshangs skud kyis thig btab pa'i dbus nas/ mtho gang zlum bskor gyi phyi ru mchu dang kha khyer la sor bzhi re nang du blum bskom gcig gi nang du lte bar padmas mtshan pa'i 'dab bzhir sems ma bzhi dang / phyi mar dbang chen sde bzhi'i lha tshogs bkod/ phyi yi kha khyer la rdo 262

thugs chen sbyin sreg/ pod/ 5rshalkerje'i phreng ba dang / zur bzhir zla phyed rdo rje re re bris khar/ mthong brgyud bzhin sreg khang ngam shing thab brtsig la spar byed kyi me tshang sogs 'du byed/ thab dang nye bar slo ba dpon gyi g.yas su sreg rdzas/ yam shing / mar khu/ til/ yungs kar/ zho zan/'bras/ so ba/ nas/ sran ma/ gro/ durba/ ku sha/ sman sna/ gos zung / so rtsi rnams ye shes dang 'jig rten pa so sor tshan gnyis breng tshar dang / g.yon du mchod rdzas/ 'das ma 'das kyi gtor ma/ sman rag chu gnyis nyer spyod dang bcas pa mtha' skor du bsham/ mdun du bsang chu'i snod/ /rdor dril/ dgang blugs sogs dang /gzhan yang rlung g.yab dang ku sha'i chun po bzhi/ lce lde soṭa 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad thams cad tshang bar bya/ de nas bkru byugs dang gnas yig gdags pa sogs ro chas su gzhug pa rnams rje bla mas mdzad pa'i sgrib gnyis rnam grol ltar lag tu blangs nas/sbyo nga rgyud las ltung ba slong ba'i phyag rgya rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyi nang du mdzub mo lcags glu gas ltar bcings nas gyen du 'phangs shing / oṃ sarba a pa ya arṣa ṇa bi shwa dha na badzra sa ma ya hūṃ/ phaṭa/ ces dang 'dod rgyal gyi rgyas/ oṃshwa dha ni sarba pā paṃ a na ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces brjod pas ngan song gsum dang /sdig sgrib thams cad sreg rdzas la thim par bsam pa man ngag tu che bar gsungs so/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la lnga las/ dang po me spar ba ni/ gang zag mchog la/ dzwa la ram̐tsam gyis me sbar/ phal pa la/ gson gcig dgongs shig rigs kyi bu/ /phung po lnga yi bud shing la/ /rgyal ba rigs lnga'i me spar ro/ /'byung ba bzhi yi bud shing la/ /lha mo bzhi yi me sbar ro/ /dbang po drug gi bud shing la/ /byang chub sems kyi me sbar ro/ /yul rnam drug gi bud shing la/ /rgyal ba'i sku gsum me sbar ro/ /sku 263

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gsum ye shes lnga ldan du/ /'gro ba'i don gnyis grub par shog /oṃ badzra dzwa la ram̐ dzwa la ram̐/ zhes pas me sbar nas/ hūṃ brjod cing rlung g.yab kyis g.yab/ gnyis pa mchod sreg gi rdzas rnams byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ bsang chu 'thor zhing / oṃ swā bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mchod rdzas dang sreg rdzas rnams rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa 'od du zhu ba las byang ba'i rdzas so so'i dngos po bdud rtsi chen ༄po'i rang bzhin zad mi shes par gyur/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ sogs dang / sarba pañtsa rakta ba ling ta ga ṇa tsakra pū tsa āḥhūṃ/ lan bdun/ oṃm hā badzra hūṃ dang / ghanḍi hūṃ/ gis rdor dril brlabs/ dgang blugs thogs la/oṃ hūṃ tt+waṃ hrīḥ āḥ st+waṃ māṃ māṃ rpā tt+waṃ gyisakha sbyor zhing / dzñā na pañtsa a mṛ ta shudhe shudhe swā hā/ zhes de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor bsam/yam shing / oṃ bo dhi brikṣa ye/ marakhu/ asna ye/ til/ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzra ye/ yungasadakar/ badzra sirnyi ye/ zhozan/ sarba saṃ bha te/'bras/ badzra puṣṭa ya/ sob/ / badzra bī dzā ya/ nas/ ma hā be gā ya/sran ma/ ma hā ba la ya/ gro/ / badzra ghasmatree/ durba/ badzra a yu ṣeku sha/ a pra ti ha ta badzra ye/ smanasna/ badzra shrī ba ye swā hā/ zhes lan bdun gyis/ rdzas rnams ngo bo ye shes kyi bdud rtsi la rnam pa tshe 'das kyi sdig sgrib nyes ltung bsreg bya'i rdzas su gyur bar bsam/ gsum pa 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa ni bsang chu 'thor zhing / oṃ ma hā shu n+ya ta dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātmako3haṃ/264

thugs chen sbyin sreg/ pod/ 5po〉 stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i thab yangs shing rgya che ba tshad dang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su/ ra skyes steng na ram̐ las me lha dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas dang pos padma dang / gnyis pas nor bu'i phreng ba/ g.yon dang pos dbyug pa dang / gnyis pas ril ba spyi blugs 'dzin pa'o/ /dbyug gu'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ/ tshur spyon tshur spyon 'byung po che/ /me lha drang srong bram ze mchog /sreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du//'di nyid du ni gshegs su gsol/ /asna ye ma hā te dzwa e hya hi sa ma ya dza dzaḥ zhes mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa la las chu dang sngags kyis phyir 'brang gi bgegs bskrad nas/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs gnyis su med par gyur/ oṃ asna ye padma ka lā ye st+waṃ/ zhes gdan phul/ ku sha thogs te/ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge/ /sa las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed yin/ /tshangs pa'i yang dag byed pa ste/ /de yis bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /bgegs rnams med cing zhi bar mdzod/ /ces pas thab gyi kha g.yon nas brtsams te g.yas bskor du dgram/oṃ asna ye swā hā/ mar khu blugs gzar bdun gyis bkang ba'i dgang blugs kha sbya ra ba 'bul zhing / oṃ asna ye dī bya dī bya bi shuja ma hā shrī ha bya ka bya bha ha na ya tshe las 'das pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad shīrnye ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes tshar gsum gyis 'bul/ gtsang zhing gtsang mar 265

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/zhe sbyar ba yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod yon 'di/ /drang srong 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /tshe 'das don du bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ asna ye ma hā te dzwa arghaṃ pra tī tstsha pū dza me gha sa mu tra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ phaṭa/ gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar ba yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i zhabs bsil 'di/ / drang srong 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /tshe 'das don du bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ agha ye ma hā te dzwa paju pra tī tstsha pū dza me gha sa mu tra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ phaṭa/ /gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar ba yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i me tog dang / /drang srong 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /tshe 'das don du bzhes su gsol/ / oṃ agha ye ma hā te dzwa puṣpe pra tī tstsha pū dza me gha sa mu tra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ phaṭa/ /gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar ba yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i bdug spos 'di/ /drang srong 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /tshe 'das don du bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ asna ye ma hā te dzwa dhu pe pra tī tstsha pū dza me gha sa mu tra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ phaṭa/ /gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar ba yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i snang gsal 'di/ /drang srong 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /tshe 'das don du bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ asna ye mahā te dzwa a lo ke pra tī tstsha pū dza me gha sa mu tra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ phaṭa/ gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar ba yi/ /lha rdza dam pa'i dri chab 'di/ /drang srong 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /266

thugs chen sbyin sreg/ pod/ 5tshe 'das don du bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ agha ye mahā te dzwa gadhe pra tī tstsha pū dza me gha sa mu tra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ phaṭa/ gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar ba yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i zhal zas 'di/ /drang srong 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /tshe 'das don du bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ asna ye ma hā te dzwa nee wi tepra tī tstsha pū dza me gha sa mu tra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ phaṭa/ gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar ba yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i rol mo 'di/ /drang srong 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /tshe 'das don du bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ asna ye ma hā te dzwa shabha pra tī tstsha pū dza me gha sa mu tra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ phaṭa/ ces dbul/ de nas bsreg rdzas rnams/ oṃ asna ye che ge mo'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad sarba pā paṃ shīnti ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes pa kho nas rdzas so so nas nyi shu rtsa gcig re sogs kyis phul mthar/ oṃ asna ye ma hā te dzwa arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po ḍakkis dbang bskur ba/ /shes rab mchog gis nyon 'amongs thams cad sreg /'dzin byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud/ /ces pas bstod/ bzhi pa ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor mchod pa ni oṃ swabhā wās stong par sbyangs la/ me lha'i lto ba yangs shing rgya che'i nang / /dbyings rig zung 'jug dag pa chen po'i zhing : rang snang lhun grub ri bo po tā la: brda rtags mtshan nyid rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor dbus:267

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ sna tshogs padma stong ldan nyi zla'i steng : trīḥlas 'gro 'dul 'phags mchog snying rje'i lha: sdug bsngal rang grol spyan ras gzigs dbang skur: zhal gcig phyag bzhi mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs: rtsa ba'i phyag gnyis thugs kar thal sbyar tshul:lhag ma rnam gnyis bgrang phreng pad dkar 'chang : longs spyod rdzogs sku dar dang rin chen mdzes: dkar dmar mdangs ldan rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras: zhi tshul dgu dang rgyan cha bcu gsum mdzes: dbu gtsug rigs bdag 'od dpag med pas mtshan:phyogs bzhir padma 'dab bzhi'i gdan steng du: shar du rje btsun sgrol ma sku mdog dkar: lho ru 'od zer can ma gser gyi mdog:nub tu ku ru kulle pad rag mdangs: byang du nor rgyun lha mo sku mdog ljang : kun kyang rang rang rgyan dang cha lugs rdzogs: sgo bzhir dbang chen sde bzhi las mdog can0 gri gug thod 'dzin cador stabs 'jigs tshul rngams: khro bo'i chas rdzogs me da pung klong na 'gyings: bar mtshams sangs rgyas byang sems rig 'dzin dang : dpa' bo ḍākki dam can sprin ltar gtibs: snang stong sgrib g.yogs bral ba'i dbyings na gsal: kun kyang gnas gsum yig 'bru gsum gyis mtshan: de las 'od 'phros rang bzhin gnas mchog dang : khyad par sprul pa'i zhing khams po tā 268

thugs chen sbyin sreg/ pod/ 5la: gnas yul nyer bzhi dur khrod brgyad sogs nas: ye shes lha tshogs badzra sa mā dza: spyan 'dren pa ni/ hrīḥ nub phyogs bde chen dbang gi pho brang nas: mgon po 'od dpag med pa gshegs su gsol: sprul pa'i zhing khams ri bo tā la nas: 'gro 'dul spyan ras gzigs dbang gshegs su gsol: thugs rjes 'gro ba 'dul ba'i pho brang nas: dkyi la 'khor lha tshogs ma lus gshegs su gsol: bdag cag sgrub pa po la byin gyis rlobs:mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol: oṃ lo ki shwa ra gu ru de wa ḍākki nī sarba sa mā ya dzaḥdzaḥ bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hrīḥdamigs med rang grol thugs rje'i dkyil 'khor lhar: gshegs byon bzhugs su gsol bar mi dmigs kyang : gnyis snang glo bar dri ma sbyang ba'i phyir0 dam ye gnyis med ngo bor brtan par dmi mi /rdo)bzhugs: badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha ho: phyaga'atshal ba ni/ hrīḥ bcom ldan thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs la: rang shes 'khrul pa bral ba'i brda phyag gar: lha chen 'phrul dga'i rnam 'gyur ji bzhin du: spang blang med pa'i ngang nas btsal bar bgyi: na mo pu ru sha ya ho: mchod pa ni/ hrīḥ kun tu bzang po'i rnam rol mchod pa'i sprin: me tog bdug spos mar me dri chab dang : zhal zas rol mo 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga: lha mi'i dpal 'byor ma lus 269

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/'bul lo bzhesaḥ oṃ badzra arghaṃ nas/ shabha rū pa shabha gandhe rā sa padhe ma hā sarba pū dza khā hi: khyad par gyi mchod pa ni/ trīḥ khyad par rmad byung bde ba chen po'i rdzas: sman gtor rakta tshogs mchod dngas re spro: shes rab rig ma blo 'das gnyug ma'i gshis:'bul lo bzhes nas dbang dang dngos grub stsol: sarba pañtsa rakta ba ling ta ma hā su kha dharma dhartu pū tsa hoḥ gang zag mchog la ro dang lha dbyer med du bskyed nas mchod pa dang / phal pa la sha khrag rus gsum bdud rtsir bsam ste mchod rdzas dbul ba ni/ dgang blugs kyi kha dang dkyil 'khor ba'i lha tshogs rnams kyi ljags la hūṃ dang ram̐ yig so sor mtshan pas bsreg rdzas kyi bdud rtsi dgyes bzhin du bzhes par gyur bar bsams la/ na maḥ sa manta bujamāṃ/ oṃ asna ye swā hā/ zhes lan bdun gyis mar khus bkang ba'i dgang blugs kha sbyar te g.yas su bskor nas/ tshe las 'das pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad shitt+waṃ ku ru ye swā hā/zhes lan gsum gyis phul nas/ rdzas gzhan rnams la/ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūṃ hrīḥche ge mo'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad sarba shinti ku ru ye swā hā/zhes pa kho nas brgya sogs kyis phul zhing / slar yang / tarya thā/ oṃ a mi ti a mi te/ a mi tod bha be/ a mi ta saṃ bha be/ a mi ta bi krarnye/a mi ta ga mi ni sarba kle ṣa/ kṣa yi ka ra swā hā/ dang rtsa rigs la sham bu sbyar nas til dang yungs dkar bung bskyed la dbul zhing / de dag rnams kyi tshe 270

thugs chen sbyin sreg/ pod/ 5dmigs yul rjes su dran pa'i de la phan pa'i bsam pas sngags bzla zhing sreg blugs byas pas/ bdag dang lha rnams las ye shes kyi 'od zer dkar po 'phros te dmigs yul la thim pas de yi sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad dag par bsam mo/ /rdzas rdzogs pa dang / oṃ badzra tambu la ye swā hāsasortsi dang / oṃ badzra wasta ye swā hā/gos zung dbul/ 'grub na lha mo bcu drug gi mchod phreng ngam/ bsdu na arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ hrīḥ chos dbyings spros pa bral ba'i pho brang nas:lhun grub longs spyod rdzogs pa'i mnga' dbang can: tshad med snying rje'i gter chen spyan ras gzigs: sdug bsngal rang grol sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: tshad med bzhi yis 'gro kun thar lam 'dren: gang la gang 'dul thugs rje rol pa'i gar: cir yang sgyur ba'i mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul can: rigs bzhi'i sems ma rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod: rnam bzhi'i phrin las kun la dbang bsgyur zhing : log 'dren 'dul phyir khro gtum rol ba'i stabs:thogs med bsgyur ba'i rigs bzhi'i hya thā: dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: phrin las bcol ba ni/ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyis tshad med pa'i thugs rje chen pos 'jig rten 'di nas pha rol tu tshe las 'das pa che ge mo'i tshe rabs 'khor ba thog med nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad lhag ma med par byang zhing dag nas thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go — 271

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/'phang mchog la 'god par mdzad du gsol/ zhes lan gsum/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang sogs kyi mthar yi ge brgya pas nongs pa bshags/oṃ khyed kyis sems can sogs nas/ badzra muḥs ye shes pa gshegs/ lnga ba me lha la gtang rag gtong zhing bsdu ba ni/ mar khu dang bcas/ oṃ asna ye dzwa la ram̐/ zhes pas me lha shin tu gsal bar byas te/ bsreg rdzas lhag ma rnams/ oṃ agha ye sdig sgrig nyes ltung thams cad shinti ku ru ye swāhā/ zhes pas phal/ oṃ asna ye irda bha lidha kha kha khā hi/ gtor ma phal/ badzra tai ba ni ri dmi ༅ rib byelaye swā hāsasortsi dang / oṃ badzra wasta ye swā hās gos zung rnams phul/ me ste bsreg bya za ba'i lha/ /drang srong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar lho me lha'i tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// zhes pas bstod/ yig brgyas nongs bshags/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don/ /sgrub byed bsreg bya za ba gshegs/ /ji lta'i dus su tshur byon la/ /las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ /badzra mus ye shes pa shar lhor gshegs/ dam tshig pa me 'bar ba'i klong du thim par bsams la bsngo smon gyis rgyas gdab/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ gis rang nyid bsrung zhing / shi rgab gcod phyir bkra shis rgyas pas mtha' brgyan par bya'o// //272
nga chosnrod che

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/༄/ /tshe ring mched lnga'i mnga' gsol phan bde'i pho nya bzhugs so//hūṃ/ mkha' spyod gnas yul nyer bzhi'i bdag /lhan skyes badzra wā ri hi/ /'jig rten 'das kyang srid na snang / /zhing skyes rigs lngar mnga' gsol lo/ /dpyid dang thig le mnyam sbyor ba'i//'pho med bde stong rdo rje'i srog /'od gsal ye shes ḍākki ni/ /tshe 'dzin mched lngar mnga' gsol lo/ /don gyi mkha' 'gro gnyug ma'i yid/ /phyag rgya rtags kyi skur bzhengs pa/ /rjes chags bzhad pa'i lang tsho can/ /sman btsun mched lngar mnga' gsol lo//snang srid srid pa ma mo'i dal/ /gzod nas rang rtsal rdzogs pa'i phyir/ /dus gsum kun la dbang bsgyur ma/ /tshe ring mched lnga mnga' gsol lo/ /khrag 'thung rig 'dzin padma yis/ /rdo rje gsang ba'i dam bsgrags tshe/ /bod khams skyong bar zhal bzhes pa//brtan ma chen mor mnga' gsol lo/ /sngags rig grub brnyes rgya mtsho'i dpyid/ /rnal 'byor yongs kyi mdza' na mo/ /dam ldan bu bzhin skyong mdzad ma/ /rdo rje'i srung mar mnga' gsol lo/ /yid chos dbu mar thim pa'i gzugs/ /kun khyab nam mkha'i sku mnga' 274

bka' srung chos skyong gsol bstod skor/ pod/ 5ma/ /yul chen nyer bzhi'i bdag mo mdzad/ /zhing skyong gtso mor mnga' gsol lo/ /rig stong mi 'gyar thig le che/ /phul byang ༄shi ra dngos grub rgya mcho1) mdzod/ /yid bzhin re ba skong mdzad ma/ /tshe ster lha mor mnga' gsol lo/ /mdor na sman btsun mkha' 'gro che/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i rje mo lnga/ /dus gsum kun tu mchod bsten pas/ /rnal 'byor don kun yongs rdzogs mdzod/ /ces pa 'ang a bhyas gang dran skad cig la bris pa ste/ grub chen rin po ches mdzad pa'i mnga' gsol 'dug kyang gter gzhung gi tshig dang bstun te bkod pa'o/ /dge'o// //༄7/ /padma thod phreng rtsal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig gis shan pa srog sgrub ma'i mchod skong gi cho ga shin tu bsdus te bya bar 'dod pas/ mchod gtor 'du byas te/hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ zhes brjod pas rang nyid skad cig gis padma thod phreng rtsal drag shul khros pa'i sku can du gyur/ rang gi mdun du gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor chen por gsod byed kyi shan pa srog sgrub ma zhal gcig phyag gnyis chu gri dang mi snying 'dzin pa sku mdog nag la rngam pa srid pa'i rlung la bzhon pa 'khor du sha za 'bum gyis bskor ba/ sa gsum zil gyis gnon pa'i bdag nyid can du bzhugs par gyur/ rol mo daklol la/ hūṃ bhyoḥchos dbyings skye ba med pa las/ /skye ba'i cho 'phrul rngam pa'i sku/ /srog sgrub shan pa 'khor dang bcas/ /ma thogs myur du 'dir 275

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gshegs shig /badzra sa māḥdzaḥzhes spyan drangs/ sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan/gyis bzhugs su gsol/ hūṃ bhyoḥ rang bzhin dag pa'i gnas mchog 'dir/ /ting 'dzin sgyu 'phrul sprul pa'i gar/ /srog sgrub shan pa 'khor bcas rnams/ /thugs dam bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni/ /bdud rtsi sman gyi rgya mtsho bskyil/ /dmar chen rakta'i dba' klong 'khrugs/ /dza gad bcud kyi sprin phung 'khrigs/ /phud skyems btung ba'i rgyun bzang sbrengs/ /tshil chen gsur gyi dri ngad 'thul/ /sna tshogs g.yang gzhi'i rgyal mtshan sogs/ /thugs kyi dgyes pa bskang ba'i rdzas/ /bzhed dgu'i rol mor 'char ba'i sprin/ /nam mkha' gang ba'i longs spyod kyis/ /srog sgrub nag mo'i thugs dam bskang / /spyang gdong rngam ma'i thugs dam bskang / kha dog 'bar ma'i thugs dam bskang / /'ug gdong nag mo'i thugs dam bskang / /sha za 'bum sde'i thugs dam bskang / /thugs dam gnyan po bskangs nas kyang / /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi/ /mi mthun bar chad zhi ba dang / /mthun rkyen legs tshogs gong 'phel ba'i/ /phrin las thogs med 'grub par mdzod/ /spro na/ oṃ nag mo khyi kha le sa pā ri wa ra e dam bha lidha kha tī/ zhes gsum mam bdun gyis gtor 'bul bya/ bsdu na gtor ma med kyang rung / mthar/badzra mus/ srog sgrub 'khor dang bcas pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs su 276

bka' srung chos skyong gsol bstod skor/ pod/ 5lgegasol/ zhes pa'ang jo bo ri mo mkhan na tha'i ming can ngor sprang smyon 'jigs med pas smras pa'o// dge'o// //༄/ /bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag nyid nga rgyal brtan po'i nga / /mdun du dkar bgegs gtor ma dang / /skyems phud phye mar la sogs bsham/ ram̐yi khaṃ gis byin rlobs shing / 'bru gsum nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags/ /phyag rgya ldan pas rab tu spel// kye/ rang bzhin ka dag spros bral chen po'i dbyings/ /snang brtags shes bya'i grwa zur mi dmigs kyang / /kun byed sgyu ma sems kyi cho 'phrul du/ /dag dang ma dag brtan g.yo'i snang char shar/ /de slad rig pa rang snang rol pa'i rgyan/ /ma rtogs 'khrul ngor gzhan snang dregs pa'i zol/ /lha dang lha min mkha' 'gro dam tshig can/ /ma lus 'khor bcas gtor ma'i mgron la gshegs/ /khyad par mdo smad rdo rong srin mo rdzong / /ri dang nags tshal rdza brag srang mdo sogs/ /gnas skyong gzhi bdag rang rang 'khor tshogs bcas/ /kun kyang 'dir gshegs bden pa'i tha tshig dgongs/ /dkar mngar sha khrag 'bras bus brgyan pa yi/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'dod dgu'i rgya mtsho dang / /ro mchog brgya ldan dbang po sim byed pa'i/ /gtsang ma phud kyi bdud rtsi gser skyems sogs/ /dngos su bshams dang yid las byung ba yi/ /gzugs mdzes sgra snyan dri zhim ro mngar dang / /reg 'jam lha 277

21rngad/ ji lngardo /spyorngan khur:drotha/thag cesacad rnganastagazud ༷ste:re ba/shākyithab 'o/dra/zug/ phanardzas rnam pa du ma'i tshogs/ /mi zad longs spyod nam mkha' mdzod lta bus/ /spyi ru snang srid dregs pa sde brgyad dang / /bye brag yul 'di'i gnas bdag gzhi bdag rigs/ /glo bur lhabs/ dang gnyug mar gnas pa'i sde/ /thugs dam skong zhing dgyes pa bskyed gyur cig /bhu mi pa ti sa pa ri wa ra i dam ba lidha kha hi/lan bdun brjod cing mgron la bsngo/ kun snang rig pa sgyu ma'i rnam ro' du/ /mi 'char srid zhi'i dngos snang yod min pas/ /yongs grub ye shes chen po'i phyag rgya ni/ /phan tshogs gter gyi rgya mtshor cir ༄yang snang / /de ltar bdag gis mchod dang bsnyen bkur mthus/ ༈ lha srin dregs pa yid kyi gzugs can rnams/ /sred pa'i shing rta phyur bur khengs nas kyang / /gnod par sems pa'i khon 'dzin zhi gyur cig /phyogs rnams kun kyang rdzogs ldan dga' ba bzhin//bde zhing dge ba'i dus ston dar babs shing / /skye dgu thams cad tshe ring nad med sogs/ /mtho ris yon tan bdun gyis 'byor gyur cig /gtor ma gshegs shing skyems phud gtor/ bhu mi pa ti sa pā ri wā ra gatstsha/ zhes brjod mgron rnams rang sar gshegs/ smon lam sa/dab cing shes pa brjod/ ces pa'ang sngags 'chang me long rdo rje dang / rtogs ldan dharma blu tu'i zhal nas bsngags shing nye char btsun pa chos ldan gyis kyang bskul ba'i ngor/'jigs med pas so// //278

bka' srung chos skyong gsol bstod skor/ pod/ 5༄༅/ /bla ma blo ldan mchog sred la na mo/ gang zhig gis mgon po legs ldan gyi mnga' gsol bya bar 'dod pas/ dbyangs gdangs snyan pos/ hūṃ/ mi 'gyur bde chen lhan skyes ye shes dngos/ /'gags med sgyu 'phrul rol mor 'bar ba'i gar/ /zhi chags khro bo'i rnam rol mtha' klas pas//dgyes mdzad rdo rje'i gzugs skur mnga' gsol lo/ /rnam kun mchog ldan spros bral dbyings nyid las/ /'pho med rig stong rdo rje srin po'i gzugs/ /snang gsum mtshan ma'i khams la khros pa'i nyams/ /'jigs mdzad dpa' bo chen por mnga' gsol lo/ /zhi ba chos sku'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang / /drag shul khros pa'i sgyu 'phrul rnam mang pos/ khams gsum 'od gsal dbyings su sgrol mdzad pa/ /bdud 'dul khrag 'thung dpa' bor mnga' gsol lo/ / dpyid dang thig le mnyam sbyar gnyug ma'i srog /zung 'jug ye shes chen por rtsal rdzogs pas/ /bde stong bdud rtsis myos pa'i bzhad sgra can/ /'dod chags rdo rje'i gsung du mnga' gsol lo/ /mtha' yas srid zhi'i dngos snang ma lus pa/ kha sbyor ye shes dbyings su rgyas thebs pas/ /brtan g.yo snang srid zil gnon he ru ka /gshe mdzad gtum chen rdo rje mnga' gsol lo/ /rtog tshogs dhu tir thim pa'i bde ba mchog /las rlung zas su zos pa'i rkan sgra yis/ /skye dang 'chi ba'i grong khyer kun 'jig pa/ /279

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/khrag 'thung 'bum sde'i gtso bor mnga' gsol lo/ /gnyug ma'i phung khams snang stong phyag rgya che/ /bde chen sgyu 'phrul 'khor lor ro gcig pas/ /kun snang snying rje'i nyams brgyar 'bar ba'i dpyid/ /snang srid gzhi bzhengs chen por mnga' gsol lo/ /chos nyid ngang gis khros pa lhan skyes dbyings/ /rang byung ye shes khro bor mi phyed pa'i/ /khro la khror ston 'jigs byed rngam pa'i thugs/khams gsum zil gnon chen por mnga' gsol lo/ /khro chags phyag rgya'i cho 'phrul cir snang yang / /gzhi grol ka nas dag pa'i stong chen dbyings/ mi shigs sems kyi rdo rje zung 'jug pa/ /rnam par mi rtog thugs su mnga' gsol lo/ /mdor na rnam mang gar dgu'i rol pa yis/ /'gro 'dul phrin las rnam bzhi'i 'jug pa can/ /bstan bsrung dregs pa 'bum sde'i gtso mchog che/ /legs ldan nag po chen por mnga' gsol lo/ /mnga' gsol byas so lha chen dur khrod bdag /dbu 'phang bstod do bka' sdod dregs pa'i rje/ /gzi byin bskyed do legs ldan tshogs kyi bdag /rdo rje'i g.yar dam gnyan po rjes su dgongs/ /dpal chen spyan sngar ji ltar dam mnos bzhin/ /thub bstan spyi dang khyad par rdo rje'i theg /mi nub phyogs dus kun tu rgyas mdzad cing / /sa gsum phan bder sbyor ba'i phrin las mdzod/ /ces bskang ba'i rjes su 280

bka' srung chos skyong gsol bstod skor/ pod/ 5bya'o/ /zhes pa'ang bla ma dzñā na sā mu dra'i bzhed ngor sprang 'khyams 'jigs med pas so/ /dge'o// //༄༅/ /shri he ru ka la na mo/ mchod skong gi nyer bsdus ni/ mchod skong gi rdzas bzang la mang ba sngags rgya dang bsam gtan gyis spel te/ bhyoḥ bde chen sgyu ma'i rol pa las/ /ye shes 'jig rten ma mo'i tshal/ /dbyings ༄phyug dpal ldan re mā ti/ /rje khol sprul par bcas pa la phyag 'tshal phyi nang mchod pa 'bul/ /rmongs dang bag med dbang gyur bas/ /so thar byang sems gsang sngags kyi/ /tshul khrims bslab pa nyams pa dang / /ma mo'i khyad par dam tshig la/ /'gal zhing nongs pa ci mchis pa/ /thog med nas bsags sdig ltung dang / /lhan cig gnong zhing 'gyod pas bshags/ /thab gzhob dme 'khon grib rigs dang / /byad phur gdon bgegs rkyen dbang gis/ /dam can mi dgyes gyur pa rnams/ /chos dbyings rnam dag bden pas bsal/ /'gro la ma ltar brtse ba yi/ /thugs rjes dgongs te tshangs par mdzod/ /mkha' 'gro 'khrugs pa'i rgyu 'bras kun/ /zhi nas 'dod pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /zhes pa'ang mkhas btsun dam pa ngag dbang kun dga' grags pa sogs nas bskul ba ltar a bhyas bris/ / 281

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/༄//dpal ldan sngags kyi srung ma la bstod cing phrin las 'chol ba'i rim pa bdud las rnam par rgyal ba'i rnga sgra zhes bya ba bzhugs/na ma shrī ma he shwa ra he ru ka ya/ he ru ka dpal 'bar ba'i bka' yis bstan srung gtso mor dbang bskur ba/ /shes rab phar phyin ma mo'i gzugs 'chang dbyings phyug rdo rje ral gcig ma/ /sgrub la mi mnyam byams pa'i ma khyod sngags bdag dregs pa'i dmag dpung bcas/ /padma'i sngags rgyud skyong bar zhal bzhes thags dam ma g.yel dus 'dir dgongs/ /ye shes gzi chen nyi ༄ma'i spyan gyis bdud sde'i dkyil 'khor sreg mdzad cing / /khros pa'i gad mo drag por dgod pas bgegs kyi grong rnams tshal bar 'gas/ /thugs rje'i nu bum mdzes par dud las dngos grub 'dzad med rgyun 'jo ba'i/ /khyod kyi ngo mtshar rgya mtsho 'phyur ba'i dba' rlabs ring po phyogs 'dir spros/ /gdug sems rlung gis nye bar bskyod pas pha rol sbyor ba nag po'i sprin/ /dug mtshon me sogasabyu'ajigs brgya'i skyin thang lhog lhog khol zhing 'ongs pa rnams//phyir bzlog dmod pa'i 'thor rlung chen pos rdul tsam med par 282

〈co sprebam/'o/ sdosupa( ཿdzathag nyuṣṭhaspreng pe/bes95 rngaku/sterngasno 14zing/ 21rngad/ spre bshigs pa'i shul/ /dge legs nyi gnyon snang ba'i gos kyis phyogs kun li khri ldan par mdzod/ /ljongs 'dir phan bde'i 'byor pa 'phrogs shing 'thab rtsod dbul phongs nad la sogs/ /byur gyi mig mang rnam par rtse ba'i ma rungs nag phyogs 'byung po'i sde/ /srid pa za byed 'bar ba'i zhal hom gnam sa gdangs ltar bzhad pa'i klong / ljags dmar dus mtha'i me phung g.yo 'dras skad cig nyid du drongs la zo/ /drag shul gar gyi rlung chen bskyod pas stong gsum kun nas rab 'khrugs ma/ /khyod kyis sa 'og 'jig rten dkrugs byed rol pa'i rdzu 'phrul gar mdzod la/ /bdag cag lag 'gro'i gdon la gtad dang phung sel bcug pa'i mngal rgya rnams/ /sprugs te phas rgol byad ma'i brang la khu tshur drag pos chad pa phob/ /gzhan yang che btsan dbang phyug grub pas bstan pa srung bar gnyer ldan pa/ /dpal 'bar rdo rje nag po che dang rdo rje legs pa sgra gcan nag /dur khrod bdag mo yang le ber sogs 'jig rten skyong ba'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /dngos grub bar chad bgegs rnams ma lus drag po las kyi g.yul du rlogs/ /mdor na thabs mchog lte ba rab brling shes rab dam pa'i mu khyud can/ /las bzhi'i rtsibs stong rnam par bkra ba'i 'khor lo rin chen khyod kyi mthus/ /bdud dang phyir rgol las 283

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/nyon rnam rtog dgra rnams kun las rgyal gyur te/ /rnam grol sku bzhi'i rgyal thabs dbang sgyur sa gsum dge ba'i bkra shis stsol/ /ces pa'ang padma rdo rje dang blo bzang chos ldan gnyis kyi ngor/ bstan pa'i nyi mas 'bar ba smin zla'i nyer dgu la sbyar ba rnam bzhi'i phrin las thogs med du 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ //༄//dur khrod lha mo la bstod pa gnod sbyin kun tu dga' ba'i dbyangs zhes bya ba/rdo rje srin mo nyi ma'i zhal mnga' glog ltar 'bar ba'i khro gnyer can/ /dmar ser me yi ral pa gyen brdzes skyin thang rlung nag g.yo ba dang / /smin ma yon po'i lta stangs res kyang sa gsum ban pa bzhin 'thib pa'i/ /bdud kyi bdud chen gtum mo khros ༄mas bdud rnams 'jigs pa skyed gyur cig /glal ba'i shugs kyis rab dmar zhal gdangs dug rlangs na bun cher 'khrigs shing / /stong khams ma lus dar bzhin 'bar ba'i dmod sngags 'brug stong nga ro ldir/ /sdig can snying khrag hub kyis btung ba'i rngams zhal khrag gi zham chu can/ /dran pa'i mod la bdud sde mthar byed 'jigs med lcam mo des srungs shig /spu gri'i sen mo mdung ltar gzengs pas byad gdon snying rtsa thal 'byin zhing / /284

bka' srung chos skyong gsol bstod skor/ pod/ 5mi gson lto ba thad kar dral nas khrag ldan rgyu lto zhal 'dren pa/ /phung byed bdud mo bshan pa'i lag can dam nyams srog dbugs mnga' mdzad mo/ /bka' sdod 'bar ma bye ba'i gtso khyod sdig can bdud la nus mthu ston/ /ce spyang mche ba khrag gis dmar rnams bzod par dka' ba'i sgra sgrogs shing / /ro lang khros pa'i bshugs skad rab 'don mi ro'i khang pa ngam gnag par/ /zhing bcu'i klad khrag rul ba'i mtsho la mi thod skyog gis 'chu mdzad ma/ /dur khrod ma mo dme ba can khyod nyams pa can la kha phru thobs/ /la la me 'bar g.yang gzhi'i gos mnabs klu bdud khros pa'i ska rags bcings/ /'ga' zhig gcer mo gdug pa'i dri 'thul ltas ngan brgya ba'i 'o dod 'bod/ /gzhan dag 'chi med lang tsho'i nyi gzhon 'jig rten mngon par dga' ba'i dpyid/ /rdo rje srin mo sna tshogs gzugs khyod deng 'dir bdud la mngon spyod mdzod/ /padma'i mig can padmo'i mdog mtshungs padma lta bur 'dzum pa'i zhal//'o 'dzin padma kha 'bus dbyibs 'dra 'jam zhing mnyen pa padma'i lag /dga' chen padmo'i zhags pa re res khams gsum rnam par 'ching nus pa/ /'od chen 'bar ma lha brgya'i gtso mos bde ba mchog gi dga' ston spel/ /mkha' ltar zhi ba chos kyi sku yang rdo rje khros pa'i snyems 'chang zhing / /bde chen snying rje'i 'dzum dkar 285

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dgod kyang mi sdug srin mo'i rnam rol can/ /dpal ldan lhan cig skyes ma'i mchog kyang ngan ne ma zhes mtshan bsgrags pa/ /de yis bdag la don kun grub pa'i dngos grub rgya chen char du snyil/ /dur khrod lha mo'i bstod pa gnod sbyin kun tu dga' ba'i dbyangs zhes bya ba rdo shod kyi smyon pa 'jigs med pas sbyar ba'o/ /maṅga lo// //༄//dkor srung dur khrod lha mo'i mnga' gsol yid bzhin 'phrul gyi lcags kyu zhes bya ba/hūṃ bhyo/ dus gsum 'gyur med rnam kun mchog ldan zhal/ /lhun grub dga' bzhi'i rol mor 'bar ba'i gzugs/ /zhi chags khro mo'i gar gyis rnam rol pa/ /bstan srung 'bum sde'i rje mor mnga' gsol lo/ /gnas yul dur khrod rgya mtsho'i zhing skyong gtso/ /brtul zhugs grub brnyes yongs kyi mdza' na mo/ /dga' chen rdo rje'i lam gyi pho nya ba/ /bde ster ḍakki'i gtso mor mngal gsol lo//'a'apho 'gyur gnyis snang rtog pa'i drwa ba kun/ /'pho med 'od gsal dbyings su bsdams pa las/ /rjes chags nyams brgya'i gzi byin 'chang ba'i dngos/ /lhan skyes rang byung rje mor mngal gsol lo/ /dbyings phyug sngags kyi rgyal mo e ka tsa/ /theg mchog bstan pa rgya mtsho'i srung ma ru/ /las byed 'khor gyi mkha' 'gro'i 286

bka' srung chos skyong gsol bstod skor/ pod/ 5skur bzhengs pa/ /gsang rgyud gnyer 'dzin chen mor mnga' gsol lo/ /kun khyab rig stong rdo rje'i phyag rgya yis/ khams gsum nam mkha'i mdzod du rgyas btab pas/ /dgyes sprin longs spyod chen po'i mdzod brnyes pa/ /dkor srung khros pa'i rgyal mor mnga' gsol lo/ /srog rtsol dbu mar thim pa'i bde ba mchog /rdo rje chags pa'i gzags skur mngon bzhengs te/ /sa gsam rigi shi risi phu'aphrul gyi lcags kyus 'gugs mdzad pa/ /gnod sbyin mdzes ldan lha mor mnga' gsol lo/ /mdor na dus kun lhan skyes pho nya mo/ /mkha' spyod grub pa'i zhal skyin khyod mchod na/ /mi phyed ye shes 'khor lor ro gcig pas/ /gang 'dul phrin las rnam bzhi'i 'bras smin mdzod/ /ces bka' sdod las kyi ma mo'i phrin las kyi 'dzum dkar gsar bas kun nas 'khyud pa'i byis pa gzhon nu a bha yas bris pa kun nas kun tu dge bar gyur cig sarba maṅga lam̐// // ༄/ /dbang phyug phud mastod kyi tshig phreng 'dod don char rgyun 'jo ba'i dbyar rnga zhes bya ba bzhugs so//dpal ldan bla ma he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dbang phyug ma la phrin las 'chol bar 'dod pas/ 'byor na chos sman dang sbyar ba'i chang phud ban gang yan chad dang /khrag skyems rakta'i phabs ldan/ gser skyems bzang mang rnams bshams/ ma 'byor yang chang phud la chos sman btab pa mtshon tsam ni med mi rung la/ gser skyems ni 287

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ngan nyung gis gtan mi rung ngo/ /bdag bskyed sgyu 'phrul khro bo lta bu bka' gter gang rung rgyas par bya ba'am/ ma grub na phyag rgya gcig pa tsam sngon du btang / 'bru gsum brgya rtsa brgyad sogs kyis skyems rnams nus ldan du brlabs/ phud kyi cha// oṃ mchod do/ /byin rlabs kyi gter/ dngos grub kyi 'byung gnas/ rtsa ba dang brgyud pa'i bla ma/ bde gshegs zhi khro rab 'byams thams cad kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes 'bul/ de nas ru lu'i dzab dbyangs ci rigs kyis spyan drangs la spos rol bya/ dar g.yab/ ho/ chos dbyings zhi ba chen po'i klong nas/ thugs rje khros pa'i rang mdangs sgyu ma ltar shar ba/ gtso 'khor ye shes kyi ngo bo gcig kyang / rnam 'gyur las byed kyi pho nyar bstan pa/ 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi mu ran skyong zhing / rnam bzhi'i phrin las thogs med du byed pa/'dod khams lha'i lcam mo/ dbang phyag ru tra'i chung ma/ dpal ༄chen gsang ba'i sgrol yum/ gsang sngags bka'i srung ma/ ye shes rtags kyi phra men/ sprul pa las kyi srin mo/ rbod gtong myur mgyogs kyi pho nya/ dgongs pa 'jig rten las 'das kyang /mdzad spyod 'jig rten ltar ston pa/ 'jig rten nyul zhing 'jig rten skyong ba/ 'jig rten gsum gyi gtso mo/ stong gsum gyi legs nyes gzigs pa/ skye 'gro rtsis la 'debs pa/ 'byung lnga'i skyed sdud la dbang ba/ rtsal gyis nam mkha' gnon pa/ bang phyogs 288

bka' srung chos skyong gsol bstod skor/ pod/ 5bcur slebs pa/ sprul bas 'jig rten khyab pa/ 'byung po'i dkyil 'khor bkas non pa/ sngags bdag dregs pa las la 'khol ba/ dbang gi rta skad la 'du ba/ dmar gyi dam tshig la dgyes pa/ rnal 'byor pa'i 'dod don sgrub pa/ he ru ka'i zhing khams skyong ba/ sbyor sgrol gyi thabs la mkhas pa/ jo bo lang rgyal bcag pa/ bcol ba'i las la nan tan byed pa/ mngags pa'i yul la rlung ltar 'gro ba/ gdug can 'dul ba la rtul phod che ba/grogs skal du ru tra snga ba/ smon lam sangs rgyas la thebs pa/las skal du sbyor sgrol thob pa/ las 'phro gsang sngags la sad pa/gdul bya chags lam gyis 'dul bas mtshan bud med du bstan pa/mi rtog pa'i de nyid ston pas zhal dud 'gro ltar bsgyur ba/gcig tu nges bzung dang bral bas sku phra men du mdzad pa/ stong pa'i dbyings su 'phyo bas nam mkha'i spyod yul la rtsen pa/ sgeg pa'i gzugs la dpa' ba'i stag sham can/ lha mo'i lus la 'jigs pa'i nga ro can/ gtsang ma'i rigs la dur khrod kyi longs spyod can/ gzugs cir yang brdzu ba/ phrin las gcig tu ma nges pa/ gdul bya sna tshogs la dgongs pa/ he ru ka'i grong khyer na rol tshe/ dpal gyi pham phab len pa/ grub pa'i gnas yul na bzhugs tshe/ rgyud sde'i gnyer kha 'dzin pa/ rnal 'byor pa'i 289

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/tshogs khang 'grim tshe/ lta nyan gyi 'byung po 'dul ba/ bka' sdod kyi dmag 'dren tshe/ lha dbang che dgu yongs kyis phyag byas pa/bstan pa'i so nam la brtson pa/ sngags rgyud kyi mel tshe la bskos pa/ bshad sgrub kyi rdzi la 'khor ba/ sngags pa'i gdung dbyangs la gsan pa/ rgyal ba'i pho nya la 'ong ba/ dngos grub kyi pham phab khyer pa/ bstan 'dzin srog tu btsa' ba/ phas rgol phyugs ltar 'dul ba/ bstan bshig lo tog bzhin brnga ba/ 'jig rten mig bsgyur gyi gzugs can/ 'dod sred kyi sgyu ma ston pa/ rtse dga'i mig 'phrul la byang ba/ gdul dka' sgyu thabs kyis 'khol ba/'dod pa'i khams na dbang btsan pa/ stong gsum na mthu che ba/bsam pa tsam gyis las 'grub pa/ bltas pa tsam gyis dgra sde 'ching ba/ bsdigs pa tsam gyis bgegs non pa/ rdzi rno ba/ rtsal drag pa/ shugs che ba/ dpung mang ba/ rgyug sla ba/ ci la'ang mi thogs pa/ cis kyang mi thub pa/ gang gis kyang mi zlog pa/stobs shugs rdo rje'i brag la theb pa/ rnon ngar lcags kyi srog rtsa chod pa/ 'bar ba lta stangs kyis gzir tshe/ dgra lha ba mo nyi mas 'ju ba lta bu/ khros pa'i goms stabs bsgyur tshe/ dgra yul bye mkhar la glang smyon brgyugs pa lta bu/ gzas phog dus mnyam du 'ong ba/ phrad 'joms cig char du byed pa/ yams nad kyi tshong 290

bka' srung chos skyong gsol bstod skor/ pod/ 5rdal shom pa/ skyin thang gi jag pa 'gyed pa/ ltas ngan gyi sprul pa spro ba/ zhing bcu'i dbugs mdangs khral du sdud pa/ dgra skyob lha srung gte 'ur 'dzin pa/ dgra khams ro gling gcig tu brdal ba/dgra snying 'drad cing rtse gar 'khrab pa/ dgra khrag 'thung zhing 'gying glu len pa/ log lta'i sde la yon por gzigs shing ma rangs pa'i gad mo dgod pa/ che btsan gyi gong gnon pa/ dregs pa can la gnya' zung byed pa/ 'khrul po che'i rtsal 'khyig pa/ mi snang ba'i lus can cir yang snang ba/ mi 'gyur ba'i lang tsho 'dod dgur sgyur ba/ phra rab kyi yid gzugs gar yang khyab pa/yid kyi shugs 'chang ba/ rdzu 'phrul gyi mthu mnga' ba/ drag po'i rig sngags kyis rtsen pa/ sgyu ma'i rnam thar la dbang 'byor pa/khrag 'thung sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi mtshan tsam gus pas 'dzin par byed pa rnams kyang gtsug gi nor bu ltar 'khur bar thugs dam bzhes shing / dam ldan sgrub pa po'i bsam dgu'i re ba yid bzhin du skong ba la rin po che dbang gi rgyal po las kyang lhag pa/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma chen mo/ dbang phyug ma nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ dam can brtan ma bcu gnyis la sogs pa 'khor zhing gi rdul snyed dang bcas pa rnams la/ ro brgya ldan pa'i skyems phud/ dngos grub kyi bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs pa/ 'dod yon gyi lbu 291

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ba 'khrigs shing / zer rlangs las mchod pa'i sprin 'byung ba/dkyil 'khor gtso bo'i gsol lhag tu byas pa/ nus pa dang yon tan mang po'i gter du gyur pa 'di nyid dgyes pa'i mchod pa dang /las kyi zhu skyems su dmigs nas 'bul lo/ /gsol lo/ /mchod do/ /zhes spyir mchod nas/ so sor mchod pa ni/ srin mo chen mo rdo rje mi'i srin mo dang / dmar mo dang / dga' ba mo dang / gsod byed mo dang / nag mo chen mo dang / ra mgo dmar ser chen mo dang / bum sna sngo nag chen mo dang / gsus 'dzin ser nag chen mo ste/ dbang phyug gtso mo brgyad kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ tshangs pa mo dang / 'khrug mo dang / dbang mo dang / 'jug sred mo dang /gzhon nu mo ste shar phyogs skyong ba'i ma mo chen mo rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ bdud rtsi mo dang / zhi ba mo dang / be con mo dang /za ba mo dang / srin mo ste lho phyogs skyong ba'i ma mo chen mo rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ khrag gis myos ma dang / gcig pur spyod ma dang / yid 'phrog ma dang / grub pa mo dang / rlung lha mo ste nub phyogs skyong ba'i ma mo chen mo rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ me lha mo dang / phag chen mo dang / rgan byed mo dang / sna chen mo dang /chu lha mo ste byang phyogs skyong ba'i ma mo chen mo rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ de dag gi sprul pa dang yang sprul/ g.yog dang yang g.yog292

bka' srung chos skyong gsol bstod skor/ pod/ 5bran dang yang bran/ 'khor zhing gi rdul snyed dang bcas pa rnams dang / khyad par du yang / nag mo bzhin mi sdug gi bu mo rdo rje kun grags ma la sogs pa bdud mo bzhi dang / dmar mo khro gnyer can ma'i bu mo rdo rje spyan gcig ma la sogs pa gnod sbyin mo bzhi/ dkar sham bzhin bzang ma'i bu mo rdo rje bod khams skyong la sogs pa sman mo bzhi ste/ rdo rje brtan ma bcu gnyis/bran g.yog 'bum sde du ma dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/zhes bar mtshams rnams su sman phud sbreng / rakta yod na 'phyar/ gser skyems mang du 'bul/ rol mo'i sgra rgya cher bya'o/ /de dag ni rgyas par bstod de 'bul ba'i tshul yin la de las bsdus pa byed na/ mkha' 'gro rma bya dga' byed ces bya ba'i sprin sgra'i dbyangs 'dis mchod par bya ste/ ho dgongs su gsol lo/ rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i lha mo/ dbyings kyi rgyan/ ye shes kyi gzugs brnyan/ snying rje'i skye gnas pa/ khrag 'thung rigs kyi thig le/ bde ba'i dbang phyug mo/ dngos grub kyi bzo la mkhas pa/rnal 'byor pa'i mtshon cha/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i dpal/ sngags kyi gzugs can/ lus sgeg pa/ bzhin 'bar zhing khro ba/ 'dod dgur sgyur ba'i gdong brnyan can/ zhe sdang sgyu ma'i lang tsho la babs pa/ zab cing 'jigs pa'i nga ro dang / bsnyen par dka' ba'i gzi brjid can/ sa'i dkyil 'khor g.yo ba'i gad mo mi 293

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ bzad pa dgod pa/ ro'i tshal na rtse ba/ dmar gyi longs spyod can/dmod pa la dbang ba/ rig sngags byed pa/ nam mkhar spyod pa/sa thams cad la dbang sgyur ba/ 'khor sna tshogs dang ldan pa/spyod pa 'chol ba/ spyod yul thams cad pa/ gting dpag dka' ba/ ngo bo nyid dag pa/ kun spyod don yod pa/ sprul pa mang po'i mdzod/ cho 'phrul gyi sprin 'byin pa/ cir yang rdzu ba/ gar yang khyab pa/ yid kyi shugs can/ thams cad du 'gro ba/ ci la'ang thogs pa med pa/ sgyu ma'i rnam thar gyis rol pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i khab tu chud pa/ rdo rje'i ming gis dbang bskur ba/dam tshig chen po'i rdo rje 'chang ba/ rgyud sde'i mdzod srung ba/bstan pa'i don byed pa/ yal gam chen po blangs pa/ snying stobs kyi rgya mtsho tshad med pa/ dam tshig can la nye ba/ rig sngags 'chang gi bgo ba nyan pa/ dag pa'i 'dod chags kyi pha rol phyin pa/ 'dod khams kun na che bar grags pa/ 'jig rten rjes chags kyis 'ching ba/ he ru ka'i gdul bya la gzigs pa/ g.yul gyi brtul zhugs la dga' ba/ thams cad du rgyal ba thob pa/'byung po'i tshogs kyis phyag byas pa/ stobs kyi rgyal mtshan mthon po thogs pa/ bsad bskrad dbye rmongs la sogs pa mngon spyod kyi thabs mang po shes pa/ sdig pas myos pa rnams drag shul gyis 294

bka' srung chos skyong gsol bstod skor/ pod/ 5tra'adzin pa/ dmyal ba'i tshong rdal gyi lam 'gog pa/ las kyi sha zas khrid pa rnams phyir 'phrog pa/ gdul par dka' ba 'dul ba /sgrub par dka' ba sgrub pa/ sangs rgyas dgyes pa'i brtson 'grus can/ rgyud thams cad du grags pa/ dkyil 'khor thams cad na spyod pa/ kun tu bzang po'i phyag brnyan chen mo/ rdo rje mi'i srin mo dang / dmar mo dang / dga' ba mo dang / gsod byed mo dang / nag mo chen mo la sogs pa dbang phyug ma nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ rdo rje brtan ma bcu gnyis la sogs pa sprul ba yang sprul/ g.yog dang yang g.yog bran dang yang bran/ 'khor zhing gi rdul snyed dang bcas pa/ ye shes mchog gi longs spyod/ sngags kyi bdud rtsi'i btung ba/ 'dod pa'i yon tan mi zad pa'i gter du byin gyis brlabs pa 'dis mchod do/ /gsol lo/ /dgyes pa bskang ngo/ /zhe sa phud dang rol mo sogs kyis mchod par bya'o/ /gang ltar yang mthar phrin las 'chol ba ni/ ho dgongs su gsol lo/ /rdo rje'i srin mo khyed rnams ni/ spang rtogs sangs rgyas dang mnyam yang / rig 'dzin sgrub pa po la thugs brtse bas/ rbod gtong gi phrin las sna tshogs mdzad pa'i slad du ci bgyi'i mngag gzhug chen mor zhal gyis 'ches pa lags pas/ bdag cag de bzhin gshegs pa'i gdung 'tshob cing /bstan pa'i mdzod srung ba dang / sems can thams cad sngags kyi 295

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/theg pas rnam par 'dul ba'i phyir dpal ldan he ru ka'i dbyibs kyi rnam pa la sems shing / de'i gsang sngags 'don pa la bag tsam brtson pa 'di gleng gzhir mdzad nas/ ji srid bla na med pa'i byang chub thob kyi bar du/ nyi ma re rer dus drug tu/ srang ba /de/ ra༄midang / bskyab pa dang / sbar bar dgongs nga / lha dang lha ma yin dang klu la sogs pa'i gdon thams cad 'dul ba dang / de dag gi dmod pa'i rig sngags gcad pa dang / rgyal po dang blon po khros pa la sogs pa zhi bar bya ba dang / shin tu gdug cing gtum pa rnams bsdigs shing phur bus gdab pa dang / btson du bzung ba dgrol zhing 'jigs pa med pa'i gnas su bzhag pa dang /pha rol gyi g.yul zlog cing 'dun gros ngan pa gzhig pa dang /dgra'i sde rnams cham la dbab pa dang / chom rkun dang gcan zan khro bo rnams bcing ba dang / rtsod pa dang nad dang ltas ngan thams cad nye bar zhi bar bya ba dang / phyi rol gyi 'byung ba'i gnod pa mtha' dag bsal ba dang / brtan pa dang g.yo ba'i dug thams cad med par bya ba dang / skal pa bzang po'i 'khor dang bde ba'i yo byad sgo thams cad nas spel ba dang / de dag nyin mtshan du rgya cher srung ba dang / gter dang bcud kyis len sogs rdzas kyi dngos grub sbyin pa dang / skye dgu'i lus sems la 296

bka' srung chos skyong gsol bstod skor/ pod/ 5sman 'dogs pa'i char bdud rtsi can dbab pa dang / sems can chen po rnams stobs kyis bkri ba dang / sa gzhi dang skye bo'i tshogs dbang du bya ba dang / mi dang mi ma yin dkar po'i phyogs la dga' ba rnams dbugs 'byin pa dang / yul dang dus dang rang bzhin bskal pa'i dngos po gsal bar ston pa dang / las kyi mtha' rnam pa sna tshogs sgrub cing don yod par bya ba la sogs pa/ mdor na gang bsam pa dang ji ltar bcol ba'i las thams cad thogs pa med par de ma thag mdzad de/ rdo rje pho nya mo rnams kyi rdzu 'phral bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / byin gyi rlabs chud mi za zurang maXbya /rdo/rdo zi sna la rigaba' bdan pa ma na sum du stan pa dang / phan bad thams cad kyi 'byung gnas rgyal ba'i dam chos spyi dang / bye brag gsang sngags snying po'i bstan pa mi nub cing sgo thams cad nas rgyas pa dang / bstan 'dzin sku tshe ring zhing sku khams bde ba dang / sgrub pa po rnams bar chad med par dngos grub kyi don 'thob pa dang /chos bzhin byed pa'i rgyal po rnams chab srid rgyas shing brtan pa dang / bstan pa'i sbyin bdag dpal 'byor dang / rigs brgyud 'phel ba dang / sems can thams cad dkon mchog gsum la dad cing spyod tshul bzang po la gnas pa dang / yul 'khor kun tu bkra shis kyi 'byor ba phun sum tshogs pa dang / bstan pa la 297

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/trasdang ba'i mi dang mi min rnams kyi phyogs 'grib cing stobs 'bri ba dang / khyad par du yang / dpal ldan bla ma dam pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mkhyen rab dang thugs rje'i phung po gcig tu 'dus pa'i ye shes kyi sku can/ don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te/ padma kha bsgyur byar rung / 'od gsal mdo sngags gling ba'i zhal snga nas kyi dgongs pa'i bzhed don/ mdzad pa'i phyag rjes/ mtshan gyi yi se/bka'i brgyud 'dzin tha mas cad yar ngo'i zla ba ltar 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ zhes 'dun pa rtse gcig pas brjod/dbang drag gi las khyad par du 'chol na skabs 'dir bya ste/ drag po ma bris la/dbang gi las 'chol gyi dper brjod tsam ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa tham/sa cad kyi gsung rdo rje'i sprul ba'i sku bde ba chen po padma sambha ba dang /byang chub sems dpa' zhi ba 'tsho dang / chos kyi rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan rnams kyi bka' drin chen pos khyab pa'i yul du gnanu/ bcas nas 'gro ba'i bla ma de dag gi bka' brgyud dri ma med pa 'dzin pa'i skyes bu rnams la mi mthun par lta zhing mi mdza' ba dang gzhan gyi phyogs su 'du shes pa/ de ltar lta zhing 'du shes pa'i mi rnams kyi phyogs dang dpung byed pa/ bsang dang phud mchod kyis brngan yang snying ring byed cing dang du mi len pa/bden pa'i chos bshad kyang dam la mi 'du zhing las bcol la mi 298

bka' srung chos skyong gsol bstod skor/ pod/ 5nyan pa/ gsar skyes kyi 'byung po gdug pa rnams dang bsdongs nas bstan srung dam tshig can rnams khyad du gsod pa/ skye bo dge ba rnams la steng nas mgo gnon byed cing / thad nas rtsod zlar lang ba/ 'og nas rtsang thur ltar 'dzug pa/ dngos dang brgyud nas brel ba dang mi bde ba sna tshogs slong zhing de'i thabs 'tshol ba la zhugs pa'i mi min gyi 'gro ba/ rigs dang dbang thang sna tshogs pa/ kun spyod dang spyod yul tha dad pa/ dbang yod la mthu dang ldan pa/ 'khor dang bcas pa dang gcig pur spyod pa/ ming gcig gam du mas 'bod pa/ rgyal khams na grags pa dang ma grags pa gang dang su mchis pa de dag thams cad bde stong phyag rgya gnyan po'i zil 'og tu chug la/ bzod med rjes chags kyi me lces gdungs pa bskyed cing / sngags kyi mchil pa rnon pos drag tu btab nas/ gnas sgul/ rten bskyong / spa bkong / 'jigs pa bskyed de/ rgol ba'i snying stobs dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi mthu/ gdug rtsub kyi ngar/ 'bros pa'i lam/ gab pa'i skyibs thams cad dang bral zhing / thabs bsam res dang /shags 'debs dbang med par/ thog rgyug dang btsan gnon drag pos/ mthon po nas phobs/ ring po nas khugs/ gting rum nas phyangs la/ srog gi gnad nas zungs/ 'gya byed kyi snying po risi mi rig mi299

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dkrogs/ 'dod gdung gi gting rtsa slongs/ shes rgyud chags myos su dkrugs/ 'od dmar gyi drwa bar chings/ 'bar ba'i phyag mtshan gyis bsdigs shing / nam mkha' la g.yug bar snang la bskor/ sa gzhi la brdab ste/ skra gzeng / gos ltung / phyogs bslad/ dran pa nyams/ dbang po myos shing / ras bal rlung gis khyer ba ltar rang dbang brtan pa dang bral nas/ skad cig thang cig yul tsam la/ dpal he ru ka chos kyi dbyings na gzi brjid kyi phung po gcig pu'i zhabs rten lhag par dmigs shing / snang srid thams cad ru lu'i sgra gzugs su shar ba'i sngags kyi 'dun sa chen po 'dir mchis par mdzod la/ padma rgyal po'i dam tshig nod pa dang / rig sngags 'chang gi g.yog por khas len du stsal zhing /so so'i rigs chos kyi mna' dam pos bsgag ste/ ji ltar nus pa'i las kyi gnyer gtad nas/ /sngon gyi gnas ji lta ba bzhin du dgyes zhing slar gso ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ zhes dar dmar g.yob/ rakta sbreng ngo/ /rjes su sman phud gtsang sar gshegs par bya'o/ /dbang gi dmod pa 'di 'dra yang lha bsnyen med par mi bya'o/ /dbang phyug phud mchod kyi tshig phreng 'dod don char rgyun 'jo ba'i dbyar rnga zhes bya ba o rgyan mkhan po'i 'bangs padma mchog grub kyis sbyar ba rdzogs so/ /shing stag dbyar ka la'o// //300

bka' srung chos skyong gsol bstod skor/ pod/ 5༄/ /bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnod sbyin yang le ber gyi bsang mchod mdor bsdus/bsang rdzas gtsang ma dri bsung ro bcud dang ldan pa rnams shing gi me la bsreg cing / bdag gi rnal 'byor sngon 'gros/ ram̐ yo khaṃ/ rang gi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi me rlung chu rnams spros te me thab bsang rdzas dang bcas pa'i nyes skyon thams cad bsreg gtor sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las zhi ba'i me thab yangs shing rgya che bar shis pa'i me 'od 'bar zhing 'phro ba'i dbyings sa bsang rdzas 'dod yon gyi rol pa lha srang risi ༅ rig rgyadagyes pa'i dud sprin phyogs brgyar spro bas 'dod dgu'i longs spyod mi zad pa'i char du 'beb par gyur bar bsam la/ sngags drug phyag drug gis byin rlabs bya/ de nas mgron spyan drangs ba ni/ rnga brdung zhing // kye/rgyal kun gsung mchog rdo rje gar dgu'i nyams/ /dbang chen rta skad rngams bzhad he ru ka'i/ /rdo rje'i bka' nyan bstan srung dregs pa'i rje/ /che btsan myur mgyogs mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul bdag /rje yi dgra lha rnal 'byor skyong ba'i gnyen/ /chos 'khor gnyan po'i srung ma gnod sbyin gtso/ /'jigs byed rol pa skya bdun 'khor dang bcas/ /bdud rtsi bsang mchod mgron la thogs med gshegs/ /yakṣa ma hā rā dza sa pā ri wa ra badzra sa ma ya 301

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dzaḥ bstod de 'bul ba dngos ni/ kye/ sngon tshe rang byung padma 'byung gnas dang / /rje 'bangs sprul pa'i lo paṇa tshogs rnams kyis/ /bod yul chos kyi snang chen bdal ba'i tshe/ /gangs can mtha' dbus dregs pa dbang bsdus nas/ /bstan pa skyong ba'i phrin las gnyer du gtad/ /bdag ni rig 'dzin de yi chos kyi gdung / /khyod kyang phrin las de yi gnyer len te/ /sngon gyi tha tshig zhal bzhes bskul ba dang / /ma 'ongs las bcol gzhung du srong ba dang / /da lta rnal 'byor g.yar dam sre ba'i phyir/ /bkra shis yid 'ong gtsang ma'i gnas mchog 'dir/ /drag rtsal myur mgyogs dgra lha khyod bos nas/ /dge mtshan bdud rtsi can gyi shing sna tshogs/ /gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar ba'i bdug spos dang / /dkar mngar sha khrag dbang po rnam lnga'i gsur/ /gzi 'bar byin za'i zhal dang mnyam sbyar te/ /ma dag dngos snang stong chen thig ler sbyangs/ /dag pa'i ye shes mig 'phrul rol pa lta'i/ /rnam gyar cir yang 'char ba cha zla'i gar/ /rdo rje'i gzags sgra dri ro raring rigang skur mereg bya ste/ /'dod yon sgyu ma'i sprin phung 'byams klas par/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i bsang mchod bdud rtsi 'dis/ /srid na che btsan dbang drag las kyi lha/ /snyan brjid grags pa rlung gi she mong can/ /btsan rgod yang le ber gyi dgyes pa bskang / /gnod 302
