bka' srung chos skyong gsol bstod skor/ pod/ 5sbyin chen po'i sku yi rnam 'phrul ba/ /gdug byed 'bar ba myo/ched drug dgyes pa bskang / /thugs 'dzin 'phrul gyi btsun mo brgya phrag dang / /bka' yi blon 'khor sde brgyad dregs pa'i tshogs/ /btsan dmag bye ba 'bum sde'i dpung dang bcas/ /ma lus lus med thams cad dgyes pa bskang / /rnal 'byor bdag cag yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi/ /sgo gsam mi shes bag med dbang gyar ribasko༅ niri minas/ /dam can g.yel dang zhud cing chad pa'i las/ /bgyis dang bgyid stsal nongs pa mthol zhing bshags/ /srung ma'i dgyes zhal zla ltar 'dzum pa dang / /mthu stobs gzi byin nyi ma'i bkrag 'bar bas/ /bdag cag dpon slob mi nor mchod yon kun/ /srung skyobs ra gur mtshams las mi 'dor zhing / /gzhis la bkra shis byes su gang bsam 'grub/ /chos dang srid kyi legs tshogs gong 'phel bas/ /gnas skabs bstan 'gro'i don chen 'grub pa dang / /mthar thug bdud 'dul gar dbang nye ru ka'i/ /go 'phang yid bzhin 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /yig brgya brjod/khyed kyi sogs/ shis brjod bya'o/ /khungs med kyi smyo gtam 'bri 'dun med kyang /dharmā shrī'i ngo ma chog par rdo stod smyon pas skad cig la byung rgyal bris// // 303

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/༄//rol ba skya bdun gyi gsol mchod bsdus pa/oṃ āḥhūṃ nas nam mkha'i mdzod kyis byin gyis brlabs/ kyai/ nub phyogs btsan yul zangs thang dmar po can/ /padma'i bka' nyan rol pa skya bdun po/ /'dir gshegs yid sprul pho brang gnas su bzhugs/ /dbang gi zhing skyong zab gter mdzod 'chang ba/ rje yi dgra lha mthu chen khyod la bstod/ /gtsang zhing brjid pa'i gtor tshogs dam rdzas bshams/ /gser skyems g.yu skyems gtsang ma'i snod du bskyil/ /sngags dang mos pas nam mkha'i mtha' klas par/ /sprul te gus gdung yid kyis 'bul lags na/ /bzhes nas bdag cag tshe ring nad med cing / /gnyen 'khor bde skyid dgra mgo tho bas brdung / /dge legs bsam don yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod/ /ces brjod phud gtor gtsang sar gshegs/ dbal shul rta mgrin ngor bstan nyis bris pa dge/༄//gnod sbyin chen po tsitta dmar po la bstod pa bdud las rnam par rgyal ba'i ru mtshon zhes bya ba/hūṃ hrīḥ padma dbang gi zhing khams skyong mdzad cing / phrin las rno myur rdo rje'i shugs mnga' ba/ /sde brgyad dregs pa'i 304

bka' srung chos skyong gsol bstod skor/ pod/ 5dmag dpon yang le ber/ /sangs rgyas bstan srung gtso la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /mdog dmar dus mtha'i me ltar bzod dka' ba'i//gtum drag gzi brjid phung pos bstan dgra rnams/ /rab 'bar nyi ma'i 'od kyis ba mo bzhin/ /skad cig tsam gyis lhag mar mdzad la bstod/ /bong che yan lag rags shing brjid pa'i gzugs/ /drag po'i g.yul du rab brtan lhun po 'dra/ /mthu rtsal thogs med rdo rje'i rlung shugs kyis/ /srid gsum bgegs dpung rnam par 'thor la bstod/ /zag bral bde chen sgyu ma'i chang rgod kyis/ /gzi byin rab rgyas 'jigs med dpa' bo'i zhal/ /khros 'khrugs bzhad pa'i nyams brgyar 'bar ba yis/ /brtan g.yo'i dngos kun zil gyis gnon la bstod/ /dmar ser ral pa'i 'od kyis nam mkha' gsal/ /sdang mig tsha zer rnon pos gdug pa sreg /rngam zhal gdangs pa'i ljags dang mche ba las/ /nyams pa'i khrag rgyun chil chil 'dzags la bstod/ /dar dmar thod chings brjid pa'i ber dmar dang / /gser gyi ska rags nor bu'i mchil lham sogs/ /mi shigs rdo rje'i chas gos bkrag can gsol/ /che btsan rgyal po'i rtags kyis spras la bstod/ /g.yas g.yon stag ral gzig shubs 'phyang ba las/ /'phur shes mda' dang 'brug sgra 'ur ba'i gzhu/ /dgra khams phye mar rlog 305

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyi/ /mtshon cha'i ser ba mi bzad 'bebs la bstod/ /phyag g.yas dbang drag las kyi zhags pa yis/ /gang la dmigs pa'i lus sems dru gur 'ching / /g.yon pas bdud las rnam rgyal ru mtshon ches/ /bstan dgra'i bla srog gnad du gzir la bstod/ /rta mchog bra bo bsam slebs rdzu 'phrul 'gros/ /rmig pas drag mkhar sgyel ba'i drag shul can/ /sga bkra rin chen sbrul gyis spras pa'i steng / /bstan pa'i bya ra mdzad cing 'khyug la bstod/ /zangs brag ri bo me chen mched 'dra'i klong / /dmar mdzod gnod sbyin 'byor pa'i sprin phung bcas/ /bse smug ldem pa'i mkhar la mnga' mdzad cing / /gnas ches kun tu sprul pas rol la bstod/ /khyod ni padma'i zab gter mdzod srang ba/ khrag ༄'thung rgyal bo'i lung gis bla na mtho/ /las dang ye shes rig sngags mtha' yas pa'i/ /stobs kyi 'khor lo bzhed dgur bsgyur la bstod/ /khri srong lde'u btsan rigs la 'go ba'i lha/ /padma'i rjes 'jug skyong bar zhal bzhes shing / /dbang chen brgyud pa'i chad mdo legs gsos te/ /tha tshig rdo rje'i ri mo brling la bstod//lnga phrag snyigs ma bdo ba'i rtsod dus mthar/ /snying stobs rdzogs ldan lang tsho ma rnying bas/ /sde bzhi'i mnga' thang gsar pa rtsom byed cing / /bsil ldan yangs pa'i 'jig rten skyong la bstod/ /306

bka' srung chos skyong gsol bstod skor/ pod/ 5mchog gsum rnam par rgyal ba'i ba dan dkar/ /rta mchog phrin las nyi ma'i kha lo ba/ /chos srid legs tshogs 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu che/ /bsam kun sgrub pa'i nye du khyod la bstod/ /nyid las sprul pa'i btsan rje mched drug dang / /dgyes pa'i dpal skyed yid bzang btsun mo'i 'khor/ /bka' yi las byed dregs pa'i dmag dpon brgyad/ /'jigs rung dmag sde rlung ltar 'tshub la bstod/ /ru mtshon 'od kyis nam mkha' me ltar 'bar/ /gnam sa 'khrugs pa'i rdzu 'phrul rlung dmar g.yo/ /drag po'i ngar sgra 'brug stong bzhin du ldir/ /snying rje khros pas pha rol gnon la bstod/ /sprul pa sde bzhis khrom gyi ru sna 'dren/ /rngam pa'i khyi spyang mang po rol tu 'brang / /'dab chags sha zan sprin ltar klad na 'khrigs/ /yang sprul pho nyas stong khams khyab la bstod/ /kun kyang dbang chen padma'i bka' nyan te/ /dam tshig gcig pa'i sgrub la snying nye zhing / /bstan bshigs che btsan yongs kyi gshed du rno//sna tshogs las kyi sgyu rtsal 'chang la bstod/ /ting 'dzin lta ba'i mkhar rdzong btsan po yis/ /bstan 'dzin yon sbyor bcas pa bsrungs nas slar/ /phyogs las rnam rgyal 'jigs med grags pa'i dbyangs/ /srid rtse'i bar du khyab par sgrogs la bstod/ /bstod do gtsang rigs mi yi dgra lha che/ /gsol lo chos 'khor 307

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/traganyan gyi srung ma'i gtso/ /bsten no sangs rgyas sprul pa'i las mkhan mchog /thugs dam dgyes skong bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod//gnod sbyin chen po tsitta dmar po la bstod pa bdud las rnam par rgyal ba'i ru mtshon zhes bya ba 'jigs med kyis chos skyong dgyes pa'i snyan shal du phul ba'o/ /lcags phag chu stod zla ba'i yar tshes pho rog gtong skad sgrog pa'i dus su'o/ /maṅga lam̐// //༄7//btsan gyi zhags pa dmar po me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od zer can/ rdo rje'i lu gu rgyud ltar brling zhing sra ba/ sbrul ltar 'khyug cing mnyen la 'khril ba/ dgra lha'i phyag na glog zhags ltar 'khyil zhing / dmigs pa'i gnas su skar mda' ltar 'gro ba/ gar song gi phyogs rnams me rlung 'tshub pa/ /'phangs pa dang thebs pa dus mnyam pa/ spyi dgra la rims nad ltar 'debs pa/ sgos dgra ngo shes ltar 'dam pa/ brnag pa'i dgra bo bshas lug ltar 'dzin pa/ nyes byed rke nas sha btson ltar 'khrid pa/ /'dra ba'i nang nas mi nor ba/ mang po'i gseb nas mi 'chor ba/ bzungs nas mi khrol ba/ bcings nas mi thar ba/ phas rgol gyi ltag na gnya' shing ltar lci ba/ bstan dgra'i ri dwags khyi spyang ltar 'ded pa/gar yang thogs med rlung gi shugs can/ btsan dmag 'bum sde'i sha ston sdud pa/ las mdzad phyag gi mngag gzhug chen po/dgra 'dul dpa' bo'i zla grogs/ /dbang sgyur drag po'i mtshon cha/308

bka' srung chos skyong gsol bstod skor/ pod/ 5don yod 'phrul gyi zhags pa yid bzhin gyi a long can/ sgrub mchog rnal 'byor pas gar bskul du pho nya ltar 'jug pa la gsol lo/ /bsang ngo/ /mchod do/ /༄tsho/ /'jigs pa'i bse mdung dmar po mtshams sprin ltar g.yo ba'i ru dar can/ dbang chen khros pa'i rdzu 'phrul gzugs su shar ba lta bu/ lag cha gcig la byed las brgya pa/ mtshon rtse lgacig la rno nus stong dang ldan pa/ drang zhing ldem la phra zhing brling ba/ rags pa 'byed cing phra mo 'byin pa/ gnyan dgu 'tshol zhing gnad la 'bigs pa/ mdung rtse gnam la bsgreng tshe/stobs chen rlung gi dmag sdes mchod bstod 'bul zhing mnga' gsol ba/ 'od nyi zla gnyis dang gral rtsod pa/ mdung rting sa la bsnun tshe/ dgra yul gzer rgod phog pa ltar 'phar zhing ldeg pa/dgra dpung tho yor bsgyel ba ltar sprugs shing sbub pa/ mdung so dgra la gtad tshe/ rgyob sod kyi dmod sngags dang 'grogs pa/rang dpung gi thog ma nas 'gro ba/ dgra sngun du 'brong ltar sgu gas pa/ dgra srog la seng ge bzhin mchong ba/ 'od dmar gyi glal ba 'khyags pa/ khrag gi dpa' skyems la spyod pa/ tshil bu'i rsā97 /waX dzodarangacad pan gyas brgyan pa/ ru dar brdab pa' rkan sgra can/ phyar na skyen po'i rtsal gnon pa/ gzas na dpa' bo'i snying 'chum pa/309

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/4bskor na mgyogs pa'i bang 'ching ba/ btab na rdo rje'i brag 'gas pa/ go cha 'dral zhing phub kyis mi srung ba/ dgra mang gsod la mi ngal ba/ sde mang brlag la mi zhum pa/ ro mang brdal la mi skyo ba/ bsnun gyin rnon ba'i ngar thogs pa/ brdeg gyin 'bigs pa'i so thon pa/ bkol gyin rtsub pa'i dbal tsha ba/dkar phyogs gzengs stod cing / nag po'i gong gnon pa/ sgrol ba sngags kyi mtshon cha/ mngon spyod grub pa'i nor bu/ dgra las rnam par rgyal ba'i mdung dmar glog mda'i shugs can/ lha srung gi dpa' zla/ sngags 'chang sgrub pa po'i dpung grogs/ lha mi'i bsam pa sgrub cing 'dod pa'i phrin las thogs med du byed pa la gsol lo/ /bsang ngo/ /mchod do/ /mnga' dbul lo/ /gzi byin bskyed do/ /༄//tsi'u dmar phrin bcol las/'jug pa'i phrin las gsar pa'i rgyal rnga rdungs/ /rnal 'byor sku tshe chos srid 'byor pa la/ /bar gcod bsam sbyor ngan pa'i 'khrul 'khor rigs/ /mthu stobs rtse brgya 'bar bas phyer btags nas/ /sgrub mchod dbu 'phang dgung dang mnyam par 310

bka' srung chos skyong gsol bstod skor/ pod/ 5bstod/ /don brgyud 'pho ba thob pa'i rten 'brel gshis/ /rgyud 'dzin bu slob yar ngo'i zla ltar rgyas/ /grub thob brgyud pas ri sul gang nas kyang / /'pho chen 'ja' lus rdo rje'i lam srol thob//snang ba dbang du 'dus pa'i rten 'brel gyis/ /pho rgyud rang dbang med par brtan pa phrogs/ /sde dpon dregs pa'i rngams sems zil gyis non/ /ban btsan pho mo'i snang blo g.yeng du chags//ni mi rab byartsa rlung las su rung ba'i rten 'brel gyis/ /mo rgyud bde skyong 'khor lo'i rtsa 'khor dkrugs/ /mdzangs dang g.yo sgyu'i rdzun phugs rang sar rdibs/ /'brel tshad dge la sbyor ba'i rten 'brel sgrigs/ /bsnyen sgrub tshad du 'khyol ba'i bden mthu yis/ /shugs smrol dmod pa'i las la ma ltos par/ /do bsdo phod du 'dzugs pa'i dgra bo rnams/ /gri 'thab dmar bshal drag pos dus mtha' stungs/ /snod bcud rten 'brel log pa'i phyogs bsgyur nas/ /bstan 'gro dkrugs pa'i phung khrol tsher ma can/ /gsar skyes nag phyogs dam sri 'gong po'i dpung / /mtha' dag mngon spyod las kyis cham la phobs/ /sogs/ dkyus ltar du dmigs bsal grub chen dgon pa'i zhabs rim la rdo grub chen gsum pa 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi mas mdzad//311

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/༄/ /'brong ri'i gnas su 'dzam gling gi gzhi bdag la mchod pa bya tshul nyung ngu kun tu dge ba'i rnga sgra zhes bya ba bzhugs so//bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yul lha chen po rdo rje gang rtsal gyi gnas rten la bsang mchod 'bul bar 'dod pas/ bsang thab zlum po'am grub bzhi mdzes par brtsegs pa'i dbus su bdud rtsi can gyi shing sna tshogs bsang rdzas gtsang ma sna tshogs bkra shis pa'i me la sbyar te/ bdag gi rnal 'byor la gnas pas/ oṃ swa bha ba sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las bsang dkyil zhi ba'i me thab zlum po ye shes kyi me 'od 'phro ba dang bsang rdzas rnams kyang ye shes sgyu ma'i rang mdangs dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa/ snang srid brtan g.yo thams cad khyab pa'i 'dod yon gyi sprin phung rnam pa thamasatshocad par gyur/ spro na sngags drug phyag drug dang / bsdu na nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya lan gsum gyis brlab/ ho/ gsan du gsol lo/ /mkhyen par mdzad du gsol lo/ /rgyal dbang padma ka ra'i tha tshig la gnas pa/dkar phyogs skyong ba'i mthu stobs kyi mnga' bdag rgyal rong brag lha mgon po'i gnas ri dang / gnas ri'i nye 'dabs na bzhugs pa'i gzhi bdag so so'i sprul 'khor pho nya dang bcas pa thams cad bdud rtsi bsang mchod kyi mgron du dgongs pa bskyed de 312

bka' srung chos skyong gsol bstod skor/ pod/ 5bzhugs shing / gzhan yang bod dang bod chen po'i mnga' ris kyi gtso'i 'dzam bu'i gling mtha' dbus kyi srung ma dkar phyog sa la dga' ba thams cad zhi zhing byams pa'i thugs kyis gnas 'dir zhal 'dzom par 'dus te/ bkra shis bsang mchod kyi dga' ston 'di la dgyes par mdzad cing bzhugs su gsol lo/ /bhu mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa ma dzaḥ dar dkar gyi g.yab mo dang dung brdas bskul zhing spyan drangs/ hoḥ mtho ris kyi yul sa rin po che'i 'byung khungs can na/ skye dgu'i bsod nams kyi nus pa dus su smin nas/ rtsi bcud kyi dge mtshan mang po g.yang du chags pa las btus te/byin za'i zhal du drang ba'i g.yu dud baiḍūrya'i phreng ba lta bur tshar du dngar zhing / sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin gyi byin gyis brlabs pa'i bsang mchod 'dod yon gyi rgya mtsho 'dis/ dbus rgyal khab ru bzhi'i mu khyad/ shar rgyal mo rong gi 'phra tog khams (〈 'jugogartsar —bye theg mi zir sngadro'i sngathorwa〉ga ra gzhung ma sda' rtan phur/ ga ra stad 'azang ra smug 'a sa 'dzin gyi zom na bzhugs pa/ 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sgyu 'phrul rnam par bkod pa'i bye brag btsan gyi dgra lha chen po/ phyugs kyi g.yang bdag chen po/ 'phan gyi srid skyong chen po/ chos kyi dge bsnyen chen po/ brag lha mgon po btsun mo gnyis dang bcas pa la mchod do/ /gsol lo/ /dbu 'phang bstod do/ /rnga rol bya/ mchod 313

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/kha gsos te/ de'i bka' 'khor gyi thubyubo dam can sdong ra dkar po/phyi'i blon chen thor bos ri bkra/ nang gi blon chen gser lag lha rtse/ gsang ba'i blon chen 'dzi chung stag rtse/ dmar mdzod kyi gnyer ka skya rengs rdza khrod rgyu/ spyan gzigs kyi srung ma rdza chen ri rdzi spun bdun/ g.yung drung rnga la stag rtse rdo rje nus ldan rtsal/'dzi chen shing gi lha mo/ rdza khra'i dam can mgar nag /sil bo/sil dmar sogs gser gzhung la klung nyin srib la gnas pa'i srung ma chos kyi dam tshig dang ldan pa thams cad bsang mchod ye shes kyi bdud rtsi 'dis mchod do/ /gsol lo/ /dbu 'phang bstod do/ /gzhan yang yul 'di'i nye 'khor du 'dabs chags pa/mdo khams rol chen bco brgyad kyi ya gyal/ rdo rol gyi yul gling thog mtha' bar gsum na gnas pa/ ral pa rtse dgu/ rdo snying mthon po/ thang yag rdo rje mgar dmar/ sku bla gnyan rtse la sogs pa zo dor che phra thams cad dang / sku bso thog rgyal ba'i dben gnas/ gsung ba gnas/ thugs sbar zhabs brag dkar/yon tan gong seng ge yang rdzong / phrin las thags rje chen po 'ur ༄'ur/ yul 'di'i smad cha rang byung rmu rdo'i pho brang sogs/ mdo khams shar phyogs kyi dben gnas/ gtsug lag khang dang /mchod rten/ tshal dang / nags dang / chu klung gi gnas sog sa 314

bka' srung chos skyong gsol bstod skor/ pod/ 5la dbang ba'i gzhi bdag ma lus shing lus pa med pa thams cad bsang byed rtsi sman gyi me mchod chen po 'dis mchod do/ /gsol lo/ /dbu 'phang bstod do/ /gzhan yang bdag cag gis gnas 'dir spyan drangs pa'i yul lha gzhi bdag gter sna tshogs kyi srung ma/ ye shes dang las la grub pa/ gangs ldan/ kai la sha/ li yul/ rgya nag /bod/ 'phags yul te 'dzam gling cha shas drug gi sa bla sa steng sa 'og gi 'jig rten spyi dang bye brag la dbang byed cing gnyug mar gnas pa dang / gling dang 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan nas glo bur du lhags pa'i lha/ klu/ gnod sbyin/ dri za rdzu 'phrul chen po la sogs pa mi ma yin dkar phyogs skyong ba thams cad lha bsang bdud rtsi 'byang ba'i yid bzhin gyi sprin chen po nam ༄mkha'i mtha' klas par khyab pa 'dis mchod do/ /gsol lo/ /dbu 'phang bstod do/ /bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa'i sgo gsum gyi spyod pa chos ma yin pa'i dbang du gyur pa dang / thab gzhob dang dme 'bag la sogs pa 'phral gyi kun tu spyod pa ma dag pas/ lha rigs dra ma rnams kyi thugs dang 'gal ba ci mchis pa thams cad bzod par mdzad du gsol lo/ /de ltar bsang mchod phul ba'i rten 'brel dang / dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa'i mthu tshad med pas/ chos skyong ba'i yul lha chen po 315

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rnams kyi dgyes pa yongs su skong ba dang / so so'i gnas lus longs spyod kyi gzi byin nyams pa thams cad sor chud nas/ rgud pa med pa'i dpal dang dbang phyag ches cher phun sum tshogs pa //sdushā rir mi 1rngo(1 rtog sna dang ldan par gyur ga gyur nas kyang bdag cag da na slab yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la nyin gsum gyi bya ra/mtshan gsum gyi mel tshe mi 'bral lus dang grib ma bzhin du mdzod la/ chag che nyam nga / nad gdon bgegs rigs/ glo bur ye 'drogs/ rmi ltas mtshan ngan/ mi 'dod pa'i nye bar 'tshe ba mi mthun pa'i rkyen ngan pa thams cad sgra tsam yang mi grags par nye bar zhi ba'i phrin las sgrubs/ mi'i tshe srog srings/ khyim gyi phywa g.yang spel/ phyugs kyi mnga' thang skyed/ btsan po'i mgo rmog bstod/ dgra gnya' ltag nas non/ zun nye 'dabs nas skyor/'khor mtha' bzhi nas sdud/ mi la dman res ma skor/ nor la skye bri ma btang / khyim la gang stong ma 'jug phug tu phyi mi dang gros ngan ma 'jog sgo ru nang gtam dang snying mi ma mngags/dkyus su 'thab 'dzing dang mi ro ma btang / mi kha dang kha smras nye skor du ma bzhag nang du skyid dar 'dzom/ phyi ru 'gro lam byams/mi chos gtsang ma bcu drug dang / pho rtsal sna dgu sogs lugs gnyis rig pa'i gnas thams cad la mdzangs pa'i 'phrul don 316

〈mi ra〉 tshanam/khur sdosukhung ཿdzathag nyusnyekhung ba/theṭa95 thabashesteposdo 14zeng/ rjesprorngan/ ji yod zhags pa'i 'khrul 'khor lta bu byin nas/ chos dang srid kyi legs tshogs rab 'byams la mnga' sgyur zhing / snyan grags kyi rnga bo che mtha' nas mtha' ru ldir bas/ bdud dang / mu stegs/kla klo dang / lha ma yin gyi 'byung po sde ris dang bcas pa nyi mas me khyer la bya ba bzhin du zil gyis gnon pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ yul phyogs 'di la sogs te yangs pa'i rgyal khams thams cad du yang nad mug 'khrug rtsod kyi skal pa ngan pa mtha' dag mi 'byung zhing / phyi snod kyi 'jig rten sa bcud dang bkrag mdangs rgyas/ char chu dus bzhin 'bab cing / lo phyugs lo bzhin legs/ nang bcud kyi 'gro ba bde skyid dang chos sa 'dzom/༄gong rje yi gdung rabs brjid/ sgab mi sde'i chus srid brtan/bar gser gyi khrims gzhung btsun/ mi mkhas pa'i mgo rna snyan grags kyis bstod/ lha dkar phyogs dbu 'phang chos spyod kyis mtho/ston pa'i bstan pa bsnyen bkur dang bshad sgrub kyis 'phel te/sde bzhi'i phun tshogs rdzogs ldan gyi dga' ba gsar du tshes pa ltar dar zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ phyogs 'dir sde 'khrugs dang mi phyugs kyi nad yams mang po'i sna 'dren pa/ thog ser dang lo nyes byed pa/ ri rud dang sa g.yo sogs 'byung bzhi'i gnod pa sna tshogs gtong ba/ mi'i bla rku zhing / phyugs kyi g.yang 317

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dang / zas kyi bcud la rloms pa/ gsar skyes dang gna' rabs nas chags pa'i 'dre srin ma rungs pa rnams dang / rku 'phrog gsod gcod la brtson pa/ mtha' mi dbus su 'bod pa/ yul 'khor gyis bcud nyams su 'jug pa/ sgang gi ri dwags dang klung gi nya gshor ba sogs nyes med kyi sems can sdug la sbyor ba/chos 'khor dang gtsug lag khang 'jig pa/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa dang bstan 'dzin la ya ga 'bod cing sbyor ngan shom pa'i mi sogs 'jig rten mi bde ba'i byed po gang yin thams cad/ lha dge sdig gi gza ba lags pas nyes byed kyi kha mgon ma mdzad/ srang zi tshosngar shudami tshorang mchir rwadroX ma mthu stabs kya mnga' bdag lags pas drag shul gya cha ba da ma thag ston la/ mthu rtsal phyag rgya gnyan po'i zil 'og nas slan chad mi ldang bar mdzad du gsol/ mdor na zhi rgyas dbang drag gi phrin las rnam pa thams cad nas gnas skabs yid la smon pa'i don thams cad thogs med du 'grub cing / mthar thug bla na med pa'i srid zhi'i gtsug rgyan du gyur nas 'gro 'dul gyi phrin las nam mkha' dang mnyam par mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod cing mchod pas mnga' dbul 'phrin bcol dang bcas pa byas nas sarba bhu mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra gatstshaḥ mchod sbyin gyi yul rnams so so'i gnas su gshegs par gyur par bsam la/ shis brjod kyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o/ /spro na gsol 318

bka' srung chos skyong gsol bstod skor/ pod/ 5mchod tshan bzhi re re bzhin/ nongs bshags/ byin bskyed/ phrin bcol rnams tshang bar sbyar/ /grangs gsog na rgyas pa tshar gcig gi 'phror byin rlabs kha gsos kyi tshul du byas mthar/ spyan 'dren gyi tshig rnams dang mthar gshegs gsol ma gtogs pa la grangs gzung ngo/ drag sngags gsang ba spu gri'i gter nas/ gter brgya phrag mang po'i za ma tog gser stod 'brong ri smug po'i zo dor gsol zhing mchod pa'i khrigs rim rgyas bsdus 'tshams pa 'di'ang / 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi mas 'brong ri'i sgo chen brag dmar yol ba'i mdun logs su bris pa maṅga lo// //༄༅/ /dkar gtor mar thud sogs kyis spras pa dang gser skyems gtsang ma 'bru gsum lan gsum gyis brlab/ a kā ros bsngos la/ kye/ dgongs shig spyan ras gzigs dbang sprul pa'i gar/ /skye dgu snying rjes skyong ba'i thugs dam can/ /gnas las ming btags 'brong ri smug po ste/ /mtshan nas brjod na rgyal rong brag lha mgon/ /g.yas g.yon btsun mo ri bkra sdong ra sogs/ /'khor bcas gdung ba'i dbyangs la rtse gcig gson/ /sngon tshe slob dpon padma thod phreng gis/ /bod khams mtha' dbus gzhi bdag 'byung po kun/ /dbang bsdus rjes 'jug skyong ba'i las gnyer gtad/ /nga ni rig 'dzin de yi sngags brgyud de/ /khyod kyang lha 'dre de yi rigs yin pas/ /ma g.yel sngon gyi tha tshig dran par mdzod/ khyad par grub dbang kun bzang gzhan phan gyis/ / lha dang mi gnyis dam tshig gcig bsres nas/ /chos srid skyong ba'i gnyer du khyod cag bskos/ /319

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bdag cag sngags 'chang de yi brgyud 'dzin te/ /khyod kyang tha tshig de las mi 'da' bas/ /ma g.yel re ba'i 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ /bdag cag 'khor bcas mi 'dod rkyen dbang gis//sa phyogs yul ris gzhan du gnas spos kyang / /lha mi'i mdza' gzhung bor nas 'ong ba min/ /grogs su khyod bzung dpung du khyod khur zhing / /rgyal mtshan khyod 'phyar khyod la rten bcas nas/ /bsdad pa'i ngang tshul dgongs la thugs brtser mdzod/ /nye yang bsam sbyor log na rang sgo'i dgra/ /ring yang dam tshig gcig na chos kyi spun/ /rdzu 'phrul shugs la nye ring ma mchis shing / /bden pa'i mdza' gcugs gzhan du mi 'gyur bas/ /bdag cag phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad gar gnas kyang / /dung sems chu bo'i rgyun bzhin ring bar mdzod/ /sangs rgyas bstan srung bstan 'dzin sku tshe sring / /dge 'dun sde skyong sbyin bdag mnga' thang skyed/ /chos mthun don sgrub rnal 'byor re ba skong / /bshad sgrub rgyun spel mthun rkyen yo byad sbyor/ /'khor tshogs bde skyid gnas gzhi bkra shis shing / /skye dgu chos bzhin spyod pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /nyin gyi bya ra mtshan gyi mel tshe dang / /mdun gyi bsu ma rgyab kyi skyel ma mdzod/ /'dug na rten phur ldang na 'khar ba gyis/ /mtho ba skyor la dma' ba lag nas drongs/ /mi yi dpal skyed phyugs kyi g.yang 320

bka' srung chos skyong gsol bstod skor/ pod/ 5tsha'izhag spel/ /smra na gtam dang bskor na blo gros byon/ /ma shes slob la ma dran gsal bar smos/ /yon po srong la 'chuṭa pa thig tu zhogasrung ba'i go dang bzur ba'i phub tu gyis/ /rta la dar thogs mtshon la rno rtse thogs/ /rang mgo gzengs bstod dgra mgo rdog pas rdzis/ /lha zhal mdangs phyungs 'dre gdong thal bas khobs/ /mdor na byams pa'i pha dang brtse ba'i mas/ /'grogs pas mi skyo lus dang grib ma bzhin/ /ma bos rang 'khor bos na snyan gsang zhing / /ma bskul las sgrub bskul na sgab yang bas/ /nyer 'tshe gang byung rtsa sbur mes bsreg dang / /mthun rkyen lcags phye khab len bzhin du gyis/ /chos nyid rang bzhin gcig tu mnyam pa dang / /rigs bdag rgyal ba gcig gis bsdus pa dang / /dam tshig srog rtsa gcig pa'i rten 'brel mthus/ /mi tshig lhas gsan lha sems mi la dgongs/ /lha mi'i 'dun gros g.yang gi rgya mtshor 'khyil/ /bde skyid gter kha rdol ba'i bkra shis shog /ces brjod la gser skyems phyogs bcur gtor/ gtor ma gtsang sar gshegs/ yang na bsang mer 'bul/ lha dang lha min gsang ba pa/ /bstan pa skyong rnams brnyas mi bya/ /zer rgyu de red pas gzhi bdag dkar phyogs skyong ba mthu bo che/ o rgyan rin po ches sgang drug gzhi bdag bcu gnyis kyi ya gyal du bsang gzhung las/ gser zla sgang la dbang bsgyur ba/ /zhes bsngags shing / 'jig rten mchod bstod kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur te/drag sngags dngos grub 'byung gter dang / gzhan yang rdzogs chen sems phyogs sogs 321

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/zab chos mang po'i gnyer byang gtad pa/ rdo grub thams cad mkhyen pa dang / khyung lung ras pa sogs la rang gzugs bstan cing zhabs tog bgyis te lhag par 'go ba'i lha 'di nyid/ rang cag rnams kyi slob dpon rgyud kyi srung ma phyi thag ring po can du snang bas/ khyad gsod brnyas smod/ dga' sdug blo 'tshub/ yid chad 'khang ra sogs ma rabs gzhung ngan gyi bya ba ngo sor mi 'khyer bar/ gus shing zhen pa dang / dang zhing zhi ba'i yid kyis mchod bstod la brtson par bya'o//༄//rdo bsang gtong tshul nyams dga' byis pa'i rtsed mo rdo yul dga' ba'i rgyan/dang por mdzad bcu dang gu ru'i rnam thar bklag /cha gsum btang yang legs/de nas gu ru zhi drag dang rta mgrin gang rung gi bdag bskyed bsgom/ bsang dngos la/bsang stegs dkar zlum steng / gdol bshan sogs min pa gtsang ma'i khyim lta bu nas blang ba'i me dang / bza' shing sogs bsang gzhung rnams las 'byung ba ltar 'du bya/dkar dmar gyi gtor ma dang klu gtor rnams so so'i rdzas kyis brgyan pa bshams/rin po che'i snod du 'bras sam nas gtsang ma la sirnyi dang rten snying spel ba brgya rtsa yan chad kyis bsngags te rgyal ba'i bka' rtags rdo rje'i srung ba dam por byin gyis brlabs la stegs mtho bar bkod/ lha'i nga rgyal brtan pos/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi bden mthu yis/ /yul 'dir rtag chags lha mgon rnams/ /gnas nas phyungs te shul 'dzin zhing / /nad mug 'khrugs rtsod slong ba dang / /rgya 'dre 'gong po'i sna 'khrid pa'i/ /nag phyogs mi min gdug pa rnams/ /322

bka' srung chos skyong gsol bstod skor/ pod/ 5skad cig shing lo rlung khyer bzhin/ /rang dbang med par 'dir khug cig /ril bu dang / chang bu nyer gcig sha chang la phug sogs tshogs pa'i gtor ma/ oṃ.āḥhūṃgasum dang / saṃ bha ra nyer gcigamatshan bzhi lan gsum gyis bsngos nas/ yul 'dir rtag chags lha mgon rnams/ /gnas nas phyungs te shul 'dzin zhing / /nad mug 'khrugs rtsod slong ba dang / /rgya 'dre 'gong po'i sna 'khrid pa'i/ /nag phyogs mi min gdug pa rnams/ /mchod sbyin gtor mas tshim byos la/ /thag ring rgya mtsho'i pha mthar songs/ /gal te mi nyan 'tshe byed na//dkon mchog bden mthu'i zhags pas bcing / /rig sngags drag po'i mtshon char dbab/ /stong pa shes pa'i me yis sbyang / /ming yang med par brlag par 'gyur/ /drag sngags rdo thun dang bcas pas bskrad/srung gur sgom/ de nas bsang rdzas rnams sngags drug phyag drug dang / bdag gi bsam pa'i sogs gsum gyis brlab/ kye/ 'dzam gling bod kyi sa cha'i smad/ /mdo khams rdo yul zhes grags pa/ /sa gzhi snum la bsil drod snyom/ /'brog sa dwangs la rong yul gshin/ /spen la bag dro phun sum tshogs/ /de la gnas su 'du shes te/ /mchod na 'go zhing bsten na nye/ /sbu gu mi yi mgon byed cing / /phan gnod las la dbang che ba/ /rdo stod ral pa rtse dgu dang / /rdo snying mthon po man chad nas/ /rdo gzhung thang yag mgar dmar dang / /323

casajid/ ji jordo sdispyirngaku 'o/:drotha/thab cesaḥde ngapeshāstizud rta):re ba//sbojidro 'o/sdo/zug/ thamardo gzhug khro chen rting pa yan/ /gzhi la bdag tu bzung snga zhing / /srid sder byas pa mang ba yis/ /sde brgyad pho mo ma ning rigs/ /che rgyud chung rgyud bar ma'i rgyud/ /rigs dang kun spyod tha dad dang / /rnam 'gyur cha byad sna tshogs la/ /ming dang mtshan nas phyang tsa na/ /stong sdes shes dang mi shes pa/ /thams cad sbyin pa'i ༄zhing bsdus te/ /mgron la 'bod kyis da tshur spyon/ /che ste mnga' thang brgyang yang brgyang / /nga che zer zhing 'gying ma bskyed/ /chung ste reng bur 'dzum yang 'dzum/ /zhan no snyam nas bag ma 'khum/ /kun kyang mos dung gus pa yis/ /dkon mchog bden pa'i bka' la nyon/ /dbang drag padma'i dam la zhugs/ /sngags kyi pham phab za ru 'dus/ /bka' rtags srung ba len du shog /gtsang ma bsang gi mchod pa 'di/ /bdud rtsi can gyi shing sna sbyar/ /bkra shis mthun pa'i me la bzhus/ /dag byed chab kyi zer mas bran/ /ting 'dzin sngags rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ /rten 'brel bzang po'i sgyu mas sprul/ /dri zhim dud pa'i na bun 'khrigs/ /mdzes pa'i me stag glog phreng 'gyu/ /'dod yon longs spyod char chen 'bebs/ /lha 'dre'i mig sngar ltad mo che/ /rlung sems lus la bdud rtsi 'dra/ /dri tshor snang ba dga' bder 'char/ /phyogs ris med de nam mkha' khyab/ /'then khyer mi dgos snyoms par 324

bka' srung chos skyong gsol bstod skor/ pod/ 5brdal/ /sngags kyi nus pas zad mi shes/ /gang ltar bsam pa de ltar snang / /ci 'dod 'byung ba'i yid bzhin sprin/ /phud kyis dkon mchog rnam gsum mchod/ /bde gshegs lhag ma byin rlabs che/ /sangs rgyas bzhes 'phro bsod nams zhing / /'phags pa'i pham phab dngos grub rdzas/ /'di ltar ya mtshan che ba yi/ /bsang mchod bdud rtsi khyad 'phags pas/ /rdo gzhung mthil na ming che ba/ /rig 'dzin sngags pa'i nye du che/ /thang yag dam can mgar ba dmar/ /sku 'khor g.yog dang bcas rnams bsang / /rdo stod phu yi kha 'dzin pa/ /gter bdag rdo snying 'thon po dang / /ral pa rtse dgu'i gzhi bdag bsang / /rdo rong gsham gyi sa srung ba/ /sku bla gnyan rtse zhes grags pa'i/ /drag rtsal shugs ldan dpa' bo bsang / /gzhan yang rdo yul stod smad kyi/ /spung ba ri dang bdal ba thang / /dro ba nyin dang bsil ba srib/ /skyes pa shing dang zug pa brag /rgyu lam bzhi mdor gnas pa yi/ /gzhi bdag rigs su gyur rnams bsang / /bsang ngo mchod do dgyes pa bskang / /grib kyi gnyid 'thib dbyings su sang / /byur gyi bag rdul rtsad nas thon/ /mi shis dri nga rang sar dengs/ /thams cad ngoms shing tshim gyur te/ /sku lus bde zhing nyams stobs 'phel/ /thugs bag phebs la mchog tu spro/ /zhi zhing byams pa'i yid ldan nas/ /325

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/'jig rten bde legs byed par shog /ces brjod/ slar yang bsang kha gsos te/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum/ gzhan yang bsang mchod 'bul ba ni/ /sna tshogs rtsi sman las skyes pa'i/ /bsang dud sbrul sngon zhi ba'i gzugs/ /'bru gsum sngags kyi srog dang ldan/ /bcud ldan bzang shing khu bas 'grang / /'khyil zhing bdud rtsi'i na bun gtibs/ /'khyug cing rtsi bcud zhun du skyug /'phyo zhing nam mkha' sman dris 'geng / /grib dang sdug bsngal bldag cing sel/ /dbang po yan lag zug cingakyangagaso/ /klu la 'os shing klu dang 'tshams/ /klu yi rgyud la ma bzhin brtse/ /rdo chu sngon mos gtso byas pa'i/ /chu klung chu phran lu ma dang / /lteng ka mtshe'u la sogs pa/ /'byung ba chu la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /chu bdag gzhi bdag thams cad la/ /so sor dgyes pa'i rdzas su 'bul/ /sdug bsngal zhi ba'i sman du ster/ /lus sems gso ba'i zungs su bsngo/ /bsang ngo mchod do dgyes pa bskang / /grib kyi gnyid 'thib dbyings su sangs/ /byur gyi bag rdul rtsad nas thon/ /mi shis dri nga rang sar dengs/ /thams cad ngoms shing tshim gyur te/ /sku las bde zhing nyams stobs 'phel/ /thugs bag phebs la mchog tu spro/ /zhi zhing byams pa'i yid ldan nas/ /'jig rten bde legs byed par shog /dkar gtor 'bru gsum gyis brlab/ a kā ros bsngo/ gzhi bdag 326

bka' srung chos skyong gsol bstod skor/ pod/ 5tra gtsang ma za ba rnams/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /dpal dang grags dang skal pa bzang / /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing / /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs/ /dngos grub kun gyi sdong grogs mdzod/ /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang / /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang / /'bru rnams 'phel zhing phyugs 'phel ba/ /dge legs thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /dmar gtor 'bru sum gyis brlab/ a kā ros bsngo/ gzhi bdag dmar la dga' ba rnams/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma sogs 'gres/ klu gtor 'bru gsum byin brlab/ a kā ros bsngo/ klu gnyan sa bdag pho mo rnams/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di sogs/ klu gtor bsngo tshul de las spro na gzhan nas 'byung ba sbyar/ de nas chos bshad dam bzhag ni/ kye/ khri gdugs nyi ma gling bzhi'i gos/ /dro 'jam 'od la mi 'de na/ /gling bzhir bsdad kyang rgyab mi dros/ /lho sprin phyug mo zhing pa'i 'bri/ /char bcud nu zho mi dgos na/ /bzho 'bri'i brtsi mthong ci la byed/ /sangs rgyas 'jig rten bsil 327

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ba'i gdugs/ /rjes brtse'i bka' 'og mi gnas na/ /sdug bsngal tsha gdung ci yis sel/ /bod kyi rnam 'dren gu ru rje/ /dam tshig 'brel ba ma btags na/ /pad 'byang thugs rjes gang nas 'drong /////bye/ //bye/ rir /bye/shā shāXbye/ 1 ste/ /rdo'ulnga brgya —na tshangs pa man chad — / / dgu— ma gtad sa la byas/ /khong rnams skyid pa chos kyi mthu/ /khyed kyang chos la brten na 'tsheng / /rgyal po'i rgyab tu dpung zhig dgos/ /bya 'phur gshog pa rlung la ltos/ /'khri shing ring ba skye ya'i drin/ /lha 'dre che yang mgon skyabs dgos/ /skyabs gnas bzang po'i bka' drin las/ /sgra gcan kha yi zla ba thar/ /chos la gnas pa'i gzi byin gyis/ /sreg pa'i phru gus nags me bzlog /dus ngan snyigs ma'i dgun mjug la/ /che btsan mar me 'khyag gis 'dzin/ /skyabs gnas nyi ma 'dra ba de/ /bslu med dkon mchog rnam gsum yin/ /de phyir mchog gsum skyabs su bsten/ /bden dang mi 'tshe shed du khur/ /gdung ba'i dbyangs su pad 'byung bos/ /gum gum chum chum dam la sdod/ /sa ma ya rakṣantu/ srung rtags sbyin pa ni/ da ni o rnams dkar po'i phyogs/ /rang byung padma 'byung gnas sogs/ /sras bcas rgyal ba rnams kyis kyang / /khyod cag chos kyi 'bangs su dgongs/ /tshangs dang dbang po nye dbang dang //'jig rten skyong ba sde bzhis kyang / /khyod cag skyabs gnas 328

bka' srung chos skyong gsol bstod skor/ pod/ 5 gcig pa dang / /brtul zhugs gcig la gnas par shes/ /khyod kyi chab srid brtan pa dang / /nag po'i g.yul gyis mi pham phyir/ /sangs rgyas phyag rtags me tog 'di/ /dmag mi'i mda' byang bzhin du zungs/ /zhes brjod de sngar byin gyis brlabs pa'i me tog rnams zhal nas gsungs pa'i shis brjod 'don bzhin bsang dkyil du 'thor/ de nas dar phyar dung 'bud rol mo cher sbir bas dpa' shugs gzi mdangs phyungs la/ phrin bcol bya ba ni/ kye/ khyod la phrin las 'chol ba ni/ /gzhi bdag gzhi yi chus tshugs zangs/ /yul skyong yul gyi so nam mdzod/ /rang rang ༄bskos pa'i las skal lags/ /dge bcu 'dzom pa'i rdo yul 'di/ / yul gyi snying po sbas pa'i gter/ /gter rgya dgra yis mi shigs pa'i/ /rim dgu'i rgya mdud khyod kyis gyis/ /chung la 'od ldan sa cha 'di/ /phag nor gser gyi sbram bu yin/ /gser sbram phyi mis mi 'khyer ba'i/ /mi snang sgrib shing khyod kyis gyis/ /padma'i gdul zhing dum bu 'di/ /yang gab chos kyi las sgo ste/ /sgo rtsa mtha' 'dres mi gnon pa'i/ /lha srung lcags ri khyod kyis gyis/ /lcags ris mi thub dgra byung na/ /sangs rgyas phyag rtags yid bzhin nor//rgyal mtshan rtse mor mchod la phyor/ /mchog gsum bden pa'i rnga sgra skul/ /mi sems dkar po'i chos la sgyur/ /lha dpung mi yis brling ba dang / /mi mgo lha yis thon pa yi/ /thabs 'phrul mkhas 329

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/pa'i mtha' rgya skyed/ /rang gi yul khams skyid dal sprod/ /skyid kyi snying po chos la sgril/ /gzhan sde'i dmag la brel ba slong / /brel brgyas 'ja' yi 'dun ma gtor/ /snying gtod mi la mdza' gzhung gces/ /yul mi byams pa'i go 'og chugs/ /bslu brid dgra la khong zon dgos/ /mtha' bzhi'i 'dre dang blo ma bstun/ /snga rabs skyes shing blo gros rgan/ /spyod tshul bzang ba'i lha klu rnams/ / gtso bor bskos kyis snga srol zungs/ /gsar skyes bag med 'chal bar spyod/ /nag phyogs dga' ba'i 'byung po rnams/ /mgo 'phang ma mtho gral zhabs bzhag/ /lha mi'i bar du dbyen sbyor zhing / /sde brgyad nang la 'khrug rtsod slong / /rtag chags srung ma khyad bsad nas/ /glo bur rgya 'dre 'bod pa'i gdon/ /rgyal khams yos ltar rngod pa rnams/ /bdud 'dul thub pa'i phyag rgyas mnan/ /dkon mchog mthu la rgyab bcol nas/ /dkar po'i gdan khri de ltar brtsigs/ /nag phyogs gong ba de ltar bcad/ /da ni rang srid chos kyis skyongs/ /rdo rtse dgung la snyeg pa yis/ /bde skyid nyi zla snga bar mdzod/ /rdo gzhung yangs la snyom pa yis/ /yul mi 'dug nyams dga' bar mdzod/ /rdo mtha' brag gis bzung ba yis/ /'gong po'i rgyu lam chad par mdzod/ /rdo mdangs snum la bkrag pa yis/ /g.yang zhag na bun 'khor bar mdzod/ /phyi na grug med 330

bka' srung chos skyong gsol bstod skor/ pod/ 5tyānang gas med/ /phyi nang srin gyis ma zos par/ /lcid ldan gser gyi pha bong bzhin/ /rdo yul 'pho 'chug med par mdzod/ /don dmigs bsal yod na dper brjod tsam du/ skyabs med mgon med ri dwags rnams/ /khyed kyi yul na skyid du re/ /gnas gcig dung zhing yid phebs pas/ /khyim gcig nang gi gces phrug 'dra/ / gces phrug mig mdzes zhi ba'i khyu/ /rngon pa'i bsang mchod khyi sha'i g.yos/ /brje len byed na 'chal ba yin/ /ya rabs 'jig rten spyod srol ltos/ /lha ri mtho yang rgyan cha dgos/ /gzhi bdag phyug kyang spyan gzigs gces/ /gar yang dgos pa'i ri dwags khyu/ /yal bar ma dor bu bzhin srung / /zhesapalta bu'o/ kye/ de ring byams pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /nam mkha' rlung gi rkyal ba'i nang / /shing mchog du ba'i sman snas gtams/ /lha klu dga' ba'i bdud rtsir sbar/ /bka' rtags rdo rje'i srung bar bcas/ /khyed la skyes su bstabs pa 'di/ /byur du ma bsam dpal du soms/ /'khon du ma lta drin du ltos/ /drin gyi nang nas dam par ltos/ /de ring gdugs kyi shar zhabs phan/ /rdo yul stod smad bar gsum gyi/ / sa bdag chu bdag che phra kun/ /bdag cag dpon slob 'khor /bcas la/ /bsam pa zhi zhing sbyor ba 'jam/ /rang bzhin bzang la rnam pa mnyen/ /'dzum pa'i bzhin la dga' ba'i yid/ /brtse 331

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dung mos par ldan pa yis/ /dus rnams kun tu phrin las sgrub/ /sa gzhi mi 'gyar rdo rje'i gdan/ /cha bsil 'chi med bdud rtsi'i dmir rigang skyems/ /rtsi thog 'du ba'i nad sel sogs/ /dge bcu'i rten 'brel legs phyogs bsgyur/( /phyi snod dngos grub me tog bzhad/ /nang bcud rnal 'byor bung ba tshim/ /dga' skyid bde ba'i glu dbyangs kyis/ /'jig rten khyab pa'i bkra shis 465/ /ces pa'i rjes su bsam pa myur 'grub kyang 'don no/ /zhes pa rdo ba bla ma'i ming btags kha mang lag mang zhes bya bas gnam lo chu byi 'char la nye ba'i tshe 'chi med thang stong rgyal po'i gzhal med khang par sbyar ba'o// //༄khya//mgar dmar bsang mchod bzhugs/zo dor chen po rdo'i mgar dmar la bsang mchod 'bul bar 'dod pas/ gtsang phyes a mṛ tas bran pa dang / 'o zho ja chang gi skyems ci rigs bsags la/ ram̐ yi khaṃ/bsang rdzas 'dod dgu'i yon tan mi zad pa'i gter kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin bzhin du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur ciga.oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan grangs ci nus brjod la/ kyai/ mi shigs brjod bral 'dus ma byas pa'i klong / /spros bral rdo rje'i rang gdangs 'gags med gzugs/ /rgyal kun mthu stobs dbang phyug gsang ba'i bdag /badzra pa ṇi'i sgyu 'phrul rol pa'i gar/ /'jig rten 332

bka' srung chos skyong gsol bstod skor/ pod/ 5srid pa'i sde dpon chen po'i tshul/ /yongs shar thang yag dam can mgar dmar ni/ /res 'ga' zhi ba dge bsnyen lha yi chas/ /ba dan nor bu 'dzin cing sha ba zhon/ /res 'ga' gnod sbyin khros pa ma rungs pas/ /ral gri tho ba 'dzin cing rlung la bcibs//rdzu 'phrul mthu stobs che btsan 'gran zla med/ /rnal 'byor bdag dang khyod gnyis g.yar dam gcig /de phyir ting 'dzin dag pas khyod 'bod na/ /ma thogs yud kyis gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /dpag yas ting nge 'dzin gyis byin brlabs pa'i/ /bsang rdzas thabs kyi rang bzhin bsregs za'i zhal/ /stong chen shes rab dbyings dang mnyam sbyor las/ /byung ba'i dud sprin zag med 'dod dgu'i rdzas/ /mi zad nam mkha' mdzod du byin brlabs pas/ /dregs pa'i gtso bo dam can chen po bsang /dgyes yum sman mo khrag gi ral pa bsang / /pho nya mngag gzhug srin mo khrag mig bsang / /shan pa 'bum sde'i gtso bo myur mgyogs/ bsang / /gnod sbyin bye ba 'bum sde'i 'khor tshogs bsang / /pho nya las byed bsam gyis mi khyab bsang / /de ltar bsang zhing mchod pa'i byin nus kyis/ /gsang chem/ bstan pa phyogs mthar rgyas pa dang / /dge 'dun sde 'phel bshad sgrub gong 'phel mthus/ /rgyal khams kun tu nad mug 'khrugs rtsod zhi/ /33 3

pod/ na rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dkutratshe dang bsod nams gong nas gong du 'phel/ /srid pa'i 'dod yon mi zad char du bsnyil/ /log lta'i dam nyams dam sri myur du sgrol/ /mdor na dus dang rnam pa thams cad du/ /nyin gyi bya ra mtshan gyi mel tshe dang / /dgra jag chom rkun gcan spyang 'jigs pa skyobs/ /bsam pa'i don kun ma lus lhun grub mdzod/ /ces pa'ang rdo'i zo dor chen po thang yag dam can mgar dmar la bsang mchod dgros zhes riṭa dpon mdo sngags nas bskul ngor/ rdo sprul gzugs des so/ / 334

4 pod/ 5༄//yul lha rngon rgya/khyad par du yang bdag cag gnas pa'i sa phyogs rngon rgya byas par blos bzung zhing / dmigs 'og tu btsud de/ skye bo mang pos shes par tshig gis mnan pa 'di dag deng phan chad/ lha srung o rnams la bcol zhing / srung skyob kyi las gnyer gtad pa yin pas/ nyin gyi bya ra/ mtshan gyi mel tshe ma g.yel/ ri klung kun tu sa bshu kyis/ phyogs mtshams kun nas so kha srung / ri dang nags tshal rnams kyi sa srung mdzod/ bya dang ri dwags yongs kyi rdzi bo mdzod/ sa gzhi rgya che zhing / srog chags grangs mang bas thams cad bskyab par dka' yang sa phyar ba tsam dang / lung pa phu dung tsam 'dir rngon rgya ma thub na o yul lha gzhi bdag rnams kyi mthu stobs rdzu 'phral yang de tsam du zad do/ /mchod sto phri shlau po de sheb da na las gsol ba ri don 'ang tsam du sa so/ /kho yul lha gzhi bdag rnams kyi pho brang gi rgyan/ spyan gzigs kyi 'don yon/ dgyes pa'i dkor nor/ rang dbang gi sgo zog rnams srung ba'i ched du/ o rang grogs su sbran/ dpung du khyer/shed du khur/ rgyal mtshan du 'phyar nas phrin las brtsams pa la/335

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ dgra dang zun gnyis ma nor/ phan byed dang gnod byed gang yin 'dam ka ma log par gyis la las kyi ngo longs shig sngags 'chang bdag cag rnams kyi sku'i rim gro dang / tshe srog gi rkyen sel du dmigs nas skad gang gi sa la gnas pa'i bya dang ri dwags rnams kyi srog bslus nas tshe thar du btang zhing / mi 'jigs pa'i bde ba byin pa la'ang / khyed dang bdag cag gan sa gcig la brten pa'i khyim mtshes/ chos dang zang zing gi 'brel bas bsdus shing /mdza' gzhung gtsang po las ring ba'i lam srol btod de/ chad mdo gcigs su bris pa lags pas/ byams brtse yi rang gi thugs kyis lhag par dgongs te/ dpung rogs dang ra mda' mdzod la 'dod don mthar skyol ba'i phrin las sgrub tu gsol/ 'di na sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab klog pa dang kha don byed pa'i gtsug lag khang dang dge 'dun bzhugs pa'i mdun sar/ me'i 'khrul 'khor bshams shing / drag po'i 'brug sgra bsgrag mtshon cha'i skyogs char phab ste/ nyes med kyi 'gro ba rtswa dang mya gu'i zas kyis chog ༄shes shing / ri sul stong pa na nyal ba/ mgon med cing skyabs dang bral ba rnams dmar gsod byed cing seng ge ltar rgyu yang dgag pa med na ni/ sdig byed dang dge 'dun mgo 'phang mnyam// dkon mchog gsum ma rabs gdol pa rnams kyi mig zhabs su 336

yul lha rngon rgya/ pod/ 5brnyas res la 'bab pas/ khyed dang bcas pas 'jig rten bde skyid 'dod pa dang / bde skyid dkon mchog las 'byang ba'i ngang ༄tshul soms la/ bcol ba'i nor srung / gtad pa'i gnyer longs/bsgo ba'i las sgrubs/ bdag cag rnams kyi 'dod pa'i re 'bras thogs pa med par 'byung bar mdzod cig dge'o// // 337

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/༄/ /byad gtad phyir bzlog /spro na dkar dmar gyi gtor ma bshams la thog mar aḥkaḥphreng skor ci rigs bzla/de nas gtor ma 'bru gsum gyis brlab/ mchog gsum ngo bo dpal mabo/na bla ma dang sogs nyer gcig sogs kyis mthar/ bdag de ma byung na 'di ka dngos rkyang bton yang chog/ gang gi 'od gsal thugs kyi thig le ru/ /rtsa gsum srung mar bcas kun yongs bzlum pa/ /thabs mkhas thugs rje nus pa'i gter gcig pu/ /thod phreng rtsal khyod bu yi mgon du bzhugs/ /rgyal ba'i yum gcig rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /'bar ba'i skur bzhengs bdud 'dul seng ge'i gdong / /ye shes phra men mkha' 'gro'i 'khor dang bcas/ /bcom ldan gdugs dkar can dang 'od zer can/ /khro gnyer can sogs rig pa'i rgyal mo che/ /rdo rje'i rnam thar mtha' yas rtsal mnga' rnams/ /so so'i sprul 'khor pho nya'i tshogs dang bcas/ /thugs dam bskul lo thugs rje'i mthu rtsal phyungs/ /bdag cag dpon slob sde dgon chos brgyud rnams/ /phyi nang ban bon sngags pa'i byad gtad kyis/ /bcing dang gzir mnan sbyor bas nyam nga tshe/ /mthu stobs rdo rje 'bar ba'i mtshon rnon gyis/ /rig sngags chod la dmod pa'i 'khrul 'khor shigs/ /lha klu sde brgyad 'byung po'i za kha sgyur/ /sri 338

zi byad gtad phyir zlog/ pod/ 5ngan mi kha bra mchu'i rigs gtogs dang / /byad 'dre 'gong po gsar skyes 'dre rgod sogs/ /mi rung mi shis byur gyi sna 'dren pa//ba yug bzhin du 'tshabs shing 'khor to cog /shugs drag ye shes ra me rasirshaphyag rgya'i 'thor rlung gis/ /gdod nas rnam dag stong chen chos dbyings su/ /phyir bzlogs rjes shul med par tshar chod la/ /chos srid legs tshogs rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /ston mchog bdud las rnam rgyal mi'i seng ge/ /shākya'i tog sogs bskal bzang 'dren pa stong / /rgyal sras phyir mi ldog pa'i dge 'dun 'khor/ /bsam yas zhing rdul grangs snyed tshogs ba cas dang / /gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i zhing bzhugs rgyal ba'i dbang / /rgyal sras nyan thos dge 'dun 'khor dang bcas/ /ye shes gzigs pa sgrib med spyan ldan rnams/ /thugs dam bskul lo sogs nas/ phrin las mdzod/ /'khor 'das zil gnon che mchog he ru ka /tshe bdag 'char kha king kang dmar nag dang / /dug gdong la sogs rigs lnga'i gshin rje gshed/ /rta mchog yang dag rdo rje gzhon nu che/ /rbod gtong ma mo rig 'dzin zhi drag dang / /mchod bstod dregs pa dreg sngags dmod pa'i lha/ /gsang bdag drang srong dri med zhi dang khro/ /rang rang rigs kyi tshom bu'i 'khor dang bcas/ /thugs dam bskul lo sogs nas/ 'phrin las mdzod/ /ye 339

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/shes ma mo sngags srung ral gcig ma/ /dur khrod ma mo bod skyong brtan ma'i sde/ /lha chen dpal 'bar sprul pa'i mgon po lnga/ /gza' bdud chen po skyes mchog thig le rtsal/ /rgyal chen sku lnga rol pa skya bdun dang / /gzhan yang gtsang ris mgon po bdun cu sogs/ /rgyal ba'i bstan srung dam can dregs pa'i tshogs/ /thams cad las kyi lha ste las bcol sgrubs/ /bdag cag dpon slob sogs nas/ chos srid legs tshogs rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod//zhes pa'ang 'phral du nyer mkho'i dbang gis kha smon byed pa po 'jigs med go cha ye shes bsrung ba'i rdo rje'o/ /340

pod/ 5༄//sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i mtshan byin rlabs can mang po mdo sde las btus pa thos pa don ldan ngag gi rol mo zhes bya ba bzhugs/na ma shākya mu na ye/ bzod bka' srid pa'i tsha gdung 'jil ba'i sman/ /bla med yon tan bdud rtsi'i rgyun chags pa/ /rgyal dbang grags pa kun dga'i me tog thod/ /gtsag tu bcings nas / ri ribadon ldan gtam 'di gleng / /de yang 'phags pa zhi ba lhas/ de bas mgon po spyan ras gzigs/ /thugs rje chen pos 'gro ba yi/ /'khor gyi 'jigs pa'ang bsal ba'i phyir/ /rang gi mtshan yang byin gyis brlabs/ /zhes gsungs pa dang tshul mthun par/ /thugs rje chen po'i sbyangs pa rab kyi mthar phyin pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni skad cig tsam yang gdul bya'i khams yal bar mi 'dor zhing /rnam pa sna tshogs kyi sgo nas gzhan gyi don la gzhol bas/ 'phags pa'i skye bo dang phrad pa'i las yongs su grub pa rnams sku dngos kyi mdzad pa dang / bsod nams kyi tshong zong legs par ma bsgrubs pa'i sems can gzhan rnams kyang tha na mtshan lan gcig rna lam du thos pas kyang mthar gyis bla na med pa'i byang chub tu nges par 'gyur ba tshun chad kyi phrin las tshad med pas rjes su 'dzin pa dus las mi yol lo/ /de'i phyir mgon po de dag gi mtshan gyi yi ge 'bru gcig tsam yang rna bar thos pa dang / yid la dran pa dang / ngag tu brjod par byed pa thams cad gcig tu dge la don yod pa kho na yin te/chen po rnams kyi mthu'i khyad par bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i phyir te spros pas chog go/ /341

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/zhedon 'di la dgongs nas bcom ldan 'das kyis mdo sde du mar de bzhin gshegs pa 'i mtshan mang po dang / /de dag gis byin gyi rlabs dang / de'i rgyu mtshan sngon gyi khyad par mang po las brtsams te rgya cher yang dang yang du bka' bstsal ba rnams kyi nang nas re zhig che long tsam zhig ni 'dir yang bshad par bya ba'i chos so/ /de ni 'di ltar sems can dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su bsags pa rnams kyang gong nas gong du khyad par chen po la sbyor zhing / /dge rtsa dman pa rnams kyi rgyud la yang bsod nams kyi phung ngo mtha' yas pa sgrub pa'i thabs/ ngal ba mang po la mi ltos pas brtson 'grus chung ngur gyur pas lhur len par 'gyur ba yin no/ /de la byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi sngon gyi smon lam gyi khyad par rgyas pa las byung ba ni/bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs gsheṭa pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mtshan legs par yongs bsgrags dpal gyi rgyal po dang / bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin po che dang zla ba dang padmas rab tu brgyan pa mkhas pa gzi brjid sgra dbyangs kyi rgyal po dang / bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas zhes rgya cher kun la sbyar te/ gser bzang dri med rin chen snang brtul zhugs grub pa dang /de bzhin gsheṭa pa mya ngan med mchog dpal dang / de bzhin gshegs pa chos grags rgya mjo'i dbyangs dang / de bzhin gshegs pa chos rgya mtsho mchog gi blo rnam par rol pa mngon par mkhyen pa dang de bzhin gshegs pa sman gyi bla bai ḍūrya'i 'od kyi 342

sangs rgyas byang sems mtshan btus/ pod/ 5rgyal po zhes bya ba rnams so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan rin chen dpag tu med pa bkod pa'i gzi brjid kyi rgyal po lta ba dang /༄de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan rin chen dpal bkod pa'i gzi brjid kyi rgyal po lta bu dang / de bzhin gshegs pa chos thams cad la spobs pa bkod pa'i dpal dang / de bzhin gshegs pa spobs pa dpag med bkod pa yang dag par spyod pa'i blo dang /de bzhin gshegs pa 'brug stong bsgrags pa'i sgra skad kyi rgyal po dang / de bzhin gshegs pa gser mchog 'od dpal dang / de bzhin gshegs pa gzi brjid kyi rgyal po rnam snang dpal snang dang /de bzhin gshegs pa bskal pa bye ba grangs med par byang chub yang dag par bsgrubs pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa gser bzang po dang / nam mkha' nges par sgrogs pa bkod pa'i 'od dang / de bzhin gshegs pa chos thams cad kyi tshul la rnam par 'phrul pa'i gzi brjid kyi 'od ces bya ba'i mtshan rnams ni/ byang chub sems dpa' yon tan rin chen me tog kun tu rgyas pas zhus pa las bka' bstsal to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med dang / de bzhin gshegs pa mi 'khrugs pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje snying pos rab tu 'dul ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa shin tu rnam par gdon mi za bar padmo rab tu rgyas pa'i sku dang / de bzhin gshegs pa chos 343

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/kyi rgyal mtshan dang / de bzhin gshegs pa seṅge dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad dang / de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi 'od zer rab tu rgyas pa'i sku dang / /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad blo gros 'od zer rgyal po dang / de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba'i thugs dang / de bzhin gshegs pa dpal bzang po zhes bya ba'i mtshan rnams ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan brjod pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs las gsungs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa shin tu yongs bsgrags dpal dang / /de bzhin gshegs pa dbang po'i tog gi rgyal mtshan gyi rgyal po dang / /de bzhin gshegs pa shin tu rnam par gnon pa grags mchog dpal dang / de bzhin gshegs pa g.yul las shin tu rnam par rgyal ba'i rtsal dang / /de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan bkod pa'i dpal kun tu snang ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa sman gyi rgyal po dpal thogs pa med pa dang /de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che'i padma las rnam par gnon pas bzhud pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che'i pad ma la rab tu gnas pa sā la'i rgyal po stematshan 'di dag ni sangs rgyas brgyad pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs las so/ /byang chub sems dpa' rin chen drwa ba can gyis zhus pa las kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan brjod par mdzad de/ de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen 'od zer zla bas brgyan pa mkhas pa'i gzi brjid dbyangs kyi 344

sangs rgyas byang sems mtshan btus/ pod/ 5dbang phyug gi rgyal po dang / de bzhin ga shegs pa me tog gi 'od kyi rnam par rol pa mngon par mkhyen pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa me tog rgyas pa sā la'i rgyal po dang / de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rnam dag dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rab tu zhi ba mkhas pa'i gzi brjid dbyangs kyi dbang phyug gi rgyal po dang / de bzhin gshegs pa brtson 'grus grangs med par yang dag par rab tu gnas pa zhes bya ba rnams so/ /rgyal po'i bu rin che zla bas zhus pa las kyang gsungs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa dpal bzang po dang / de bzhin gshegs pa tsandan dpal dang / de bzhin gshegs pa snang ba mtha' yas dang / de bzhin shegs pa me tog gi dpal dang / de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan med pa'i dpal dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che'i mchod sdong dang /de bzhin gshegs pa me tog dpal dang / de bzhin gshegs pa mngon par shes pa chung ngu dang 'bring dang chen po'i rnam par rol pa dang / de bzhin gsheg/sa pa snang ba'i dpal dang / de bzhin gshegs pa nor dpal zhes bya ba rnams so/ /sangs rgyas bdun pa'i mdo las kyang gsungs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par gzigs dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che'i gtsug tor can dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad skyob dang / de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor ba 345

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/'jigs dang / de bzhin gshegs pa gser thub dang / de bzhin gshegs pa 'od srung dang / ston pa bcom ldan 'das de bzhin shegs pa shākya thub pa rnams so/ /gzhan yang / de bzhin gshegs pa ting nge 'dzin glang po dam pa'i dpal dang / de bzhin gshegs pa padma dam pa'i dpal dang / de bzhin gshegs pa nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor snang ba dam pa'i dpal dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che'i gdugs gcig pa dam pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa ting nge 'dzin dam pa rnam par gnon pa'i dpal dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che'i dkyil 'khor gzi brjid kyis mngon par 'phags pa'i rgyal po'i dpal dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen me tog kun tu snang ba'i dpal dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che'i snying po dang / de bzhin gshegs pa go 'phang mtha' yas rnam par gnon dang / de bzhin gshegs pa spos mchog mtha' yas rgyal po dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen dam pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa mthu snang che dang /de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che dam pa ste 'di dag ni mdo sde sangs rgyas kyi dbu rgyan las smos pa rnams so/ /yang / de bzhin gshegs pa nam mkha'i dpal dri med rdul sel rab mdzes yon tan gyi tog gi 'od me tog padma beeḍūrya'i 'od zer rin po che'i gzags lta ba'i sku dang ༄shi ༄346

sangs rgyas byang sems mtshan btus/ pod/ 5ldan pa spos mchog dam pa'i mchod pa sku rnam par spras shing legs par brgyan pa gtsug tor gyi gtsug nas nyi ma'i 'od zer dpag med zla 'od smon lam gyis brgyan pa rab sprul bkod pa chen po chos kyi dbyings las mngon 'phags chags med rin chen rgyal po dang / de bzhin gshegs pa cha lha gzhon nu nyi ma'i sgron ma zla ba'i ༄me tog rin chen padma gser sdug nam mkha' lta bu'i sku ldan rnam par snang mdzad 'od zer rab brgyan thogs med 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor phyogs bcur 'od zer rab 'byin 'jig rten khams kun tu snang byed tog gi rgyal mtshan rgyal po dang / de bzhin gshegs pa bkod pa thams cad dri med 'od dang / de bzhin gshegs pa spobs pa'i rgyan la dgongs pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa dri med zla ba'i tog gi rgyal po grags ldan dang / de bzhin gshegs pa me tog gi bkod pa snang bar mdzad pa dang /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od mdzad dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che mchog gi tog grags ldan dang / de bzhin gshegs pa 'jigs med rnam par gzigs dang / de bzhin gshegs pa 'jigs bral bag tsha ba mi mnga' spu zing mi byed dang / de bzhin gshegs pa seṅge bsgyings pa'i mid pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa gser 'od gzi brjid 'jigs bral rgyal po zhes bya ba rnams ni sangs 347

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/tyārgyas bcu gnyis pa'i mdo sde las gsungs so/ de bzhin gshegs pa don thams cad grub pa zhes bya ba'i mtshan ni 'phags pa dkon mchog 'byung gnas las bka' bstsal to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gser 'od seṅge rnam par rol pa'i rgyal po dang / de bzhin gshegs pa 'od zer kun nas 'phags pa'i dpal brtsegs rgyal po dang / de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan shin tu gnas pa nor bu brtsegs pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba rnams ni 'phags pa sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin las gsungs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun tu gzigs pa'i mtshan ni 'jam dpal gyi zhing khams bkod pa las gsungs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dri ma med par 'bar ba rin chen gser gyi 'od zer snang ba'i tog dang / de bzhin gshegs pa 'dzam bu gser gyi rgyal mtshan gser du snang ba dang /de bzhin gshegs pa gser du snang ba'i snying po dang / de bzhin gshegs pa nyi ma brgya'i 'od zer snang ba'i snying po dang / de bzhin gshegs pa gser ri rin chen 'byung gnas gdugs brtsegs dang / de bzhin gshegs pa gser gyi me tog 'bar ba'i 'od zer gyi tog dang / de bzhin gshegs pa sgron ma chen po dang //de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che'i tog dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rnga sgra la sogs pa ni gser 'od dam pa'i mdo mdo sde las gsungs so/ /de nas phyogs bcu'i mun pa rnam par sel ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs las gsungs pa yang brjod 348

sangs rgyas byang sems mtshan btus/ pod/ 5pa bya ste/ 'di ltar/ de bzhin gshegs pa rjes spyod dang / de bzhin gshegs pa sems dang po bskyed pa yid la mdzad pa rnam grangs bsnyengs pa dang bag tsha ba dang bral bas mngon par 'phags pa'i rgyal po dang / de bzhin gshegs pa khon dang rgyags pa rnam par gnon pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen gzugs bkod 'od gnon dang / de bzhin gshegs pa bdud dang yid gnyis kun 'joms rnam gnon dang / de bzhin gshegs pa sems dang po bskyed pas phyir mi ldog pa'i 'khor lo 'byung ba'i dpal dang /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen gdugs 'phags snang dang / de bzhin gshegs pa byang chub sems dpa' 'dul ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa skrag med man bral ting nge 'dzin mngon ༄'phags rgyal po dang / de bzhin gshegs pa dang po sems bskyed the tshom gcod mdzad nyon mongs bskyod ces bya ba dag go/ /'phags pa bkra shis brgyad pa las kyang bka' bstsal pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa sgron ma'i rgyal po dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rtsal brtan don grub dgongs pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa kun la dgongs pa rgya cher grags pa can dang / de bzhin gshegs pa byams pa'i rgyan gyi dpal dang / de bzhin gshegs pa dge bar grags pa dpal dam pa dang / de ba zhin gshegs pa lhun po ltar 'phags pa rtsal 349

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rab grags pa'i dpal dang / de bzhin gshegs pa sems can thams cad la dgongs pa grags pa'i dpal dang / de bzhin gshegs pa yid tshim par mdzad pa rtsal rab grags pa'i dpal zhes bya ba rnams so/ /de dag kyang brjod bya'i gtso bo tsam zhig smos pa yin gyi rnam rngu gzhan du na/ shar phyogs su sangs rgyas kyi zhing gzhan gyis mi thub pa na bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa mtshan legs pa yongs grags dpal gyi rgyal po zhabs ring ba byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun grangs med pa dang bcas pa zhes bya ba la sogs pa rgyas par mdo sde las 'byung ba bzhin du brjod par bya'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan de ltar bshad nas/ slar yang byang chub sems dpa' smon lam gyi stobs can 'ga' zhig gi mtshan brjod pa la 'jug ste/ de la/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa dang /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa zhes rgya cher kun la sbyar te/ lag na rdo rje dang /byang chub sems dpa' sa yi snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa' byams pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po rnams ni dkyil 'khor brgyad pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs las bka' bstsal zhing byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod tshad med pa rnams su bsngags pa rgya cher gsungs pa dag go/ /byang 350

sangs rgyas byang sems mtshan btus/ pod/ 5 chub sems dpa' 'od kyi tog dang / byang chub sems dpa' ye shes bla ma dang / byang chub sems dpa' zhi ba'i dbang po dang / byang chub sems dpa' smon lam blo gros zhes bya ba rnams ni 'jam dpal gyi zhing bkod pa las gsungs so / /byang chub sems dpa' spyod pa khyad par can dang / byang chub sems dpa' spyod pa mtha' yas dang /byang chub sems dpa' spyod pa rnam dag dang / byang chub sems dpa' spyod pa brtan pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sman gyi rgyal po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sman yang dag 'phags dang /byang chub sems dpa' sang sang po'i dbyangs la sogs pa'i bsngags pa ni dam pa'i chos padma dkar po las gsungs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' mdzes pa'i tog dang / byang chub sems dpa' gser 'od dam pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' gser gyi snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngu dang / byang chub sems dpa' chos 'phags zhes bya ba'i mtshan rnams ni gser 'od dam pa las gsungs so/ byang chub sems dpa' rdul med rnam par gnon pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' lag na padma dang / byang chub sems dpa' nyi 'od ces bya ba ni sangs rgyas kyi dbu rgyan las gsungs pa rnams so/ /byang chub sems dpa' kun tu snang ba'i mdzod kyi snying pos byung ba dang /byang chub sems dpa' zab mo'i mdzod kyi snying pos byung ba dang /351

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ 〉byang chub sems dpa' dpal gyi gzi brjid kyi mdzod kyi snying pos byung ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' sprin sgra zab mo rnam pa tha dad pa'i mdzod kyi snying pos byung ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje mi phyed pa'i gtsug gi mdzod kyi snying pos byung ba dang /byang chub sems dpa' ngag gi lam mi g.yo bar kun tu 'gro ba'i 'od zer snang ba'i gzi brjid kyi mdzod kyi snying pos byung ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' grags pa snyan pa kun tu rnam par grags pa'i 'od kyi gzi brjid kyi mdzod kyi snying pos byung ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' ri'i rgyal po mi g.yo ba'i 'od zer snang ba'i gzi brjid kyi mdzod kyi snying pos byung ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' kun nas blta ba'i gzugs rnam par dmigs pa'i 'od zer gyi rgyal po snang ba'i gzi brjid kyi mdzod kyi snying pos byung ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' stobs bcu rnam par dag pa thub pa med pa'i 'od zer snang ba'i gzi brjid kyi mdzod kyi snying pos byung ba ste 'di dag ni kun tu bzang pos bstan pa shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i sde snod las gsungs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rgya mtsho dang / byang chub sems dpa' mthu chen thob dang / byang chub sems dpa' lag na rin po che dang / byang chub sems dpa' gtsug na rin po che dang / byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang / byang 352

sangs rgyas byang sems mtshan btus/ pod/ 5chub sems dpa' rdo rje snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi blo gros dang / byang chub sems dpa' bzang po'i dpal dang / byang chub sems dpa' zla 'od gzhon nur gyur pa dang /byang chub sems dpa' bzang skyong dang / byang chub sems dpa' mchog tu dga' ba'i rgyal po dang / byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i mdzod dang / byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas blo gros mngon sum dang / byang chub sems dpa' bud med 'gyur ba dang /byang chub sems dpa' spos kyi glang po dang / byang chub sems dpa' nyi ma ltar snang byed dang / byang chub sems dpa' zla ba ltar gsal byed dang / byang chub sems dpa' rin chen phyin dang /byang chub sems dpa' dri ma med par grags pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' blo gros mi zad pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sor mo'i phreng ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' drwa ba can gyi 'od dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems bskyed ma thag tu chos kyi 'khor lo skor ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' nor bzang dang /byang chub sems dpa' gzangs kyi dbang phyag rgyal po dang / byang //nge/ /༷bye/ re//rdorir mi rig michub mas dpa' lha— —da paṇa la sogs pa gzhan yang rgyal ba'i sras kyi 'dus pa'i nang na gtso bor smos pa rnams mdo sde'i gleng gzhi dang phyogs bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' 'dus pa'i dga' ston la rtse ba'i skabs rnams su shes par bya ste 353

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/'dir ni phyogs tsam zhig bshad do/ /de ltar sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i mtshan rin thang med pa'i rin po che'i mchog 'di dag la brten nas/ bsod nams kyi 'byor pa rgya chen po sgrub pa'i tshul yang ji lta bya zhe na/mtshan de dag thos nas len cing 'dzin la klog cing kun chub par byed de 'jug par byed cing gzhan dag la rgya cher yang dag par rab tu ston na zhes mdo sde las gsungs shing / de ma zad mtshan de dag thos pa tsam dang brjod pa tsam la'ang sbyar nas phan yon rgya cher gsungs so/ /des na yan lag gi bya ba mang po dang ma 'brel na yang mtshan tsam brjod pas dgos pa mi 'grub pa min mod/ phyag mchod la sogs pa'i tshogs bsags dang sbrel nas brjod na stobs che ste/ sangs rgyas bcu gnyis pa dang / dpang kong phyag rgya pa la sogs pa mthong ba las shes so/ /'jug pa bde bar smos na/ bzang po spyod pa'i phyag 'tshal gyi tshigs su bcad pa bzhi'i rjes la bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas zhes thog ma dang phyag 'tshal lo mchod do skyabs su mchi'o zhes tha mar sbyar te lan bdun la sogs pa brjod cing byang chub sems dpa' rnams la yang rigs pa bgre/ de nas mchod pa nas brtsams te 'od dpag 354

sangs rgyas byang sems mtshan btus/ pod/ 5med pa'i gnas rab thob par shog ces pa'i mthar thug gi bar du brjod cing don yid la dran par bya'o/ /de'ang snga dro la sogs pa'i dus gsum du bya bar rin chen zla bas zhus pa las gsungs shing / sangs rgyas bcu gnyis pa'i mdo las/ nyin zhag bdun du tshang bar ni/ /mtshan rnams 'di dag 'dzin byed na/ /gang gis 'dren rnams mthong 'gyar ba'i/ /rgya chen mig ni sbyang bar 'gyar/ //re/ /nye) 1)/ ra mi 34sa 〉rngo/ rig nyu11 sa na zhag — grangs tshad kyang gsungs / /'a ra phan na gyi rim pa ni/ mdo sde brgyad brgya par de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi sngon gyi khyad par bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi gsungs pa dang / li tsa bis zhus par/ gang gis skyob pa'i mtshan ni bzung byas na/ /de la byang chub dam pa rnyed sla zhing / /bde bar gshegs pa'i yon tan gzhan rnams dang / /yon tan dri med 'di dag mis 'thob 'gyur/ /zhes sogs gtso bo'i yon tan nges legs dang de'i cha lag tu/ rgyal ba de'i mtshan ni sus bzung ba/ /me dang chu dang dug gis mi 'chi zhing / /'di la mtshon gyis mi tshugs mkhas pa dag /mngal du mi skye gzungs rnams mi des 'thob/ /ces sogs mngon mtho'i yon tan las brtsams te rgya cher bka' bstsal pa dang / bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgyal po'i mdor/ mtshan 'di dag thos pa'i byang chub sems dpa' 'chi ba'i tshe na rab 'byams rgya 355

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/4mtsho'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams mdun na mngon sum du bzhugs pa mthong bar gsungs pa dang / sangs rgyas brgyad pa'i chos kyi rnams grangs las/ 'jig rten mgon po de dag gi/ /mtshan rnams 'dzin par byed pa ni/ /mi khom thams cad yongs spangs nas/ /myur du bzang 'gror 'gro bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa nas/grags ldan rnams kyi mtshan thos nas/ /de dag dpa' zhing shes rab che/ /'jig rten mi mchog sangs rgyas 'a gyur/ /zhes pa'i bar du gsungs pa dang / /rin chen drwa ba can gyis zhus par gsungs pa'i phan yon kyang mdor bsdu na gang thos pa tsam gyis byang chub sems dpa' rnams bla na med pa'i byang chub tu nges par 'gyur ba dang / tshe rabs dran pa dang / ser sna'i sems dang lhan cig mi gnas pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyis mdzes pa dang / yon tan grangs med pa mang pos kyang yongs su 'dzin pa dang / sangs rgyas thams cad dgyes par bgyid pa dang / sems can thams cad tshim par bgyid pa dang / bdud thams cad skrag par bgyid pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad sbyong ba dang / sems can thams cad sems kyi dri ma sel zhing / de dag chos dkar po rnams la 'jog pa dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang lha rnams kyis srung ba mdza da 356

sangs rgyas byang sems mtshan btus/ pod/ 5pa la sogs par 'gyur ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan de dag gang lags zhes dris nas ston pas sngar bshad pa rnams kyi sgo nas lan btab pa yin par shes pa snang ba dang / rin chen zla bas zhus pa las/ 'jig rten mgon po de rnams kyi/ /mtshan ni gang zhig 'dzin byed pa/ /ma 'ongs dus na de dag kun/ /rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog tu 'gyur/ /zhes sogs mthar thugs gi yon tan dang / gang zhig skyob pa de dag gi/ /mtshan 'di dag ni 'dzin 'di la/ /me dang chom rkun dug rnams dang / /mtshon gyis tshugs par mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes sogs gnas skabs kyi yon tan las brtsams te bka' bstsal pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa gtsug tor can gyi mtshan thos pa'i yon tan gser 'od dam pa'i mdo sder gsungs pa dang / ston pa shākya thub pa'i mtshan thos pa'i yon tan snying rje pad dkar nas gsungs pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa bdun po de'i mchod rten gyi yon tan dam pa'i chos dran pa nye bar gzhag pa las ji skad bstan pa sogs dang sgrub tshul gcig pa'i sgo nas rtogs nus pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi dbu rgyan las/ 'jig rten 'di ni gaṅgā'i bye snyed kyis/ /rin chen gser gyi mdog gis bkang 'bul bas/ /gang zhig sangs rgyas mchog gi mtshan thos nas/ /sbyin phung de yis brgya yi char mi phod//357

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gang gis sangs rgyas mtshan 'di thos nas 'dzin/ /de dag rim gyar mchog ni legs par rnyed/ /de mi'i 'jig rten dbyangs kyi ༄yan lag ldan/ /rab tu 'byung ba legs rnyed zas legs spyad/ /ces 'byung ba dang / sangs rgyas bcu gnyis pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs las/ gzugs dang mtshan ni phun sum tshogs/ /zhes dang /spos ngad de yi kha nas 'byung / /sogs lus kyi yon tan dang /tshangs pa'i dbyangs ni ldan par 'gyur/ /sogs ngag gi yon tan dang / mos byed shes rab 'chal mi 'gyur/ /sogs yid kyi yon tan dang / nor chen khyim du skye bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / dad pa bla na med pa 'thob/ /ces zang zing dang chos kyi longs spyod dang /lha dang dri za klu dbang dang / /mkha' lding lha min gsang ba pa/ /rtag tu de la srung ba byed/ /ces thub par dka' ba'i yon tan la sogs pa mang du 'byung ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa don thams cad grub pa la sogs pa'i mtshan brjod pa'i yon tan yang mdo sde de dang der dngos dang shugs bstan ci rigs pas gsal bar mdzad pa dang / phyogs bcu mun sel dang bkra shis brgyad pa'i mdor/ mtshan de dag srung ba chen por bstan pa dang / za ma tog bkod pa la sogs par byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan mang du bsngags par rgyas par mdo nyid las rig par bya'o/ /de 358

sangs rgyas byang sems mtshan btus/ pod/ 5dag la tshad mas drangs pa'i nges shes skyed tshul yang / rin chen drwa ba can gyis zhus pa las/ de'i mtshan la som nyi mi za zhing / /ngas mthong ba la yang yid ches na/ /zhes gsung sa te som nyi mi za zhes bya ba ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams la yang the tshom gyi nyes pas ci tsam du sgrib pa'i tshul mdo sde mang du gsungs pa'i don de lta bu la dgongs so/ /ngas mthong ba la yang yid ches na zhes pas rgyal ba de dag gi sngon gyi smon lam gyi khyad par rnams tshu rol mthong ba la shin tu lkog gyur du bstan nas/ de la de bzhin gshegs pa'i yul tshad mar byed dgos so zhes bka' bstsal pa yin te/ de'i don ni 'di 'dra ba'i gnas la lung dpyad pa gsum gyis dag pa rgyu mtshan du byed par shing rta chen po rnams kyis bshad pa lta bu'o/ /mtshan 'di dag gis sngar chos ma thos shing dran par ma byas pa'i sems can 'chi ga ma rnams la'ang phan gdags par bya ste/ des kyang de la sman yon chen po btags par 'gyur ba'i phyir te/ rgya mtsho'i chu srin gyi byung ba snying rje padma dkar po'i mdor bshad pa dang / nya khri'i rabs ji skad 'byung ba bzhin no/ /phan yon gong du smros pa de dag 'thob pa'i dus tshad kyang ji lta bu zhe na/ 'di la rten gyi gang zag lhag pa'i bsam pa'i stobs mchog dman gyi rim pa mi 'dra ba la brten nas myur 359

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bul gyi bye brag tu ma zhig yod par sangs rgyas phal po che las bshad la phan yon brjod tshul 'ga' zhig ni dus gzhan la dgongs te gsungs pa'i dgongs pa can yang chen po dag gis bshad de/ tshul 'dis ni mdo'i dngos bstan du byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gtso bor mdzad de gsungs pa gang la la byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa'i rigs kyi ba'am rigs kyi ba mos de ra mi rigamibazhin gshegs pa'i mtshan 'di dag dus gsum du 'dzin par byed na zhes bya ba la sogs pa 'byung ba rnams kyang theg pa la ma zhugs pa rnams kyis mtshan de dag 'dzin na don du mi 'gyur ba'i don can ma yin par shes par bya ste/ ji ltar 'phags pa 'od dpag med kyi zhing khams bkod pa'i mdo byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi smon lam yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir du bka' bstsal pa yin yang / bde ba can gyi zhing gi yon tan brjod pa de thos na skye bo gzhan gyi don du mi 'gyur ba min par grags che ba bzhin no/ /de ltar na bshad par khas blangs pa'i skabs don yongs su rdzogs par gleng zin to/ /dpang gyur kun mkhyen lung gi chu gter che/ /yang dag rigs pa'i srub shing gis bsrubs pas/ /don ldan gtam gyi zla ba gsar pa zhig /skal bzang yid mkha'i ngos su dal gyis rgyu/ /360

sangs rgyas byang sems mtshan btus/ pod/ 5de ltar bdag gis rgyal la dad pa yis/ /chos mthun gtam 'dir chung zad ngal ba las/ /bsod nams phung po gang zhig ses pa'i mthas/ /byang chab sing por 'gro kan ga'ol gyar cig /2rngolko nodang rari sna/ rang / / / skurab /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i mtshan byin rlabs can mdo sde las btus pa thos pa don ldan ngag gi rol mo zhes bya ba/ dkon mchog gsum la dad pa dang ldan pa'i btsun pa sog tsha tshe phyug nas nan tan chen pos bskul ba'i ched dang / rang yozhan mang po la phan par bsam pas kyang mtshams sbyar te/ 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi mas rnam 'gyur zhes pa lcags stag sa ga'i nya ba'i dkar phyogs kyi dga' ba thog ma la legs par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sdom brtson blo gsal dam pa tshul khrims nor bus bgyis pa 'dis kyang rang dang gzhan la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung bar gyur cig sarba maṅga lo// //361

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/༄/ /bhoṭa'i yul gyi slob dpon chen po mañdzu shrī dharma mi tra'i zhabs kyi rtogs pa mdo tsam du brjod pa 'jig rten kun tu dga' ba'i gter zhes bya ba bzhugs so//na mo gu ru mañdzu shrī ye/ tshogs gnyis ri bo'i ba gam rtser 'dzegs thub bstan mkha' la rgyan du byed/ /phrin las 'od kyis phyogs stong spyi bor mdzes sdug cod pan nyin bzhin 'dogs/ /dam pa'i blo gros chu skyes tshal nang kun dga'i rol pa 'bum 'gyed pa/ /'jam dbyangs rjes brtse'i chu gter las bltams bla ma'i nyin byed rgyal gyar cig /de yi bka' drin lcags kyas drangs pa'i //rngo| rig mi /ste pa ra pa /rdo peyid/ / 'phrogs dga' bar la bas nyer bskyod nga / /'dod pa'i gom stabs bsod nams dzam bu'i nags/ /rtse gcig bsgyur ba'i ca co dbyangs su len/ /zab cing rgya che'i sbyor ba brgyas bsags pa/ /dag pa'i thugs mnga' rnams kyi rnam par thar/ /so so rang rig yul la bdag 'dra bas/ /ci dgar smra ba'i go skabs ga la rnyed/ /'on kyang bden gsung bdud rtsi'i rlabs phyur ba/ /dang ba'i snyim par cha tsam 'thung ba las/ /blo gros lang 362

'jam dbyangs marṣa brtse rin po che'i rtogs brjod/ pod/ 5tsho rgyags pa'i myos glu ni/ /rang bzhin brjod pa'i rtogs brjod phreng bar spel/ /de la lnga brgya pa rnams kyi gtsug gi nor bu/'dzam bu'i gling na che ba'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug 'jam dpal chos kyi bshes gnyen zhes snyan grags kyi yi ges sa gzhi'i dkyil 'khor brgyan par mdzad pa de nyid 'jig rten du ji ltar byung ba'i tshul ni/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi gdul zhing / bod kha ba can gyi shar phyogs/ mdo khams sde dge'i mnga' ris las/ yul gyi dge bcu g.yang du chags shing nye 'khor bkra shis rtags brgyad kyis re khās bkra la/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i grong mang po dang 'dabs 'brel bas khyad par du 'phags pa gter lhung zhes pa'i sa'i cha shas/ nyang rin po che'i gter lung las/ rtse sgang zhes pa'i ri bo'i mdun: pha bong klu dbang 'khyil ba'i steng : mnga' bdag 'jam pa'i dbyangs zhes 'byung : bcu gsum zab mo'i gter la spyod: ces pa ltar/rgyab ri rtse sgang du grags pa'i mdun/ brag ri sbrul 'khyil ba lta ba'i gzags su gnas pa'i steng / de'u mgo zhes pa'i grong du zini mi zir kya 119dza ///ji 1//goyab tshang chags shing / sku bltams sa dadkus khyung —na brag nye 'dabs su dbyar mal phog yod pa'i skabs/ ras dkar gyi lding gur phub pa'i nang du byung bas/ gu ru tshe brtan rgyal mtshan pa'i 363

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gter yig las/ mon bu spyi ring skra yi lwa ba can: ri bo khyung chen lding ba'i zhol du 'byung : zhes 'byung ba dang shin tu 'grigs/ de'ang mdzes sdug gi yon tan las ming chags pa myos kyi rigs las mi dbang sde dge'i drung chen gtsug lag gnyis la blo gros mchog tu yangs pa rin chen dbang rgyal dang / yum mdun na 'don gtso bo'i rgyud du byung ba dge rab bu mo bsod nams mtsho'i sras su rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i sa mo yos la lhums su zhugs/de'i tshe yum gyi lus mdangs dang ldan zhing bde ba dang / dge sems rang bzhin gyis 'phel bar gyur te/ mngal du zla ba brgyad bzhugs nas lcags 'brug chu stod zla ba'i chos 'khor dus chen dang nye ba dkar phyogs rdzogs pa dang po'i tho rangs khyim nyi ma shar ba lta bu'i 'od kyis gang ba dang / nyi ma shar dus su chu snod kyi chu 'o ma'i phung por bsnyon nus par song ba sogs ltas khyad par can gyis mdun bsus te/ de nyid kyi nyi ma'i gung la kun dga'i lang tsho smin mtshams dpa' bo'i rgya rtags kyis spras shing /skye mched shin tu dang ba/ kho lag yangs shing sku byad lta na sdug pa/'khri shing gsar pa'i 'dab ma ltar mnyen la gzi brjid kyis snum pa/ spos kyi shing bzhin lhan cig skyes pa'i dri bsung zhim po can/dbyig gi gdangs sprin gyi nga ro lta ba'i rgyan dang ldan pa zhig dab rig me rig mi364

'jam dbyangs masmo brtse rin po che'i rtogs brjod/ pod/ 5skra nag po sil bar gyar cing / sha ma'i g.yogs chos gos dkri ༄ ༄tshul ltar mnab pa/ ku sha'i se ral kha dang bcas pa'i rnam pas yum la gnod pa med par bltams/ byang chub sems dpa' rin po che 'di byung ba'i mthu las khyim de bkra shis kyi gzi dang ldan par gyur pa tsam du ma zad/ rgyal khams spyir yang bde ba dang lo legs pa sogs 'jig rten skyong ba rnams btsas ston byed pa la brtson pa bzhin du gyur ro/ /mdo khams stod smad phal cher sngo 'jam dpal rtag ngus gang ba 'di'ang rje bla ma ma byon gong du med zer te/ si tu chos 'byung gi dris lan zhig dang bstun na bden par gsal/ /byis pa'i dus nas nag po chen po dang re ma tis rgyun du srung ba rnams dngos su gzigs/ gzhon nu de ni rang bzhin gyis brtse ba che zhing / gtong ba la dgyes pa dang / des shing 'grogs na bde ba dang / snying stobs chen po'i ngang tshul sus kyang dgag tu mi btub/ grub chen dril bu zhabs dang / paṇḍi ta sgo mtha' yas pa'i blo gros/ nags kyi rin chen/ mnga' skyong khri lde/ 'brom chos kyi rgyal po/ thang rgyal sogs 'phags bod kyi skyes mchog mang por 'khrungs pa'i sngon rabs kyi mdzad pa dang 'brel bar chos kyi rnam grangs dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen dgon gnas dkyil 'khor 365

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/’mang po sogs rjes su dran/ lar yang skyes bu chen po 'di lo rgyus 'chad pa na sngon rabs kyi yi ge snga phyi rnams su mi 'byung ba'i gtam gyi sbyor ba zhib mo rang tshig gi sa ma bsal ba nyan pa po'i blos mkhyud dka' ba sha stag 'byung ste sngon gnas rjes dran gyi mthur snang / sku tshe mang por byang chub sems dpa'i nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims khyad par can legs par sbyangs pa'i rgyu mthun las sku na shin tu phra mo nas rab byung kho na la dgyes shing khyim pa'i rtags ring du spangs/ rdza dang gangs khrod sogs dben gnas 'ba' zhig la rtag tu dgongs pa'i rnam 'gyur dang dus dang dus su bsam gtan la mnyam par 'jog pa'i kun spyod/ldang ba na chos 'chad pa'i lad mo sogs rmad du byung ba'i rol rtsed kyang mdzad/ lhan cig skyes pa'i shes rab rlabs che bas sku tshe 'dir sgra snyan sdeb sbyor dang nang gi rig gnas ci yang ma bslabs pa dgung grangs bcu gnyis skor du yang bstod tshogs dang mdo sngags lam rim/ gzhan dag chos la skul ba'i gtam sogs zad mi shes par dgongs nyams byung rgyal gyi ngang nas rtsom chog pa dang / de dag kyang rjod byed kyi nyams 'gyur/ brjod bya'i 'gangs/ gong 'og gi 'brel phun sum tshogs pas mkhas pa rnams kyi yid 'phrog pa kho na yod/ dgung lo brgyad du phebs pa 366

'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse rin po che'i rtogs brjod/ pod/ 5dkun snyun gyi tshor ba rtsub mos thugs bsdus pa lta bu'i rkyen las mngon sum gyi snang char o rgyan rin po che dang ḍākki'i dbang mo mkhar chen bzas rdo rje phur pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur bas bar chad dngos grub kyi grogs su lhongs shing / lan gcig gter lhung gi brag skyibs shig tu nam mkha' nas dhī'i rang sgra chen po grags pas cung zad brgyal thabs su song / de las sad ma thag rje btsun mkhyen pa'i gter dang slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen dbyer med pa'i sku'i snang ba dang dgongs pa ting nge 'dzin gyis byin gyis brlabs/ dgung lo bco lnga par nyin snang dngos dang dbye ba mi phyed pa lta bu'i nyams kyi gsal char rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi gandho la rim pa dgu pa gser gyi rgya phibs dang sman shing gi ra ba sogs bkod pa bzang zhing rgya che bar slob dpon chen po 'jam dpal bshes gnyen las shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i chos kyi gsang mdzod thob/gandho la'i sgo drung du me phung chen po 'bar ba zhig gzigs par dbang med du zhugs par rags lus sbyangs/ dwangs ma 'od kyi lus su snang ba'i ngang la paṇa chen bi ma la dngos kyi nga rgyal du 'byams klas/ lo de'i rgyal zla bar tshe sgrub mdzad pa'i tho rangs zhig bzlas pa la babs pa na nam mkha'i dbyings nas ḍā ma ru'i 367
