pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rsharsha tsharasgra dang shin tu zhim pa'i dri bsung bcas 'od dmar bkrag mdangs 'bar ba zhig sgrub rdzas kyi steng nas zhugs shing 'dres pa'i klong du ye shes ḍākki tsaṇḍa li gar stabs bsgyur ba'i zhal nas dbang dang gdams pa bstsal ba'i mthar shis brjod kyi me tog dmar po char du bsnyil ba'i gzigs snang dang lhan cig sgrub dkyil steng du g.yar mo thang lta bu'i me tog gi char pa dngos gnas la babs/ lo bcu drug bzhes pa'i sa ga zla ba'i tshes bcur padma 'od gling du phebs par zangs mdog dpal ri brag ri lhun chags kyi rnam par gzigs pa'i khong du shing bal gyi 'dab ma spungs pa lta bu'i sprin gsar mdzes pa'i klong na dpal o rgyan chos kyi rgyal po rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i 'khor rgya mtsho lta bu dang bcas par gzigs shing / sku gsum ngo sprod kyi gdams pa thun mong ma yin pa bstsal ba sogs las rdo rje gsum gyi ye shes gong du 'phel/skye bas thob pa'i yon tan phul byung dang / /ngang gis rlabs chen mgon dang bcas gyur pa'i/ /tshul 'dis rje btsun sku tshe du ma nas/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs chen bsags par rtogs/ /dgung lo brgyad nas yab dang bla sman chos grags rgya mtsho sogs las bris klog dang rtsis dkar nag bod kyi brda sprod gzhung gnyis/ gso rig rgyud bzhi yan lag phra mo tshun gyi bshad 368

'jam dbyangs masmo brtse rin po che'i rtogs brjod/ pod/ 5pa dang lag len/ sku gzugs mchod rten dang dkyil 'khor gyi cha tshad spos sbyor sogs ches mkhas shing byang bar bslabs/ de nas ring po ma lon par yab gshegs pa'i rkyen gyis re zhig gsan sbyangs 'phro can du lus/ yab yum 'das nas cir 'gyur gzigs pas yab lcang lo can du 'phags pa lag na rdo rje'i zhal mthong ba'i gnod sbyin zhig dang / yum zhing skyes sha za ṭakki zhig tu skyes pa mthong gsungs/ dgung lo bcu dgu par ze chen pa 'gyur med mthu stobs las sgra ka tsaṇa dbyangs gsum gyi ri mo dang go don rgyas pa/ mngon brjod 'chi med mdzod rtsa 'grel/ snyan dngags me long / sdeb sbyor rin 'byung sogs gsan bsam mang du sbyangs pas so so la mkhas pa'i tshad du phyin/ dgung grangs nyer gcig par o rgyan smin grol gling gi chos grwar mkhan chen 'gyur med rig 'dzin bzang po sogs dad pa'i dge 'dun grangs tshang ba las bsnyen par rdzogs/ sa skya bdag chen rdo rje rin chen dang smin gling khri 'gyur med sangs rgyas kun dga' sogs du ma las smon 'jug gi thugs bskyed bzhes/ snga phyir ngor sa skya dpal ldan 'bras spungs/ bkra shis lhun po/ mdo khams sogs su bzhugs te/ gzim 'og mchog sprul byams pa ngag dbang bstan 'dzin snyan grags/ sgo mang zhabs drung dkon mchog 369

21rngad/ pa/ :rdo sdi/rngaku 'o/:drob/thag byaspucad ngasabastazud rta):re ba/sdosajinga'o/dra/zug/ nga〉bstan pa rab rgyas/ the bo sprul sku ye shes thub bstan rgya mtsho/ li thang rab 'byams pa byams pa phun tshogs/ sems dpa' chen po 'jigs med rgyal ba'i mya gu sogs las/ byang chub lam sgron dang 21 ming rtsa'ithosgo zir ra༅21 rtsar byenge 4447 ta ba' 'u bum sngan / byang chub lam ram chung / zla sbyang don bdun ma/ legs bshad kun 'dus/ lam rim bde lam dang / 'jam dpal zhal lung / rnying phyogs sngon 'gro'i khrid rim mang po sogs bstan rim gyi yi ge du ma dang de dag gi rgyab chos 'dul ba mdo rtsa/ rgyan 'jug gnyis/ mdzod/ rnam 'grel/bsdus grwa tshun chad rgya cher sbyangs pas sa dge'i lugs srol padma'i 'dab ma ltar bkra ba rnams la rab brtags ma yin par gting mtha' med pa'i blo gros kyi 'jug pa sad/ gtso bor smos pa'i dam pa de dag dang / dpal sa skya pa chen po bkra shis rin chen/ngor chen byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin dang / byams pa rnal 'byor bzang po/ dpon slob rin po che ngag dbang legs grub/zha lu mchog sprul rin chen blo gsal bstan skyong / 'bras spungs lha btsun rin po che ye shes don grub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ rta nag sgrol ma ba 'jam dbyangs chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang blo gros mtha' yas sogs bgrang bar dka' ba'i rdo rje'i slob dpon rnams las/ bya rgyud rigs gsum/ rnam snang mngon byang /370

'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse rin po che'i rtogs brjod/ pod/ 5tyārdor dbyings/ 'jam dpal gsang ldan sogs yo ga'i skor rdo rje'i phreng ba/ kye rdo rje'i dbang dang rgyud gsum yan lag dang bcas pa/ gser chos bcu gsum sogs dpal ldan sa skya pa'i dbang gdams che phra mtha' dag sngags rim/ gsang bde dus 'khor 'jigs byed skor sogs rje btsun tsong kha pa rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i gzhung lugs rgya mtsho/ mdo sgyu sems gsum dang /bka' brgyad yang phur sogs rnyingabyuphyogs bka' babs kyi chu bo bzhi'i chos tshul mtha' yas pa phal cher re re'ang lan du mar gsan te/ de bzhin du shangs chos mar lugs zhi byed gcod yul sogs la'ang 'dra ste mdor na yongs 'dzin dam pa brgya lnga bcu bsten nas bod gangs can tsam na rgyun bzhugs tshad kyi dbang dang gdams pa la ma gsan pa med pa lta bur mdzad/ bka' 'gyur rin po che dang / snga 'gyur rgyud 'bum/ bstan 'gyur rgyun gang bzhugs sogs bklag lung kho na yang glegs bam bdun brgya lhag tsam gsan/ de'ang 'chad nyan dang glegs bam gyi rgyun re re'i ched du'ang rigs rus stobs 'byor sogs kyis khengs pa dang / sde ris dang grub mtha'i phyogs zhen shul lam rim bgrod dang chos sgugs kyi ngal bas zhum pa sogs yong ye mi mnga' bar dka' spyad khur du khyer ba'i chos tshol gyi rnam thar brjod par mi 371

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/sgenus shing / ngor chen las bde mchog nag po lugs kyi dbang gsan skabs bla ma he ru ka zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis par gzigs pa dang / rje 'jam dpal bzang po rnal 'byor dbang phyug birba par gzigs pa sogs bla ma sangs rgyas su mthong tshul rmad du byung bas byang drangs te/ chos gsan pa'i bla ma thams cad la gces dgu'i bdog pas mchod pa sogs sgo du ma nas mnyes pa ma bsgrubs pa dang / phyin ci log gi bsam sbyor ngan pa gcig bcang ba'ang med gsungs te 'di kho na yang snyigs ma'i dus kyi rang byung gi kun mkhyen mang pos bsam par sla ba'ang ma yin pa'i rnam thar ngo mtshar bar mthong ngo/ /dbang chos gsan pa na dngos grub grub pa'i nang gi ltas khyad par can yang mang du gzigs tshul mtshan gzhi ngos 'dzin tsam brjod na/ rdo rje phreng ba gsan skabs sta gon gyi nub mo'i tho rangs/ skyes bu brjid chags pa snum bag can bong tshad gzhan las nyis 'gyur gyis che ba za 'og nag po'i gos lhub gyon byas pa zhig gis thog drangs skye bo'i tshogs rab tu mang pos rang nyid la 'dud pa dang / shar phyogs nas nyi ma zhig shar ba thugs kar thim/ de las slar skar ma lta bu'i nyi ma chung ngu mang po 'phro ba dang / bye'u chung ngu zhig khras ded pa srog bskyab mdzad pa rnams byung / de nyid nas brtsis 372

〈co 'o/joṭazu/ rngasnodrarmidziputhag bya/tāstan ngasarbegi 5rdozug dzes byebye:rno |tsāb/ba/ nga/:jojug/ 21rngad/ kā/pa'i nub bzhi par/ chu chen po zhig brgal ba'i pha rol pha bong zhig gi steng du grub chen rdo rje dril bu zhabs bzhugs 'dug de'i 'khris su kun tu rgyu'i cha byad can zhig gis li khri dngos yin tshul gyis shing lo dmar ser reg pas tshon dmar ser du 'gyur ba zhig dpral bar bslan/ darba dngos yin zhes shing tog ser po zhig 45byin pa gsol bas ro khyad par du 'phags pa byung / bcud len mchog tu 'gyur zhes zer/ de nas re zhig na lha khang gog po zhig tu rgyal ba ma pham pa'i snang brnyan khyad 'phags shig thigs pas 'jig la khad du 'dug pa zhig gsos mdzad pas dar gcig na zhal ras yan chad legs po zhig grub/ de'i spyan sngar rab gnas dang tshogs kyi 'khor lo mdzad pa'i mthar/ oṃ shrī a la la hoḥbade chen gyi ye shes mthar son pas/ /kha sbyor la yan lag bdun dang ldan/ /dpal rdo rje 'chang chen mi gzugs can/ /rje bla ma'i zhabs pad snying nas dran/ /phung po dang khams dang skye mched kun//gdan gsum gyi dkyil 'khor gcig tu shar/ /rje bla ma sku yi rdo rje la/ /yul snang stong gi ngang nas gsol ba 'debs/ /rtsa a ba dhū ti'i rgyud mangs las/ rlung mi shigs nā da'i dbyangs snyan len/ /rje bla ma gsung gi rdo rje la/ /sgra grags stong gi ngang nas gsol ba 'debs/ /thabs bde ba chen pos drangs pa yi/ /stong nyid la 373

21rngad/ spre zerdo sdi/ngas 'o/:dropo/bzhi byaspurngasno thababastazud rta):re ba/sdo/spyang 'o/dra/zu// pharasnying rje'i rang rtsal rdzogs/ /rje bla ma thugs kyi rdo rje la/ /blo rig stong gi dang nas gsol ba 'debs/ ches phra ba'i rtsa rlung thig le'i khams/ /'od gsal du dwangs pa'i zung 'jug sku/ /rje bla ma ye shes rdo rje la/ /don dbyer med kyi ngang nas gsol ba 'debs//nges 'byang gi chu yis snying rab bsil/ /tshul khrims kyi bslab rir :jordo /rje)༷༷/ 1(1 (re/pas lus ngag dag /ting 'a na dngha dnghad sa mas rgyud dul/ /shes rab kyi mig dang ldan par shog /snang ba kun 'a ja' tshon lha skur shar/ /stong pa yang bde bdi thabs dang bcas/ /zung 'jug la dga' bzhi'i rtsal rdzogs pa'i/ /go 'phang de tshe 'dir 'grub gyur cig /ces pa'i glu dbyangs mdzad pa dang / nub bdun par/ lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang du nang skor la phebs par phyag tu 'bras dkar gyis khengs pa'i rin po che'i za ma tog 'dug pa nas 'thor bzhin du byon pas sa la chags rim bzhin du me tog dkar po re lam lam skyes/ jo bo rin po che'i drung du spro bzhin slebs/ der mar me brgya skong zhig sbar grabs byas 'dug pa'i 'khris der ngo mi 'tshal ba'i mi zhig gis/ sku zhabs kyi grub rtags khyad par 'phags/ da mar me 'di rnams la thugs smon gnang na rang 'bar du yong / de byung na smon lam gang btab myur du 'grub zer bar/ mar me la dmod btsugs te 374

'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse rin po che'i rtogs brjod/ pod/ 5me tog 'thor bas rang 'bar du song / der phan bde 'byung ba'i sogs dang / 'jig rten bde zhing sogs kyi smon lam btab pas da ci'i mi de na re/ rang don du'ang smon lam zhig mdzod dang zer bar/ phar ltos dpon med tshur ltos g.yog med cing / /'dul rgyu'i dgra med skyong rgyu'i gnyen med par/ /dben pa'i gnas su rang sems 'dul ba dang / /rlabs chen rgyal sras spyod pa mthar phyin shog /ces btab pas yi rang ba'i rnam 'gyur ston pa dang / nub bcu par rang nyid 'khrungs yul yin snyam pa'i sman ljongs nyams dga' ba zhig tu slebs/ der bdud rtsi ril bur 'gro ba'i sngo sman rnams tshol ba'i 'dun pas phebs par phal cher zhig rnyed/ slar a ru ra'i nags tshal thol le ba zhig tu phyin/ de nas sman gyi drang srong yin zer ba'i dge slong bgres po zhig 'dug pas sngo sman mang po'i ngos 'dzin dang / sman sbyor kha shas gsung / de la yul 'di rgya bal gyi sa cha zhig yin 'dra ste ji skad zer ba lags zhus pas/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi gnas khyad par can yin/ sku rang byon kyang bzhugs pas mjal du 'dong zhes khrid/ khang bzang cud zad gog pa zhig gi sgo phye ba'i nang du mtsho nag ngam pa zhig gi dbus bde mchog gi sku blos mi 'chud pa'i chen po zhig mjal/ zil bsam gyis mi khyab pas 375

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/sgere zhig brgyal bsnyam byed pa sogs mnal ltas mtha' dag brjod par mi nus shing / phyi rol du'ang 'jigs med rgyal ba'i myu gu las klong chen snying thig gi dbang khrid che long gsan skabs bzhugs sgar la 'ja' kha dog lnga ba'i gur khyim phub pa sogs dge mtshan shar/ nyid kyi yongs 'dzin rnams kyang phul du byung ba'i yon tan gyis thugs phrogs te rje rang gi khu bo rmog ston mthu stobs dbang po 'jigs bral chos dbyings rdo rjes/ khyod 'jigs bral gyi slob dpon don thams cad grub pa yin no zhes rjes su bsngags pa dang / ngor chen kun dga' bstan 'dzin pas rtsod dus kyi thams cad mkhyen par bkur ba dang / sa skya khri chen bkra shis rin chen gyis/ sras lcam dral la khyod tshos mdo khams mchog sprul 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i zhal mjal rgyu byung na skal ba phun sum tshogs pa yin de da mjal dka'/ skal bzang chos sgron khyod kyis mjal yong gsung ba dang / gtsang paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa bstan pa'i nyi mas phrin yig gi lam nas bsngags shing /dngos mjal dus dar nang mdzod mgul du gsol/ gser zho 'khor lnga phyag tu gtad/ dbu la phyag gis byugs te thar rtse ma hā paṇḍita zhes gces spras kyis bstod pa sogs mtha' yas/ snga phyi ci rigs par gso rig rgyud bzhi dang / bka' pod kyi rtsa ba sogs 376

'jam dbyangs masmo brtse rin po che'i rtogs brjod/ pod/ 5gzhung mang po thugs 'dzin mdzad/ ris med pa'i gsung rab kyi dpe klog tshad bzung mi btub pas dus mang 'das/ brda sprod la thugs ma bsgrims zhing bslabs nas ring po ma lon par slob dpon mnyes pa'i tshig rgyug phul ba dang / snyan dngags gsal byed nges pa'i bya dka' saṃ skyi ta'i skad du brtsams pa dang /mdzad pa bcu gnyis dang sbyar ba'i kun bzang 'khor lo'i re mig dbyangs nges pa'i tshig rgyun gyi phreng bar spel ba sogs rtsom pa'i nyams 'gyur phul du byung ba mnga' zhing / rang gi mkhyen rab kyi rtsal gyis nad gang dang gang la gnyen po'i sman sbyor ci dang ci brtsams pa de dag de kho na ltar mi bslu ba dang / sman dpyad gang sbyar ba thams cad 'tsho phyed phal dang mi 'dra ba'i phan stobs chen po can du 'byung ba dang / nang rig pa'i gzhung lugs chen po ci 'dra zhig gzigs kyang gzigs pa tsam gyis gting slebs par nus pa dang / chos kyi grags pa'i rigs gzhung la zhugs ma thag nas mkhas pa'i mdun sar gtan tshigs rig pa'i bgro gleng mkhas pa mgu ba'i khyad chos can mdzad pa dang / grub mtha' phyogs med kyi dgag bzhag dang / rang lugs kyi khas len/ mdo sngags kyi lam gnad/ grub chen so so'i lugs srol/ sgrub phrin gyi lag len phra mo yan chad rgyu mtshan zhib tig dang bcas te rang 377

21rngad/ ji lngardo sdispying/ khur:drob/thab byasarngasno ngasartagazug rta):re ba/sdosathang 'o/dra/zug/ ra〉rang so so'i brgyud 'dzin rnams kyang spa bkong nus par bsnyad du yod pa sogs brtson 'grus dang shes rab kyi rnam 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab/ ji skad brjod pa'i chos tshol gyi khongs sa bsod ༄nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs rlabs po che rdzogs pa'i rten 'brel las/ lan cig dga' ldan nas 'ongs zer ba'i paṇḍi ta chos gos rdo tshos can mnab pa zhig gis byams chos lnga la brten nas gdams ngag dang rjes bstan bstsal te/ de 'phags pa thogs med yin par 'dug gsungs pa dang slob dpon kā ma la shī la las dpal ldan zhi ba 'tsho'i rigs pa'i lam srol gsan pa dang /o rgyan gyi slob dpon rdo rje dril bu pa yum dang bcas pas brda'i dbang bzhi bskur/ lam rim pa lnga'i bcud 'dril gsungs pa'i mthar snying dbus mi shigs pa'i thig ler zhugs pa dang / byang sham bha lar gshegs te rigs ldan dpal skyong las mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas gsan pa dang / slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ba las sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i lam rim nod pa dang / lho brag mar pas phyag rgya chen pos brda bstan pa dang / rig 'dzin dga' rab rdo rje g.yas g.yon na padma dang shri sedha bzhugs pas rdzogs chen gyi lam gnad rgya cher phye ba dang / bla chen brtse ba chen pos ma rgyud dgyes pa rdo rje'i dbang dang man ngag gnang ba sogs sangs rgyas 378

'jam dbyangs masmo brtse rin po che'i rtogs brjod/ pod/ 5dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang theg mchog bgro ba'i longs spyod rmi lam du'ang rgyun mi chad cing / gtsang stod sa chen phug par smra seng gi sgrub pa mdzad pa'i tshe rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs dmar ser li khri'i chu gter dwangs pa'i 'od phung gi klong na bzhugs pa'i thugs ka nas glegs bam gyis mtshan pa'i utpal kha phye ma thag pa dang ral gri zhig spros te rje nyid kyi thugs dang 'dres pas nyin zhag mang por ting nge 'dzin gyi dgyes pas thugs drangs pa sogs lhag pa'i lha'i dgongs pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i dbang gis lhag par yang mkhyen rab dbyar gyi chu bo ltar rdol/tshul khrims 'dzin mar thos pa'i chu klung bsags/ /sangs rgyas ye shes klu dbang bye bas bzung / /rigs tshul ngag gi rlabs phreng 'bum spro ba/ /smra ba'i khyu mchog rnam par bsgying ba'i gtam/ /bsdu ba'i tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /sku na gzhon nu nas chen po'i ngo srung dang nye du'i kha 'dzin gyod 'khon gyi gnyer ba sbyin bdag la khe spogs 'tshol ba dang grong chog ldom bu brgya bshig nas stong 'gugs pa sogs kyi bsam sbyor mnal lam du'ang mi 'byung ba'i bya btang chen por bzhugs/ de lta na'ang dkyus ma'i mdzad spyod kyi bab las de ltar shes pa ma gtogs sger gyi phyi tshul la skyo shas kyis thugs lhag par gdung ba 379

11rngad/ pa/ lngardo sdispyings 'o/:drob/thag byasaspras thaspu/lngazud phyo):re po//sdusprang khuradra/zug/ 〈lilta bu dang / de'i shan gyis phyag dbang dang chos 'brel tsam la'ang mi bzod pa'i rnam pa 'dra bo'i mngon tshan can ye nas mi mdzad/ mes dbon gyi chos 'khor gsum dang / sku gsung thags ༄yon tan phrin las kyi gnas chen lnga sogs stod lho mon dang mnga' ris man chad kyi gtsug lag khang dang grub pa'i gnas chen bgrang bar dka' ba rnams su mu to kun tu rgyu'i brtul zhugs kyis dka' ba du ma spyad de rgyu zhing gshegs/ lha ldan jo bo rin po che'i spyan sngar slebs pa'i tshe mchog gi sprul sku dngos dang mjal ba lta bu'i mos gus kyi 'gyur ba mi bzlog pas thugs phrogs/ jo mdun du mchod rdzas sna gcig 'bul rgyu med par 'jug ma myong zhing /mjal res kyis bka' gdams kyi rnam thar gtsang ma 'khyong ba'i smon lam kho na rtsal du bton nas btab gsungs/ gzhan yang chos sde dang dben gnas rten gsum gang mjal ba rnams la mchod 'bul/ bsnyen sgrub tshogs mchod/ bstod bsngags dang smon lam gyi tshigs bcad mang po brtsams te phul ba sogs zad mi shes pa'i bsnyi stangs mdzad/ de dag tu byin rlabs kyi zil chen pos thugs snang rang dbang med par 'gyur ba lan mang du byung zhing lha ldan 'phags pa rang byon lnga ldan las sprul pa'i ring bsrel 'ga' zhig dang / yar klung tshe chu 'bum par tshe'i bdud rtsi khyad /380

po〉 khurajoṭazug chisdodrarmisprangathag zugastemin ngasarbegi :sdezud 11 byebye:re |tsāb/theg rngaspro:sdorngasno/ casarngad/ kā par can mig 'phrul lta bur phyag tu babs/ ti sgro'i tshogs khang chen mor o rgyan rin po che yab yum gyis mnal lam du dbang bskur ba dang / byang ra sbreng du jo bo 'jam pa'i rdo rje dang /dpal ldan a ti sha'i 'dra sku dbu yon ma gnyis lha dang bla ma de dang de dngos su gzigs pa na/ de skor sbyar dug tu dogs pa'i snyun gzhi lci ba zhig yod pa'ang skad cig la dwangs pa'i cho 'phrul dang / rtsi khog tu rje btsan dam pa sangs rgyas nyi 'de ma'i cha byad ༄can gyis dam chos sdug bsngal zhi byed pha phog tu bstsal ba dang /zangs ri mkhar dmar du phebs dus lab kyi sgron ma'i sku 'dra rin po che zhal bzhad cing sku g.yo 'gul mdzad pas sa g.yo ba lta bu'i zil chen zla grogs kun gyis tshor ba dang bcas gcod yul gyi bka' babs brnyes nas rig rtsal gdams ngag tu shar ba'i glu dbyangs kyang mdzad/ jo nang sku 'bum chen mor mkha' 'gro'i rigs kyi mi mo zhig gis sna drangs te phebs pas de'i lus las rlangs zil 'dra bo zhig byung ba skur reg pa'i rkyen gyis bde stong gi nyams mu mtha' med par shar ba'i snang char/ sa phyogs thams cad dag pa'i zhing khams lta bu'i gzigs mor 'bar zhing / de'i dbus su sham bha la'i chos rgyal bdun dang rigs ldan gyi phreng ba mngon sum par mjal ba'i gsal snang shin tu brtan po'i mthar/381

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/nam mkha'i dbyings nas e waṃ gyi sngags sgra zhig byung ba la brten nas dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud don mtha' dag la mi 'jigs pa brnyes pas mtshon te/ dpa' bo dang dpa' mo'i dbang phyag ma rnams kyi thugs rgyud rtogs pa'i byin rlabs 'phos //bye( risi mi /rdo/rdo ———— /3spu/ khroX pa mtshan ma mtshar can zengs 'ga' ma na par ga gas/lang tsho dang po nas brtsams te snga phyir lo grangs bcu gsum snyed du sgom sgrub kyi mtshams bsdam 'ba' zhig mdzad/ sku tshe smad phyogs them spang gdan gcig pa'i brtul zhugs kho nas lo nyi shu rtsa grangs bskyal/ dus rgyun du byang chub kyi sems rin po che rnam pa gnyis la thugs dam mdzad pas/ mos gus can gyi slob ma la rang gi ngang tshul ma bcabs pa'i spring yig stsal ba rnams su'ang /byang chub kyi sems rnam pa gnyis la ci nus su blo sbyangs khul gyis gnas zhes 'di nyid rtogs pa brjod tshul gyi gtso bor bstan/der ma zad gsang sngags kyi nyams len gang gi tshe yang nges 'byung gi bsam pa/ byang chub kyi sems dang / mtha' bral gyi lta ba/ smin byed dbang / srog 'dzin dam tshig rnams ngo bo dang grangs dang go rim nges pa'i sgrom nas 'don pa'i phyogs nyag gcig gtso bor mdzad/ don 'di bka' rtsom gyi gsol 'debs dang smon lam than thun tsam mam/ gzim lam du mgur bzhes 382

'jam dbyangs maṭha brtse rin po che'i rtogs brjod/ pod/ 5pa'i tshigs bcad tsam la bltas kyang mthong ba'i chos so/ /de lta bu'i tshul gyis bya rgyud rigs gsum spyi dang / spyod rgyud rnam snang mngon byang / yo ga rdo rje dbyings rnams la las rung gi ljags bsnyen dang kun rig bsnyen chen btang / rnam 'jom dang gdugs dkar la sogs pa'i bzlas sgom thor bu pa'ang mang du bsgrubs/ rnal 'byor bla med kyi gsar phyogs gsang bde 'jigs gsum/ kye rdo rje dus kyi 'khor lo/ rje btsun mkha' spyod ma sogs mkha' 'gro ma'i bye brag du ma/ gur zhal sogs chos srung mang po'i bsnyen pa dang / sgom bzlas mdzad cing / rnying phyogs mdo sgyu gnyis bka' brgyad dang phur pa lugs srol bcu dgu tsam/gter kha mang po'i gu ru zhi drag dang thugs rje chen po/ gsar rnying gi tshe sgrub brgya phrag lhag pa gtso bor byas pa'i bzlas bsnyen ches mang ba bskyal/ de dag gi khongs su so so'i kha skong sbyin sreg dang / phal mo che'i las tshogs kyi bsnyen pa bcas phyag len gtsang la zhib pa'i mthar thug pas grub par mdzad/ ji srid cig tu sku mtshams kyi dam bca' bzhag pa'i yun tshad de ma rdzogs bar la nye du dang mi chen sbyin bdag ngo gnyan sus kyang bcad rgya 'dral bar nus mi srid pas brtsams pa'i don la ma tshang ba mi 'byung / nang gi grub rtags mnal lam gyi skabs su dpal he ru 383

stuXsdojid/ 5 lngardo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ka rdo rje gzhon nus phyag tha ma'i phur pas dbang bskur te mnal sad pa na snang grags thams cad rdo rje phur pa'i lha sngags kyi rol par mer mer shigs shigs g.yo ba gzigs shing / 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo yi ge bcu pa'i gsang sngags kyi dbyangs can mngon sum du gshegs nas nyid dang mi gnyis par byin gyis brlabs pa sogs dang / phyi rol gyi mtshan ma'ang tshe rta zung 'brel gyi sgom bzlas dus 'chi med kyi grub cha bam chang gang nam ༄༄ ༄mkha' nas rdol ba dang / phyis su lo gsum tsam la tshe sgrub chag med mdzad skabs tshe chang rgyun bzhag de dbyar mi rul/ dgun mi 'khyag kha dog gser smug shin tu gar ba'i nyams can/ dbus nas gyen du phyur ba la dri ro dpe med pa'i ya mtshan can du gyur pa lta bu mang yang dngos grub yal ba'i rgyu mi 'byung ba thob pas grub pa'i mtshan ma lta ci/ de thad ci zhig gi bsnyen pa la bzhugs pa tsam yang phal cher nye gnas pas kyang mi shes pa yin la/ phyis su'ang kho bos rje nyid kyi shin tu gsang ba'i gzigs snang gi rtogs brjod cig stsol bar zhus pas/ rnal 'byor pa'i nyams la mi 'char ba dang / pra se na'i snang ba la mi bab pa med/ de bshad bsdad na skyes bu'i tshe mtha' dag zad zad du'ang rdzogs pa mi yong ste dgos pa med/ ces dang / gzhan 'ga' zhig gis de rigs 384

'jam dbyangs masmo brtse rin po che'i rtogs brjod/ pod/ 5zhus pa la'ang / rlung khams ldang ba'i mis mi rig mi mthong ba ci yod/ de 'dra la yid rton ci'ang med ces pa'i gsung gi zil gyis mnan pa ltar dgos pa'i dbang gis brgya lam na re zung gsungs pa ma gtogs thos shin tu dka'/ skabs 'gar rags pa'i zhal zas phar zhog /gsol ja'ang 'bul sa med par rlung 'tsho kho nas zhag bdun phrag du ma yol bar mdzad pas bcud len gyi nus pa stobs su gyur/ khyad par du bde mchog lū dril dang nag po lugs/ kye rdo rje'i lam 'bras/ na ro dang ni gu'i chos drug /dus kyi 'khor lo'i sbyor drug /rdzogs chen bi ma dang padma'i bka' srol sogs rgyud sde dang grub chen gyi lam srol mang po la brten nas rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgom mtha' yas pa mngon du mdzad/ rdo rje lus kyi rtsa 'khor mngon sum du gzigs/tsong kha pa chen po'i yi ge'i steng nas mngon brjod nyung ngar thags ༄ ༄dpyad mdzad skabs shig mnal lam du/ sku lus las rnag khrag dang mi gtsang ba mang du thon pa'i mthar dag cing 'jam la ches yangs pa'i sku can zhig tu song / der nam mkha' la gya gyur bzhud nas brag dang nags tshal gyis gtam pa'i ri bo thang maṇḍal bkram pa lta bu'i mthar snang ba zhig tu phebs/ de'i mgul na grub chen lū hi pa yin zer ba'i rnal 'byor pa'i chas can zhig 385

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/mdun phar phyogs te khog ma la me 'bud cing tshod ma btso ba ltar 'dug pa/ ri bo'i zhol nas bdag la dngos grub cig stsol zhes bos pas zhal tshur gzigs pa nas gzi brjid nyi ma ltar bzod dka' ba zhig snang / slar mdun gyi me de drag tu gtor byung ba'i gseb tu nyung ma bsregs pa'i rdog po lta bu'i gong bu gcig 'dugade kha phye ba'i nang nas shing thog las grub pa lta bu'i dpal he ru ka'i sku ser smug nyams brgyar 'bar ba zhig rnyed pa zhal du gsol bas sku thugs bde stong chen po'i ros gang ba'i ngang la sad pa na dpal bde mchog gi byin rlabs rdzogs par brnyes pa'i nges shes 'khrungs pa la sogs pa'i tshul gyis rtsa rlung thig le lhag par yang byin gyis brlabs/ dus gcig na brtan g.yo thams cad bde stong rol pa'i mig 'phrul du gzigs pa dang / dpa' bo ḍākki'i byin rlabs nang 'dzom pa'i rten 'brel las sgyu ma sprul pa ltar snang ba'i sa gzhi yangs shing rgya che bar/ shing lo sngon po'i spyil ba steng ༄thams cad me tog dmar po dang / 'og gzhir kha dog sna tshogs pa'i me tog bkram zhing dri zhim khor yug tu ldang ba zhig phub pa gzigs/ de'i nang du rgyal po'i chas can/ sku bong mi tshad gnyis 'gyur tsam/ gzi brjid shin tu che ba zhig bzhugs 'dug pa'i spyan sngar phebs/ des khyod kyis nga su yin shes sam gsung / mi 386

'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse rin po che'i rtogs brjod/ pod/ 5 shes zhus pas/ nga ni gnas brtan rnams kyi gtso bo sa ra ha zhes grags pa de yin gsung / der rgyal chen ind+ra bhu ti min nam dgongs pa zhig byung ba'i skabs/ de'i zhal nas/ ngas ni mi dung phyur cig bsnyen par rdzogs pa yin/ khyod kyis kyang da ste mi lnga bcu bsnyen par rdzogs dgos kyi/ do nub ngas khyod bsnyen par rdzogs par bya gsung / las byed pa'i dge 'dun mi 'dug snyam du dgongs pa na/ des las byed 'di ltar yod gsungs te dbang gi lta stangs dang lcags kyu'i phyag rgya zhig mdzad ma thag gnam khol ba dang / sa ber bsnyam byed pa'i rol mo'i sgra dang lhan cig glog 'od 'khyug pa'i rum nas mkha' 'gro ma gzhon nu sngo sangs rus pa'i rgyan can mdzes sdug lta bas mi ngoms pa zhig skad cig la mdun du lhags/ de nas legs sbyar skad sha stag gis dbang zhig bskur/ bum dbang gi gnas su phyag spyi bor bzhag gsang dbang snyoms 'jug gi bdud rtsi dngos kyis bskur/ sher dbang la mkha' 'gro ma de bstsal ba las rnyed pa'i dga' bzhi dang dbang bzhi pa tshig gi ngo sprod mdzad pa rnams so so'i thad du ye shes kyi nyams mi 'dra ba re re skyes/ mthar bod kyi skad du/ de rnams kyis dge bsnyen/ dge tshul/ dge slong / gnas brtan rgan po'i go 'phang rnams rim bzhin grub pa yin no/ /zhes gsan mthar 387

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/'od gsal mkha' ltar zhi ba'i dbyings su snyoms par zhugs/ de phyin kyang mda' bsnun chen por pho nya'i zab lam gyi gzhung chen zhig gsan/ mkha' spyod rdo rje btsun mo la sogs pa lhan cig skyes dang rdo rje g.yar mo bsil la sogs pa zhing skyes kyi ḍākki rnams dang 'du ba thob ste bla na med pa'i brtul zhugs kyi mthu chen po grub/ sku lus kyi dbyings la dpa' bo mkha' 'gro til gyi gong bu rdol ba lta bus rdo rje'i rgyud dang sngags kyi sgra mu mtha' med par sgrogs pa dang / dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i skur gyur te bde ba chen po'i me long du rnam pa kun gyi mchog dang ldan pa'i shes bya'i dkyil 'khor rab 'byams cig char du gsal bar rdzogs pa la sogs te bde chen sgyu ma'i rig rtsal phyogs med du shar/ sku dngos las rdo rje sems dpa'i dbang thob tshad phyir mi ldog pa'i skal ba can du dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bos lung bstan/ chos dbang gter byon thugs rje chen po'i gdams pa nyams bzhes dus/stobs bcu mnga' ba'i gdung spel ba por bsngags pa'i ltas su/rje rang gi phyag mthil na de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel gcig 'dug par 'khor ba dong sprugs kyi gzungs sngags zlos bzhin zhal phu btab pas ring bsrel grangs med pa skad cig la 'phel pa'i gzim lam byung / tshang la ma nor thabs mkhas phul byung ba'i//388

'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse rin po che'i rtogs brjod/ pod/ 5rnal 'byor bdud rtsis sim pa'i thugs can rnams/ /mkhas pa min pas smrar yang nus min pa/ /'di 'dra'i yon tan 'thob kyi gzhan du min/ /da ni rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi gsang mdzod ma gtogs gzhan du ma grags pa'i chos tshul rgya mtsho'i gter la rdzogs par dbang bsgyur ba'i sgo nas rdo rje theg pa'i lung rtogs je rgyas su mdzad pa'i tshul gyi phyogs gcig zhar byung dang bcas pa brjod par bya ste/ de'ang sku gzhon nu nas rdzas chos kyi gter kha mang por dbang ba'i rten 'brel sad kyang ched gnyer ma mdzad/ phyis su o rgyan rin po che'i smon lam gyi ri mo bsub tu med pas/dbus su phebs lam byang 'brog dge rgyal du tshes bcu'i mchod pa mdzad skabs/ slob dpon chen po'i dngos zhal gyi snang ba bstan nas rjes sa bzang / bsam yas sa nyang gter mtsho skyes rdo rje'i rig rir rag sku tshab rin po che'i drung du mchod pa rgyas par mdzad pas snang brnyan de mtsho skyes rdo rje 'chang dngos su gyur te mtsho skyes snying thig gi gdams pa bstsal zhing dgongs klong dbyer med du byin gyis brlabs/ lan cig tshes bcu'i nyi shar la mnga' bdag khri srong 'khrungs yul brag dmar mgrin bzang du phebs pa na/ sa g.yo ba lta bu'i rkyen las snod bcud thams cad dpal he ru ka'i 389

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/zhing khams su gzigs pa'i mod/ ye shes mkha' 'gros gter sgrom la bse'i ga'u zhig dngos su bstsal bar 'gro 'dul 'phags pa sems nyid ngal gso'i thugs tig dang / rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i gdams pa ye shes 'od kyi snying po/ bram ze nyer gcig gi gdung sogs byon pa/ mi lo bcu gsum bar shin tu gsang zhing gter chos thugs nyams su bzhes pa las gzhan la 'phrigs tsam yang ma byung / rje btsun nyid kyi bar chad zhi zhing 'gro 'dul gyi phrin las rgyas pa'i rten 'brel khyad par can 'grigs/ phyis sems nyid ngal gso'i chos skor 'ga' zhig gter lung las/ dbang gi gnas su dbang gi dus: dbang chen padma'i rigs skyes pa'i:rnam 'phrul zung gi don du ston: tshom bu dang bcas skal bzang 'gyur: zhes pa'i rten 'brel ma bsgrigs lhun grub kyis dpal ri bo dbang zhu'i snying po bkra shis zla gam dbang phug tu/ dbang chen lcags sprel lo sprel zla ba'i tshes bcur/ dbang chen grub pa rgyal ba mchog dbyangs kyi sprul pa dpal karma pa theg mchog rdo rje dang / padma rigs kyi dpa' bo tā'i si tu padma kun bzang chos rgyal gnyis dang / gzhan yang rje padma gar dbang sogs 'dus pa dgu la shog ser phab 'phral du bstsal/ gter kha 'di bzhes dus dang lo zla tshes grangs chu tshod tshun gcig par gter chen mchog 390

sge 'jam dbyangs mastekhrid brtse rin po che'i rtogs brjod/ pod/ 5gyur bde chen gling pas kyang chos rgyal yab sras kyi skabs smon lam gcig pa'i rten 'brel gyis mdo khams kha la rong sgo nas thugs sgrub bar chad kun sel bzhes te/ de nas lo lnga tsam 'das skabs rje bla ma dang mjal nas dbang chos mang po gsan/ snying thig gong ma'i dbang gi dus bla ma paṇa chen bi ma la dngos su gzigs pa sogs dag pa'i snang ba khyad par can gyis go phyes te gnas lugs kyi rang zhal rjen par mjal/ sngags srung ma'i srog dbang gnang tshe snod kyi 'jig rten 'khrugs pa lta bu'i 'jigs zil dang bcas ral gcig ma dngos su gzigs/ dpon slob gnyis char la lo gsum mtshams su dngos grub chen po sbyin zhes rdzogs chen sde gsum gyi gter kha'ang lung bstan/ dpal yang dag lha dgu'i dbang chen gsan pa na mgon po 'di dpal ldan he ru ka'i sku dngos sa gzigs pa'i mos gus kyi rkyen las thags ka rib phu riri ༅nas 'od zer mthing kha'i gong bu hūṃ yig gis mtshan pa zhig thon te gter ston rang gi dbu gtsug nas thim pa'i gsal snang shar bas nang gi rtsa mdud zhig rdo rje'i glu'i dkor mdzod 'dzad med du grol/ sngon chad thugs sgrub bar chad kun sel gyi brda ji bzhin ma khrol ba'ang tshegs med par mkhyen te/ spyir rje rin po che dgung lo bcu drug gi dus rtsa gsum thugs sgrub hrīḥrgya can bde 391

ngesarngan/ 5 zerdo /spyib 'o/:drob/thag byaspurngasno babastan nyi:re ba/sdo/nga 'o/dra/zug/ nga〉gshegs 'dus pas gter du bzhes pa yod kyang / rjes su mchog gling gis sa gter thon zhing / de gnyis tshig don gcig tu 'dug pas zur du ma spel zhes gsungs par ma zad snga ma cha shas tsam phab pa'ang de kho na ltar yod de/ shog ser 'bebs pa dang gter sgrub kyang gnyis 'dus su mdzad pas rje 'di'i gter khar yang bgrang rung / lcags phag lor rgyang yon po lung gi gu ru'i sgrub phag tu tshogs kyi mchod pa mdzad pa'i tshe phag de'i sgo gong du riri zu riri ༅gu ru'i sku tshab dang / gsol 'debs bsam pa lhun grub ma'i chos skor bzhugs pa gzigs shing / chos kyi zhib rgyus kyang gting thug par ma.o/ phyis sku tshab rin po che dngos grub dpal 'bar dang / thugs sgrub yid bzhin nor bu'i shog ser/ don kun grub pa'i gi waṃ gi bam po rnams rtsi ske nor bu spun gsum du bzhugs pa gsal bar gzigs nas gter chen mchog gyur gling pa la bka' gnang ste spyan drangs/ shog ser la brda yig ma gsal ba yab sras zhal 'dzoms pas gter sgrub zhag bdun dang sbrags bdud rtsi lnga'i chu la sbangs pas zhag lnga nas brda yig gi grong khyer bdun lam mer shar/ thugs sgrub cha tsam gtan la phab/ sgrub chen mdzad pas gzhal med khang rgya khyon bkod pa blos mi khyud pa zhig tu thugs sgrub gnyis kyi lha tshogs bla 'og gi rnam par bzhugs pa'i 392

'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse rin po che'i rtogs brjod/ pod/ 5gtso bo'i zhal nas/ gsol 'debs tshul bzhis 'chad pa'i man ngag sogs gsung gi bdud rtsi mang du gsol zhing / gter srung rnams kyi phrin las sgrub pa'i g.yar dam blangs/ shangs zam bu lung gi ne'u seng nyams dga' ba zhig tu gsol tshigs mdzad par/de'i brag la rang gi gter skal gyi rje btsun sgrol ma'i chos skor rgyas pa zhig bzhugs pa ches gsal bar mkhyen kyang gter shog bzhes rgyu ma byung / 'on kyang de'i tshig don mtha' dag thugs su chud de rtsa ba shog ldeb gsum bzhi rnyed phyag bris mdzad pa na/ jo jo zhig gis 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi thugs dam rten rje btsun ma'i sku rnying zhig phul/ 'di la yon du gser zho bdun dgos zer nas/sku chas la gser zho bdun kho na btags yod pa bstsal/ mi de ni nye gnas sku 'khris su yod pas kyang ma mthong ste gter srung dang /gser rnams gter tshab tu dgos pa yin par mngon/ slad nas sku gzugs 'dis gter chen mchog gyur gling par legs so gsum gyi dbugs dbyung byin/ de bzhin du jo mo kha rag tu phebs tshe rang gter gyi srang mas phur pa khyad par can dngos su 1 zig riring zugacig 41〉〉 lag sna (pe〉〉phul/ rjas nas khams su bzhugs rang kaig 'dam shad pya gter kha klu'i 'jim pa las grub pa'i gu ru'i sku tshab thod phreng sde lnga yab yum gyi byang sems nyi zla'i zhun gyis g.yogs pa dang / bla 393

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ma sku bzhi'i sgrub skor/ slob dpon chen po'i tshems las sprul pa'i ring bsrel/ blangs pas 'dzad pa med pa'i ngo mtshar can rnams gnyan chen thang lhas spyan drangs te phul ba/ ring bsrel gyi 'byung khungs rje nyid gshegs kha'i snga lo tsam nas gter srung gis phyir khyer bas ma bzhugs/ de nas rab yid rdzogs pa zad par gyi lor/ratna gling pa'i phyag chen nyi snying mar/ stag tshang rong du sbas pa 'di: mnga' bdag nyang gi gdung brgyud ni: mi rabs yang brgyud bcu gsum na: 'jam dbyangs sprul pa blo gros canaḥ'ajam dpal bshes gnyen zhes pas 'don: gdul bya gangs can yul khyab 'byung : zhes gsungs pa ltar tho rangs shig rnga yab gling nas dpa' bo'i chas can gnyis byung te/ 'di sprod pa'i dus tshod dngos shing stag lo yin kyang rten 'brel yol/ da res slob dpon padma'i bkas khyod la sprod du phyin zer/ shog dril zhig byin nas mi snang bar song / shog dril de 'thor 'bru'i za ma tog tu bcug ste nam langs pa dang gzigs pas gter gyi kha byang du 'dug de dang mthun par lo de nyid kyi smin drug zla ba'i tshes bcur gter chen mchog gling dang lhan cig rong me 'chi med dkar mo stag tshang du phebs/ brag gi rgya bcu gsum bshig ste rig 'dzin rdo rje drag rtsal gyi sku/ shog ser/ phyag mtshan gnam 394

'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse rin po che'i rtogs brjod/ pod/ 5lcags kyi rdo rje rnams khrom gter du spyan drangs/ de'i phyi nyin yang khrom tshogs mang po'i dbus su ma pham seng rgod g.yu mtsho nas/mja' dang 'od dang me tog gi char sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas te/ rdzu 'phrul rdo rje'i bkod pas gter kha gser gyi sgrom bu he ru ka zhal sbyor gyi rnam pa can sogs bzhes pa na gter srung klu'i rgyal po gser gyi gdugs can 'ong ba dngos su gzigs shing /than mong gi snang bar mtsho phyar ba dang lhan cig dar khung gi nye ra mi pha rig sna rigaririg la rig zuring 'tsho pa'agram thams cad gsar phyas sar nyul gyas khyab pa ma nga /'ga' zhig gis gser cung zad rnyed kyang rnyed/ der thugs sgrub rdo rje drag rtsal dang / rtsa gsum sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i chos sde byon kyang lam rim ye shes snying po tsam las gzhan 'chad spel ma gnang /rab tshes smin drug zla ba'i tshes bcur stod 'bras mo ljongs nas smad g.yu lung gangs ra yan chad kyi gnas che chung stong phrag lhag pa'i bkod pa dang gter kha sogs sgrib med du gzigs/ zhe dga'i phyogs bkra shis gnas kyi shar phyogs zhi khro shes she'uphug ces sngon chad yul der gnas pas kyang rgyus med par rje nyid kyis lam mtshon nas phebs shing grol tig skor gsum dang gnas yig 'ga' zhig gis shog ser bzhes/ rin po che blo gros mtha' yas kyis yi ge pa mdzad de shog ser las cha tsam phab pa na 'ja' tshon 395

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gyi bla re bres shing me tog sil ma'i char babs/ khyung tshang brag bi/ gter kha rig 'dzin yongs rdzogs kyi thugs tig sogs gter srung klu mos gsal bar bstan nas rje mchog gling dang gdan 'dzoms pas bzhes/ gter lhung khang dmar mdor bzhud skabs rje blo gros mtha' yas kyis phyogs 'dir rdor sems kyi gter kha yod par bdud 'dul gter lung las bshad pas/ de las sna gcig bzhes dgos zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bai ro'i gsang phug tu chogs kyi 'khor lo mdzad pa'i mthar/ de nyid nas slob da pon bee ro tsa na'i thags dam rten gyi rdo rje sems dpa'i li sku ༄khyad 'phags shig blangs nas bstsal/ rdzong shod bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sku'i gnas nas dpag bsam shing gi 'bras bu las grub pa'i padma rgyal po'i sku rgyan shin tu ngo mtshar ba bzhes shing /der tsha sgang pa rin chen rnam rgyal zham ring du khrid de sngar med pa'i phug pa ya mtshan can gyi sgo phye nas mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i sgrub skor dang / nyang rin po che'i yang gter gnam lcags kyi rdo rje zhig phyungs/ khro zil khrom gyi mdun ngos chu mig cig nas mkha' 'gro las kyi dbang mo che'i rang byung gsang ba'i bdud rtsi bton/ bkra shis zla gam dbang phug gi gnam khung nas mgon po rdza bha la'i sku dang sgrub skor/ de'i nye phyogs kyi brag nas rje btsun 396

'jam dbyangs masmo brtse rin po che'i rtogs brjod/ pod/ 5 sgrol ma'i tshe ril zla ba'i snying po/ seng ge g.yu mtsho nas mon mo bkra shis khye'u 'dren gyi dar sham dang / byang chub shing gi lo ma sogs gzhan yang bzhes/ de rjes them pa mi 'da' bar bzhugs dus shig gter ston kun grol gsang ba la/ pha bong gser gdugs can na sangs rgyas dpa' bo bdun gyi ring bsrel dang /padma shel rir yang gter kha zhig yod pa de len du song bka' bstsal pa ltar/ khong gis gter gnas su phebs te tshogs skong gser skyems gsol 'debs sogs mdzad kyang ring bsrel ma rnyed/zla gam dbang phug tu zhag gsum sgrub pa tshogs mchod bcas grub pa'i snga dro gnas ri'i dbu rtser lha srin dam bsgrags pas/ padma shel ri nas bya rgod cig 'ja' sprin 'khrigs pa'i nang du 'phur zhing 'ongs te 'og gi brag rtser babs/ sindha ra'i 'jim pa rlon pas bstums pa'i gter sgrom zhig der bzhag nas song bas/sgrom bu de ka ltar bsnams te rje bla ma'i spyan sngar phul/ de zhal phyes pa'i nang nas tshe dbang rig 'dzin gyi sku tshab li smug las grub pa/ rtsa gsam spyi 'dus chos skor/ gnas chen mang po'i mdo ༄byang gi shog ser rnams byon/ sku tshe 'di'i zab gter gyi gtso bo gtsang g.yas ru rtsis kyi lha khang gi ka zhu la bzhugs pa'i rtsa gsum bka' 'dus chen mo yin yang / 'don pa'i dus thog la phebs 397

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ khyostabs ma 'grigs pas tshod las yol ba/ phyis gtsug lag khang 'jig tu nye ba'i dbang gis gnas 'phos te/ de'i nye 'khor gyi brag gcig la bzhugs pa sa ler gzigs shing / gter rdzas gnam lcags kyi rdo rje khyad 'phags shig phyag tu'ang son/ dgung lo bzhi bcu pa don grub kyi lor/ o rgyan rin po che gter chen sangs rgyas gling pa'i sku'i rnam par bstan nas gter 'byung si glegs bam bstsal zhing byin gyis brlabs pas nyid kyi sku gleb/sa bam der gyur pa lta bu'i mnal lam brtan po shar/ de tshun chad nas bod yul 'dir byon dang 'byon 'gyur gyi sprul pa'i gter chen stong rtsa snyed kyi rnam thar dang zab gter gang bzhugs thams cad cung zad kyang lkog tu ma gyur pa'i ye shes kyi spyan rnon po brnyes shing / chos gter de thams cad kyi bka' babs su gyur/ de'i mthu las gter ston sangs rgyas bla ma'i gter kha rtsa gsum dril sgrub dngos grub brtan gzigs zhus lan nyer gcig pa dang /rgya lo tsā'i bla ma bstan gnyis skor gsum/ nyi ma seng ge'i thugs rje chen po padma zhi khro/ rong zom lo tsā'i mkha' 'gro rig byed rtsal/o rgyan gling pa'i bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho'i bcud dril/ ra mo shel sman gyi rdo rje bdud rtsi/ rgyal ston padma'i dbang phyug gi 'khor lo bde mchog dmar po/ lha btsun rgya mtsho blo gros kyi zhi 398

la〉 'o/joṭazug tshog/rmingangabazhi zugartemin ngapechen ṣṭhasdezug mtho byenge:re satsāb/bzhu ngape:dzdzastasno/ rjesarngad/ spre/byed bdun pa/ g.yag phyar sngon mo'i sgrol ljang 'jigs pa kun skyob/ bal po a hūṃ 'bar gyi yakṣa dzam bha la nag po/ mnga' bdag mo la mi 'khyil gyi rgyal bsen gnad 'beb 'khor lo'i man ngag gar dbang las 'phro gling pa 'i phag dkar shes rab 'khor lo/ sna nam thub rgyal gyi rten 'brel yang snying 'dus pa/ gtsug lag dpal dge'i drag sngags them 'dun/ khyung po dpal dge'i rgyal po mdos bcu/ rong sman nyi 'od gsal gyi gso dpyad rdzong 'phrang snying thig sogs mtha' yas pa zhig rdo rje'i gnas kyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis brda yig rgya dpe/ bod kyi yig rnying ci rigs par pusti ka dngos su phul/ 'on kyang de dag la 'chad spel gyis phrin las bskyang ma bskyang dang bskyangs kyang tshang bar bskyang ma bskyang ni sna tshogs shig yod par snang / jo mo sman mo padma mtsho skyid kyi gter skal mkha' 'gro ma'i gsang ba kun 'dus kyi skor rnams rje nyid chos dbang rin po cher gyur dus gter chen ma dang thabs shes kyi rten 'brel stobs su gyar pa'i dbang gis rjes su dran pa'i ༄cho 'phrul dang / jo mo chen mos badzra a ra li'i sbyor bas byin rlabs bstabs pa dang / dgongs pa nam gtad du gter yig pra phab pa ltar 'char ba ste gsum ldan gyis gtan la phab/ lang gro lo tsā ba dkon mchog 'byung gnas kyi thugs kyi gsang ba rjes su 399

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/nga〉dran nas de'i thugs dam tshe sgrub kyi man ngag snang bar mdzad/sngon chad dgung grangs nyer bzhi par 'o yug gi mthil du gshegs pa'i skabs tha mal gyi snang zhen dbyings su thim pa'i ye shes me long gtsang ma'i ngos su lce btsun seng ge dbang phyug 'od lus su bzhengs pa'i gnas dus ston 'khor gyi tshom bu dang bcas pa gsal bar shar nas klong lnga'i yi ge dum bu gsum pa thugs gter du babs pa yun ring por gsang rgyas btab/ mthar dbyings phyug e ka dza tis chos sgo dbye bar bskul nas rim par spel/ rje btsun yid bzhin 'khor lo dang rnal 'byor dbang phyug thang stong pa'i byin rlabs las 'chi med 'phags mo'i snying thig dang / grub thob thugs thig gi skor rnams rang shar ba'i byung tshul yang yod de gzhan du shes/ rdzong shod bde gshegs 'dus pa'i pho brang du bzhugs skabs nub gcig 'od gsal gyi snang bar/ mchod rten bde byed brtsegs pa'i drung du slebs/ der sgrub sde'i bka' babs kyi rig 'dzin brgyad rnams gu ru mtshan brgyad kyi rnam can dang / kun 'dus slob dpon padma thod phreng bcas tshom bur bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar/ bka' brgyad kyi gzhung man ngag sgyu 'phrul zhi khro/ a nu yo ga rdzogs chen gyi gdams pa rnams rgya cher gsan pas mtshon/ skad cig re rer chos kyi rnam grangs ji 400

'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse rin po che'i rtogs brjod/ pod/ 5snyed cig dbang du gyur pa'i pha mtha' yang su zhig gis brjod nus/der yang ma zad rdo rje bdud rtsi'i gdams pa gter yig las thog mar bsgyur ba na/ o rgyan rin po cher gsol 'debs mang du mdzad pas/ snon zla'i tshes bcur padma 'od kyi gzhal med khang du gu ru rin po che rig 'dzin ḍākki'i tshogs dang bcas pas sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur zhing gdams ngag rtsal sprugs su gnang ba dang / rtsa ba'i chos bdag la dbang bka' gnang bar bzhed pa'i tshe 'od gsal sgyu ma'i rol par/ so ma pu ri'i lha khang nam mkha'i zar phud la son pa snyam byed pa'i mthon po zhig tu 1rngosarir /༷sgo /rdobye/ 1rngo/phebs/ ra stan stong pa ga 'dug pa la bzhugs pa dang /mi dbang ind+ra bhu ti mkha' 'gro ma las kyi dbang mo che dang dbyer med pa'i phyag 'di de dag gi dgongs pa gtad pa la bsam gyi dngos su rje rang gi bla ma'i phyag yin/ na chang snod lta bu'i bum pa zhig thogs te/ 'di rgyal po dzaḥl bka' babs kyi chu bo bzhi 'dus pa'i dbang gi chu rgyun ma nyams pa yin gsungs nas gar chang 'dra ba'i bdud rtsi zhig ljags la phab pas stong gsal bde bas myos pa'i ye shes kyi nyams 'bar ba sogs chos sgo re re la brten nas byin rlabs kyi pha phogs thob pa'i tshul yang dpag par sla ba ma yin no/ /dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i khyu mchog rnams kyi dgongs don brda'i de 401

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/nyid la ches cher nang byan tshud pas/ rje btsun 'dis bsgyur tshad kyi gter gzhung thams cad rjod byed dbyings che la rgyas bsdus 'tshams/ brjod bya gnad 'dril la zab cing rgya che/ blo'i mthu mi dman pa rnams la gzhung lugs re res kyang sngon yongs su grags pa dang ma grags pa'i grub pa'i gseng lam mi 'dra ba du ma mtshon nus pa sha stag bzhugs/ rig 'dzin gter bdag gling pa'i bzhed pas mchog gi dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs cha tshang 'doms pa zhig gter skal du dbang ba la gter ston chen por 'jog ste de ltar byas na mgon po 'di'i gter gzhung sna re tsam la dbang bas kyang gter chen gyi gral du bsgyings chog pa yod/ brgyud pa'i babs so brnyes tshul la yang / ring brgyud/ gter brgyud/ dag snang ste gsum/ gter la dngos gter ram sa gter dang dgongs gter gnyis/ sa gter la rang gter dang yang gter gnyis/ dgongs gter la spyi ming phyogs gcig la btags pa'i dgongs gter dang rjes dran gyi gter gnyis/ dag snang la zhal gzigs dang snyan brgyud gnyis te bka' babs kyi chu bo bdun 'dres shing / yang gter gyi gsang mdzod kho na la'ang gter 'byin gzhan mtha' dag gi chos sde thams cad rdzogs pa dang /de dag kyang gter gnas thag ring por bgrod pa'i dka' las 402

'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse rin po che'i rtogs brjod/ pod/ 5dang / gter bdag mchod pa/ rten 'brel gyi sna kha mi log pa'i ched du srung rim chen po'i yo lang sogs 'bad rtsol sna gcig mi dgos par mkha' 'gro ma'i 'khor los sgyur ba chen po'i go 'phang brnyes pa'i lag rjes su nam mkha' dang sa 'og gi nor bu char bzhin du 'byung ba sogs ni bdag nyid chen po 'di'i khyad par 'phags chos rnam dag yin no/ /de 'dra ba rnams o rgyan dus gsum mkhyen pas lung ston pa chos nyid yin pas/ u rgyan gling pa'i thags rje chen po ye shes 'od mchog gi gter lung las ma ༄'ongs chos kyi bdag po de nyid kyang : shar gyi phyogs nas 'brug gi lo pa 'byung : rang nor spyod pas bstan pa'i me ro gso:zhes dang / rig 'dzin yongs 'dus kyi lung byang du'ang / bdag dang nam mkha'i snying po'i smon lam lasaḥ khams kyi phyogs su 'brug gam byi phag lo: sde snod rgyud sde'i gsang ba kun bsdus nas: rig 'dzin rnam bzhi'i brgyud pa rgyas par byed: mthar ni dpal chen thugs dang gnyis su med: ces pa gnyis kas 'khrungs yul/ dgung snying skyes rabs sgos mdzad dang bcas pa gsal bar bstan la/ rdo rje gling pa dang rin chen gling pa bdud 'dul rdo rje rol pa'i rdo rje sogs kyi gter lung na'ang rje bla ma 'di gsal bar zin tshul yod/ lung zin gyi skyes bu 'dra min 403

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/shan 'byed dgongs 'dus lung bstan bka' rgya mar/ gang yang mi 'gyur brda rtags gsum dang ldanaḥ lus la lte sme snying gar sha mtshan namaḥ sme ba dkar dmar thig les spras dang gcigaḥ ngag ni snyan 'gyur ngag tshig rtsol ba can: yang na mgrin par sha mtshan thig le'am: padma las byung padma'i ming ldan gnyisaḥ yid ni rtse gcig gdung shugs nga nyid dran: phur tshugs 'di min yid la mi byed gsum: de gsum gsum 'dzom mchog yin gnyis 'dzom 'bring : gcig 'dzom tha ma gang yang las can te: zhes gsungs pa'i mtshan ma gsum po'ang rje 'di la tshang bar mnga'/dngos gter la dbang ba'i rgyal sras lha rje'i skye ba bcu gsum pa'ang 'di nyid yin par rang gter gyi lung byang las bshad do //dgung lo nyer gcig skor nas sa ngor sogs kyi gdan sar/brda sprod dang snyan dngags sogs rig gnas mang po'i bslab grwa btsugs pas/ sa skya gong ma bkra shis rin chen/ thar rtse zhabanu drungs byams pa kun dga' bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ dpon slob rin po che ngag dbang legs grub/ na lend+ra'i gzim 'og mchog sprul bstan 'dzin snyan grags sogs cher mkhas pa'i slob ma'ang thon/ ngor du bzhugs dus bod ston zhig gis 'di sems can 'bum phrag 'dren pa'i ston par 'gyur te/ de'i mtshan mar 404

'jam dbyangs marṣa brtse rin po che'i rtogs brjod/ pod/ 5zhabs g.yas pa'i mthe bong la sme ba klu'i mig lta bu zhig snang zhes lung bstan/ sku tshe ril po ngur smrig 'chang ba'i kun spyod dul ba dang zhi ba'i dpal gyis brgyan pa 'ba' zhig gis bskyangs par mdzad/ lar yang da lta grub spyod yin zhes nyag hor gyi skya chas byed/ nag chang spyod/ rta rgyugs mda' 'phen ri dwags bsher/glu len bro rdung lha babs 'dre babs zer nas srog rlung can a rag gis g.yengs pa lta bu rdzu mkhan mang ste/ nged rang 'dra bas gzhan gyi rgyud tshod la kha tshon mi chod kyang / spyir btang mkhan slob chos gsum gyi ring nas/ dbu zlum rab byang dang / lcang lo ༄sngags pa'i sde gnyis bya ba las/ khram chas rkun ma'i sde zer rgyu'i phung po gsum pa zhig srol 'dzugs ma myong zhes bstan pa'i mig ltos la dgongs pa'i gsung bgros kyang byon/ ring mo'i dus nas tshul khrims nag nog med par bsrungs pa'i byin gyis rlabs dang /snying rje chen po dang 'gro 'dul gyi smon lam bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rtags snang phyi rol du shar bas zhal gyi 'gyur ba dang phyag gi sgu la skyod lta bu'i spyod lam phra mos kyang gzhan sems dang ba'i shugs kyis 'khol nus pa mnga'/ de lta na'ang dad med 'ga' zhig gis/ de mthong ma thag tu snang ba bsgyur yong rgyu de mgul du yid bzhin nor bu 'dra ba cang yod pa min nam zhes smras 'dug405

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/sku'i nyer spyod dang / der ma zad gzim khang gi sgo yol btegs pa tsam nas spos dri ma yin pa'i dri bsung shin tu zhim pa zhig khya ba par ldang ba dang / gang du bzhugs kyang me phung gi nye 'khor lta ra tsha drod 'thibs pa zhig rgyun du yod/ skal ba dang ldan pa 'gas thog mar mjal dus thang stong rgyal po sogs sku'i rnam pa tha dad du mthong ba'i lo rgyus kyang snang / gnas byin gyis brlabs pas ma rungs pa dag gis sgrub khang la me sbar yang zhugs kyis za bar ma nus shing / bzhugs pa'i yul phyogs su yang chos srid kyi phywa g.yang chags pas chu stod can gyi zla ba ltar nyams dga'/ rgyal sras chen po rnams gdul bya'i tshogs su spyod mkhas pas su dang yang mi mthun pa med pa'i snyom chung dang / sngon du smra ba dang phebs par smra ba'i ngang tshul byis pa mdzangs pa lta bur bzhugs/lhag par yang phongs shing nyam chung ba'i 'gro ba rnams la shin tu zhi zhing sman pa'i gsung gis kun tu dga' bar mdzad/ dus 'khrugs kyi yo lang chen mos 'jig rten mi chos kyi phyogs nas pho rtsal sna dgu dang / dam pa'i lha chos kyi phyogs nas mngon shes rdzu 'phrul gyis snyems pas rgya stag ngar ma ltar 'gying ba rnams kyang snga bsam phyi mno thams cad stor zhing snying lkog mar lhung ste/ phyi mig mi lta bar 'bros pa'am/ shes bzhin du dgra'i dwangs mar blo 406

〈co 'o/joṭazug rngasnodrasgrosprabab/ zugartemin ngasarbegi :sdizud rngos byenge:re shenyab/thag ngasasgyujorngasno/ 21rngad/ pa/gtad ling bskyur/ mgo bcad pang bzhag gi ngang la 'phyan pa'am/gdol spyod kyi 'khrul 'khor mig mang bzhin du rtse ba'i phongs chos sogs ci byed 'di byed med par thal ba de 'dra ba'i skabs su'ang /pha rol gyi tsham rngam 'jigs zil ji tsam che ba de tsam du thugs stobs lhag par rgyas te shin tu zung thub pa lhun po'i dbang po ltar brjid pas gang dga' bar brdzis te bzhugs/ gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i shes pa dang mthu'i rtsal gyis rtag tu bsgyings shing re dogs kyi zug rngu thon pas phrin las thams cad grags ldan gyi shes rlom dang dbang can gzhan su la'ang ltos pa med par khyu mchog gi rjes bzhin 'jug rang bzhed kyi mdzad pa ci dang ci bskyangs kyang de la stobs ldan gyi che dgu su 'dra bas kyang 'gong bar mi nus pas sa'i steng na gcig pur dbang che/ mkhas pa'i snyems pa dang / grub pa'i hur spyod dang / mthon po'i thob thang gis nyi ma ltar bsnyen dka' ba rnams kyang sku drung du phyin pa tsam na zil gyis gnon nus pa'i bsod nams brgya pa'i mthu dpal dang ye shes kyi gzi brjid mthong ba'i chos/ snga phyir lung bstan mang du bzhugs kyang / der gsungs pa'i spang blang gi bgyi 'os rigs ni dus ngan pa'i sems can dam rgod kyis thog khel mi nus/ gter ༄ston lung bstan gyis phung bya ba der zad gsungs nas spyir brtag 407

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dkulung zhus pa la mi mnyes na'ang mdo khams dus 'gyur chen mo'i skabs sogs gal che dus gang gsung thog tu ma khel ba med cing /thugs drang zhing gzu bor gnas pa dang / lha tshogs mi chos gang la'ang thugs rab rgya che bas dpyod ldan mchog dman kun gyis bka' la gser bzhin du brtsi zhing gsang 'phros kyi tshig zur yan chad la snying po ci lon byed/ bla chen chos brgyad mkhan rnams kyi mdun sar gtam gyi me tog med du mi rung ba rang nyid la ngo bstod dang / chen po gzhan la zur za sogs gsan ma thag nas dgongs pa khrel ba'i rnam 'gyur mdzad pas mtshon/ gya gyu can gyi sgyu ma gang gis kyang bsnyen dka'/ gang 'dul gyi mdzad pa la log par lta zhing ya ga 'bod pa'i log sgrub mkhan mang du mchis kyang / 'di lta ma yin na drang srong chen pos sems can gyi bsam spyod sna tshogs su mi gsung zhes bden kha ster bas rgyab skyor ba ma gtogs mi dgyes pa bag tsam mi gnang / lhun grub steng du chos ston skabs skye bo glang snying ba zhig gis dug drangs pa mkhyen bzhin du bzhes pas tshems nag por gyur pa dang / sku lus la dug gi me tog shar ba sogs tshabs cher 'khrugs pa ltar byung ba'i tshe'ang ngan lan gzhan lta ci/ sbyor ngan mkhan su yin tsam yang mi ston par slar la thugs gcugs par mdzad pas skyes bu chen po'i 408

'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse rin po che'i rtogs brjod/ pod/ 5sems stobs kyi che ba bstan/ gsol ngan de'i rkyen dang gzhan yang kun mkhyen bla ma 'di bod khams spyi khyab skyob pa'i mgon du byon pa la gangs can spyi'i bsod nams kyi dbang gis/ de skor tshun nas rim gyis sku khams je zhan dang / snyun gzhi yang je cher 'dra bor song / de dag kun tu'ang sman sngags dpyad sbyor sogs ci drag gi ngal ba rgyang btang ste/ nged lta bu na dga' shi skyid yin dogs med/ chu tshod rer bde bar 'dug rgyu byung na'ang dga' ste/da las bdag gir bya ba las thabs ma mchis zhes khu sim mer bzhugs/ thugs ches sgam pas lugs gnyis kyi pho sgo shin tu yangs pa rnams kyis drung du yun ring por brtags kyang dgongs pa'i gsang mi shes pas/ rje btsun mi pham pas bstod pa sbyar ba las kyang / mkhas dang grub pa'i snyan grags gtam/ /rgyang nas thos pa'i rjes bsnyegs te/ /drung du yun ring brtags na yang / /phyi phyir gting dpag dka' ba khyod/ /ces 'byung / rnyed bkur dang 'khor bsdu ba'i rtsol sgrub lhag ma smos ci dgos/ rang gter chos bdag gi rten 'brel tsam yang ched du sgrigs pa'i spros pa mi mdzad pa'i kun spangs sran ma ltar zlum pa kho nar bzhugs kyang /'du ba gsam gyi rten 'brel las slob tshogs ngang gis 'dus pa'i ༄tshul yang / dpal ldan sa skya bdag chen dang / rje btsun ma rnam 409

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ gsum/ ngor chen kun dga' bstan 'dzin dang / gzhan yang e waṃ thar pa rtse'i mkhan po dang zhabs drung phal che ba/ rje zhwa lu rin chen blo gsal bstan skyong / gzim 'og chos rje bstan 'dzin snyan grags/ yar klung dpon rin po che/ sa skya dga' ldan dpon slob /'dar grong chen slob dpon kun dga' 'jam dpal/ shar bla ma kun dga' dpal ldan/ dpal karma pa bcu bzhi pa dang bco lnga pa/stag lung ma rin po che gong 'og khams ri bo che'i zhabs drung no mi han sogs sprul sku rnam gsum/ si tu padma nyin byed/ zla bzang sprul sku/ dpal spungs dbon sprul sku mched/ dpal mdo khams sprul/ paṇḍi ta karma nges don/ khyab bdag karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtsho'i sde/ sbyor ra rin po che/ bsam sdings rdo rje phag mo/ lcags zam nyi ma chos 'phel/ bkra shis 'khyil ba chen po dkon mchog bstan pa rab rgyas/ lha btsun don grub rgyal mtshan/ bkra shis lhun po dang ser 'bras kyi mkhas pa du ma/brag g.yab no mi han chen po/ hor khang gsar skyabs mgon/ li thang byams pa phun tshogs/ rdor smin dpal ri lcags zam sogs kyi bla ma dge 'dun mang po/ ka thog si tu gong 'og rmog tsha sprul sku/ rdzogs chen mchog sprul rin po che dang / ze chen sku skye rnam gnyis/ rgya rong nam sprul rin po che dang rje dbon sprul sku/ rdo rje 410

'jam dbyangs ma.a brtse rin po che'i rtogs brjod/ pod/ 5'dzin pa chen po padma badzra/ ra shar paṇa chen thub bstan chos grags dang / rje mi pham rnam rgyal zhabs/ ra sgang pa chos kyi seng ge sogs go sa dang yon tan gyis che ba'i bla ma dpon slob dang /rgya dpon rma tā lo ye dang / bod kyi sa dbang chen mo sogs mi chen bka' mda' rtsis gsum/ sde dge chos rgyal/ gling tshang rgyal po sogs mi'i gtso bo du mas zhabs la gtugs/ sngon chad rgyal sras gzhan phan mtha' yas pas kyang nyang gter khros ma nag mo sogs kyi smin grol rgya cher gsan rtsis don gnyer cher mdzad na'ang sku tshe mthar ma 'khrol bas lus/ phyi dus 'dir 'gran zla dang bral ba'i rgyal sras dpa' bo chen po o rgyan 'jigs med chos kyi dbang pos kyang rigs gsum snying thig mchog gling las gsan cing / rje rin po che 'di rgya gar gyi grub chen lta bur 'dug ces ched brjod mdzad la/ tshe sku dang brtan bzhugs kyi springs yig lan mang por phul/ khams su them spangs la bzhugs dus kyang sde dge lho byang / ko 'jo brag g.yab/ cha mdo/ lho nang chen/ spo bo/ khyung po/ mgo log gser thal/ gling tshang / nyag brgyud/rgyal mo rong sogs skad rigs mi gcig pa'i yul tha dad nas 'dus pa'i sde ris dang chos rgyud sna tshogs pa'i bla ma/ sde dpon rab byung / sngags pa dmangs phal pa sogs phyag mjal dang chos 411

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/nyan du lhags pa zla ba snga phyi'i khongs su'ang stong phrag ldang ba lta bu rtag tu yod/ skabs 'di shed cig la gtsang paṇa chen bstan pa'i dbang phyug gis kyang rje 'di gdan 'dren la rang gi gzim dpo na 'khor bcas ched mngags mdzad par gzim dpon lam nas grongs/ g.yog rnams kyis bka' shog 'bul du 'ong bas/phebs mi thab tshal gyis bka' lan springs/ de bzhin du thar rtse ༄ ༄phyogs nas kyang phebs skul gyi yi ge mang du byung ba thams cad ji mi snyam par bzhag ste/ da nga dbus gtsang du phyin na rnyed bkur snyan grags chen po zhig 'ong bar 'dug ste/ de la brten nas bar chad 'byung ba mthong gsung / lhun grub steng du brtag gnyis kyi bshad pa mdzad skabs rgyal po shugs ldan chos nyan la 'ong /khyod kyi bshad pa snyan cing chos legs pas nyan 'dod skyes pa yin zer/ kho rang la dbu phar gyi dka' gnad mang po bshad du bcug pas thogs pa ma byung gsungs pa lta bu gdug pa'i 'dre rnams kyang zhal gyi bdud rtsi 'thung ba la 'dun pas mtshon te mi min gyi gdul bya rtsis kyis mi chod/ sa dge'i phyogs kyi don gnyer gtsor gyur la rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sin dkyil gyi byin rlabs kho na'ang bdun cu rtsa grangs song / gzhan du smin gling rdor sems gcig po'i dbang yang lnga bcu skor dang / klong chen 412

'jam dbyangs masmo brtse rin po che'i rtogs brjod/ pod/ 5snying tig gi dbang khrid nyi shu rtsa skor rtsa dbang rgyal thabs spyi blugs brgya phrag thal ba sogs nas bstan bcos mngon rtogs rgyan gyi bshad pa sogs mdo phyogs dang / dus 'khor dbang chen dang 'grel chen dri med 'od kyi bshad pa sogs sngags phyogs kyi gzhung bshad pa dang lag len lci ba rnams kyi 'chad spel bar phyogs lhung dang bral bar mdzad/ gter phyogs sngon 'gro'i gdams khrid dang / dka' gdams pa'i blo sbyor gi skor mang pos gdul bya phal pa rnams la'ang theg pa chen po'i phyogs snang ba'i bka' drin bskyangs/ kun mkhyen bla ma 'di 'khor gang du chos 'chad kyang ser ge ltar ma zhums shing / dran pa chu klung bzhin du myur ba/ sa'i phyogs rgya mtsho ltar zab pa'i dbyangs kyis khyab par mdzad de/ phyag dang zhabs mi g.yo zhing smin ma mi skyod pa sogs spyod lam mdzes pas yid dang ba 'dren par chos ston te/ spyir sde snod mtha' dag dang / khyad par rdo rje theg pa'i gsung rab 'chad pa na chos skad gtsang zhing brling la 'brel chags pa dang /lung dang rigs pa'i rgyan rgya chen po dang ldan pa'i gtam gyi sbyor bas mkhas pa rnams mgu bar mdzad/ tshul de lta bus skabs 'gar nyin re 'khyong bar zhal zas kyi bya ba'ang btang ste chos sbyin nyin mtshan sbrel ma brgya phrag bgrang ba skyo dub mi mnga' bar tshar 413

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/du dngar/ de ltar yin kyang dus dang dus min gyi rnam dbye la gzigs pas bcad rgya'i sgang la rgya bod kyi che dgu su 'dras kyang zla ba dang zhag bgrang nas chos sgug la sdod dgos pa mthong ste skyes bu chen po 'di las gdams ngag 'thob pa la rnyed dka' ba'i 'du shes mi skye ba med de/ 'di gcig pos kyang sems can mang po chos la gus pa'i dge tshogs gsog par snang / bod kyi ba ka' blon phu lung pa dang / sde dge gnyer chen rgya mkhar bsod nams/a rdog la kha ba 'byor ldan mkha' 'gro sogs khyim gnas kyi dad can mang po rab byung la bkod/ bstan pa'i gzhi ma ring du mi nub pa'i phyir/ chos sde mang por gzhi gsum gyi lag len rnam par dag pa'i srol 'chad nyan dang bcas pa btsugs/ sku dngos yun ring por thags las chung ngu lta bur bzhugs kyang rdo rje gsum ༄gyi gzi brjid kyis ji srid zla zhal gyi snang ba ma bsdus pa de srid yul phyogs kun tu dam pa'i chos nyan bshad dang sgom sgrub/bsags sbyangs rma med pa'i kun dga'i longs spyod shugs 'byung du 'phel/ lar sngon dus su srog chags 'bum phrag bgrang ba kha lo gyen la bsgyur ba bas snyigs ma bas kyang cher snyigs pa'i dus mtha' 'dir sems can bcu phrag re tsam la byang chub kyi myu gu bskrun pa'ang ya mtshan che ba'i tshod yin te/ mchog zung dang ka 414

'jam dbyangs ma.o brtse rin po che'i rtogs brjod/ pod/ 5 pi na chen pos slob ma lnga brgya btul ba'i lo rgyus bzhin no/ /de phyir bdag nyid chen po 'di'i mdzad pa rnams ni/ lto phyir rgyal khams skor ba dang / grags skam gyi phyir du gzi byin sgrub pa/ brgya bshig nas stong 'gugs pa'i g.yo thabs sogs la bya ba las kyi 'khor lo zhes ming tshon po btags pa'i rnam thar rnams dang 'dra ba'i go skabs ga la yod/ lhag par yang rje rang gi mnal ltas shig tu/ rang nyid bsam yas kyi pho brang zhig tu rgyal po'i gzugs kyis bzhugs te 'dug de'i g.yas ngos kyis phyogs yangs pa zhig na mi 'ga' zhig slob dpon padma bod yul du 'byon pa'i skas 'dzugs pa yin zer nas sgrom skas chen po zhig bar snang la 'dzugs grabs byed cing / der skye bo shin tu mang pos ca co dang skor 'tshub zing zing byed par 'dug kyang / shing thung pas ring du mi slebs pa dang / lcid kyis mi theg pa sogs las phebs su rung ba zhig mi yong bar gzigs/ phyogs de na mi gzi brjid can zhig 'dug pa de na re/ 'di tshos 'ud chen po byed kyang / don la khyod dang / rje padma gar dbang / mchog gyur gling pa rnams ma gtogs skas 'di 'dzugs nus mkhan ni su yang mi 'dug ces gsang rdo rje padma saṃ bha ba'i phrin las kyi byed po'i ༄nang na khyu mchog lta bur bsngags pa bzhin/ gter rnying ring 415

21jid/ ji zerdo /spyitha'e 'o/:drotha/05 byasarngasno rngababastazug rta):re ba/sdosakhung 'o/dra/zug/ 〈mibargyud ma nub pa rnams rgya cher spel/ nub pa rnams nye brgyud la brten nas rgyun bsab/ gter gsar gyi rnam grangs du ma'i chos sgo phyes/ zab gter dag snang gi chos tshul gsar rnying mang po rgyun gcig tu bsdu ba mdzad de/ pusnyi bco lnga tsam bsgrigs nas 'phro rdo rje'i slob dpon padma gar dbang la rtsom pa'i gnang ba byin te rin chen gter gyi gsang mdzod gsar pa bzhengs/ nyang gter rdo rje khros ma'i dbang gnang skabs bdud rtsi'i thod pa reg tu mi bzod pa lta bu'i drod 'bar ba dang / rang nyid kyi yang gter padma gtum po'i dbang dus me long la bris pa'i sngags phreng phyis bsub tu med pa'i rang byon du gyur pa dang / khyung khras 'og gdon gyis zin pa'i slob ma'i nad gzhi med du sangs ba dang /gang zag bzang po zhig la 'phags ma'i snying tig gi dbang bskur mdzad pa na/ spyan bdun po khra hrig ger bkra ba mjal bas dad pa'i shugs kyis shes pa brgyal thabs su song ba dang / mchog gling dang / kun mkhyen bla ma 'di/ rje blo gros mtha' yas te sprul pa'i sku 'di gsum gzhon rim nas sdud pa'i lung bstan yod pa ltar lcags rta lor gter chen mchog gling pa sku bsnyun tshul bstan cing nyid la sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par bzhud pa'i gsal snang shar/ mi ring bar sa g.yo dang 'ja' 'od sogs kyi 416

'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse rin po che'i rtogs brjod/ pod/ 5cho 'phrul bcas zhi bar gshegs pa'i zhal chems skor rje rin po cher babs pa rgyal zla'i tshes bcur tshogs mchod dang 'brel bar khyab bdag blo gros mtha' yas zhabs kyis yi ge pa mdzad de gtan la phab pa na sa gzhi'i khyon la drod chen po lhung thabs su babs pas 'khyags pa rnams chu bo'i rgyun du zhu ba'i mngon rtags sogs byin rlabs kyi mtshan ma'ang mang du bstan/ gter gzhung spyi dang bye brag pa'i khog dbub mdor bsdus tsam re gsungs pa la'ang rgyud don 'phags yul gyi grub pa'i dbang po rnams kyis 'grel lugs lta bu'i bshad tshul rmad du byung ba du ma zhig yod de kun kyang nyi ma dang 'od zer ltar rang gi gzugs sku'i snang ba dang mnyam du bsdus pas yid phya/ zhal mthong gi 'brel bas bsdus tshad la sku tshab rin po che'i rten dbang ma thob pa ni ye mi snang bas o rgyan gu ru'i phrin las rnam pa thams cad nas rgyas/bdud rtsi'i sgrub pa ches mang du mdzad cing / chos sman dang /skyes bdun ril bu/ tshe rdzas sogs rang nyid dang sprul pa'i gter 'byin gzhan gyi gter byon rnam grangs brgya phrag du ma phab gter bsdus pa dang / sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i tshems las sprul pa'i ring bsrel sogs kyi sbyin pas ni gangs can mtha' dbus kun du'ang khyab ste grol ba bzhi ldan gyi phrin las cha gcig yin/ phyogs dang 417

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/phyogs nas sku gsung thugs rten dang / rgya bod kyi nor sna khyad 'phags phal gyis yun ring du bsgrubs pas 'thon dka' ba rnams dang mkho dgu'i nyer spyod sogs rgya che la rgyun mi chad par rtsol med du 'du/ yo byad thams cad rdo rje'i longs spyod du byin gyis brlabs pa'i gzugs brnyan phyir shar bas phyag tu bzhugs tshad kyi spyad pa rnams ngan ngon zhig yin rung spus dag dang gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i bkrag zil can lta bu 'ba' zhig yod/ dbul zhing phongs pa rnams kyis dngos po ngan nyung tsam phul ba la'ang /'di phyag po zhig yin na gser dngul gos dar gyi 'bul ba'i tshod ri'i mi ///mi 4155 //rngo/ ༷lnga/glo /gri//du 'dug sa phra zhang phra ba rnams kyang gnas na du chud sa 'gro bar mdzad/ nor sred kyi gsog 'jog ye mi mnga' bas rnyed pa gang byung bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi tshogs su 'dabs gter sba ba'i phyir/ rang nyid kyi bla ma rnams la chos gsan pa'i thog mar maṇḍal gyi 'bul ba dang / mthar gtang rag gi mchod pa/dus gzhan du'ang zhabs brtan gyi mnga' dbul sogs dag cing bzang la rgya che ba'i mchod sprin yang dang yang du spros te phul/dgon gnas gsar bzhengs rigs/ dus dbang gis dgos pa chung bar gzigs te ma mdzad kyang / bar skabs su stod smad 'khrugs long kyi dbang gis sde dge lho byang phyogs kyi sa skya/ rnying 418

nga〉 'o/jodrozug rngasnodranajungathag zugastemin ngagurbegi ṣṭhasdezug 21 byebye:re shergab/thag ngas:dzdzarngasno/ 21rngad/ pa/ma/ dge lugs kyi dgon sde mang po nyams shing zhig ral du song ba na/ zhig gso'i cha rkyen dngos ja sum stong lhag bstsal zhing /rgya bod kyi dpon chen dang / mi dbang sde dge rnams la mthun sbyor sgrubs shig pa'i bka' phabs te gzhi bzhengs grub pa dang /mchod thebs zhal 'debs dang / 'phral yun kun tu dge ba'i bslab ston sgo du mas gzhal bar dka' ba'i bka' drin gyi phung po 'du mdzad kyang / ngas byas kyi zhal pho dang drin yus 'dren pa'i tshig zur gcig tsam mi 'byung / nye ba'i char 'khod pa'i chos sde rnams la lo re bzhin gzungs sngags klog sgrog dang / bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam gyi yon sbyar gong 'og bsdom na dngos ja bzhi stong lhag pa'i rgyu 'gro phul/ mdor na ku su li brag skyibs na spyod pa tshun chad kyi gang zag dang dge 'dun la mchod pa mdzad pa'i rnam grangs bgrang bar dka'/ rab byung gis rten bzhengs sogs kyi ched du sha thang thang la longs spyod sgrub pa gsung rab las bkag kyang / de ltar ma bsgrubs bzhin du rnyed pa rnams dkon mchog gsum la bsnyen bkur bya ba'i cha rkyen du sbyor bar gsungs pa'i srol gso ba dang / rang nyid la zang zing 'ba' zhig gi 'brel bas bsdus pa rnams kyang mtha' yas pa'i rgyal dang de sras la dge ba'i rtsa ba rgya cher skyed pa'i rten 'brel dang bstan 'gro'i 419

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rgud pa zhi ba'i dgos dbang khyad par can gzigs nas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i sku'i rnam 'gyur thun mong ba dang /than mong ma yin pa rtsa gsum chos srang dang bcas pa'i snang brnyan racing lha/bdu niri mi shārnyiXste ////gzungs ldan ga ra zangs las grub pa sa nga sor dang / gyang ris kyi bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong sku gser dul ma ljibs thugs can/ bris thang gser chab dang za 'og gis byugs pa brgya phrag brgal ba/ gsar rnying gi yi dam mang po'i chu tshon dkyil 'khor sogs bzhengs/ bka' bstan rin po che rnam gnyis dang /gangs ri'i khrod kyi shing rta chen po rnams kyi gsung rab bris spar bsdoms pa glegs bam stong phrag gnyis tsam glegs shing / na bza'/ gdong dar/ chings thag seng mgo bcas sgros gtsang 'gangs legs kyis spras pa bsgrubs/ rgya bod kyi gsung rab pusti bzhi bcur nye ba spar du bkod/ lhun grub steng gi mchod sdong mthong grol chen mo dngul srang 'khor lnga stong bzhi brgya tsam gyis bskrun pa gtso bor gyur pa'i gser zangs kyi mchod rten gzungs ldan cha tshang legs pa brgya rtsa lhag gsar bskrun mdzad/ de rnams kyi bzhugs gnas lha khang che chung bcu gsum tsam mchod pa'i yo byad rgyu bzang la bzo khyad gtsang ba sna tshogs kyis bkod legs par brgyan pa bzhengs/ 'di lta bu'i mdzad pa'i bab kyis sku'i nye 420

'jam dbyangs masmo brtse rin po che'i rtogs brjod/ pod/ 5zhe'akhor du yig mkhan/ lha ris pa/ shing bzo brkos mkhan mgar ba gos bzo sogs bzo rig pa'i 'du ba rgyun chad med/ de 'dra ba rnams kyang 'brel tshad don ldan gyi smon lam rlabs po che'i bden pas gzhan phan gyi phrin las gting dpag dka' ba sha stag tu 'jug gi/ mngags gzhug tha mal ba gtan min/ de la bzo gnas pa kha cig ni zla ba mang por lto chas phyag rdzas nas 'bogs shing / mi gzhan gyi las kar brtson pa'am/ rang dgar gnas pas dus 'da' bar byed kyang / thugs mi 'khrugs par ma zad/mthar gnang skyes bzang po res dga' ba bskyed de dgyes bzhin du gtong ba dang / nyam thag 'ga' zhig ni bzo gnas ci yang mi shes bzhin du mngon tshan chung ngus gla lto ster ba'i thabs tsam la dgongs te las ka ba'i gral du 'jog pa sogs ci dang ci nas kyang ma ltar mnyes shing gshin pas bzo bo rnams ma bsdus par yang yul phyogs du ma nas padma'i dri la bung ba ltar dga' zhing 'du/de dag la bzo 'di gyis kyi bka' so sor stsol ba tsam las drag 'jun dang mgo rdzi brko bzhag sogs ci yang mi mdzad rung /ngang gis g.yo med par rang rang gi bgyi ba gang yin pa de la 'jug cing / yun ring por mi skyo ba'i yid kyis gnas/ las grub nas gla rngan yul lugs las lhag pa tsam la/ ngo so 'don 421

ngesarngan/ 5 lngardo sdispyings khu/:drob/ba/ cesarngasno ngas/ltazug rta):re ba/sdo/thang 'o/dra/zug/ stanapa'i gtang rag zur pa dang bcas te dngos gtsang la rngams 'thug par bstsal bas/ rang rang gi zho sha'i 'brel 'jog kyang mjug rjes su yi rang dang 'brel ba'i sgo nas stobs dang ldan pa'i bsod nams su grub par mdzad/ gzhan pa su dag rten bzhengs la spro bas grabs bsham yang yo byad kyis dbul ba gzigs tshe de'i 'dun pa'i yol go gang nges pa'i nor dbyig sogs bstsal/ grwa rkyang dkyus ma'i rigs kyis 'jim sku dang drwa mig tsam bzhengs pa la'ang tshon rtsi sogs mthun 'gyar gyi sbyin pa dang bcas spros bas 1zig zi tsho ni/sprag/)bye tshorang hwa pagabongs bstad/ lhag gnas pya da du gzhan gyas bcal zhu phul ba'i sku gzugs rnams kyang gser byugs kyis zhal ras snum par mdzad de na bza' sogs kyi bsnyi stangs stobs/ mchog dman bar ma'i 'gro ba la phyag mchod kyi zhing dkyus ma dang / rten gzhan bzhengs su 'jug rgyu sogs la sku gsung thugs rten rnyed dka' khyad 'phags rigs 'byams klas pa bkyes shing / phyag dpe gang bzhugs la che chung sus kyang blta zhing klog pa dang /dpe rgyun 'bri ba sogs bsod nams dang ye shes kyi bya ba mang du byed pa'i go skabs yangs pas rten gsum la nang rdzas dang /g.yang rten dang gzi byin sgrub pa'i 'phyor chas tsam du 'du shes shing ser snas dam du srung ba'i dregs ldan rnams sma phab kyi gnas 422

tyā 'jam dbyangs mastemin brtse rin po che'i rtogs brjod/ pod/ 5su bkod/ smos ma thag pa'i lha khang rnams su spos dang mar me sogs kyi rgyun thebs sbyor 'jag dang / dpal thams cad rig pa/bde mchog nag po lugs/ gsang 'dus 'jam pa'i rdo rje/gter gsar rigs gsam snying thig sogs gsar rnying gi thags riri sbyi ri riXdam du ma'i sgrub mchod yo byad kyis phyug pa rgyun btsugs/ dbyar ka chu klung gi 'gram du chu mchod stong phrag du ma 'bul ba'i phyir sku 'khor ched mngags gnang ba dang / dus rgyun du gzim spyil gyi lha khang phyi nang bar khyams kun tu mar me'i phreng ba nyin mtshan rgyun chad med pa dang bzang spos rgyun sbar/ mchod yon dang me tog gi bye brag mang po/ zhal zas kyi sbrang tshar sogs bkod legs shing gtsang sbra thon pa dang / nyin re zhing bda' dgu'i bza' btung gi longs spyod dang ldan pa'i tshogs kyi mchod pa re chag med/ yar mar gyi tshes bcu'i mchod pa rnams su mar me kho na'ang brgya phrag ma mthar bzhag pas mtshon tshogs mchod kyi yo byad rgyas spros/ rgyal ba'i dus chen bzhi dang / nya stong brgyad gsum nam byung la spos dang mar me brgya rtsa'i phreng ba rab tu mang ba gtsor bton gyi dngos bshams dang / de'ang gzungs dang rig pa dang mos pa'i stobs kyis chos dbyings dang mnyam par spel te 'bul zhing bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam gyis rgyas 'debs 423

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/mdzad/ rnam par thar pa 'di la ni da lta nges don gyi lta ba la khag bcol nas spyod phyogs thabs kyi cha chen po rnams la mchil ma'i thal ba bas kyang lod par brtsi ba'i sgom chen dang grub gter rnams kyis cung zad re dpyod dgos par mngon no/ sde dge blon chen padma legs grub rgyal po'i thags sa ma 'thad pa'i rkyen gyis ra ༄byikhams brag g.yab dang / sde dge 'gras gzhi chen po byung skabs/de la brten nas dme 'khrug 'jigs su rung ba zhig yong bar mkhyen te/ mi phangs nor las byas pa'i 'khon bsdum mdzad/bstan 'gro spyi'i byur sel du nee pa la'i dong tse gsum bzhi skor gyi rin thang rdzong 'debs su btang ba'i glud bsngo re nyin bzhin ma chag pa mdzad/ mu to dang bya khyi'i skye gnas pa rnams la brgyags dang rgyags rten gnang ba'ang tshad med/ de 'dra la dgongs nas khyab bdag blo gros mtha' yas pas/ bstan 'gro'i don du gces dgu'i bdog pa yang / /rtswa bzhin gtong bar mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes rang bzhin brjod pa'i gtam du gsung / dbus g.yo ru'i khra 'brug tu lung bstan gyi nges pa gzigs pa bzhin dpal chu bo ri'i gu ru'i sgrub phug nam mkha' lding du bod khams bde thabs kyi phrin las mdzad pas/ o rgyan bde ba chen po gtso 'khor grangs med pas nam mkha' khengs pa dang / sprul pa'i 'du 424

'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse rin po che'i rtogs brjod/ pod/ 5'phros bod la mi 'jigs pa bstsal ba gzigs shing / lo skor gcig tu mtha' dmag gi 'tshe ba mi 'byung ba'i mtshan ma brtan po brnyes/ dus gcig na snang srid rmi lam ltar gzigs pa'i ting nge 'dzin shin tu brtan po'i gsal snang la chos 'khor lha sa'i bar skor du phebs/ de na mkhar chen bza' mi las 'das pa'i mtshar sdug rgyan chas can gzi brjid mchog tu 'bar ba'i rnam pa'i phyag na me tog dmar pos bkang ba'i bum pa zhig bsnams te byung ba dang mjal/ phan tshun ma bu lta bu'i brtse gdung gis gsung gleng mang zhig mdzad pa'i mthar/ jo bo yid bzhin nor bu'i spyan sngar 'grogs te byon/ der bod 'bangs bde ba'i smon lam mang po mdzad/ jo mos bod spyi la phan pa'i lung bstan rgya cher bstsal nas bar snang ḍā ma ru'i sgras bkang / steng gi nam mkha' la thal ler gshegs/ 'on kyang dgung lo bcu drug par rong btsan kha ba dkar por mtsho rgyal sprul pa'i mi mo zhig phrin las kyi sgo 'byed du byon yang de dang zhal 'dzom pa'i mthun rkyen ma tshogs pa dang /phyis mchog gyur gling pa dbus su phebs skabs mon yul dkar mo brag gi gter kha 'don dgos tshul dus gnad dang bcas pa nan cher gdams kyang / khong dpon slob lam bar nas 'gyangs pas thog tu ma khel ba sogs gangs can phan bde 'byung ba'i rten 425

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/'brel gyi sgo khyad par can rnams gdul bya'i bsod nams kyis rdzogs par ma lcigs pas rags pa mthun snang du byin rlabs kyi lag rjes 'bring tsam zhig las yul la smin ma thub par gsung /nyag dpon a mgon rnam pa g.yul 'khrug gi she mong dar ba'i dus su sde dge'i rgyal srid phrogs/ rgyal po yum sras gsum btson du bzung nas blon 'bangs sus kyang thar ba'i re ba zad pa na rje bla ma 'dis sgrol ma btson 'don ma'i phrin las kyi sbyor ba mdzad de/ma rmas par thar 'ong ba'i lung bstan gnang ba ji bzhin du byung /phyis shig tu nyag rong a mgon dang nged gnyis la sngon gyi 'brel ba 'dug pas tshe 'dir phrad ma thub pa ma gtogs/ phrad na ngas de la chos kyi phan thogs shig yong rgyu yin par 'dug gsungs/dkar po'i phyogs la blo mi 'jug cing / rlabs po che'i sdig stobs dang ldan pa nyag blon lu gu tshe ring lta bu'i ma rungs pa yang /rje btsun thags rje'i dbang phyag 'di'i mtshan gyi bdud rtsis 1171 niring ririg //)shā rwa ste/ //sde/ gas pas cung zad dul bar gyur tsho / zang zing sa ba na bkur bstabs/ phyis dme shod phyogs pa'i byas nyes la bsten nas kho'i dmag gis rdzong gsar dgon khang me la sbyangs mod/der yang rje bla ma 'di la dmag dpon rnams kyis brlang spyod brnyas thabs spu tsam ma byas par ma zad/ phyag dpe rnams mi 426

'jam dbyangs masmo brtse rin po che'i rtogs brjod/ pod/ 5'jigs pa'i phyogs su thabs rtsol du mas skyel ba sogs rang phyogs las kyang lhag pa'i zhabs tog byas/ de nas mi 'gyang ba'i dus su rje rang gi thabs la mkhas pa'i 'phrul gyis chos gzhi slar gsos te/ bkra shis lha rtse'i mdun thad du sā la'i nags chen po sbrul gyis gang ba zhig yod pa de shin tu gnyan pas sngon chad lcug phran gcig kyang 'breg phod mkhan med pa las/ de dus rje bla ma 'di shing slong mdzad pas/ de tshun chad nags der sbrul gyi rgyu ba 'gag cing shing ci 'dod du len btub/ sngar dgon de'i gtsug lag khang zhig gso la 'tshub 'gyur cher ldang ba zhig yod pa'ang /rje 'dis nyams gso mdzad pa nas bzung rang 'jam la song bar gleng / rab byung bco lnga pa'i thog mar khang dmar lung mdor bstan 'gro spyi'i srung bar dgongs te sgrub chen mang po mdzad pa'i skabs shed cig sde dge'i chab srid 'di la sngar yang smon log gi sems can nye char 'khod pa 'ga' re'i bya ba'i bab kyis rma nyes mang po btang / da gzod kyang las smon log pa mang pos mtshams sbyor gyis don nyan 'ong dka'/ 'on kyang da res kyi srung ba 'dis lo skor gnyis la bde 'jags yong shas che gsungs pa ltar de nas brtsams te rnam 'gyur lcags stag bar chab srid 'jam dar du gnas shing / de'i phyi lo nas rgyal blon nang 427

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rdze khye'akhrugs sogs mi shis pa gang mang byung bas bden pa'i lung don mngon sum par mthong / gzhung sa'i bka' blon phu lung ba rab tu byung rjes shig la dga' ldan sna ring gi 'jigs pas nyen par gyur nas/ tshe lha rnam gsum la brten pa'i rim gro mdzad pas/cang ma phan gsung / de nas mi ring bar chu la g.yugs/ khong shi nas yar 'brog gi lug cig tu skyes/ de nas sa skya'i sku ngo zhig tu skye bar 'gyur gsungs/ 'di rigs gzhan yang slob ma dad can la so sor gyes skabs da rang re gnyis tshe 'dir phrad par dka' gsungs pa dang / da dung thug yong gsungs pa rnams de kho na ltar gyur pa dang / rdzong gsar du bzhugs skabs shig dgon stod la me'i dogs pa gyis gsungs pa dang / lan cig dgon smad du me zon gyis gsungs nas bltar phyin pas/ phyogs de dang der 'khris su yod pa'i mi rnams kyis kyang ma tshor bar me shor nas 'dug pa dang / zhabs tog par phyi rol gyi khang pa'i nang du yi ge 'bri ba'i las ka sogs gnang ba ji srid ma grub par nyin zhag mang po song yang de'i gleng mo mi mdzad la/ zin mtshams kho nar khyer shog gi dril brda gnang ba zhig stes dbang min par phal cher la 'ong ba dang / sku mdun du glo bur ba'i skye bo sogs kyis zhu phrin bskur ba nye gnas rnams kyis zhu bar brtsams pa na/ de 428

'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse rin po che'i rtogs brjod/ pod/ 5bshad mi dgos/ ha go/ gsungs pa sogs dbang 'das kyi don gzigs pa'i mngon mkhyen mnga' ba'i gsung ci rigs kyang zhar la byon/ snod bcud kyi dge legs nyams pa gso ba'i phyir lhag gnas dang byin 'jug gter bum sgrub pa sogs mang du mdzad/'gro 'dul rgyal sras dpa' bo 'jigs med chos dbang zhabs kyis lha rdzas rin chen gnyis pa'i 'bul ba dang bcas bskul ma mdzad pa ltar rdza stod rdo ring chen mor ye shes brtan bzhugs kyi dgongs pa gtad pas/ de'i phyogs dang rta pa'i nyin lam bdun brgyad kyis bar du chod kyang rten la lhag par gnas pa'i me tog ser po mtha' yas pa babs pa rdo ring phyag mjal ba'i pho mo brgya phrag du mas mngon sum du grub/ gshin po'i 'gro ba rnams la phan gdags phyir dus dang dus su gnas lung gi cho ga sreg sbyong satstsha gdab chog dang bcas pa mdzad cing / 'dus pa'i dge 'dun la kun rig gi byang bsreg bgyid du stsol ba dang / sku tshe'i smad la nyin re bzhin tshogs mchod tshar gsam dang sbrel ba'i skong ༄bshags kyi cho ga rgyas bsdus gnyis re chag med mdzad pa sogs rjes 'dzin gyi phrin las bskyang ba'i sgo mang / a bhi tsarya'i phrin las la rtsal du bton pa'i bzlas bsgom sna gcig tsam yang mdzad ma myong ba 'dra bor yod kyang / nyag mi'i 'khrug long gi mdo 429
