pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/khams pa rnams sdug la sbyor ba'i skabs shig mnal lam du rang nyid kyi mdun sar lcags slang zhig tu ling chung snying gar stag ma'i lo ma la/ erni tri dzaḥzhes khrag gis bris pa re res mtshan pa bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi bkod 'dug der skyes bu brjid ldan zhig gis/'khrug pa 'di'i rjes 'brang la phung byed kyi dam sri zhi bcu rtsa bzhi yod pas de rnams sgrol dgos zhes nan gyis btud nas gso la ba 'debs par/ byung rgyal du gu ru drag po'i sgom bzlas shig brtsams pa'i rkyen gyis rang gi sku dpal mgon ma ning gi rnam par skad cig la song / de yongs su gyur pa las kun thub rgyal mo sku mi tshad las lhag pa zhig tu bzhengs/ dgug bsnyim gyi ting nge 'dzin re mdzad pas/ dam sri gcan gzan dang klu nor 'dab chags sha zan 'jigs rung gi mgo can grangs med pa 'dus te ling gzugs rnams la zhugs/ de'i mod la de dag re re zhing gzugs chen po srog dang bcas par gyur pa/ mthar gyis mtshon cha sna tshogs kyis bsgral/ khrag gi rgyun 'o chu ltar babs/ sha khrag dwangs snyigs med par gsol te slar ldang ba'i go skabs bcom/de 'dra ba nyer bzhi rdzogs pa dang mnal sad/ sad snang du'ang khrag gi dri tshor ba sogs byang ste/ de skabs srang zlog gi 'khrul ——7 ri sna zi dza ri'i zi pa lang ༄༄mi sngo ri ——7 zuraga'akhar skar rlam mang yang dan du kun marten bla ma 'ad kha na' 430

'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse rin po che'i rtogs brjod/ pod/ 5gzhan phan gyi thugs bskyed la he ru ka'i byin rlabs srog tu zhugs zil gyis nag phyogs gdug pa'i tsha ngar phyed tsam zhig zhi ba yin par snang ngo/ /de rjes nyag dpon mgon rnam dga' ldan pho brang pa'i dpung gis mthar smrod btang / rje 'di las zhal bkod nod pa ltar phogs dpon phun rabs spyi khyab dpon du bskos/ da dung yang 'phral la 'tshub 'gyar zhig 'ong bar lung bstan bstsal ba lharwa〉 'ang tsho rig zi pa7)(1 zurar rsā phabadan/ slar nyag rang pa rnams nga ga nas ra nang 'brug rdzang gi mtha' nyin zhag mang por dmag gis bskor te brgal bas rdzong sdod rnams rnga thog tu sran ma lhung ba ltar bag mi phebs par gnas pa'i tshe rje 'dis rgyal khams bde ba'i mthun grogs la rnam sras rta sngon can gyi bskul ba mdzad pas/ nub gcig spyi khyab dpon gyi rmi lam du/ ri nang gi mdun ri sbang 'bur rtser mi nag po mdung dar thogs pa shing sā la'i sdong po bas bong mtho zhing 'jigs su rung ba zhig mdung rting sa la lan gsum rdeg pa'i mod 'dzam gling gi sa gzhi g.yo snyam byed cing / kwa'i phun rab pa khyod ma 'jigs shig nged rang sde dge dgon chen nas 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtses btang ba yin no zhes gsang mthor sgrog pa'i ngang la gnyid sad/ der zhag gsum nas nyag sde rnams kyis bzod gsol dang bcas mgo tshur btags byung ba yin skad/ sangs 431

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/zhe rgyas kyi phrin las pa rnams kyi thu bo 'di la kla klo'i srung ma rnams rang gi rgud pa mi zad pa lta bur mthong ste lhag par sdang ba'i phyir lan gcig kla klo'i zhags pa byung zer nas dru gu 'dra ba zhig babs te sku lus bcings/ dgu tshigs kyi ngos shig la bsdams song bar/ nag po chen po phyag bzhi ba 'ong nas gri gug bsnun pas byad thag dum bur song / gnam dpag tshad stong phrag du mi'i steng nas 'dzam bu'i gling gi sa la lhung bar rtsom pa na/ dam can rdo rje legs pas sa ltar yangs pa'i thu ba bzed de/ mgon chen sde bzhi 'dra po ma gtogs/ bdag 'dras gtor ma tsam yang thob ma myong ste/ 'di lta bu'i gnas skabs na nga yang dgos dgos 'dra zer nas nye zho med par blangs pa'i mnal ltas shar/bde chen padma shel phug tu gter gsar thugs sgrub kyi tshogs skong mdzad dus khrom mang du 'dus pa la dbang zhig mdzad par dgongs pa'i tshe/ dam can dngos su 'ongs nas/ 'dir mi nyi shu las mang ba 'dzud mi nyan zhus pas khrom dbang rgyab tu mdzad/padma shel rir bzhugs dus phyi dro zhig la/ da lta 'og gi pha bong 'gram 'dir rdo rje legs pa byung na sa g.yas kyi rdo rjes yar gyi brag la bstan/ mig zur gyis mar gyi sgrub phug 'di la bltas song bas 'di gnyis la gter kha re re yod par 'dug gsungs te/432

'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse rin po che'i rtogs brjod/ pod/ 5 phyir nyin brag gnyis po nas gter re re bzhes/ zla gam dbang phug tu bzhugs skabs/ khyab bdag blo gros mtha' yas pas dpal spungs ri khrod kyi rten gtso gsar bzhengs mdzad pa'i nang du gzhug rgyu'i byin rten khyad 'phags shig dgos zhus par/ rdo rje g.yu sgron ma la phrin las bcol bas des rin po che asma garbha las grub pa'i rdo rje sems dpa'i sku gzugs khyad par can dngos su phul/ byang chub gling pa'i zab gter kun bzang thags gter ༄'khor 'das rang grol gyi chos rgyun gsos skabs/ jo mo rgya gar ma shing lo'i gos can mnal lam du 'ongs nas/ dga' rtags 'bras kyi snye ma zhig dang / de'i phyi nub kyi mtshan thog thag bsnyen bkur zhabs tog phul ba sogs srung ma'i dbang po rnams bran bzhin rtag tu gnas pas phrin las thams cad shugs 'byung du 'grub/ de lta bu'i rnam par thar pa rnams rje rang nyid kyis mgur du bzhengs pa'ang snang ste/ a ho/ dran pas gdung sel khyab bdag gi bla ma/ /ye shes sku can snying dbus su bzhugs nas//'brel tshad rnam grol go 'phang la sbyor ba'i/ /byin rlabs zab mo mngon sum du stsol cig /sngon smon dkar po'i nye rgyu la brten nas/ma bsgrubs yi dam lha zhal dang mjal ba/ bsod zad 'dre mthong mkhan po ni ma lags/ /mngon sum byin rlabs thob pa 'di 433

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dga' yo/ /mtsho skyes bla ma'i thugs rje la brten nas/ /ma 'bad chos kyi mdzod chen du gyar pa/ /sa rko rdo rlog rdzun rib ni ma lags//༄spobs pa'i gter chen grol ba 'di dga' yo/ /dwangs ma las rung gzi brjid la brten nas/ /ma bos zhing skyes pho nya rnams 'du ba/ /las ngan mu ge rkub 'phel ni ma lags/ /bde stong brtul zhugs grub pa 'di dga' yo/ /rtsa rlung dwangs pa'i rten 'brel la brten nas/ /gsal snang me long gzugs brnyan bzhin shar ba/ /mi chos bla ma'i mgo skor ni ma lags/ /gang smras thog tu phebs pa 'di dga' yo/ /gnas lugs gnyug ma'i gsang lam la brten nas/ /ma bsgom don dam mngon sum du gyur pa/ /nga rgyal sgom chen rgan po ni ma lags/ /re dogs rtsad nas zad pa 'di dga' yo/ /brgyud ldan dam pa'i gzhung bzang la brten nas//ma 'bad grub pa'i nges gsang kun mthong ba/ /rtsal bshad rtog ge'i tshig skam ni ma lags/ /don gyi dgongs zab rtogs pa 'di dga' yo/ /rtsa gsum byin rlabs snying dbus su bzhugs pas/ /ma brtsams las bzhi thogs med du grub pa/ /rnga gog zad zad sdug yus ni ma lags/ /rang gzhan phan bder sbyor ba 'di dga' yo/ /sngon bsags bsod nams 'phen shugs la brten nas//ma bsdus zang zing sprin bzhin du 'du ba/ /brgya bshig stong 434

'jam dbyangs masmo brtse rin po che'i rtogs brjod/ pod/ 5'gugs bse rag ni ma lags/ /'phral byung 'phral dag mchod sbyin 'di dga' yo/ /gzhan phan bzang po'i legs smon la brten nas/ /ma bskul khrom tshogs lang long du 'ur ba/ /khyi rgan lhag ldud slong mkhan ni ma lags/ /'brel tshad don dang ldan pa 'di dga' yo/ /snang ba dbang 'dus rten 'brel la brten nas/ /ma bstun bla dpon dregs ldan kun 'dud pa/ /ci rag ngo srung yi dwags ni ma lags/ /kun la zhen med hur spyod 'di dga' yo/ /lhag bsam dkar po'i rten 'brel la brten nas/ /ma bshad mos ldan thar lam du 'khrid pa/ /skyid sdug sgos khur tshogs dpon ni ma lags/ /gzhan rgyud ngang gis 'gyur ba 'di dga' yo/ /nye 'khon med pa'i rten 'byung la brten nas/ /ma rtsol bstan pa ris med du spel ba/ /re bas bsgribs pa'i las thabs ni ma lags/ /phyogs med ris med blo bde 'di dga' yo/ /yongs la snying brtse'i gzhan dbang la brten nas/ /ma chags mi 'khon thams cad dang mdza' ba/ /ngo srung mthun 'jug bslu brid ni ma lags/ /rgyal khams gces phrug gzhon nu 'di dga' yo/ /gang la bltas kyang skyo shas dang nges 'byung / /ma bcos snying nas lam lam du 'char ba/ /rtogs ldan gsar pa'i tsab tsub ni ma lags/ /mngon zhen gting nas thongs pa 'di dga' yo/ /chos 'gal bya 435

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/0ba rlabs chen gyi bdud las/ /ma spang rang bzhin shugs 'byung gis dag pa/ /dge slong gzhon nu'i tshul 'chos ni ma lags / /chos dad zhu dag pher ba 'di dga' yo/ /bla ma lha yi byin rlabs la brten nas/ /ma btul rang rgyud phyogs med du grol ba/ /sngags pa rgan po'i rbad khams ni ma lags/ /shi yang 'gyod pa med pa 'di dga' yo/ /dga' ba bcu drug snye ma dang 'grogs nas/ /drang srong dregs pa'i ngag tshig gi gling bu/ /re dogs med par thol byung du sbrengs pas/ /'brel tshad don ldan dge legs su gyur cig /ces bka' stsal to/ /srid na gnas kyang de yi nyes pa'i rdul/ /chags pa'i gnas med kun dga'i rol rtsed can/ /tshul 'dis brtan rnams 'jig rten dbang phyug gi/ /phyag yangs padmas brgyan pa bzhin du mdzes/ /spong klog las gsum dbyar gyi phun tshogs bzhin/ /phan tshun mi 'dra'i ngo mtshar brgyas gang zhing //kun kyang 'gal med grogs su song ba'i tshul/ /'di 'dra'i gnas la dpyod shes su mi dad/ /bsdu ba'i tshigs su bcad pa'o/ / de dag gis ni dang por rnam smin gyi yon tan brgyad dang ldan pa'i rten ji ltar bzhes tshul/ de nas rten de la dge ba'i bshes gnyen tshul bzhin du brten te thos pa'i gru bo ches lung gi bstan pa rgya mtsho lta bu'i pha rol tu son tshul/ de'i 'og tu bsam 436

'jam dbyangs ma.o brtse rin po che'i rtogs brjod/ pod/ 5sgom gyi mkhyen rab rmad du byung ba'i rtsal gyis thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rtogs pa'i bstan pa la mnga' brnyes tshul/mthar gting dpag dka' ba'i thabs mkhas kyi 'jug pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas 'gro ba'i don mdzad tshul te rgyal bas bsngags pa'i rnam thar gyi tshul bzhi po 'di brjod pa yin la/ de dag gi khongs su theg pa chen po'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi mtshan nyid rnams kyang tshang bar bsnyad de/ mtshan nyid de dag kyang gang zhe na/'di la mdo bstan bcos nas mang du gsungs kyang / re zhig mdo sde rgyan las gsungs pa 'di don gsal zhing rgyas pas/ de dang sbyor na/ bshes gnyen dul ba zhi ba nyer zhi ba/ /yon tan lhag pa brtson bcas lung gis phyug /de nyid rab tu rtogs pa smra mkhas ldan/ /brtse ba'i bdag nyid skyo ngal spangs la bsten/ /zhes gsungs te/ de la dul ba ni tshul khrims kyi bslab pas thugs sbyangs pa la byed pas/ de ni sngar sor byang gi sdom pa bzhes tshul dang / byang chub kyi sems gnyis sbyangs par bshad pa'i nang nas 'jug sems sbyangs pa dang / skabs phyi mar bsnyen rdzogs kyi bslab pa la gces spras mdzad tshul brjod pa rnams kyis mtshon zhi ba dang / nye bar zhi ba ni go rim bzhin du ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab kyi bslab pas thugs rgyud btul ba la byed de/437

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/de ni byang chub sems gnyis la thugs sbyangs par bstan pa'i nang tshan/ don dam sems bskyed sbyangs pas bsdus te/ byang chub sems dpas zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi sbyor bas de kho na nyid sgom pa la don dam sems bskyed nyams su len par 'jog pas so/ /lung gis phyag pa ni theg chen gyi gsung rab ris su ma chad pa //khros ///gornams la gas par sbyangs pas gdams ngag stong glegs bam du gyur tshul ji skad brjod pa rnams kyis bstan/ de kho na nyid gzigs pa ni zab mo dbu ma'i gzhung don la blo gros kyi snang ba thob par brjod pa des bstan/ yon tan lhag pa ni snyigs ma'i mtha' 'dir grags ldan gyi chen po rnams kyi nang na yang skyes bu dam pa 'di lta bu 'byon par dka' tshul dngos shugs ci rigs su bstan pas mtshon/ smra mkhas pa dang ldan pa ni chos ston pa'i rgyan dang ldan tshul rnams kyis bshad/ brtse ba'i bdag nyid ni ci mdzad gzhan phan du 'jug tshul dang / dman la lhag par brtse ba/gdul bya'i log sgrub bzod tshul rnams kyis 'phangs te bstan/de'i snga mas gzhan phan la spro ba che ba'i brtson bcas kyang 'phen/skyo ngal spangs pa ni chos 'chad pa la skyo dub med tshul bshad pas ston te/ dang po drug gis rang rgyud phyogs med du grol tshul dang /phyi ma bzhis de nyid sems can thams cad kyi grogs su gtong tshul 438

'jam dbyangs masmo brtse rin po che'i rtogs brjod/ pod/ 5brjod pa yin no/ khyad par du gsang sngags ston pa'i slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid la/ rgyud sde phyi nang dang / nang pa'i yang rgyud sde so sor ches mang du gsungs mod/ gsang sngags kyi bla ma bsten tshul spyi'i gzhung bla ma lnga bcu pa las gsungs pa ni/ brtan cing dul la blo gros ldan/ /bzod ldan drang la g.yo sgyu med/ /sngags dang rgyud kyi sbyor ba shes/ /snying brtser ldan zhing bstan bcos mkhas/ /de nyid bcu ni yongs su shes/ /dkyil 'khor 'dri ba'i las la mkhas/ /sngags bshad pa yi sbyor ba shes/ /rab tu dang zhing dbang po dul/ /zhes pa ste/ 'di dag ni 'grel chen dri med 'od du'ang drangs so/ /de la brtan pa ni lus kyi nyes spyod bsdams pa dang / dul ba ni ngag gi nyes spyod bsdams pa ste/ de gnyis ni gong du sku gsung gi mdzad spyod yongs su dag tshul nyug tsam smos pas brjod/ blo gros ldan pa ni/ skyes sbyangs kyi mkhyen rab phul du byung tshul rnams kyis bshad/ bzod ldan ni gzhan gyis log sgrub bzod cing zab mo'i lta ba rnyed tshul gyis bstan/ drang ba ste lhag bsam bzang ba ni bka' btsan tshul brjod pa'i skabs su thugs dgongs drang bar bstan pa des zin/ g.yo sgyu med pa ni gsang ba srung ba la thugs sgam par bstan pas mtshon te/ rang gi yon tan rnam par dag pa rnams kyang gter bzhin du mi mngon 439

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/par mdzad na/ yon tan med bzhin du yod rdzu dang / skyon yod pa zol gyis sgrib pa'i skabs med pa'i phyir ro/ /g.yo sgyu ni/ rnyed bkur la chags pas 'dren par bshad pas zhen med kyi kun spangs chen por bzhugs tshul rnams kyis kyang ston no/ /blo ldan nas 'di'i bar yid bsdams pa yin zhing / lus ngag yid gsum bsdam tshul gyi gtso bo ni skabs gsum par rdo rje theg pa'i dam tshig la gces nor ltar gzigs par bstan pa de yin no/ /'di yan chad gyis rtogs brjod rnams su sgo gsum bsdams pa de nyid la dbang sgyur thob tshul yang bsdus yod pas 'og nas 'byung ba'i dbang po dul ba'ang tshang / sngags dang rgyud kyi sbyor ba zhes pa'i rgyud kyi sbyor ba ni sman sbyor gyi bya ba la gsungs te/ sngags dang rdzas kyi sgo nas bgegs zlog pa sogs shes pa'o/ /de ni 'chad 'gyar gyi de nyid bcu ston byed dang tshig gi rim pa gcig go/ /༄ snying brtser ldan pa ni gong smos brtse ba'i bdag nyid dang gnyis la/theg chen gyi bla ma spyi'i mtshan nyid dang / bye brag tu rdo rje slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid du 'gro ba'i cha tha dad pa ma gtogs/ ngo bo'i khyad par gzhan med pas 'chad byed kyi zur du ma bkod/bstan bcos la mkhas pa ni bcu phrag rig pa'i gzhung lugs la nang byan tshud tshul bshad pas zin/ de nyid bcu shes zhes pa'i 440

'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse rin po che'i rtogs brjod/ pod/ 5de nyid bcu la rgyud sde 'o ga ma'i rdo rje slob dpon gyis mkhas par bya dgos pa dang / bla med rgyud kyi slob dpon gyis bye brag tu slob dgos pa'i de nyid bcu tshan gnyis las/ dang po/ dkyil 'khor/ting 'dzin/ phyag rgya/ stangs stabs/ 'dug stangs/ bzlas brjod/ sbyin sreg mchod pa/ las sbyor/ gshegs gsol te bcu dang / phyi ma bsgom pa dang bris pa'i srung 'khor gyis bgegs zlog pa/ gsang sher gnyis kyis mtshon pa'i dbang bzhi/ dgra kha sbyor dbye ba/ gtor ma/ rdor bzlas mtshon byed du byas pa'i bzlas pa sgo mang po/ lha la drag shul sgrub pa/ rab gnas/dkyil 'khor sgrub pa ste bcu/ de thams cad la mkhas pa ni rgyud/sgrub thabs/ le lag man ngag lag len dang bcas pa phyogs lhung med par mkhyen rab gzo tshul gyis bsnyad/ tshig gi rim pa de nyid kyis dkyil 'khor 'dri ba'i las la mkhas pa yang bstan/sngags bshad pa yi sbyor ba shes pa ste gsang sngags 'chad mkhas pa ni/ dpa' bo mkha 'a 'gro'i gsang mdzod la dbang bsgyur ba'i stobs kyis gsang sngags smra ba'i khya mchog tu gyar tshal phyi mas ra rang ༄༄midangos su zin/ rab tu dang ba ste theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i tshul rnams la dad pa mi phyed pa ni/ chos tshul de dag la brtson pa drag pos bya ba mdzad tshul rnams kyis 'phen te/ brtson 'grus 441

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dad pa'i rtsa ba can yin par shing rta chen pos gsungs pa'i phyir ro//gzhung de dang dus 'khor bsdus rgyud sogs kyi bla mar mi rung ba'i mtshan nyid ston pa'i skabs las bzlog pa'i don la yo byad la ser sna'i kun 'dzin bral ba'ang yod pas/ de ni nor gang byung tshogs bsags su btang ba'i tshul dang sbyar ro/ /gzhan yang rdo rje gur las/ nyan thos spyod pa skyong byed cing / /sngags kyi theg pa'i rim par gus/ /gzugs ldan mthong na dga' ba dang / /dkyil 'khor 'dri mkhas bzlas par ldan/ /zhes gsungs pa'i dang po ni spyod pa dam pa'i chos 'dul ba dang bstun tshul bshad pa des bstan/ dus kyi 'khor lor bshad ma thag pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i slob dpon la dge slong / dge tshul/ khyim pa ste gsum las/ dang po rab/ de nas rim bzhin 'bring dang tha mar gsung pa la sbyar na'ang / mgon po 'di rdo rje 'dzin pa rab tu 'gyur te de'i tshig 'dzin shin tu sla/ sngags kyi theg pa'i rim par gus pa ni rab tu dang ba'i thad du 'du/ gzugs ldan mthong na dga' ba ni sku'i gzi byin thun mong ma yin par brjod pas bstan/dkyil 'khor 'dri mkhas kyi don gong du bsdus zin/ bzlas par ldan tshul lhag pa'i lha mang po'i bsnyen pa mdzad tshul gyis bstan/de'ang rab 'khor lo can gyis gnang ba dang / min yang des ma 442

'jam dbyangs masmo brtse rin po che'i rtogs brjod/ pod/ 5bkag pa'i sgo nas dkyil 'khor chen po'i slob dpon du byed par gsungs pa'i nang tshan snga ma zung 'jug grub pa rnams kyis rjes su bzung lugs khyad par can bstan pas bsnyad/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba 'chi med che'i rgyud las/ dngos grub kyis gzhan la phan 'dogs pa'i slob dpon la mthu byin che zhing dam can nye ba sogs dgos par gsungs pa'ang dngos zin du thon pas mtshon/ dus kyi 'khor lo dang rdzogs chen gyi rgyud sogs du ma dang sbyar du yod mod kyi/ mang bas 'jigs nas ma spros so/ /de lta bu'i yon tan rnams rdzogs par tshang ba ma rnyed na yon tan gyi phyogs mang po tsam yang rdo rje slob dpon du bya rung bar don dam bsnyen pa las gsungs shing / de 'dra ba la bsten pa'i rgyu mtshan du/ rtsod ldan dbang gis bla ma skyon dang yon tan 'dres/ /rnam pa kun tu sdig pa med pa yod ma yin/ /zhes mtshan nyid rdzogs pa'i bla ma rnyed dka' ba bkod do/ /de bzhin du theg chen spyi'i bla ma la'ang sngar bshad pa'i mtshan nyid thams cad tshang ba ma rnyed na/ bya rgyud dpung bzang las sngags g.yog la gsungs pa'i rigs pa sbyar te mtshan nyid ji skad bshad pa'i brgyad cha tshang bas kyang rung bar bka' gdams pa chen po dag gis gsungs te/ de ltar na bdag nyid chen po 'di'i yon tan gyi cha phra mo re tsam mnga' ba la'ang 443

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/theg mchog dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang / rdo rje theg pa'i slob dpon gyi don dang tha snyad gnyis ka gnas pa yin no/ /tshul des 'di lta bu'i rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob yon tan gyi phung po rnams la ni/'ibalta ba dang / bsnyen bkur bya ba dang / gdams ngag len pa slad du gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi byang chub sems dpa' dang / khyad par gsang sngags kyi sgo la spyad pa spyod pa'i rgyal sras dpa' bo rnams kyang dka' ba mtha' yas pa spyad de skyes bu'i rtsal ci yod kyis 'jug pa ni/ rang gi bla ma la phyogs zhen byas pa'i gtam min gyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung tshad mar bgyis nas cung zad dpyad pa'o/ /tshig tshogs 'dab ma mi ring yang / /rtogs brjod sdong po mdzes byed rgyan/ /skal bzang rab dga'i me tog 'di/ /smra ba'i byis pa bdag gis bskyed/ /bar skabs kyi tshigs bcad do/ /gshegs ka'i phyogs kyi lo snga phyir(lo snga phyir phyogs kyi/)phyag mjal ba sngar las kyang ches mang bar 'dus pas sku dngos kyi gdul bya rdzogs par mdzad/ me phag lor bdag cag gis zhabs pad ring du brtan par gsol ba btab skabs/ kho bo skye 'chi la rang dbang yod zer rgyu dka' yang / bstan 'gro'i don chen 'grub pa'i sgor 'gyur nges su mthong na lo brgyar yang sdod mi chog rgyu 444

'jam dbyangs masmo brtse rin po che'i rtogs brjod/ pod/ 5cher med/ ces gsungs na'ang / de lta bu'i legs tshogs byang phyogs pa'i skal bar ma shongs pas/ rab tshes chu 'brug gi gnam lo gsar du 'char skor cig la/ a tsa ra'i chas can gnyis byung ste/ nged gnyis rgya gar nas 'ongs/ da lta rdo rje gdan na dge 'dun gyi sde dang / 'chad nyan/ mchod pa sogs kyi srol rnam dag yod kyang / mkhan po med nas rje nyid mkhan por gdan 'dren du btang ba yin zer ba'i rmi lam cig byung ci zhig yin ang / de su la ma zer zhes pa dang / bde ba can na de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med dge slong gi dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i nang na bzhugs pa'i snang ba 'ba' zhig 'char bar 'dug cis yin mi shes zhes nye gnas la gsungs/ rnam rgyal cho 'phrul zla ba'i nyer lnga la dus mchod rgyas pa mdzad/ sku 'khris kyi dpe nyob sogs dag par bsdus nas/ mchod dpon bla ma la de ring nas brtsams te khyod kyi dka' las ci'ang mi dgos gsangs/ de'i phyi ༄nyin nas sku khams cung zad rnyog pa'i tshul bstan/ drung 'khor rnams kyis sku rim sgrub dgos tshul zhus pas/ ci yang mi dgos/zla ba rjes ma'i nyi shu skor la dwangs 'gro gsungs/ nan gyis zhus pas/ da 'o na ngas tshe ril por dbang chos ha cang bshad ches shing / dam tshig la so nam byed mkhan nyung bar 'dug pas nad 445

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/'di byung ba yin/ rdo rje sems dpa'i yig brgya ci 'grub re bsgrub na legs pa yod/ nged kyi ring la gtor bca' ma myong bas de rigs kyis ni dgos pa mi mchi gsungs/ smon lam gyi byin gyis brlabs pa'i sprul pa lnga 'byung zhing / de las bzhis gsang sngags snga 'gyur/ sa skya/ dge lugs/ bka' rgyud pa rnams kyi ring lugs so sor bzung ste bstan pa la bya ba byed cing /gcig bon lugs pa rnams la mngon mtho'i 'jug ngogs ston pa'i slad du g.yung drung gi lugs 'dzin par snga gong nas lung bstan/ nyin gcig 'o ma gsol zhal gang bzhes pa la skyems kyi phyi mar mdzad/ de nas dbo zla ba'i dmar phyogs kyi dga' ba gnyis pa'i nangs snga phyag bsil nas/ da las ka tshar bar 'dug bca' lag phar khyer gsung / me tog 'thor ba dang sbrags nas shis brjod kyi bden tshig mang po gsung gi tha mar bstsal/ der nyis dros kyi cha tsam na bi ma'i thugs tig gi lung bstan ltar ye shes kyi sku phung po rags pa'i za ma tog spangs te 'jam dbyangs sprul pa'i pho brang dpal ri bo rtse lnga'i gzhal med khang la sogs par chu nang gi zla ba lta bu'i gar gyis gshegs/ de dang mi ring ba'i snga logs sa g.yo 'jam po dang / gshegs rjes sa zhal gyi ༄dkyil 'khor zla ba ltar dag pa dang / sku shing bal ltar yang ba 446

'jam dbyangs masmo brtse rin po che'i rtogs brjod/ pod/ 5sogs byung / der khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang blo gros mtha' yas zhabs dang / thar rtse mkhan chen po rin po che gnyis kyis bla ma mchod pa thugs rgyud skul ba'i gsol 'debs dang bcas pa rgya cher bsgrubs/ zla ba de'i rdzogs pa phyi mar sku gdung rin po che tsandan dang a ka ru sogs bzang shing 'ba' zhig gi zhugs la spyan drangs pas me tog dkar po'i char pa yang shin tu 'thug par babs/ skye dgu'i nyin byed nub pa'i byung ba 'di/ /yid la gdung ba skyed pas smrar mi sems/ /de lta'ang zhi bar gzims pa'i gtam gyis kyang / /sangs rgyas phrin las byed snyam cha tsam bsnyad/ /bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /de nas rje rang gi sku'i dbon po gtsug lag gnyis la rnam dpyod che zhing lhag bsam rlabs po che'i mthu can skal bzang rdo rje zhes rje nyid chos dbang rin po cher gyur dus/ lho brag na rdo rje sgron ma zer ba'i sbyin bdag mo zhig yod pa de'i skye bar lung bstan pa de dang / dul zhing brtan la blo che ba sogs dam pa'i yon tan gyis brgyan pa/ khyad par du'ang bla ma sangs rgyas ltar bsnyen bkur ba'i mthu las rgyal ba'i lung rtogs kyi sgo du ma la zhugs pa nye gnas chen po 'jam dbyangs legs pa'i blo gros dang /ma ti rin po che rnam gnyis la sogs pas dbus gtsang khams 447

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gsum du mchod 'bul/ mang bskol/ 'gyed gtong rigs bgrang bar dka' ba dang / rten bzhengs kyi bgyi ba rgya chen pos dgongs pa rdzogs pa'i thabs tshul gsol smon dang bcas pa bsgrubs pa ste/ 'di dag gi drin las kun mkhyen bla ma'i sku gdung de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdul phra rab kyi rang bzhin can phyi mtha'i bar du lha dang mi rnams kyi bsod nams kyi zhing du mngon par snang bas/ skyes ba chen po'i zla ba chos dbyings sa mnal risisko༅ dmi byeyang / grol ba bzhi ldan gyi phrin las bdud rtsi dkar po'i dga' ba ni da dung yang nyams pa med par gyur to/ /de dag ni mdor bsdus pa tsam ste/ rgya cher khyab bdag bla ma blo gros mthas yas kyi gsung rab las shes bar bya'o/ /slar smras pa/ mang thos chu gter bzhi yi mtshams las brgal//mi mnyam yon tan rin chen rdul mang brtsegs/ /gzhan phan rang 'od mkha' dang snyoms 'jug pa/ /rgyal bstan mtho ris 'degs pa gzhan yod min/ /bod chen 'dzin ma'i nyungs 'brur srid zhi'i khyon/ /dogs por 'gengs pa'i rnam thar stong gsum gzugs/ /gsal rdzogs dbang 'byor skye ba'i ya mtshan gtam/ /thun mong mthong ba dang sbyar cha tsam bsnyad/ /bsngags pa'i gnas 'di dus mang sbyang ba'i blo/ /mtha' yas rtsal mnga' de yis legs phye mod/ /448

'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse rin po che'i rtogs brjod/ pod/ 5brgya byin rol pa yongs 'du'i me tog nang / rtse ba'i skal bzang bung ba su zhig 'gog /kwa ye grogs dag mkhyen rab nyin byed ni/smon lam dro ba snying rje'i 'od rnon dang / /lhan cig 'gyed 'dis khyed blo smin 'gyar gyis/ /ngo mtshar rtogs brjod ri bo'i zom ༄'di bsten/ /bsod nams 'di yis mtha' klas 'gro ba kun/ /lam ston phyi dang thabs shes nang gi ni/ /yongs su 'dzin pas srid zhi'i mtha' bkag ste/ /sku bzhi'i rgyal srid mchog la spyod gyur cig /bho ṭa'i yul gyi slob dpon chen po mañdzu shrī dharma mi tra'i rtogs pa mdo tsam du brjod pa 'jig rten kun tu dga' ba'i gter zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rje btsun bla ma de nyid kyi nye gnas chen po 'jam dbyangs legs pa'i blo gros pas/ bla ma'i rnam thar mdo rgyud nas gsungs pa'i slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid rnams dang sbyar ba zhig bris zhes bkra shis pa'i dar dkar srid du ring ba dang bri gzhi bstsal ba bcas bskul ma mdzad cing / rang gi mos gus kyi gsos su dmigs te/ slar la bskul zhu phul ba ltar gnang ba'i zin bris kyi yi ge thor bu dang / lnga rig smra ba'i dbang po karma tshe dpal bas kyang zin tho gnang ba dag la brten cing / khyad par bai ro dngos byon bka' gter bstan pa'i shing rta bla ma rje btsun blo gros mtha' yas kyi zhal snga nas mdzad pa'i rtogs brjod rin po 449

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/che la gzhi byas/ der phyi nang gsang ba'i rnam thar khug pa'i tshul du gsungs pa rnams 'khor lo gsum gyi rtogs brjod kyi dkyus su bskyang / tshig rgyas pa rnams cung zad bsdus/ der mi gsal ba 'ga' zhig kha bskangs te/ rgyas bsdus 'bring po'i tshul du/mgon po de nyid kyi zhabs rdul rin po che'i phreng ba gtsag gi rgyan ༄du thob pa/ mdo smad kyi sprang po 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi ma phrin las kun tu khyab pa'i dpal gyis myos byed kyi lo sa ga nya ba'i dkar phyogs dga' ba dang por/ brdzi med chos lung bsam gtan dga' 'khyil gyi ri rtser nyis bris ma byas par gang dran ci thon chu babs kyi rtsa thor bkod pa 'dis kyang 'gro kun zung 'jug bla na med pa'i rgyal thabs la reg par gyur cig maṅga lam̐// //'di ni dang po'i 'char gzhi tsam bkod pa las phyis nyis bris ma thub par sor gnas steng mgo mjug gi tshigs bcad tsam bsnan nas sbyar byang brgyab pa yin pas blo gsal mkhas pas gzigs nyan cher med kyang rkyen 'gas bskul nas spar du brkos pa dge/450

pod/ 5༄/ /mtshungs bral rgyal ba'i myu gu o rgyan 'jigs med chos kyi dbang po'i rtogs brjod phyogs tsam gleng ba bdud rtsi'i zil thigs zhes bya ba bzhugs/dpal ldan bla ma la phyag 'tshal/ /rgyal kun yab gcig rgyal ba'i zhing kun tu/ /rgyal sras gzhon nu'i gzugs kyis rnam rol pa /'jam pa'i dbyangs zhes grags pa'i rnga bo che'i/ /rang sgras srid gsum 'gengs pa de la 'dud/ /de yis 'jigs med spobs pa'i mchog byin te/ /zab rgyas chos kyi sgra dbyangs mi zad pas/ /thar 'dod rnam byang dbang po rgyas mdzad pa/ /mtshungs med bla ma de la gus phyag 'tshal/ /zhes mchod par brjod nas/ bdag cag gi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa/ sku tshe dpag tu med pa nas byang chub kyi spyod pa rlabs po che la bslabs shing / rgyal ba'i dam chos 'dzin pa'i smon lam legs par bsgrubs pa/ gsung rab kyi dgongs don gsal bar byed pa'i bshad pa dang dben par yang dag 'jog la brtson pa'i sgrub pa ste 'khor lo gnyis kyis theg pa mchog gi bstan pa'i srog bzung ba/ bstan pa'i snang ba ches mi gsal 451

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ba'i yul gyi skye bo'i tshogs 'bum phrag du ma la yang mngon mtho nges legs kyi lam bzang nyin mo ltar gsal bar mdzad pas 'gro ba'i bla ma/ 'jig rten gyi mgon po zhes phyogs dang phyogs bral gyi dam pa rnams kyis snyan pa'i rgyud mangs mgrin gcig tu blangs pa/ don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te o rgyan 'jigs med chos kyi dbang po'i rtogs brjod phyogs tsam gleng ba la gnyis te/ sku tshe snga ma'i byung ba dang / sku tshe 'di nyid kyi mdzad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du slob dpon chen po zhi ba lha dang / bod yul du a ro ye shes 'byang gnas su gyar pa ra ༄shil sogs pa'i 'khrungs rab kyi phreng ba du ma zhig rje bla ma thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'i zab gter 'gro 'dul 'phags pa sems nyid ngal gso'i chos skor na bzhugs par grags kyang deng dus mjal du mi snang bas 'chad par mi nus la/ sku 'di'i snga rol de ma thag par yongs su grags pa ni byang rgyud rdza chu'i 'gram gyi stod phyogs su byung ba'i dpal dge bsam gtan phun tshogs zhes bya ba 'phags pa 'jam dpal la thugs dam gyi lhar mdzad cing mtshan brjod 'bum phrag lhag pa zhal 'don du mdzad pa/ sngon dus rmog grub nam mkha' chos dbang rdza stod ma mo'i thang du pheb skabs sa phyogs 452

dpal sprul rin po che'i rtogs brjod/ pod/ 5'dir 'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa'i skyes bu zhig gi dam chos yi ge drug ma'i rdo 'bum ngo mtshar can bzhengs par 'gyur zhes lung bstan pa ltar dpal dge'i rdo ring mar grags pa'i rten bzhengs chen po mdzad de mthong thos dran reg gi 'gro ba dpag tu med pa la dkar po rnam par 'phel ba'i sa bon btab cing da dung du yang phrin las kyi rgyun chu bo'i rgyun ltar 'jug bzhin pa de'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ bod kyi rus chen sde lnga'i nang tshan ldong smug po'i rigs kyi bye brag dge rtse zhes pa'i sder rgyal thog zhes pa'i gdung las rab yid rnam byang zhes pa sa 'brag gi lor skye ba'i mya ra ༄4 ra gu sad/ dbu gdugs ltar 'dug pa dang zhal ras padma ltar rgyas pa/ skye mched shin tu dwangs pa/ rang bzhin gyis snyun nyung ba/chung ngu nyid nas shes rab dang / snying rje dang / snying stobs ches che ba/ spobs pa'i gzengs mtho zhing smra mkhas pa sogs yon tan gyi 'byor ba tshad med pas mtho ba zhig byung / 'bri klog dka' ba med par mkhyen/ rdo bla mkhas grub chen po 'jigs med skal bzang gis dpal dge bsam gtan phun tshogs kyi sprul pa'i skur ngos bzung zhing / grub pa'i dbang phyug 'jigs med phrin las 'od zer la'ang de tshun gyi rgyu mtshan zhus pas/ khong gi zhal nas/453

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/de khyed kyis ngos 'dzin byas pa ltar yin nges/ ngas kyang klong chen snying thig gi bstan pa yongs rdzogs dgongs gtad smon lam dang bcas pas de la gtad pa yin cing / o rgyan 'jigs med chos kyi dbang por mtshan gsol ba yin zhes phyi mtha' gzigs pa'i lung bstan bstsal/ de dag la brten nas dpal dge gong ma'i dbon po dkon mchog gis bla brang du spyan drangs te sprul ba'i skur mnga' gsol/ rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pa'i thugs sras 'jigs med rgyal ba'i myu gu zhes 'brel tshad don ldan gyi skyes bu dam pa de las snga phyir klong chen snying thig gi sngon 'gro'i lam khrid kho na'ang tshar nyi shu rtsa lnga gsan cing / khrid sbyang yang de snyed grub par mdzad/ gzhan yang rtsa rlung dang rdzogs chen gyi khrid sogs shin tu smin pa dang / snga 'gyur bka' ma'i skor sogs mang du gsan/ gong smos kyi mkhas pa 'jigs med skal bzang dang kun mkhyen gyi dngos slob rje bla ma 'jigs med ngo mtshar/ rgyal sras gzhan phan mtha' yas sogs las kyang ngal gso skor gsum/spyod 'jug rtsa rgyud gsang ba snying po/ rig gnas skor 'ga' zhig sogs dang / zhe chen dbon sprul mthu stobs rnam rgyal las bka' 'gyur gyi lung dang sgra rig gsan/ gang gsan de dag lan re tsam gyis thags su chud cing / gtso bor bka' bstan 'gyar rib rgyu rimi mi454

dpal sprul rin po che'i rtogs brjod/ pod/ 5ro cog dang kun mkhyen yab sras sa paṇa rje tsong kha pa sogs ris med pa'i skyes chen rnams kyi legs bshad la dpe gzigs kho na rtag 'grus su brtson par mdzad pas nyin re zhing mkhyen rtogs zla ba yar ngo ltar gong 'phel du gyur/ tha na 'jig rten gyi pho sgo'ang 'gran zla med pa zhig ste/ sku na shin tu chung ba'i dus shig dpal dge dbon po la btsan pos gnya' gnon lta ba'i kha mcha zhig phog ra༅ ra ste sde dge'i sku tshab rtsar gtugs sher byas skabs byang sde rdza chu kha tsam na pho rgod ya med du grags pa'i 'bum shul mthu stobs mgon po bya ba de rje 'dis lan gcig ma yin par shags kyis pham par byas nas rgyal kha blangs pas dpal dge dbon po mgu ste sprul sku yin rung min rung lom spyad cig red zer skad/ kun mkhyen mchog sprul rin po che 'jigs med ye shes rdo rje rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa mdzad cing phebs skabs shig rje 'di'i nye skor du byon nas dpal dge zhes bos te/ khyed dpa' snying ci 'dra/bzang na 'dir shog gsungs nas sku rtsar phyin pa dang skra nas bzung ste sa la brdabs shing drud de byon pas mtshams shig na chang gi dri zhig chil gyis byung / der 'o khong gis chang gsol yod pa 'dra grub thob chen po 'di 'dra yang chang bzas 'chol spyod 'di 'dra mdzad pas bcom ldan 'das kyis chang gi nyes dmigs mang 455

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/po bka' stsal pa thog tu babs snyam pa cig byung ba'i rngo/da phyag gis btang ste khyed tsho rtog ge ba bya ba 'di 'dra'i rnam rtog ngan pa 'char ba pha'u/ khyod khyi rgan red ces gdong la zhal mchil btab/mdzu gu chung bstan nas bzhud/ de 'phral ga re nga 'khrul/ de ngo sprod cig yin par 'dug snyam nas lus gnad bcos te bzhugs pas zang thal gyi rig pa nam mkha' g.ya' thag chad pa lta bu zhis / mngon du gyar te sngon nas 'jigs med rgyal ba'i mya guṭa/ rig ngo charano༅ rtsar char spyor yig ༄du yigasprad pa da nam lang ba' stang du nya ma shar ba bzhan sang / phyas su yang khyi rgan zer ba 'di sku phyogs mkhyen brtses nga la gsang ming btags pa yin zhes zhal rtsed gnang / sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pa chen po bsod nams dpal dge'i zhal snga nas dang lhan cig klong snying rtsa rlung gi khrid sbyang shin tu rgyun ring bskyangs/ dpal dge dbon po 'das nas gshegs rjes kyi bya ba rnams rdzogs 'phral bla brang bsdus nas kun spang kun tu rgyu'i tshul gyis gnas nges med du phebs/ rdzogs chen gdan sar yun ring tsam bzhugs/skyabs mgon rdzogs chen rin po che mi 'gyur nam mkha'i rdo rje dang /sku zhabs gzhan phan mtha' yas 'od zer sogs las dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi mtha' yas pa bzhes/ ru dam yang dben gshin rje'i sgrub phug dang tshe ring phug sogs su thugs dam mdzad pas 456

dpal sprul rin po che'i rtogs brjod/ pod/ 5byang chub sems gnyis dang / khyad par rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i gnas lugs kyi rtogs pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa brnyes/klong chen snying thig gi sngon 'gro'i khrid yig chen mo dang theg chen mdo sde mthong ba'i phan yon sogs legs bshad kyi rtsom pa'ang mang du mdzad/ dgung lo sum cu'i nang shed a mdo zhabs dkar ba tshogs drug rang grol gyi snyan pa gsan nas mjal du byon yang /zhabs dkar gshegs tshar ba'i skad cha lam bar du gsan nas gdung dbyangs kyi tshigs bcad mdzad cing gser thal phyogs yar lung padmo bkod du dge mang sku zhabs kyi grwa 'khor gseb tu zhugs nas phebs/ der dge mang rin po ches gsang snying rgyud bshad rgyas par gnang skabs rje 'bis khrid dpon mdzad cing / de rje sa kyang gnas der lo gnyis tsam la zhag zhe lnga re'i ring rgyud bshad shin tu rgyas pa bka' drin du bstsal bas snga 'gyur rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa sprin mthongs kyi nyi zhur tsam gsal bar byung bas/ yul gser stod du snying po'i bstan pa dar/ zhes pa'i lung bstan thog tu khel bar gleng / dbal shul stobs rgyal sogs kyis spyan drangs te dbal shul khag gsum/ gser thal tsho ma lag bco brgyad phal mo che dang bcas pa la spyod 'jug ma ṇi bka' 'bum/ bde smon sogs chos kyi sbyin pa grangs med pa bstsal zhing bde smon dang yi 457

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ge drug ma'i phrin las khyab gdal du spel/ gson rim dang gshin chog la skam lug mang po bsad de dge 'dun la dmar ston byed pa'i srol ngan rgyun bcad cing jag rgya rkun khrims bzhag ste phan bde'i lam srol chen po btod/ rim gyis rdo yul du phebs/shug chung dgon sogs su chos ci rigs bstan/ shug chen stag mgor yun ring bzhugs nas bka' 'gyur rin po che zhib tu gzigs shing bklag pas mdo sde mang po thugs la zin gsungs/ a ri'i nags kyi ljon shing yal 'dab rgyas pa zhig gi drung du zla ba kha shas bzhugs te/ nags tshal sa phyogs dben zhing nyams dga' dang / /zhes pa de 'di 'dra la zer ba yin zhes thugs spro nyams mdzad/ der gzhi chen sprul sku sogs don gnyer can mang po la sems nyid ngal gso dang yon tan mdzod kyi bshad khrid rgyun ring du bskyangs/ 'dzi kar yang phebs te ma ṇi bka' 'bum sogs gsungs shing yig drug gi phrin las rgyas par mdzad/ dzam thang du kun mkhyen dol po'i 'grel pa'i steng nas rgyud bla ma rgyas par bshad cing bsdus don brtsams/ gtsang ba dge slong ngag dbang chos 'byor las sbyor drug gsan/ mi nyag gi yul du byon te 'dra ba dge bshes tshul khrims rnam rgyal la phar phyin skor gyi dri ba mang po zhus pas khyod su yin gang nas 'ong gsungs par/458

dpal sprul rin po che'i rtogs brjod/ pod/ 5 zizungadapal dge zer ba khams rdza chu kha pa zhig yin zhus/ phyir phebs rjes dge bshes chen po des nye gnas la de su yin/ kho dpal dge bya ba yin zer te rgyal khams na yongs su grags pa'i skyes bu dam pa zhig yin pa'i 'os su 'dug gsung skad/ smar khog stod smad mang por yang ma ṇi bka' 'bum gtso bor gyar pa'i dam pa'i ///nye ri bzhuchos — char phab ste ba lang lta bu'i skye bo blun po rnams la'ang thar pa dang thams cad marṣa pa'i sa bon bskrun/ dad pa dang snying rje chung ba dkar phyogs la sdang zhing sdig la mdzem med du spyod pa'i mi dpon dang jag dpon nga rgyal can shin tu gdul dka' ba rnams kyang snying rje'i dka' thub grub pa'i gsung gi mtshams las 'da' bar ma nus te rkun rgya jag khrims dang rngon pa mang po'i sdig 'phro gcod pa sogs kyi sgo nas yul khams dkar por bsgyur/smar rong gi yul mtha' sngon chad yig drug 'don pa lta ci bsgrang phreng lag tu 'dzin srol tsam yang gtan med pa'i phyogs sogs su'ang chos bstan te ma ṇi 'don pa'i srol lam po che bzhin du yangs por btod pa sa mtshon gdul dka' 'dul ba'i phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab/ slar yang rdo yul du byon nas dhi chung phug tu bzhugs skabs sku zhabs mkho brtse rin po che sgar pa dar rtse mdo phyogs nas btegs te gnyan po g.yu rtse'i gnas mdun sngo mtsho'i 459

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/khar phebs pa gsan nas der ched gtad kyis byon/ sku zhabs kyang shin tu dgyes nas chos kyi gsung gleng mang du mdzad/ mkha' 'gro bde chen rgyal mo'i dbang zhig gnang bar zhus pas/ de ngas gsang rgyas btab nas su la'ang ma byin par lo mang song ba yin te/da res khyod la ster zhes dgyes bzhin gnang / lo brgyad cur 'tsho ba'i lung bstan dang 'brel tshad don ldan gyi dbugs dbyung sogs phyi nang gsang ba'i bka' lung mang po thob nas slar yang rdo yul du phyag phebs/ stod smad phan tshun gyi sa'i cha du mar spyod 'jug gtso bor gyur pa'i chos sbyin bkyes/ de nas mi ring bar stod phyogs su zhabs pad bkod/ rdzogs chen dgon seng ge ri'i chos grwa dang pad ma'i thang dang nags chung ma'i ri khrod sogs su mngon rtogs rgyan dang / rtsa ba shes rab/ mdo sde rgyan/ mngon pa mdzod/ sgyu 'phrul gsang snying / yon tan mdzod/ sdom gsum rnam nges sogs mang du bshad/ lo snga phyi du mar spyod 'jug gsung skabs phyogs der me tog gser chen 'dab ma sum cu dang lnga bcu yod pa sogs sngar med mang du skyes pa la spyod 'jug me tog tu grags pa byung / mngon rtogs rgyan la legs bshad gser phreng gi rjes su 'brang ba'i sgom rim brtsam pa phyis su rje mi pham pas 'di las ngo mtshar che ba ma mthong zhes ched du bsngags /460

dpal sprul rin po che'i rtogs brjod/ pod/ 5mkhan po shes rab bzang po las rab tu byung ste mtshan 'jigs med dge ba'i 'byung gnas su gsol/ sde dge lha sras 'chi med rtag pa'i rdo rje sku mched nyag sked pa'i 'og nas thar te rgyal sar 'khod dus rdzogs chen bla brang nas gdan zhus dga' ston phul/de skabs rje 'dis kyang bzang po spyod pa'i chos 'brel dgyes bzhin gnang / 'di dus mchog gyur bde chen gling pa'ang rdzogs dgon du byon te ru dam gangs khrod nas bde mchog sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor gyi gter kha bzhes/ chos skor de dang rigs gsum snying thig sogs kyi chos bdag tu ngos 'dzin gnang ba ltar rje 'dis kyang thugs dad chen pos dbang lung khrid gsum yongs rdzogs mnog chos su gsan/ slar yang dge 'dun tshogs mang la dgongs 'dus sgrub thabs skor gyi lung gnang bar rje 'dis gsol ba btab nas de bzhin bstsal ba mjug rdzogs mtshams su gsung mthon pos 'o de ring rang re rnams kyis gter ston sangs rgyas gling pa'i mdun nas bla ma dgongs 'dus thob pa'i skal bzang byung ba red pas kun gyis bsnyen sgrub re gyis/ zhes gsungs/ ka thog rdo rje gdan du'ang zhabs kyis bcags te/dam gtsang byams gsum gyi gdung 'bum la phyag skor mang du mdzad cing / si tu mchog sprul dam pa chos kyi blo gros sogs kyis 461

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gsol ba btab pa ltar/ gtsug lag khang chen mo'i 'dus sde yongs la spyod 'jug rgyas par gsungs/ zhing skyong rin po ches kyang chos thun gcig tsam gsan/ dge rtse ser shul dgon dang /lab khri 'du dgon/ cha hor dgon sogs ri bo dge ldan pa'i ༄dgon chen mang por byon nas spyod 'jug sogs kyi bshad pa rgya cher bstsal/ de dag gi tshe yang gsar rnying gi grub mtha'i phyogs 'dzin dang / dgag bzhag gi zer mchu rang bstod gzhan smod sogs skabs su ma babs pa dang / dus kyi dbang las chags sdang gi rgyur 'gro ba'i gtam rnams cha shas tsam yang ma 'dres par 'grel pa mkhan su'i lugs ltar bshad pa de dang de'i rang bzhed kha gtsang / gsal zhing dag la zur phyin pa/ don gyi gnad thog tu 'dril zhing / ha cang rgyas bsdus kyi mthar ma lhung ba nyams len gyi steng du bskor nas gsungs pas lha ldan smon lam rab 'byams pa mang pos kyang yi rang gi me tog 'thor zhing gus pas btud/ hor khang gsar skyabs mgon byon nas gdol pa'i drang srong gi gtam du grags pa/ gang gis khams gsum khams zas su//zhes pa'i dbu can de bshad khrid kyi lugs su gsung bar zhus pas spyi don bkod nas bkral te gsungs/ 'dan padma ri mtho'i shel dkar phug tu rgyang tsam bzhugs skabs sde dge'i gzim dpon 462

dpal sprul rin po che'i rtogs brjod/ pod/ 5dkubakra shis dge legs kyis zhus ngor lha chos dang mthun pa'i gtam padma'i tshal gyi zlos gar zhes bya ba'i ya mtshan can de dang / sku zhabs mkhyen brtse'i gsol 'debs chen mo bkra shis dge legs mdzad/ phyis su gtso bor bla ma spyan ras gzigs kyi gdan sa rdza rgyal dgon gyi nye skor nyid du bzhugs shing byams chos dang rtsa shes/bud dha pā li ta/ spyod 'jug yon tan mdzod/ bzang spyod bshad pa sogs ci rigs par gnang / sngon dus dpal dge bsam gtan phun sum tshogs kyis rdo 'bum chen mo bzhengs skabs da dung ngas skye ba phyi mar da lta'i 'di las rgya mi chung ba'i rdo 'bum kha gso byed rgyu yin zhes zhal gyis bzhes par grags pa ltar a thub tshong dpon chen po'i rigs las byung ba'i dad ldan 'jam dbyangs blo gros sogs bkas bskul zhing lo bzhi lnga tsam du mchog dman sus dad 'bul che phra byung tshad sngon dus dang mi 'dra bar brtse bzhes mdzad de rdo brkos bzang la mang ba bsogs nas sngon gyi rdo 'bum las kyang rgya che zhing dpangs mtho bas kha gso gnang zhing rdo brkos 'bur thams cad rtsis len zhib gzigs nan tan du mdzad pas shin tu 'byon gtsang spus legs mtha' rgyas su grub/ bka' las rten bzhengs 'di sems can mang po la phan thogs che bar 'dug kyang sa 'bum dang sa sku sogs ni char 463

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/chus 'jig zangs gser sogs las byas pa ni bdag po ngan na chom rkun yang ldang / logs ris dang thang ka yang rkyen khyag chung /gtsug lag khang bzhengs na ni thigs tshag sogs gnyer cag legs po byed pa'i dkon gnyer/ de'i zas gos sgrub rten sogs 'bad rtsol brgya phrag dgos shing / de byas kyang dkon gnyer bzang po yang brgyud mar rnyed dka'/ gsung rten gleg bam yang 'thor brlag chud zos su 'gro sla zhing / spar brko dus spar yig la zhu dag lan dgu re byas kyang da dung mi dag pa mang du snang zer gyi 'dug pas chad lhag 'khrul gsum gyis ma gos pa dka' tshod red/ rdo 'bum 'di ni bzhengs tshar nas dbyar dus thigs tshag dang dgun dus kha ba phyag sprugs phug ron dang byi ba bsrung ba dkon gnyer bsko 'jog sogs gang yang mi dgos/ yig 'bra ༄drug po de ma nor phan chad zhu dag bya mi dgos shing / de rdo brkos mi nag pa rnams kyi'ang blo la yod pas dpe gzhan la mi ltos/ma ṇi 'di sangs rgyas nyid kyis chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong gi nang bcud yig 'bru drug tu bsdus nas byin gyis brlabs pa yin pas rten bzhengs gzhan mang po ni yal ga la 'jus pa dang ngas 'di ni ljon shing gi rtsa ba'i gnad nas bzung ba dang 'dra/ lung pa dmag gis khengs yang 'di la chom rkun yod dogs mi dgos 464

dpal sprul rin po che'i rtogs brjod/ pod/ 5pas mi rabs mang po'i mthar yang gnas chog gna' myi'i kha dngaṭa la/ ma ṇi'i rdo la gdan bting na da gzod gshin rje chos rgyal gyi drung du dge sdig rgya ma la bkyag dus gdan gyi ljid de dge ba'i kha snon la bkyag chog zer/ gang ltar yang 'di la ni 'dzam bu'i chu gser gyi gdan bting yang 'os pa las lhag kyang yin te/'khos kyis mi lcogs/ 'on kyang ngas ni sa chen po 'di rdo gdan la bzhag pa yin zhes ngag yid gnyis kas/ bsngos yod/ nga'i dge ba rgya ma la bkyag na i mi lji snyam zhes gsungs te/ rdo 'bam 'di ni phyi rabs nas phyi rabs sa mthong thos dran reg gi riri bye risi sbyo'agro ba grangs med pa'i don du rje nyid kyi zhal tshabs(su) byin gyis brlabs pa yin par snang ngo/ /rdzogs chen mchog sprul lnga ba dang sku zhabs dge mang mchog sprul/ mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang padma badzra dang / mkhan po dkon mchog 'od zer sogs la gsang snying rgyud bshad gnang skabs rdo ring la rab gnas mdzad du bcugaslar yang rdzong gsar du kun mkhyen bla ma rdo rje 'chang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i zhabs kyi spyan sngar dar nang mdzod dang dngul rta rmig gi zhu rten bcas rab gnas kyi ched du 'phrin gyis gsol 'debs mdzad pas/ chu stod zla ba'i tshes bcur lhag gnas mdzad rgyu'i zhal bzhes gnang ba ltar du sa tshod de nas 465

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/brtsams pa'i nyin zhag gsum tsam gyi ring rdo 'bum gyi steng shod bar gsum yongs rdzogs lhag par gnas pa'i me tog gis khyab pa'i ngo mtshar bstan/ de dang lhag par lce btsun snying thig gzigs pa sogs kyis thugs drangs te/ dil sprul tshang 'di ni rgya gar gyi grub chen lta bu'i tshod du 'du shes dang / slob ma mang po la'ang / khong kun mkhyen klong chen pa dngos rang yin tshod red/da lta sa steng na khong che/ de'i zhal gcig mthong na khyed tsho'i dpral ba na mig cig yod pa de la don 'bras byung ba yin zhes sogs lan cig min par bsngags/ slad nas zhabs brtan gyi tshigs bcad tshe dpag med kyi sku rten dang sbrag pa lan mang du phul ba'i nang nas/ rgyal ba'i rgyal tshabs rig 'dzin bla ma mchog ces pa'i dbu can sogs zhabs brtan tshigs bcad re zung da lta'ang bka' 'bum gyi khrod na snang / 'jigs med rgyal ba'i myu gur rdza khra ma bla ma zhes bzhugs gnas las mtshan chags pa'i khra ma lung du dge mang rje dbon rin po che bstan 'dzin nor bu sogs snod ldan mchog gi 'khor 'ga' zhig dang lhan cig 'khor 'das ru shan nas bzung rdzogs chen thun min gyi sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi khregs chod thod rgal yongs rdzogs kyi myong khrid shin tu smin par mdzad pa dang sbrag nas rje rang gis kyang khrid sbyang yun 466

dpal sprul rin po che'i rtogs brjod/ pod/ 5ring du gnang / dge mang dbon rin po che'i zhal nas/ sngon chad nged tshos rdzogs chen go lo thos lo dang bshad mdog byas tshad tshig spyi yam me ba tsam las cher shes pa ma byung / khra ma lung du nyams khrid bka' drin bskyang ba nas bzung chos 'di la go rtogs mthil phyin pa zhig thob snyam byang gsangs/ rdzogs chen gyi lam ra dbyisgrub pa po gnyis las rig pa rang snang gi blo can yin yang brtul zhugs ru shan gyi spyod pa dang mos gus bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang sbrel nas nyams su blang na bogs che bas snga gong ru dam du bzhugs dus kyang gangs khrod dang nye ba'i rdza gseb tu ru shan mdzad par grags shing / phyis sku na ches mthon por phebs dus kyang mtshan mo'i ring klong snying bla ma'i rnal 'byor la thugs dam mdzad de srod dang nam gung gi dus mang por/ rje btsun chen po pad 'byung mkhyen/ zhes gdung dbyangs mdzad pa lcang ma lung du sdod skabs bdag cag gis kyang mngon sum du gyur/ bsgrubs 'bras kyi gtso bo ni bsgoms rtags nyon mongs chung ba zhes grags pa ltar/ smyo shul lung rtogs zhabs pad yun ring du bsten pa'i thugs zin gyi slob ma yin pas lan cig khong la/ khyod bla ma su la gsol ba 'debs kyin yod gsungs par/ gsol 'debs kyang cher mi thub 'dug zhus pas/ mi thub dus der zad thub dus su 467

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/la 'debs gsungs/ der 'jigs bzhin du/ khyed la gsol ba re 'debs pa yin zhes gcom chung ngus zhus pas/ rgyal khams na bla ma 'di'i mang nyung la nga la gsol ba 'debs pa ci yin gsungs/rang la dge sems skad cig ma re skyes kyang 'o de ci las byung bsam tsa na khyed kyis chos re bshad kyin bsdad pa'i mthu kho na red 'dug pas drin che snyam pa lags zhus pas/ de yin na a tho bden thang da ni gsol ba re btab kyang rung ba 'dra/ nga'i rgyud 'di na nyon mongs pa zer rgyu de tsho gtan nas 'char rgyu mi 'duka ces gsung mthon po byon/ rtag tu rjes su bzung ba'i lhag pa'i lha ni rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs te/ gso rig gi man ngag dwangs ma 'grim pa'i rtsa dgu'i rnam bshad khyad par can cig mdzad pa na man ngag de g.yu thog snying thig gi gsol 'debs bsnyen pa mdzad skabs sman rgyal gu ṇa'i zhabs dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs dbyer med pas dngos su gdams pa tshig zin la thon cing / gzhan du yang / rab dkar ke la sha dpal mdzes pa la/ /baiḍūr thor tshugs bkod dang gang mtshungs pa/ /'jam dpal dpa' bo rjes 'dzin mtshungs med lhas/ /tshe rabs phreng ba rnams su slar yang skyongs/ /zhes gsungs pa 'di 'dra'i rigs mang po zhig snang / de'i phyir sku na shin tu gzhon nu nas ji srid mya ngan 4'u8

dang4la sprul rin po che'i rtogs brjod/ pod/ 5las 'das kyi bar du nyin mtshan rgyun gyi 'khor lo phal che bar 'jam dpal mtshan brjod 'ba' zhig thugs dam gyi mthil du mdzad/ bka' dgongs 'grel gyi chos gang yang gzigs pa tsam gyis don thugs su chud cing / spyod 'jug rtsa ba dang mtshan brjod kyi glegs bam zhig res yod/ res gzhan la gnang nas med/ de tsam ma gtogs 'grel pa dang brjed byang sogs kyi dpe cha shog ldeb gcig dang tha na snag snyug tsam yang tshags mdzad pa med par/ kog de langs na gzhis rdzogs pa/ bya ba de kho nar bzhugs kyang dbu phar mngon pa sogs gzhung gang 'chad rung dpe cha mang po bsdu rtsol dang thugs gsos su gzigs rtog skyor ba'i rigs gang yang mi dgos par ral gri phyung rgyags kyi tshul du thogs pa med par bshad pas chog pa yang 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyis mchog sbyin pa'i byin rlabs kyi cha shas zhig tu mngon/ru dam gshin rje'i sgrub phug 'og mar rje bla ma nyid bzhugs shing /phag pa gong mar rgyal mo rong pa'i chos pa glen ne ba zhig yod ༄skabs/ nyin gcig rje'i zhal nas/ 'di ltar dben pa'i gnas su dge sbyor byas te bsdad na rnam g.yeng med cing rig pa ngang gis dwangs pas sngon gnas rjes dran sogs 'ong ba la yang tshegs med/ khyod la de 'dra cang e byung gsungs par/ khos ci yang ma 469

casadzin/ yini 1rdo ༷/ngas 65:ngeb/ba/ cesacan ngasabastazug rtanacirdo pa/ba/papa ngu'idra/ca// stanabyung zer/ ngas ni res 'ga' snga ma'i tshe rabs brgya phrag lhag pa/ yang dran par byung / sngon dus grub chen nag po spyod pa grong khyer du byon dus shig nga rang grong khyer gyi smad 'tshong mar gyur pas gser gyi gdu bu zhig phul ba de tshun chad du blun rmongs phag thomyo/ lta bur nam yang ma skyes pa zhig kyang dran gsungs skad/ 'di ltar mngon par shes pa mnga' ba'i gsung sgros su gtogs pa gzhan yang rdo stod kyi sa'i cha dhi chung phug tu bzhugs dus zhig/bod chung rta shul gyi rgad po zhig tshong la 'gro ba'i lam du chus khyer nas shi ba zla bo rnams kyis ro bkal nas phug pa dang nye ba'i phyogs su phyin te 'pho ba zhus pas chos zhu mang po dang bcas pas 'pho lung gsungs/ mtshams shig nas rje bla ma nyid rgya cher bzhad de 'pho lung gsungs 'phro lus kyang 'khor rnams kyis mjug rdzogs par bton/ de skabs ci yang ma gsungs/ phyis rdza stod du rgyu zhing bzhud skabs shig 'khor kha cig la de'i lo rgyus gsungs nas/ de dus rgad po shi ba de'i bar srid sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha yul du lha'i byis pa'i gzugs kyis slebs pa zhig mthong nas/mdun der rgad po'i ro mgo se ye re ba 'dug pa de la bltas pas/rgad po se bo 'di'i mgyogs pa la ang snyam nas nga dgod kha shor te pho lung 'don 'phro chad pa zhig byang zhes gsungs pa lta bu ༄470

dpal sprul rin po che'i rtogs brjod/ pod/ 5'ga' re yod tshod 'dug yang sngon nga rang gshin rje'i phug par 'dug skor zhig la gzhan 'ga' res khyod kyi sha mdog sogs la bltas na mdze nad kyi dogs pa zhig 'dug zer/ rang la'ang klu gdon gyi rtags mtshan 'ga' re byung bar/ ratna gling pa'i gter kha'i rta nag de'i bsgom bzlas byas pas rang gi lus las sbrul chen po phyir thon pa ral gris dum bur bcad pa sogs rmi ltas ya mtshan che ba dang bcas zhag bdun kho nas nad de yul bud gsungs/ yang mchog gyar gling pa'i rigs gsum snying thig 'jam ༄dpal rdzogs chen de la ngas bsnyen sgrub cig byas pas de'i gzhung nas bshad pa'i rmi rtags tsho gsal po byung / mchog gyur bde chen gling pa de gter ston bden pa zhig red gsungs pa sogs las dpag na bsnyen sgrub kyi rigs gzhan yang mang po mdzad yod tshod snang yang phyir mi mngon pas shes dka'/ dus nam yang byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems kho na thugs dam dge sbyor thams cad kyi rtsa bar 'dzin cing / skye bo mchog dman thams cad la bsam pa bzang po bzang po gyis 'di las gal che ba med gsungs/bsnyen sgrub byed pa kun la yang / sde snod mang po shes pa dang /stong pa nyid kyi lta ba'i phyogs mthong yod pa dang / lha bsgom sngags bzlas kyis lo zla mang po phul ba sogs kyang ba sam pa ngan 471

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/pa'i dbang gis gdug 'drer skyes pa mang / snying rje yi dam gyi mthil por 'dzin pa la gdug 'drer skyes pa gcig kyang mi srid pas 'di kho na gad med g.yang med kyi chos yin gsungs/ ming gnang bar zhu mkhan tshor yang snying rje thog mar sbyar nas btags snang / bcom ldan 'das kyis mdo sde las de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung rabs ni legs par ma bklags pa'i nyes pas nub tshul gsungs pa thugs la bzhag nas rtag tu dam pa'i— chos 'chad nyan gyi bya ba la gces spras mdzad cing / gzhan nyan bshad byed pa kun la yang dgyes pa tshad med 'byang / chos gang gsung yang 1)/rdo //khro/ riring //rngo/ //bye/ ///rdomakhas ma — spros pa gang mang tsam na par gdul bya blo da dang bstun nas phan gang che mdzad pas/ mkhas pas brtags na don bzang ba/ blun pos nyan yang go sla ba/ gnad 'dum la 'dzin bde ba/ ran la 'brel chags pa/ snyan la ro nyams dang ldan pa/ 'jam rtsub ji ltar bshad kyang gdam ngag gi ro gcig tu mthun par 'byung bas mkhas rmongs bar ma'i skye bo mtha' dag gi yid 'phrogs pa yod/ rdza khog ga shed 'dre ngan khog brlam gyi smyon pa gnyis yid gcug pa'i gleng mo mang du byed kyin 'dug par gzhan cig gis ci yin dris pas rdza stod du dpal sprul tshang gis spyod 'jug bshad dus par ma zer ba'i lung pa de'i mdo yan chad 472

dpal sprul rin po che'i rtogs brjod/ pod/ 5gang ba'i lha 'dre'i khrom tshogs kyis chos zhus/ de dus nged gnyis grogs mched du gyur pas ngo shes kyi skad cha lab pa yin zer bas mtshon chos sbyin gyis bsdus shing bskyang ba'i mi min gyi 'jig rten yang tshad med pa zhig yod par mngon/ sngon dus mtshan nyid kyi chos grwa che ba 'dra ma gtogs gzhan du spyod 'jug sogs mtshan tsam las don shes pa lta ci/ glegs bam 'chang ba tsam yang dkon pa las slad nas rje bla ma 'di kho na'i drin gyis stod smad bar gsum kun tu spyod 'jug dang byams chos/ sdom gsum /yon tan mdzod sogs kyi 'chad nyan sa lang rdo lang du dar zhing btsun chung lo bca' bcu pa yan chad kyi nang na spyod 'jug gis mgrin pa brgyan pa ches mang du thon pa dang / rgyu mtshan des theg pa chen po'i lam gyi lus yongs rdzogs las dang po pa'i dus nas nyams su len pa'i rim pa la blo kha legs par phyogs nas phyogs mos byed pa ches mang bas sa 'di dpal yon ldan par gyur pa dang / gsang sngags rnying ma'i bskyed rdzogs rdzogs pa chen po'i bstan pa spyi'i sgrom chu 'go gangs la thug pa lta bu sgyu 'phral gsang //sne/ /trore///bye(/rdo/khro /bye/mi riring (nga yin yang nu sa rgyun phal ra nub la nye ba yang bdag tsho nyid chen po dge mang gzhan phan mtha' yas dang dam pa 'di gnyis kyi drin las da lta'i bar du ma nub par bzhugs pa dang /473

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/theg mchog bstan pa'i yang rtse 'od gsal rdo rje rtse mo'i ring lugs kyang blun sgom yid dpyod kyi dri mas mang du bslad de gser la g.ya' zhugs pa lta bur gyur pa rje btsun 'dis kun mkhyen dri med 'od zer yab sras kyi legs bshad la brten nas byi dor mdzad de kun bzang dgongs pa'i gnad gsang gsal bar mdzad pa'i bka' drin gyi bdud rtsi nod de ri sul du grub thob gong ma'i lugs bzhin rdzogs chen sgom pa'i rnal 'byor pa mang du byung ba dang / 'jig rten mi nag gi skye bo pho mo rnams kyang spyod 'jug bshad pa'i chos gral du bag tsam re nyan pas theg pa chen po'i chos kyi srog rtsa bsam pa bzang po byang chab kyi sems yin pa'i ༄'gro phyogs shes shing / bde smon gsungs pa rnams thos nas bde ba can du smon lam 'debs pa dang / sangs rgyas 'od dpag med kyi mtshan brgya stong khri 'bum sogs brjod pa la yi dam nar mar 'dzin pa dang / stobs bzhis sdig pa sbyong ba'i thabs kyi sgo mthong nas de la nan tan byed pa sogs dbyar gyi rtsi shing ltar mang ba byung bas snyigs las cher snyigs pa'i skal ngan gyi mun rum stug po'i khrod du bstan 'dzin dam pa'i zla ba snying rje'i gzi brjid can 'di lta bus rjes su bzung ba ni dus mtha'i 'gro ba rnams bsod nams kyi bgo skal mi dman par snang ngo/ /dgung grangs 474

dpal sprul rin po che'i rtogs brjod/ pod/ 5bdun cu skor zhig la rdza stod ma mo'i thang du khrom tshogs stong phrag kha shas 'dus par bde smon gyi khrid rgyas par bstsal/ de phyin chad chos cher ma gsungs shing chos zhur 'ong ba rnams dbon rin po che bstan 'dzin nor ba sogs kyi drung du gtong / nan bskyed ༄de gdams ngag zhu ba phal cher la bka' bkyon gnang / su la ci tsam bkyon yang phyi phyir dad gus je 'phel du 'gro ba ma gtogs mi mthun par 'dzin pa su yang med pas rje nyid kyi gsung las/dben pa'i rnal 'byor smyon pa rgyal khams kyi gces phrug /lhag bsam byang sems 'byor ba 'gro kun gyi skyabs mgon/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar sems can thams cad dang ma bzhin du mthun/spyir gyong tshig 'jigs la zil che ba gnang yang chags sdang sogs kyi gtam dang yong ye mi 'dre zhing brtags shes na dngos sam brgyud nas gdams ngag 'ba' zhig tu yod/ gang gsung thams cad bden zhing ngo lkog med la zol zog gi lhad dang gtan mi 'grogs pa'i rin chen gser ltar btsun pa kho nar gnas pas mchog dman thams cad kyis tshad mar rtsi/ mthon po la ngo srung sems 'dzin dang dman pa la brnyas bcos khyad gsod mi mdzad par chos 'gal sus byed kyang bcos su mi rung ba'i gshis ngan du gzigs na ma gtogs mtshang nas rgol zhing chos bzhin spyod pa 475

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rnams la gzengs bstod dbugs dbyung mdzad/ bsnyen par dka' ba ltar snang yang drung du ci tsam 'grogs kyang phyogs 'dzin re dogs 'gyur ldog 'gal 'dzol sogs thengs gcig kyang yong mi srid par 'dres rtag la 'grogs bde ba bag yangs shing legs nyes thams cad bzod pa'i ngang tshul can yin pas 'bral mi phod pa 'ba' zhig 'ong / bsam spyod g.yo sgyu khram gsum la goms pa'i byi la'i brtul zhugs can rnams la gting nas mi mnyes shing rje nyid g.yo med drang por gsung ba'i ngang tshul las nam yang mi 'da' ba gong smros ltar bzhugs kyang thugs kyi gting sus kyang dpog par dka' ba'i rgya mtsho ltar zab cing sgam pa'ang yin pa dang / 'jig rten ya rabs kyi spyod tshul nas bzo dang las kyi gnas phra mo yan chad kyi rgyus zhib mor 'byed pa'i blo gros ku sha'i rtse ltar ma 'dres pa mnga' yang gang la'ang ched 'dzin rtsis gdab mi mdzad par ltos med bag yangs su spyod pa'i bya btang gi rgyal por bzhugs/ rang nyid kyi bka' las/ brjod gzhi med pa'i stong skad bstod ra gcig /phan pa med pa'i che bkyag bkur sti gnyis/ /rnam smin lci ba'i dad rdzas 'bul nor gsum/ /spangs nas khyi rgan khyi bzhin 'chi nus shog /ces phebs pa ltar nga rgyal dang che tshugs bshig cing gsol zhal dang 'phral 'tsho tsam gyi zas 476

dpal sprul rin po che'i rtogs brjod/ pod/ 5gos ma gtogs mnga' thang gi zin byin mchil ma'i thal ba ltar bor te gdol pa'i byis pa srang mdo na rgyu ba lta bu'i kun spyod kyis bzhugs kyang thugs brtan cing sgam la chos kyi gzi byin mtshungs pa med pa'i che bas stobs 'byor gyi dregs pa'i bla dpon che dgu sogs kyang zil gyis mnan nas thams cad kyis gdong smad de zhum bzhin du btud/ mdor na gser sa 'og tu yod na 'od nam mkha' la 'phro ba'i dpe ltar sku tshe ril po sbas pa'i brtul zhugs la bskyal yang ci mdzad thams cad byang chub kyi spyod pa'i mtshams las mi 'da' ba'i shugs kyis gang nas bltas kyang mdzes shing 'tshams pa/ ci tsam brtags kyang dag cing gtsang ba/bsams shing bsam na dad pa 'phel ba'i rnam thar 'ba' zhig can du bzhugs pa/ gzur gnas blo gros dang ldan pa kun gyi mdun sar rlung ltar grags pa yin no/ /sku tshe'i mjug la nye ba na o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa srin yul du bzhud kar zhi khro na rag dong sprugs kyi cho gas bod 'dir sku dngos kyi gdul bya'i 'phro rdzogs par mdzad pa bzhin bla ma mtshams pa rin po che'i sku gdung gi drung du dong sprugs kyi sgrub mchod lo lnga'i bar rgyun chags su mdzad de gdul bya dpag tu med pa'i srid pa'i rgya mtsho gting sprugs/ rab tshes thams cad 'dul zhes pa me phag gi lo'i stod 477

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/la sku khams cung zad rnyog tshul bstan/ de skabs ma 'ongs lung bstan sogs gzigs snang gi 'char sgo mtha' yas pa'i gsung gi dbyibs dod kyang sngar dus de 'dra zhu ba la mi mnyes pa'i dbang gis sus bka' 'dri zhu bar ma spobs/ gna' dus spyod 'jug gsung ba'i zhor du bde ba can gyi zhing gi che ba bshad pa'i 'phros shig tu/ dag pa'i zhing khams yon tan mtha' yas pa dang smon lam btab na skye sla ba gnyis 'dzoms pa zhig la shar phyogs mngon par dga' ba 'gran zla med/ de'i 'og na bde ba can khyad par du 'phags zhes gsungs shing / de rjes zhabs 'bam gyi bsnyung g.yog la gling bla'i dbon po 'jam dpal zer ba'i sman pa de sdod skabs/ lan cig khong gis a ba tshang gi snga phyi'i gsang sgros gang rig mi rir mil bsam kyang nged rang tshos tshes phyi ma'i don du smon lam 'debs pa de nub phyogs bde ba can kho na la mthil gtad na snyam pa de ltar lags sam zhus pas/ cung zad bzhugs nas/ 'o khyod nub nga shar red pa zhes bka' bstsal/ mthar bsnyun tshul bstan skabs 'dir yang nyin mo'i res shig cung zad gzim la yur ba ltar mdzad rjes/ da res nga gnyid du song ba'i rmi lam na/ bande 'dra ba gnyis kyis khyod kyi gdul bya shar phyogs na yod zer ba zhig byung / nga 'dra ba la gdul bya dag cang yod dam gsung /478

canang/khub /spru95 ṣṭhasdezug 11 byenge:re shenyatha/thag thabazlejorngasno/ rjesarngan/ sgo 〉07yang sngar dus shig tu nangs gcig nged tshos gzhan la bde smon 'dra ba bshad/ rang gis kyang dag pa'i zhing khams rer smon lam mang po 'debs mdog byas pa yin yang mdang sum tshor ko mo 'o lu na sngar dus bzhin bsdad yod pa'i nying 'khrul kho nas mtshan thog thag yol ba byung / da dung yang der gcig yong dgos pa yin nam zhes kyang gsungs skad/ lo de'i sa ga zla ba'i tshes brgyad nyin sku drang por bsrangs/ phyag mnyam bzhag zhabs rdo rje skyil krung mdzad de 'chi srid rnam par dag pa ka dag gi nang dbyings chen por snyoms par zhugs/ gshegs rjes kyi bya ba rnams dge mang rje dbon rin po che dang thugs zin gyi zham ring ba bsod nams tshe ring sogs kyis mtha' rgyas su bsgrubs/bdag nyid chen po 'di'i slob mar gyur pa ni/ ka thog si tu mchog sprul chos kyi blo gros/ rdzogs chen mchog sprul lnga pa/ rgya rong nam sprul rin po che kun bzang theg mchog rdo rje/ rdzogs chen gling sprul thub bstan rgyal mtshan/ rdo grub yang srid 'jigs med phun tshogs 'byung gnas dang dri med grags pa rnam gnyis/sku zhabs mkhyen brtse'i rigs sras bde chen rig pa'i ral gri/'gro 'dul sems dpa' chen po 'jigs med rgyal ba'i myu gu'i yang srid kun bzang bde chen rdo rje/ sku zhabs dge mang rin po 479

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/che'i mchog sprul gzhan phan chos kyi snang ba/ a 'dzom 'brug pa sprul sku 'gro 'dul rdo rje/ sprul pa'i gter ston las rab gling pa/rig gnas mang po la mkhas pa dbal shul rig bzang dang de'i gcung rdo rje 'dzin pa bsod nams rnam rgyal/ se ra'i grwa sar mkhas grags kyi rgyal mtshan thob pa'i ser shul lha ram pa thub bstan/ dpal spungs bla ma bkra shis 'od zer/ mu ra sprul sku thub bstan chos dpal bzang po/ hor 'ba' phug sprul sku chos dpal rgya mtsho/ sde dge sa dbang sku mched/ 'ju bla ma grags pa rgyal mtshan/ bla sprul chen po'i ming ma btags kyang gzhan phan gyi mdzad pa bzang po can mgo log bla ma 'gyur med dang a bos dge legs dang rdo rgu tshal khrims sogs bgrang gis mi lang ba yod ༄kyang dam pa'i chos nyan bshad kyi phrin las lhag par skyong ba'i slob ma ni mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang ba padma dam chos 'od zer dang /dge mang rje dbon o rgyan bstan 'dzin nor bu/ mkhas grub chen po mi pham rnam rgyal/ rtogs ldan dam pa lung rtogs 'phel rgyas bzang po/ 'dul 'dzin mkhas pa'i dbang phyug thub bstan chos kyi grags pa/ rje mdo sngags rgya mtsho sogs mang du byon te de dag gi drin las mtshungs bral rje btsun mchog gi rnam dkar phrin las kyi 'od snang dbyig 'dzin yangs pa'i rgyan du da lta'ang gnas 480

dpal sprul rin po che'i rtogs brjod/ pod/ 5bzhin pa ste/ da dung yang bskal bzang sgron me lnga ba'i nyin byed kyis 'char ka'i 'od dmar spro ba la phyogs pa'i bar du 'phel rgyas 'byung bar gyur cig gu/ yon tan rgya che dgongs pa shin tu zab/ /sbas pa'i brtul zhugs gzhan gyis mi shigs pa/ /bdag nyid chen po'i rnam thar dpag dka' yang / /phyogs tsam mdzub mos zla ba bzhin du bstan/ /dad pa'i 'bab stegs las 'ong tshig gi chu/ /don bzang rin chen bye ma 'dren pa'i rgyun/ /phab 'dis lus can sdig pa'i dri 'khrud cing / /gtan bde bsil ba'i ngal 'tsho sbyin gyur cig /ces pa'ang mkhas btsun bzang po'i yon tan gyis mngon par phyug pa'i ra hor sprul sku mañdzu'i mtshan can gyis rin po che'i gnang rten dang bcas nan bskul mdzad pa ltar/ rje btsun bla ma mchog de'i bka' 'bangs kyi tha chung 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi mas yid la dran tshad smras rim ltar dkon mchog chos 'phel bzang pos yi ger bris pa dge ba gyur cig mdzad pa'i go rim sogs rang gis ji bzhin ma nges pa'i 'khrul pa mang du yod shas che ba rnam thar la 'dris zhib che ba rnams kyis bcos rogs mdzad na rjes su yi rang ngo// //481

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/༄/ /gtsug lag khang phyag dar gyi gtam bsod nams sprin gyi rnga sgra zhes bya ba bzhugs so//bla ma dang ston pa thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo de yang 'o skol gyi ston pa shākya thub pa'i bka' drin dang / mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi mthu las/ thos bsam sgom pa'i shes rab khyad par can skye ba la phyi nang gi rkyen phal mo che 'dzoms bzhin pa'i gnas skabs su gyur kyang / da dung sa lam gyi rtogs pa bogs mi thon pa'i gnad kyi che shos ni blo las su mi rung bar byed pa 'gal rkyen las ngan pa'i sdig sgrib kho na las yin pas de sbyong byed zhing gi mthu la bsten te tshogs kyi bsags rgyab mang ba zhig gnad du che zhing / de'i tshul ni byang chub sems dpa'i sa dang spyod 'jug la sogs par mtha' yas pa zhig yod pa las/ 'dir jo bo bka' gdams pa'i sbyor chos kyi sdom drug gi thog mar/ gnas khar byi dor bya zhing sku gsung thugs kyi rten dgram pa'i skabs nas 'byung ba ltar phyag dar gyi tshul las brtsams pa'i gtam nyung ngur dril te 'chad pa la/ phan yon 482

gtsug lag khang phyag dar gyi gtam/ pod/ 5bshad pa dang / phyag dar gyi tshul dngos brjod pa ste gnyis las/dang po la'ang phan yon dngos dang / des na tshul 'di la 'bad par bsam pa gnyis las/ /dang po ni/ sngon btsun pa rnam grol sdes 'phags pa byams pa lo bcu bsgrubs kyang ma grub ste/ dpal ldan zla ba la thabs dris pas sdig pa zhi ba'i don du bsregs blugs kyis shig par gdams pa bzhin/ sbyin sreg 'bum phrag mang po bgyis pas nam zhig me thab kyi khung bur byams pa'i zhal bstan par grags pa bzhin/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i phun sum tshogs pa thams cad kyang rang rang gi 'gal rkyen nam zad pa na mngon du 'gyar ba chos nyid yin pas yon tan gyi tshogs rdzogs pa ༄la sgrib sbyang gi thabs mang ba dgos shing / de las stobs bzhi'i bshags pa la sogs pa phung po gsum gyi dge tshogs rlabs po che bsdu ba ni skye bo mkhas shing mdzangs pa rnams kyi yul yin zhing /dngos 'byor gyi mchod pa phal cher yang bsod nams chung ngu'i da ri dra rnams kyi skal bas mi khugs pa dang / log 'tsho dang ser snas ma sbags pa'ang dka' la/ yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod pa la brten nas bsod nams gsog pa ni blo shin tu rtul ba rnams la 'char dka' ba sogs kyi phyir/ bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang lam 483

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dzi chung ba ha cang dbul bar gzigs te/ dge 'dun gyi mchil lham dang lham sgrog gu can rnams byi dor bya ba'i las 'ba' zhig bcol nas rdul spang ngo/ /dri ma bral lo/ /zhes zlos su bcug pas/ sngar oṃ bhu zhes pa'i yig 'bru tsam yang 'dzin mi nus pa la dus der dkon mchog gi zhing la bsten pa'i las dkar po de'i nus pas tshig sde tshan gnyis ka zin te nyin re zhing dge 'dun gyi las kho na bgyis pas ci zhig na 'phags pa'i lam gyis rgyud 'grol ba'i dge rtsa smin te/ rdul 'di sa rdul min te 'dod chags rdul/ /zhes sogs ched du brjod de dgra bcom thob pa ltar/ bya sla zhing sa chod ches gnad zab pa'i tshogs bsags kyi sgo ches che ba ni phyag dar gyi mchod pa'i bsnyen bkur yin te/ 'di ni lus kyi ngal ba tsam la brten pa'i phyir longs spyod kyi she mong dang / dbang thang gi khyad nor sogs dka' ba dang dkon pa'i rgyu tshogs la mi ltos pas bya sla lugs de ltar yin zhing / mu stegs can gyis me lnga bsten pa ltar srid pa'i rtsa ba gcod byed kyi thabs dang ma 'brel ba'i kun spyod ma yin par/ 'di ni slob dpon ma ti tsi tras dkon mchog gi byin rlabs rgyud la 'jug mi 'jug gi phyi rkyen sangs rgyas la sogs pa yod med las min gyi/ nang rkyen rang gi dge ba'i tshogs kyis yul de la bya ba byas ma byas nas yin par 484

gtsug lag khang phyag dar gyi gtam/ pod/ 5bsngags 'os bsngags bstod du gsungs pa bzhin/ rang rgyud kyi srid rtsa ldog pa la kun nyon rmang sgyel gyi thabs de rang dbang du ston pa po sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi bdag rkyen la bsten dgos/ bsten lugs kyang sangs rgyas mthong bas re zhig mi 'dul ba mtshan thos pa la brten nas rim gyis 'dul ba dang /chos thos pas re zhig mi tha la bar ston pa cang mi gsang ba mthong dming nisigi bas 'dul ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi gzugs kyis mi thul gyi rang rgyal gyi gzugs kyis 'dul ba dang / gtam 'bel bas mi thul gyi rdzu 'phrul bstan pas 'dul ba la sogs pa gdul bya'i rigs mi 'dra ba'i dbye ba mtha' med par mdo sde mang po nas gsungs mod/gang ltar yang dngos sam brgyud nas sangs rgyas kyi gdul byar gyur phan chad sngon de bzhin gshegs pa la bya ba byas shing dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa zhig ni ci nas kyang med mi rung du dkon mchog brtsegs pa nas gsungs pa ltar yin pas ston pa sangs rgyas las gdams ngag nod de rnam byang gi yon tan yongs su rdzogs pa'i rten 'brel rgyud la sgrib byed du 'gro ba'i phyir/ sa chod che lugs de ltar yin te/ ne tso mi skad shes pa zhig gis bcom ldan 'das sems dang bas skad snyan pa gcig phyung ba kho nas lhar skyes te ston pa'i spyan sngar bden pa mthong bar las brgya 485

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/par gsungs na/ de las lhag pa'i 'bad rtsol gyi ngal ba dang bcas te zhing khyad par can la bsnyen bkur bgyis pa lta ci smos pa'i phyir ro/ /de'ang las kyi rnam smin che chung dang stobs drag zhan gyi khyad par ni bshes springs las/ rtag dang mngon par zhen dang gnyen po med/ /sogs gsungs pa lta bu ste/ mdor bsdu na/zhing gi mthu che chung dang / bsam pa'i shugs drag zhan dang /sbyor ba'i 'jug pa mchog dman nas yin pas/ 'dir yang zhing khyad par can dkon mchog gsum la bsten pa dang / bsam pa khyad par can mdzod las/ kun slong rnam gnyis rgyu dang ni/ /de yi dus kyi slong zhes bya/ /zhes pa lta bu'i kun slong gnyis po gang rung du don chen po gsum la dmigs pa dang / sbyor ba khyad par can rgyun mi chad pa dang shugs drag pa dang dka' tshegs chen pos bsgrubs pa'i phyir dge ba'i 'gyur tshabs kyang de snyed de snyed kyis shin tu che ba ste/ yul sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi ye shes sgyu ma'i rnam pa bsam gyis mi khyab/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs rgya mtsho bsam gyis mi khyab/ thags rje chen po sam rigapho niring cu rtsa gnyis kyi 'jug pa bsam gyis mi khyab/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i phrin las kyi sgo mo che mtha' yas pa mtha' yas pa skad cig skad cig la ngang gis 'jug pa bzhin du yul can sangs rgyas la 486

gtsug lag khang phyag dar gyi gtam/ pod/ 5dmigs pa'i dad pas bsnyen bkur bgyis pa la'ang bsod nams kyi phang po mtha' med de/ rin chen phreng bar/ sems can khams ༄ni tshad med la/ /phan 'dod de ni de 'dra'o/ /zhes byang chub sems kyi phan yon rigs pas bsgrub sa pa nyid/ sangs rgyas yon tan tshad med la/ /bsnyen bkur de ni de 'dra'o/ /zhes 'don pa bsgyur bas chog pas phyir te/ gnad zab lugs de ltar yin no/ /de'i tshul zhib tu ni bande ye shes sde'i sangs rgyas gtso'i rgya cher 'grel gyi/ bsam mi khyab la dad byas pa'i/ /rnam par smin pa'ang bsam mi khyab/ /ces pa'i 'grel pa dang mdo sde rnams dang bzhi brgya ba'i 'grel pa la sogs par bltas pas shes so/ /phan yon 'thob lugs kyang / sku gzugs dang mchod rten lta bu gcig la dmigs nas mchod pa phul ba bas phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi mchod rten la dmigs pa'i mchod pa bsod nams ches lhag par 'phags pa thogs med zhabs kyis bshad cing / sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam pa nyid kyi tshul rgya mtsho la nges shes ma rnyed par de bzhin gshegs pa gcig la dmigs pa'i mchod pa dang / thams cad la dmigs pa'i mchod pa gnyis kyi yang phyi ma bsod nams che bar paṇa chen mang pos bshad pa ltar yin pas lha rten dang gtsug lag khang nyi tshe ba re la dmigs nas 487

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/phyag dar bgyis pa dang / mchod rten thams cad la dmigs pa'i phyag dar gyi bsnyen bkur gnyis las phyi ma mchog tu bsngags pa dang / sangs rgyas gcig gi ye shes nyid sangs rgyas thams cad kyi de bzhin nyid la zhugs par nges pa ma 'drong ba'i gang zag gis/rgyal ba thams cad la dmigs pa dang / re re la dmigs pa'i phyag dar gyi bsnyen bkur gnyis la yang snga ma ches lhag pa'i phyir 'dun shugs rgya che ba zhig gnad du che la/ des mtshon te khyad par gzhan yang sngar drangs pa'i bshes springs kyi lung las shes par bya'o/ /ston pas kyang rjes 'jug rnams la don de nye bar 'doms pa'i phyir/ khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin nyin re zhing rgyal byed tshal 'phyag tu 'ong ba las/ nyin gcig brel ba zhig byung nas lus pas/ nyi ma shar ba dang ston pa kun dga' ra ba'i sgor 'chags pas rgyal byed tshal rdul gyis gang ba gzigs nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis phal ba'i rtsa mchog gi chan po bsnams rigazi ༄༄ te/ de bzhin gshegs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun dang bcas pas phyag dar mdzad pa yin te/ der ma zad nyin de nyid kyi phyi dro ston pas dge 'dun bsdus te/ phyag dar gyi yon tan lnga bshad par yang gsungs so/ /yon tan lnga ni/ phyag dar byas pas rang gi sems dang ba dang / gzhan gyi sems dang ba 'dren pa dang / lha 488

gtsug lag khang phyag dar gyi gtam/ pod/ 5rnams kyang de la dga' ba dang / mdzes pa'i las gsog pa dang /lus zhig nas bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten du 'gro ba rnams yin te/ bsdu na/ tshe 'di'i yon tan dang / tshe rabs brgyud mar 'thob pa'i yon tan gnyis su phyag dar gyi phan yon thams cad 'du la/ tshe 'dir ni/ 'phral du bde bar 'dod pa'i yon tan dang / yun du don chen 'grub pa'i yon tan gnyis 'byung ste/ dang po ni/ sangs rgyas sam dge 'dun nam bla ma'am mchod rten la sogs pa bsod nams dam pa'i zhing la bsten te dge tshogs rgya chen po yongs su bzlum pa'i mthas chu snod nam ༄shi ri ri zuradwangs pa na zla gzugs shugs la 'char ba ltar dkan mchag ga byin rlabs rgyud la 'jug go/ /de zhugs na dad pa'i nyer len dang tshogs zhing gi lhan cig byed rkyen la brten nas gang zag de la phun tshogs bde ba'i dngos po mtha' yas pa zhig nye bar 'gyur te/ dgra bcom pa mi sdug sngon gyi las dbang gis bsod snyoms bslang ba yang mi rnyed par bkres ltog gi gdungs pa kho nas rtag tu mnar ba las/ nyin gcig des ston pa'i dri gtsang khang phyag dar la zhugs pas/ nyin der bsod snyoms kyi skal ba cher thob/de phan chad du ston pa'i gtsang khang dbyi ba des kho bo'i zas skal gcod pa yin pas las 'di bdag gi skal bar zhog cig ces sgra 489

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bsgrags pa bzhin no/ /de'ang dgra bcom pa ni phyis khams gsum du skye ba mi len pas de 'dra de la ni bsod nams kyi rnam smin yang mthong chos bde bar gnas pa'i rkyen tsam du 'char ba ste/chos mngon par/ dgra bcom pas rgyal ba mchod pa lta bu phyi ma'i bde 'bras kyi slad du ma yin pas ston pa la drin du gzo ba'am byas pa shes pa'i phyir yin no/ /zhes grags pas mtshon la/gzhan ni de dang sgo phyogs re nas 'dra bar zad kyi/ thams cad nas ni ma yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ sems rnyog pa can la bden mthong gi nus pa med pas/ sa ga ma'i bu rnams gsal rgyal gyis bkum pa'i tshe/de dag gi mgo bcad nas sgrom du bcug ste ma'i khyim du bskur ba na/ ston pas/ re zhig sgrom de'i kha ma dbye zhig ces bsgos nas chos bstan pas sa ga mas bden pa mthong ba'i 'og tu gdod sgrom dbye bar gnang ba bzhin/ 'tshig pa dang mngon par mi dga' ba la sogs pas sems ma dkrugs pa rnams la tshul bzhin yid la byed pa 'char sla zhing / phyag dar ni sems dang ba'i rnam pa dang mthun pa nyid kyi phyir chos kyi dga' ba 'dren pa dang / der yang ma zad de phyag dar gyi cho gas rgyal ba sras bcas la bsti stangs bgyis pa'i mthu las dkon mchog gi byin rlabs sems la 'jug 490

gtsug lag khang phyag dar gyi gtam/ pod/ 5pas bsam bsgom la myong ba khyad par can 'don nus pa'ang yin no/ /tshe rabs brgyud mar 'thob pa ni/ nyi tshe ba'i dmyal ba phal mo che dang de ma yin pa'i dmyal ba'i rigs mang po zhig dge 'dun gyi gtsug lag khang 'dral ba dang smod pa dang ngan skyugs mchil snabs dor ba dang / rang dgar spyad pa la sogs pa'i rnam smin du gsungs pa ltar/ de nyid 'don pa bsgyur ba las dkon mchog gsum la gus pa nye bar bzhag ste/ dge 'dun gyi gtsug lag khang ngam/ mchod rten gyi nye 'khor dang / bla ma'i gnas gzhi sogs phyag dar byas pa dang / chag chag btab pa dang / bag yod pa'i sems kyis bkur snyir bgyis pas kyang mtho ris kyi grong khyer bde zhing mi mthun pa med pa rnams su skyes te/'dug na nyams dga' ba'i pho brang / gzhal med khang shin tu bde ba dang / 'gro na yid du mchi ba'i lam srang rin po che bkod pa'i ngo mtshar du ma dang ldan par 'gyur ba la sogs pa phan yon gyi sgo 'phar mang po zhig mtshon nus te/ za ma tog lta ba'i gtam ༄las/ mchod rten gdung bcas gtsug lag khang / /mi gang 'bad pas nyen kor 'phyag /kun nas dri ma med byed pa/ /gser gyi kha dog 'dra bar 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /gong du smos pa'i phyag dar gyi yon tan bzhi pa'i steng nas bsngags pa brjod de gsungs pa 491

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/'dis yon tan lnga pa'ang mtshon nus so/ /slob dpon ye shes rdo rjes de nyid mthong ba'i lam las kyang / ba lci chur bcas sbyin pa 0 ste/ /sogs maṇḍal byi dor byas pa dang ba byung gis chag chag btab pa la sogs pa pha rol phyin drug dang sbyar te/ de'i mthus gnas skabs su kha dog gser du snang zhing nad med la tshe rabs mang por rgyal po'i rigs nor mang po'i khyim du skye ba dang mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa 'grub par yang gsungs te/ marṇal de ni 'phags yul gyi slob dpon mi pham bshes gnyen ḍagyi 'jam dpal mchod chog tu bshad pa lta bu'i sangs rgyas sras bcas gang du spyan 'dren pa'i mchod stegs yin pas/ de ni 'dir yang dkon mchog gsum dngos sam de'i rten gsum gyi gnas gtsug lag khang kun la rigs pa sbyar du yod mod/ 'on kyang de nyid phyag dar bya ba dang / spos chus 'debs pa la sogs pa phyin drug gi ya gyal du 'gro ba dang / zhing khams rnam dag gi sbyong byed du 'gro ba ni sems bskyed kyis ma zin na gtan med pas/'jam dpal zhing bkod las/ mtshan rab sum cu rtsa gnyis brgyan pa'i sku/ /bde gshegs 'gyur bar su dag 'dod pa dag /snying la rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems zhog ste/ /mchod pa'i phyir ni de yi thad du song / /zhes rkang pa dang po gnyis kyi bstan don de 492

ba/rbetsub/ khukhuspa/ /basprang /grob/ rngasnozang /) ba//stozug/ 11rngan/ pa/ ri rkang pa bzhi pa'i bstan don rkyang ba tsam gyis mi 'grub pas/ rkang pa gsum pas khyad par can gyi sgra sbyar ba ltar 'dir yang 'dra'o// 'o na theg chen pa dang thun mong gi phyag dar gyi phan yon ci 'dra zhig ce na/ de ni sngar yang bshad zin te/ mdor na theg pa dman pa'i sems kyis bsod nams ci tsam zhig bsags kyang rang 'bras nyan rang gi dgra bcom gang rung las 'gro sa med pas tshe dang ldan pa bran bu dang skyong ba gnyis la phyag dar gyi bdag rkyen las ci tsam thob pa'i yon tan de las lhag pa zhig dman lam pa la 'thob tu med par mthong ngo/ /de'i gtam ni/ mtha' 'khob ke ra'i rgyal pos ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal la khye'u gnyis skyes su bskur te/ g.yos la mkhas pa bran bu dang /gnas mal gyi las la mkhas pa skyong ba gnyis so/ /de dag zas la brkam drags pas tshong dus kyi zas sna rnams kyang byung rgyal du spyad pas skye bo rnams 'phya zhing smod do/ /nam zhig de gnyis las gcig ni las 'bras la log par lta/ gcig ni 'phags pa la skur ba 'debs pa yin pas gsal rgyal gyi zhabs ring ba gnyis ni lta ba ngan pa can no zhes phyogs dang phyogs mtshams su sgra rnam par grags pa rgyal pos ma bzod pa dang / khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi khyu mchog gi tshig bgam pa'i phyir de gnyis khyim 493
