pod / 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bdag la byin no/ /des de dag bags kyis bskyangs nas nyin gcig rgyal byed tshal 'phyag tu btang ba dang / de dag gis de 'phyag par brtsam pa na ston pas rdul gyi phung po de mi 'dzad par byin gyis rlabs pa dang / de gnyis jo bo la snying nye bas skyo bzhin du ma btang ngo/ /de ltar nyin mo de phyag dar gyis 'das par byas nas mtshan thog thag kun dga' bo'i drung du nyal bas/ ston pa'i spyan sngar lha rdzu 'phrul can dang dgra bcom pa cho 'phrul gyis rtse ba mthong nas log lta ma lus pa zhig ste/ rab tu byung nas lam bsgoms pas dgra bcom pa thob/ khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi khyim du rdzu 'phrul gyi rnam rol bstan pa mthong nas/ ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal kyang lhag par dad de/ kye ma'o sangs rgyas/kye ma'o legs par gsung ba'i chos 'dul ba/ bran bu dang skyong ba sdig pa'i lta ba can de dag kyang go 'phang mthon po 'di lta bu la bzhag par gyur to zhes ched du brjod do/ /de ltar spyir btang du yang phyag dar gyi mchod pa la bsod nams tshad med par gsungs na/ deng sang bstan pa lnga brgya phrag tha la shin tu nye ba'i dus kyi rgud pa du mas gtser zhing / ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan can phal mo che yang dge 'dun gyi gtsug lag khang mthong na gzi byin gang che/ yul dbus 'gyur 'chang gi bzo sku mthong na rin thang 494

gtsug lag khang phyag dar gyi gtam/ ri pod/ 5gang mang / gsung rab kyi glegs bam mthong na rkyen sel gang bzang la dpyad pa 'jug pa'i gnas skabs 'dir ston pa dang bstan pa la rgyu mtshan shes pa'i dad pas bsnyen bkur chung ngu tsam zhi ga byas kyang bsod nams shin tu mang bar 'phel ba ni ting 'dzin rgyal por bskal pa grangs med par sangs rgyas gaṅga'i rdul snyed mchod pa bas kyang dam pa'i chos 'jig pa la nye ba 'i tshe nyin mtshan gcig tu bslab pa sna gcig bsrung ba ches khyad par 'phags pa'i bsngags brjod mdzad pa bzhon no/ /gal te sngar bshad pa'i gtam gyi rabs de dag ni bcom ldan 'das mngon sum du bzhugs dus kyi dbang du byas pa sha stag yin pas da lta mi mtshangs so zhe na/ shin tu mtshangs te/ mchod rten bskor ba'i riring rig miphan yon las/ da lta nga la mchod pa dang / /ma 'ongs ring bsrel mchod pa gnyis/ /bsod nams mnyam zhing rnam smin mnyam/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dang / khyad par theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i mdo sde ltar bshad na/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams ni smon lam gyi mtha' nyi tshe ba dang ldan pa ma yin te/ ji tsam las dang nyon mongs mthar gyur pa/ /bdag gi smon lam mtha' yang de tsam mo/ /zhes yun ring po nas kun tu bzang po'i smon lam shin tu tshad med pas nges par 'byung ba nyid kyi phyir/ de ni sngar zhig — 495

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/'jig rten na byung gis da lta med do zhes bsam par mi nus pa'i phyir dang / ston pa da lta mi bzhugs so zhes bya ba'ang chos kyi sku la bya na ni thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes rgyun chad par sus kyang smra mi nus la/ gzugs kyi sku la bya na yang longs sku ni mya ngan las 'da' ba med de/ nges pa lnga ldan chen po'i tshul gser 'od dam pa la sogs par bshad pa bzhin yin la/ sprul sku mya ngan las 'das so zhes zer na ni mi rigs te/ bdag cag gi ston pa nyid kyang 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan dang gzhan na bcom ldan 'das chos 'phags bskal pa grangs med phrag bdun brgyar bzhugs pa sogs cho 'phrul sprul ba'i sgyu ma mtha' gcig tu ma nges par ston tshul mdo sde mang po nas bshad pa'i phyir dang / zhing khams gcig po 'di'i dbang du byas so zhes kyang mtha' gcig tu smra mi nus te/ 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor gcig na yang sems can la las ni ston pa sangs rgyas nas lo gcig lon pa tsam du shes pa dang / kha cig ni bskal pa gcig tsam du shes pa dang / 'ga' zhig ni dang po lhums su zhugs pa tsam du shes pa sogs snang tshul tshad med pa zhig 'ong bar mdo sde las bshad pas zhing 'di nyid na'ang da lta bcom ldan 'das bzhugs par shes pa'i sems can mtha' yas pa yod na/ rnam 'grel las ma mthong phyir na med pa 496

gtsug lag khang phyag dar gyi gtam/ pod/ 5min/ /gsungs pa ltar byis pa'i blo gros kyis bab col smra bar mi bya'o/ /des na da lta nga la zhes sogs ma 'ongs pa na ston pa nyid mi bzhugs pa ltar bstan pa rnams kyang sems can phal mo che'i bsam pa'i dbang nye bar bzung nas bshad pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ blo sbyong gi nyams len la brtson 'grus skyed pa rnams kyang gong du smos pa ltar rang gi sems dang ba dang / tshogs zhing la bsnyen bkur bya ba'i phyir yon tan dran pa'i sgo nas chos 'di nyid la thog mar bslab par bya ste/ de'ang skye bo phal cher zhig gdol pa'i kun spyod la 'thas te gtsang sbra dang maṇḍal la sogs pa'i cho ga la bla mar mi byed pa yin te/ de 'dra ba dag gis ni phyag dar dang chag chag bya ba la lhur len cher ma bgyis kyang mi rung ba med de/ ma hā tsi na la sogs pa'i yul gru 'ga' zhig stan las ldang ba la sri zhur byed cing / 'dug pa la ma yin pa dang / kha cig tu 'khum ste sdod pa la sri zhur byed kyi ldang ba la ma yin pa la sogs pa khyad par mang zhing / ston pas kyang ma ghadha la sogs pa rnams kyi tha snyad kyi dbang gis mdo sde de dang der zhe sa'i tshul nges pa ltar bshad kyi/ gzhan du na/ bsam pa bzang pos mchil lham zhig /thub pa'i dbu la bzhag pa dang / /zhes sogs bzhi brgya par gsungs pa ltar/ rgan mo ka tsa lis ston 497

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/pa'i sku la 'khril bzhin du bden pa mthong ba lta bu ches mang ngo/ /de lta na'ang gong du bshad pa'i yon tan khyad par ba de dag lhag por 'thob pa'i phyir du/ gzhan yang 'jig rten phal cher ni gtsang sbra la dga' zhing mos pa nyid yin pas/ de dag gi bsam pa'i dbang gis ni phyag dar la'ang brtson 'grus bskyed par bya ste/rgyal po gtum po zhig mgron la bos kyang phu dud dang rim gro bya ba ches chen po dgos na/ sangs rgyas chos kyi rgyal po sa gsum gyi 'dren pa gcig pu ba lta ci smos/ gal te sgrub pa'i nan tan cher mi nus pa zhig yin kyang las 'di la bslab par bya ste/ yul 'khor skyong gis zhus pa las/ sangs rgyas 'jig rten phan pa drang srong che/ /bskal pa bye ba brgya lam 'byung srid tsam/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams ni u dum wa ra ltar 'byung bar dka' ba yin la/ sangs rgyas 'byung ba med par ni bsod nams kyi zhing rmad du byung ba nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas gzhan yang mi 'byung bas na/ su zhig zhing khyad par can dang phrad bzhin du bsod nams mi byed pa de dag ni smad pa ste/rkang pa gnyis kyis sa la 'gro shes pa tsam mo/ /des na tshe gang dus brgya'i za ma lan gcig de nan gyis za ba ltar 'phrad dka' zhing phrad na yun du 'tsheng ba'i bsod nams kyi zhing de sgo du ma 498

gtsug lag khang phyag dar gyi gtam/ pod/ 5nas mnyes par bgyi ba'i thabs la nan tan du bya bar shes dgos/de shes pas mi chog chung ngu na chu thigs pa re tsam gyis bsod nams gsog pa'i thabs la 'bad dgos/ de la 'bad pa'ang phyag dang mchod pa sogs sha thang thang gi ngal ba mang po la bsten mi nus na tshegs chung ngus don chen po ster ba'i thabs mchog yang dag pa phyag dar gyi las 'di tsam la rtag tu nan tan bya ste/ gang zhig dge ba'i las sla ba yang mi byed na shin tu smad do zhes rnam bshad rig par gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /'di na ched du bya ba dman pa lto 'geng pa tsam zhig 'dod pas kyang nya bda' ba dang ri dwags bshor ba dang zhing rmod pa la sogs pa mi bzad pa'i gdungs pa bsten cing / skar chen zhwar gyon/ snal ma'i lcag brab/ba mo lham du byas te cang mi sems par snying sran skyed na/ ched du bya ba dam pa rang gzhan thams cad kyi don nam/ min du zin kyang rang nyid kyi tshe rabs kun tu phan dang bde ba'i dga' ston mi nyams par bya ba la da lta phyag dar gyi ngal ba chung ngu tsam zhig tu ma zad kyi de bas ches lhag pa'i dka' thab kyang ci'i phyir mi ༄ bsten te/ bsod nams stobs kyi rtogs pa brjod pa las/bsod nams bsags na bde bar 'gyur/ /de phyir mi yis bsod nams bsags/ yang dang yang du bsod nams bsags/ /de 499

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/nyid la ni 'dun te bya/ /zhes sogs 'jig rten pha rol tu sgren mo lag pa stong par chas te 'gro ba na bsod nams ma gtogs pa skyabs dang dpung gnyen gzhan med par rnam grangs du mas bstan pa ltar yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de skad du'ang 'phags pa zhi ba lhas/ dka' zlog dad dang karṇa pa/ /bsregs dang bcad sogs tshor ba ni/ /don med bzod byed thar ba yi/ /don du bdag ko ci zhig sdar/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gzhan yang tshong dang jag bya ba la sogs pa rgyu sgrub pa'i dus su ngal ba mang zhing / 'bras bu myong ba'i dus kyang sdug bsngal pa/ de dag la yang skye bo rmongs pa rnams rgod dur khrod la dga' ba bzhin du 'jug na/ gnas khang byi dor tsam zhig gis dkon mchog gsum la bla mar bya ba'i cho ga 'di ni rgyu'i dus sa tshegs chang la/ rnam smin gyi tshor ba yid 'ong rang rangakho nar 'char ba'i phyir yang ci ste mi brtson te/ spyod 'jug las/spu gri'i sor chags sbrang rtsi lta'i/ /'dod pa rnams kyis mi ngoms na/ /rnam smin bde la zhi ba yi/ /bsod nams kyis lta ci ste ngoms/ /zhes gsungs/ de'i phyir bde ba'i don du byas par rlom kyang bde ba'i rgyur 'gyur min ma nges pa rnams byed pa bas/ mtha' gcig tu bde bar 'gyur ba'i bsod nams kyi sgo 'phar 'di dbye ba'i rigs so/ /500

gtsug lag khang phyag dar gyi gtam/ pod/ 5gnyis pa phyag dar gyi tshul dngos ni/ bshad ma thag pa'i yon tan rnams dngos su 'dren byed kyi phyag dar ni/ phyag dar tsam zhig min gyi/ khyad par ba zhig dgos so/ /de ni 'di ltar zhing gi che ba bla ma'am mkhan po sogs dngos su bzhugs pa'i gnas sam/ mchod rten dang sku gzugs dang sde snod kyi glegs bam bzhugs pa'i lha khang lta bu dang / de dag min kyang gnas der bdag nyid kyi mos pa'i stobs kyis bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas mngon sum du spyan drang bar 'dod pa gang rung zhig dgos kyi/de lta ma yin na sa ga ma bag mar 'gro ba la gzas pa'i tshe/ de'i mas me long byi dor gyis shig par bsgos pa'i don/ khyim me long 'dra ba'i ga dar bya ba'i don du bshad pa lta bu'i 'jig rten gyi rig pa rnams kyang ha cang thal bar 'gyur ro/ /bsam pa'i che ba/sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' bla ma dang slob dpon du bcas pa la chos kyi rje bo'i 'du shes dang / bdag nyid la chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i khol po'i 'du shes dang / phyag dar la ri mor bya ba'i 'du shes dang / thabs 'di la brten nas rnam par grol ba'i yon tan gyi phung po lnga rdzogs par bya ba'i 'du shes bskyed de bya zhing / blo sbyong gi dmigs rnam skyong ba'i sbyor chos sa byed pa la ༄ni/ tshogs zhing la dang ba'i dad pa/ lam gyi myong ba la 'dod 501

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/pa'i dad pa/ phyag gar gyi phan yon la yid ches pa'i dad pa ste gsum ka tshang ba zhig dgos so/ /phyag dar ni lus kyi rnam rig ste/mdzod las/ don dam pa dang ngo bo nyid dang mtshungs ldan dang kun slong gi dge ba bzhi bshad pa'i nang tshan ka ra ni ra las skyes pa'i me tog zer ba ltar bsam pa'i dbang gis dge bar 'gyur ba kun slong gi dge ba yin pas kun slong bzang ba zhig ci nas kyang gces so/ khyad par rgyal ba sras bcas rnams kyi spyan sngar bdag nyid zham ring du gnas pa'i 'du shes yang dang yang du bzhag ste 'bangs rgyal po'i mdun sar bab col mi byed pa bzhin du ma gus pa skad cig kyang mi bgyid par phyag dar sri zhu'i dran pa nye bar gnas na mtshan mo'i rmi lam la yang sangs rgyas dang dge 'dun rjes su dran pa 'byang ba tsam gyi bag chags 'thag por 'gro zhing /11re/ ra//rto rig pa //nge/ /rdo / ltar song na 'ate ka dang bar do la sogs par ba na gshegs pa'i sku'i snang ba nges par 'byung la/ gzhan yang snam sbyar dge sbyong gi dran pa gso byed du bsngags pa ltar/ phyag dar gyi sbyor bas sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa yang yang drang na de la brten nas ngo tsha dang khrel yod kyi bsam pas nyes spyod chen po'i sdig ltung mang po zhig kyang 'gog nus te/ spyod 'jug tu/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dag /kun tu thogs med gzigs 502

gtsug lag khang phyag dar gyi gtam/ pod/ 5par ldan/ /de dag thams cad spyan snga na/ /rtag par bdag ni gnas so zhes/ /de ltar bsams nas ngo tsha dang / /gus dang 'jigs ldan de bzhin mnos/ /zhes gsangs pa bzhin no/ /sbyor ༄ba'i che ba/ sla las dang khral chos su ma song bar brtson 'grus kyi ngo bo dge ba la spro ba yin pas spro shugs drag tu bskyed de/ thog mar rdul mi ldang ba'i phyir chu gtsang gis chag chag btab ste sa gzhi'i khams cung zad brlan la/ dal zhing 'jam pa'i spyod lam gyis rnga ma'i phon po'am rtsa'i chun po blang bas rdul rnams bags kyis phyags zin pa dang / ba'i lci ba 'jam po'i rkyang nul bya zhing spos sam dri bzang po'i shing gi dud pas bdugs te rang gzhan gyi rgyud la dang ba 'dren nges par bya'o/ /de'ang rten gyi gang zag byang chub sems dpa' zhig yin na ni phal po che las gsungs pa ltar spyod yul yongs su dag pa'i smon lam gyi rgyas gdab par bya ste/'di ltar/ des ni dmigs pa rgya chung ngu dang lhag pa'i bsam pa'i cho ga nyi tshe ba tsam zhig mi bya'i/ mkha' ltar gos pa ma mchis pa'i ye shes kyi sgo la brten te/ chos thams cad sgra brnyan dang sprul ba'i rang bzhin du tshul bzhin yid la byed do/ /de ltar yid la byas nas bdag nyid rmi lam gyi mi lta bur mos so/ /phung po lnga chu shing lta bur mos so/ /zhing thams cad dri za'i grong khyer ltar mos 503

stuXs/ 5 lngardogrub 'jigs ni/da bstan nyi:rno gaṭa/nga 'dra/ma/so/ /phyag dar la smig rgyu'i gar lta bur mos so/ /sangs rgyas thams cad sgyu ma'i rnam pa lta bur mos so/ /bsgul bskyod thams cad chu nang gi zla ba lta bur mos so/ /de de ltar lhag par yid la byed pas chos thams cad rtog pa'i dbang gis btags pa tsam ma gtogs don rang ngos nas btags don 'tshol bas 'thad pas grub pa rdul tsam yang med par rtogs nas phal po che'i bzod pa'i le'u nas bshad pa 'dra ba sgra brnyan lta bu'i bzod pa dang cha mthun pa'i ye shes kyis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi spyan snga na rang gi lus rgya mtsho byin gyis rlabs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la ri mor bya ba'i slad du lus re re la lag pa zhing gi rdul snyed dang / lag pa re re la ba spu zhing gi rdul snyed dang / ba spu re re la 'od zer zhing gi rdul snyed/ 'od zer re re la yang lag pa rnam par phye ba zhing gi rdul snyed dang de snyed kyi phyag dar bya ba'i tshul rgya mtsho bsam gyis mi khyab par dmigs pa ni/ phyag mchod dpag med bzhi ldan dang / bstod dbyangs yan lag rgya mtsho bzhin no//de ltar phyag dar gyi las de la zhugs nas smon lam bsam gyis mi khyab pa yongs su bsngo ste/ 'di ltar bdag gis phyag dar gyi sri zhus rgyal ba sras bcas la phu dud bgyis pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis/ bdag sangs rgyas thams cad kyi spyan sngar kun tu bzang 504

gtsug lag khang phyag dar gyi gtam/ pod/ 5 po khya mchog gi mthu phyang ba'i lus kyis phyi ma'i mu mthar thag gi raX —rig skur zi sna zurang su sna nor zurarabar du gnas ta sangs rgyas mchad pa dang // ram grar bya ba' tshul rgya mtsho yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / 'jig rten khams thams cad kyi ngan song dang sdug bsngal gyi rdul ma lus pa byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i phyag mas 'ded cing rnam par sbyang ba dang / phyogs bcu'i zhing thams cad na bde bar ga shegs pa'i bstan pa rin po che'i gzhal med khang ji snyed cig gnas so cog bdag gi byang chub sems dpa'i snying stobs kyis ga dar byed cing / bdud dang mu stegs lta ba ngan pa'i rdul thams cad thabs stobs smon lam gyis phyag mas 'ded pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi don du khyu mchog rwa chad pa lta bu'i sems khengs dregs dang nga rgyal med pas gnas te phyag dar ltar dman pa'i las rnams kyang rang nyam sa su bstar ba dang / nam zhig bla na med pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas te sangs rgyas kyi zhing rdul dang tha ba las 'das pa/ lag mthil ltar bde zhing 'jam la mnyes pa mgon po don thams cad grub pa'i zhing bkod mdo sde dkon mchog 'byung gnas su bshad pa lta bu'i yon tan yongs su grub par 'gyur ba de lta de ltar dmigs pa tshad med pa'i rjes su song ba'i smon lam 'debs te/ 'di ni 505

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi phu dud kyi sgo 'phar ches che ba zhig yin pa'i phyir/ 'phags pa rtag tu ngus kyang byang chub sems dpa' chos 'phags la bla mar bya ba'i phyir 'khor gyi khyams su tsandan gyi chus chag chag gdab par brtsams pa las bdud kyi rdzu 'phrul gyis chab thams cad mi snang bar byas pas rang gi rtse'u (mthe'u) chung gtar ba'i khrag gis chag chag btab ste do gal che che mdzad pa'ang don gyi dbang de ltar gzigs nas yin pas gnad shin tu che'o/ /de ltar bas na bsod nams gsog par 'dod pas thabs 'di la nan tan du bya ba'i rigs so/ /dben pa'i bya skyibs brag ri'i ba gam can/ /shing lo'i grib bsil mi mthun med pa na/ /mu to'i kun spyod 'dzin pa'i gzhon nu zhig /bsod nams gtam gyi rol mo ci yang 'khrol/ /de dge dri med padmo mdangs 'dra bas/ /skye zhing skye bar bshes gnyen mthong ba dang / /zhi ba'i nags rir yon tan mchog tshogs can/ /bzang po spyod pa'i rnam thar 'dzin gyur cig /gtsug lag khang phyag dar gyi gtam bsod nams sprin gyi rnga sgra zhes bya ba 'di'ang rdo rong gi sprang po 'jigs med bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis rang lo nyer gcig pa shing bya cho 'phrul gyi zla ba'i rgyal ba drug pa'i nyin lhun grub rang byung gi brag skyibs la brten pa'i shing sā la'i lcugs 506
gtsug lag khang phyag dar gyi gtam/ pod/ 5phran gyi lding khang dben zhing nyams dga' bar sbyar ba dge zhing bkra shis/ /sarba maṅga lo// //507

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gyi/ /me tog mchod pa'i gtam bzhugs so/ /bla ma sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /da lta rang cag rnams kyis shin tu rnyed par dka' ba'i mi'i lus rten gtsang ma dang /bsod nams kyi zhing mchog bla na med pa rnyed pa'i dus 'dir zhing gi mchog la ji ltar nus pa bzhin du sa bon ci thebs byas nas/gcig pur rang lus tshun chad shul du bor nas srid pa gzhan du 'gro ba'i dus su 'khyer rgyu'i rgyags skal mi pham pa re ci nas kyang byed dgos te/ da res kyi byed stangs la bltas na yang srid med pa'i go 'phang la re ba zad/ de phan chad/ 'di las ches mchog dgos pa gzhan ma mchis/ /zhes pa de 'di la 'bab pa yin/ tha na chu dang me tog gi mchod pa tsam la'ang gus par bya zhing bsgrims nas bya ste/ bsags na grog mkhar 'phel 'gyur la/ /spyad na mig sman zad 'gyur ba/ /zhes pa ltar de tsam yang bsags na mang por 'gro ba'i phyir dang / las 'phel che ba'i phyir dang / lhag par yang zhing gi mthu la brten pa'i las phra mo gcig kyang 'bras bu rgya che zhing yangs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa skye ba'i phyir ro/ /de la me tog rnams ni shin tu gtsang la dbyibs 508

me tog mchod pa'i gtam/ pod/ 5dang kha dog dang dri bsang dang reg bya'i yon tan phan sam tshogs rig mi ra mi rig mishing chos nyid kyis 'jig rten dga' ba skyed pa'i yo byad mchog yin pas rgyal po chen po'i lag gis phul yang mi 'tshams pa med la/dbyibs dang kha dog tha dad pa dang dri bsung sna tshogs pa dang chu dang thang dang shing las skyes pa'i rigs mi 'dra ba dpag tu med pas dbyar dus sa chen po 'di bkab nas skye bas sprang po rnams kyis kyang phangs med du rnyed/ de'ang sdig med du rnyed pas dngos po shin tu dag ci tsam phul yang ser sna dang 'gyod pa sogs mi skye bas sbyor mjug dngos gzhi kun tu bsam pa'ang dag po 'ong /gnas khang ngan ngon yin yang me tog gis brgyan na dga' tshal bzang po ltar snang zhing sems lha yul ltar dang bar byed pas mchod rdzas gcig la mthu che/ smra 'dod kyi seng ges gnas khang me tog gis brgyan pa la brten nas sems gnas rnyed de 'bras bu thob par gsungs pa lta bu sems dang ba la yon tan gzhan yang mang / lha rnams kyang me tog la mchod rdzas bzang shos su brtsi ste mngon par byang chub ma thag pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa la yang dang por lha'i me tog rnams kyis mchod par rgya cher rol pa las gsungs/ dag pa'i zhing na'ang mchod rdzas kyi dam par byed de 'od mdo las/ de dag me tog kha dog tha dad pa/ /dri zhim yid 509

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ 'ong mang po snyim thogs te/ /tshe dpag med pa lha dang mis mchod pa/ /mi yi 'dren pa mchog la rab tu 'thor/ /zhes pa lta bu/des na 'phags pa rtag tu ngus chos 'phags pa dang / nor bzang gis rje btsun byams pa mjal ba na yang dang por me tog gtor bas mchod par gsungs shing / zhing tha dad kyi rgyal ba nang phan tshun mchod pa'i skyes skur ba na yang me tog la skyes mdzad par mdo sde du ma las gsungs so/ /de lta bu'i mchod rdzas phul ba'i phan yon phyogs tsam ni/ za ma tog lta bu'i gtam las/me tog bzang po dge 'dun la/ /rab tu 'thor zhing mchod byed pa/ /brgya byin las lhag longs spyod ldan/ /padma'i dbang po lta bur mdzes/ /mchog tu grags pa dang ldan zhing / /rtag tu de ni skad cig gis/ /dgra las rnam par rgyal ba dang / /sa rnams la ni spyod byed 'gyur/ /zhes longs spyod che ba dang / lus mdzes pa dang / grags pa dang ldan pa dang / dgra las rgyal ba dang /dbang phyug che ba rnams gsungs te/ mchod pa'i yul la dge 'dun zhes 'byung ba ni mtshon byed tsam ste/ rang sangs rgyas zhing gi rdul rnyed la bskal pa gaṅgā'i bye snyed du lha'i zas dang na bzas mchod pa bas sangs rgyas la dmigs nas me tog cig nam mkha' la bor ba bsod nams ches che bar me tog brtsegs pa'i gzungs 510

me tog mchod pa'i gtam/ pod/ 5las gsungs pa bslab btus su drangs so/ /dkon brtsegs kyi blo gros bzang mos zhus pa dang dri ma med kyis byin pas zhus pa las ni/ padma dang utpal sogs kyis lag pa bkang ste sangs rgyas la phul bas de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyan sngar rin po che'i padma chen po rnams las brdzus te skye ba'i phan yon gsungs so/ /'dul ba lung las kyang / mkhas pa gang gis sangs rgyas mchod rten la/ /dga' ba'i sems kyis me tog sil ma spungs/ /dzam bu'i chu gser snod du bzhag pa ni/ /stong phrag brgya yang de dang mnyam pa min/ /zhes gsungs te sangs rgyas la me tog phul ba'i phan yon rin thang brtsi na dzam bu'i chu bo'i gser gyis gtams pa'i snod 'bum phrag gis kyang de'i tshad du mi slebs ces pa'o/ /gzhan yang spyan ras gzigs zhes bya ba'i mdo sogs mdo sde rnams su shes par bya'o/ /sangs rgyas bzhugs dus mchod pa dang / mya ngan las 'das rjes su de la dmigs te mchod pa bsod nams skye ba la mnyam par ga sungs shing / lha rnams kyis me tog man dā ra ba phul ba dang / rang res me tog ser chen sogs phul ba'ang mnyam par nges te/ gang 'byor de phul bas bsam pa'i khyad par bzhin 'bras bu 'byung gi dngos po mi gtso ba'i phyir te/ gsal rgyal dang dbul mo grong nyul mas mar me phul ba'i lo rgyus bzhin no//511

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/phan yon de dag bsam nas dga' spro chen pos 'jug par rigs te/ khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis thab pa la mchod pa'i ༄phyir rgyal po'i ldum ra srung ba la padma gcig kho na'i rin du gser srang 'bum phrag 'das par byas tshul las brgya pa las 'byung ba dang / jo bo rje lha cig gis me tog shang dril 'di rgya gar na med/yod na ngas gser 'jal nus gsungs pa sogs bsod nams kyi mdzod zad mi shes pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams kyang 'di la ched cher mdzad na/ 'o skol lta ci smos pa'i phyir ro/ /de'ang dug gi me tog mchod rdzas su mi rung la/ gzhan me tog gsar ba ma nyams shing / gtsang ma'i phyogs su skyes pa rnams srog chags yod med brtags te med par shes na kha dang lag pa bkrus la btu/ sil ma dang phreng bar byas nas mchod pa so sor spyod 'jug tu gsungs shing phan yon yang blo gros mi zad pas bstan pa sogs nas so sor bshad pas gang 'dod dam gnyis ka bya/ sil ma 'bul na snyim pa legs par bkang / phreng bar byas pa yin na lag pa gnyis kas btegs/ gang ltar yang sangs rgyas kyi yon tan rjes su dran par bya zhing / yon tan mi shes na'ang sangs rgyas la dmigs pa sngon du btang ste/ bdag gis 'di ltar phul ba'i me tog 'di dag dkon mchog tā lar/ me tog phal cher me tog bla 512

me tog mchod pa'i gtam/ pod/ 5bre dang / /sogs dang / phung po gsum pa'i mdo las/ me tog thams cad kyi bla re bres pa'i rgyan gyis chos kyi dbyings kun tu gnas par gyur cig ces sogs ltar phyogs bcu'i zhing rab 'byams kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad du lha rdzas kyi me tog bkod pa'i bla bre dang khang brtsegs dang chun 'phyang la sogs par gyur te/ de dag re re las kyang rin po che dang me tog la sogs pa'i char gyis nam mkha'i khams thams cad rgyas par 'gengs pa'i 'od zer gyi sprin rgya mtsho 'byung zhing /phyi ma'i mu mthar gnas par gyur cig snyam du bsam la dbul zhing /'od mdo las/ longs la nub phyogs su phyogs te me tog gtor la thal mo sbyor te phyag tshol cig ces gsungs ltar thal mo sbyor ba dang phyag 'tshal ba'ang bya/ sku gzugs dang mchod rten la 'bul ba yin na/ sngo na du de'i nye 'khor gyis phyogs byi dor bya zhing / sngar phul ba'i me tog rnying pa yod na phyags te skye bos mi 'gom pa'i phyogs su dor la gdod phul na legs te/ de 'dra'i me tog nyal nyil 'phyags pa dang / gsar pa phul ba gnyis bsod nams mnyam par mdo las gsungs so/ /mjug tu sngar dkon brtsegs drangs nas bshad pa'i phan yon sogs la bsam pa thag pa nas dmigs pa'i smon lam gdab cing / rin po che'i 513

pod/ 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/phreng ba nas 'byung ba'i tshigs bcad nyi shu pa sogs shes na ngag tu'ang brjod par bya'o/ /de dag gi tshe skye bo gzhan dag kyang grogs su bskul nas gnyis char gyis byed pa dang / gzhan yang pha ma sogs rgan 'khogs dang nad pa me tog 'thur 'gro mi nus pa rnams la'ang byin te mchod du 'jug pa dang / khyim pa ser sna can dang byis pa rnams kyang thabs mkhas pas rna ba gtod cing 'dzin du gzhug nus na tshul 'di la sbyor ba dang / phyogs su 'gro ba'i lam gar yi ge drug ma rdo la brkos pa gcig mthong yang me tog btogs nas mchod pa tshun chad kyis goms par byas na sgo du ma nas bsod nams kyi stobs rgyas te ji skad bshad pa'i phan yon thams cad myur du 'thob pa ni lung las/ zla ba skar ma bcas pa gnas ltung zhing / /ri dang nags tshal bcas pa'i sa g.yos la/ /nam mkha'i khams ni gzhan du 'gyur srid kyi/ /khyod ni mi bden pa yi tshig mi gsungs/ /zhes gsungs pa lta ba'o/ /zhes pa'ang cha rigame ༄༄mistod zla ba'i me tog gi chun po zhig na re/ kho bo'i gtam nyung gsal zhig bris zhes bskul nas mi rgan rnam rtog rgya mtsho ca co mthas yas zhes bya bas shang shang dril bu rlung bskyod kyi ldem bag g.yo ba'i bas mtha'i gtsug lag khang nyams dga' bar bris pa'o////514

pod 5— bsgrigs rjes kyi gtam/de yang mdo khams rol chen bco brgyad las/ rma rol dang /smar rol/ rdo rol/ zla rol sogs su gtso bor chags pa'i lcags mo mgo log pa 'di dag yongs grags ltar na phal cher spyi lo'i dus rabs bcu bzhi ba'i mjug ste bod rab byung bdun pa tshugs ma thag tsam la khams 'gu kho lung nas gnas spo byas te/ da lta'i mgo log padma rdzong gi sa cha gtso bor gyur ba'i rdo 'dzi smar gsum gyi yul gru bdag gir byas nas ring du ma song ba na/ mgo log phag thar gyi sras su kaḥthog bla ma byang chub seng ge'i thugs zin gyi slob bu mkhas shing grub pa'i bdag nyid chen po mgo log bla ma chos 'bum bya ba 'khrungs pas dbu bzung / rim bzhin kar rnying bstan pa'i sgron me karma yongs 'dzin chen po dang / zhwa nag sku phreng bcu ba mchog sprul chos dbyings rdo rje/ bcu gcig pa chen po ye shes rdo rje/ zhwa dmar bdun pa ye shes snying po/ rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pa'i yang sprul de ma thag pa mkhyen brtse ye shes rdo rje/ zhe chen rab 'byams lnga ba kun bzang bstan pa'i nyi ma sogs gangs 1

pod 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/can bstan 'gro'i rtsa lag chen por gyur ba dag dang / gzhan yang mkhas pa'i khyu mchog mdo sngags chos kyi rgya mtsho/ grub pa'i dbang po gtsang ba byams pa chos 'dzin/ smra ba'i dbang phyug rdo grub bstan pa'i nyi ma/ gtsug lag rtsis kyi nyin byed phyag mdzod byams pa gsung rab/ sman rgyal g.yu thog gnyis pa lha rje stag bla nor bu/lo rgyus smra ba'i dbang po gyi lung sras po sku mched/ rtsod rigs smra ba'i seng chen 'gya ba a lags mdo sngags/ sbas pa'i rnal 'byor chen po khra dge slong tshul khrims dar rgyas/ yongs 'dzin chen po 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros/ bstan pa'i nyin byed a rig dge bshes chen mo/ gsang chen bka' babs shar wod grags pa bzang po/ mdo rgyud smra ba gyang sprul don yod rdo rje/ nges pa don gyi paṇḍi ta sku phyogs shing bza' sku phreng / rtsod bral dus babs kyi gter chen khrag 'thung bdud 'joms gling pa/ rab 'byams gzhung brgya smra ba'i mkhan chen a skong blo bzang rdo rje/ theg mchog smra ba'i bka' babs kun bzang bde skyong dbang mo sogs mkhas dbang nor bu'i phreng ba zam ma chad par yul 'dir sku 'khrungs pa'am dus yun ring por bzhugs te mdzad phrin rgya cher bskyangs pa dang /dgon gnas dang dge 'dun gyi 'dus sde dag smra ma dgos/ khyim pa sbra nag pa dag gi khrod du'ang yig tshang lo rgyus gleng ba'i dge 2

bsgrigs rjes kyi gtam/ pod 5 thon cing / dpe gtam sgrung rgyud 'chad la mnga' brnyes pa/ dkar nag rtsis kyi 'phrul la thogs pa med cing / gso byed sman gyi lugs la dbang 'byor ba/ ri mo dang yi ge'i bzo rtsal la mdzes byang gi cha khyad du thon pa sogs mang du byung 'dug par brten de dag gis mdzad pa'i bstan bcos rig gnas kyi shul bzhag tu gyur ba par ma dang bris ma'i glegs bam du byas pa'ang da lta'i bar mi nyung ba zhig bzhugs yod pa la/ spyir grub mtha'i dbang du byas na yul 'dir snga 'gyur rnying ma ba dang / ri bo dge ldan pa/ mnyam med bka' brgyud pa/ rgyal ba jo nang ba sogs bod brgyud nang ba stan gyi grub mtha' che rigs phal cher zhig mnyam gnas su bzhugs shing / sa bab kyi dbang du byas tshe'ang mdo khams/ lho byang 'brel mtshams su chags yod pa sogs kyi dbang gis yul 'di'i rig gnas spyi dang dmangs khrod kyi rig gnas tshun chad la mdo khams rig gnas ma lag gnyis ka 'dres pa las byung ba'i khyad chos thun mong ma yin pa zhig yod par brten/ myur skyob dang zhib 'jug dpyad gzhi'i rin thang 'gangs che ba zhig yod par gdon mi za/de'i phyir spyir bod kyi rig gnas 'dzin skyong spel gsam gyi ༄ bya bzhag la rang ngos kyi nus shugs 'bul ba dang / sgos thun min 3

pod 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rang khyad thon pa'i sa gnas rig gnas shul bzhag myur skyob dang dar spel byed pa'i kun slong gis bskul te/ nged las khungs nas 'tshol bsdu sgrig gsum gyi bya ba yun ring spel mthar dpe rnying mi nyung ba zhig lag son byung ba las bdams pa brgyud/ 〈mgo log sa khul mkhas dbang rim byon gyi gsung rtsom gces bsgrigs dpe tshogs〉zhes pa zhig bsgrigs nas rim par dpe deb skor zhig par du skrun par rgya che'i klog pa po dag gi gdeng 'jog legs po dang 'brel yod sde khag gi gzengs bstod thob/ rting skul de dag gi rmang gzhi'i steng〈krung go'i grangs nyung mi rig gna' rtsom spyi byang gnad bsdus〉lag star byed pa'i go skabs dang bstun te nga tshos rim pa sngar las spags te/ slar yang〈mgo log dpe rnying dpe tshogs〉kyi par skrun jus gzhi gsar ba zhig bzos nas khul srid gzhung dang 'brel yod mgo khrid la yar zhu byas pas rgyab skyor dang khas len legs par thob par brten da lta jus gzhi dngos su lag star byed pa'i skal ba legs po thob/de la 'dir〈dpe tshogs〉'di nyid 'tshol sdud dang dag sgrig rtsom sgrig par skrun bcas kyi skor gsal bshad du 'os pa 'ga' zhig zhu ba 'di lta ste/1 nga tshos bya ba 'di spel ba la mgo log khul u dang / khul 4

bsgrigs rjes kyi gtam/ pod 5dmangs chen/ khul srid gzhung / khul srid gros bcas 'go khrid tshan skor che bzhi dang 'brel yod sde khag gi 'gan 'khur ba las grub pa'i ched don 'go khrid tshan chung btsugs thog 'brel yod don bya gang ci'i thad bka' skor snyan seng zhus pa'i dgongs don ltar bsgrubs pa yin la/ ched dmigs bya ba'i jus gzhi yig thog nas khul mi dmangs srid gzhung la zhus te chog mchan thob cing brgyud spel gnang ba dang bstun pa sha stag yin/ dus mtshungs su ma phyi'i yig rnying yod tshad so so'i 'brel yod gnyer bdag dang chos bdag dgon bdag sogs brgyud de tshul ldan lugs mthun sgos 'tshol sdud byas shing / khong tshor gros zhu byas te par skrun byed par thugs mthun yid 'thad byung ba yin la/ rgyun srol lam gsang ba sngags dang 'brel ba sogs kyi dbang gis bka' dog dgos min dag kyang khong tsho'i dgongs 'dod bka' 'khrol dang bstun pa ma gtogs nged cag gi lag tu gang son ltar gzu lum sger gcod byas pa gcig kyang med/2 mthan rkyen 'byor ba'i gnas bab 'og gsung 'bum ༄gcig la'ang bris ma dang par ma'i ma phyi ci rnyed cig nye bar bsdus te phan tshun bsdur gshib sgos gang rgyas shos kyi rmang gzhi'i steng gzhan las kha bskangs shing / dmangs khrod du kha 'thor du 5

pod 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bzhugs pa'i thor bu dag kyang lag tu ci 'ong gis gsab snon byas yod pas/ so so'i gsung 'bum gang la mtshon na'ang mig snga ltar na da lta'i〈dpe tshogs〉'dir 'khod pa kho na kha tshang shos dang rgyas shos su brtsi chog snyam/3 gsung chos go rim sgrig stangs skor la sngon gyi ma phyi gang legs shos su snang ba de'i sgrig stangs gzhir bzhag gi rmang gzhi'i steng gcig 'gyur dang dgos dbang sogs la gzhigs te rtsom sgrig pa nas las babs kyi 'gan dbang spyad de 'os 'tsham gyi skyar sgrig dang slar sdeb kyang byas yod/4 ma phyi phal cher la dpe chod yang yang bgyis la tshad ldan gyi par gzhi med pa sogs kyi dbang gis yi ge mi dag cing / chad lhag shor ba/ go rim 'chol ba/ ma yig mi gsal ba sogs cung mang ba la rang blos lcigs pa 'khrul med du snyam pa dag legs par bcos shing dag par bsgrigs la/ dogs gzhir mthong ba du ma zhig gzigs pa yangs shing de phyogs su nang rgyus che ba'i mkhas pa du mar drung bcar bka' 'dri yang yang byas te dogs pa chod pa dag de bzhin du bcos/ re zhig khungs lung mi gsal zhing dpog par dka' ba re zung 'dug pa phyis kyi dpyad gzhir zin bris su bgyis thog 'ol tshod kyis ma bcos shing dpyad yams la ma 6

bsgrigs rjes kyi gtam/ pod 5/jibye/ /rdo/rdo //bye/ //bye/ /)tu/ /bye/shā'ajus par ma sor 'a ga byas nga / 'ga' ga la na shas bar 'dod pa'i yi ge de zur gyi zla khyim du bkod yod/5 klog bde bar gzhigs te gsung chos bye brag pa phal mo cher mdzad byang sogs las dras te kha byang bkod cing / sa bcad blangs la/ ldeb byang yang bye brag tu bkod yod/6 ba zur 'dogs min lta bu sogs yi ge skor zhig gi bkol stangs da lta'i dag yig 'ga' zhig dang gcig tu mthun min yod kyang mkhas pa tshad ldan gyi phyag rgyun la thar chags su yod phyin khungs lung re yod srid la phyis su dag yig zhib dpyod pa dag gi dpyad gzhir nye bar mkho yang srid snyam nas ji bzhin sor 'jog byas/ gzhan yang ma yig tu skabs 'gar mkhas pa gzhan gyi gsung thung ngu tsam re yongs su drangs 'dug pa zhib par dpyad tshe gong 'og gi gsung gang rung re de'i zur rgyan nam gsal 'don ci rigs su song ba sogs 'brel shin tu che bas dgos dbang la gzhigs nas 'dir yang ma yig ltar bkod pa lags/bye brag rdo grub chen rin po che 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi ma'i gsung 'bum la gsal bshad du zhu dgos pa zhig ni khong la da reb kyi deb bdun po 'dir 'khod pa las gzhan da dung gsung chos mang tsam yod par nges la de ltar du'ang thos mod dus dbang 7

pod 5 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/du gyur bas yid phangs la/ nga tshos rtsad gcod byas pa ltar na'ang khong gis mdzad pa'i rus mdzod deb gcig da dung yod nges su 'dug kyang da reb lag son ma byung la/ dpal ldan bla ma la rdol thabs kyi ca cos bstod pa ces pa'i rtsom de'ang cung zad kha mi tshang bar 'dug pas slad char don gnyer can dag la thugs 'dog do gzigs kyi las su zhu'o/ /mtshams 'dir slebs tshe nga tshos cis kyang dran yul du bslang bar 'os pa ni〈dpe tshogs〉'di nyid la thog ma tha' gang rung du thugs khur rgyab skyor khyad du gnang zhing 'di nyid kyi ched du sku tshegs 'o brgyal mdzad pa'i 'brel yod 'go khrid dang mkhas dbang blo mthun gyi tshogs dag yin te/ khong cag rnam pa'i rgyab skyor rogs ram dang bral phyin〈dpe tshogs〉'di nyid klog pa po dag gi spyan lam du gzigs mor spro ba'i de ring gi skal ba bzang po 'di nyid nyams par 'gyur bas/ nga tshos khong rnam par lhag bsam dag pas bka' drin zhu ba lags/ lhag par du〈dpe tshogs〉'di nyid 'tshol sdud dang / dag sgrig par skrun sogs gang ci'i thad thugs khur dang phyag ston bla lhag gnang zhing / gnad don du ma'i 'gag mdor gyar ba par skrun ma dngul gyi mthun rkyen sbyor /༷bye/ ni/// 1111 //de /byerje/ba — cha nas bka' —na khyad du na —nga mdzad —sa kun las lhag 8

bsgrigs rjes kyi gtam/ pod 5pa ni khul u'i hru'u ci gzhon pa khul gna' rtsom dpe tshogs 'tshol sdud dag sgrig par skrun 'go khrid tshan chung gi tshan gtso sku zhabs pad ma rnam rgyal lags yin pas rang re 'brel yod mi rabs snga phyi kun nas khong gi bka' drin yid la 'chang zhing rjes su dran par 'os zhes 'di gar ched du gsal 'debs zhus pa lags/ de bzhin rdzong gtso smug lo lags nas kyang sa gnas mi rigs rig gnas phyogs dgongs klong yangs la spyod pa mdzangs pa'i bka' drin bstsal ba mdzad pa dge ba'i phyag rjes su che/gzhan yang zi khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang bod yig rtsom sgrig khang nas nga tshor phyogs gang ci'i thad bla na med pa'i mthun rkyen bskrun cing mi rigs rig gnas la gcig tu brtse ba'i lhag bsam dkar pos phyogs du ma nas dmigs bsal chen po'i mdzad pa bskyangs pas dngos gnas bka' drin che zhu/ lnga rig mkhas pa'i dbang po bshes gnyen chen po ngag dbang bde legs rab rgyas dang / mkhas pa'i dbang po 'ju bkra shis bzang po nas kyang〈dpe tshoṭa〉'di la thugs khur sku tshegs kyi mdzad pa bzhes shing / gsung chos sam mdzad pa po so so la 'brel yod kyi dgon sde bla sprul rnam pas rang ngos kyi mthun rkyen sbyar ba'ang rang re klog pa po dang bcas pas yid la bsrel bar 'os pa nyid do/ /9
